entries.example_en: She had only a vague apprehension of what the proposal would involve.

entries.definition_en: feeling worried or anxious about something that might happen
entries.example_cn: 她对即将到来的面试感到忧虑，昨晚睡不着觉。
entries.example_en: She felt apprehensive about the upcoming interview and couldn't sleep last night.

entries.definition_en: feeling afraid of possible harm or evil
entries.example_cn: 随着头顶乌云密布，人群感到恐惧。
entries.example_en: The crowd was apprehensive as the storm clouds gathered overhead.

entries.definition_en: able to understand things quickly
entries.example_cn: 这个学生对复杂的数学题理解力很强，几分钟就解出来了。
entries.example_en: The student was apprehensive about the complex math problem and solved it in minutes.

entries.definition_en: in a way showing anxiety or fear about something that might happen
entries.example_cn: 她焦虑地等待着医学检查的结果。
entries.example_en: She waited apprehensively for the results of the medical test.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of fear or anxiety about something that might happen
entries.example_cn: 她对即将到来的考试的忧虑让她整夜未眠。
entries.example_en: Her apprehensiveness about the upcoming exam kept her awake all night.

entries.definition_en: a person who learns a trade by working for an expert
entries.example_cn: 他五年前开始当木匠学徒。
entries.example_en: He started as an apprentice carpenter five years ago.

entries.definition_en: to train or employ someone as an apprentice; to be an apprentice to someone
entries.example_cn: 主厨下个月将收这位年轻厨师为徒。
entries.example_en: The master chef will apprentice the young cook next month.

entries.definition_en: serving as an apprentice
entries.example_cn: 他受雇于一位木工大师，做了五年的学徒。
entries.example_en: He was apprenticed to a master carpenter for five years.

entries.definition_en: a position where a person learns a trade by working for an employer
entries.example_cn: 他当了三年木匠学徒后完成了学徒期。
entries.example_en: He completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter after three years.

entries.definition_en: pressed close to or lying flat against something
entries.example_cn: 这种植物的叶子紧压着茎生长。
entries.example_en: The appressed leaves of the plant grow flat against the stem.

entries.definition_en: the act of informing someone by words
entries.example_cn: 经理向员工通报了公司的财务状况。
entries.example_en: The manager gave an apprisal of the company's financial status to the staff.

entries.definition_en: to inform someone about something
entries.example_cn: 公司将通知所有员工新的政策。
entries.example_en: The company will apprise all employees of the new policy.

entries.definition_en: to make someone aware of a fact or situation
entries.example_cn: 请随时告知我任何日程变更。
entries.example_en: Please apprise me of any changes to the schedule.

entries.definition_en: (archaic) to determine the value or worth of something
entries.example_cn: 该房产在出售前被估价。
entries.example_en: The property was apprised before the sale.

usage.label: archaic
usage.pattern: 古义：评估某物的价值，近 appraise

entries.definition_en: (archaic) to put a price on something for sale
entries.example_cn: 该房产被估价以供出售。
entries.example_en: The property was apprised for sale.

entries.definition_cn: （英式非正式）先供顾客检验、不购买即可退回的货物交付安排
entries.definition_en: an informal British term for an arrangement in which goods are supplied for inspection and may be returned if not bought
entries.example_cn: 这些商品是按先检验、不购买即可退回的方式交付的，顾客可以检查后再决定。
entries.example_en: The goods were delivered on appro so the customer could inspect them before deciding.

usage.label: informal British; usually in “on appro”
usage.pattern: w39733r0: goods were delivered on appro

entries.definition_cn: 处理问题或情况的方法或行动
entries.definition_en: ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation
entries.example_cn: 我们需要一种新方法来解决这个问题。
entries.example_en: We need a new approach to solve this problem.

entries.definition_cn: 在空间上靠近某物的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of drawing spatially closer to something
entries.example_cn: 飞机的降落过程平稳而稳定。
entries.example_en: The plane's approach was smooth and steady.

entries.definition_cn: 进入或接近某处的通道
entries.definition_en: a way of entering or leaving
entries.example_cn: 进入城堡的方式是通过旧大门。
entries.example_en: The approach to the castle is through the old gate.

entries.definition_en: to move towards
entries.example_cn: 汽车缓慢地驶向十字路口。
entries.example_en: The car approached the intersection slowly.

entries.definition_en: to begin to deal with
entries.example_cn: 是时候着手处理气候变化问题了。
entries.example_en: It is time to approach the issue of climate change.

entries.definition_en: to come near in time
entries.example_cn: 项目的截止日期快到了。
entries.example_en: The deadline for the project is approaching.

entries.definition_cn: 接近或类似于，在性质或特征上更接近
entries.definition_en: to come near or verge on, resemble, or come nearer in quality or character
entries.example_cn: 他的行为接近专业人士的水平。
entries.example_en: His behavior approaches that of a professional.

entries.definition_cn: 飞机着陆前的进场航线
entries.definition_en: the final path followed by an aircraft as it is landing
entries.example_cn: 飞行员做出了完美的降落路径。
entries.example_en: The pilot made a perfect approach for landing.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being easy to talk to or deal with
entries.example_cn: 经理的平易近人让员工们感到可以安心地提出自己的担忧。
entries.example_en: The manager's approachability made employees feel comfortable sharing their concerns.

entries.definition_en: easy to talk to or do business with
entries.example_cn: 她非常随和，总是愿意帮助同事。
entries.example_en: She is very approachable and always willing to help her colleagues.

entries.definition_en: easy to reach or get to
entries.example_cn: 这个偏远的村庄在冬季很难到达。
entries.example_en: The remote village is not very approachable during the winter months.

entries.definition_en: easy to understand or deal with
entries.example_cn: 这本教科书采用了适合初学者的易懂风格。
entries.example_en: The textbook is written in an approachable style for beginners.

entries.definition_en: of the relatively near future
entries.example_cn: 我们正在讨论即将到来的截止日期。
entries.example_en: We are discussing the approaching deadline.

entries.definition_en: the act of drawing spatially closer to something
entries.example_cn: 汽车的靠近是无声的。
entries.example_en: The approaching of the car was silent.

entries.definition_en: the event of one object coming closer to another
entries.example_cn: 即将到来的风暴促使所有人寻找避难所。
entries.example_en: The approaching storm caused everyone to seek shelter.

entries.definition_en: the temporal property of becoming nearer in time
entries.example_cn: 冬天的临近带来了更短的白昼。
entries.example_en: The approaching of winter brings shorter days.

entries.definition_en: to approve or sanction officially
entries.example_cn: 委员会将于下周正式批准新法规。
entries.example_en: The committee will approbate the new regulations next week.

entries.definition_en: to accept documents as valid
entries.example_cn: 法院毫不犹豫地认可了提交的证据。
entries.example_en: The court approbated the submitted evidence without hesitation.

entries.definition_en: official approval or sanction
entries.example_cn: 该项目获得了市议会的批准。
entries.example_en: The project received the approbation of the city council.

entries.definition_cn: 对某人的工作或品格的赞许或认可
entries.definition_en: praise or recognition for someone's work or character
entries.example_cn: 她的新书终于获得了文学界的认可。
entries.example_en: Her new book finally received the approbation of the literary community.

entries.definition_cn: 表示赞许或正式批准的
entries.definition_en: expressing approval or officially sanctioning something
entries.example_cn: 完成项目后，她得到了老师赞许的点头。
entries.example_en: She received an approbative nod from her teacher after finishing the project.

entries.definition_en: expressing or manifesting praise or approval
entries.example_cn: 演讲中充满了对团队辛勤工作的赞许之词。
entries.example_en: The speech was filled with approbatory remarks about the team's hard work.

entries.definition_en: that can be appropriated
entries.example_cn: 这块土地被认为可用于新的建设项目。
entries.example_en: The land is considered appropriable for the new construction project.

entries.definition_en: suitable for a particular person or place or condition
entries.example_cn: 这是开始项目最合适的时间。
entries.example_en: This is the most appropriate time to start the project.

entries.definition_en: meant or adapted for an occasion or use
entries.example_cn: 他们穿着适合炎热天气的服装。
entries.example_en: They wore appropriate clothing for the hot weather.

entries.definition_en: to give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause
entries.example_cn: 政府决定拨款用于新建学校。
entries.example_en: The government decided to appropriate funds for the new school.

entries.definition_en: to take possession of, especially by force or without permission
entries.example_cn: 敌军强行占有了城镇的物资。
entries.example_en: The enemy troops appropriated the town's supplies.

entries.definition_en: in a way that is suitable for the circumstances
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一套适合正式会议的西装。
entries.example_en: She wore a suit appropriately for the formal meeting.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being specially suitable for a specific purpose
entries.example_cn: 这个会议地点的适宜性堪称完美。
entries.example_en: The appropriateness of the venue for the conference was perfect.

entries.definition_en: behavior that is suitable for a particular situation or occasion
entries.example_cn: 她讲话的得体之处对在场每个人来说都显而易见。
entries.example_en: The appropriateness of her speech was evident to everyone in the room.

entries.definition_en: money set aside by a legislature for a specific purpose
entries.example_cn: 政府批准了一项用于教育改革的新拨款。
entries.example_en: The government approved a new appropriation for education reform.

entries.definition_en: a deliberate act of acquiring something, often without the owner's permission
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家对时尚品牌擅自使用他的设计感到不满。
entries.example_en: The artist was upset by the appropriation of his design by a fashion brand.

entries.definition_cn: （艺术创作中）对借用元素的使用
entries.definition_en: the use of borrowed elements in creating a new work
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家对传统图案的借用赋予了装置作品独特的风格。
entries.example_en: The artist's appropriation of traditional motifs gave the installation a distinctive style.

entries.definition_en: relating to the act of taking something for oneself
entries.example_cn: 该政策的占有性质引发了争议。
entries.example_en: The appropriative nature of the policy sparked controversy.

entries.definition_cn: 为自己使用而取得某物的人；（尤指未经许可的）侵占者
entries.definition_en: someone who takes something for their own use, especially without permission
entries.example_cn: 这位侵占者为了个人利益窃取了公司的知识产权。
entries.example_en: The appropriator stole the company's intellectual property for personal gain.

entries.definition_en: the formal act of approving
entries.example_cn: 该项目获得了市议会的正式批准。
entries.example_en: The project received official approval from the city council.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of liking something or someone good
entries.example_cn: 当老师表扬学生时，她投去了赞许的目光。
entries.example_en: She gave her teacher a look of approval when he praised the student.

entries.definition_en: acceptance as satisfactory
entries.example_cn: 新设计已获得专家的广泛认可。
entries.example_en: The new design has gained widespread approval from experts.

entries.definition_en: a favorable response or endorsement
entries.example_cn: 这篇评论收到了许多读者的好评。
entries.example_en: The review received many messages of approval from readers.

entries.definition_en: to think that something is good or right
entries.example_cn: 我不赞同他粗鲁的行为。
entries.example_en: I do not approve of his rude behavior.

entries.definition_en: to officially agree to or accept something
entries.example_cn: 经理明天将批准预算。
entries.example_en: The manager will approve the budget tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: officially accepted or authorized
entries.example_cn: 该建筑计划已获得市议会批准。
entries.example_en: The building plans have been approved by the city council.

entries.definition_en: an authority with the power to approve something
entries.example_cn: 批准者在施工开始前签署了许可证。
entries.example_en: The approver signed the permit before construction began.

entries.definition_en: showing praise or agreement
entries.example_cn: 听到好消息时，她露出了赞许的微笑。
entries.example_en: She wore an approving smile when she heard the good news.

entries.definition_en: the formal act of giving approval
entries.example_cn: 董事会批准了新预算计划。
entries.example_en: The board gave its approving to the new budget plan.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows approval
entries.example_cn: 她赞许地点了点头，表示同意他的建议。
entries.example_en: She nodded approvingly at his suggestion.

entries.definition_en: not exactly correct or precise
entries.example_cn: 我们只知道项目大概需要多长时间。
entries.example_en: We only have an approximate idea of how long the project will take.

entries.definition_en: very similar in appearance or nature
entries.example_cn: 这两幅画是彼此的近似复制品。
entries.example_en: The two paintings are approximate copies of each other.

entries.definition_en: located very close together
entries.example_cn: 村里的房子彼此邻近。
entries.example_en: The houses in the village are approximate to one another.

entries.definition_en: to be close to or similar to something
entries.example_cn: 冬天的温度接近零摄氏度。
entries.example_en: The temperature approximates zero degrees Celsius in winter.

entries.definition_en: to estimate or judge something tentatively
entries.example_cn: 在我们开始之前，你能估算一下维修费用吗？
entries.example_en: Can you approximate the cost of the repairs before we start?

entries.definition_en: imprecise but fairly close to the correct amount or number
entries.example_cn: 学校大约有500名学生。
entries.example_en: There are approximately 500 students in the school.

entries.definition_en: an estimate of quantity, degree, or worth that is not exact
entries.example_cn: 我们使用π的近似值来计算圆的面积。
entries.example_en: We used an approximation of pi to calculate the area of the circle.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being very close to the true value or identity
entries.example_cn: 对该曲线近似程度的判断取决于它与精确形状的接近程度。
entries.example_en: The approximation of the curve was judged by its closeness to the exact shape.

entries.definition_en: an account that is imprecise or incomplete
entries.example_cn: 他对事件的描述是基于道听途说的，并不准确。
entries.example_en: His approximation of the events was based on hearsay.

entries.definition_en: the surgical act of bringing tissue edges together
entries.example_cn: 外科医生仔细地将伤口边缘对合起来。
entries.example_en: The surgeon performed the approximation of the wound edges carefully.

entries.definition_en: relating to or involving an estimate or approximation
entries.example_cn: 数据的近似性质限制了其精确度。
entries.example_en: The approximative nature of the data limits its precision.

entries.definition_en: equipment consisting of miscellaneous articles needed for a particular operation or sport
entries.example_cn: 租赁套餐包括船只和所有必要的装备。
entries.example_en: The rental package included the boat and all necessary appurtenances.

entries.definition_en: a supplementary component that improves capability
entries.example_cn: 新的软件附加组件允许打印机无线扫描文档。
entries.example_en: The new software appurtenance allows the printer to scan documents wirelessly.

entries.definition_en: belonging or pertaining to something, especially as an appurtenance; ancillary
entries.example_cn: 附属设施包括健身房和游泳池。
entries.example_en: The appurtenant facilities include a gym and a swimming pool.

entries.definition_cn: 失用症的；与失用症有关的
entries.definition_en: relating to or affected by apraxia, especially impaired ability to perform purposeful movements
entries.example_cn: 病人的失用症使她很难扣上衬衫的扣子。
entries.example_en: The patient's apractic condition made it difficult for her to button her shirt.

entries.definition_cn: 尽管运动和感觉功能基本正常，却无法完成协调、有目的的动作或操纵物体
entries.definition_en: inability to perform coordinated, purposeful movements or manipulate objects despite adequate motor and sensory function
entries.example_cn: 这位患者的失用症使她很难使用勺子，尽管她的手很强壮。
entries.example_en: The patient's apraxia made it difficult for her to use a spoon even though her hands were strong.

entries.definition_cn: 失用症的；表现出失用症的
entries.definition_en: relating to or exhibiting apraxia, especially impaired ability to perform purposeful movements
entries.example_cn: 中风影响运动皮层后，出现了失用症状。
entries.example_en: The apraxic symptoms appeared after the stroke affected his motor cortex.

entries.definition_en: a downy yellow to rosy-colored fruit resembling a small peach
entries.example_cn: 她吃了一个甜美的杏子当甜点。
entries.example_en: She ate a sweet apricot for dessert.

entries.definition_en: an Asian tree having clusters of usually white blossoms and edible fruit resembling the peach
entries.example_cn: 杏树在早春开花。
entries.example_en: The apricot tree bloomed in early spring.

entries.definition_en: a pale yellow-orange color like that of an apricot
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一条柔和的杏色连衣裙。
entries.example_en: She wore a dress in a soft apricot color.

entries.definition_en: the belief that knowledge is based on principles that are self-evident to reason or exist independently of experience
entries.example_cn: 这位哲学家批评该理论中的先验论忽视了经验证据。
entries.example_en: The philosopher criticized the apriorism in the theory for ignoring empirical evidence.

entries.definition_cn: 系在身前、用于保护衣物的围裙
entries.definition_en: a garment worn over the front of the body to protect clothing from spills
entries.example_cn: 她在做饭前系上了围裙。
entries.example_en: She tied an apron around her waist before cooking.

entries.definition_en: a paved area where aircraft are parked
entries.example_cn: 飞机滑行到停机坪等待起飞。
entries.example_en: The plane taxied onto the apron to wait for its turn to take off.

entries.definition_en: the part of a stage in front of the curtain
entries.example_cn: 演员们在幕布前的区域表演，而乐队在下方演奏。
entries.example_en: The actors performed on the apron while the orchestra played below.

entries.definition_cn: （高尔夫）果岭前沿及其周边区域
entries.definition_en: the area immediately surrounding or leading onto the green in golf
entries.example_cn: 球滚到了果岭前的区域，然后停在洞口附近。
entries.example_en: The ball rolled onto the apron before stopping near the hole.

entries.definition_en: of an appropriate or pertinent nature
entries.example_cn: 她发表了一句恰当的评论，完美地总结了会议的成果。
entries.example_en: She made an apropos comment that perfectly summarized the meeting's outcome.

entries.definition_en: used to introduce a related or incidental remark
entries.example_cn: 顺便问一句，你听说即将到来的假期了吗？
entries.example_en: Apropos, have you heard about the upcoming holiday?

entries.definition_en: at an opportune time
entries.example_cn: 他来得正是时候，恰好赶上我们需要帮忙搬重家具。
entries.example_en: He arrived apropos, just as we needed help moving the heavy furniture.

entries.definition_en: regarding or concerning; on the subject of
entries.example_cn: 他就拟议中的变动作了简短评论。
entries.example_en: He made a brief remark apropos the proposed changes.

entries.definition_cn: 教堂东端的穹顶或拱顶凹室
entries.definition_en: a domed or vaulted recess at the east end of a church, usually containing the altar
entries.example_cn: 牧师站在教堂的凹室里布道。
entries.example_en: The priest stood in the apse to deliver the sermon.

entries.definition_en: relating to or having the shape of an apse
entries.example_cn: 这座教堂拥有一个长长的后殿式中殿。
entries.example_en: The church features a long apsidal nave.

entries.definition_cn: 行星、彗星或月球椭圆轨道上距其所绕天体最近或最远的点
entries.definition_en: a point in the elliptical orbit of a planet, comet, or moon where it is nearest to or farthest from the body it orbits
entries.example_cn: 这颗彗星每十一年到达一次轨道拱点。
entries.example_en: The comet reaches its apsis every eleven years.

entries.definition_en: a domed or vaulted recess or projection on a building, typically found at the east end of a church and containing the altar
entries.example_cn: 会众在后殿聚集参加晨祷。
entries.example_en: The congregation gathered in the apsis for the morning service.

entries.definition_en: having a natural tendency or inclination to do something
entries.example_cn: 他倾向于夸大事实。
entries.example_en: He is apt to exaggerate the facts.

entries.definition_en: likely to suffer from something unpleasant
entries.example_cn: 这座老建筑在大风中容易倒塌。
entries.example_en: The old building is apt to collapse in strong winds.

entries.definition_en: quick to learn and mentally nimble
entries.example_cn: 她是个机灵的学生，能迅速掌握新概念。
entries.example_en: She is an apt student who grasps new concepts quickly.

entries.definition_en: suitable or appropriate for a particular purpose
entries.example_cn: 那是对这种情况的恰当描述。
entries.example_en: That was an apt description of the situation.

entries.definition_en: lacking wings, typically used to describe certain insects
entries.example_cn: 这种无翼的甲虫无法飞行，依靠跳跃来逃避捕食者。
entries.example_en: The apteral species of beetle cannot fly and relies on jumping to escape predators.

entries.definition_en: having columns at the ends of a building but not along the sides
entries.example_cn: 这座古庙采用无侧柱式设计，柱子仅位于正面和背面。
entries.example_en: The ancient temple was designed in an apteral style with columns only at the front and back.

entries.definition_en: having no wings
entries.example_cn: 这些无翼的昆虫无法从捕食者面前飞走。
entries.example_en: The apterous insects were unable to fly away from the predator.

entries.definition_cn: （茎或叶柄等）没有翅状膜质扩展的
entries.definition_en: Lacking winglike membranous expansions, as a stem or petiole.
entries.example_cn: 这种植物的叶柄没有近缘物种所具有的翅状边缘。
entries.example_en: The plant has an apterous petiole without the winglike margins found in related species.

entries.definition_en: a nocturnal flightless bird of New Zealand with stout legs and a long bill
entries.example_cn: 几维鸟在夜间寻找昆虫。
entries.example_en: The apteryx searches for insects at night.

entries.definition_en: a natural ability to learn or do something well
entries.example_cn: 她很有数学天赋。
entries.example_en: She has a great aptitude for mathematics.

entries.definition_en: relating to or based on natural abilities or talents
entries.example_cn: 能力倾向测试有助于识别学生在不同学科方面的优势。
entries.example_en: The aptitudinal test helps identify students' strengths in different subjects.

entries.definition_en: in an apt, suitable, fitting, or appropriate manner
entries.example_cn: 他恰当地用几句话描述了这种情况。
entries.example_en: He aptly described the situation in a few words.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being appropriate for a specific occasion

entries.example_en: The arboriculturist pruned the old maple tree to promote healthy growth.

entries.definition_en: having a shape or branching pattern like a tree
entries.example_cn: 那棵古老橡树树状的根蔓延在森林地面上。
entries.example_en: The arboriform roots of the ancient oak spread across the forest floor.

entries.definition_en: to develop a tree-like branching structure
entries.example_cn: 这条神经纤维呈树状分成多个分支。
entries.example_en: The nerve fibre arborises into multiple branches.

entries.definition_en: a person who practices arboriculture, especially a specialist in caring for and treating trees
entries.example_cn: 我们请了一位树木医生来修复折断的树枝。
entries.example_en: We hired an arborist to fix the broken branches.

entries.definition_en: to branch out in a way that resembles a tree
entries.example_cn: 叶片中复杂的血管网络从主茎处分枝如树般延伸。
entries.example_en: The complex network of veins in the leaf arborizes from the central stem.

entries.definition_en: the religious worship of trees
entries.example_cn: 古代文化有时会进行树崇拜，相信灵魂居住在最古老的树木中。
entries.example_en: Ancient cultures sometimes practiced arborolatry, believing spirits lived in the oldest trees.

entries.definition_en: relating to, formed by, or resembling trees
entries.example_cn: 树木般的树冠为下方的动物提供了阴凉。
entries.example_en: The arborous canopy provided shade for the animals below.

entries.definition_en: a large group of RNA viruses transmitted by arthropods like mosquitoes and ticks, which can cause fevers, hepatitis, hemorrhagic fever, or encephalitis
entries.example_cn: 脑炎的爆发被追溯到由当地蚊子携带的虫媒病毒。
entries.example_en: The outbreak of encephalitis was traced back to an arborvirus carried by local mosquitoes.

entries.definition_cn: 崖柏属、罗汉柏属或侧柏属的常绿针叶树，供木材生产或观赏
entries.definition_en: an evergreen conifer of the genera Thuja and Thujopsis or the species Platycladus orientalis, grown for timber or ornament
entries.example_cn: 园丁种了一棵侧柏来遮挡后院与街道之间的视线。
entries.example_en: The gardener planted an arborvitae to screen the backyard from the street.

entries.definition_en: the branching white matter of the cerebellum
entries.example_cn: 扫描图清楚地显示了小脑的分枝状髓树。
entries.example_en: The scan showed the branching arborvitae of the cerebellum clearly.

entries.definition_en: a framework that supports climbing plants
entries.example_cn: 我们坐在凉棚下享受阴凉和花香。
entries.example_en: We sat under the arbour to enjoy the shade and the flowers.

entries.definition_en: a large heterogeneous group of RNA viruses transmitted by arthropod vectors such as mosquitoes and ticks
entries.example_cn: 前往热带地区的旅行者应接种某些虫媒病毒的疫苗。
entries.example_en: Travelers to tropical regions should be vaccinated against certain arboviruses.

entries.definition_en: any of several evergreen shrubs of the genus Arbutus found in temperate Europe and America
entries.example_cn: 花园里种满了盛开的草莓树灌木。
entries.example_en: The garden is filled with blooming arbutus shrubs.

entries.definition_en: a continuous portion of a circle
entries.example_cn: 该设计包含一个连接两座塔楼的大圆弧。
entries.example_en: The design features a large arc connecting the two towers.

entries.definition_en: something curved in shape
entries.example_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成了一道美丽的弧线。
entries.example_en: The rainbow formed a beautiful arc in the sky.

entries.definition_en: electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field
entries.example_cn: 焊工产生了一道明亮的电弧。
entries.example_en: The welder produced a bright electrical arc.

entries.definition_en: to form an arch or curve
entries.example_cn: 这座桥优雅地呈弧形跨越河流。
entries.example_en: The bridge arcs gracefully over the river.

entries.definition_en: a freestanding buttress connected to a building by an arch
entries.example_cn: 这座哥特式大教堂拥有宏伟的飞扶壁，支撑着高耸的墙壁。
entries.example_en: The Gothic cathedral features magnificent arc-boutants that support the high walls.

entries.definition_cn: 两侧有商店和摊位的有顶通道
entries.definition_en: a covered passageway with shops and stalls on either side
entries.example_cn: 我们穿过市中心繁忙的拱廊街。
entries.example_en: We walked through the busy arcade in the city center.

entries.definition_cn: 由一系列由柱子支撑的拱门组成的结构
entries.definition_en: a structure composed of a series of arches supported by columns
entries.example_cn: 这座古建筑拥有一座宏伟的拱廊。
entries.example_en: The ancient building featured a grand arcade.

entries.definition_en: understandable only to a small number of people with specialized knowledge
entries.example_cn: 该仪式涉及少数人才能理解的深奥符号。
entries.example_en: The ritual involved arcane symbols that few understood.

entries.definition_en: information or knowledge known only to a special group
entries.example_cn: 那份古老的配方是只有大炼金术士才知道的秘术。
entries.example_en: The ancient recipe was an arcanum known only to the master alchemists.

entries.definition_en: the inverse function of the cosine; the angle that has a cosine equal to a given number
entries.example_cn: 为了找到角度，你必须计算邻边除以斜边的反余弦值。
entries.example_en: To find the angle, you must calculate the arccos of the adjacent side divided by the hypotenuse.

entries.definition_en: the angle whose cosecant is equal to a specific number
entries.example_cn: 在三角学中，2 的反余割是余割值为 2 的角度。
entries.example_en: In trigonometry, the arccosecant of 2 is the angle whose cosecant is 2.

entries.definition_en: the inverse function of the cosine; the angle whose cosine equals a given number
entries.example_cn: 为了找到角度，你需要计算邻边除以斜边的反余弦值。
entries.example_en: To find the angle, you need to calculate the arccosine of the adjacent side divided by the hypotenuse.

entries.definition_en: the inverse function of the cotangent; the angle whose cotangent equals a given number
entries.example_cn: 反余切函数返回余切值等于输入值的角度。
entries.example_en: The arccotangent function returns the angle for which the cotangent is equal to the input value.

entries.definition_cn: 角度单位；度（整圆的三百六十分之一）
entries.definition_en: a unit of angular measurement equal to one three-hundred-sixtieth of a full circle
entries.example_cn: 该弧所对的角以度为单位测量。
entries.example_en: The angle subtended by the arc is measured in arcdegrees.

entries.definition_en: shaped like or resembling an arch
entries.example_cn: 这座桥拥有跨越河流的优美拱形设计。
entries.example_en: The bridge features a beautifully arced design spanning the river.

entries.definition_en: a masonry construction for spanning an opening and supporting the weight above it
entries.example_cn: 这座古老的拱门历经数个世纪依然坚固。
entries.example_en: The ancient arch still stands strong after centuries.

entries.definition_en: a curved shape in the vertical plane that spans an opening
entries.example_cn: 这座桥在河上有一个高高的拱形。
entries.example_en: The bridge has a high arch over the river.

entries.definition_en: a passageway under a curved masonry construction
entries.example_cn: 他们穿过城堡下的拱道。
entries.example_en: They walked through the arch under the castle.

entries.definition_en: a curved bony structure supporting or enclosing organs
entries.example_cn: 足弓有助于支撑身体的重量。
entries.example_en: The arch of the foot helps support the body's weight.

entries.definition_en: to form an arch or curve
entries.example_cn: 猫受惊时背弓了起来。
entries.example_en: The cat arched its back when it was scared.

entries.definition_en: knowing, sly, or playfully ironic in a way that may seem condescending
entries.example_cn: 他请求帮助时，她对他露出一个狡黠的微笑。
entries.example_en: She gave him an arch smile when he asked for help.

entries.definition_en: naughtily or annoyingly playful
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在严肃的仪式上互相顽皮地使眼色。
entries.example_en: The children gave each other arch looks during the serious ceremony.

entries.definition_cn: 太古宙的；太古宙岩石的
entries.definition_en: of or relating to the Archaean Eon or its rocks
entries.example_cn: 太古宙岩石中包含早期生命形式的证据。
entries.example_en: The archaean rocks contain evidence of early life forms.

entries.definition_en: a member of the domain Archaea; an archaeon
entries.example_cn: 科学家在深海中发现了一种新的古细菌物种。
entries.example_en: Scientists discovered a new species of archaebacterium in the deep ocean.

entries.definition_en: related to or dealing with the study of ancient history and artifacts
entries.example_cn: 该博物馆收藏了大量青铜时代的考古发现。
entries.example_en: The museum has an extensive collection of archaeologic findings from the Bronze Age.

entries.definition_en: relating to the study of human history through the excavation of sites and analysis of artifacts
entries.example_cn: 博物馆正在展示从古城发掘出的新考古发现。
entries.example_en: The museum is displaying new archaeological findings from the ancient city.

entries.definition_en: a person who studies or practices archaeology
entries.example_cn: 考古学家小心翼翼地挖掘了这些古代废墟。
entries.example_en: The archaeologist carefully excavated the ancient ruins.

entries.definition_en: the study of the human past through the excavation and analysis of material remains
entries.example_cn: 考古学帮助我们了解古代文明是如何生活的。
entries.example_en: Archaeology helps us understand how ancient civilizations lived.

entries.definition_en: an extinct primitive bird from the Jurassic period with teeth and a long feathered tail
entries.example_cn: 始祖鸟的化石为鸟类从恐龙进化提供了关键证据。
entries.example_en: Fossils of the archaeopteryx provide crucial evidence for the evolution of birds from dinosaurs.

entries.definition_cn: 太古宙的；属于前寒武纪两个分期中较早一个的
entries.definition_en: of or belonging to the earlier of the two divisions of the Precambrian era
entries.example_cn: 太古宙时期的化石为早期生命形式提供了线索。
entries.example_en: Fossils from the archaeozoic period provide clues about early life forms.

entries.definition_en: belonging to an earlier period; very old-fashioned
entries.example_cn: 诗中使用的古语很难理解。
entries.example_en: The archaic language used in the poem is difficult to understand.

entries.definition_en: little changed from an earlier ancestral type
entries.example_cn: 这个物种是现代狼的原始形态。
entries.example_en: This species is an archaic form of the modern wolf.

entries.definition_en: the use of an old-fashioned or outdated expression
entries.example_cn: 作者的古语用法使故事具有了永恒的魅力。
entries.example_en: The author's use of archaicism gave the story a timeless quality.

entries.definition_cn: 使某物具有古风；用古语说话或写作
entries.definition_en: to make something archaic in style, or to speak or write in an archaic manner
entries.example_cn: 作者选择使对话古雅，以唤起中世纪的氛围。
entries.example_en: The author chose to archaise the dialogue to evoke a medieval atmosphere.

entries.definition_cn: 古语或古雅文体的使用
entries.definition_en: the use of an archaic word, expression, or style
entries.example_cn: 作者使用古语，使这段对话具有历史感。
entries.example_en: The author's use of archaism gave the dialogue a historical feel.

entries.definition_en: a person who uses old-fashioned language or style
entries.example_cn: 这位古语使用者坚持在整首诗中使用“thou”而不是“you”。
entries.example_en: The archaist insisted on using 'thou' instead of 'you' throughout the poem.

entries.definition_en: an expert or collector of antiquities
entries.example_cn: 博物馆聘请了一位著名的古董专家来鉴定新发现的文物。
entries.example_en: The museum hired a renowned archaist to authenticate the newly discovered artifacts.

entries.definition_cn: 模仿古风或旧式风格的
entries.definition_en: imitative of an archaic style or manner
entries.example_cn: 这幅画具有模仿文艺复兴时期技法的古风特质。
entries.example_en: The painting has an archaistic quality, deliberately mimicking the techniques of the Renaissance.

entries.definition_cn: 使某物具有古风；用古语说话或写作
entries.definition_en: to make something archaic in style, or to speak or write in an archaic manner
entries.example_cn: 许多现代作家在他们的文本中使用古语，以创造一种历史距离感。
entries.example_en: Many modern writers archaize their texts to create a sense of historical distance.

entries.definition_en: a high-ranking angel, especially one leading other angels
entries.example_cn: 在基督教传统中，米迦勒通常被描绘为首席大天使。
entries.example_en: In Christian tradition, Michael is often depicted as the chief archangel.

entries.definition_cn: 当归属的一种栽培二年生草本植物
entries.definition_en: a cultivated biennial herb of the genus Angelica
entries.example_cn: 园丁把大天使草当作园艺草本植物种植。
entries.example_en: The gardener grew archangel as a garden herb.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to or resembling archangels
entries.example_cn: 合唱团的表演如同大天使般神圣，用空灵的声音填满了大教堂。
entries.example_en: The choir's performance was archangelic, filling the cathedral with a divine and ethereal sound.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to or resembling archangels
entries.example_cn: 唱诗班如同大天使般的气质让大教堂充满了敬畏之情。
entries.example_en: The archangelical presence of the choir filled the cathedral with awe.

entries.definition_en: a senior bishop who is in charge of an archdiocese and presides over an ecclesiastical province
entries.example_cn: 大主教向会众发表了布道。
entries.example_en: The archbishop delivered a sermon to the congregation.

entries.definition_en: the territorial jurisdiction of an archbishop
entries.example_cn: 该大主教辖区涵盖北部省份的三个教区。
entries.example_en: The archbishopric covers three dioceses in the northern province.

entries.definition_en: a high-ranking official in the Anglican Church, below a bishop
entries.example_cn: 教区副主教视察了教区内的每一个堂区。
entries.example_en: The archdeacon visited every parish in the diocese.

entries.definition_en: the territorial jurisdiction of an archdeacon
entries.example_cn: 副主祭辖区涵盖北部的三个郡。
entries.example_en: The archdeaconry covers three counties in the north.

entries.definition_en: relating to an archdiocese
entries.example_cn: 大主教理事会开会讨论新政策。
entries.example_en: The archdiocesan council met to discuss the new policy.

entries.definition_en: the diocese under the jurisdiction of an archbishop
entries.example_cn: 该总教区涵盖了北部地区的几个城市。
entries.example_en: The archdiocese covers several cities in the northern region.

entries.definition_en: belonging to or befitting an archduke or his archduchy
entries.example_cn: 大公的皇冠陈列在皇家金库中。
entries.example_en: The archducal crown was displayed in the royal treasury.

entries.definition_cn: 大公的妻子或遗孀，或奥地利前统治王朝的公主
entries.definition_en: a wife or widow of an archduke or a princess of the former ruling house of Austria
entries.example_cn: 大公夫人参加了维也纳的皇家舞会。
entries.example_en: The archduchess attended the royal ball in Vienna.

entries.definition_en: the domain controlled by an archduke or archduchess
entries.example_cn: 奥地利大公国是欧洲中部一个强大的国家。
entries.example_en: The archduchy of Austria was a powerful state in Central Europe.

entries.definition_cn: 奥地利旧统治家族的王子，特指奥匈帝国皇帝的儿子或男系孙，或大公国的统治者
entries.definition_en: a prince of the former Austrian ruling house, specifically a son or male-line grandson of an emperor of Austria-Hungary or a ruler of an archduchy
entries.example_cn: 大公访问首都视察新博物馆。
entries.example_en: The archduke visited the capital to inspect the new museum.

entries.definition_en: relating to the earliest known rocks formed during the Precambrian Eon
entries.example_cn: 科学家研究太古岩石以了解地球早期历史。
entries.example_en: Scientists study archean rocks to understand early Earth history.

entries.definition_en: having an arch or arches
entries.example_cn: 这座桥采用了跨越河流的拱形设计。
entries.example_en: The bridge has an arched design that spans the river.

entries.definition_en: curved or shaped like an arch
entries.example_cn: 道路蜿蜒穿过呈拱形的山谷。
entries.example_en: The road winds through the arched valley.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to an archegonium
entries.example_cn: 颈卵器细胞位于植物生殖结构的基部。
entries.example_en: The archegonial cells are located at the base of the plant's reproductive structure.

entries.definition_cn: 与颈卵器有关的；具有颈卵器的
entries.definition_en: relating to or possessing archegonia
entries.example_cn: 具有颈卵器的植物在颈卵器中产生卵细胞。
entries.example_en: Archegoniate plants produce eggs in their archegonia.

entries.definition_en: a female reproductive organ found in mosses, ferns, and most gymnosperms
entries.example_cn: 颈卵器在非开花植物中产生卵细胞。
entries.example_en: The archegonium produces the egg cell in non-flowering plants.

entries.definition_en: the central cavity of a gastrula that develops into the digestive tract
entries.example_cn: 在胚胎发育过程中，原肠形成原始的消化道。
entries.example_en: During embryonic development, the archenteron forms the primitive gut.

entries.definition_en: relating to or concerned with the study of archaeology
entries.example_cn: 这次考古学调查揭示了埋在土壤下的古代工具。
entries.example_en: The archeologic survey revealed ancient tools buried beneath the soil.

entries.definition_en: relating to the study of human history through the excavation of sites and artifacts
entries.example_cn: 博物馆正在展示从古城发掘出的新考古发现。
entries.example_en: The museum is displaying new archeological findings from the ancient city.

entries.definition_en: a scientist who studies prehistoric people and their cultures
entries.example_cn: 考古学家小心翼翼地挖掘古代废墟以发现历史文物。
entries.example_en: The archeologist carefully excavated the ancient ruins to uncover historical artifacts.

entries.definition_en: the study of prehistoric people and their cultures
entries.example_cn: 博物馆有一个关于古代考古学的新展览。
entries.example_en: The museum has a new exhibit on ancient archeology.

entries.definition_en: an extinct primitive bird from the Jurassic period with teeth and a long feathered tail
entries.example_cn: 科学家研究始祖鸟以了解鸟类的进化。
entries.example_en: Scientists study the archeopteryx to understand the evolution of birds.

entries.definition_en: relating to the earliest division of the Precambrian era
entries.example_cn: 太古宙的化石提供了关于地球早期生命的线索。
entries.example_en: Fossils from the Archeozoic era provide clues about early life on Earth.

entries.definition_en: relating to an archbishop or their office
entries.example_cn: 该大主教令由大教堂发布。
entries.example_en: The archepiscopal decree was issued from the cathedral.

entries.definition_en: a small freshwater fish found in Indonesia and Australia that catches insects by squirting water at them
entries.example_cn: 射水鱼精准地喷出一股水柱，将苍蝇击落水中。
entries.example_en: The archerfish knocked the fly into the water with a precise spray.

entries.definition_en: the sport of shooting arrows with a bow
entries.example_cn: 她每周日都练习射箭运动已经两年了。
entries.example_en: She has been practicing archery every weekend for two years.

entries.definition_cn: 孢原；产生小孢子或大孢子的孢子囊细胞群
entries.definition_en: a group of cells in a sporangium from which microspores or megaspores develop
entries.example_cn: 孢原发育成产生小孢子或大孢子的细胞。
entries.example_en: The archespore develops into cells that produce microspores or megaspores.

entries.definition_en: relating to the cells in a sporangium that give rise to spores
entries.example_cn: 原孢子囊细胞位于孢子囊的中心。
entries.example_en: The archesporial cells are located at the center of the sporangium.

entries.definition_cn: 孢原；孢子囊中产生孢子的细胞或细胞群
entries.definition_en: a cell or group of cells in a sporangium that gives rise to spores
entries.example_cn: 孢原产生孢子母细胞。
entries.example_en: The archesporium gives rise to the spore mother cells.

entries.definition_en: representing or constituting an original type after which other similar things are patterned
entries.example_cn: 这个故事讲述了一位拯救王国的典型英雄。
entries.example_en: The story features an archetypal hero who saves the kingdom.

entries.definition_en: an original model or ideal example of something
entries.example_cn: 小说中的侦探是经典英雄的原型。
entries.example_en: The detective in the novel is an archetype of the classic hero.

entries.definition_en: serving as a perfect model or original pattern for other similar things
entries.example_cn: 小说中的英雄是勇气的典型人物。
entries.example_en: The hero in the novel is an archetypical figure of courage.

entries.definition_en: a small primitive marine worm lacking external segmentation and resembling polychaete larvae
entries.example_cn: 古环节虫在深海中自由游动。
entries.example_en: The archiannelid swims freely in the deep ocean.

entries.definition_cn: 会吏长的；与会吏长或其职位有关的
entries.definition_en: relating to an archdeacon or the office of an archdeacon
entries.example_cn: 该会吏长法庭审理了有关教会财产的案件。
entries.example_en: The archidiaconal court heard the case regarding church property.

entries.definition_en: the office or position of an archdeacon
entries.example_cn: 他被任命为北部教区的会吏长。
entries.example_en: He was appointed to the archidiaconate in the northern diocese.

entries.definition_en: relating to or characteristic of an archbishop
entries.example_cn: 大主教的宫殿是一座位于市中心的宏伟建筑。
entries.example_en: The archiepiscopal palace was a magnificent building located in the city center.

entries.definition_cn: 东正教大型修道院或修道院群的院长
entries.definition_en: the head or superior of a large monastery or group of monasteries in the Orthodox Church
entries.example_cn: 修道院院长每天早上带领修士们祈祷。
entries.example_en: The archimandrite led the monks in prayer every morning.

entries.definition_cn: 俄国旧长度单位，约合71厘米
entries.definition_en: a historical Russian unit of length, approximately 71 centimeters
entries.example_cn: 这张古地图用俄尺测量了距离。
entries.example_en: The ancient map measured the distance in archines.

entries.definition_en: shaped like an arch or having a curved shape
entries.example_cn: 这座拱形大桥横跨宽阔的河流。
entries.example_en: The arching bridge spans the wide river.

entries.definition_cn: 古皮层；脑披盖中最古老的区域，在人类中构成海马
entries.definition_en: the oldest region of the brain's pallium, often associated with the olfactory cortex and forming the hippocampus in humans
entries.example_cn: 神经科学家正在研究古皮层，包括它与海马的关系。
entries.example_en: Neuroscientists are studying the archipallium, including its relation to the hippocampus.

entries.definition_en: relating to or forming part of a group of islands
entries.example_cn: 这个群岛国家拥有复杂的海上边界系统。
entries.example_en: The archipelagic nation has a complex system of maritime boundaries.

entries.definition_en: a large group of islands in the sea
entries.example_cn: 菲律宾是东南亚的一个庞大群岛。
entries.example_en: The Philippines is a vast archipelago in Southeast Asia.

entries.definition_en: a person who designs buildings and other structures
entries.example_cn: 这位建筑师设计了一座拥有大片玻璃窗的现代图书馆。
entries.example_en: The architect designed a modern library with large glass windows.

entries.definition_cn: 某物的设计或总体结构
entries.definition_en: the design or overall structure of something
entries.example_cn: 把这部小说的各章作为一个整体来看时，它的总体结构就更清晰了。
entries.example_en: The architectonic of the novel becomes clearer when its chapters are viewed as a whole.

entries.definition_en: relating to the principles of construction or architecture
entries.example_cn: 大教堂的建筑学设计反映了哥特式风格。
entries.example_en: The architectonic design of the cathedral reflects the Gothic style.

entries.definition_en: the science of architecture
entries.example_cn: 这门建筑学课程探讨了建筑设计的基础理论。
entries.example_en: The course on architectonics explores the theoretical foundations of building design.

entries.definition_en: of or pertaining to the art and science of architecture
entries.example_cn: 这座博物馆拥有精美的建筑设计。
entries.example_en: The museum has a beautiful architectural design.

entries.definition_cn: 在建筑方面；从建筑角度
entries.definition_en: in a way that relates to the design or structure of buildings
entries.example_cn: 这栋建筑在设计上很有创新性。
entries.example_en: The building was designed to be architecturally innovative.

entries.definition_en: an architectural product or work
entries.example_cn: 这座新图书馆是现代建筑的杰作。
entries.example_en: The new library is a masterpiece of modern architecture.

entries.definition_en: the discipline dealing with the principles of design and construction and ornamentation of fine buildings
entries.example_cn: 他在大学主修建筑学。
entries.example_en: He studied architecture at university.

entries.definition_en: the profession of designing buildings and environments with consideration for their aesthetic effect
entries.example_cn: 建筑设计职业需要敏锐的细节观察力。
entries.example_en: Architecture requires a keen eye for detail.

entries.definition_cn: （计算机科学）计算机硬件或系统软件的结构与组织
entries.definition_en: (computer science) the structure and organization of a computer's hardware or system software
entries.example_cn: 该软件的设计考虑了特定的架构。
entries.example_en: The software was designed with a specific architecture in mind.

entries.definition_en: the largest known mollusk, reaching up to 60 feet in length
entries.example_cn: 大王乌贼是一种神秘的深海生物。
entries.example_en: The giant squid, or architeuthis, is a mysterious deep-sea creature.

entries.definition_cn: 门、窗或其他矩形开口周围的装饰线脚
entries.definition_en: the molding around a door, window, or other rectangular opening
entries.example_cn: 修复团队更换了壁炉周围损坏的装饰线脚。
entries.example_en: The restoration team replaced the damaged architrave around the fireplace.

entries.definition_cn: 檐口（古典建筑中置于柱头上的最底层横梁）
entries.definition_en: the lowest horizontal beam of a classical entablature, resting on column capitals
entries.example_cn: 檐口横跨两根支撑柱之间的空间。
entries.example_en: The architrave spans the space between the two supporting columns.

entries.definition_en: relating to the storage and preservation of records
entries.example_cn: 这家博物馆收藏了大量档案照片。
entries.example_en: The museum has an extensive collection of archival photographs.

entries.definition_en: a place where historical records and documents are kept
entries.example_cn: 这所大学有一个专门存放旧照片的档案库。
entries.example_en: The university has a special archive for old photographs.

entries.definition_en: the records, documents, or other material kept in an archive
entries.example_cn: 这家博物馆的档案中保存着数千张早期照片。
entries.example_en: The museum's archive contains thousands of early photographs.

entries.definition_en: to put something into an archive
entries.example_cn: 我们需要在删除这些旧邮件之前将它们归档。
entries.example_en: We need to archive these old emails before deleting them.

entries.definition_en: a person who manages and organizes archives
entries.example_cn: 档案管理员花了数小时整理历史文件。
entries.example_en: The archivist spent hours cataloguing the historical documents.

entries.definition_en: in a playful, sly, or roguish manner
entries.example_cn: 她狡黠地微笑着看着他试图掩盖错误的样子。
entries.example_en: She smiled archly at his attempt to hide the mistake.

entries.definition_en: inappropriate playfulness
entries.example_cn: 她在严肃会议上的轻佻举止惹恼了其他参与者。
entries.example_en: Her archness during the serious meeting annoyed the other participants.

entries.definition_cn: 主龙类动物，包括鳄类和鸟类以及已灭绝的恐龙和翼龙
entries.definition_en: a reptile in the taxon Archosauria, including crocodilians and birds, as well as extinct dinosaurs and pterosaurs
entries.example_cn: 在沙漠中发现的化石属于一种大型主龙类爬行动物。
entries.example_en: The fossil found in the desert belonged to a large archosaur.

entries.definition_en: an archosaur
entries.example_cn: 这块化石被鉴定为主龙类动物。
entries.example_en: The fossil was identified as an archosaurian.

entries.definition_cn: 与主龙类爬行动物有关的
entries.definition_en: relating to or characteristic of reptiles in the subclass Archosauria
entries.example_cn: 这个头骨的主龙类特征包括下颌有一个大开口。
entries.example_en: The archosaurian features of this skull include a large opening in the lower jaw.

entries.definition_cn: 高级神父，尤指具有特殊教会级别或职能的神父
entries.definition_en: a senior priest with a special ecclesiastical rank or function
entries.example_cn: 大司祭庄严地主持了仪式。
entries.example_en: The archpriest led the ceremony with great solemnity.

entries.definition_en: a passageway or doorway with an arch-shaped top, especially one made of masonry
entries.example_cn: 他们穿过古老的拱门进入了城堡庭院。
entries.example_en: They walked through the ancient archway into the castle courtyard.

entries.definition_en: shaped like or resembling an arch
entries.example_cn: 这座桥拥有优雅的拱形设计，横跨河流。
entries.example_en: The bridge has an elegant arciform design that spans the river.

entries.definition_en: a unit of angular measurement equal to one-sixtieth of a degree
entries.example_cn: 天文学家以角分和角秒为单位测量恒星的位置。
entries.example_en: Astronomers measure the position of stars in arcminutes and arcseconds.

entries.definition_en: describing instruments in the violin family that are played with a bow
entries.example_cn: 小提琴家用弓拉奏了这首协奏曲。
entries.example_en: The violinist played the concerto arco.

entries.definition_cn: 反正割函数；正割值等于给定数的角
entries.definition_en: the inverse function of the secant; the angle that has a secant equal to a given number
entries.example_cn: 在高等三角学中，反正割函数用于根据正割值求角度。
entries.example_en: In advanced trigonometry, the arcsec function is used to find angles from secant values.

entries.definition_en: the inverse function of the secant; the angle whose secant is a given number
entries.example_cn: 在三角学中，一个数的反割函数表示具有该割函数值的角。
entries.example_en: In trigonometry, the arcsecant of a number represents the angle with that secant value.

entries.definition_en: a 60th part of a minute of arc
entries.example_cn: 这台望远镜可以测量恒星的位置，精确到角秒。
entries.example_en: The telescope can measure the position of a star to the nearest arcsecond.

entries.definition_en: the inverse function of the sine; the angle whose sine equals a given number
entries.example_cn: 为了解出 x，我们对方程两边取反正弦。
entries.example_en: To solve for x, we take the arcsin of both sides of the equation.

entries.definition_cn: 正弦函数的反函数；正弦值等于给定数的角
entries.definition_en: a function inverse to the sine function; an angle whose sine equals a given number
entries.example_cn: 为了解这个方程，你需要计算 0.5 的反正弦值。
entries.example_en: To solve the equation, you need to calculate the arcsine of 0.5.

entries.definition_en: the inverse function of the tangent; the angle whose tangent is a given number
entries.example_cn: 要找到这个角度，你需要计算边长比值的反正切。
entries.example_en: To find the angle, you need to calculate the arctan of the ratio of the sides.

entries.definition_en: the inverse function of the tangent; the angle whose tangent is a given number
entries.example_cn: 为了解这个方程，我们需要找到对边与邻边比值的反正切。
entries.example_en: To solve the equation, we need to find the arctangent of the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side.

entries.definition_en: a stout-bodied moth with broad wings featuring distinct stripes or spots; its larvae are hairy caterpillars
entries.example_cn: 这只裳蛾被灯光吸引，落在了门廊上。
entries.example_en: The arctiid moth was attracted to the light and landed on the porch.

entries.definition_en: forming or resembling an arch
entries.example_cn: 这座桥有着美丽的拱形。
entries.example_en: The bridge has a beautiful arcuate shape.

entries.definition_en: a white, arc-shaped deposit found on the cornea of the eye
entries.example_cn: 医生在检查时发现患者角膜上有一个小弧斑。
entries.example_en: The doctor noticed a small arcus on the patient's cornea during the examination.

entries.definition_en: a simple light plough without a mouldboard
entries.example_cn: 农民使用一种无犁壁的轻型犁来翻硬土。
entries.example_en: Farmers used an ard to break the hard soil.

entries.definition_en: a unit of dry measure used in Egypt
entries.example_cn: 这位古埃及农民用阿尔德布来测量谷物。
entries.example_en: The ancient Egyptian farmer measured the grain in ardebs.

entries.definition_en: characterized by strong enthusiasm
entries.example_cn: 他是一位古典音乐的狂热爱好者。
entries.example_en: He is an ardent lover of classical music.

entries.definition_en: characterized by intense emotion
entries.example_cn: 他们是新政策的热烈支持者。
entries.example_en: They were ardent supporters of the new policy.

entries.definition_en: providing light or heat (literary)
entries.example_cn: 炽热的炉火照亮了房间，也温暖了旅人。
entries.example_en: The ardent fire lit the room and warmed the travelers.

entries.definition_en: in an ardent manner
entries.example_cn: 她热烈支持环保事业。
entries.example_en: She ardently supported the cause of environmental protection.

entries.definition_en: a strong feeling of eagerness or enthusiasm for a person or cause
entries.example_cn: 她对环保事业表现出极大的热忱。
entries.example_en: She showed great ardor for the cause of environmental protection.

entries.definition_en: intense feeling of love
entries.example_cn: 他们彼此间的炽热爱情多年来从未减退。
entries.example_en: Their ardor for each other never faded over the years.

entries.definition_en: intense heat
entries.example_cn: 夏日烈日的酷热让人觉得这一天漫长无尽。
entries.example_en: The ardor of the summer sun made the day feel endless.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of strong eagerness, usually in favor of a person or cause
entries.example_cn: 尽管困难重重，她对这项事业的热忱从未动摇。
entries.example_en: Her ardour for the cause never wavered despite the difficulties.

usage.label: British, Canadian, Australian spelling
usage.pattern: ardour is the spelling variant of ardor

entries.definition_en: intense feeling of love
entries.example_cn: 他们的婚姻建立在相互炽热的爱与尊重之上。
entries.example_en: Their marriage was founded on mutual ardour and respect.

entries.definition_en: feelings of great warmth and intensity
entries.example_cn: 人群以极大的热情接待了演讲者。
entries.example_en: The crowd received the speaker with great ardour.

entries.definition_en: requiring great physical effort and causing exhaustion
entries.example_cn: 攀登这座山的费力过程整整花了一天。
entries.example_en: The arduous climb up the mountain took all day.

entries.definition_cn: 难以完成的，需要大量脑力劳动的
entries.definition_en: difficult to achieve, requiring significant mental effort
entries.example_cn: 解这道复杂的方程对学生来说是一项艰巨的任务。
entries.example_en: Solving the complex equation was an arduous task for the student.

entries.definition_cn: 极度困难的，考验耐力的
entries.definition_en: extremely difficult and demanding of endurance
entries.example_cn: 他们面临穿越沙漠的艰难旅程。
entries.example_en: They faced an arduous journey across the desert.

entries.definition_en: in a way that requires great effort and causes fatigue
entries.example_cn: 他们费力地爬上了山顶。
entries.example_en: They climbed the mountain arduously to reach the summit.

entries.definition_en: extreme effortfulness
entries.example_cn: 攀登的极度费力让许多徒步者望而却步。
entries.example_en: The arduousness of the climb discouraged many hikers.

entries.definition_cn: 罕用且已不推荐使用的面积单位，等于 100 平方米
entries.definition_en: A rare, deprecated metric unit of area equal to 100 square meters.
entries.example_cn: 这片农场占地五公亩。
entries.example_en: The farm covers five ares of land.

entries.definition_en: a particular geographical region with indefinite boundaries, often distinguished by its people, culture, or geography
entries.example_cn: 该地区以其独特的文化而闻名。
entries.example_en: The mountain area is known for its unique culture.

entries.definition_en: the extent of a two-dimensional surface enclosed within a boundary
entries.example_cn: 这个房间的面积是五十平方米。
entries.example_en: The area of the room is fifty square meters.

entries.definition_en: a subject of study or a field of knowledge
entries.example_cn: 数学是我最喜欢的研究领域。
entries.example_en: Mathematics is my favorite area of study.

entries.definition_en: a part of a structure having some specific characteristic or function
entries.example_cn: 屋顶是房子的重要部分。
entries.example_en: The roof is an important area of the house.

entries.definition_en: a part of an animal that has a special function or is supplied by a given artery or nerve
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了伤口周围的部位。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined the area around the wound.

entries.definition_en: a particular environment or walk of life
entries.example_cn: 他在商界很有名。
entries.example_en: He is well known in the business area.

entries.definition_en: relating to or covering a specific area or region
entries.example_cn: 该物种的区域分布在大洲上差异显著。
entries.example_en: The areal distribution of the species varies significantly across the continent.

entries.definition_cn: 建筑物之间的通道或通往地下室的通道
entries.definition_en: a passageway between buildings or giving access to a basement
entries.example_cn: 我们把车停在车库和房子之间狭窄的通道里。
entries.example_en: We parked the car in the narrow areaway between the garage and the house.

usage.label: Canada; US
usage.pattern: source w55225r0 labels the noun Canada and US.

entries.definition_en: a tall tropical palm tree native to Southeast Asia that produces egg-shaped nuts
entries.example_cn: 槟榔树在该岛潮湿的气候中茁壮成长。
entries.example_en: The areca palm thrives in the humid climate of the island.

entries.definition_cn: 反射消失；可能是神经损伤的迹象
entries.definition_en: absence of a reflex; a sign of possible nerve damage
entries.example_cn: 医生注意到患者肢体反射消失，这是神经损伤的症状。
entries.example_en: The doctor noted the areflexia in the patient's limbs as a symptom of nerve damage.

entries.definition_en: a particular environment or area of activity
entries.example_cn: 互联网已成为政治辩论的新领域。
entries.example_en: The internet has become a new arena for political debate.

entries.definition_cn: 用于露天体育或娱乐的大型场馆
entries.definition_en: a large structure designed for open-air sports or entertainments
entries.example_cn: 该市建造了一个新场馆来举办篮球决赛。
entries.example_en: The city built a new arena to host the basketball finals.

entries.definition_en: a playing field where sports events take place
entries.example_cn: 足球赛在一个大型户外场地举行。
entries.example_en: The football match was played in a large outdoor arena.

entries.definition_cn: 古罗马圆形剧场中央铺沙的竞技区
entries.definition_en: the central area of an ancient Roman amphitheater where contests were held, often covered with sand
entries.example_cn: 角斗士们在斗兽场铺满沙子的竞技区中搏斗。
entries.example_en: Gladiators fought in the sand-covered arena of the Colosseum.

entries.definition_cn: 像沙子的、含沙的、多沙的或在沙地生长的
entries.definition_en: resembling or containing or abounding in sand; or growing in sandy areas
entries.example_cn: 沙漠中的沙质土壤非常适合仙人掌生长。
entries.example_en: The arenaceous soil in the desert is perfect for cacti.

entries.definition_cn: 沙粒病毒属的一种病毒，常由啮齿动物传播并导致严重疾病
entries.definition_en: a virus of the genus Arenavirus, often causing severe disease transmitted by rodents
entries.example_cn: 科学家正在研究这种罕见沙粒病毒的基因结构。
entries.example_en: Scientists are studying the genetic structure of this rare arenavirus.

entries.definition_en: growing, living, or burrowing in sand
entries.example_cn: 人们发现这种沙生甲虫在沙漠沙土深处打洞。
entries.example_en: The arenicolous beetle was found burrowing deep into the desert sand.

entries.definition_cn: 乳晕；（广义）与周围组织颜色不同的小圆形区域
entries.definition_en: a small circular area, such as that around the human nipple or an inflamed area around a pimple or insect bite
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了昆虫叮咬周围发红的圆形区域。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined the red areola surrounding the insect bite.

entries.definition_cn: 组织或身体部位中的小空隙
entries.definition_en: a small space in a tissue or body part, such as the area between veins on a leaf or an insect's wing
entries.example_cn: 叶脉之间精致的空隙让光线得以透过。
entries.example_en: The delicate areola between the leaf veins allowed light to pass through.

entries.definition_cn: 仙人掌上长有刺或钩毛的小斑块
entries.definition_en: a small patch on a cactus bearing spines or glochids
entries.example_cn: 仙人掌上的每个小斑块都会长出一簇刺。
entries.example_en: Each areola on the cactus produces a cluster of spines.

entries.definition_en: relating to or resembling an areola
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了乳头周围的乳晕组织。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the areolar tissue surrounding the nipple.

entries.definition_cn: 具乳晕状结构的；呈小块状或龟裂状的
entries.definition_en: having areolae or a pattern divided into small areas
entries.example_cn: 接种疫苗后，病人的皮肤上出现了由小块状区域组成的皮疹。
entries.example_en: The skin of the patient developed an areolate rash after the vaccination.

entries.definition_cn: （尤指古希腊哲学中的）卓越；德性
entries.definition_en: excellence or virtue, especially as understood in ancient Greek philosophy
entries.example_cn: 在古希腊哲学中，arete 与品格上的卓越联系在一起。
entries.example_en: In ancient Greek philosophy, arete was associated with excellence of character.

entries.definition_cn: 阿雷图莎兰（沼泽兰的一种，即阿雷图莎兰属唯一物种，开洋红色花）
entries.definition_en: a bog orchid, Arethusa bulbosa, the sole species of the genus Arethusa, with a magenta flower
entries.example_cn: 稀有的阿雷图莎兰在潮湿的沼泽中短暂地绽放了。
entries.example_en: The rare arethusa bloomed briefly in the damp marsh.

entries.definition_en: wild sheep of semidesert regions in central Asia
entries.example_cn: 探险队发现一群阿尔加尔羊在高原的岩石斜坡上吃草。
entries.example_en: The expedition team spotted a herd of argal grazing on the rocky slopes of the plateau.

entries.definition_en: a wild sheep found in the semidesert regions of central Asia
entries.example_cn: 阿尔泰盘羊是亚洲草原上一种大型野生绵羊。
entries.example_en: The argali is a large wild sheep native to the steppes of central Asia.

entries.definition_en: a type of tick that lacks a dorsal shield and has mouthparts on the underside of its head
entries.example_cn: 无盾蜱通常被发现藏在鸟巢里。
entries.example_en: The argasid tick is often found hiding in bird nests.

entries.definition_en: a plant with large white or yellow flowers and prickly leaves, native to tropical America
entries.example_cn: 蓟罂粟属植物在墨西哥的干旱地区野生生长。
entries.example_en: The argemone grows wild in the arid regions of Mexico.

entries.definition_en: of lustrous grey; covered with or tinged with the color of silver
entries.example_cn: 月光在白雪覆盖的田野上投下一片银灰色的光辉。
entries.example_en: The moonlight cast an argent glow over the snow-covered fields.

entries.definition_en: a metal tincture used in heraldry to give a silvery appearance
entries.example_cn: 纹章上有一个银盾，上面有一只直立的狮子。
entries.example_en: The coat of arms features a shield argent with a lion rampant.

usage.label: heraldry
usage.pattern: argent tincture on a coat of arms

entries.definition_en: relating to chemical compounds where silver has a valence of two
entries.example_cn: 在这种银二价化合物中，银原子与其他元素形成两个化学键。
entries.example_en: In this argentic compound, the silver atom forms two bonds with other elements.

entries.definition_en: containing silver or capable of yielding silver
entries.example_cn: 矿工们发现了一种含银岩石，可以从中提炼银。
entries.example_en: The miners discovered an argentiferous rock that could be processed for silver.

entries.definition_en: a huge herbivorous dinosaur from the Cretaceous period found in Argentina
entries.example_cn: 阿根廷龙是曾在南美洲漫游的最大的恐龙之一。
entries.example_en: The argentinosaur was one of the largest dinosaurs to roam South America.

entries.definition_en: a valuable silver ore consisting of silver sulfide
entries.example_cn: 矿工们在安第斯山脉的辉银矿矿藏中提取纯银。
entries.example_en: Miners extracted pure silver from the argentite deposits in the Andes.

entries.definition_en: relating to chemical compounds in which silver has a valence of one
entries.example_cn: 一价银氯化物比其他银氯化物更易溶解。
entries.example_en: The argentous chloride is more soluble than the other silver chlorides.

entries.definition_en: a white clay, especially the type used by potters
entries.example_cn: 古代陶工将白陶土与水混合以制作他们的器皿。
entries.example_en: The ancient potters mixed the argil with water to create their vessels.

entries.definition_en: resembling or containing clay

entries.example_en: The argillaceous soil was difficult to dig due to its high clay content.

entries.definition_en: a sedimentary rock that differs from shale by being bound by silica and from slate by having no slate cleavages
entries.example_cn: 地质学家根据其硅质胶结特征及缺乏片理解理，识别出峡谷岩壁中的泥板岩。
entries.example_en: Geologists identified the argillite in the canyon walls based on its silica binding and lack of cleavage.

entries.definition_en: a bitter-tasting amino acid found in proteins that is essential for nutrition and sperm production
entries.example_cn: 精氨酸是一种对精子生成必要的氨基酸。
entries.example_en: Arginine is an amino acid necessary for the production of spermatozoa.

entries.definition_en: a verbal dispute or a wrangling argument
entries.example_cn: 会议在两位对立经理的争吵中结束。
entries.example_en: The meeting ended in an argle-bargle between the two opposing managers.

usage.label: slang
usage.pattern: The noun is tagged slang in source w55237r0.

entries.definition_en: a colorless, odorless gas that does not react with other substances; one of the six noble gases
entries.example_cn: 氩气常被用来填充灯泡，以防止灯丝烧断。
entries.example_en: Argon is commonly used to fill light bulbs to prevent the filament from burning out.

entries.definition_en: a person who undertakes a dangerous but potentially rewarding adventure
entries.example_cn: 这位探险家是一位冒险家，致力于寻找失落的文明。
entries.example_en: The explorer was known as an argonaut who sought lost civilizations.

entries.definition_cn: 船蛸（一种雌性会形成精致纸状贝壳的海洋章鱼）
entries.definition_en: a marine octopus of the family Argonautidae, whose female produces a delicate, paper-like shell
entries.example_cn: 潜水员发现一只罕见的船蛸漂浮在水面附近。
entries.example_en: The diver spotted a rare argonaut floating near the surface.

entries.definition_en: a large merchant ship, or a fleet of such ships
entries.example_cn: 船长指挥着一艘满载香料的大商船。
entries.example_en: The captain commanded a magnificent argosy laden with spices.

entries.definition_cn: 特定群体使用的专门或秘密词汇，尤指盗贼或某一行业的用语
entries.definition_en: a specialized or secret vocabulary used by a particular group, especially thieves or people in a profession
entries.example_cn: 那些小偷使用了一种警察难以理解的古老行话。
entries.example_en: The thieves used an old argot that was hard for the police to understand.

entries.definition_en: open to argument or debate; not certain.
entries.example_cn: 该事件的确切日期在历史学家之间仍有争议。
entries.example_en: The exact date of the event remains arguable among historians.

entries.definition_en: capable of being supported by argument or evidence.
entries.example_cn: 鉴于可用数据有限，该假设是可论证的。
entries.example_en: The hypothesis is arguable given the limited data available.

entries.definition_en: as can reasonably be argued or supported by evidence, though not with absolute certainty

entries.example_en: He is arguably the best player on the team.

entries.definition_en: present reasons and arguments
entries.example_cn: 她论证说新政策将造福所有人。
entries.example_en: She argued that the new policy would benefit everyone.

entries.definition_en: have an argument about something
entries.example_cn: 他们争论如何最好地度过假期。
entries.example_en: They argued about the best way to spend their vacation.

entries.definition_en: give evidence of
entries.example_cn: 他的行为表明他缺乏对规则的尊重。
entries.example_en: His behavior argues a lack of respect for the rules.

entries.definition_en: a person who argues or presents an argument
entries.example_cn: 这位提出论证的人为新政策提出了有力论据。
entries.example_en: The arguer presented a compelling case for the new policy.

entries.definition_en: to have a disagreement or argument about something
entries.example_cn: 他们开始就合同的细节争论起来。
entries.example_en: They began to argufy about the details of the contract.

usage.label: colloquial; intransitive

entries.definition_en: a dispute involving strong disagreement
entries.example_cn: 关于这项新政策，大家争论不休。
entries.example_en: There was a lot of arguing about the new policy.

entries.definition_en: a heated disagreement or fight
entries.example_cn: 他们为晚饭去哪里而大声争吵。
entries.example_en: They had a loud argument about where to go for dinner.

entries.definition_cn: 作为证据的事实或断言
entries.definition_en: a fact or statement used to prove something is true
entries.example_cn: 这位科学家提出了关于气候变化的有力论据。
entries.example_en: The scientist presented a strong argument for climate change.

entries.definition_cn: 就某提议进行正反双方的讨论
entries.definition_en: a discussion where reasons are given for and against a proposal
entries.example_cn: 这次会议就是讨论是否要建一座新图书馆。
entries.example_en: The meeting was an argument about whether to build a new library.

entries.definition_cn: 用逻辑证明观点的过程
entries.definition_en: the process of using logic to prove a point
entries.example_cn: 这位哲学家的论证基于严密的推理。
entries.example_en: The philosopher's argument was based on careful reasoning.

entries.definition_cn: 编程中传递给函数的值或引用
entries.definition_en: a value passed to a function in programming
entries.example_cn: 该函数接受两个参数：姓名和年龄。
entries.example_en: The function takes two arguments: the name and the age.

entries.definition_en: a variable whose value determines another variable
entries.example_cn: 在这个方程中，x 是自变量，y 是因变量。
entries.example_en: In this equation, x is the argument and y is the result.

entries.definition_cn: 故事或电影的剧情梗概
entries.definition_en: a brief summary of the plot of a story or movie
entries.example_cn: 你能给我这本书的简短剧情梗概吗？
entries.example_en: Can you give me a short argument of the book?

entries.definition_en: the presentation and exchange of arguments
entries.example_cn: 关于气候变化政策的辩论涉及了双方的广泛辩论。
entries.example_en: The debate on climate change policy involved extensive argumentation from both sides.

entries.definition_en: a course of reasoning aimed at demonstrating a truth or falsehood; the methodical process of logical reasoning
entries.example_cn: 这位数学家的论证过程无懈可击，无可置疑地证明了该定理。
entries.example_en: The mathematician's argumentation was flawless, proving the theorem beyond doubt.

entries.definition_en: given to or characterized by argument
entries.example_cn: 他非常好争辩，经常与同事展开辩论。
entries.example_en: He is very argumentative and often starts debates with his colleagues.

entries.definition_en: in a disputatious manner
entries.example_cn: 他与对手好辩地争论，拒绝接受任何妥协。
entries.example_en: He argued argumentatively with his opponent, refusing to accept any compromise.

entries.definition_en: carefully observant or attentive; on the lookout for possible danger
entries.example_cn: 她密切注视着银行附近可疑的活动。
entries.example_en: She kept an argus-eyed watch on the suspicious activity near the bank.

entries.definition_en: having very keen vision
entries.example_cn: 保安人员目光敏锐，在人群中发现了每一个细节。
entries.example_en: The security guard was argus-eyed, spotting every detail in the crowd.

entries.definition_cn: 喧闹的争吵（有时伴有打斗）
entries.definition_en: a noisy disagreement, often involving some fighting
entries.example_cn: 会议因无休止的预算争论而搞砸了。
entries.example_en: The meeting was ruined by endless argy-bargy over the budget.

entries.definition_en: to argue noisily
entries.example_cn: 他们为该由谁付账争吵了一个晚上。
entries.example_en: They spent the evening argy-bargying over who should pay the bill.

entries.definition_en: a pattern of multicolored diamonds on a solid background, originally from Scottish clan tartans
entries.example_cn: 他穿了一件菱形格纹毛衣。
entries.example_en: He wore a sweater with an argyle pattern.

entries.definition_en: a sock knitted or woven with an argyle design
entries.example_cn: 她用一条相配的围巾搭配了那双菱形格纹袜。
entries.example_en: She paired her argyle with a matching scarf.

entries.definition_en: a metal container with a detachable inner vessel for hot water, used to keep gravy warm
entries.example_cn: 服务员把保温肉汁壶放在桌上以保持酱汁温热。
entries.example_en: The waiter placed the argyle on the table to keep the sauce warm.

entries.definition_cn: 以苏格兰氏族方格纹为原型的纯色背景上的多彩菱形图案
entries.definition_en: a pattern of multicolored diamonds on a solid background, originally for knitting and based on a Scottish clan tartan
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一件带有阿盖尔图案的毛衣。
entries.example_en: She wore a sweater featuring an argyll design.

entries.definition_cn: 带有阿盖尔图案的袜子
entries.definition_en: a sock knitted or woven with an argyll design
entries.example_cn: 他出门前穿上了那双阿盖尔图案的袜子。
entries.example_en: He pulled on his argylls before leaving the house.

entries.definition_cn: 带盖的金属肉汁保温器
entries.definition_en: a metal container with a cover, holding gravy and a separate vessel of hot water to keep it warm
entries.example_cn: 服务员把肉汁保温器放在桌上以保持肉汁温热。
entries.example_en: The waiter placed the argyll on the table to keep the gravy warm.

entries.definition_en: a rare steel-grey mineral made of silver, germanium, and sulfur
entries.example_cn: 地质学家在深山中发现了一脉银锗矿。
entries.example_en: Geologists discovered a vein of argyrodite deep in the mountain.

entries.definition_en: an elaborate song for solo voice, typically in an opera
entries.example_cn: 女高音唱了一首动人的咏叹调，让观众热泪盈眶。
entries.example_en: The soprano sang a beautiful aria that moved the audience to tears.

entries.definition_en: lacking sufficient water or rainfall
entries.example_cn: 这片干旱的土地上稀疏地分布着仙人掌。
entries.example_en: The arid landscape was dotted with sparse cacti.

entries.definition_en: lacking vitality or spirit; lifeless
entries.example_cn: 这次会议枯燥的氛围让每个人都感到无聊。
entries.example_en: The arid atmosphere of the meeting made everyone feel bored.

entries.definition_en: a condition of having very little moisture, especially due to a lack of rain
entries.example_cn: 沙漠的干旱使得耕作变得困难。
entries.example_en: The aridity of the desert makes farming difficult.

entries.definition_cn: 贫乏、枯燥或缺乏思想内容的性质
entries.definition_en: the quality of being barren or lacking in intellectual or creative substance
entries.example_cn: 这场辩论内容贫乏，令听众感到无聊。
entries.example_en: The aridity of the debate left the audience bored.

entries.definition_en: the state or quality of being arid
entries.example_cn: 沙漠的干旱使得耕作变得困难。
entries.example_en: The aridness of the desert makes farming difficult.

entries.definition_en: a short aria
entries.example_cn: 女高音演唱了歌剧中的一段精致的小咏叹调。
entries.example_en: The soprano performed a delicate arietta from the opera.

entries.definition_en: in an accurate or correct manner
entries.example_cn: 请在提交报告前正确地核对计算结果。
entries.example_en: Please check the calculations aright before submitting the report.

entries.definition_en: a fleshy, usually brightly colored covering that develops from the ovule stalk and partially or entirely envelops a seed
entries.example_cn: 红豆杉的假种皮呈红色且肉质。
entries.example_en: The aril of the yew berry is red and fleshy.

entries.definition_en: having an aril, a fleshy and often brightly colored covering of a seed
entries.example_cn: 具假种皮的种子吸引鸟类，帮助传播它们。
entries.example_en: The ariled seeds attract birds that help spread them.

entries.definition_en: (of some seeds) having a fleshy and usually brightly colored cover
entries.example_cn: 许多热带树木产生具假种皮的种子。
entries.example_en: Many tropical trees produce arillate seeds.

entries.definition_en: having a melody rather than being spoken in a recitative style
entries.example_cn: 这首咏叹调旋律优美，引人入胜，与宣叙调部分形成了鲜明对比。
entries.example_en: The aria was ariose and captivating, contrasting with the recitative sections.

entries.definition_cn: 咏叙调；介于宣叙调和咏叹调之间的声乐段落
entries.definition_en: a short, melodic passage in music that is more expressive than a recitative but not a full aria

entries.example_en: The composer included an arioso for the solo voice in the second movement.

entries.definition_en: come into existence
entries.example_cn: 项目期间可能会出现新问题。
entries.example_en: New problems may arise during the project.

entries.definition_en: originate or come into being

entries.example_en: The conflict arose from a misunderstanding.

entries.definition_en: result or issue from a cause

entries.example_en: What will arise from this decision?

entries.definition_en: get up and out of bed

entries.example_en: I usually arise early in the morning.

entries.definition_en: move upward

entries.definition_en: rise to one's feet

entries.definition_en: take part in a rebellion

entries.example_en: Several soldiers arose against the king.

entries.definition_en: a bristle-like structure near the tip of an insect's antenna
entries.example_cn: 苍蝇触角上的触角芒有助于它感知气流。
entries.example_en: The arista on the fly's antenna helps it sense air currents.

entries.definition_en: a social class of people who hold hereditary titles and have special privileges
entries.example_cn: 贵族阶层在几个世纪里一直掌握着这个国家的权力。
entries.example_en: The aristocracy has held power in the country for centuries.

entries.definition_en: the most powerful and influential members of a society
entries.example_cn: 这项新政策旨在削弱权贵的影响力。
entries.example_en: The new policy was designed to reduce the influence of the aristocracy.

entries.definition_en: a member of the aristocracy
entries.example_cn: 那位贵族穿着最考究的西装参加了皇家舞会。
entries.example_en: The aristocrat attended the royal ball in his finest suit.

entries.definition_en: having the qualities or style associated with the nobility

entries.example_en: The hotel's service was notably aristocratic and formal.

entries.definition_en: belonging to or characteristic of the nobility or aristocracy

entries.example_en: The aristocratical manners of the guests made the common people feel uncomfortable.

entries.definition_en: in a manner characteristic of the aristocracy

entries.example_en: The guests were seated aristocratically around the long table.

entries.definition_en: the principles, practices or characteristics of aristocracy

entries.example_en: The new constitution was criticized for its aristocratism and exclusion of the lower classes.

entries.definition_cn: 通过姓名字母对应的数字进行占卜

entries.definition_en: the branch of mathematics that deals with numbers and their properties
entries.example_cn: 她擅长算术，能迅速解决复杂的问题。
entries.example_en: She is good at arithmetic and can solve complex problems quickly.

entries.definition_en: relating to or involving the calculation of numbers

entries.example_en: The arithmetic mean of the three values is 12.

entries.definition_en: relating to or involving arithmetic

entries.example_en: The arithmetical operations were performed correctly.

entries.definition_en: in a way that relates to arithmetic

entries.example_en: The numbers are equal arithmetically, but not logically in this context.

entries.definition_cn: 函数或运算所接受的参数或操作数的数量；对于关系，则为相应笛卡尔积中的域数

entries.definition_en: a large boat built by Noah to save his family and animals from the flood
entries.example_cn: 根据《圣经》，方舟在水上漂浮了许多天。
entries.example_en: According to the Bible, the ark floated on the waters for many days.

entries.definition_cn: （犹太教会堂内存放《托拉》卷轴的）圣柜

entries.example_en: The rabbi opened the synagogue ark and took out a Torah scroll.

entries.definition_en: money paid to secure a contract

entries.example_en: He paid arles to bind the seller to the agreement.

entries.definition_en: the upper limb of a human, from the shoulder to the hand

entries.example_en: He hurt his arm while playing tennis.

entries.definition_en: an instrument used in fighting or hunting

entries.example_en: The soldier carried arms.

entries.definition_en: the part of a garment covering the arm

entries.definition_en: the part of a chair that supports the elbow

entries.definition_en: to equip with weapons

entries.example_en: The country decided to arm its soldiers.

entries.definition_en: to supply with weapons

entries.example_en: The politician was accused of arm-twisting to get votes.

entries.definition_en: a very large fleet of warships, or a large group of similar things
entries.example_cn: 西班牙无敌舰队是一支庞大的舰队，被派去入侵英格兰。
entries.example_en: The Spanish Armada was a massive fleet sent to invade England.

entries.definition_en: a nocturnal mammal that burrows and has a body covered with hard, horny plates

entries.example_en: The farmer was surprised to find an armadillo digging in his garden at night.

entries.definition_cn: 大决战；世界末日般的灾难

entries.definition_en: weapons used by military or naval forces

entries.definition_en: the act of equipping with weapons in preparation for war

entries.example_en: The rapid armament of the new division surprised the enemy.

entries.example_en: The electric motor relies on the armature to generate motion.

entries.definition_en: a band worn around the upper arm
