entries.example_en: The climb up the mountain caused severe breathlessness.

entries.definition_en: causing one to stop breathing momentarily due to awe or excitement
entries.example_cn: 山顶令人屏息的景色让我们忘记了呼吸。
entries.example_en: The breathtaking view from the mountain top made us forget to breathe.

entries.definition_en: a type of rock made of sharp fragments stuck together in clay or sand
entries.example_cn: 地质学家检查了角砾岩以确定岩石碎片的来源。
entries.example_en: The geologist examined the breccia to identify the source of the rock fragments.

entries.definition_en: the opening at the back of a gun barrel used for loading bullets
entries.example_cn: 士兵将子弹装入步枪的枪膛后部。
entries.example_en: The soldier loaded the cartridge into the breech of the rifle.

entries.definition_en: (of guns) designed to be loaded at the breech
entries.example_cn: 后膛装填步枪比前膛装填步枪装弹更快。
entries.example_en: The breech-loading rifle was faster to reload than the muzzle-loader.

entries.definition_en: a metal block in breech-loading firearms that is withdrawn to insert a cartridge and replaced to close the breech before firing
entries.example_cn: 士兵小心地取下后膛闭锁块以装填新弹药。
entries.example_en: The soldier carefully removed the breechblock to load the new ammunition.

entries.definition_en: dressed in trousers
entries.example_cn: 婴儿穿上了裤子，准备出门。
entries.example_en: The baby was breeched and ready for the outing.

entries.definition_en: trousers ending above the knee
entries.example_cn: 他穿着传统的马裤参加骑马比赛。
entries.example_en: He wore traditional breeches for the horse riding competition.

entries.definition_en: a special variety of domesticated animals within a species
entries.example_cn: 金毛寻回犬是一种受欢迎的犬种。
entries.example_en: The Golden Retriever is a popular dog breed.

entries.definition_en: a special type
entries.example_cn: 这是一种罕见的苹果品种。
entries.example_en: This is a rare breed of apple.

entries.definition_en: call forth
entries.example_cn: 巨大的噪音引起了人群的恐慌。
entries.example_en: The loud noise bred a sense of panic among the crowd.

entries.definition_en: cause to procreate (animals)
entries.example_cn: 农民繁殖牛只以生产优质牛肉。
entries.example_en: Farmers breed cattle to produce high-quality beef.

entries.definition_en: have young (animals) or reproduce (organisms)
entries.example_cn: 狗可以在六个月大时繁殖。
entries.example_en: Dogs can breed as early as six months old.

entries.definition_en: copulate with a female, used especially of horses
entries.example_cn: 这匹种马将在春天与母马交配。
entries.example_en: The stallion will breed with the mare in the spring.

entries.definition_en: a person who breeds animals
entries.example_cn: 这位育种者培育纯种狗。
entries.example_en: The breeder raised purebred dogs.

entries.definition_en: the production of animals or plants by inbreeding or hybridization
entries.example_cn: 这家公司专门从事稀有兰花的育种。
entries.example_en: The company specializes in the breeding of rare orchids.

entries.definition_en: the sexual activity of conceiving and bearing offspring
entries.example_cn: 兽医就狗的交配提供了建议，以确保幼犬健康。
entries.example_en: The vet advised on the mating of dogs to ensure healthy puppies.

entries.definition_en: good upbringing, especially knowledge of correct social behavior
entries.example_cn: 他对待客人的方式显示了他良好的教养。
entries.example_en: His breeding was evident in the way he treated his guests.

entries.definition_en: helping someone grow up to be an accepted member of the community
entries.example_cn: 这所学校致力于培养负责任的公民。
entries.example_en: The school focuses on the breeding of responsible citizens.

entries.definition_en: elegance shown through fine manner and expression
entries.example_cn: 她天生优雅，在正式场合中脱颖而出。
entries.example_en: She has a natural breeding that makes her stand out at formal events.

entries.definition_en: producing offspring or set aside for producing offspring
entries.example_cn: 这家农场养了一群用于繁殖的牛。
entries.example_en: The farm keeps a herd of breeding cattle.

entries.definition_en: a light and gentle wind
entries.example_cn: 微风拂面，让人感到凉爽舒适。
entries.example_en: The breeze felt cool and refreshing on our faces.

entries.definition_en: an easy task or undertaking
entries.example_cn: 对她来说，通过考试轻而易举。
entries.example_en: Passing the exam was a breeze for her.

entries.definition_en: to proceed quickly and easily
entries.example_cn: 我们轻松地读完了这本书的第一章。
entries.example_en: We breezed through the first chapter of the book.

entries.definition_en: to blow gently and lightly
entries.example_cn: 风开始轻拂树木。
entries.example_en: The wind began to breeze through the trees.

entries.definition_en: in a breezy manner
entries.example_cn: 她轻快地驳斥了批评，并未当真。
entries.example_en: She breezily dismissed the criticism without taking it seriously.

entries.definition_en: a lively and cheerful manner or atmosphere
entries.example_cn: 她的谈话中有一种轻快活泼的基调，让大家都感到放松。
entries.example_en: There was a certain breeziness to her conversation that put everyone at ease.

entries.definition_en: a state of air that is mildly windy
entries.example_cn: 下午的微风让沿着海岸的散步非常愉快。
entries.example_en: The breeziness of the afternoon made the walk along the coast very pleasant.

entries.definition_en: abounding in or exposed to the wind or breezes
entries.example_cn: 沿海地区以夏季多风的气候而闻名。
entries.example_en: The coast is known for its breezy weather in the summer.

entries.definition_cn: 轻松活泼的；轻快而随意的
entries.definition_en: fresh and animated; full of energy and enthusiasm
entries.example_cn: 演讲者做了一个轻快活泼的演示，吸引了观众的注意力。
entries.example_en: The speaker gave a breezy presentation that kept the audience engaged.

entries.definition_cn: 矢状缝与冠状缝交汇处的颅顶测量点
entries.definition_en: the craniometric point where the sagittal and coronal sutures meet at the top of the cranium
entries.example_cn: 解剖学家在头骨模型上标记了矢状缝与冠状缝交汇处的颅顶测量点。
entries.example_en: The anatomist marked the bregma on the skull model.

entries.definition_en: a brent goose, a small dark goose that breeds in the north and migrates southward
entries.example_cn: 黑雁冬季向南飞行。
entries.example_en: The brent geese fly south for the winter.

entries.definition_en: members of a male religious order
entries.example_cn: 修道院欢迎了来自邻近修道院的来访修士。
entries.example_en: The abbey welcomed the visiting brethren from the neighboring monastery.

entries.definition_en: a small U-shaped mark placed over a vowel to show it should be pronounced quickly
entries.example_cn: 词典在元音上方使用短音符号来表示短元音。
entries.example_en: The dictionary uses a breve over the vowel to indicate a short vowel sound.

entries.definition_cn: 临时晋升（不加薪）的委任状
entries.definition_en: a document that gives a military officer a higher rank for a short time without extra pay
entries.example_cn: 该军官收到了一份任命他为上校但不加薪的临时委任状。
entries.example_en: The officer received a brevet appointing him colonel without an increase in pay.

entries.definition_en: to promote someone to a higher military rank temporarily without increasing their pay
entries.example_cn: 该军官因英勇行为被临时晋升为少校。
entries.example_en: The officer was brevetted to major for his bravery.

entries.definition_en: a book of daily prayers used by priests and members of religious orders in the Roman Catholic Church
entries.example_cn: 神父打开他的日课经开始早祷。
entries.example_en: The priest opened his breviary to begin the morning prayers.

entries.definition_en: the quality of using few words; conciseness
entries.example_cn: 她欣赏他解释的简练。
entries.example_en: She appreciated the brevity of his explanation.

entries.definition_en: the state of being short in time or duration
entries.example_cn: 会议的短暂让我们能迅速回到工作中。
entries.example_en: The brevity of the meeting allowed us to get back to work quickly.

entries.definition_en: to prepare a drink by brewing
entries.example_cn: 她正在为客人冲泡一壶咖啡。
entries.example_en: She is brewing a pot of coffee for the guests.

entries.definition_cn: 将茶、草药或其他物质浸泡在热水或沸水中以提取其风味
entries.definition_en: to soak tea, herbs, or another substance in hot or boiling water to extract its flavor
entries.example_cn: 把草药用热水冲泡十分钟。
entries.example_en: Brew the herbs in hot water for ten minutes.

entries.definition_en: a drink made by steeping and boiling and fermenting rather than distilling
entries.example_cn: 这家酒吧供应当地酿造的啤酒。
entries.example_en: The pub serves a local brew.

entries.definition_en: a person whose job is to make beer or ale
entries.example_cn: 这位著名的酿酒师创造了一种获奖的新式世涛啤酒。
entries.example_en: The famous brewer created a new type of stout that won an award.

entries.definition_en: the owner or manager of a brewery
entries.example_cn: 这位新的酿酒厂老板决定扩建工厂以满足日益增长的需求。
entries.example_en: The new brewer decided to expand the factory to meet growing demand.

entries.definition_en: a plant where beer is brewed by fermentation
entries.example_cn: 这家当地的酿酒厂生产一种著名的世涛啤酒。
entries.example_en: The local brewery produces a famous stout.

entries.definition_cn: 酿造酒类，尤指啤酒；酿造过程
entries.definition_en: the production of alcoholic beverages, especially beer, by fermentation; the brewing process
entries.example_cn: 这家当地酿酒厂已经完善其酿造技术超过一个世纪了。
entries.example_en: The local brewery has been perfecting its brewing techniques for over a century.

entries.definition_en: a restaurant that brews its own beer for on-site consumption
entries.example_cn: 我们决定去市中心新开的自酿啤酒餐厅吃晚饭。
entries.example_en: We decided to have dinner at the new brewpub downtown.

entries.definition_en: to keep fire burning at the mouth of an oven to preserve heat
entries.example_cn: 那位老妇人整夜在炉口生火，以保持面包温暖。
entries.example_en: The old woman would brian the oven all night to keep the bread warm.

entries.definition_cn: 带刺的植物，尤指野蔷薇
entries.definition_en: a thorny plant, especially a wild rose, with prickly stems
entries.example_cn: 园丁修剪了玫瑰，以促进春季开花。
entries.example_en: The gardener pruned the briar to encourage more blooms in the spring.

entries.definition_en: a prickly woody vine native to the eastern United States with tough stems and inedible berries
entries.example_cn: 徒步者经常被沿着森林小径生长的野蔷薇划破皮肤。
entries.example_en: Hikers often get scratched by the briar growing along the forest trail.

entries.definition_en: an evergreen Mediterranean shrub with fragrant white flowers, used to make tobacco pipes
entries.example_cn: 古董店出售了一支用这种灌木根部雕刻的石楠木烟斗。
entries.example_en: The antique shop sold a briar pipe carved from the root of the shrub.

entries.definition_en: a pipe made from the root of the tree heath
entries.example_cn: 他更喜欢抽烟斗而不是陶土烟斗。
entries.example_en: He preferred smoking a briar over a clay pipe.

entries.definition_en: an old French breed of large, strong, usually black dogs with a long tail and a long, wavy, slightly stiff coat
entries.example_cn: 农夫训练他的布里亚尔犬来放羊。
entries.example_en: The farmer trained his briard to herd sheep.

entries.definition_cn: 用于制作烟斗的石南根硬木
entries.definition_en: hard wood from the root of the briar plant, used for making tobacco pipes
entries.example_cn: 他用树莓木雕刻了一支新烟斗。
entries.example_en: He carved a new pipe from briarwood.

entries.definition_cn: 为腐蚀某人的判断而向其（处于受信任地位者）支付的款项
entries.definition_en: payment made to a person in a position of trust to corrupt their judgment
entries.example_cn: 这位政治家因接受建筑公司的贿赂而被捕。
entries.example_en: The politician was arrested for accepting a bribe from a construction company.

entries.definition_cn: 为换取恩惠或影响力而向（某人）支付非法款项
entries.definition_en: make illegal payments to in exchange for favors or influence
entries.example_cn: 他被指控贿赂法官以改变判决结果。
entries.example_en: He was accused of bribing the judge to change the verdict.

entries.definition_en: a person who bribes someone
entries.example_cn: 行贿者向那名官员送钱后被逮捕了。
entries.example_en: The briber was arrested after offering money to the official.

entries.definition_en: the practice of offering money or gifts to gain an unfair advantage
entries.example_cn: 该公司因贿赂被罚款。
entries.example_en: The company was fined for bribery.

entries.definition_en: a collection of various small, miscellaneous decorative objects
entries.example_cn: 这家古董店里摆满了来自不同时代的杂七杂八的装饰品。
entries.example_en: The antique shop was filled with bric-a-brac from different eras.

entries.definition_en: a rectangular block of baked clay used for building
entries.example_cn: 这面墙是用红砖砌成的。
entries.example_en: The wall was built with red bricks.

entries.definition_en: a helpful and trustworthy person
entries.example_cn: 他是我们团队中真正的可靠之人。
entries.example_en: He is a real brick in our team.

entries.definition_cn: （电子设备）变砖；彻底失去功能，通常难以修复
entries.definition_en: of an electronic device: to become non-functional, often beyond repair, especially because of software or configuration problems
entries.example_cn: 我的手机在一次失败的固件更新后变成了砖头，彻底失去了功能。
entries.example_en: My phone bricked after a failed firmware update.

entries.definition_en: having the shape of a brick
entries.example_cn: 这座建筑的占地面积呈砖形。
entries.example_en: The building has a brick-shaped footprint.

entries.definition_en: blunt criticism
entries.example_cn: 评论家对新政策的严厉批评虽然苛刻但公正。
entries.example_en: The reviewer's brickbat against the new policy was harsh but fair.

usage.label: figurative
usage.pattern: Used figuratively for sharp criticism or an uncomplimentary remark.

entries.definition_cn: 用作武器的砖块、石块或类似物
entries.definition_en: a piece of brick, rock, or similar material used as a weapon
entries.example_cn: 暴徒向警车投掷砖块。
entries.example_en: The rioters threw brickbats at the police cars.

entries.definition_en: a place where bricks are manufactured and sold
entries.example_cn: 建筑公司在砖窑附近购买了土地以扩大业务。
entries.example_en: The construction company bought land near the brickfield to expand its operations.

entries.definition_en: a worker who builds walls and structures using bricks
entries.example_cn: 这位熟练的泥瓦匠在日落前完成了烟囱的建造。
entries.example_en: The skilled bricklayer finished the chimney before sunset.

entries.definition_en: the skill or work of laying bricks to build walls or structures
entries.example_cn: 砌砖是一项需要极大耐心和精确度的传统工艺。
entries.example_en: Bricklaying is a traditional craft that requires great patience and precision.

entries.definition_en: having little elasticity; easily cracked or fractured
entries.example_cn: 那个旧陶瓷花瓶很脆，一摔就碎了。
entries.example_en: The old ceramic vase was brickle and shattered when dropped.

entries.definition_en: walls or structures built using bricks and mortar
entries.example_cn: 古老的砖石结构已屹立数个世纪。
entries.example_en: The old brickwork has survived for centuries.

entries.definition_en: a place where bricks are manufactured and sold
entries.example_cn: 建筑公司从当地的砖厂购买了材料。
entries.example_en: The construction company bought its materials from a local brickyard.

entries.definition_en: the construction of something using whatever materials are available
entries.example_cn: 艺术家用木料、铁丝和布料碎片拼凑制作了一件装置作品。
entries.example_en: The artist used bricolage, combining scraps of wood, wire, and fabric into an installation.

entries.definition_cn: 用现有材料拼凑而成的东西
entries.definition_en: something made using whatever materials are available
entries.example_cn: 这个避难所是用木板、防水布和绳子拼凑而成的。
entries.example_en: The shelter was a bricolage of wooden boards, tarpaulins, and rope.

entries.definition_cn: 将其他作品的摘录或片段组合起来创作新作品的修辞风格
entries.definition_en: a rhetorical style that combines excerpts or samples from other works to create a new work
entries.example_cn: 这部小说采用拼贴式写法，将报纸、日记和广告中的引文编织在一起。
entries.example_en: The novel uses bricolage, weaving together quotations from newspapers, diaries, and advertisements.

entries.definition_en: relating to a wedding
entries.example_cn: 她穿着一件漂亮的婚纱参加了仪式。
entries.example_en: She wore a beautiful bridal gown to the ceremony.

entries.definition_en: relating to a bride
entries.example_cn: 新娘的伴娘们提前到达拍照。
entries.example_en: The bridal party arrived early for the photos.

entries.definition_en: an archaic term for a wedding or wedding feast
entries.example_cn: 这首诗描述了这对年轻夫妇欢乐的婚礼。
entries.example_en: The poem describes the joyous bridal of the young couple.

entries.definition_en: a woman who has recently been married
entries.example_cn: 新娘在婚礼上穿了一件白裙子。
entries.example_en: The bride wore a white dress to the wedding.

entries.definition_en: a woman participant in her own marriage ceremony
entries.example_cn: 作为新娘，她既紧张又高兴。
entries.example_en: As the bride, she felt nervous but happy.

entries.definition_en: a present given to the bride at a wedding
entries.example_cn: 新郎一家在仪式前给了新娘礼物。
entries.example_en: The groom's family gave the bride-gift before the ceremony.

entries.definition_en: a woman who is soon to be married
entries.example_cn: 这位未婚妻对她的即将到来的婚礼感到紧张。
entries.example_en: The bride-to-be was nervous about her upcoming wedding.

entries.definition_en: a man who has recently been married.
entries.example_cn: 新郎走下过道时看起来很紧张。
entries.example_en: The bridegroom looked nervous as he walked down the aisle.

entries.definition_en: a man participating in his own marriage ceremony.
entries.example_cn: 作为新郎，他穿着燕尾服参加了婚礼。
entries.example_en: As the bridegroom, he wore a tuxedo to the wedding.

entries.definition_en: an unmarried woman who attends the bride at a wedding
entries.example_cn: 莎拉被选为伴娘。
entries.example_en: Sarah was chosen to be the bridesmaid.

entries.definition_en: a structure built over a river, road, or railway to allow people or vehicles to cross it
entries.example_cn: 他们通过石桥过河。
entries.example_en: They crossed the river on a stone bridge.

entries.definition_en: a card game for four players based on whist
entries.example_cn: 他们晚饭后玩了桥牌。
entries.example_en: They played bridge in the evening after dinner.

entries.definition_en: the hard ridge on the upper part of the nose
entries.example_cn: 她的鼻梁很高。
entries.example_en: She has a high bridge on her nose.

entries.definition_en: something that looks like or works like a bridge
entries.example_cn: 门道的拱形起到了连接两面墙的桥梁作用。
entries.example_en: The arch of the doorway acts as a bridge between the two walls.

entries.definition_en: to connect two things or reduce the distance between them
entries.example_cn: 这条新公路将缩短这两座城市之间的距离。
entries.example_en: The new highway will bridge the gap between the two cities.

entries.definition_en: to make a bridge across something
entries.example_cn: 他们用一条临时通道在两栋建筑之间架了一座桥。
entries.example_en: They bridged the gap between the two buildings with a temporary walkway.

entries.definition_en: to cross over on a bridge
entries.example_cn: 下雨前我们迅速过了河。
entries.example_en: We bridged the river quickly before the rain started.

entries.definition_en: a circuit with four arms arranged in a diamond shape, used to measure electrical resistance
entries.example_cn: 工程师使用惠斯通电桥来测试电阻器。
entries.example_en: The engineer used a Wheatstone bridge to test the resistor.

entries.definition_en: capable of being connected by a bridge or as if by a bridge
entries.example_cn: 这两座岛屿可以通过一座新的悬索桥连接起来。
entries.example_en: The two islands are bridgeable by a new suspension bridge.

entries.definition_en: an area in enemy territory that has been captured and is held while waiting for more troops and supplies
entries.example_cn: 军队在河对岸建立了桥头堡。
entries.example_en: The army established a bridgehead on the other side of the river.

entries.definition_en: a defensive position located at the end of a bridge closest to the enemy
entries.example_cn: 士兵们坚守桥头防御工事，抵御进犯的部队。
entries.example_en: Soldiers held the bridgehead against the advancing forces.

entries.definition_en: a dental prosthesis anchored to teeth on either side of missing teeth
entries.example_cn: 牙医建议做牙桥来替换缺失的三个磨牙。
entries.example_en: The dentist recommended bridgework to replace the three missing molars.

entries.definition_en: the construction or repair of bridges
entries.example_cn: 这家公司专门从事桥梁建造和其他大型基础设施项目。
entries.example_en: The company specializes in bridgework and other large infrastructure projects.

entries.definition_en: headgear for a horse, consisting of a headstall, bit, and reins
entries.example_cn: 骑手在上马前调整了马笼头。
entries.example_en: The rider adjusted the bridle before mounting the horse.

entries.definition_en: a restraint, curb, or check
entries.example_cn: 他克制住了自己的脾气。
entries.example_en: He kept a bridle on his temper.

entries.definition_en: to show resentment or take offense
entries.example_cn: 她对暗示她能力不足的说法感到愤怒。
entries.example_en: She bridled at the suggestion that she was incompetent.

entries.definition_en: to put a bridle on (a horse)
entries.example_cn: 马夫仔细地给马戴上了笼头。
entries.example_en: The groom bridled the horse carefully.

entries.definition_en: to hold up one's head proudly or affectedly
entries.example_cn: 那匹马昂首傲然走进场地。
entries.example_en: The horse bridled proudly as it entered the ring.

entries.definition_en: lasting for a short time or distance
entries.example_cn: 午餐前我们开了个简短的会。
entries.example_en: We had a brief meeting before lunch.

entries.definition_en: concise and to the point
entries.example_cn: 她简要地解释了规则。
entries.example_en: She gave a brief explanation of the rules.

entries.definition_en: very short in length (of clothing)
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一条极短的裙子去参加聚会。
entries.example_en: She wore a brief skirt to the party.

entries.definition_en: to give someone essential information
entries.example_cn: 经理向团队简要说明了新政策。
entries.example_en: The manager briefed the team on the new policy.

entries.definition_en: a short written summary
entries.example_cn: 请阅读报告的摘要。
entries.example_en: Please read the brief of the report.

entries.definition_en: a document summarizing facts and legal points for a case
entries.example_cn: 律师为法庭准备了一份案情摘要。
entries.example_en: The lawyer prepared a brief for the court.

entries.definition_en: a case with a handle; for carrying papers or files or books
entries.example_cn: 她把文件放进公文包里。
entries.example_en: She put her documents in her briefcase.

entries.definition_en: a concise summary of a current situation, especially one prepared for an operation or undertaking
entries.example_cn: 将军在任务前参加了一次简报。
entries.example_en: The general attended a briefing before the mission.

entries.definition_en: for a short time
entries.example_cn: 她短暂地停下来系鞋带。
entries.example_en: She stopped briefly to tie her shoe.

entries.definition_en: in a concise manner; in a few words
entries.example_cn: 会议开始前，他简略地解释了规则。
entries.example_en: He briefly explained the rules before the meeting.

entries.definition_en: the quality of lasting for a very short time
entries.example_cn: 暴风雨的短暂性让每个人都感到惊讶。
entries.example_en: The briefness of the storm surprised everyone.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being concise in expression
entries.example_cn: 她欣赏他的解释简洁明了。
entries.example_en: She appreciated the briefness of his explanation.

entries.definition_en: short tight-fitting underpants
entries.example_cn: 他买了一副新的三角裤去健身房。
entries.example_en: He bought a new pair of briefs for the gym.

entries.definition_en: a tangled mass of prickly plants
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在树林里玩耍时被荆棘丛划伤了。
entries.example_en: The children got scratched by the brier while playing in the woods.

entries.definition_en: a thorny stem or twig
entries.example_cn: 她小心地从口袋里拔出了那根带刺的细枝。
entries.example_en: She carefully removed the brier from her pocket.

entries.definition_cn: 一种茎带刺、叶有香气、开亮粉色花并结鲜红色果实的欧亚玫瑰
entries.definition_en: a Eurasian rose with prickly stems, fragrant leaves, bright pink flowers, and scarlet hips
entries.example_cn: 花园里的这种玫瑰因其亮粉色的花朵吸引了许多蜜蜂。
entries.example_en: The brier in the garden attracted many bees with its bright pink flowers.

entries.definition_cn: 美国东部一种非常带刺的木质藤本植物，茎坚硬圆形，叶有光泽呈皮革状，开小绿色花，结不可食用的光亮黑色浆果
entries.definition_en: a very prickly woody vine of the eastern United States with tough round stems, shiny leathery leaves, small greenish flowers, and inedible shiny black berries
entries.example_cn: 这种藤本植物沿着河岸成团生长。
entries.example_en: The brier grew in tangled masses along the riverbank.

entries.definition_cn: 一种常绿、树状的地中海灌木，开芳香白花，有坚硬木质根，用于制作烟斗
entries.definition_en: an evergreen treelike Mediterranean shrub with fragrant white flowers and hard woody roots used to make tobacco pipes
entries.example_cn: 人们采集这种灌木的根来制作高质量的烟斗。
entries.example_en: The brier was harvested for its roots to craft high-quality tobacco pipes.

entries.definition_en: having or covered with protective barbs, quills, spines, thorns, or setae
entries.example_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿过茂密且长满荆棘的灌木丛。
entries.example_en: The hikers struggled through the dense, briery undergrowth.

entries.definition_en: a two-masted sailing ship with square sails on both masts
entries.example_cn: 海盗们捕获了一艘双桅横帆船，并将其驶向最近的岛屿。
entries.example_en: The pirates captured a brig and sailed it to the nearest island.

entries.definition_en: a prison, especially one on a ship
entries.example_cn: 水手们因拒绝服从命令而被关进了囚室。
entries.example_en: The sailors were locked in the brig for refusing to follow orders.

entries.definition_en: a military unit smaller than a division, made up of several battalions
entries.example_cn: 该旅被部署到边境地区进行守卫。
entries.example_en: The brigade was deployed to secure the border region.

entries.definition_en: to form or unite into a brigade
entries.example_cn: 志愿者们联合起来组织救援工作。
entries.example_en: The volunteers brigaded together to organize the relief effort.

entries.definition_en: a military officer who commands a brigade, ranking below a major general
entries.example_cn: 准将在关键行动中指挥部队。
entries.example_en: The brigadier led the troops during the critical operation.

entries.definition_en: a member of a band of armed robbers
entries.example_cn: 强盗们躲在山里以躲避警察。
entries.example_en: The brigands hid in the mountains to avoid the police.

entries.definition_cn: 布面甲；一种中世纪铠甲，由金属鳞片或甲片缝在或铆接在布料上制成
entries.definition_en: a medieval coat of armor made of metal scales or plates sewn or riveted onto canvas, linen, or similar material
entries.example_cn: 骑士在外衣下面穿着布面甲，以获得额外保护。
entries.example_en: The knight wore a brigandine beneath his outer clothing for extra protection.

entries.definition_en: two-masted sailing vessel square-rigged on the foremast and fore-and-aft rigged on the mainmast
entries.example_cn: 那艘双桅横帆船在开阔的大海上快速航行。
entries.example_en: The brigantine sailed swiftly across the open sea.

entries.definition_en: emitting or reflecting light readily or in large amounts
entries.example_cn: 明亮的太阳温暖了雪地。
entries.example_en: The bright sun warmed the snow.

entries.definition_en: having lots of light either natural or artificial
entries.example_cn: 我们需要一个光线充足的手术室。
entries.example_en: We need a bright room for the surgery.

entries.definition_en: having strong or striking color
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一条鲜艳的红色连衣裙去参加聚会。
entries.example_en: She wore a bright red dress to the party.

entries.definition_en: characterized by quickness and ease in learning
entries.example_cn: 这个聪明的学生很快解出了数学题。
entries.example_en: The bright student solved the math problem quickly.

entries.definition_en: cheerful or favorable; promising
entries.example_cn: 她有着光明的未来。
entries.example_en: She has a bright future ahead of her.

entries.definition_en: with brightness
entries.example_cn: 星星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
entries.example_en: The stars shone bright in the night sky.

entries.definition_en: shining strongly; not dimmed
entries.example_cn: 整个风暴期间灯光都保持明亮。
entries.example_en: The lights remained bright throughout the storm.

entries.definition_en: made smooth and bright by or as if by rubbing; reflecting a sheen or glow
entries.example_cn: 他把鞋子擦得锃亮。
entries.example_en: He polished the shoes until they were bright.

entries.definition_cn: 使（某物）更明亮或更欢快
entries.definition_en: to make something brighter or more cheerful
entries.example_cn: 鲜花的鲜艳色彩使阴郁的房间变得欢快起来。
entries.example_en: The bright colors of the flowers helped to brighten the gloomy room.

entries.definition_en: to become brighter or clearer
entries.example_cn: 随着雾气散去，天空变得明亮起来。
entries.example_en: The sky brightened as the fog lifted.

entries.definition_en: with brightness
entries.example_cn: 阳光在雪地上明亮地照耀着。
entries.example_en: The sun shone brightly on the snow.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being luminous; emitting or reflecting light
entries.example_cn: 太阳的亮度使得夜晚很难看到星星。
entries.example_en: The brightness of the sun made it difficult to see the stars at night.

entries.definition_en: the location of a visual perception along a continuum from black to white
entries.example_cn: 摄影师调整了图像的明度，使阴影部分更加清晰。
entries.example_en: The photographer adjusted the brightness of the image to make the shadows clearer.

entries.definition_en: intelligence as manifested in being quick and witty
entries.example_cn: 这个孩子解决复杂谜题的速度很快，显示出他非常聪慧。
entries.example_en: The child's brightness was evident in how quickly he solved the complex puzzle.

entries.definition_en: European food fish
entries.example_cn: 厨师用新鲜的菱鲆做了一道美味的菜肴。
entries.example_en: The chef prepared a delicious meal featuring fresh brill.

entries.definition_en: exceptional mental ability
entries.example_cn: 她解决问题的才智受到了赞扬。
entries.example_en: She was praised for the brilliance of her solution to the problem.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being magnificent or splendid
entries.example_cn: 烟花表演的壮丽景象令观众惊叹。
entries.example_en: The brilliance of the fireworks display amazed the crowd.

entries.definition_en: an extremely bright light
entries.example_cn: 太阳的强光使司机目眩。
entries.example_en: The brilliance of the sun blinded the driver.

entries.definition_en: a quality that is much better or more impressive than usual
entries.example_cn: 她表演的卓越程度令整个观众席感到惊讶。
entries.example_en: The brilliancy of her performance surprised the entire audience.

entries.definition_en: having or marked by unusual and impressive intelligence
entries.example_cn: 这位才智过人的学生迅速解决了复杂的问题。
entries.example_en: The brilliant student solved the complex problem quickly.

entries.definition_en: of surpassing excellence
entries.example_cn: 她在期末考试中表现卓越。
entries.example_en: She gave a brilliant performance in the final exam.

entries.definition_en: having strong or striking color
entries.example_cn: 这件裙子是鲜艳的红色，吸引了所有人的目光。
entries.example_en: The dress was brilliant red and caught everyone's eye.

entries.definition_en: full of light; shining intensely
entries.example_cn: 晴朗的天空中阳光灿烂。
entries.example_en: The sun was brilliant in the clear sky.

entries.definition_en: characterized by grandeur
entries.example_cn: 这座宫殿是一座装饰华丽的宏伟建筑。
entries.example_en: The palace was a brilliant building with gold decorations.

entries.definition_en: clear and sharp and ringing
entries.example_cn: 铃声清脆响亮，在大厅里回荡。
entries.example_en: The bell gave a brilliant sound that echoed through the hall.

entries.definition_cn: （旧）发油；使头发易于梳理并有光泽的发膏
entries.definition_en: dated: a hair pomade used to make hair manageable and lustrous
entries.example_cn: 她在头发上涂了一点发油，使其更有光泽。
entries.example_en: She applied a little brilliantine to her hair to give it shine.

entries.definition_en: in a brilliant, highly skillful, or impressive way
entries.example_cn: 她极其聪明地解决了这个复杂的数学问题。
entries.example_en: She brilliantly solved the complex mathematical problem.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows great brightness
entries.example_cn: 在晴朗的夜空中，星星明亮地闪耀着。
entries.example_en: The stars shone brilliantly in the clear night sky.

entries.definition_en: to be full to the top; be filled to the brim
entries.example_cn: 杯子里装满了热咖啡。
entries.example_en: The cup was brimming with hot coffee.

entries.definition_en: to fill something to the brim
entries.example_cn: 他们把桶装满水，然后抬走了。
entries.example_en: They brimmed the bucket with water before carrying it away.

entries.definition_en: the top edge of a cup, bowl, or other container
entries.example_cn: 她端起杯子凑近嘴边，小心不要溢出杯沿。
entries.example_en: She lifted the cup to her lips, careful not to spill over the brim.

entries.definition_en: the stiff circular part of a hat that sticks out from the top
entries.example_cn: 他调整了一下帽檐，以遮挡阳光。
entries.example_en: He adjusted the brim of his hat to shield his eyes from the sun.

entries.definition_en: filled to the very top
entries.example_cn: 她把茶倒满了杯子。
entries.example_en: She poured the tea into a brimful cup.

entries.definition_en: filled up
entries.example_cn: 杯子里装满了热咖啡。
entries.example_en: The cup was brimming with hot coffee.

entries.definition_en: an archaic term for the chemical element sulfur
entries.example_cn: 这位老炼金术士在讨论火的性质时提到了硫磺。
entries.example_en: The old alchemist referred to brimstone when discussing the properties of fire.

entries.definition_en: having a grey or brown streak, pattern, or patchy coloring, especially in the fur of cats
entries.example_cn: 育种者挑选了一只杂色的猫，因为它有着独特的灰褐色皮毛图案。
entries.example_en: The breeder selected a brinded cat for its distinctive grey and brown fur pattern.

entries.definition_en: having a grey or brown streak or a pattern or a patchy coloring, especially on the fur of cats
entries.example_cn: 这只虎斑猫有着美丽的皮毛，浅色背景上有深色条纹。
entries.example_en: The brindle cat had a beautiful coat with dark stripes on a lighter background.

entries.definition_en: having a grey or brown streak or a pattern or a patchy coloring, especially on the fur of cats
entries.example_cn: 这只猫的皮毛有着美丽的虎斑图案，夹杂着灰色和棕色。
entries.example_en: The cat had a beautiful brindled coat with patches of grey and brown.

entries.definition_en: water containing a high amount of salt
entries.example_cn: 渔夫把船从咸水中拉了出来。
entries.example_en: The fisherman pulled the boat out of the brine.

entries.definition_en: a strong saltwater solution used for pickling
entries.example_cn: 橄榄是在一缸腌卤中腌制的。
entries.example_en: The olives were cured in a vat of brine.

entries.definition_cn: 用盐水腌制；用盐水浸泡
entries.definition_en: to preserve or prepare food by soaking it in brine
entries.example_cn: 他们在烤火鸡之前用盐水浸泡了它。
entries.example_en: They brined the turkey before roasting it.

entries.definition_en: to take something or someone with you to a specific place
entries.example_cn: 请明天把作业带到课堂上。
entries.example_en: Please bring your homework to class tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: to cause something to happen as a result
entries.example_cn: 他的行为导致了政策的改变。
entries.example_en: His actions brought about a change in the policy.

entries.definition_en: to cause something to enter a particular state or condition
entries.example_cn: 寒冷的天气使花朵停止生长。
entries.example_en: The cold weather brought the flowers to a halt.

entries.definition_en: to go after and return with something
entries.example_cn: 我会从图书馆把书取回来。
entries.example_en: I will bring the book back from the library.

entries.definition_en: to change something into a different state
entries.example_cn: 雨水让干燥的土地焕发生机。
entries.example_en: The rain brought the dry ground to life.

entries.definition_en: to be accompanied by someone or something
entries.example_cn: 这份新工作伴随着许多责任。
entries.example_en: The new job brought a lot of responsibility with it.

entries.definition_en: to bestow a quality or characteristic on someone
entries.example_cn: 老师给学生带来了希望。
entries.example_en: The teacher brought hope to the students.

entries.definition_en: to present something formally in a court of law
entries.example_cn: 律师向法官提出了动议。
entries.example_en: The lawyer brought a motion to the judge.

entries.definition_cn: 带来或携带某物的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of bringing something
entries.example_cn: 邮件的递送因暴风雨而延误。
entries.example_en: The bringing of the mail was delayed by the storm.

entries.definition_en: a hairy herb cultivated for its large, glossy edible fruit used as a vegetable.
entries.example_cn: 农民从花园里收获了茄子，准备晚餐。
entries.example_en: The farmer harvested the brinjals from the garden for the evening meal.

entries.definition_cn: 事物发生或变化的临界点
entries.definition_en: the limit beyond which something happens or changes
entries.example_cn: 这个国家正处于战争边缘。
entries.example_en: The country is on the brink of war.

entries.definition_en: the edge of a steep place
entries.example_cn: 他们站在悬崖边缘向下看。
entries.example_en: They stood on the brink of the cliff looking down.

entries.definition_en: a line or area that marks a boundary
entries.example_cn: 这条河标志着两国之间的边界。
entries.example_en: The river marks the brink between the two countries.

entries.definition_en: the policy of pushing a dangerous situation to the brink of disaster.
entries.example_cn: 外交官批评了政府在危机期间的边缘政策。
entries.example_en: The diplomat criticized the government's brinkmanship during the crisis.

entries.definition_en: salty or resembling seawater
entries.example_cn: 湖水微咸的味道来自附近的海洋。
entries.example_en: The briny taste of the lake water comes from the nearby sea.

entries.definition_en: the sea
entries.example_cn: 他们在海上度过了几个月。
entries.example_en: They spent months on the briny.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being active, spirited, and vigorous
entries.example_cn: 这场演出充满了活力。
entries.example_en: The performance was given with great brio.

entries.definition_en: a light, slightly sweet roll made with eggs and butter
entries.example_cn: 我们早餐享用了一份涂着黄油和果酱的温热布里欧修面包。
entries.example_en: We enjoyed a warm brioche with butter and jam for breakfast.

entries.definition_cn: 泻根属的一种有大叶和小花、能产生辛辣汁液的藤本植物
entries.definition_en: a vine of the genus Bryonia with large leaves and small flowers that yields acrid juice
entries.example_cn: 泻根属的这种藤本植物在河岸边野生生长。
entries.example_en: The briony grows wild along the riverbank.

entries.definition_en: a block of compressed charcoal or coal used as fuel
entries.example_cn: 他们用煤块点燃了火。
entries.example_en: They lit the fire with a briquet.

entries.definition_cn: 由压制的木炭或煤尘制成、用作燃料的固体块
entries.definition_en: a solid block made from compressed charcoal or coal dust that is used as fuel
entries.example_cn: 他们使用煤块在冬天取暖。
entries.example_en: They used briquettes to heat the room during the winter.

entries.definition_en: quick and energetic
entries.example_cn: 我们在公园里轻快地散步。
entries.example_en: We took a brisk walk in the park.

entries.definition_en: imparting vitality and energy
entries.example_cn: 新经理给办公室带来了充满活力的氛围。
entries.example_en: The new manager brought a brisk atmosphere to the office.

entries.definition_en: very active
entries.example_cn: 生意很兴旺，市场里有许多购物者。
entries.example_en: Business was brisk, with many shoppers at the market.

entries.definition_en: to become brisk
entries.example_cn: 咖啡一到，谈话就活跃起来了。
entries.example_en: The conversation brisked up after the coffee arrived.

entries.definition_en: a cut of meat from the breast or lower chest especially of beef
entries.example_cn: 我们点了一份慢炖牛胸肉作为晚餐。
entries.example_en: We ordered a slow-cooked brisket for dinner.

entries.definition_en: the chest of an animal
entries.example_cn: 那匹马的胸部宽阔而健壮。
entries.example_en: The horse's brisket was broad and muscular.

entries.definition_en: in a quick and energetic manner
entries.example_cn: 人群轻快地穿过狭窄的街道。
entries.example_en: The crowd moved briskly through the narrow streets.

entries.definition_en: liveliness and eagerness
entries.example_cn: 她动作的活力显示了她完成工作的决心。
entries.example_en: The briskness of her movements showed her determination to finish the work.

entries.definition_en: a stiff, coarse hair or fiber found on animals or used in brushes
entries.example_cn: 这把刷子有硬挺的刚毛。
entries.example_en: The brush has stiff bristles.

entries.definition_en: a single stiff hair
entries.example_cn: 一根刚毛勾在了织物上。
entries.example_en: A single bristle caught on the fabric.

entries.definition_cn: 因受到冒犯而恼怒；愤然反应
entries.definition_en: to react with anger or offense
entries.example_cn: 他对别人暗示自己懒惰而勃然大怒。
entries.example_en: He bristled at the suggestion that he was lazy.

usage.label: usually intransitive; bristle at
usage.pattern: Source w26805r5 supports intransitive use and the pattern “bristle at”.

entries.definition_cn: 因恐惧或愤怒而竖起毛发
entries.definition_en: to become stiff with fear or anger
entries.example_cn: 当看到陌生人时，那只狗因恐惧而竖起毛发。
entries.example_en: The dog bristled when it saw the stranger.

entries.definition_cn: 布满刚毛或其他突起物
entries.definition_en: to be covered or filled with many stiff hairs or other protruding objects
entries.example_cn: 山坡上遍布着刺刀。
entries.example_en: The hillside bristled with bayonets.

entries.definition_en: to move or vibrate quickly and slightly
entries.example_cn: 树叶在强风中颤动。
entries.example_en: The leaves bristled in the strong wind.

entries.definition_cn: 长有保护性倒刺、棘刺、刺毛或刚毛的
entries.definition_en: having or covered with protective barbs, quills, spines, thorns, or setae
entries.example_cn: 种荚上长满刚毛的表面能防止食草动物啃食。
entries.example_en: The bristled surface of the seed pod protects it from grazing animals.

entries.definition_en: covered with protective barbs, quills, spines, thorns, or setae
entries.example_cn: 刺猬身上长满了刺。
entries.example_en: The hedgehog has a bristly coat.

entries.definition_en: very irritable
entries.example_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个易怒的回答。
entries.example_en: He gave a bristly reply to the question.

entries.definition_en: informal term for breeches
entries.example_cn: 他去马厩之前穿上了旧马裤。
entries.example_en: He put on his old britches before going to the barn.

entries.definition_cn: 鲱鱼或鲱科鱼类的幼鱼
entries.definition_en: the young of a herring or sprat or similar fish
entries.example_cn: 渔民从深水中捕获了一条大幼鲱鱼。
entries.example_en: The fishermen caught a large britt from the deep waters.

entries.definition_cn: 构成露脊鲸食物的微小甲壳类动物
entries.definition_en: minute crustaceans forming food for right whales
entries.example_cn: 露脊鲸主要以漂浮在海洋中的一种叫作 britt 的微小甲壳类动物为食。
entries.example_en: Right whales feed primarily on tiny crustaceans called britt drifting in the ocean.

entries.definition_en: having little elasticity and easily cracked or snapped
entries.example_cn: 那根老树枝很脆，在雪的重压下断了。
entries.example_en: The old branch was brittle and broke under the weight of the snow.

entries.definition_cn: 缺乏温情和宽厚的；冷漠的
entries.definition_en: lacking warmth and generosity of spirit
entries.example_cn: 他对这场悲剧的冷漠回应显露出他缺乏温情和宽厚。
entries.example_en: His brittle response to the tragedy revealed a lack of warmth and generosity.

entries.definition_en: (of metal or glass) not annealed and easily cracked
entries.example_cn: 那块未退火的玻璃很脆，一摔就碎了。
entries.example_en: The unannealed glass was brittle and shattered when dropped.

entries.definition_en: caramelized sugar, usually with nuts, cooled into thin sheets
entries.example_cn: 她掰下一块坚果脆糖来吃。
entries.example_en: She broke off a piece of the brittle to eat.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being hard but easily broken
entries.example_cn: 旧玻璃的脆性使其难以安全处理。
entries.example_en: The brittleness of the old glass made it dangerous to handle.

entries.definition_en: bring up a topic for discussion
entries.example_cn: 他决定在会议上提出加薪的话题。
entries.example_en: He decided to broach the subject of salary increases at the meeting.

entries.definition_en: a broad chisel for cutting stone
entries.example_cn: 石匠用宽刃石凿切割石头。
entries.example_en: The mason used a broach to cut the stone.

entries.definition_en: having a hole made in the side of a cask or barrel
entries.example_cn: 那个已开口的酒桶正把酒漏到地板上。
entries.example_en: The broached cask was leaking wine onto the floor.

entries.definition_en: having a large width from one side to the other
entries.example_cn: 宽阔的河流缓缓流淌。
entries.example_en: The broad river flowed slowly.

entries.definition_en: covering a wide range of subjects or areas
entries.example_cn: 这门课程涵盖了广泛的历史主题。
entries.example_en: The course covers broad topics in history.

entries.definition_en: not detailed or specific; general
entries.example_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个笼统的回答。
entries.example_en: He gave a broad answer to the question.

entries.definition_en: full and unobstructed, especially of daylight
entries.example_cn: 盗窃案发生在光天化日之下。
entries.example_en: The theft occurred in broad daylight.

entries.definition_en: lacking subtlety; obvious and easy to see
entries.example_cn: 这是一个明显的暗示，他想离开。
entries.example_en: It was a broad hint that he wanted to leave.

entries.definition_cn: 女人；姑娘（美国口语，过时俚语）
entries.definition_en: a woman or girl (US, colloquial, dated slang)
entries.example_cn: 在那部老电影中，一个男人把女友称为“broad”。
entries.example_en: In the old film, a man calls his girlfriend a broad.

entries.definition_en: very large in size or scope
entries.example_cn: 他们面临着一个巨大的挑战。
entries.example_en: They faced a broad challenge.

entries.definition_en: (of speech) having a strong regional accent
entries.example_cn: 他用浓重的南方口音说话。
entries.example_en: He spoke with a broad Southern accent.

entries.definition_en: having leaves that are wide rather than thin or needle-like
entries.example_cn: 这片森林主要由在秋天落叶的阔叶树组成。
entries.example_en: The forest is dominated by broad-leaved trees that lose their leaves in autumn.

usage.label: not-comparable
usage.pattern: Source w27566r0 marks this adjective as not comparable.

entries.definition_en: respectful of opinions and beliefs that are different from your own
entries.example_cn: 一位开明的老师鼓励学生探索各种政治观点。
entries.example_en: A broad-minded teacher encourages students to explore various political viewpoints.

entries.definition_en: not easily shocked or offended
entries.example_cn: 她心胸开阔，没有因他不同寻常的外表而感到震惊。
entries.example_en: She is broad-minded and was not shocked by his unusual appearance.

entries.definition_en: in a manner that is open to new ideas and tolerant of different opinions
entries.example_cn: 尽管最初有些怀疑，她还是以开明的态度接受了同事们的建议。
entries.example_en: She broad-mindedly accepted the suggestions from her colleagues despite her initial doubts.

entries.definition_en: the willingness to accept different opinions or behaviors without judgment
entries.example_cn: 她的思想开明使她成为来自不同背景之人的好朋友。
entries.example_en: Her broad-mindedness made her a great friend to people from all backgrounds.

entries.definition_en: having broad shoulders
entries.example_cn: 他是个肩宽、打橄榄球的男人。
entries.example_en: He is a broad-shouldered man who plays rugby.

entries.definition_en: relating to a communications network that can carry multiple signals simultaneously
entries.example_cn: 我们需要升级宽带连接以进行视频会议。
entries.example_en: We need to upgrade our broadband connection for video conferencing.

entries.definition_en: of, relating to, or carrying a wide band of electromagnetic frequencies
entries.example_cn: 这根宽带天线能够在很宽的频率范围内传输信号。
entries.example_en: The broadband antenna can transmit signals across a wide range of frequencies.

entries.definition_en: a swordfish (Xiphias gladius)
entries.example_cn: 有人在岛屿附近捕获了一条剑鱼。
entries.example_en: A broadbill was caught near the island.

entries.definition_cn: 一种北美潜水鸭，拥有蓝灰色喙
entries.definition_en: a diving duck of North America with a bluish-grey bill
entries.example_cn: 这只鸭潜入水中捕鱼。
entries.example_en: The broadbill dove underwater to catch fish.

entries.definition_cn: 一种北半球淡水鸭，拥有宽阔扁平的喙
entries.definition_en: a freshwater duck of the Northern Hemisphere with a broad flat bill
entries.example_cn: 这种鸭经常在水边捕食昆虫。
entries.example_en: The broadbill is often seen feeding on insects near the water's edge.

entries.definition_cn: 一种与夜鹭相关的热带美洲鹭
entries.definition_en: a tropical American heron related to night herons
entries.example_cn: 我们发现一只罕见的鹭鸟在浅河中涉水。
entries.example_en: We spotted a rare broadbill wading in the shallow river.

entries.definition_cn: 旧世界热带地区的小型鸟类，拥有鲜艳的羽毛和短宽的喙
entries.definition_en: small birds of the Old World tropics with bright plumage and short wide bills
entries.example_cn: 那只色彩斑斓的鸟栖息在热带树的树枝上。
entries.example_en: The colorful broadbill perched on the branch of the tropical tree.

entries.definition_en: to transmit a program or message over radio or television
entries.example_cn: 电台今晚将现场直播这场音乐会。
entries.example_en: The station will broadcast the concert live tonight.

entries.definition_en: to make something known to many people
entries.example_cn: 丑闻被媒体传播到了全世界。
entries.example_en: The scandal was broadcast to the entire world by the press.

entries.definition_en: to scatter seeds over a wide area, especially by hand
entries.example_cn: 农民把种子撒遍了田野。
entries.example_en: The farmer broadcast the seeds across the field.

entries.definition_en: a program or message sent out by radio or television
entries.example_cn: 我们在收音机上听了新闻广播。
entries.example_en: We listened to the news broadcast on the radio.

entries.definition_en: a specific show or program on radio or television
entries.example_cn: 那个喜剧广播节目深受孩子们喜爱。
entries.example_en: That comedy broadcast is very popular with children.

entries.definition_en: a person who sends out radio or television programs
entries.example_cn: 广播员在演播室里播报了新闻。
entries.example_en: The broadcaster announced the news from the studio.

entries.definition_en: a machine that scatters seeds, fertilizer, or sand in all directions
entries.example_cn: 农民使用撒播机将肥料均匀地撒在田里。
entries.example_en: The farmer used a broadcaster to spread fertilizer evenly across the field.

entries.definition_cn: 广播电视业；广播电视行业
entries.definition_en: the business or profession of radio and television
entries.example_cn: 广播业随着数字技术发生了迅速变化。
entries.example_en: The broadcasting industry has changed rapidly with digital technology.

entries.definition_en: the act or process of broadcasting a radio or television programme
entries.example_cn: 她喜欢现场直播的激动人心。
entries.example_en: She enjoys the excitement of live broadcasting.

entries.definition_en: a densely textured woolen fabric with a shiny finish
entries.example_cn: 他穿着一套用优质密织毛料制成的西装。
entries.example_en: He wore a suit made of fine broadcloth.

entries.definition_cn: 有横向细条纹的紧密丝织物或合成纤维织物
entries.definition_en: a closely woven silk or synthetic fabric with a narrow rib
entries.example_cn: 这条裙子是用奢华的横向细条纹丝织物制成的。
entries.example_en: The dress was crafted from a luxurious broadcloth.

entries.definition_en: to increase the range or scope of something
entries.example_cn: 该公司计划明年扩大其产品系列。
entries.example_en: The company plans to broaden its product line next year.

entries.definition_en: to make something wider
entries.example_cn: 工人拓宽了城镇附近的道路。
entries.example_en: The workers broadened the road near the town.

entries.definition_en: to become wider
entries.example_cn: 这条路在接近城镇时变宽了。
entries.example_en: The road broadens as it approaches the town.

entries.definition_en: to vary investments to reduce risk
entries.example_cn: 我们需要分散我们的投资组合以降低风险。
entries.example_en: We need to broaden our investment portfolio.

entries.definition_en: the process of becoming broader
entries.example_cn: 河流的变宽导致山谷发生洪水。
entries.example_en: The broadening of the river caused flooding in the valley.

entries.definition_en: the action of making broader
entries.example_cn: 道路的拓宽将改善交通流量。
entries.example_en: The broadening of the road will improve traffic flow.

entries.definition_en: an increase in width
entries.example_cn: 从山顶可以看到地平线的变宽。
entries.example_en: The broadening of the horizon was visible from the hilltop.

entries.definition_en: having relatively broad rather than needlelike or scalelike leaves
entries.example_cn: 阔叶林提供了茂密的树冠。
entries.example_en: The broadleaf forest provides a dense canopy.

entries.definition_en: a carpet made on a wide loom so it has no seams
entries.example_cn: 他们在宽敞的客厅里安装了一块无缝的宽幅地毯。
entries.example_en: They installed a seamless broadloom in the large living room.

entries.definition_en: woven in one continuous piece without seams
entries.example_cn: 这块整幅地毯覆盖了整个地板，没有任何接缝。
entries.example_en: The broadloom rug covered the entire floor without any joints.

entries.definition_en: in a general way, without focusing on specific details or exceptions
entries.example_cn: 大体而言，尽管有一些小挫折，这个项目还是取得了成功。
entries.example_en: Broadly speaking, the project was a success despite minor setbacks.

entries.definition_en: over a wide area or in a wide manner
entries.example_cn: 这条河宽广地铺展在山谷中。
entries.example_en: The river spreads broadly across the valley.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being very wide
entries.example_cn: 这条河太宽阔了，没有船就无法渡河。
entries.example_en: The broadness of the river made it impossible to cross without a boat.

entries.definition_en: a large newspaper with pages of standard dimensions, usually covering serious news
entries.example_cn: 这家报纸出版了一期深入报道选举的大报。
entries.example_en: The newspaper published a broadsheet edition covering the election in depth.

entries.definition_en: a speech of violent denunciation
entries.example_cn: 这位政治家对政府的政策进行了猛烈抨击。
entries.example_en: The politician delivered a broadside against the government's policies.

entries.definition_en: an advertisement printed on a page or leaflet for wide distribution
entries.example_cn: 该公司分发数千份传单以推广新产品。
entries.example_en: The company distributed thousands of broadsides to promote the new product.

entries.definition_cn: 船的一侧（从船头到船尾）
entries.definition_en: the whole side of a vessel from stem to stern
entries.example_cn: 船员们在船的一侧工作以修复损坏。
entries.example_en: The crew worked on the broadside of the ship to repair the damage.

entries.definition_en: from or toward the side of a vessel or object
entries.example_cn: 侧视图展示了船的全长。
entries.example_en: The broadside view showed the ship's entire length.

entries.definition_en: to collide with the broad side of something
entries.example_cn: 货船从侧面撞上了那艘小船。
entries.example_en: The cargo ship broadsided the smaller vessel.

entries.definition_en: with a side facing an object
entries.example_cn: 船只侧向停泊在风中。
entries.example_en: The ship anchored broadside to the wind.

entries.definition_cn: 战舰一侧的全部火炮或武器
entries.definition_en: all the guns or armament on one side of a warship
entries.example_cn: 这艘战列舰的一侧配备了十门重炮。
entries.example_en: The battleship's broadside included ten heavy guns.

entries.definition_cn: 齐射（战舰单侧所有火炮同时发射）
entries.definition_en: the simultaneous firing of all armament on one side of a warship
entries.example_cn: 船长下令齐射以击沉敌舰。
entries.example_en: The captain ordered a broadside to sink the enemy vessel.

entries.definition_en: a sword with a wide blade designed for cutting rather than stabbing
entries.example_cn: 骑士有力地挥舞着他的阔剑。
entries.example_en: The knight swung his broadsword with great force.

entries.definition_en: a thick, heavy, and expensive fabric with a raised pattern woven into it
entries.example_cn: 她为参加舞会穿了一件由华丽锦缎制成的连衣裙。
entries.example_en: She wore a dress made of rich brocade for the gala.

entries.definition_en: to weave a decorative design into a textile
entries.example_cn: 工匠在丝绸上织出了花卉图案。
entries.example_en: The artisan brocaded a floral pattern onto the silk.

entries.definition_cn: 饰有通过压力或刺绣形成的凸起图案的
entries.definition_en: embellished with a raised pattern created by pressure or embroidery
entries.example_cn: 裁缝为晚礼服挑选了一块饰有凸起图案的织物。
entries.example_en: The dressmaker selected a brocaded fabric for the evening gown.

entries.definition_en: a plant with dense clusters of tight green flower buds
entries.example_cn: 我们晚餐蒸了一些新鲜的西兰花。
entries.example_en: We steamed some fresh broccoli for dinner.

entries.definition_en: branched green undeveloped flower heads
entries.example_cn: 厨师从市场上挑选了最好的西兰花。
entries.example_en: The chef selected the best broccoli from the market.

entries.definition_cn: 在小签子或烤肉叉上烤制的食物
entries.definition_en: food cooked on a small skewer or spit
entries.example_cn: 我们点了一份烤蔬菜串。
entries.example_en: We ordered a brochette of grilled vegetables.

entries.definition_en: a small spit or skewer
entries.example_cn: 肉是在明火上的签子上烤熟的。
entries.example_en: The meat was cooked on a brochette over the open fire.

entries.definition_en: a small book with a paper cover containing information
entries.example_cn: 旅行社给了我们一份关于这次旅行的宣传册。
entries.example_en: The travel agency gave us a brochure about the tour.

entries.definition_en: a male red deer in its second year of life
entries.example_cn: 猎人追踪那只年轻的两岁雄性红鹿穿过茂密的树林。
entries.example_en: The hunter tracked the young brocket through the dense woods.

entries.definition_cn: 一种有不分叉鹿角的南美小鹿
entries.definition_en: a small South American deer with unbranched antlers
entries.example_cn: 人们在亚马逊雨林深处发现了一只稀有的这种小鹿。
entries.example_en: The rare brocket was spotted deep in the Amazon rainforest.

entries.definition_en: a heavy working shoe
entries.example_cn: 他穿着一双结实的工作鞋走过泥泞的田野。
entries.example_en: He wore sturdy brogans while walking through the muddy fields.

entries.definition_en: a heavy shoe traditionally made of untanned leather (dated)
entries.example_cn: 农夫穿着结实的生皮厚重鞋。
entries.example_en: The farmer wore sturdy brogues made of untanned leather.

entries.definition_en: to cook food under a broiler
entries.example_cn: 她喜欢用柠檬烤鱼。
entries.example_en: She likes to broil fish with lemon.

entries.definition_en: to be exposed to great heat
entries.example_cn: 市中心在午后的高温下会变得非常热。
entries.example_en: The city center will broil in the afternoon heat.

entries.definition_en: to expose something to great heat
entries.example_cn: 太阳会把路面烤得滚烫，走上去都受不了。
entries.example_en: The sun will broil the pavement until it is too hot to walk on.

entries.definition_en: food prepared by broiling
entries.example_cn: 这家餐馆的烤制食品鲜嫩可口。
entries.example_en: The restaurant's broil was tender and flavorful.

entries.definition_cn: 肉用鸡；适合烧烤的嫩鸡
entries.definition_en: a young chicken raised for meat, especially one suitable for broiling
entries.example_cn: 这道菜需要一只新鲜的嫩鸡以确保肉质鲜嫩。
entries.example_en: The recipe calls for a fresh broiler to ensure tender meat.

entries.definition_cn: 烤炉；烤箱中的烧烤部件
entries.definition_en: an oven or part of a stove used for broiling
entries.example_cn: 她把鸡肉放在烤炉下面快速烹饪。
entries.example_en: She placed the chicken under the broiler to cook it quickly.

entries.definition_en: extremely hot
entries.example_cn: 他们在树荫下休息，以躲避午后酷热的阳光。
entries.example_en: They rested in the shade to escape the broiling afternoon sun.

entries.definition_en: the process of cooking food by exposing it directly to radiant heat, such as from a fire or a grill
entries.example_cn: 牛排经过几分钟的烧烤后完美熟透。
entries.example_en: The steak was perfect after a few minutes of broiling.

entries.definition_en: having no money
entries.example_cn: 我身无分文，买不起午饭。
entries.example_en: I am broke and cannot afford to buy lunch.

usage.label: informal
usage.pattern: usually predicative; often “dead broke” or “flat broke”

entries.definition_en: physically separated into pieces or cracked
entries.example_cn: 花瓶碎了。
entries.example_en: The vase is broken.

entries.definition_en: not continuous in space, time, or sequence
entries.example_cn: 旅程因暴风雨而中断。
entries.example_en: The journey was broken by a storm.

entries.definition_en: having been violated or disregarded
entries.example_cn: 被违背的承诺让他深感痛苦。
entries.example_en: The broken promise hurt him deeply.

entries.definition_cn: 意志消沉的；备受打击的
entries.definition_en: emotionally defeated or brought very low
entries.example_cn: 失败后，他一蹶不振。
entries.example_en: After the defeat, he was a broken man.

entries.definition_en: spoken or written in an imperfect, nonstandard way
entries.example_cn: 他说着不太规范的英语。
entries.example_en: He speaks broken English.

entries.definition_en: topographically very uneven
entries.example_cn: 崎岖不平的地面使行走变得困难。
entries.example_en: The broken ground made walking difficult.

entries.definition_en: tamed or trained to obey
entries.example_cn: 这匹马已被驯服，可以骑了。
entries.example_en: The horse is broken and ready for riding.

entries.definition_en: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
entries.example_cn: 派对结束后，房间一片狼藉。
entries.example_en: The room was left broken after the party.

entries.definition_en: having a damaged spine
entries.example_cn: 这位脊柱受损的病人需要立即手术。
entries.example_en: The broken-backed patient required immediate surgery.

entries.definition_cn: （马）背骨因骨质增生而连合的
entries.definition_en: (of a horse) having the back bones united by a bony growth
entries.example_cn: 这匹背骨愈合的马退役了。
entries.example_en: The broken-backed horse was retired from racing.

entries.definition_en: (of a ship) weakened so that it sags at both ends
entries.example_cn: 那艘旧船两端下垂，航行不安全。
entries.example_en: The old ship was broken-backed and unsafe to sail.

entries.definition_en: not in working order
entries.example_cn: 那辆出故障的汽车发动不起来。
entries.example_en: The broken-down car wouldn't start.

entries.definition_en: in a deplorable condition
entries.example_cn: 这所房子破败不堪，需要修理。
entries.example_en: The house was broken-down and needed repairs.

entries.definition_en: feeling full of sorrow because of a loss or disappointment
entries.example_cn: 当她得知他离开的消息时，她心碎了。
entries.example_en: She was brokenhearted when she received the news of his departure.

entries.definition_en: a businessman who buys or sells for another in exchange for a commission
entries.example_cn: 经纪人帮助客户迅速卖掉了房子。
entries.example_en: The broker helped the client sell their house quickly.

entries.definition_cn: 充当经纪人；撮合或安排交易
entries.definition_en: act as a broker; mediate or arrange a transaction
entries.example_cn: 该公司促成了两国之间的协议。
entries.example_en: The company brokered a deal between the two nations.

entries.definition_en: a person, company, or other organization that trades securities for its own account or on behalf of customers
entries.example_cn: 该经纪交易商代表客户执行了这笔交易。
entries.example_en: The broker-dealer executed the trade on behalf of the client.

entries.definition_en: a business or firm that acts as a broker
entries.example_cn: 这家经纪公司负责了这笔房地产交易。
entries.example_en: The brokerage handled the real estate transaction.

entries.definition_en: the business of a stock broker; a fee charged for acting as an intermediary between a buyer and a seller
entries.example_cn: 该公司决定降低经纪费以吸引更多客户。
entries.example_en: The company decided to cut its brokerage fees to attract more clients.

entries.definition_en: a place where a broker conducts their business
entries.example_cn: 经纪人将他的经营场所搬到了市中心更大的办公室。
entries.example_en: The broker moved his brokerage to a larger office downtown.

entries.definition_en: a colloquial term for an umbrella
entries.example_cn: 别忘了带上你的雨伞，看起来好像要下雨了。
entries.example_en: Don't forget to take your brolly; it looks like it might rain.

entries.definition_cn: （两名男子之间）非性关系的亲密友谊
entries.definition_en: a close, friendly, and intense relationship between two men that is not sexual
entries.example_cn: 他们的深厚友谊持续了几十年，即使他们搬到了不同的国家。
entries.example_en: Their bromance lasted for decades, even after they moved to different countries.

usage.label: slang
usage.pattern: a bromance between two or more men

entries.definition_en: a chemical compound containing the bromate ion
entries.example_cn: 装瓶前对水进行了溴酸盐残留检测。
entries.example_en: The water was tested for traces of bromate before being bottled.

entries.definition_en: to react with bromine
entries.example_cn: 这种有机化合物遇热会迅速与溴反应。
entries.example_en: The organic compound bromates rapidly when exposed to heat.

entries.definition_en: to treat with bromic acid or a bromate
entries.example_cn: 该溶液用溴酸盐试剂进行了处理。
entries.example_en: The solution was bromated with a bromate reagent.

entries.definition_en: a type of grass found in woodlands and meadows, native to temperate regions
entries.example_cn: 徒步者注意到草甸中的野花间长着成片的布罗麦草。
entries.example_en: The hikers noticed patches of brome growing among the wildflowers in the meadow.

entries.definition_en: a trite or obvious remark
entries.example_cn: 他的演讲充满了让听众感到无聊的陈词滥调。
entries.example_en: His speech was full of bromides that bored the audience.

entries.definition_en: any of the salts of hydrobromic acid; formerly used as a sedative but now generally replaced by safer drugs
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一种溴化物来帮助病人入睡。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed a bromide to help the patient sleep.

entries.definition_en: a nonmetallic, heavy, volatile, corrosive, dark brown liquid element belonging to the halogens, found in sea water
entries.example_cn: 溴是一种用于某些灭火器的化学元素。
entries.example_en: Bromine is a chemical element used in some fire extinguishers.

entries.definition_en: a wild horse that has not been broken to a saddle or rider
entries.example_cn: 这位牛仔花了数年时间试图驯服这匹野马。
entries.example_en: The cowboy spent years trying to tame the bronc.

entries.definition_en: relating to the bronchi, the large airways in the lungs
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了他的支气管是否有感染的迹象。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined his bronchial tubes for signs of infection.

entries.definition_en: inflammation of the membranes lining the bronchioles
entries.example_cn: 医生在检查症状后诊断出孩子患有细支气管炎。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed the child with bronchiolitis after checking the symptoms.

entries.definition_en: inflammation of the membranes lining the bronchial tubes
entries.example_cn: 医生诊断他患有急性支气管炎。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed him with acute bronchitis.

entries.definition_cn: 未断或断得不太彻底的野马
entries.definition_en: an unbroken or imperfectly broken mustang
entries.example_cn: 那匹野马在平原上飞奔。
entries.example_en: The broncho galloped across the plain.

entries.definition_en: a drug that relaxes and widens the bronchial tubes to improve airflow into the lungs
entries.example_cn: 患者在外出到寒冷环境中之前服用了支气管扩张剂。
entries.example_en: The patient took a bronchodilator before going outside in the cold.

entries.definition_en: a type of pneumonia involving inflammation of the small airways
entries.example_cn: 患者在发高烧后被诊断为支气管肺炎。
entries.example_en: The patient was diagnosed with bronchopneumonia after developing a high fever.

entries.definition_en: a slender tubular instrument used to examine the bronchial tubes
entries.example_cn: 医生插入支气管镜以检查患者的气道。
entries.example_en: The doctor inserted a bronchoscope to inspect the patient's airways.

entries.definition_en: relating to or used for examining the inside of the bronchi
entries.example_cn: 医生进行了支气管镜检查以检查炎症。
entries.example_en: The doctor performed a bronchoscopic examination to check for inflammation.

entries.definition_en: a sudden tightening of the airways in the lungs that makes breathing out difficult and noisy
entries.example_cn: 患者在哮喘发作期间经历了严重的支气管痉挛。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered a severe bronchospasm during the asthma attack.

entries.definition_en: either of the two main branches of the trachea that lead into the lungs
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了患者的支气管以查看是否有感染的迹象。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined the patient's bronchus to check for signs of infection.

entries.definition_en: a wild horse that has not been broken to a saddle
entries.example_cn: 牛仔骑着野马穿过尘土飞扬的平原。
entries.example_en: The cowboy rode the bronco across the dusty plains.

entries.definition_en: a huge four-legged plant-eating dinosaur from the late Jurassic period in North America
entries.example_cn: 博物馆的展览展示了一个巨大的雷龙模型。
entries.example_en: The museum exhibit features a model of the massive brontosaurus.

entries.definition_cn: 通常指《小马宝莉：友谊就是魔法》的成年男性粉丝
entries.definition_en: usually an adult male fan of the animated television series My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic
entries.example_cn: 这位《小马宝莉》的成年男性粉丝参加了大会，去见了他最喜欢的角色。
entries.example_en: The brony attended the convention to meet his favorite characters.

entries.definition_en: an alloy made of copper and tin
entries.example_cn: 这座雕像是用青铜铸造的。
entries.example_en: The statue was cast in bronze.

entries.definition_en: a sculpture made of bronze
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展示了一座著名的青铜像。
entries.example_en: The museum displays a famous bronze.

entries.definition_en: to make something look like bronze
entries.example_cn: 艺术家使雕塑的表面呈现出青铜色。
entries.example_en: The artist bronzed the surface of the sculpture.

entries.definition_en: to develop a tan through exposure to the sun
entries.example_cn: 他在夏天的阳光下很快晒黑了。
entries.example_en: He bronzed quickly in the summer sun.

entries.definition_en: having the color of bronze
entries.example_cn: 她的皮肤因日晒而呈青铜色。
entries.example_en: She has bronzed skin from the sun.

entries.definition_en: made from bronze
entries.example_cn: 他们买了一个青铜奖杯。
entries.example_en: They bought a bronze trophy.

entries.definition_en: having a brownish color from exposure to the sun
entries.example_cn: 在海滩待了一周后，她的皮肤晒成了古铜色。
entries.example_en: After a week at the beach, her skin was bronzed.

entries.definition_cn: 镀有青铜的；覆有青铜的
entries.definition_en: coated with bronze
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展出了一尊镀青铜的古代国王雕像。
entries.example_en: The museum displayed a bronzed statue of the ancient king.

entries.definition_en: a cosmetic powder in shades of brown used to make skin look tanned
entries.example_cn: 她在脸颊上涂抹修容粉，让自己看起来像是被阳光晒过一样。
entries.example_en: She applied bronzer to her cheeks to give her a sun-kissed look.

entries.definition_en: having the color of bronze
entries.example_cn: 在沙滩度过一天后，她的皮肤呈现出青铜色。
entries.example_en: After spending the day at the beach, her skin looked bronzy.

entries.definition_en: a decorative pin worn on clothing, typically by women
entries.example_cn: 她把一枚银胸针别在外套上。
entries.example_en: She pinned a silver brooch onto her coat.

entries.definition_en: to fasten something with or as if with a brooch
entries.example_cn: 她用胸针将两块布料固定在一起。
entries.example_en: She brooched the two pieces of fabric together.

entries.definition_en: think moodily or anxiously about something
entries.example_cn: 他坐在角落里，为他的失败而沉思。
entries.example_en: He sat in the corner brooding over his failure.

entries.definition_cn: 笼罩（常指令人不安或威胁的事物）
entries.definition_en: hang over, as of something threatening, dark, or menacing
entries.example_cn: 怀疑的乌云开始笼罩着这个团队。
entries.example_en: A dark cloud of suspicion began to brood over the team.

entries.definition_en: sit on (eggs)
entries.example_cn: 这只鸭子在蛋上孵了三周。
entries.example_en: The duck brooded on her eggs for three weeks.

entries.definition_en: be in a huff and display one's displeasure
entries.example_cn: 她拒绝和他说话，只是生气地摆脸色。
entries.example_en: She refused to speak to him and just brooded.

entries.definition_cn: 因不满而保持沉默或闷闷不乐
entries.definition_en: remain silent or sullen in an offended mood
entries.example_cn: 争吵后，他回到房间生闷气，拒绝和任何人说话。
entries.example_en: After the argument, he went to his room and brooded, refusing to speak to anyone.

entries.definition_en: the young of an animal cared for at one time
entries.example_cn: 母鸡坐在她的一窝小鸡上。
entries.example_en: The mother hen sat on her brood of chicks.

entries.definition_en: a box designed to keep a constant temperature using a thermostat, used for raising chicks or premature infants
entries.example_cn: 农民把雏鸡放进育雏箱，以确保它们保持温暖。
entries.example_en: The farmer placed the chicks in a brooder to ensure they stayed warm.

entries.definition_en: deeply or seriously thoughtful, often in a gloomy way
entries.example_cn: 他坐在沉思的沉默中，思考着自己的未来。
entries.example_en: He sat in a brooding silence, thinking about his future.

entries.definition_cn: 忧思；持续而阴郁的沉思
entries.definition_en: a period of brooding; persistent gloomy or morbid thought
entries.example_cn: 她整天都在为失败而病态地沉思。
entries.example_en: She spent the whole day in brooding over her failure.

entries.definition_cn: 在蛋上伏卧使其孵化的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of sitting on eggs to keep them warm until they hatch
entries.example_cn: 这只母鸡的孵卵持续了三周，直到蛋孵化。
entries.example_en: The hen’s brooding lasted three weeks, until the eggs hatched.

entries.definition_en: a female horse used for breeding
entries.example_cn: 马厩主人在这匹母马生下最后一匹小马后将其退役。
entries.example_en: The stable owner retired the broodmare after she produced her last foal.

entries.definition_en: moody and absorbed in thought
entries.example_cn: 他坐在窗边，神情沉思，陷入了深思。
entries.example_en: He sat by the window, looking broody and lost in thought.

entries.definition_en: having the physical condition to sit on and hatch eggs
entries.example_cn: 产下蛋后，母鸡变得有孵蛋本能了。
entries.example_en: After laying her clutch, the hen became broody.

entries.definition_en: a female chicken that is ready to sit on her eggs to hatch them
entries.example_cn: 那只孵蛋母鸡拒绝离开巢穴。
entries.example_en: The broody hen refused to leave the nest.

entries.definition_en: a small stream of water
entries.example_cn: 我们沿着小溪走，穿过森林到了另一边。
entries.example_en: We walked along the brook to get to the other side of the forest.

entries.definition_en: to tolerate or accept something unpleasant
entries.example_cn: 我无法再忍受这个项目的任何延误。
entries.example_en: I cannot brook any more delays in this project.

entries.definition_en: a small stream or brook
entries.example_cn: 我们沿着穿过森林的小溪前行。
entries.example_en: We followed the brooklet through the forest.

entries.definition_en: a cleaning implement for sweeping; bundle of straws or twigs attached to a long handle
entries.example_cn: 她买了一把新扫帚来打扫车库地板。
entries.example_en: She bought a new broom to clean the garage floor.

entries.definition_en: any of various shrubs of the genera Cytisus or Genista or Spartium having long slender branches and racemes of yellow flowers
entries.example_cn: 黄色的荆豆花在春天绽放。
entries.example_en: The yellow broom flowers bloomed in the spring.

entries.definition_en: common Old World heath represented by many varieties; low evergreen grown widely in the Northern Hemisphere
entries.example_cn: 荒原上覆盖着茂密的帚石南灌木。
entries.example_en: The heathland was covered with dense broom bushes.

entries.definition_en: sweep with a broom or as if with a broom
entries.example_cn: 清洁工会在客人到来之前用扫帚清扫走廊。
entries.example_en: The janitor will broom the hallway before the guests arrive.

entries.definition_cn: 用扫帚或刮板抚平膜材以改善其黏附性
entries.definition_en: to improve a membrane's adhesion by smoothing it with a broom or squeegee
entries.example_cn: 工人用扫帚抚平屋面膜材，以确保其与胶黏剂良好接触。
entries.example_en: Workers broomed the roofing membrane to ensure good contact with the adhesive.

entries.definition_en: tall grasses grown for the elongated stiff-branched panicle used for brooms and brushes
entries.example_cn: 农民收割扫帚草来制作耐用的家用扫帚。
entries.example_en: Farmers harvest broomcorn to make durable household brooms.

entries.definition_en: the long handle of a broom
entries.example_cn: 她用扫帚柄扫了地板。
entries.example_en: She swept the floor using the broomstick.

entries.definition_en: liquid made by simmering meat and vegetables, used as a base for soups or sauces
entries.example_cn: 她在牛肉汤里加了胡萝卜，做了一锅营养丰富的汤。
entries.example_en: She added carrots to the beef broth to make a hearty soup.

entries.definition_en: a thin soup made from meat, fish, or vegetable stock
entries.example_cn: 医生建议他喝点清汤来恢复健康。
entries.example_en: The doctor recommended a light broth for his recovery.

entries.definition_en: a building where prostitutes are available
entries.example_cn: 警方突袭了这家妓院以调查非法活动。
entries.example_en: The police raided the brothel to investigate illegal activities.

entries.definition_cn: 有共同父母的男性兄弟
entries.definition_en: a male sibling sharing parents
entries.example_cn: 我的兄弟住在伦敦。
entries.example_en: My brother lives in London.

entries.definition_cn: 团体或组织的男性成员
entries.definition_en: a male member of a group or organization
entries.example_cn: 他是教会里的兄弟。
entries.example_en: He is a brother in the church.

entries.definition_en: a term of address for men in a movement
entries.example_cn: 同志，帮帮我。
entries.example_en: Brother, help me with this.

entries.definition_en: a close male friend
entries.example_cn: 来吧，哥们，我们走。
entries.example_en: Come on, brother, let's go.

entries.definition_en: a brother by marriage
entries.example_cn: 我的姐夫今晚要来吃晚饭。
entries.example_en: My brother-in-law is coming to dinner tonight.

entries.definition_en: the feeling that men should treat one another like brothers
entries.example_cn: 士兵们在共同经历战斗后产生了深厚的兄弟情谊。
entries.example_en: The soldiers felt a deep brotherhood after surviving the battle together.

entries.definition_en: the kinship relation between a male offspring and the siblings
entries.example_cn: 当这两个男孩不得不共用一个房间时，他们的兄弟情谊受到了考验。
entries.example_en: The brotherhood of the two boys was tested when they had to share a room.

entries.definition_en: people engaged in a particular occupation
entries.example_cn: 木匠同业者开会讨论新的安全规定。
entries.example_en: The brotherhood of carpenters met to discuss new safety regulations.

entries.definition_en: an association of people with a common occupation or purpose
entries.example_cn: 钢铁工人工会投票决定因工资削减而罢工。
entries.example_en: The steelworkers' brotherhood voted to strike over wage cuts.

entries.definition_en: like or characteristic of or befitting a brother
entries.example_cn: 他们之间有着兄弟般的情谊，持续了一生。
entries.example_en: They shared a brotherly bond that lasted a lifetime.

entries.definition_en: (archaic as adverb) in a manner characteristic of a brother
entries.example_cn: 他像兄长一样给小他几岁的表兄弟提供了建议。
entries.example_en: He offered brotherly advice to his younger cousin.

entries.definition_en: a light carriage pulled by a single horse
entries.example_cn: 这对富有的夫妇乘坐一辆时尚的马车穿过城市。
entries.example_en: The wealthy couple rode in a stylish brougham through the city.

entries.definition_cn: 乘客舱封闭且驾驶座无车顶的轿车
entries.definition_en: an automobile with an enclosed passenger compartment and no roof over the driver's seat
entries.example_cn: 司机坐在敞开的驾驶座上，而乘客则乘坐在封闭的车厢内。
entries.example_en: The chauffeur sat in the open driver's seat while the passengers rode in the enclosed cabin.

entries.definition_en: a disturbance that is much larger than its cause deserves
entries.example_cn: 委员会对那个小错误的反应完全是小题大做。
entries.example_en: The committee's reaction to the minor error was a total brouhaha.

entries.definition_en: a loud and confused noise coming from many sources
entries.example_cn: 停电时，厨房里爆发出一阵嘈杂声。
entries.example_en: A brouhaha erupted in the kitchen when the power went out.

entries.definition_en: the part of the face above the eyes
entries.example_cn: 她皱着眉头，显得很不高兴。
entries.example_en: She frowned with her brow furrowed.

entries.definition_en: the arch of hair above each eye
entries.example_cn: 他有一对浓黑的眉毛。
entries.example_en: He has thick black brows.

entries.definition_en: the peak or top of a hill
entries.example_cn: 他们爬上山顶以获得更好的视野。
entries.example_en: They climbed to the brow of the hill for a better view.

entries.definition_en: to intimidate or discourage someone using threats or a domineering manner
entries.example_cn: 那个恶霸恫吓较小的孩子，逼他们给他午餐钱。
entries.example_en: The bully browbeat the smaller children into giving him their lunch money.

entries.definition_en: to treat someone in a bossy and domineering way
entries.example_cn: 经理专横地对待员工，迫使他们加班。
entries.example_en: The manager browbeat the employees into working overtime.

entries.definition_en: of a color similar to that of wood or earth
entries.example_cn: 这只熊有棕色的皮毛。
entries.example_en: The bear has brown fur.

entries.definition_en: (of skin) deeply suntanned
entries.example_cn: 他在墨西哥度假后看起来晒成了深棕色。
entries.example_en: He looked very brown after his vacation in Mexico.

entries.definition_cn: 一种低亮度低饱和度的橙色
entries.definition_en: an orange of low brightness and saturation
entries.example_cn: 画家混合了棕色来制造阴影。
entries.example_en: The painter mixed brown to create the shadow.

entries.definition_en: fry in a pan until it changes color
entries.example_cn: 她在加入酱汁之前将牛排煎至变色。
entries.example_en: She browned the steak before adding the sauce.

entries.definition_en: make brown in color
entries.example_cn: 在海滩待了一周后，阳光把他的皮肤晒成了棕色。
entries.example_en: The sun browned his skin after a week at the beach.

entries.definition_en: having hair that is dark in color
entries.example_cn: 那个棕发的女孩坐在窗边。
entries.example_en: The brown-haired girl sat by the window.

entries.definition_en: to flatter someone in order to gain favor or advantage
entries.example_cn: 他试图拍马屁以得到晋升。
entries.example_en: He tried to brown-nose the manager to get a promotion.

entries.definition_en: cooking to a brown crispiness over a fire or on a grill
entries.example_cn: 牛排烤至棕褐色酥脆，赋予了它美味的风味。
entries.example_en: The browning of the steak gave it a delicious flavor.

entries.definition_en: having a color similar to that of wood or earth
entries.example_cn: 随着秋天的临近，叶子变成了褐色。
entries.example_en: The leaves turned brownish as autumn approached.

entries.definition_en: the state or quality of being brown
entries.example_cn: 边缘呈棕色，表明烘烤快完成了。
entries.example_en: The brownness at the edges indicates that the roasting is almost done.

entries.definition_en: a temporary reduction in electrical power that causes lights to dim or go out
entries.example_cn: 热浪期间，这座城市经历了电压骤降，许多路灯变得昏暗。
entries.example_en: The city experienced a brownout during the heatwave, leaving many streetlights dim.

entries.definition_en: a row house built of brownstone, typically reddish-brown in color
entries.example_cn: 他们搬进了市中心的一座经典褐砂石排屋。
entries.example_en: They moved into a classic brownstone in the city center.

entries.definition_en: a reddish-brown sandstone used in building construction
entries.example_cn: 建筑师为新建图书馆的外墙选择了红褐色砂岩。
entries.example_en: The architect selected brownstone for the facade of the new library.

entries.definition_en: to look around casually and randomly without seeking anything in particular
entries.example_cn: 她在网上随意浏览了几分钟，然后找到了她需要的东西。
entries.example_en: She browsed the internet for a few minutes before finding what she needed.

entries.definition_en: to shop around without necessarily buying anything
entries.example_cn: 在做决定之前，我喜欢在书店里浏览一下。
