entries.example_cn: 他的沙文主义使他无视对他国家的任何批评。
entries.example_en: His chauvinism made him dismiss any criticism of his country.

entries.definition_cn: 对自己所属群体的无理偏袒或偏爱，尤指男尊女卑的观念
entries.definition_en: unwarranted bias or favoritism toward one's own group, especially belief in male superiority
entries.example_cn: 该公司的政策因其潜在的男尊女卑偏见而受到批评。
entries.example_en: The company's policy was criticized for its underlying chauvinism.

entries.definition_en: a person who believes their own group is superior to others
entries.example_cn: 这位沙文主义者拒绝听取任何与他观点不同的意见。
entries.example_en: The chauvinist refused to listen to any opinions that differed from his own.

usage.label: derogatory
usage.pattern: The independent noun source explicitly labels chauvinist derogatory.

entries.definition_cn: 极端好战的民族主义者
entries.definition_en: an extreme nationalist who is aggressive and warlike
entries.example_cn: 这位领导人被指控是一名暴力的极端民族主义者。
entries.example_en: The leader was accused of being a violent chauvinist.

entries.definition_cn: 沙文主义的；过度爱国或严重偏袒的
entries.definition_en: excessively patriotic or heavily biased, in an offensive way
entries.example_cn: 这篇社论因对其他国家持沙文主义态度而受到批评。
entries.example_en: The editorial was criticized for its chauvinist attitude toward other countries.

entries.definition_cn: 沙文主义的；认为自身性别或群体优越的
entries.definition_en: of or relating to persons convinced of the superiority of their own gender or kind
entries.example_cn: 他对女性的大男子主义态度令人反感。
entries.example_en: His chauvinistic attitude towards women was offensive.

entries.definition_en: fanatically patriotic
entries.example_cn: 那场极端爱国的演讲煽动了民族狂热。
entries.example_en: The chauvinistic speech stirred up nationalist fervor.

entries.definition_en: to chew; grind with one’s teeth
entries.example_cn: 他嚼了一块口香糖一个小时。
entries.example_en: He chawed on a piece of gum for an hour.

entries.definition_cn: 一口嚼烟；一团可咀嚼物
entries.definition_en: a wad of tobacco or other chewable substance held in the mouth
entries.example_cn: 他从口袋里掏出一块嚼烟。
entries.example_en: He reached into his pocket to get a chaw of tobacco.

entries.definition_en: having a low price or costing little money
entries.example_cn: 这家店卖非常便宜的衣服。
entries.example_en: This store sells very cheap clothes.

entries.definition_en: of very poor quality; flimsy
entries.example_cn: 这把廉价的塑料椅子很容易坏。
entries.example_en: The cheap plastic chair broke easily.

entries.definition_en: showy in a tasteless way
entries.example_cn: 酒店大堂的装饰风格很俗气。
entries.example_en: The hotel lobby was decorated in a cheap style.

entries.definition_en: embarrassingly stingy
entries.example_cn: 他拒绝付晚餐钱真是太小气了。
entries.example_en: It was cheap of him to refuse to pay for dinner.

entries.definition_cn: 贬低（使某物显得价值降低或质量较差）
entries.definition_en: to make something seem less valuable or of lower quality
entries.example_cn: 使用低质量材料会损害该品牌的声誉。
entries.example_en: Using low-quality materials will cheapen the reputation of the brand.

entries.definition_en: with little expenditure of money
entries.example_cn: 他们通过使用公共交通，以很少的花费完成了旅行。
entries.example_en: They managed to travel cheaply by using public transport.

entries.definition_en: in a cheap manner
entries.example_cn: 这件家具制作廉价，很快就散架了。
entries.example_en: The furniture was cheaply made and fell apart quickly.

entries.definition_en: in a stingy manner
entries.example_cn: 他吝啬地用廉价食物招待客人。
entries.example_en: He cheaply treated his guests with cheap food.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being cheap, especially in price; inexpensiveness
entries.example_cn: 门票的低价使得这场音乐会对学生来说负担得起。
entries.example_en: The cheapness of the tickets made the concert affordable for students.

entries.definition_cn: 因廉价而显得粗俗乏味
entries.definition_en: a lack of quality or style resulting from being cheap or shoddy
entries.example_cn: 塑料家具的廉价感破坏了房间的优雅。
entries.example_en: The cheapness of the plastic furniture ruined the elegance of the room.

entries.definition_en: a person who is unwilling to spend money
entries.example_cn: 别这么吝啬，我们买得起晚饭。
entries.example_en: Don't be such a cheapskate; we can afford to buy dinner.

entries.definition_cn: 作弊；通过违规获取不公平优势
entries.definition_en: to violate rules, especially in a game or examination, to gain an unfair advantage
entries.example_cn: 你不能在期末考试中作弊。
entries.example_en: You cannot cheat in the final exam.

entries.definition_en: to take something away from someone by lying or tricking them
entries.example_cn: 他骗走了朋友最后一块披萨。
entries.example_en: He cheated his friend out of the last slice of pizza.

entries.definition_en: to act dishonestly or fraudulently
entries.example_cn: 该公司因在账单上欺骗客户而被罚款。
entries.example_en: The company was fined for cheating customers on their bills.

entries.definition_en: to be unfaithful to a spouse or partner
entries.example_cn: 当他发现妻子出轨时，他非常生气。
entries.example_en: He was angry when he found out his wife had cheated on him.

entries.definition_en: a person who deceives others by telling lies
entries.example_cn: 警察逮捕了那个从银行偷钱的骗子。
entries.example_en: The police arrested the cheat who stole money from the bank.

entries.definition_en: the act of deceiving someone to get money or goods
entries.example_cn: 这个骗局是一个设计精巧的诈骗，旨在窃取储蓄。
entries.example_en: The scam was a clever cheat designed to steal savings.

entries.definition_cn: 雀麦（一种原产欧洲的麦田杂草）
entries.definition_en: a weedy annual grass native to Europe and widely distributed in wheat fields
entries.example_cn: 这种雀麦在欧洲麦田中很常见。
entries.example_en: This cheat is very common in European wheat fields.

entries.definition_en: a weedy annual grass often found in grain fields and other cultivated land, whose seeds are sometimes considered poisonous
entries.example_cn: 农民试图从麦田中清除毒麦。
entries.example_en: Farmers try to remove the cheat from their wheat fields.

entries.definition_en: someone who cheats or deceives
entries.example_cn: 别相信他，他是个有名的骗子。
entries.example_en: Don't trust him; he is a known cheater.

entries.definition_cn: 旱雀麦（Bromus tectorum），一种原产欧洲的一年生或越冬一年生禾草
entries.definition_en: an annual or winter-annual grass, Bromus tectorum (drooping brome), native to Europe
entries.example_cn: 农民们很难控制旱雀麦在干燥田地中的蔓延。
entries.example_en: Farmers struggle to control the spread of cheatgrass in dry fields.

entries.definition_en: not faithful to a spouse or lover
entries.example_cn: 他被发现对妻子不忠。
entries.example_en: He was caught cheating on his wife.

entries.definition_cn: 违反公认标准或规则的
entries.definition_en: violating accepted standards or rules
entries.example_cn: 这名作弊的选手被取消了比赛资格。
entries.example_en: The cheating player was disqualified from the match.

entries.definition_cn: 欺骗、欺诈、诡计或不忠行为
entries.definition_en: an act of deception, fraud, trickery, or infidelity
entries.example_cn: 这种欺诈行为让公司蒙受了损失。
entries.example_en: The cheating cost the company money.

entries.definition_en: to examine something to see if it is correct or good
entries.example_cn: 提交前请检查你的作业。
entries.example_en: Please check your work before you submit it.

entries.definition_en: to be sure to do something
entries.example_cn: 确保你锁好了门。
entries.example_en: Check that you have locked the door.

entries.definition_en: to investigate or examine something
entries.example_cn: 警察正在调查犯罪现场。
entries.example_en: The police are checking the crime scene.

entries.definition_en: the bill in a restaurant
entries.example_cn: 请把账单给我好吗？
entries.example_en: Can I have the check, please?

entries.definition_en: a written order telling a bank to pay money
entries.example_cn: 我写了一张支票付房租。
entries.example_en: I wrote a check to pay my rent.

entries.definition_en: an assessment of the current situation
entries.example_cn: 我们需要对市场状况进行评估。
entries.example_en: We need a check on the market conditions.

entries.definition_en: a stop or restraint that limits or prevents something
entries.example_cn: 新规定限制了不必要的支出。
entries.example_en: The new rules put a check on unnecessary spending.

entries.definition_en: to reduce the strength or intensity of something
entries.example_cn: 这种药有助于抑制疼痛。
entries.example_en: The medicine helped check the pain.

entries.definition_en: the process of registering your arrival at a hotel or airport
entries.example_cn: 我们在机场的报到柜台等了很久。
entries.example_en: We had a long wait at the check-in desk at the airport.

entries.definition_cn: 联系某人以告知对方自己情况的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of contacting someone to keep them informed about your situation
entries.example_cn: 我给父母发了条简短的信息，让他们知道我平安无事。
entries.example_en: I sent my parents a quick check-in to let them know I was safe.

entries.definition_cn: 将源代码或其他材料提交到源代码管理仓库的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of submitting source code or other material to a source-control repository
entries.example_cn: 这次代码提交包括一个登录漏洞修复。
entries.example_en: The code check-in included a fix for the login bug.

entries.definition_en: the place in a store where you pay for your purchases
entries.example_cn: 我们在收银台前排了二十分钟的队。
entries.example_en: We waited in line at the check-out counter for twenty minutes.

entries.definition_en: the latest time for vacating a hotel room
entries.example_cn: 客人必须在上午 11 点前完成退房手续。
entries.example_en: Guests must complete the check-out procedure before 11:00 AM.

entries.definition_en: the act of checking or testing that something is satisfactory or works properly
entries.example_cn: 技术员对这台新机器进行了全面检查。
entries.example_en: The technician gave the new machine a thorough check-out.

entries.definition_en: a thorough physical examination that includes various tests depending on the person's age, sex, and health
entries.example_cn: 医生建议五十岁以上的人每年进行一次体检。
entries.example_en: The doctor recommended an annual check-up for everyone over fifty.

entries.definition_en: a book containing blank checks issued to account holders
entries.example_cn: 请在离开银行前签好支票簿。
entries.example_en: Please sign the checkbook before you leave the bank.

entries.definition_en: having a pattern of alternating squares of color
entries.example_cn: 这块桌布有红白相间的方格图案。
entries.example_en: The tablecloth has a red and white checked pattern.

entries.definition_en: delivered to an airline or other carrier to be stored in an area inaccessible to passengers during a journey
entries.example_cn: 乘客必须在行李转盘处领取托运行李。
entries.example_en: Passengers must collect their checked baggage at the carousel.

entries.definition_en: a person who verifies the accuracy of something
entries.example_cn: 核对员审查了财务报告以确保所有数字准确无误。
entries.example_en: The checker reviewed the financial report to ensure all numbers were correct.

entries.definition_en: a person whose job is to check coats or baggage for customers
entries.example_cn: 酒店检查员让我把行李留在前台。
entries.example_en: The hotel checker asked me to leave my luggage at the front desk.

entries.definition_en: one of the flat round pieces used in the game of checkers
entries.example_cn: 他将跳棋棋子移到棋盘中心以阻挡对手。
entries.example_en: He moved his checker to the center of the board to block his opponent.

entries.definition_en: to mark a surface with squares or draw crossed lines on it
entries.example_cn: 她在地板上画了网格图案后再进行粉刷。
entries.example_en: She checkered the floor with a grid pattern before painting it.

entries.definition_cn: 把……画成交替颜色的方格图案；使呈棋盘格图案
entries.definition_en: to mark or form a pattern of alternating colors or shades
entries.example_cn: 艺术家把桌布画成了交替颜色的方格图案。
entries.example_en: The artist checkered the tablecloth with alternating colors.

entries.definition_en: a board with 64 squares arranged in two alternating colors
entries.example_cn: 国际象棋棋子被摆放在棋盘上。
entries.example_en: The chess pieces were arranged on the checkerboard.

entries.definition_en: having a pattern of alternating squares of different colors
entries.example_cn: 她戴了一条方格围巾以搭配她的装束。
entries.example_en: She wore a checkered scarf to match her outfit.

entries.definition_cn: 起伏不定的；命运多舛的
entries.definition_en: marked by frequent changes in fortune, success, or failure
entries.example_cn: 他起伏不定的职业生涯既包括巨大的成就，也包括重大的失败。
entries.example_en: His checkered career included both great achievements and significant failures.

entries.definition_cn: 一种每人有12枚棋子的棋盘游戏，目标是跳过并吃掉对方的棋子
entries.definition_en: a checkerboard game for two players who each have 12 pieces; the object is to jump over and so capture the opponent's pieces
entries.example_cn: 他们花了一下午时间下西洋跳棋。
entries.example_en: They spent the afternoon playing checkers.

entries.definition_en: a list of items to be checked or consulted
entries.example_cn: 离开办公室前请检查清单。
entries.example_en: Please review the checklist before leaving the office.

entries.definition_en: to place an opponent's king under an attack from which it cannot escape, ending the game
entries.example_cn: 这名选手在最后一着将死了对手。
entries.example_en: The player checkmated his opponent in the final move.

entries.definition_en: a chess move that attacks the opponent's king inescapably
entries.example_cn: 他献上了一记精彩的将死。
entries.example_en: He delivered a brilliant checkmate.

entries.definition_en: a complete victory over an opponent
entries.example_cn: 该队在对阵对手时取得了完胜。
entries.example_en: The team achieved a checkmate against their rivals.

entries.definition_en: a counter in a supermarket where you pay for your purchases
entries.example_cn: 请在收银台排队付款购买您的杂货。
entries.example_en: Please line up at the checkout to pay for your groceries.

entries.definition_cn: （网上购物的）确认并付款流程
entries.definition_en: the process of confirming and paying for an online purchase
entries.example_cn: 网站要求我在结账前核对订单。
entries.example_en: The website asked me to review my order before checkout.

entries.definition_en: the latest time for vacating a hotel room
entries.example_cn: 这家酒店的退房时间是上午 11 点。
entries.example_en: The checkout time at this hotel is 11:00 AM.

entries.definition_en: the act of inspecting or verifying something
entries.example_cn: 项目的最终检查揭示了几个错误。
entries.example_en: The final checkout of the project revealed several errors.

entries.definition_en: a place where people or vehicles are stopped for inspection
entries.example_cn: 我们必须在检查站排队出示护照。
entries.example_en: We had to wait in line at the checkpoint to show our passports.

entries.definition_en: a number calculated from digital data to detect errors during transmission, storage, or data entry
entries.example_cn: 该软件自动计算校验和以验证下载文件的完整性。
entries.example_en: The software automatically calculates a checksum to verify the integrity of the downloaded file.

entries.definition_en: a routine medical or dental examination
entries.example_cn: 她预约了与医生的常规体检。
entries.example_en: She scheduled a routine checkup with her doctor.

entries.definition_en: hard smooth-textured cheese; originally made in Cheddar in southwestern England
entries.example_cn: 她在三明治里加了一片切达干酪。
entries.example_en: She added a slice of cheddar to her sandwich.

entries.definition_en: the side of the face below the eye
entries.example_cn: 她打了他一记耳光。
entries.example_en: She slapped him on the cheek.

entries.definition_en: an impudent remark
entries.example_cn: 他说了句关于老板年龄的无礼的话。
entries.example_en: He made a cheek remark about the boss's age.

entries.definition_en: the fleshy part of the animal's rear end
entries.example_cn: 那条狗摇着尾巴，露出了臀部。
entries.example_en: The dog wagged its tail and showed its cheek.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being impudent
entries.example_cn: 他竟敢要求加薪，真是无礼。
entries.example_en: He had the cheek to ask for a raise.

entries.definition_en: to speak to someone in an impudent way
entries.example_cn: 别那样无礼地跟你的老师说话。
entries.example_en: Don't cheek your teacher like that.

entries.definition_en: the arch of bone beneath the eye that forms the prominence of the cheek
entries.example_cn: 她高高的颧骨使她的面容显得格外引人注目。
entries.example_en: She has high cheekbones that give her face a striking appearance.

entries.definition_en: in a brash cheeky manner
entries.example_cn: 他厚颜无耻地要求加薪，仿佛他理应得到一样。
entries.example_en: He asked for a raise cheekily, as if he were entitled to it.

entries.definition_en: the trait of being rude and impertinent; inclined to take liberties
entries.example_cn: 他在考试期间的无礼行为惹恼了老师。
entries.example_en: His cheekiness annoyed the teacher during the exam.

entries.definition_en: bold in an annoying or disrespectful way
entries.example_cn: 那个孩子对老师做了一个无礼的鬼脸。
entries.example_en: The child gave the teacher a cheeky grin.

usage.label: informal
usage.pattern: often mildly impudent but amusing or endearing

entries.definition_en: to make high-pitched, short sounds like a young bird
entries.example_cn: 小雏鸡一孵化就开始发出尖细的叫声。
entries.example_en: The little chick began to cheep as soon as it hatched.

entries.definition_en: the short, weak cry of a young bird
entries.example_cn: 我们听到了巢中雏鸟微弱的叫声。
entries.example_en: We heard the faint cheep of a baby bird from the nest.

entries.definition_en: a loud shout of approval or happiness
entries.example_cn: 当球队得分时，人群发出欢呼声。
entries.example_en: The crowd let out a cheer when the team scored.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of happiness and optimism
entries.example_cn: 尽管下着雨，派对上充满了愉快的心情。
entries.example_en: The party was full of cheer despite the rain.

entries.definition_en: to show approval by shouting
entries.example_cn: 球迷们大声为他们最喜欢的球员欢呼。
entries.example_en: Fans cheered loudly for their favorite player.

entries.definition_en: to give encouragement to someone
entries.example_cn: 教练在比赛的最后几分钟鼓励球员们。
entries.example_en: The coach cheered the players on during the final minutes.

entries.definition_en: to make someone feel happier
entries.example_cn: 这个好消息立刻让她高兴起来。
entries.example_en: The good news cheered her up immediately.

entries.definition_en: to become cheerful
entries.example_cn: 看到老朋友时，他高兴起来。
entries.example_en: He cheered up when he saw his old friend.

entries.definition_en: to encourage someone, especially by shouting
entries.example_cn: 队伍鼓舞跑步者冲过终点线。
entries.example_en: The team cheered the runners to cross the finish line.

usage.label: cheer someone on
usage.pattern: 动词短语 cheer someone on 表示“为某人加油、鼓劲”。

entries.definition_en: full of good spirits and happy
entries.example_cn: 那些兴高采烈的孩子们在公园里玩耍。
entries.example_en: The cheerful children played in the park.

entries.definition_en: optimistic, even unrealistically so
entries.example_cn: 尽管处境艰难，他依然保持盲目乐观。
entries.example_en: He remained cheerful despite the difficult situation.

entries.definition_en: in a cheerful manner
entries.example_cn: 尽管很累，她还是愉快地迎接了客人。
entries.example_en: She greeted the guests cheerfully despite her tiredness.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being cheerful and dispelling gloom
entries.example_cn: 孩子们的愉快让阴郁的房间亮了起来。
entries.example_en: The cheerfulness of the children brightened the gloomy room.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of spontaneous good spirits
entries.example_cn: 她的兴高采烈具有感染力。
entries.example_en: Her cheerfulness was contagious.

entries.definition_en: in a cheerful and good-humoured way
entries.example_cn: 尽管很累，她还是愉快地迎接了客人。
entries.example_en: She greeted the guests cheerily despite her tiredness.

entries.definition_en: encouragement given by spectators in the form of loud shouts
entries.example_cn: 体育场里充满了欢呼声。
entries.example_en: The stadium was filled with the sound of cheering.

entries.definition_cn: 令人振奋的；鼓舞人心的
entries.definition_en: providing freedom from worry or anxiety
entries.example_cn: 他康复的消息让全家人感到欣慰。
entries.example_en: The news of his recovery was cheering to the whole family.

entries.definition_cn: 一种新西兰小型萨沃洛伊香肠
entries.definition_en: a small saveloy, often eaten with tomato sauce at parties
entries.example_cn: 聚会上供应了蘸番茄酱的小型萨沃洛伊香肠。
entries.example_en: The party served cheerios with tomato sauce.

entries.definition_en: to act as a cheerleader in a sports event
entries.example_cn: 学生们聚集在看台上为他们的校队加油助威。
entries.example_en: The students gathered in the stands to cheerlead for their school team.

entries.definition_en: a person who leads cheers at a sporting event
entries.example_cn: 啦啦队领队跳上跳下为球队加油。
entries.example_en: The cheerleader jumped up and down to encourage the team.

entries.definition_cn: 对某人或某项事业热情且积极发声的支持者
entries.definition_en: an enthusiastic and vocal supporter of a person or cause
entries.example_cn: 她是朋友新创业项目的忠实支持者。
entries.example_en: She was a loyal cheerleader for her friend's new business venture.

usage.label: figurative
usage.pattern: supporter of a person or cause

entries.definition_en: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
entries.example_cn: 废弃房屋令人沮丧的氛围让每个人都感到不安。
entries.example_en: The cheerless atmosphere of the abandoned house made everyone feel uneasy.

entries.definition_en: bright and pleasant; making people feel happy
entries.example_cn: 快活的天气让每个人都笑了。
entries.example_en: The cheery weather made everyone smile.

entries.definition_en: a solid food made from pressed milk curds
entries.example_cn: 我想在三明治里加些奶酪。
entries.example_en: I would like some cheese with my sandwich.

entries.definition_cn: 一种开紫红色花的多年生植物
entries.definition_en: an Old World perennial plant with rosy-purple flowers
entries.example_cn: 这种植物在美国部分地区野生生长。
entries.example_en: The cheese plant grows wild in some parts of the United States.

entries.definition_en: used in the imperative to tell someone to get away or stop
entries.example_cn: 别闹了！停止制造噪音。
entries.example_en: Cheese! Stop making that noise.

entries.definition_cn: 将纱线卷绕成奶酪形线筒
entries.definition_en: to wind yarn into a cheese-shaped package
entries.example_cn: 纺纱工正在把纱线卷绕成奶酪形线筒。
entries.example_en: The spinner is cheesing the yarn into a cheese-shaped package.

entries.definition_en: a tray used for serving various types of cheese
entries.example_cn: 我们把奶酪板放在桌子中央用于聚会。
entries.example_en: We placed the cheeseboard in the center of the table for the party.

entries.definition_en: a hamburger topped with melted cheese
entries.example_cn: 我想要一个加酸黄瓜的芝士汉堡。
entries.example_en: I would like a cheeseburger with extra pickles.

entries.definition_en: a dessert made with sweetened cream cheese and eggs baked in a crumb crust
entries.example_cn: 我们要了一份芝士蛋糕当甜点。
entries.example_en: We ordered a slice of cheesecake for dessert.

entries.definition_cn: 穿着暴露的性感女性形象；美女海报
entries.definition_en: images of scantily clad, sexually attractive women; pin-ups
entries.example_cn: 公司禁止在更衣室展示暴露的性感女性形象。
entries.example_en: The company banned cheesecake imagery from its locker rooms.

entries.definition_en: a coarse, loosely woven cotton gauze originally used to wrap cheeses
entries.example_cn: 她用奶酪布过滤自制的酸奶。
entries.example_en: She used cheesecloth to strain the homemade yogurt.

entries.definition_en: someone who sells cheese
entries.example_cn: 我们去了当地的奶酪商那里买了一些手工布里奶酪。
entries.example_en: We visited the local cheesemonger to buy some artisanal brie.

usage.label: British
usage.pattern: Source w46797r0 labels the noun British.

entries.definition_en: of very poor quality; flimsy or insincere
entries.example_cn: 这部电影很俗套，缺乏真正的深度。
entries.example_en: The movie was cheesy and lacked any real depth.

entries.definition_en: a long-legged spotted cat native mainly to Africa, with nonretractile claws; the fastest land animal
entries.example_cn: 猎豹在保护区被训练去追捕猎物。
entries.example_en: The cheetahs were trained to run down game in the reserve.

entries.definition_en: a professional cook who prepares food in a restaurant or hotel
entries.example_cn: 主厨为客人们准备了一顿美味的饭菜。
entries.example_en: The chef prepared a delicious meal for the guests.

entries.definition_en: inflammation and cracking of the skin of the lips
entries.example_cn: 医生开了药膏来治疗因寒冷天气引起的唇炎。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed ointment to treat the cheilitis caused by the cold weather.

entries.definition_cn: 甲壳类或蛛形纲动物的钳状螯
entries.definition_en: a pincer-like claw found on crustaceans or arachnids
entries.example_cn: 螃蟹用它的大螯压碎了贝类。
entries.example_en: The crab used its large chela to crush the shellfish.

entries.definition_en: a pupil or disciple, particularly in Hindu traditions
entries.example_cn: 上师在考验了年轻人的虔诚后，收他为弟子。
entries.example_en: The guru accepted the young man as his chela after testing his devotion.

entries.definition_cn: 与金属离子形成螯合物
entries.definition_en: to form a chelate with a metal ion
entries.example_cn: 该试剂螯合重金属以将其从体内排出。
entries.example_en: The agent chelates heavy metals to remove them from the body.

entries.definition_cn: 金属离子通过配体的两个或更多配位键结合形成的化合物
entries.definition_en: a compound in which a metal ion is bound by a ligand through two or more coordinate bonds
entries.example_cn: 科学家分析了反应过程中形成的螯合物。
entries.example_en: The scientist analyzed the chelate formed during the reaction.

entries.definition_cn: 与螯合有关或具有螯合特征的
entries.definition_en: relating to or characterized by the formation of chelates
entries.example_cn: 该溶液的螯合特性有助于稳定金属。
entries.example_en: The chelating properties of the solution help stabilize the metal.

entries.definition_en: having or resembling claws or pincers
entries.example_cn: 螃蟹的螯状附肢用于抓取食物。
entries.example_en: The crab's chelate appendages are used for grasping food.

entries.definition_en: relating to or characterized by chelation
entries.example_cn: 螯合铁更容易被身体吸收。
entries.example_en: The chelated iron is easier for the body to absorb.

entries.definition_en: the medical process of removing heavy metals from the bloodstream using a chelate, such as in treating lead or mercury poisoning
entries.example_cn: 医生建议进行螯合疗法以清除他体内的过量汞。
entries.example_en: The doctor recommended chelation to remove the excess mercury from his system.

entries.definition_cn: 多齿配体与金属离子结合并形成环状结构的螯合物形成过程
entries.definition_en: the formation of a chelate compound when a multidentate ligand binds a metal ion, forming a ring
entries.example_cn: 该分子的稳定性取决于配体与金属离子之间的螯合。
entries.example_en: The stability of the molecule depends on the chelation between the ligand and the metal ion.

entries.definition_en: a reptile of the order Chelonia.
entries.example_cn: 这只龟鳖类动物大部分时间都在岩石上晒太阳。
entries.example_en: The chelonian spent most of its time basking in the sun on the rocks.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to or resembling or being a turtle or tortoise.
entries.example_cn: 龟鳖类的壳为它提供了极好的保护，免受捕食者侵害。
entries.example_en: The chelonian shell provided excellent protection against predators.

entries.definition_en: relating to or used in chemistry
entries.example_cn: 处理化学物质时我们需要穿戴防护装备。
entries.example_en: We need to wear protective gear when handling chemical substances.

entries.definition_en: made from or using substances produced by chemical reactions
entries.example_cn: 这种布料是由化学纤维制成的。
entries.example_en: This fabric is made from chemical fibers.

entries.definition_en: a substance produced by or used in a chemical reaction
entries.example_cn: 这家工厂生产许多危险的化学物质。
entries.example_en: The factory produces many dangerous chemicals.

entries.definition_cn: 以化学方式；用化学方法
entries.definition_en: using chemicals or in a way involving chemicals
entries.example_cn: 这种布料经过化学处理以使其防水。
entries.example_en: The fabric was treated chemically to make it water-resistant.

entries.definition_cn: 按照化学原理；在化学上
entries.definition_en: according to the principles of chemistry
entries.example_cn: 从化学性质来看，这两种物质非常相似。
entries.example_en: Chemically, the two substances are very similar.

entries.definition_en: luminescence resulting from a chemical reaction, such as the oxidation of luciferin in fireflies
entries.example_cn: 化学发光的光芒照亮了黑暗的洞穴。
entries.example_en: The glow of the chemiluminescence illuminated the dark cave.

entries.definition_en: relating to the emission of light during a chemical reaction
entries.example_cn: 萤火虫的化学发光在黑暗的森林中清晰可见。
entries.example_en: The chemiluminescent glow of the fireflies was visible in the dark forest.

entries.definition_en: a woman's sleeveless undergarment
entries.example_cn: 她在晚礼服里面穿了一件白色衬裙。
entries.example_en: She wore a white chemise under her evening gown.

entries.definition_en: a loose-fitting dress hanging straight from the shoulders without a waist
entries.example_cn: 维多利亚时代的直筒连衣裙是一件简单的、无腰身的直筒外衣。
entries.example_en: The Victorian chemise was a simple, straight dress worn as an outer garment.

entries.definition_en: the adhesion of atoms or molecules to a surface through chemical bonds
entries.example_cn: 催化剂通过反应物分子在其表面的化学吸附起作用。
entries.example_en: The catalyst works by chemisorption of the reactant molecules onto its surface.

entries.definition_en: a scientist who specializes in chemistry
entries.example_cn: 化学家在实验室里分析了样本。
entries.example_en: The chemist analyzed the sample in the laboratory.

entries.definition_en: a health professional trained in the art of preparing and dispensing drugs
entries.example_cn: 我去药店买了一些药。
entries.example_en: I went to the chemist to buy some medicine.

entries.definition_cn: （英国、澳大利亚、新西兰）药店，尤指独立经营的小型综合商店
entries.definition_en: a pharmacy, especially a small standalone general store (British, Australian, New Zealand)
entries.example_cn: 我需要去药店买些药。
entries.example_en: I need to buy some medicine at the chemist's.

entries.definition_en: the science of matter; the branch of the natural sciences dealing with the composition of substances and their properties and reactions
entries.example_cn: 她在大学学习化学。
entries.example_en: She studied chemistry at university.

entries.definition_en: the way two individuals relate to each other
entries.example_cn: 他们之间没有化学反应。
entries.example_en: There is no chemistry between them.

entries.definition_en: the chemical composition and properties of a substance or object
entries.example_cn: 这种新合金的化学成分非常稳定。
entries.example_en: The chemistry of this new alloy is very stable.

entries.definition_en: a substance that causes motile cells to move towards it
entries.example_cn: 细菌会向着宿主细胞释放的趋化吸引物移动。
entries.example_en: Bacteria move towards the chemoattractant released by the host cells.

entries.definition_en: a sensory receptor that responds to chemical stimuli
entries.example_cn: 当吞下令人不适的东西时，喉咙里的化学感受器会引发恶心反射。
entries.example_en: The chemoreceptor in the throat triggers the gag reflex when something unpleasant is swallowed.

entries.definition_cn: 利用氧化化学营养物质获得能量，而不是利用阳光，从二氧化碳等简单化合物合成碳水化合物及其他化合物
entries.definition_en: the production of carbohydrates and other compounds from simple compounds such as carbon dioxide, using energy from oxidizing chemical nutrients rather than sunlight
entries.example_cn: 深海生物依靠化能合成而非阳光获取能量。
entries.example_en: Deep-sea organisms rely on chemosynthesis rather than sunlight for energy.

entries.definition_en: the movement of a cell or organism in response to a chemical stimulus
entries.example_cn: 白细胞利用趋化性来定位并移向感染部位。
entries.example_en: White blood cells use chemotaxis to locate and move toward sites of infection.

entries.definition_en: relating to or used in chemotherapy
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一种新的化疗药物来治疗癌症。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed a new chemotherapeutic agent to treat the cancer.

entries.definition_en: a chemical agent used in chemotherapy
entries.example_cn: 这种新的化疗药物针对一条特定的信号通路。
entries.example_en: The new chemotherapeutic targets a specific signaling pathway.

entries.definition_en: the treatment of disease using chemical agents
entries.example_cn: 病人开始接受化学疗法以控制癌症。
entries.example_en: The patient began chemotherapy to control the cancer.

entries.definition_cn: 柔软有绒面的织物，用于服装、室内装饰、地毯和床罩
entries.definition_en: a soft, tufted fabric used for clothing, upholstery, rugs, and bedspreads
entries.example_cn: 他们为客厅买了一块绒布地毯，因为它摸起来非常柔软。
entries.example_en: They bought a chenille rug for the living room because it feels very soft.

entries.definition_en: a soft, tufted cord used in embroidery
entries.example_cn: 设计师使用软绒线在布料上创造了有纹理的图案。
entries.example_en: The designer used chenille to create a textured pattern on the fabric.

entries.definition_en: a written order directing a bank to pay money
entries.example_cn: 我用支票支付了杂货费。
entries.example_en: I paid for the groceries with a cheque.

entries.definition_en: to withdraw money by writing a check
entries.example_cn: 你可以在银行开支票取款。
entries.example_en: You can cheque your account at the bank.

entries.definition_en: a book containing blank cheques issued to account holders
entries.example_cn: 她从支票簿里开了一张支票来付账单。
entries.example_en: She signed a cheque from her chequebook to pay the bill.

entries.definition_en: a flat round piece used in the game of checkers
entries.example_cn: 他从棋盘上拿起一枚黑色的跳棋棋子。
entries.example_en: He picked up a black chequer from the board.

entries.definition_en: to mark or draw squares on a surface
entries.example_cn: 艺术家在地板上画上了网格图案。
entries.example_en: The artist chequered the floor with a grid pattern.

entries.definition_en: to vary in color or pattern with different shades
entries.example_cn: 那面旧墙上长满了苔藓和地衣，显得斑驳陆离。
entries.example_en: The old wall was chequered with patches of moss and lichen.

entries.definition_en: a board having 64 squares of two alternating colors
entries.example_cn: 他们在棋盘上玩国际象棋。
entries.example_en: They played chess on a chequerboard.

entries.definition_en: having a pattern of alternating colored squares
entries.example_cn: 桌布有着鲜艳的方格图案。
entries.example_en: The tablecloth had a bright chequered design.

entries.definition_cn: 毛叶番荔枝树结的圆锥形果实，果肉白色
entries.definition_en: the conical fruit of the cherimoya tree, with white flesh
entries.example_cn: 她剥开毛叶番荔枝，露出奶油般的白色果肉。
entries.example_en: She peeled the cherimoya to reveal its creamy white flesh.

entries.definition_cn: 毛叶番荔枝树，一种原产于南美山区的亚热带树木
entries.definition_en: a subtropical tree, Annona cherimola, native to mountainous South America
entries.example_cn: 花园里的毛叶番荔枝树开满了花。
entries.example_en: The cherimoya tree in the garden is full of blossoms.

entries.definition_en: be fond of; be attached to
entries.example_cn: 她珍视童年的回忆。
entries.example_en: She cherishes the memories of her childhood.

entries.definition_en: feeling or showing great love and care for something
entries.example_cn: 她珍藏着童年夏天的美好回忆。
entries.example_en: She has a cherished memory of her childhood summers.

entries.definition_en: a cigar with both ends cut flat
entries.example_cn: 他更喜欢抽切头雪茄而不是普通雪茄。
entries.example_en: He preferred smoking a cheroot over a regular cigar.

entries.definition_en: a red fruit with a single hard stone
entries.example_cn: 我从碗里吃了一颗甜美的樱桃。
entries.example_en: I ate a sweet cherry from the bowl.

entries.definition_en: any of numerous trees and shrubs producing a small fleshy round fruit with a single hard stone; many also produce a valuable hardwood
entries.example_cn: 我们在后院种了一棵樱桃树。
entries.example_en: We planted a cherry tree in the backyard.

entries.definition_en: a red color resembling that of ripe cherries
entries.example_cn: 日落时天空变成了深樱桃色。
entries.example_en: The sky turned a deep cherry at sunset.

entries.definition_en: the wood of certain cherry trees, especially the black cherry
entries.example_cn: 这件家具是由整块樱桃木制成的。
entries.example_en: The furniture was made from solid cherry.

entries.definition_en: bright red; cherry red
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一条樱桃色的连衣裙去参加聚会。
entries.example_en: She wore a cherry dress to the party.

entries.definition_en: having a deep red color like that of cherries or blood
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一条樱桃红连衣裙去参加聚会。
entries.example_en: She wore a cherry-red dress to the party.

entries.definition_cn: 一种比小颈蛤大的硬壳蛤蜊，常生吃或煮熟食用
entries.definition_en: a quahog larger than a littleneck, often eaten raw or cooked
entries.example_cn: 我们晚餐点了一盘比小颈蛤大的硬壳蛤蜊。
entries.example_en: We ordered a platter of cherrystone clams for dinner.

entries.definition_cn: 一只尚未完全成熟的蛤蜊
entries.definition_en: a half-grown quahog
entries.example_cn: 牡蛎养殖户在这些硬壳蛤长到完全成熟之前将其捕捞。
entries.example_en: The oyster farmer harvested the cherrystone clams before they reached full size.

entries.definition_en: a hard variety of rock made of microcrystalline quartz
entries.example_cn: 考古学家发现了用燧石雕刻的古代工具。
entries.example_en: Archaeologists found ancient tools carved from chert.

entries.definition_en: resembling or containing chert
entries.example_cn: 这块岩石坚硬且呈燧石状，很难破碎。
entries.example_en: The rock was hard and cherty, making it difficult to break.

entries.definition_cn: 天使等级中的第二级天使，通常被描绘成有翅膀的孩子
entries.definition_en: An angel of the second order, usually portrayed as a winged child.
entries.example_cn: 这幅画描绘了天堂里一个天使在弹奏竖琴。
entries.example_en: The painting depicts a cherub playing a harp in heaven.

entries.definition_en: A sweet and innocent baby.
entries.example_cn: 那个婴儿脸颊红润，看起来像个天使。
entries.example_en: The baby looked like a cherub with its rosy cheeks.

entries.definition_en: having a sweet, innocent nature like an angel
entries.example_cn: 那个天使般的男孩用明亮的眼睛对着镜头微笑。
entries.example_en: The cherubic boy smiled at the camera with his bright eyes.

entries.definition_cn: 一种用于汤和沙拉的细叶芹（法式香芹）
entries.definition_en: an herb with finely divided or curly leaves used in soups and salads
entries.example_cn: 她在奶油汤上撒了一些新鲜的细叶芹。
entries.example_en: She sprinkled fresh chervil over the creamy soup.

usage.label: countable for the plant; uncountable for the leaves
usage.pattern: The plant is countable; its culinary leaves are uncountable.

entries.definition_cn: 用作鸡肉、小牛肉、煎蛋卷和沙拉配料的新鲜细叶芹叶
entries.definition_en: fresh parsley-like leaves used as a garnish for chicken, veal, omelets, and salads
entries.example_cn: 厨师用精致的细叶芹叶装饰煎蛋卷。
entries.example_en: The chef garnished the omelet with delicate chervil leaves.

entries.definition_en: a board game for two players who move their 16 pieces according to specific rules; the object is to checkmate the opponent's king
entries.example_cn: 他们下国际象棋下了几个小时。
entries.example_en: They played chess for hours.

entries.definition_en: weedy annual native to Europe but widely distributed as a weed especially in wheat
entries.example_cn: 农民不得不从麦田里清除雀麦。
entries.example_en: The farmer had to remove the chess from the wheat field.

entries.definition_en: a board with a checker pattern used for playing chess
entries.example_cn: 他们在桌上摆好棋盘开始下棋。
entries.example_en: They set up the chessboard on the table to start their game.

entries.definition_en: a piece used in the game of chess
entries.example_cn: 他将那个棋子移到了一个更安全的格子上。
entries.example_en: He moved the chessman to a safer square.

entries.definition_en: the part of the human torso between the neck and the abdomen or the corresponding part in other vertebrates
entries.example_cn: 他深吸一口气，挺起了胸膛。
entries.example_en: He took a deep breath and puffed out his chest.

entries.definition_en: a strong box with a lid used for storing things
entries.example_cn: 她把旧信件放在一个木箱里。
entries.example_en: She kept her old letters in a wooden chest.

entries.definition_en: a piece of furniture with drawers for keeping clothes
entries.example_cn: 她把毛衣放在抽屉柜里。
entries.example_en: She kept her sweaters in a chest of drawers.

entries.definition_en: the front part of the body from the neck to the abdomen
entries.example_cn: 马低下头，把胸脯贴在地上。
entries.example_en: The horse lowered its head and rested its chest on the ground.

entries.definition_cn: 一种扶手直立的宽大沙发
entries.definition_en: an overstuffed sofa with upright armrests
entries.example_cn: 他们坐在客厅的宽大沙发上。
entries.example_en: They sat on the chesterfield in the living room.

entries.definition_cn: 一种带天鹅绒领的修身大衣
entries.definition_en: a fitted overcoat with a velvet collar
entries.example_cn: 他穿了一件带天鹅绒领的黑色修身大衣去参加正式晚宴。
entries.example_en: He wore a black chesterfield to the formal dinner.

entries.definition_en: the edible nut produced by chestnut trees
entries.example_cn: 我们在火边烤栗子。
entries.example_en: We roasted chestnuts by the fire.

entries.definition_en: a type of deciduous tree that produces hard wood and edible nuts
entries.example_cn: 一棵古老的栗树矗立在公园中央。
entries.example_en: The old chestnut tree stood in the center of the park.

entries.definition_en: the hard wood obtained from chestnut trees
entries.example_cn: 这件家具是用抛光栗木制成的。
entries.example_en: The furniture was made of polished chestnut.

entries.definition_en: the brown color of chestnuts
entries.example_cn: 秋天的叶子变成了深栗色。
entries.example_en: The autumn leaves turned a deep chestnut.

entries.definition_en: a horse with a dark golden-brown or reddish-brown coat
entries.example_cn: 骑手骑上了他的栗色马。
entries.example_en: The rider mounted his chestnut horse.

entries.definition_en: having a golden brown to reddish brown color
entries.example_cn: 她戴着栗色的围巾。
entries.example_en: She wore a chestnut-colored scarf.

entries.definition_en: a small horny callus on the inner surface of a horse's leg
entries.example_cn: 训练师检查了马腿上的胼胝。
entries.example_en: The trainer examined the chestnut on the horse's leg.

entries.definition_cn: 乳房丰满的；胸部发达的
entries.definition_en: having large breasts; busty
entries.example_cn: 杂志把那位模特描述为乳房丰满。
entries.example_en: The model was described as chesty in the magazine.

entries.definition_en: showing feelings of unwarranted importance due to overbearing pride
entries.example_cn: 他自高自大的态度使得其他人难以与他合作。
entries.example_en: His chesty attitude made it difficult for others to work with him.

entries.definition_cn: 骑士；（尤指旧式的）风度翩翩的绅士
entries.definition_en: a gallant or courtly gentleman
entries.example_cn: 他被誉为旧式骑士中的真君子。
entries.example_en: He was known as a true chevalier of the old school.

entries.definition_en: a soft cheese made from goat’s milk
entries.example_cn: 这种手工奶酪是一种带有酸味的软质山羊奶酪。
entries.example_en: This artisanal cheese is a soft chevre with a tangy flavor.

entries.definition_en: a V-shaped sleeve badge indicating military rank and service
entries.example_cn: 军官的制服上戴着金色的军衔标志。
entries.example_en: The officer wore a gold chevron on his uniform.

entries.definition_en: a wide inverted V-shaped figure on a shield
entries.example_cn: 这面盾牌上有一个宽大的倒V形图案。
entries.example_en: The shield bore a wide inverted-V chevron.

entries.definition_cn: （chivvy 的不常见变体）反复纠缠或用小动作骚扰
entries.definition_en: to pester or harass repeatedly with petty attacks; an uncommon variant of chivvy
entries.example_cn: 经理不断催逼那名学徒回答问题。
entries.example_en: The manager repeatedly chevied the apprentice for an answer.

usage.label: transitive
usage.pattern: The harassment sense takes a direct object, as in w11712r3.

entries.definition_en: to bite and grind food with your teeth to make it soft enough to swallow
entries.example_cn: 那只狗咀嚼骨头几个小时。
entries.example_en: The dog chewed the bone for hours.

entries.definition_en: the action of biting and grinding food in your mouth
entries.example_cn: 咀嚼的声音从隔壁房间传来。
entries.example_en: The sound of chewing could be heard from the next room.

entries.definition_en: a plug or wad of chewing tobacco
entries.example_cn: 他把嚼烟放进嘴里，走向公交车站。
entries.example_en: He put a chew in his mouth and walked to the bus stop.

entries.definition_en: able to be chewed or cut
entries.example_cn: 这种新口香糖设计为可以咀嚼更长时间。
entries.example_en: The new gum is designed to be chewable for a longer period of time.

entries.definition_en: someone who chews, especially someone who chews tobacco
entries.example_cn: 那个嚼烟草的人口袋里总装着一袋烟草。
entries.example_en: The chewer kept a pouch of tobacco in his pocket.

entries.definition_en: the action of using your teeth to crush food
entries.example_cn: 他停止咀嚼，看着相机。
entries.example_en: He stopped chewing and looked at the camera.

entries.definition_en: requiring much chewing
entries.example_cn: 这块牛排很硬且需要费力咀嚼，花了好长时间才吃完。
entries.example_en: The steak was tough and chewy, taking a long time to eat.

entries.definition_en: (of a consistency) requiring chewing
entries.example_cn: 这些软糖质地需要咀嚼，吃起来很有趣。
entries.example_en: These gummy candies are chewy and fun to eat.

entries.definition_cn: 传统中国哲学、文化、医学等中的生命力，与呼吸和循环有关
entries.definition_en: A life force in traditional Chinese philosophy, culture, medicine, etc, related to breath and circulation.
entries.example_cn: 练习气功有助于平衡体内的生命力。
entries.example_en: Practicing qigong helps to balance the chi in the body.

entries.definition_cn: 希腊字母表中的第二十二个字母
entries.definition_en: The twenty-second letter of the Classical and Modern Greek alphabets.
entries.example_cn: 单词“chi”是希腊字母表中的第二十二个字母。
entries.example_en: The word 'chi' is the twenty-second letter of the Greek alphabet.

entries.definition_cn: 中国尺，一种基于人类前臂的传统中国长度单位
entries.definition_en: The Chinese foot, a traditional Chinese unit of length based on the human forearm.
entries.example_cn: 这张古地图用“尺”来测量距离。
entries.example_en: The ancient map measured distances in chi.

entries.definition_cn: 1984 年标准化的中国长度单位，等于三分之一米
entries.definition_en: The Chinese unit of length standardized in 1984 as ¹/₃ of a meter.
entries.example_cn: 新的标准尺正好是三分之一米。
entries.example_en: The new standard chi is exactly one-third of a meter.

entries.definition_cn: 台湾的长度单位，标准化为三十三分之十米，与日本尺相同
entries.definition_en: The Taiwanese unit of length standardized as ¹⁰/₃₃ of a meter, identical to the Japanese shaku.
entries.example_cn: 在台湾，尺用于测量布料。
entries.example_en: In Taiwan, the chi is used for measuring fabric.

entries.definition_cn: 尺或香港尺，一种标准化为 0.371475 米的长度单位
entries.definition_en: The chek or Hong Kong foot, a unit of length standardized as 0.371475 meters.
entries.example_cn: 传统香港尺比大陆尺略长。
entries.example_en: The traditional Hong Kong chi is slightly longer than the mainland chi.

entries.definition_en: Clipping of chihuahua.
entries.example_cn: 她为她的公寓买了一只小吉娃娃。
entries.example_en: She bought a small chi for her apartment.

entries.definition_en: a monochrome picture created by using several different shades of the same color
entries.example_cn: 艺术家在画廊展出了一幅明暗对照单色画。
entries.example_en: The artist displayed a chiaroscuro in the gallery.

entries.definition_en: a point where two nerve tracts cross over each other in an X shape
entries.example_cn: 视交叉是双眼视神经交汇并交叉的部位。
entries.example_en: The optic chiasm is the location where the optic nerves from each eye meet and cross.

entries.definition_cn: 两条神经、韧带或其他结构交叉形成的X形交叉点或连接处
entries.definition_en: a crossing or junction of two nerves, ligaments, or other structures, often forming an X
entries.example_cn: 视交叉是视神经交叉的地方。
entries.example_en: The optic chiasma is where the optic nerves cross.

entries.definition_cn: 将平行短语中成分的顺序交错倒置的修辞手法
entries.definition_en: a rhetorical inversion of the order of elements in parallel phrases
entries.example_cn: “美即丑，丑即美”是倒装修辞的一个著名例子。
entries.example_en: “Fair is foul, and foul is fair” is a well-known example of chiasmus.

entries.definition_en: elegant and stylish
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一条时髦的黑色晚礼服去参加舞会。
entries.example_en: She wore a chic black dress to the gala.

entries.definition_en: elegance that comes from being fashionable
entries.example_cn: 这家精品店的室内设计散发着一种独特的时尚感。
entries.example_en: The boutique's interior design exudes a certain chic.

entries.definition_cn: 赛车场上为减速而设置的连续急弯
entries.definition_en: a sharp double bend on a racecourse, designed to slow vehicles
entries.example_cn: 车手接近赛道上的连续急弯时，必须减速。
entries.example_en: Drivers had to slow down as they approached the chicane on the track.

entries.definition_cn: 使用诡计欺骗某人，尤其是为了从他们那里骗取钱财
entries.definition_en: the use of tricks to deceive someone, especially to get money from them
entries.example_cn: 这个骗局是一个精心设计的诡计，旨在骗取老年人的积蓄。
entries.example_en: The scam was a sophisticated chicane designed to steal savings from elderly people.

entries.definition_cn: 桥牌中没有将牌的一手牌
entries.definition_en: a bridge hand that has no trump cards
entries.example_cn: 这名牌手拿到一手缺将牌，迫使对手谨慎出牌。
entries.example_en: The player held a chicane, with no trumps in hand, forcing the opponents to lead carefully.

entries.definition_cn: 用诡计或欺骗手段欺骗某人
entries.definition_en: to deceive someone by using tricks or subterfuge
entries.example_cn: 骗子用诡计骗得那名投资者交出了积蓄。
entries.example_en: The con artist chicaned the investor into handing over his savings.

entries.definition_en: to raise trivial objections
entries.example_cn: 委员会成员开始用一些细微的技术细节对该提案提出琐碎的反对意见。
entries.example_en: The committee members began to chicane the proposal with minor technicalities.

entries.definition_en: deception by trickery, quibbling, or subterfuge
entries.example_cn: 这位政客被指控在竞选活动中使用欺诈手段。
entries.example_en: The politician was accused of chicanery during the election campaign.

entries.definition_cn: 一种来自中美洲和南美洲的发酵饮料，通常用玉米、葡萄或苹果酿制
entries.definition_en: a fermented beverage from South and Central America, commonly made from maize, grapes, or apples
entries.example_cn: 他们端上了用发酵玉米酿制的奇恰酒。
entries.example_en: They served chicha made from fermented maize.

entries.definition_en: affectedly trendy and fashionable
entries.example_cn: 这家故作时髦的餐厅挤满了想装作名流的人。
entries.example_en: The chichi restaurant was full of people trying to look like celebrities.

entries.definition_cn: （拉丁美洲，俚语，通常用复数）女性的乳房
entries.definition_en: (Latin America, slang, usually plural) a woman's breast
entries.example_cn: 在拉丁美洲部分地区，chichis 是指女性乳房的俚语。
entries.example_en: In parts of Latin America, chichis is a slang term for a woman's breasts.

entries.definition_en: elegance derived from being fashionable
entries.example_cn: 新系列的时尚感立刻引起了评论家的注意。
entries.example_en: The chichi of the new collection was immediately noticed by the critics.

entries.definition_en: a young bird, especially one of a domestic fowl like a chicken
entries.example_cn: 农民数了数鸡舍里的新雏鸡。
entries.example_en: The farmer counted the new chicks in the coop.

entries.definition_cn: 对年轻女子的非正式称呼
entries.definition_en: an informal term for a young woman
entries.example_cn: 她是聚会上很受欢迎的年轻女孩。
entries.example_en: She was a popular chick at the party.

entries.definition_cn: 北美洲各种小型灰黑色山雀
entries.definition_en: any of various small grey-and-black songbirds found in North America
entries.example_cn: 一只小小的山雀落在喂食器上，大声鸣叫后飞走了。
entries.example_en: A tiny chickadee landed on the feeder and chirped loudly before flying away.

entries.definition_en: a domestic bird raised for its meat or eggs
entries.example_cn: 农民每天早上喂鸡谷物。
entries.example_en: The farmer feeds the chickens grain every morning.

entries.definition_en: the meat of a chicken that is eaten as food
entries.example_cn: 我们晚餐吃了炸鸡。
entries.example_en: We had fried chicken for dinner.

entries.definition_en: a person who lacks confidence and is indecisive
entries.example_cn: 他在公开演讲方面真是个胆小鬼。
entries.example_en: He is a real chicken when it comes to public speaking.

entries.definition_en: a dangerous game in which participants continue until one competitor becomes afraid and gives up
entries.example_cn: 他们开车相向而行，玩起了比胆量的游戏。
entries.example_en: They played chicken by driving their cars toward each other.

entries.definition_en: easily frightened or lacking courage
entries.example_cn: 别这么胆小，你能做到的！
entries.example_en: Don't be so chicken; you can do it!

entries.definition_en: having a chest deformity where the breastbone sticks out, caused by infantile rickets
entries.example_cn: 医生诊断出这名儿童因缺乏维生素 D 而患有鸡胸症。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed the child with a chicken-breasted condition due to lack of vitamin D.

entries.definition_en: a very small or insignificant amount of money
entries.example_cn: 那笔贿赂对那位腐败官员来说不过是九牛一毛。
entries.example_en: The bribe was nothing more than chickenfeed to the corrupt official.

entries.definition_en: a contagious disease causing a rash of blisters on the skin
entries.example_cn: 孩子们因为得了水痘被送回了家。
entries.example_en: The children were sent home from school because they had chickenpox.

entries.definition_en: a coward
entries.example_cn: 真是个胆小鬼。
entries.example_en: What a chickenshit.

entries.definition_en: a large white roundish Asiatic legume; usually dried
entries.example_cn: 她在汤里加了干鹰嘴豆来增加浓稠度。
entries.example_en: She added dried chickpeas to the soup to thicken it.

entries.definition_en: the seed of the chickpea plant
entries.example_cn: 鹰嘴豆是地中海菜肴中流行的食材。
entries.example_en: Chickpeas are a popular ingredient in many Mediterranean dishes.

entries.definition_en: the chickpea plant, cultivated for its edible seeds
entries.example_cn: 农民在干旱地区种植鹰嘴豆植株，以收获营养丰富的种子。
entries.example_en: The farmer grows chickpea plants in the arid region for their nutritious seeds.

entries.definition_en: a plant of the genus Stellaria, especially common chickweed
entries.example_cn: 园丁从潮湿的土壤中拔除了繁缕。
entries.example_en: The gardener pulled up the chickweed from the damp soil.

entries.definition_en: a plant related to the common chickweed
entries.example_cn: 植物学家识别出生长在草地上的那种稀有的类似星星草的植物。
entries.example_en: The botanist identified the rare chickweed growing in the meadow.

entries.definition_cn: 奇克尔胶；人心果树的乳胶
entries.definition_en: a gum-like substance obtained from the sapodilla tree
entries.example_cn: 奇克尔胶是制作口香糖的传统基础材料。
entries.example_en: Chicle is the traditional base material used to make chewing gum.

entries.definition_cn: 菊苣（一种多年生草本植物，开蓝色花，叶和根可食用）
entries.definition_en: a perennial herb with blue flowers, grown for its edible leaves and root
entries.example_cn: 花园里长满了开蓝色花、叶子可食用的菊苣。
entries.example_en: The garden was full of chicory with its blue flowers and edible leaves.

entries.definition_cn: 菊苣的脆嫩、多刺且略带苦味的叶子
entries.definition_en: the crisp, somewhat bitter leaves of the chicory plant, especially cultivated salad varieties
entries.example_cn: 她把菊苣叶子拌进沙拉里，增添了苦脆的口感。
entries.example_en: She tossed the chicory into the salad for a bitter crunch.

entries.definition_cn: 菊苣的干根（用作咖啡替代品）
entries.definition_en: the dried root of the chicory plant, used as a substitute for coffee
entries.example_cn: 他在咖啡里加了洋蓟根以降低成本。
entries.example_en: He added chicory to his coffee to cut the cost.

entries.definition_cn: 烘焙研磨的菊苣根（用于掺假或替代咖啡）
entries.definition_en: roasted and ground chicory root used to adulterate or replace coffee
entries.example_cn: 这种混合物含有菊苣，以模仿真正咖啡的味道。
entries.example_en: The blend contained chicory to mimic the taste of real coffee.

entries.definition_cn: 肯塔基咖啡树（一种北美树木）
entries.definition_en: the Kentucky coffeetree, a North American tree with bipinnate leaves and large woody pods
entries.example_cn: 肯塔基咖啡树在北美中部的森林中生长茂盛。
entries.example_en: The chicot tree grows abundantly in the forests of central North America.

entries.definition_en: to reprove or scold, often mildly or angrily
entries.example_cn: 老师因学生上课迟到而严厉斥责了他。
entries.example_en: The teacher chided the student for being late to class.

entries.definition_en: the act of rebuking someone harshly
entries.example_cn: 老师的责备虽然严厉，但对学生的进步是必要的。
entries.example_en: The teacher's chiding was harsh but necessary for the student's improvement.

entries.definition_en: most important or main
entries.example_cn: 延误的主要原因是天气恶劣。
entries.example_en: The chief reason for the delay was bad weather.

entries.definition_en: a person who is in charge of a group or organization
entries.example_cn: 警察局的局长参观了这所学校。
entries.example_en: The chief of the police department visited the school.

entries.definition_en: a person who exercises control over workers
entries.example_cn: 工人们向工头抱怨了不安全的工作条件。
entries.example_en: The workers complained to the chief about the unsafe conditions.

entries.definition_en: a head of a tribe or clan
entries.example_cn: 部落首领决定将村庄搬迁到新地点。
entries.example_en: The chief decided to move the village to a new location.

entries.definition_en: for the most part
entries.example_cn: 该团队主要由志愿者组成。
entries.example_en: The team is chiefly composed of volunteers.

entries.definition_en: the leader of a group of people
entries.example_cn: 首领召集村民们讨论即将到来的收成。
entries.example_en: The chieftain gathered the villagers to discuss the upcoming harvest.

entries.definition_en: a head of a tribe or clan
entries.example_cn: 这位古老的部落首领以智慧和力量统治着整个氏族。
entries.example_en: The ancient chieftain ruled over the clan with wisdom and strength.

entries.definition_en: the position of chieftain
entries.example_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了酋长职位。
entries.example_en: He inherited the chieftaincy from his father.

entries.definition_cn: 酋长统治的地区或人口
entries.definition_en: the area or population ruled by a chief
entries.example_cn: 这个酋长领地包括沿河的几个村庄。
entries.example_en: The chieftaincy included several villages along the river.

entries.definition_en: the position or office of a chieftain
entries.example_cn: 他由长老会选举为酋长。
entries.example_en: He was elected to the chieftainship by the council of elders.

entries.definition_cn: 由丝绸、聚酯纤维、棉或类似纱线织成的轻薄透明织物
entries.definition_en: a lightweight, sheer fabric woven from silk, polyester, cotton, or similar yarns
entries.example_cn: 这件连衣裙由精致的雪纺制成。
entries.example_en: The dress was made of delicate chiffon.

entries.definition_cn: 一种以包括人类在内的脊椎动物组织液为食、会引起强烈瘙痒的幼螨
entries.definition_en: a larval harvest mite that feeds on the tissue fluids of vertebrates, including humans, causing intense itching
entries.example_cn: 这只幼螨叮咬了徒步旅行者，引起了强烈瘙痒。
entries.example_en: The chigger's bite caused intense itching in the hiker.

entries.definition_cn: 一种小型热带跳蚤；受精雌虫会钻入包括人类在内的宿主皮下
entries.definition_en: a small tropical flea; the fertilized female burrows under the skin of a host, including humans
entries.example_cn: 这只热带跳蚤钻进了他的皮下，引起了瘙痒。
entries.example_en: The chigger burrowed under his skin and caused itching.

entries.definition_en: a roll of hair worn at the nape of the neck
entries.example_cn: 为了参加正式晚宴，她把头发梳成了一个整洁的发髻。
entries.example_en: She wore her hair in a neat chignon for the formal dinner.

entries.definition_en: painful inflammation of the skin on the hands and feet caused by exposure to cold and dampness
entries.example_cn: 她在没有戴手套的情况下在雪地里行走后，手指上长出了红色的冻疮。
entries.example_en: After walking in the snow without gloves, she developed red chilblains on her fingers.

entries.definition_en: a young person of either sex
entries.example_cn: 那个孩子在花园里玩耍。
entries.example_en: The child played in the garden.

entries.definition_en: a son or daughter
entries.example_cn: 他们有两个孩子。
entries.example_en: They have two children.

entries.definition_en: an immature person
entries.example_cn: 别再像个孩子一样行事。
entries.example_en: Stop acting like a child.

entries.definition_cn: 从属或派生于另一事物的项目、过程或对象
entries.definition_en: a subordinate or derivative item, process, or object related to another one
entries.example_cn: 子节点存储父节点的实际数据。
entries.example_en: The child node stores the actual data of the parent node.

entries.definition_en: a member of a clan or tribe
entries.example_cn: 他是山地部落的一员。
entries.example_en: He is a child of the mountain tribe.

entries.definition_en: designed to promote a child's personal qualities rather than to provide training or information
entries.example_cn: 学校采用了以儿童为中心的方法，以鼓励创造力和独立性。
entries.example_en: The school adopted a child-centered approach to encourage creativity and independence.

entries.definition_en: the process of giving birth to a child
entries.example_cn: 这家医院专门处理高危生育病例。
entries.example_en: The hospital specializes in high-risk childbearing cases.

entries.definition_en: relating to or suitable for childbirth
entries.example_cn: 她是一位处于生育年龄、计划近期组建家庭的女性。
entries.example_en: She is a woman of childbearing age who plans to start a family soon.

entries.definition_en: the final stage of pregnancy; confinement for childbirth
entries.example_cn: 她分娩时，助产士一直照料她。
entries.example_en: The midwife cared for her while she was in childbed.

entries.definition_en: the process of a woman giving birth to a baby
entries.example_cn: 这家医院有一个专门收治产妇的科室。
entries.example_en: The hospital has a special unit for women in childbirth.

entries.definition_en: services that look after other people's children
entries.example_cn: 政府正在增加对托儿服务的投资，以帮助在职父母。
entries.example_en: The government is investing more in childcare to help working parents.

entries.definition_en: the period of a person's life when they are a child
entries.example_cn: 她写了一本关于自己童年的书。
entries.example_en: She wrote a book about her childhood.

entries.definition_en: the state of being a child between infancy and adolescence
entries.example_cn: 这些玩具是为儿童早期阶段设计的。
entries.example_en: The toys are designed for the early childhood stage.

entries.definition_en: showing a lack of maturity
entries.example_cn: 他幼稚的行为惹恼了老师。
entries.example_en: His childish behavior annoyed the teacher.

entries.definition_cn: 孩子气地；幼稚地；愚蠢地
entries.definition_en: in a childish, immature, or foolish way
entries.example_cn: 他像个孩子一样，在输掉比赛时大发脾气。
entries.example_en: He acted childishly by throwing a tantrum when he lost the game.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being like a child, often implying immaturity
entries.example_cn: 他的幼稚使他无法理解严重的局势。
entries.example_en: His childishness prevented him from understanding the serious situation.

entries.definition_en: having no children
entries.example_cn: 他们在多年无子女后决定收养一个孩子。
entries.example_en: They decided to adopt a child after remaining childless for years.

entries.definition_en: the condition of having no children or offspring.
entries.example_cn: 尽管他们渴望拥有家庭，但他们还是坦然接受了没有子女的现实。
entries.example_en: Despite their desire for a family, they accepted their childlessness gracefully.

entries.definition_en: having the innocent and happy qualities of a young child
entries.example_cn: 她对日出的美景怀有孩童般天真的惊奇。
entries.example_en: She had a childlike wonder at the beauty of the sunrise.

entries.definition_en: showing simple trust and belief, like a child
entries.example_cn: 他对朋友怀有孩童般单纯的轻信，这使他容易受骗。
entries.example_en: His childlike faith in his friends made him easy to deceive.

entries.definition_cn: 使某物对儿童安全，尤其是防止儿童打开、操作或误用
entries.definition_en: to make something safe for children, especially by preventing them from opening, operating, or misusing it
entries.example_cn: 父母在离开家之前必须使药柜对儿童安全，防止他们打开或误用。
entries.example_en: Parents must childproof the medicine cabinet before leaving the house.

entries.definition_en: a very hot and finely tapering pepper
entries.example_cn: 她在汤里加了一根辣椒以增加辣味。
entries.example_en: She added a chile to the soup for extra spice.

entries.definition_en: a dish made with ground beef, chili peppers, and often tomatoes and beans
entries.example_cn: 昨晚我们点了辣椒肉酱作为晚餐。
entries.example_en: We ordered chili for dinner last night.

entries.definition_en: a very hot pepper with a long, thin shape
entries.example_cn: 她在汤里加了一根新鲜的辣椒以增加辣味。
entries.example_en: She added a fresh chili to the soup for extra spice.

entries.definition_en: a group of one thousand, or a period of one thousand years
entries.example_cn: 预言描述了一千年的和平时期。
entries.example_en: The prophecy described a chiliad of years of peace.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of coldness caused by a cold environment
entries.example_cn: 寒风带来了一股刺骨的寒意。
entries.example_en: The wind brought a sharp chill.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of coldness that often happens before you get sick
entries.example_cn: 我有点发冷，头也疼。
entries.example_en: I have a chill and my head hurts.

entries.definition_en: a sudden feeling of fear or excitement
entries.example_cn: 她感到一股战栗顺着脊背传下来。
entries.example_en: She felt a chill run down her spine.

entries.definition_en: to make something cool or cooler
entries.example_cn: 请把牛奶放进冰箱冷藏。
entries.example_en: Please chill the milk in the fridge.

entries.definition_en: to become cold
entries.example_cn: 金属在冷空气中很快变冷。
entries.example_en: The metal chilled quickly in the cold air.

entries.definition_en: to make someone feel sad or discouraged
entries.example_cn: 失败使队伍士气低落。
entries.example_en: The defeat chilled the team.

entries.definition_en: a sudden feeling of intense fear
entries.example_cn: 一阵惊恐攫住了他。
entries.example_en: A chill of dread seized him.

entries.definition_en: a machine that removes heat from air, food, or a refrigeration system
entries.example_cn: 大楼的冷水机为空调系统散热。
entries.example_en: The building's chiller removed heat from the air-conditioning system.

entries.definition_cn: 惊悚作品；使人害怕的书、电影或戏剧作品
entries.definition_en: a frightening book, film, or other dramatic work
entries.example_cn: 这部新惊悚片让观众一直紧张到最后一幕。
entries.example_en: The new chiller kept viewers tense until the final scene.

entries.definition_en: a very hot and finely tapering pepper of special pungency
entries.example_cn: 她在炖菜里加了几个辣椒以增加辣味。
entries.example_en: She added a few chillies to the stew for extra heat.

entries.definition_en: the state or quality of being moderately cold
entries.example_cn: 清晨空气的微冷让每个人都去拿外套。
entries.example_en: The chilliness of the morning air made everyone reach for their coats.

entries.definition_en: a lack of affection, warmth, or enthusiasm in one's behavior
entries.example_cn: 他对新员工的冷淡态度办公室里人人都看在眼里。
entries.example_en: His chilliness towards the new employees was noticeable to everyone in the office.

entries.definition_en: provoking fear or terror
entries.example_cn: 那令人恐惧的尖叫声在走廊里回荡。
entries.example_en: The chilling sound of the scream echoed down the hallway.

entries.definition_cn: 冷却某物的行为或过程
entries.definition_en: the act or process of cooling something
entries.example_cn: 饮料迅速冷却后就可以上桌了。
entries.example_en: The rapid chilling of the drinks made them ready to serve.

entries.definition_cn: 相当冷或令人不快地冷
entries.definition_en: appreciably or disagreeably cold
entries.example_cn: 我们醒来时是一个寒冷的早晨。
entries.example_en: It was a chilly morning when we woke up.

entries.definition_en: lacking warmth of feeling; unfriendly
entries.example_cn: 经理冷漠的态度让员工们感到不舒服。
entries.example_en: The manager's chilly attitude made the employees uncomfortable.

entries.definition_en: not characterized by emotion; cold and unfeeling
entries.example_cn: 他对她的邀请给出了冷漠的回应。
entries.example_en: He gave a chilly response to her invitation.

entries.definition_cn: 一种非常辣且尖端细长的辣椒
entries.definition_en: a very hot and finely tapering pepper of special pungency
entries.example_cn: 厨师在酱汁中加入了一小撮辣椒。
entries.example_en: The chef added a pinch of chilly to the sauce.

entries.definition_en: to produce a ringing sound
entries.example_cn: 那座老钟每小时整点都会发出叮当声。
entries.example_en: The old clock chimes every hour on the hour.

entries.definition_en: a musical instrument made of tuned bells struck with a hammer
entries.example_cn: 钟琴在管弦乐队中奏出了清晰的旋律。
entries.example_en: The chime rang out a clear melody in the orchestra.

entries.definition_en: relating to or resembling a chimera; fantastical or impossible
entries.example_cn: 这位科学家提出了一种将两个不同物种元素结合在一起的奇美拉理论。
entries.example_en: The scientist proposed a chimeric theory that combined elements from two different species.

entries.definition_en: produced by a wildly fanciful imagination
entries.example_cn: 他关于飞行汽车的荒诞计划从未实现。
entries.example_en: His chimerical plans for a flying car were never realized.

entries.definition_cn: 与奇美拉有关的；似奇美拉的
entries.definition_en: being or relating to or like a chimera
entries.example_cn: 画中那只似奇美拉的生物结合了不同动物的身体部位。
entries.example_en: The chimerical creature in the painting combined parts of different animals.

entries.definition_en: a vertical pipe built through a wall or roof to carry smoke away from a fire
entries.example_cn: 那座老房子屋顶上有一个高高的砖砌烟囱。
entries.example_en: The old house has a tall brick chimney on the roof.

entries.definition_en: a glass tube that surrounds the wick of an oil lamp to direct the flame
entries.example_cn: 她清洗了她那盏古董油灯的玻璃灯罩。
entries.example_en: She cleaned the glass chimney of her antique oil lamp.

entries.definition_en: a shelf that projects from the wall above a fireplace
entries.example_cn: 他们在壁炉架上挂了一幅大画来装饰房间。
entries.example_en: They hung a large painting on the chimneypiece to decorate the room.

entries.definition_en: an intelligent ape that lives in trees in the forests of equatorial Africa
entries.example_cn: 黑猩猩以其聪明和使用工具的能力而闻名。
entries.example_en: Chimps are known for their intelligence and ability to use tools.

entries.definition_en: an intelligent somewhat arboreal ape of equatorial African forests
entries.example_cn: 研究人员在野外研究了黑猩猩的社会行为。
entries.example_en: Researchers studied the social behavior of chimpanzees in the wild.

entries.definition_en: an exercise where you pull yourself up on a bar until your chin is level with it
entries.example_cn: 他在健身房的单杠上做了十个引体向上。
entries.example_en: He did ten chin-ups on the gym bar.

entries.definition_en: light informal conversation for social occasions
entries.example_cn: 他们坐在门廊上，闲谈着夏天的旅行。
entries.example_en: They sat on the porch enjoying a chin-wag about their summer travels.

entries.definition_en: high-quality porcelain originally made only in China
entries.example_cn: 她在古董店买了一个漂亮的瓷器花瓶。
entries.example_en: She bought a beautiful china vase at the antique shop.

entries.definition_en: dishware made of high-quality porcelain
entries.example_cn: 请在收好之前小心清洗这些瓷器餐具。
entries.example_en: Please wash the china carefully before putting it away.

entries.definition_en: a tree native to northern India and China with purple flowers and small inedible yellow fruits, often grown as a shade tree in the southern United States
entries.example_cn: 他们在南方的花园里种了一棵苦楝树作为遮阴树。
entries.example_en: They planted a chinaberry as a shade tree in their southern garden.

entries.definition_en: an evergreen tree from tropical America with pulpy fruit containing saponin, which was used by Native Americans to make soap
entries.example_cn: 这种无患子树为美洲原住民提供了天然肥皂。
entries.example_en: The chinaberry tree provided the Native Americans with a natural soap.

entries.definition_en: porcelain tableware
entries.example_cn: 搬家前，她小心翼翼地包装了那些古董瓷器。
entries.example_en: She carefully wrapped the antique chinaware before moving house.

entries.definition_en: a bug found in temperate regions that infests beds and feeds on human blood.
entries.example_cn: 人们发现床虱藏在床垫里。
entries.example_en: The chinch was discovered hiding in the mattress.

entries.definition_cn: 原产于安第斯山脉、因柔软的珍珠灰色皮毛而被圈养的小型啮齿动物
entries.definition_en: small rodent with soft pearly grey fur; native to the Andes but bred in captivity for fur
entries.example_cn: 南美栗鼠是一种皮毛柔软、呈珍珠灰色的小型啮齿动物。
entries.example_en: The chinchilla is a small rodent with soft pearly grey fur.

entries.definition_cn: 南美栗鼠的珍贵银灰色皮毛
entries.definition_en: the expensive silvery grey fur of the chinchilla
entries.example_cn: 这件南美栗鼠皮大衣是用当时能找到的最奢华皮毛制成的。
entries.example_en: The chinchilla coat was made from the most luxurious fur available.

entries.definition_cn: 一种厚实的羊毛棉斜纹布
entries.definition_en: a thick twilled fabric of wool and cotton
entries.example_cn: 这种厚重的粗斜纹羊毛棉布非常适合做冬衣。
entries.example_en: The heavy chinchilla fabric was perfect for winter coats.

entries.definition_en: a cut of meat or fish that includes part of the backbone
entries.example_cn: 厨师准备了一块带脊骨的猪肉用来烤。
entries.example_en: The chef prepared a chine of pork for the roast.

entries.definition_en: the backbone of an animal
entries.example_cn: 猎人检查了鹿的脊骨。
entries.example_en: The hunter examined the chine of the deer.

entries.definition_en: to cut through the backbone of an animal
entries.example_cn: 他们必须切开羊的脊骨才能取出肉。
entries.example_en: They had to chine the sheep to remove the meat.

entries.definition_en: a narrow gap or opening, such as between planks
entries.example_cn: 光线透过墙上的缝隙照了进来。
entries.example_en: Light filtered through the chink in the wall.

entries.definition_en: a short, sharp metallic sound
entries.example_cn: 寂静的房间里回荡着银器发出的短促声响。
entries.example_en: The chink of silverware echoed in the silent room.

entries.definition_cn: 原本强大的系统或组织中的弱点或漏洞
entries.definition_en: a weak point or flaw in an otherwise strong system or organization
entries.example_cn: 过时的软件是这家公司安全系统中的漏洞。
entries.example_en: The outdated software was the chink in the company's security system.

entries.definition_cn: 从小缝隙中透进来的一束窄光或一片光
entries.definition_en: a narrow beam or patch of light coming through a small opening
entries.example_cn: 门下透进来一缕光。
entries.example_en: A chink of light showed beneath the door.

entries.definition_cn: 发出轻微的金属碰撞声
entries.definition_en: to make a slight sound like metal objects touching
entries.example_cn: 他走路时，硬币在口袋里叮当作响。
entries.example_en: The coins chinked in his pocket as he walked.

entries.definition_en: to fill a gap or crack with a substance like cement
entries.example_cn: 他们花了一天时间用填料填充石头之间的缝隙。
entries.example_en: They spent the day chinking the gaps between the stones.

entries.definition_en: to cause cracks or gaps to appear in something
entries.example_cn: 霜冻使结冰的湖面出现了细小裂缝。
entries.example_en: The frost chinked the frozen lake surface, leaving thin cracks.

entries.definition_en: an offensive term for a person of Chinese descent
entries.example_cn: 使用“chink”这个词被认为是非常冒犯和种族主义的。
entries.example_en: The use of the word 'chink' is considered highly offensive and racist.

entries.definition_en: having a receding chin
entries.example_cn: 那个下巴后缩的男人看到医生时看起来很担心。
entries.example_en: The chinless man looked worried when he saw the doctor.

entries.definition_cn: 性格软弱、优柔寡断、无能或愚笨的
entries.definition_en: having a weak, indecisive, ineffectual, or dim-witted character
entries.example_cn: 他对危机的软弱回应表明他不适合领导。
entries.example_en: His chinless response to the crisis showed that he was not suited to lead.

entries.definition_en: a type of durable cotton fabric often used for trousers
entries.example_cn: 这些制服由耐用的斜纹棉布制成。
entries.example_en: The uniforms were made from durable chino.

entries.definition_cn: 一种反映中国影响的艺术风格；装饰繁复且图案精致
entries.definition_en: a style in art reflecting Chinese influence; elaborately decorated and intricately patterned
entries.example_cn: 房间装饰着精美的中国风家具，配有宝塔形状的灯具。
entries.example_en: The room was furnished in exquisite chinoiserie, featuring pagoda-shaped lamps.

entries.definition_en: trousers made with chino cloth
entries.example_cn: 他穿了一条斜纹布裤去办公室。
entries.example_en: He wore a pair of chinos to the office.

entries.definition_cn: 美国东南部的阿勒格尼矮栗，结有可食用的小坚果
entries.definition_en: a shrubby chestnut tree (Castanea pumila) of the southeastern United States, bearing small edible nuts
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行者经常从美国东南部的树林中采集阿勒格尼矮栗。
entries.example_en: Hikers often gather chinquapins from the trees in the southeastern woods.

entries.definition_cn: 美国南部和中西部的奥扎克矮栗，与阿勒格尼矮栗近缘但叶片较大
entries.definition_en: a shrubby tree (Castanea ozarkensis) related to the Allegheny chinkapin, with larger leaves, found in the southern and midwestern United States

entries.definition_en: iron-deficiency anemia characterized by yellow-green discoloration of the skin
entries.example_cn: 医生注意到她黄绿色的肤色和疲劳症状后，诊断她患有这种缺铁性贫血。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed chlorosis after noting her yellow-green complexion and fatigue.

entries.definition_en: affected by chlorosis, a condition where plants lose their green color
entries.example_cn: 植物黄化的叶子表明土壤中缺乏铁。
entries.example_en: The chlorotic leaves of the plant indicate a lack of iron in the soil.

entries.definition_cn: 一种合成的吩噻嗪类衍生药物，用作抗精神病药、镇静剂、安定剂和止吐药
entries.definition_en: a synthetic phenothiazine-derivative drug used as an antipsychotic, tranquilizer, sedative, and antiemetic
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一种氯丙嗪来帮助控制患者严重的焦虑。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed chlorpromazine to help manage the patient's severe anxiety.

entries.definition_cn: 一种常见的有机磷杀虫剂
entries.definition_en: a common organophosphate insecticide
entries.example_cn: 农民在处理氯吡硫磷时必须穿戴防护装备。
entries.example_en: Farmers must wear protective gear when handling chlorpyrifos.

entries.definition_en: a diuretic medication used to treat high blood pressure and conditions causing fluid retention
entries.example_cn: 医生开了氯噻酮来帮助降低病人的血压。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed chlorthalidone to help lower the patient's blood pressure.

entries.definition_en: a colloquial British abbreviation for chocolate
entries.example_cn: 我在回家的路上从商店买了一块巧克力。
entries.example_en: I bought a bar of choc from the shop on my way home.

entries.definition_cn: 巧克力脆皮冰淇淋；巧克力冰淇淋棒
entries.definition_en: a chocolate-coated ice-cream bar
entries.example_cn: 我们决定把巧克力脆皮冰淇淋当甜点吃。
entries.example_en: We decided to have a choc-ice for dessert.

entries.definition_cn: 用作楔子或填塞物的物体，尤指防止车轮滚动的物件
entries.definition_en: an object used as a wedge or filler, especially to prevent a wheel from rolling
entries.example_cn: 抬起车辆前，先在车轮后放一块止轮楔。
entries.example_en: Place a chock behind the wheel before lifting the vehicle.

entries.definition_en: to secure something with chocks
entries.example_cn: 他们用垫木固定车辆，防止其滚下山坡。
entries.example_en: They chocked the vehicle to prevent it from rolling down the hill.

entries.definition_en: to support something on chocks
entries.example_cn: 引擎被垫木支撑着。
entries.example_en: The engine was chocked up on blocks.

entries.definition_en: entirely; quite
entries.example_cn: 箱子里装满了书。
entries.example_en: The box was chock full of books.

entries.definition_en: in a completely full or tightly packed state
entries.example_cn: 仓库里的箱子堆得满满当当。
entries.example_en: Boxes were stacked chock-a-block in the warehouse.

entries.definition_en: filled completely to the limit
entries.example_cn: 教室里挤满了学生。
entries.example_en: The classroom was chock-full of students.

entries.definition_en: filled completely with no empty space
entries.example_cn: 剧院里挤满了等待演出开始的人群。
entries.example_en: The theater was chockablock with people waiting for the show to start.

entries.definition_en: a sweet food made from roasted ground cacao beans
entries.example_cn: 他睡前吃了一块巧克力。
entries.example_en: He ate a piece of chocolate before going to bed.

entries.definition_en: a beverage made from cocoa powder, milk, and sugar
entries.example_cn: 寒冷的一天，她点了一大杯热巧克力取暖。
entries.example_en: She ordered a large hot chocolate to warm up on the cold day.

entries.definition_en: a dark brown color
entries.example_cn: 她把指甲涂成了深巧克力色。
entries.example_en: She painted her nails a deep chocolate color.

entries.definition_cn: 巧克力棕色的；深棕色的
entries.definition_en: of a deep brown color resembling chocolate
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一件与她眼睛颜色相配的巧克力棕色外套。
entries.example_en: She wore a chocolate-brown coat that matched her eyes.

usage.label: not comparable
usage.pattern: Used as a color adjective; source w07588r0.

entries.definition_en: the person or thing that is selected
entries.example_cn: 他是这份工作的最佳人选。
entries.example_en: He was the best choice for the job.

entries.definition_en: the act of deciding what to do or choose
entries.example_cn: 这是一个艰难的选择。
entries.example_en: It was a difficult choice.

entries.definition_en: one of several options from which to choose
entries.example_cn: 你有很多可选的方案。
entries.example_en: You have many choices available.

entries.definition_en: of very high quality
entries.example_cn: 这是上等的葡萄酒。
entries.example_en: This is a choice selection of wines.

entries.definition_cn: （过时）选择谨慎的；有鉴别力的
entries.definition_en: (obsolete) careful and discriminating in choosing
entries.example_cn: 他用词很讲究。
entries.example_en: He was choice in his use of words.

entries.definition_en: a group of singers who perform together, especially in a church
entries.example_cn: 合唱团在礼拜期间演唱了一首优美的赞美诗。
entries.example_en: The choir sang a beautiful hymn during the service.

entries.definition_en: a group of musical instruments that are similar and play together
entries.example_cn: 铜管乐器组在音乐会中听起来非常有力。
entries.example_en: The brass choir sounded powerful in the concert.

entries.definition_cn: 教堂内唱诗班所在的区域
entries.definition_en: the area of a church occupied by the choir
entries.example_cn: 唱诗班席位位于圣所和中殿之间。
entries.example_en: The choir lies between the sanctuary and the nave.

entries.definition_en: to sing as part of a choir
entries.example_cn: 学生们将在仪式上合唱国歌。
entries.example_en: The students will choir the national anthem at the ceremony.

entries.definition_en: a boy chorister
entries.example_cn: 唱诗班男孩站在教堂前面唱赞美诗。
entries.example_en: The choirboy stood at the front of the church to sing the hymn.

entries.definition_en: the person who directs and conducts a choir
entries.example_cn: 新的合唱指挥教歌手们如何融合他们的声音以产生和谐的音响。
entries.example_en: The new choirmaster taught the singers how to blend their voices for a harmonious sound.

entries.definition_cn: 因气道受阻而无法呼吸
entries.definition_en: to be unable to breathe because the windpipe or airway is obstructed
entries.example_cn: 孩子开始因食物卡住气道而窒息。
entries.example_en: The child began to choke on a piece of food.

entries.definition_en: to stop someone from breathing by constricting their throat
entries.example_cn: 袭击者试图扼住受害者的喉咙。
entries.example_en: The attacker tried to choke the victim.

entries.definition_en: to breathe with difficulty due to strong emotion
entries.example_cn: 听到这个消息时，她哽咽了。
entries.example_en: She choked with emotion when she heard the news.

entries.definition_en: to fail to perform well because of nervousness or stress
entries.example_cn: 球员在最后一场比赛中因紧张而失常。
entries.example_en: The player choked during the final match.

entries.definition_en: to be too tight and press against something
entries.example_cn: 这条新皮带勒着我的腰。
entries.example_en: The new belt chokes my waist.

entries.definition_en: a valve in a gasoline engine that controls air flow to the carburetor
entries.example_cn: 机械师调整了节气门以解决启动问题。
entries.example_en: The mechanic adjusted the choke to fix the starting problem.
