entries.definition_en: a region of the Earth's atmosphere containing a high concentration of free electrons
entries.example_cn: 无线电波可以通过反射电离层传播很长的距离。
entries.example_en: Radio waves can travel long distances by bouncing off the ionosphere.

entries.definition_en: a medical treatment that uses a local electric current to push medicine ions into the body tissues
entries.example_cn: 医生建议通过电离子导入疗法治疗患者的皮肤状况。
entries.example_en: The doctor recommended iontophoresis to treat the patient's skin condition.

entries.definition_en: a very small or almost unnoticeable amount
entries.example_cn: 我的想法丝毫不会改变。
entries.example_en: I won't change my mind one iota.

entries.definition_cn: 希腊字母表的第九个字母
entries.definition_en: the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet
entries.example_cn: 这个词以希腊字母iota开头。
entries.example_en: The word begins with the Greek letter iota.

entries.definition_en: a medicinal drug used to evoke vomiting (especially in cases of drug overdose or poisoning)
entries.example_cn: 历史上，催吐药曾被用于中毒情况以诱导呕吐。
entries.example_en: Historically, ipecac was used to induce vomiting in cases of poisoning.

entries.definition_en: on or relating to the same side of the body
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了同侧的腿以查看是否有肿胀。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the ipsilateral leg to check for swelling.

entries.definition_en: a tendency to feel resentful anger easily
entries.example_cn: 他的易怒使得同事们很难与他共事。
entries.example_en: His irascibility made it difficult for colleagues to work with him.

entries.definition_en: easily angered or annoyed
entries.example_cn: 他易怒的性格使他难以共事。
entries.example_en: His irascible nature made him difficult to work with.

entries.definition_en: characterized by a tendency to be angry
entries.example_cn: 这位老人以脾气暴躁而闻名。
entries.example_en: The old man was known for his irascible temper.

entries.definition_en: feeling or showing extreme anger
entries.example_cn: 这位愤怒的顾客要求见经理。
entries.example_en: The irate customer demanded to speak to the manager.

entries.definition_en: strong anger or resentment
entries.example_cn: 事故的消息激起了社区的愤怒。
entries.example_en: The news of the accident filled the community with ire.

entries.definition_en: belligerence caused by a perceived wrong
entries.example_cn: 她表达了对所受不公待遇的愤慨。
entries.example_en: She expressed her ire at the unfair treatment she received.

entries.definition_en: promoting or conducive to peace
entries.example_cn: 演讲的和平基调有助于缓和冲突。
entries.example_en: The irenic tone of the speech helped to de-escalate the conflict.

entries.definition_en: the visual property of something having a milky brightness and a play of colors from the surface
entries.example_cn: 孔雀的羽毛在阳光下展现出美丽的虹彩。
entries.example_en: The peacock's feathers display a beautiful iridescence in the sunlight.

entries.definition_en: varying in color when seen in different lights or from different angles
entries.example_cn: 蝴蝶的翅膀在阳光下呈现出变色效果。
entries.example_en: The butterfly's wings were iridescent in the sunlight.

entries.definition_en: having a play of lustrous rainbow colors
entries.example_cn: 肥皂泡表面呈现出彩虹光泽。
entries.example_en: The soap bubble showed an iridescent surface.

entries.definition_en: a heavy brittle metallic element of the platinum group; used in alloys; occurs in natural alloys with platinum or osmium
entries.example_cn: 铱常存在于陨石中，用于制造极硬的合金。
entries.example_en: Iridium is often found in meteorites and is used to make very hard alloys.

entries.definition_en: the colored muscular part of the eye that controls the size of the pupil and the amount of light entering it
entries.example_cn: 她的虹膜是引人注目的绿色。
entries.example_en: Her irises are a striking shade of green.

entries.definition_en: a plant with sword-shaped leaves and tall stalks bearing bright flowers made of three petals and three drooping sepals
entries.example_cn: 花园里开满了春天里色彩斑斓的鸢尾花。
entries.example_en: The garden is filled with colorful irises blooming in the spring.

entries.definition_en: a diaphragm made of thin overlapping plates that adjusts to change the size of a central opening
entries.example_cn: 摄影师调整了相机镜头的光圈以控制景深。
entries.example_en: The photographer adjusted the iris of the camera lens to control the depth of field.

entries.definition_en: inflammation of the iris of the eye
entries.example_cn: 眼科检查后，该患者被诊断为急性虹膜炎。
entries.example_en: The patient was diagnosed with acute iritis after the eye examination.

entries.definition_en: to annoy or irritate someone
entries.example_cn: 持续的噪音开始惹恼邻居们。
entries.example_en: The constant noise began to irk the neighbors.

entries.definition_cn: 令人恼怒或厌烦的；因持续或反复而令人疲惫的
entries.definition_en: causing irritation, annoyance, or mental weariness, especially through persistence or repetition
entries.example_cn: 邻居发出的烦人噪音让人难以集中注意力。
entries.example_en: The irksome noise from the neighbor made it hard to concentrate.

entries.definition_cn: 铁；一种沉重、延展性好且具有磁性的金属，纯态时呈银白色但易生锈，用于建筑和工具，也用于武器；在血液中运输氧气
entries.definition_en: a heavy, ductile, magnetic metal that is silver-white in pure form but rusts easily; used in construction, tools, and weapons; also plays a role in transporting oxygen in the blood
entries.example_cn: 铁是一种有磁性且容易生锈的金属。
entries.example_en: Iron is a magnetic metal that rusts easily.

entries.definition_en: a household appliance for pressing clothes
entries.example_cn: 她为洗衣买了一个新的熨斗。
entries.example_en: She bought a new iron for her laundry.

entries.definition_en: a golf club with a metal head
entries.example_cn: 他用铁杆击球。
entries.example_en: He hit the ball with an iron.

entries.definition_en: a hot tool used to mark animals
entries.example_cn: 农民用烙铁给牛做标记。
entries.example_en: The farmer used an iron to brand the cattle.

entries.definition_en: to remove wrinkles from clothes using a heated tool
entries.example_cn: 我需要在会议前熨烫我的衬衫。
entries.example_en: I need to iron my shirt before the meeting.

entries.definition_cn: 坚强的；坚定不移的，尤指性格或意志
entries.definition_en: very strong or unwavering, especially of character or will
entries.example_cn: 领导者强健的意志鼓舞了团队。
entries.example_en: The iron will of the leader inspired the team.

entries.definition_cn: 僵化根深蒂固且不可改变的
entries.definition_en: inflexibly entrenched and unchangeable
entries.example_cn: 工会谈判达成了一项僵化且不可更改的协议。
entries.example_en: The union negotiated an ironclad agreement that could not be altered.

entries.definition_en: without flaws or loopholes
entries.example_cn: 律师起草了一份无懈可击的合同以保护客户的利益。
entries.example_en: The lawyer drafted an ironclad contract to protect the client's interests.

entries.definition_en: sheathed in iron plates for protection
entries.example_cn: 那艘古老的铁甲舰装备了厚重的装甲以抵御敌方炮火。
entries.example_en: The old ironclad ship was heavily armored against enemy fire.

entries.definition_cn: 19世纪装有铁或钢装甲的木制战舰
entries.definition_en: a wooden warship of the 19th century that is plated with iron or steel armor
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展示了一艘罕见的美国内战时期铁甲舰。
entries.example_en: The museum displays a rare ironclad from the American Civil War.

entries.definition_en: smoothed with a hot iron
entries.example_cn: 桌布在放在餐桌上之前被熨平了。
entries.example_en: The tablecloth was ironed before being placed on the dining table.

entries.definition_en: expressing humor or mockery through sarcasm
entries.example_cn: 他关于下雨天气的讽刺评论让大家都笑了。
entries.example_en: His ironic comment about the rainy weather made everyone laugh.

entries.definition_en: showing a surprising difference between what is expected and what actually happens
entries.example_cn: 消防站被烧毁真是讽刺。
entries.example_en: It was ironic that the fire station burned down.

entries.definition_en: sarcastic or mocking, using irony
entries.example_cn: 他在暴风雨期间对天气发表了讥讽的评论。
entries.example_en: He made an ironical comment about the weather during the storm.

entries.definition_en: characterized by a poignant difference between what is expected and what actually happens
entries.example_cn: 消防站失火真是莫大的讽刺。
entries.example_en: It was ironical that the fire station burned down.

entries.definition_en: contrary to plan or expectation
entries.example_cn: 讽刺的是，消防站被烧毁了。
entries.example_en: Ironically, the fire station burned down.

entries.definition_en: in an ironic manner
entries.example_cn: 他讽刺地笑了笑那个笑话。
entries.example_en: He smiled ironically at the joke.

entries.definition_en: the work of using heat to smooth clothes and remove wrinkles
entries.example_cn: 客人们到来前，她花了一下午的时间熨烫衣物。
entries.example_en: She spent the afternoon doing ironing before the guests arrived.

entries.definition_cn: 待熨烫或已熨烫的衣物
entries.definition_en: garments or linens that need to be ironed or have been ironed
entries.example_cn: 桌上那堆待熨烫的衣物包括衬衫和桌布。
entries.example_en: The pile of ironing on the table included shirts and tablecloths.

entries.definition_en: a person who uses ridicule, irony, and sarcasm
entries.example_cn: 这位作者是位技艺高超的讽刺作家，常通过幽默来批判社会。
entries.example_en: The author is a skilled ironist who often critiques society through humor.

entries.definition_cn: 铁人；体力和耐力极强的运动员
entries.definition_en: an exceptionally tough and strong athlete, especially one competing in endurance or extreme events
entries.example_cn: 这位铁人即使极度疲惫，仍完成了马拉松。
entries.example_en: The ironman completed the marathon despite severe exhaustion.

entries.definition_en: a person who sells hardware
entries.example_cn: 五金商帮我挑选了适合我门的合页。
entries.example_en: The ironmonger helped me choose the right hinges for my door.

entries.definition_en: a shop that sells hardware
entries.example_cn: 我们在当地的五金店买了新锁。
entries.example_en: We bought the new locks at the local ironmonger.

entries.definition_en: various metal goods, tools, and hardware sold in a specialized shop
entries.example_cn: 我们在当地市场买齐了新建棚屋所需的所有五金器具。
entries.example_en: We bought all the necessary ironmongery for the new shed at the local market.

usage.label: UK, Ireland; dated
usage.pattern: Usually an uncountable noun for tools and hardware.

entries.definition_en: metal shackles used to restrain hands or legs
entries.example_cn: 囚犯们在押送途中被迫戴上沉重的脚镣。
entries.example_en: The prisoners were forced to wear heavy irons during their transport.

entries.definition_en: a man who is very strong and brave
entries.example_cn: 船长是一位铁汉，带领船员度过了风暴。
entries.example_en: The captain was an ironside who led the crew through the storm.

entries.definition_en: household utensils, tools, and other articles made of iron
entries.example_cn: 这家古董店专门出售19世纪的复古铁制器具。
entries.example_en: The antique shop specializes in vintage ironware from the 19th century.

entries.definition_en: any of various plants of the genus Vernonia
entries.example_cn: 斑鸠菊花朵的锈色预示着田野里秋天的到来。
entries.example_en: The rusty hue of the ironweed flowers signals the arrival of autumn in the field.

entries.definition_cn: 铁木（由多种铁木树获得的极其坚韧坚硬的木材）
entries.definition_en: extremely tough and hard wood obtained from various ironwood trees
entries.example_cn: 枕木通常由铁木制成，因为它具有卓越的耐用性。
entries.example_en: Railroad ties are often made from ironwood because of its exceptional durability.

entries.definition_cn: 铁木（一种来自东印度的常绿乔木，常作为观赏植物种植，其木材非常沉重坚硬）
entries.definition_en: a fragrant evergreen tree from East India, often grown as an ornamental plant, whose wood is very heavy and hard
entries.example_cn: 花园里有一棵罕见的铁木树，开着美丽的白花。
entries.example_en: The garden features a rare ironwood tree with beautiful white flowers.

entries.definition_cn: 铁木（北美东部的一种中等大小的树）
entries.definition_en: a medium-sized hop hornbeam tree found in eastern North America
entries.example_cn: 森林里那棵古老的铁木为许多小动物提供了庇护所。
entries.example_en: The old ironwood in the forest provides shelter for many small animals.

entries.definition_cn: 铁木（一种原产于伊朗北部的落叶小乔木，生长缓慢，呈低矮的圆顶状）
entries.definition_en: a small, slow-growing deciduous tree native to northern Iran with a low, domed shape
entries.example_cn: 植物学家研究铁木，因为它对严酷北方气候的独特适应性。
entries.example_en: Botanists study the ironwood for its unique adaptation to the harsh northern climate.

entries.definition_en: structures or decorations made of iron, such as railings or gates
entries.example_cn: 阳台上有精美的花卉图案铁艺装饰。
entries.example_en: The balcony features intricate ironwork with floral patterns.

entries.definition_en: a skilled worker who shapes and installs iron or steel structures.
entries.example_cn: 这位铁工仔细地将钢梁焊接到建筑物的框架上。
entries.example_en: The ironworker carefully welded the beams to the building's frame.

entries.definition_en: a workplace where iron is smelted or iron goods are manufactured
entries.example_cn: 山谷中的这家历史悠久的铁厂已持续运营了两个多世纪。
entries.example_en: The historic ironworks in the valley has been operating continuously for over two centuries.

entries.definition_en: incongruity between what might be expected and what actually occurs
entries.example_cn: 消防站失火真是事与愿违。
entries.example_en: It was pure irony that the fire station burned down.

entries.definition_en: the use of words that convey a meaning different from their literal meaning, often humorously or sarcastically
entries.example_cn: 评论家使用讽刺来嘲笑作者矫揉造作的风格。
entries.example_en: The critic used irony to mock the author's pretentious style.

entries.definition_en: a trope that involves incongruity between what is expected and what occurs
entries.example_cn: 剧作家在剧中将反讽手法作为核心修辞。
entries.example_en: The playwright employed irony as a central trope in the drama.

entries.definition_cn: 使受到辐射；用辐射治疗
entries.definition_en: to expose something to radiation
entries.example_cn: 医疗团队将对肿瘤进行辐射以消灭癌细胞。
entries.example_en: The medical team will irradiate the tumor to destroy cancer cells.

entries.definition_en: to shine rays of light upon something
entries.example_cn: 阳光将白雪照耀得一片洁白。
entries.example_en: The sun irradiates the snow with a brilliant white light.

entries.definition_en: to give spiritual insight to (used in religious contexts)
entries.example_cn: 这篇布道旨在用神圣的智慧启迪会众。
entries.example_en: The sermon was intended to irradiate the congregation with divine wisdom.

entries.definition_en: the sterilization of food, utensils, or other materials by exposing them to radiation
entries.example_cn: 对包装食品进行辐照可以在不打开包装的情况下将其灭菌。
entries.example_en: The irradiation of packaged food can sterilize it without opening the package.

entries.definition_en: medical treatment using radioactive substances to cure disease, especially cancer
entries.example_cn: 病人接受了放射治疗以治疗肿瘤。
entries.example_en: The patient underwent irradiation to treat the tumor.

entries.definition_en: (obsolete) the illumination or brightness produced by light
entries.example_cn: 在那份旧记载中，大厅的光照使它显得宏伟壮丽。
entries.example_en: In the old account, the irradiation of the hall made it seem magnificent.

entries.definition_cn: 视错觉（亮物体在暗背景上显得更大）
entries.definition_en: the optical illusion where a bright object appears larger against a dark background
entries.example_cn: 由于视错觉，月亮在地平线附近升起时看起来非常大。
entries.example_en: The moon looks huge when it rises near the horizon due to irradiation.

entries.definition_cn: 感觉神经冲动在皮层的扩散
entries.definition_en: the spreading of sensory nerve impulses across the brain's cortex
entries.example_cn: 疼痛感引起了大脑中广泛的神经活动扩散。
entries.example_en: The sensation of pain caused a widespread irradiation of neural activity in the brain.

entries.definition_cn: 条件反射（由相似但非原初的刺激引发）
entries.definition_en: a conditioned response triggered by a stimulus similar to, but not identical with, the original one
entries.example_cn: 狗对另一种铃声流口水，表现出了条件反射。
entries.example_en: The dog showed irradiation by salivating at the sound of a different bell.

entries.definition_en: not based on or consistent with reason
entries.example_cn: 他对蜘蛛的不合理恐惧让他陷入了恐慌。
entries.example_en: His irrational fear of spiders caused him to panic.

entries.definition_cn: 不能表示为两个整数之比的实数
entries.definition_en: real but not expressible as the quotient of two integers
entries.example_cn: 在数学中，根号二是一个实数且不能表示为两个整数之比。
entries.example_en: The square root of two is an irrational number in mathematics.

entries.definition_en: a real number that cannot be expressed as a ratio of two integers
entries.example_cn: π是一个无限不循环的无理数。
entries.example_en: Pi is an irrational number that goes on forever without repeating.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being not based on reason or logic; lack of understanding
entries.example_cn: 这项决定是出于非理性，而非经过周密的计划。
entries.example_en: The decision was made out of irrationality rather than careful planning.

entries.definition_en: in a way that is not based on reason or logic
entries.example_cn: 他非理性地拒绝接受证据。
entries.example_en: He irrationally refused to accept the evidence.

entries.definition_en: impossible to reconcile or bring into agreement
entries.example_cn: 他们不可调和的分歧导致了合作的终结。
entries.example_en: Their irreconcilable differences led to the end of the partnership.

entries.definition_en: unable to be recovered or regained
entries.example_cn: 硬盘崩溃后，丢失的数据无法挽回。
entries.example_en: The lost data was irrecoverable after the hard drive crashed.

entries.definition_en: unable to be improved or reformed
entries.example_cn: 经过几年的不良行为，他被认为是无可救药的。
entries.example_en: After years of bad behavior, he was considered irredeemable.

entries.definition_en: (of paper money) not convertible into coin
entries.example_cn: 政府发行了不可兑换的纸币以控制通货膨胀。
entries.example_en: The government issued irredeemable banknotes to control inflation.

entries.definition_cn: 领土收复主义；主张吞并具有历史或民族联系的外国领土的民族主义学说
entries.definition_en: a nationalistic doctrine advocating the annexation of foreign territories with historical or ethnic ties to the nation
entries.example_cn: 该政府利用领土收复主义为吞并具有历史民族联系的邻国领土辩护。
entries.example_en: The government used irredentism to justify annexing neighboring territory with historical ethnic ties.

entries.definition_en: a person who supports the idea of reclaiming territory that is currently under the control of another country
entries.example_cn: 该收复失地运动试图将分散的地区统一在一面旗帜之下。
entries.example_en: The irredentist movement sought to unite the scattered regions under one flag.

entries.definition_en: unable to be made smaller, simpler, or less complex
entries.example_cn: 这个数学问题无法简化为更简单的形式。
entries.example_en: The mathematical problem is irreducible to a simpler form.

entries.definition_en: impossible to deny or disprove
entries.example_cn: 证据确凿无可辩驳，因此陪审团迅速做出了裁决。
entries.example_en: The evidence was irrefutable, so the jury reached a verdict quickly.

entries.definition_cn: 不管怎样（常用作幽默或错误用法）
entries.definition_en: in any case; regardless (often used humorously or incorrectly)
entries.example_cn: 不管天气如何，我们这周末都要去徒步。
entries.example_en: Irregardless of the weather, we are going hiking this weekend.

entries.definition_en: contrary to rule or accepted order or general practice
entries.example_cn: 这块岩石不规则的形状使得堆叠变得困难。
entries.example_en: The irregular shape of the rock made it difficult to stack.

entries.definition_en: not occurring at a regular rate or fixed intervals
entries.example_cn: 体检时发现了不规则的心跳。
entries.example_en: The irregular heartbeat was detected during the checkup.

entries.definition_en: somewhat odd or abnormal
entries.example_cn: 他古怪的行为让老师们感到担忧。
entries.example_en: His irregular behavior worried the teachers.

entries.definition_en: (used of the military) not belonging to or engaged in by regular army forces
entries.example_cn: 非正规部队独立于主力军之外行动。
entries.example_en: The irregular forces operated independently of the main army.

entries.definition_en: failing to meet manufacturing standards due to flaws
entries.example_cn: 工厂在包装前丢弃了有瑕疵的物品。
entries.example_en: The factory discarded the irregular items before packaging.

entries.definition_en: merchandise that has imperfections; usually sold at a reduced price without the brand name
entries.example_cn: 他在市场上买了一些次品来修复并转卖。
entries.example_en: He bought some irregulars at the market to fix and resell.

entries.definition_en: a member of an irregular armed force that fights a stronger force by sabotage and harassment
entries.example_cn: 游击队员在夜间袭击了补给线。
entries.example_en: The irregulars attacked the supply lines at night.

entries.definition_en: (of solids) not having clear dimensions that can be measured; volume must be determined with the principle of liquid displacement
entries.example_cn: 这个不规则固体需要用水位差法来测量其体积。
entries.example_en: The irregular solid required water displacement to find its volume.

entries.definition_cn: 违反规则、习俗或道德标准的行为
entries.definition_en: a violation of a rule, custom, or moral standard
entries.example_cn: 该员工因一项违反公司规定的违规行为受到处分。
entries.example_en: The employee was disciplined for an irregularity that violated company rules.

entries.definition_en: the state or condition of being irregular, or the extent to which something is irregular
entries.example_cn: 降雨的不规律性使得农民难以规划作物种植。
entries.example_en: The irregularity of the rainfall made it difficult for farmers to plan their crops.

entries.definition_en: a lack of symmetry or a non-uniform pattern in shape
entries.example_cn: 艺术家欣赏那块岩石构造的不规则形状。
entries.example_en: The artist admired the irregularity of the rock formation.

entries.definition_cn: 排便不规律、次数减少或排便困难；可能是肠梗阻或憩室炎的症状
entries.definition_en: irregular and infrequent or difficult evacuation of the bowels; can be a symptom of intestinal obstruction or diverticulitis
entries.example_cn: 手术后，病人抱怨排便不规律。
entries.example_en: The patient complained of irregularity in bowel movements after the surgery.

entries.definition_en: in an inconstant manner, not according to a fixed rate or schedule
entries.example_cn: 她不定期地看望她的祖母。
entries.example_en: She visits her grandmother irregularly.

entries.definition_en: at an uneven rate
entries.example_cn: 在那段时间里，心跳不均匀。
entries.example_en: The heart beat irregularly during the episode.

entries.definition_en: in a way that does not follow a regular pattern or form
entries.example_cn: 该动词在过去时态中不规则变位。
entries.example_en: The verb is conjugated irregularly in the past tense.

entries.definition_cn: 与当前主题无关或不重要的性质
entries.definition_en: the lack of a relation to, or importance for, the matter at hand
entries.example_cn: 法官因证人的证词与案件不相关而将其驳回。
entries.example_en: The judge dismissed the witness's testimony due to its irrelevance to the case.

entries.definition_en: the quality of not being related to the matter being discussed
entries.example_cn: 法官裁定该证据与案件无关，其不相关性被记录在报告中。
entries.example_en: The judge ruled that the evidence was irrelevant and its irrelevancy was noted in the report.

entries.definition_en: not connected with or important to the matter being discussed
entries.example_cn: 他的私生活与本案无关。
entries.example_en: His personal life is irrelevant to the case.

entries.definition_en: in an irrelevant manner; without bearing on the matter at hand
entries.example_cn: 他在严肃的会议上不相关地提到了他的度假计划。
entries.example_en: He irrelevantly mentioned his vacation plans during the serious meeting.

entries.definition_en: the quality of not being devout or religious
entries.example_cn: 现代社会中关于不信教现象的辩论很复杂。
entries.example_en: The debate on irreligion in modern society is complex.

entries.definition_en: not religious, or opposed to religion
entries.example_cn: 他的反宗教观点使他拒绝有组织的宗教。
entries.example_en: His irreligious views led him to reject organized religion.

entries.definition_en: impossible to fix, correct, or make better
entries.example_cn: 生态系统的损害无法补救，需要一份完整的恢复计划。
entries.example_en: The damage to the ecosystem was irremediable, requiring a complete restoration plan.

entries.definition_en: incapable of being removed or taken away
entries.example_cn: 白衬衫上那块无法去除的污渍毁了这件衣服。
entries.example_en: The irremovable stain on the white shirt ruined the garment.

entries.definition_en: impossible to fix or make better
entries.example_cn: 这部古手稿的损坏无法修复。
entries.example_en: The damage to the ancient manuscript was irreparable.

entries.definition_en: in a way that cannot be fixed or repaired
entries.example_cn: 风暴使这座建筑物遭受了无法修复的损坏。
entries.example_en: The storm irreparably damaged the building.

entries.definition_en: impossible to replace
entries.example_cn: 原始手稿是一件不可替代的历史文物。
entries.example_en: The original manuscript is an irreplaceable piece of history.

entries.definition_en: impossible to repress or control
entries.example_cn: 人群无法抑制的热情填满了体育场。
entries.example_en: The crowd's irrepressible enthusiasm filled the stadium.

entries.definition_en: free of guilt; not subject to blame
entries.example_cn: 他无可指责的服务记录为他赢得了最高荣誉。
entries.example_en: His record of service was irreproachable, earning him the highest honors.

entries.definition_en: impossible to reproduce or duplicate
entries.example_cn: 那年独特的天气模式是无法复制的。
entries.example_en: The unique weather patterns of that year were irreproducible.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being so powerful that it cannot be resisted
entries.example_cn: 这个节日的魅力之所以不可抗拒，在于其友好的氛围和欢快的音乐。
entries.example_en: The festival's irresistibility came from its welcoming atmosphere and lively music.

entries.definition_en: impossible to resist or avoid
entries.example_cn: 新鲜面包的香味令人无法抗拒。
entries.example_en: The smell of fresh bread was irresistible.

entries.definition_en: extremely attractive or charming
entries.example_cn: 她觉得新电影的剧情极具吸引力。
entries.example_en: She found the new movie's plot irresistible.

entries.definition_en: in a way that cannot be resisted
entries.example_cn: 新鲜面包的香味对饥饿的孩子们来说不可抗拒地诱人。
entries.example_en: The smell of fresh bread was irresistibly appealing to the hungry children.

entries.definition_en: uncertain how to act or proceed; lacking determination
entries.example_cn: 她对于要上哪所大学一直犹豫不决。
entries.example_en: She remained irresolute about which university to attend.

entries.definition_en: the quality of lacking firmness of purpose
entries.example_cn: 她的意志不坚定阻碍了她追求梦想。
entries.example_en: Her irresolution prevented her from pursuing her dreams.

entries.definition_en: doubt about which of two or more possible choices to make
entries.example_cn: 他的犹豫不决使得团队难以选择策略。
entries.example_en: His irresolution made it difficult for the team to choose a strategy.

entries.definition_en: without regard to difficulties or disadvantages
entries.example_cn: 他们不顾恶劣的天气条件，不知疲倦地工作。
entries.example_en: They worked tirelessly, irrespective of the harsh weather conditions.

entries.definition_en: lack of responsibility or accountability
entries.example_cn: 他的不负责任导致项目失败。
entries.example_en: His irresponsibility caused the project to fail.

entries.definition_en: showing a lack of care for the consequences of one's actions
entries.example_cn: 在拥挤的地方无人看管地让汽车怠速是不负责任的行为。
entries.example_en: It is irresponsible to leave a car running unattended in a crowded area.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows a lack of responsibility
entries.example_cn: 他不负责任地将所有积蓄都花在了赌博上。
entries.example_en: He irresponsibly spent all his savings on gambling.

entries.definition_en: impossible to get back, recover, or fix
entries.example_cn: 生态系统的破坏现已无法挽回。
entries.example_en: The damage to the ecosystem is now irretrievable.

entries.definition_en: in an irretrievable manner
entries.example_cn: 对生态系统的破坏是无可挽回的。
entries.example_en: The damage to the ecosystem was done irretrievably.

entries.definition_en: a lack of proper reverence or respect
entries.example_cn: 他对宗教符号的不敬令人震惊。
entries.example_en: His irreverence towards religious symbols was shocking.

usage.label: usually uncountable
usage.pattern: The supplied source marks irreverence as usually uncountable.

entries.definition_en: an instance of irreverent behavior
entries.example_cn: 喜剧演员对逝者的不敬行为遭到了家属的批评。
entries.example_en: The comedian's irreverence towards the deceased was criticized by the family.

entries.definition_en: showing a lack of due respect or veneration
entries.example_cn: 他对神圣仪式的不敬言论激怒了观众。
entries.example_en: His irreverent comments about the sacred ceremony offended the audience.

entries.definition_en: playfully disrespectful or lacking conventional seriousness
entries.example_cn: 剧中轻佻而兴高采烈的幽默逗乐了年轻的观众。
entries.example_en: The irreverent humor in the play delighted the young audience.

entries.definition_en: not revering god
entries.example_cn: 这个不信神的教派拒绝了传统的宗教仪式。
entries.example_en: The irreverent sect rejected traditional religious rituals.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows a lack of respect
entries.example_cn: 他对神圣的传统说话很不敬。
entries.example_en: He spoke irreverently about the sacred traditions.

entries.definition_en: in an irreverent manner
entries.example_cn: 她在庄严的仪式上轻率地大笑。
entries.example_en: She laughed irreverently at the solemn ceremony.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being unable to be changed back to the original state
entries.example_cn: 该化学反应的不可逆性意味着产物无法变回反应物。
entries.example_en: The irreversibility of the chemical reaction meant the products could not be turned back into reactants.

entries.definition_en: unable to be changed back to the original state
entries.example_cn: 洪水造成的损害是不可逆转的。
entries.example_en: The damage caused by the flood was irreversible.

entries.definition_en: in a way that cannot be changed or undone
entries.example_cn: 对生态系统的破坏是不可逆转的。
entries.example_en: The damage to the ecosystem was done irreversibly.

entries.definition_en: unable to be cancelled or taken back
entries.example_cn: 合同一旦签署就不可撤销。
entries.example_en: The contract is irrevocable once signed.

entries.definition_cn: 不可撤销地；不可逆转地
entries.definition_en: in a way that cannot be changed, cancelled, or taken back
entries.example_cn: 她不可挽回地改变了职业道路。
entries.example_en: She irrevocably changed her career path.

entries.definition_en: to supply land with water through channels or ditches
entries.example_cn: 农民利用河水灌溉田地。
entries.example_en: Farmers irrigate the fields using water from the river.

usage.label: transitive
usage.pattern: irrigate farmland or land with water; source w24447r0.

entries.definition_en: to supply a body part with liquid for cooling or cleansing
entries.example_cn: 医生会用生理盐水冲洗伤口。
entries.example_en: The doctor will irrigate the wound with saline solution.

entries.definition_en: the process of supplying dry land with water using ditches or pipes for farming
entries.example_cn: 现代灌溉系统帮助农民在干旱地区种植作物。
entries.example_en: Modern irrigation systems help farmers grow crops in dry areas.

entries.definition_en: the medical act of cleaning a wound or organ by flushing it with water or solution
entries.example_cn: 医生对病人感染的伤口进行了冲洗。
entries.example_en: The doctor performed irrigation on the patient's infected wound.

entries.definition_en: an irritable and petulant feeling
entries.example_cn: 噪音使人群突然变得易怒。
entries.example_en: The noise caused a sudden irritability in the crowd.

entries.definition_en: a disposition to exhibit uncontrolled anger
entries.example_cn: 他的易怒倾向使得与他合作变得困难。
entries.example_en: His irritability made it difficult to work with him.

entries.definition_cn: 器官或身体部位病理性过度兴奋或对刺激过度敏感的状态
entries.definition_en: a pathological state of excessive excitability or sensitivity of an organ or body part
entries.example_cn: 治疗后，病人抱怨皮肤出现过度敏感。
entries.example_en: The patient complained of irritability in her skin after the treatment.

entries.definition_en: easily annoyed or angered
entries.example_cn: 漫长的飞行让他变得易怒且脾气暴躁。
entries.example_en: The long flight made him irritable and short-tempered.

entries.definition_en: showing an abnormal sensitivity to a stimulus
entries.example_cn: 手术后，患者对光和声音表现出过度的敏感。
entries.example_en: After the surgery, the patient was irritable to light and sound.

entries.definition_en: capable of reacting to stimuli
entries.example_cn: 这种植物对触摸有反应，一碰叶子就会闭合。
entries.example_en: The plant is irritable to touch, closing its leaves when touched.

entries.definition_en: in an irritable manner
entries.example_cn: 他对批评反应易怒。
entries.example_en: He reacted irritably to the criticism.

entries.definition_en: in a petulant manner
entries.example_cn: 她因汤是凉的而闹脾气地向服务员抱怨。
entries.example_en: She irritably complained to the waiter about the cold soup.

entries.definition_en: something that causes irritation and annoyance
entries.example_cn: 灰尘对过敏人群来说是一个主要的刺激物。
entries.example_en: The dust was a major irritant for people with allergies.

entries.definition_en: to make someone feel annoyed or angry
entries.example_cn: 持续的噪音开始激怒邻居们。
entries.example_en: The constant noise began to irritate the neighbors.

entries.definition_en: to cause physical pain, redness, or swelling by rubbing or scratching
entries.example_cn: 这件羊毛衫刺激了他敏感的皮肤。
entries.example_en: The woolen sweater irritated his sensitive skin.

entries.definition_cn: 刺激（组织或器官）产生生理反应
entries.definition_en: to stimulate a living tissue or organ to produce a physiological response
entries.example_cn: 实验人员用微弱的电流刺激运动神经，使肌肉收缩。
entries.example_en: The experimenter irritated the motor nerve with a mild electrical current, causing the muscle to contract.

entries.definition_en: aroused to impatience or anger
entries.example_cn: 她因建筑工地的持续噪音而感到恼怒。
entries.example_en: She was irritated by the constant noise from the construction site.

entries.definition_en: inflamed and painful
entries.example_cn: 绷带取下后，伤口变得发炎并疼痛。
entries.example_en: The wound became irritated after the bandage was removed.

entries.definition_en: causing someone to feel annoyed or angry
entries.example_cn: 建筑工地持续的噪音非常令人恼火。
entries.example_en: The constant noise from the construction site was very irritating.

entries.definition_en: causing physical discomfort
entries.example_cn: 这件衬衫粗糙的布料摩擦着她的皮肤，很不舒服。
entries.example_en: The rough fabric of the shirt was irritating against her skin.

entries.definition_en: serving to stimulate or excite (used of physical stimuli)
entries.example_cn: 这种刺激使神经产生了反应。
entries.example_en: The irritating stimulus caused the nerve to fire.

entries.definition_en: in a way that causes annoyance or anger
entries.example_cn: 在体育场附近找个停车位令人恼火地困难。
entries.example_en: It was irritatingly difficult to find a parking space near the stadium.

entries.definition_cn: 感到恼怒或烦躁的心理状态
entries.definition_en: the psychological state of being irritated or annoyed
entries.example_cn: 持续的噪音让邻居们感到非常恼火。
entries.example_en: The constant noise caused a great deal of irritation among the neighbors.

usage.label: countable or uncountable
usage.pattern: Both countable and uncountable usage is attested in w13654r0-w13654r1.

entries.definition_cn: 令人不适的心理痛苦或烦恼感
entries.definition_en: an uncomfortable feeling of mental painfulness or distress
entries.example_cn: 她对这种不公平待遇感到深深的痛苦和烦恼。
entries.example_en: She felt a deep irritation at the unfair treatment.

entries.definition_en: a thing or person that annoys
entries.example_cn: 他不断的打断是演讲者的一大烦恼。
entries.example_en: His constant interruptions were a source of irritation to the speaker.

entries.definition_cn: 使某人烦恼或惹恼的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of troubling or annoying someone
entries.example_cn: 狗的吠叫不断打扰了正在睡觉的一家人。
entries.example_en: The dog's barking was a constant irritation to the sleeping family.

entries.definition_cn: 组织因损伤或刺激产生的炎症或疼痛性反应
entries.definition_en: inflammation or a painful reaction of tissue to damage or a stimulus
entries.example_cn: 患者在使用新霜剂后出现了皮肤异常敏感的症状。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from irritation of the skin after using the new cream.

entries.definition_en: a sudden outburst of anger
entries.example_cn: 看到那堆乱糟糟的东西，他怒火中烧。
entries.example_en: His irritation flared up when he saw the mess.

entries.definition_cn: 器官、肌肉或腺体的神经或电兴奋
entries.definition_en: the neural or electrical arousal of an organ or muscle or gland
entries.example_cn: 神经末梢的兴奋引起了剧烈的疼痛。
entries.example_en: The irritation of the nerve endings caused a sharp pain.

entries.definition_cn: （指物理刺激）引起兴奋或刺激的
entries.definition_en: (of physical stimuli) serving to stimulate or excite
entries.example_cn: 冷水引起的刺激效应导致皮肤发红。
entries.example_en: The irritative effect of the cold water caused the skin to flush.

entries.definition_cn: 突然猛烈的闯入或侵入
entries.definition_en: a sudden violent entrance; a bursting in
entries.example_cn: 暴风雨的突然闯入使村民们感到恐慌。
entries.example_en: The sudden irruption of the storm caused panic among the villagers.

entries.definition_cn: 某种通常不良状况的突然猛烈爆发
entries.definition_en: a sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
entries.example_cn: 城市中突然爆发的暴力事件震惊了整个国家。
entries.example_en: The irruption of violence in the city shocked the entire nation.

entries.definition_cn: 种群数量的突然急剧增加
entries.definition_en: a sudden sharp increase in the relative numbers of a population
entries.example_cn: 蝗虫种群的突然急剧增加摧毁了该地区的庄稼。
entries.example_en: The irruption of locusts devastated the crops in the region.

entries.definition_en: referring to igneous rock that solidified beneath the earth's surface, such as granite or gabbro
entries.example_cn: 地质学家确定这种深成岩是一种在地底深处形成的闪长岩。
entries.example_en: The geologist identified the irruptive rock as a type of diorite formed deep underground.

entries.definition_cn: be 的第三人称单数现在时形式
entries.definition_en: third-person singular simple present form of be
entries.example_cn: 她是一名教师。
entries.example_en: She is a teacher.

entries.definition_cn: 用于存在句中，主语为复数时
entries.definition_en: used in existential phrases with plural subjects
entries.example_cn: 外面有很多人在等待。
entries.example_en: There is many people waiting outside.

entries.definition_cn: be 的现在时（方言用法）
entries.definition_en: present indicative of be (dialectal)
entries.example_cn: 他是我哥哥。
entries.example_en: He is my brother.

entries.definition_cn: us 的替代拼写（吉尔德方言）
entries.definition_en: alternative spelling of us (Geordie dialect)
entries.example_cn: 跟我来。
entries.example_en: Come with is.

entries.definition_en: alternative form of i's
entries.example_cn: 这段文字把“i's”拼作“is”。
entries.example_en: The text spells “i’s” as “is.”

entries.definition_en: a condition where blood flow to a part of the body is reduced, causing a lack of oxygen.
entries.example_cn: 患者因动脉阻塞导致腿部缺血。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from ischaemia in the leg due to a blocked artery.

entries.definition_en: relating to or caused by a lack of blood supply
entries.example_cn: 这位患者患有缺血性心脏病。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from ischaemic heart disease.

entries.definition_en: inadequate blood supply to a body part, often caused by vascular obstruction or constriction
entries.example_cn: 患者因动脉阻塞导致腿部缺血。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from ischemia in his leg due to a blocked artery.

entries.definition_en: relating to or affected by ischemia
entries.example_cn: 这位患者患有缺血性心脏病。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from ischemic heart disease.

entries.definition_cn: 髋骨的一部分，位于髂骨下方
entries.definition_en: one of the three sections of the hipbone; situated below the ilium
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了髋骨以评估骨折的范围。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the ischium to assess the extent of the fracture.

entries.definition_en: having constant entropy throughout a process
entries.example_cn: 假设该气体的膨胀过程是等熵的。
entries.example_en: The expansion of the gas was assumed to be isentropic.

entries.definition_cn: 用鲟鱼等鱼类的鳔制成的明胶，用作黏合剂以及葡萄酒和啤酒的澄清剂
entries.definition_en: gelatin made from the air bladders of sturgeon and certain other fish, used as an adhesive and to clarify wine and beer
entries.example_cn: 酿酒师加入鱼胶来澄清啤酒。
entries.example_en: The brewer added isinglass to clarify the beer.

entries.definition_cn: 云母（一种可裂成薄片的铝或钾含水硅酸盐矿物，用作电绝缘体）
entries.definition_en: a mineral consisting of hydrous silicates of aluminum or potassium that can be split into very thin leaves and used as electrical insulators
entries.example_cn: 工程师因其完美的解理性和高电阻率而选择了云母。
entries.example_en: The engineer selected isinglass for its perfect cleavage and high resistance to electricity.

entries.definition_en: a piece of land surrounded by water, smaller than a continent
entries.example_cn: 夏威夷是太平洋上一个美丽的岛屿。
entries.example_en: Hawaii is a beautiful island in the Pacific Ocean.

entries.definition_cn: 被周围不同事物环绕的孤立对象或区域
entries.definition_en: an entity distinct from and surrounded by unlike things
entries.example_cn: 在风暴期间，市中心变成了一个平静的孤岛。
entries.example_en: The city center became an island of calm during the storm.

entries.definition_en: a person who lives on an island
entries.example_cn: 这位岛民用传统食物和故事欢迎游客。
entries.example_en: The islander welcomed the tourists with traditional food and stories.

entries.definition_en: a California evergreen wild plum with spiny leathery leaves and white flowers
entries.example_cn: 这种稀有的加州野李只生长在加利福尼亚的高山上。
entries.example_en: The rare islay grows only in the high mountains of California.

entries.definition_en: a small island
entries.example_cn: 他们航行到海岸附近的一个小岛。
entries.example_en: They sailed to a tiny isle off the coast.

entries.definition_en: a very small island
entries.example_cn: 小船漂向远处的一座小岛。
entries.example_en: The boat drifted toward a tiny islet in the distance.

entries.definition_cn: 具有特定功能的孤立组织块；腺岛
entries.definition_en: an isolated piece of tissue that has a specific function
entries.example_cn: 每个胰岛都含有有助于调节血糖的细胞。
entries.example_en: Each pancreatic islet contains cells that help regulate blood sugar.

entries.definition_en: a belief or system of beliefs accepted as authoritative by a group
entries.example_cn: 辩论集中在各种政治主义之间的差异上。
entries.example_en: The debate focused on the differences between various political isms.

entries.definition_cn: （气象学）连接同一时刻气压相等点的等压线
entries.definition_en: (meteorology)an isogram connecting points having equal barometric pressure at a given time
entries.example_cn: 天气图显示了一条表示该地区高压的等压线。
entries.example_en: The weather map shows an isobar indicating high pressure over the region.

entries.definition_cn: 某元素的一个核素，其质量数与另一元素的一个核素相同
entries.definition_en: a nuclide of an element that has the same mass number as a nuclide of a different element
entries.example_cn: 碳-14和氮-14是同量异位素，因为它们的质量数相同。
entries.example_en: Carbon-14 and nitrogen-14 are isobars because they have the same mass number.

entries.definition_en: a chemical compound used in the production of gasoline components
entries.example_cn: 异丁烯是合成橡胶生产中的关键成分。
entries.example_en: Isobutylene is a key ingredient in the synthesis of synthetic rubber.

entries.definition_cn: 等时线：地图或图表上连接时间相关变量值相同点的线，如旅行时间相同的点
entries.definition_en: a line on a map or chart connecting points with the same value for a time-related variable, such as travel time
entries.example_cn: 地图显示了从市中心出发的等时线，标示了旅行时间。
entries.example_en: The map displays isochrones showing travel times from the city center.

entries.definition_en: having equal duration or occurring at equal time intervals.
entries.example_cn: 落地钟的摆锤设计为等时的，以确保计时的一致性。
entries.example_en: The pendulum of a grandfather clock is designed to be isochronous, ensuring consistent timekeeping.

entries.definition_cn: （数据）与时间敏感型应用有关的
entries.definition_en: of or relating to data for applications in which timing is critical
entries.example_cn: 这些等时数据包承载语音流量，必须按固定时间间隔传送。
entries.example_en: These isochronous data packets carry voice traffic and must be delivered at regular intervals.

entries.definition_cn: 使用同一时钟基准同步的；与之相关的
entries.definition_en: using or relating to clocks synchronized to the same clock reference
entries.example_cn: 全国电话网络采用等时同步，所有时钟都与同一个基准时钟同步。
entries.example_en: The national telephone network is isochronous, with all its clocks synchronized to a single reference clock.

entries.definition_cn: 异氰酸基（−N=C=O）或其烃基衍生物（异氰酸酯）
entries.definition_en: the univalent radical −N=C=O, or any of its hydrocarbyl derivatives
entries.example_cn: 聚氨酯泡沫是通过异氰酸酯与多元醇的反应产生的。
entries.example_en: Polyurethane foam is produced through the reaction of an isocyanate with a polyol.

entries.definition_en: a widely used inhalation anesthetic
entries.example_cn: 麻醉师在手术期间使用异氟烷维持全身麻醉。
entries.example_en: The anesthesiologist used isoflurane to maintain general anesthesia during the operation.

entries.definition_en: to separate someone or something from others
entries.example_cn: 政府决定隔离受感染的区域。
entries.example_en: The government decided to isolate the infected area.

entries.definition_en: to keep apart from others
entries.example_cn: 争吵后，他选择与朋友孤立自己。
entries.example_en: He chose to isolate himself from his friends after the argument.

entries.definition_en: to separate a substance to obtain it in pure form
entries.example_cn: 科学家们成功从病人的血液中分离出病毒。
entries.example_en: Scientists managed to isolate the virus from the patient's blood.

entries.definition_en: to separate experiences from emotions
entries.example_cn: 她试图将这段创伤经历与它引发的情感分离开来。
entries.example_en: She tried to isolate the traumatic experience from the emotions it evoked.

entries.definition_cn: 孤立的；感到与世隔绝的
entries.definition_en: separated from others; feeling alone or apart
entries.example_cn: 她因不懂同事们的语言而感到与他们格格不入。
entries.example_en: She felt isolated from her colleagues because she did not speak their language.

entries.definition_en: far away from other people or places; physically or socially remote
entries.example_cn: 他们住在深山深处的一座偏僻小屋中。
entries.example_en: They live in an isolated cabin deep in the mountains.

entries.definition_en: occurring at separate times with gaps in between
entries.example_cn: 这些袭击是孤立事件，不能反映总体情况。
entries.example_en: The attacks were isolated incidents that did not reflect the general situation.

entries.definition_cn: 与通常相连或相邻的元素分离的
entries.definition_en: separated from things that are usually connected or next to each other
entries.example_cn: 该岛屿是大陆的一个孤立部分，被一条深渠隔开。
entries.example_en: The island is an isolated part of the continent, separated by a deep channel.

entries.definition_cn: 被切断与外界联系或被遗留下的
entries.definition_en: cut off from others or left behind
entries.example_cn: 洪水切断了村庄与外界的联系，阻断了所有补给线。
entries.example_en: The village was isolated by the flood, cutting off all supply lines.

entries.definition_cn: 被强制隔离的，尤其是出于健康原因
entries.definition_en: kept apart from others, especially for health reasons
entries.example_cn: 该患者被隔离在特殊病房中，以防止病毒传播。
entries.example_en: The patient was isolated in a special ward to prevent the spread of the virus.

entries.definition_en: relating to a language where words express distinct ideas and grammar depends mainly on word order
entries.example_cn: 英语是一种孤立语，词形变化很少。
entries.example_en: English is an isolating language with little inflection.

entries.definition_en: the state of being separated from others
entries.example_cn: 这座岛屿完全与世隔绝。
entries.example_en: The island is in total isolation.

entries.definition_cn: 因与他人分离而产生的孤独感
entries.definition_en: a feeling of loneliness caused by separation from others
entries.example_cn: 搬到新城市后，他感到深深的被孤立感。
entries.example_en: He felt deep isolation after moving to the new city.

entries.definition_en: the action of separating something from others
entries.example_cn: 病毒通过严格的隔离措施得到了控制。
entries.example_en: The virus was contained through strict isolation.

entries.definition_cn: 国家与其他国家缺乏外交关系的状态
entries.definition_en: a country's lack of diplomatic relations with other countries
entries.example_cn: 孤立主义政策导致了经济制裁。
entries.example_en: The policy of isolation led to economic sanctions.

entries.definition_cn: 弗洛伊德理论中将困扰性想法与相关情绪分离的防御机制
entries.definition_en: a Freudian defense mechanism separating a troubling thought from its associated emotions
entries.example_cn: 治疗师讨论了病人将困扰性想法与情绪分离的防御机制。
entries.example_en: The therapist discussed the patient's isolation of a troubling thought from its emotions.

entries.definition_en: a policy of avoiding involvement in international economic and political affairs
entries.example_cn: 该国的孤立主义政策阻止其加入全球贸易协定。
entries.example_en: The country's isolationism prevented it from joining the global trade agreement.

entries.definition_en: a person who advocates avoiding involvement in international affairs
entries.example_cn: 这位政治家因反对介入外国冲突而被批评为孤立主义者。
entries.example_en: The politician was criticized as an isolationist for opposing involvement in foreign conflicts.

entries.definition_en: relating to or supporting the policy of avoiding international involvement
entries.example_cn: 这项条约是由一个奉行孤立主义政策的政府签署的。
entries.example_en: The treaty was signed by an isolationist government.

entries.definition_en: an essential amino acid found in proteins; isomeric with leucine
entries.example_cn: 膳食补充剂通常含有异亮氨酸以支持肌肉恢复。
entries.example_en: Dietary supplements often contain isoleucine to support muscle recovery.

entries.definition_cn: 分子式相同但原子排列结构不同的化合物
entries.definition_en: a compound with the same molecular formula as another but a different arrangement of atoms
entries.example_cn: 该分子有两种具有不同物理性质的同分异构体。
entries.example_en: The molecule has two isomers with distinct physical properties.

entries.definition_en: an enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of a substrate into an isomeric form
entries.example_cn: 这种异构酶促进了分子内原子的重排。
entries.example_en: The isomerase facilitates the rearrangement of atoms within the molecule.

entries.definition_en: relating to or exhibiting the phenomenon of isomerism
entries.example_cn: 这些异构化合物具有相同的化学式，但结构不同。
entries.example_en: The isomeric compounds share the same chemical formula but have different structures.

entries.definition_en: the process of changing a chemical compound into one of its isomers
entries.example_cn: 该工业过程涉及将丁烷异构化为异丁烷。
entries.example_en: The industrial process involves the isomerisation of butane into isobutane.

entries.definition_en: the condition of existing in different forms that have the same chemical formula but different structures
entries.example_cn: 有机化学在很大程度上是研究同分异构现象以及不同结构如何影响性质的学科。
entries.example_en: Organic chemistry is largely the study of isomerism and how different structures affect properties.

entries.definition_en: the process of converting a chemical compound into an isomer of itself
entries.example_cn: 该工业过程涉及将丁烷异构化为异丁烷。
entries.example_en: The industrial process involves the isomerization of butane into isobutane.

entries.definition_en: to change into an isomer
entries.example_cn: 在高压下，该气体异构化为更稳定的形式。
entries.example_en: Under high pressure, the gas isomerizes into a more stable form.

entries.definition_en: to cause a substance to change into an isomer
entries.example_cn: 化学家利用热量和催化剂使该化合物发生异构化。
entries.example_en: Chemists use heat and catalysts to isomerize the compound.

entries.definition_cn: 具有相等尺寸或测量值
entries.definition_en: having equal dimensions or measurements
entries.example_cn: 这个房间是等尺寸的，所有墙壁长度相同。
entries.example_en: The room is isometric, with all walls being the same length.

entries.definition_cn: 等长收缩的；涉及肌肉长度不变而张力增加的
entries.definition_en: involving muscular contraction where tension increases but length stays constant
entries.example_cn: 她做等长运动来增强核心肌肉。
entries.example_en: She performed isometric exercises to strengthen her core muscles.

entries.definition_en: related by an isometry
entries.example_cn: 这两个形状是等距的，意味着它们大小和形状相同。
entries.example_en: The two shapes are isometric, meaning they have the same size and shape.

entries.definition_cn: 等轴的；具有三个相互垂直且相等的轴的
entries.definition_en: of a crystal system with three equal axes at right angles
entries.example_cn: 该矿物样本被鉴定为具有等轴晶体结构。
entries.example_en: The mineral sample was identified as having an isometric crystal structure.

entries.definition_en: a line connecting isometric points
entries.example_cn: 建筑师画了一条连接对应等距点的线。
entries.example_en: The architect drew an isometric line connecting the corresponding points.

entries.definition_cn: 通过对抗阻力收缩肌肉、但不改变肌肉长度或移动关节的运动
entries.definition_en: exercises involving muscle contractions against resistance without changing muscle length or moving the joints
entries.example_cn: 教练推荐进行等长运动来增强力量，同时不移动四肢。
entries.example_en: The trainer recommended isometrics for building strength without moving the limbs.

entries.definition_en: a mathematical transformation that preserves the distance between points
entries.example_cn: 在几何学中，等距变换将一个形状映射到另一个形状，而不改变其大小或形状。
entries.example_en: In geometry, an isometry maps one shape onto another without changing its size or shape.

entries.definition_en: the quality of having equal measurements or intensity
entries.example_cn: 声波的度量相等带来了完美的平衡听觉体验。
entries.example_en: The isometry of the sound waves resulted in a perfectly balanced audio experience.

entries.definition_en: the state of being at the same height above sea level
entries.example_cn: 两座山峰之间的海拔相等意味着它们处于完全相同的高度。
entries.example_en: The isometry between the two mountain peaks means they stand at exactly the same elevation.

entries.definition_en: growth where different parts of an organism increase in size at the same rate
entries.example_cn: 胚胎发育的等比例生长确保了所有肢体与身体按比例生长。
entries.example_en: The isometry of the developing embryo ensures that all limbs grow in proportion to the body.

entries.definition_cn: 通过保持结构的一一对应关系相关的
entries.definition_en: related by a one-to-one correspondence that preserves structure
entries.example_cn: 这两个图是同构的，因为它们的顶点和边完全对应。
entries.example_en: The two graphs are isomorphic because their vertices and edges correspond exactly.

entries.definition_cn: 结构或功能相似但在遗传或进化上无关的
entries.definition_en: having a similar structure or function despite lacking a genetic or evolutionary relationship
entries.example_cn: 这两种结构在功能上相似，但它们是独立进化的。
entries.example_en: These two structures are isomorphic in function, although they evolved independently.

entries.definition_en: (biology) similarity or identity of form or shape or structure
entries.example_cn: 同形研究帮助生物学家理解不同物种如何进化出相似的结构。
entries.example_en: The study of isomorphism helps biologists understand how different species evolve similar structures.

entries.definition_en: having the same or similar form or structure; exhibiting isomorphism
entries.example_cn: 这两种同形晶体结构相似，但化学组成不同。
entries.example_en: The two isomorphous crystals had similar structures but different chemical compositions.

entries.definition_cn: 用于预防和治疗结核病的抗菌药
entries.definition_en: an antibacterial drug used to prevent and treat tuberculosis
entries.example_cn: 异烟肼用于预防和治疗结核病。
entries.example_en: Isoniazid is used to prevent and treat tuberculosis.

entries.definition_en: a small crustacean with seven pairs of legs that lives on land or in water
entries.example_cn: 这只等足类动物在潮湿的木头上缓慢爬行。
entries.example_en: The isopod crawled slowly across the damp wood.

entries.definition_en: a type of alcohol used as antifreeze or a solvent
entries.example_cn: 机械师用异丙醇清洗发动机部件。
entries.example_en: The mechanic used isopropanol to clean the engine parts.

entries.definition_en: a drug used to treat bronchial asthma and to stimulate the heart
entries.example_cn: 医生开了异丙肾上腺素来帮助患者呼吸更顺畅。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed isoproterenol to help the patient breathe easier.

entries.definition_en: (of a triangle) having two sides of equal length
entries.example_cn: 在等腰三角形中，至少有两条边长度相等。
entries.example_en: In an isosceles triangle, at least two sides are equal in length.

entries.definition_cn: 一种双环呋喃衍生物，其硝酸酯被用作血管扩张剂
entries.definition_en: a bicyclic derivative of furan whose nitrate esters are used as vasodilators
entries.example_cn: 异山梨醇是用于帮助控制心绞痛的硝酸酯类药物的基础化合物。
entries.example_en: Isosorbide is the basis of nitrate drugs used to help manage angina.

entries.definition_en: in geology, a general equilibrium of forces that tend to elevate or depress the earth's crust
entries.example_cn: 均衡说解释了为什么山脉在地幔深处有深长的根部。
entries.example_en: The theory of isostasy explains why mountain ranges have deep roots extending into the mantle.

entries.definition_en: a line on a map connecting points that have the same temperature at a specific time
entries.example_cn: 天气图显示了一条等温线，将寒冷的北部地区与较温暖的南部隔开。
entries.example_en: The weather map shows an isotherm separating the cold northern region from the warmer south.

entries.definition_en: describing a process or change that happens at a constant temperature
entries.example_cn: 该实验在等温室中进行，以保持温度稳定。
entries.example_en: The experiment was conducted in an isothermal chamber to maintain a steady temperature.

entries.definition_cn: 异硫氰酸酯；含有异硫氰酸酯基（–N=C=S）的化合物
entries.definition_en: an organic compound containing the isothiocyanate group, –N=C=S, responsible for the pungency of some plants
entries.example_cn: 酱汁的辛辣味来自萝卜中的异硫氰酸酯化合物。
entries.example_en: The sharp flavor of the sauce comes from the isothiocyanate compounds in the radish.

entries.definition_en: having the same or equal osmotic pressure
entries.example_cn: 医生经常给病人输注等渗液体以维持血压。
entries.example_en: Physicians often administer isotonic fluids to patients to maintain blood pressure.

entries.definition_en: involving muscular contraction in which tension is constant while length changes
entries.example_cn: 在锻炼过程中，肌肉进行等张收缩以举起重量。
entries.example_en: During the exercise, the muscle performed an isotonic contraction to lift the weight.

entries.definition_en: having equal tension
entries.example_cn: 两块对抗的肌肉以张力相等的方式协同工作以稳定关节。
entries.example_en: The two opposing muscles worked in an isotonic manner to stabilize the joint.

entries.definition_en: having the same tone
entries.example_cn: 这两件乐器被调成同样的音高。
entries.example_en: The two instruments were tuned to the same pitch.

entries.definition_en: one of two or more atoms with the same atomic number but with different numbers of neutrons
entries.example_cn: 碳 -14 是一种用于测定古代文物的放射性同位素。
entries.example_en: Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope used in dating ancient artifacts.

entries.definition_en: relating to or involving isotopes
entries.example_cn: 同位素分析揭示了化石的年龄。
entries.example_en: The isotopic analysis revealed the age of the fossil.

entries.definition_en: having properties that are the same in all directions
entries.example_cn: 这种材料是各向同性的，意味着其强度不随方向变化。
entries.example_en: The material is isotropic, meaning its strength does not vary with direction.

entries.definition_en: in an isotropic manner
entries.example_cn: 该材料在受热时各向同性地膨胀，在所有方向上保持其形状。
entries.example_en: The material expands isotropically when heated, maintaining its shape in all directions.

entries.definition_en: the property of having the same value in all directions
entries.example_cn: 材料的各向同性确保了无论应力方向如何，其强度都是均匀的。
entries.example_en: The isotropy of the material ensures uniform strength regardless of the stress direction.

entries.definition_cn: 正式发行或发放；发行行为
entries.definition_en: the action of giving something out officially or in large numbers
entries.example_cn: 新护照的正式签发花了几个星期。
entries.example_en: The official issuance of the new passport took several weeks.

entries.definition_en: a subject or problem being discussed or considered
entries.example_cn: 我们需要讨论污染问题。
entries.example_en: We need to discuss the issue of pollution.

entries.definition_en: an important question that is in dispute and must be settled
entries.example_cn: 主要问题是生活成本。
entries.example_en: The main issue is the cost of living.

entries.definition_en: one of a series published periodically
entries.example_cn: 我读了这本杂志的最新一期。
entries.example_en: I read the latest issue of the magazine.

entries.definition_en: prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
entries.example_cn: 公司将于下个月发行新股。
entries.example_en: The company will issue new shares next month.

entries.definition_en: bring out an official document (such as a warrant)
entries.example_cn: 警方签发逮捕令。
entries.example_en: The police issued a warrant for his arrest.

entries.definition_en: circulate or distribute or equip with
entries.example_cn: 他们向难民分发食物。
entries.example_en: They issued food to the refugees.

entries.definition_en: the act of providing an item for general use or for official purposes (usually in quantity)
entries.example_cn: 政府向旅行者发放护照。
entries.example_en: The government issued passports to the travelers.

entries.definition_en: come out of
entries.example_cn: 烟囱冒出了烟。
entries.example_en: Smoke issued from the chimney.

entries.definition_en: a person or organization that issues, emits, or publishes something
entries.example_cn: 中央银行是国家货币的主要发行机构。
entries.example_en: The central bank is the primary issuer of the national currency.

entries.definition_en: the act of providing items for general use or official purposes
entries.example_cn: 由于纸张短缺，新护照的发放已被推迟。
entries.example_en: The issuing of new passports has been delayed due to the shortage of paper.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to or forming an isthmus
entries.example_cn: 地峡运动会曾在古科林斯举行。
entries.example_en: The Isthmian Games were held in ancient Corinth.

entries.definition_en: a relatively narrow strip of land connecting two larger land areas with water on both sides
entries.example_cn: 巴拿马运河穿过巴拿马地峡。
entries.example_en: The Panama Canal cuts through the isthmus of Panama.

entries.definition_cn: 连接较大结构的狭窄部分，尤指解剖结构中的峡部
entries.definition_en: a narrow part connecting two larger structures, especially an anatomical structure
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了连接甲状腺两叶的峡部。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the isthmus connecting the two lobes of the thyroid.

entries.definition_en: used to refer to an inanimate object, abstract entity, or non-human living thing.
entries.example_cn: 那只猫正睡在沙发上，看起来很舒服。
entries.example_en: The cat is sleeping on the sofa, and it looks very comfortable.

entries.definition_cn: 非人称 it（无实义主语）
entries.definition_en: used without referent as the subject of an impersonal verb or statement.
entries.example_cn: 外面正下着大雨。
entries.example_en: It is raining heavily outside.

entries.definition_cn: 用于指认某人身份，尤其用于电话或有人敲门时
entries.definition_en: used to identify someone, especially on the phone or at the door
entries.example_cn: 是谁？——是亚历克斯，打电话来是关于预约的。
entries.example_en: Who is it? — It's Alex calling about the appointment.

entries.definition_en: used to refer to a baby or child, especially of unknown gender.
entries.example_cn: 看那个婴儿，它（他/她）真可爱。
entries.example_en: Look at that baby; it is so cute.

entries.definition_en: most fashionable, popular, or in vogue.
entries.example_cn: 那种发型现在非常时髦。
entries.example_en: That hairstyle is very it right now.

entries.definition_cn: 它（指非人生物或去人性化者）
entries.definition_en: one who is neither a he nor a she; a creature; a dehumanized being.
entries.example_cn: 士兵们像对待物品一样对待囚犯。
entries.example_en: The soldiers treated the prisoners like it.

entries.definition_en: used to refer to an unspecified person.
entries.example_cn: 如果是他，他就迟到了。
entries.example_en: If it is him, he is late.

entries.definition_cn: 代词 it（“它”）的冒犯性用法，用来指代跨性别者或非二元性别者
entries.definition_en: an offensive use of the third-person singular pronoun it for a transgender or non-binary person
entries.example_cn: 用 it（“它”）指代跨性别者可能具有强烈冒犯性。
entries.example_en: Using it for a transgender person can be deeply offensive.

entries.definition_en: to write or print text in italics
entries.example_cn: 请在你的参考文献中用斜体书写书名。
entries.example_en: Please italicize the title of the book in your bibliography.

entries.definition_en: a sensation that makes you want to scratch
entries.example_cn: 蚊子叮咬引起了持续的痒感。
entries.example_en: The mosquito bite caused a persistent itch.

entries.definition_en: a strong desire to do something
entries.example_cn: 她渴望去新的国家旅行。
entries.example_en: She had an itch to travel to new countries.

entries.definition_en: to feel a desire to scratch your skin
entries.example_cn: 坐得太久后，我的腿开始发痒。
entries.example_en: My legs started to itch after sitting for too long.

entries.definition_en: to have a strong urge to do something
entries.example_cn: 我渴望今晚看那部新电影。
entries.example_en: I itch to see the new movie tonight.

usage.label: itch to + verb / itch for + noun

entries.definition_en: to cause someone to feel an itch
entries.example_cn: 羊毛衫让他脖子发痒。
entries.example_en: The wool sweater itched his neck.

entries.definition_en: to rub or scratch your skin to relieve an itch
entries.example_cn: 他抓了抓手臂，以免发痒。
entries.example_en: He scratched his arm to stop himself from itching.

entries.definition_en: a contagious skin infection caused by mites
entries.example_cn: 她需要接受由疥螨引起的疥疮治疗。
entries.example_en: She needed treatment for scabies caused by itch mites.

entries.definition_en: a sensation on the skin that causes a desire to scratch
entries.example_cn: 蚊子叮咬导致她手臂上持续感到瘙痒。
entries.example_en: The mosquito bite caused a persistent itchiness on her arm.

entries.definition_en: a sensation on the skin that makes you want to scratch
entries.example_cn: 蚊子叮咬引起了剧烈的瘙痒。
entries.example_en: The mosquito bite caused intense itching.

entries.definition_en: causing an irritating sensation on the skin
entries.example_cn: 这件羊毛衫贴着他的脖子，让他觉得发痒。
entries.example_en: The wool sweater was itchy against his neck.

entries.definition_en: feeling nervous and unable to relax
entries.example_cn: 她在重要面试前感到坐立不安。
entries.example_en: She felt itchy before the big interview.

entries.definition_en: an individual entry in a list or group
entries.example_cn: 请将新项目添加到购物清单中。
entries.example_en: Please add the new item to the shopping list.

entries.definition_en: an individual thing in a collection
entries.example_cn: 这本书是图书馆收藏中的一个个体。
entries.example_en: This book is an item in the library's collection.

entries.definition_cn: 整体中的一个单独部分或细节
entries.definition_en: a separate part or detail of a larger whole
entries.example_cn: 这份报告分别讨论了提案中的每一项。
entries.example_en: The report discusses each item of the proposal separately.

entries.definition_en: an isolated fact considered separately
entries.example_cn: 那只是战争漫长历史中的一个孤立事实。
entries.example_en: That is just one item in the long history of the war.

entries.definition_en: a specific instance of a symbol type
entries.example_cn: 字母'A'是字母表中的一个符号实例。
entries.example_en: The letter 'A' is an item of the alphabet.

entries.definition_cn: 也；同样（用于正式或古旧的列举语境）
entries.definition_en: also; likewise (used as a formal or archaic list marker)
entries.example_cn: 此外，租户还应支付所有税费。
entries.example_en: Item, the tenant shall pay all taxes and charges.

entries.definition_en: to list things one by one
entries.example_cn: 请在发票上逐项列出所有费用。
entries.example_en: Please itemise all the expenses on the invoice.

entries.definition_en: to specify or describe something in detail
entries.example_cn: 该报告详细说明了对策变更的原因。
entries.example_en: The report itemises the reasons for the policy change.

entries.definition_en: the act of making a list of items
entries.example_cn: 会计师花了一下午时间逐项列出公司的开支。
entries.example_en: The accountant spent the afternoon on the itemization of the company's expenses.

entries.definition_cn: 游戏中可获得的物品及其设计和属性所构成的系统
entries.definition_en: the system of items available in a game, including their design and qualities
entries.example_cn: 这款游戏的物品系统很差，因为最好的物品太稀有了。
entries.example_en: The game's itemization is poor because the best items are too rare.

entries.definition_en: to give a separate, detailed account of each item
entries.example_cn: 请在表格中逐项列出所有费用。
entries.example_en: Please itemize all the expenses on the form.

entries.definition_en: to place things on a list
entries.example_cn: 会计师为审计将库存物品列入清单。
entries.example_en: The accountant itemized the inventory for the audit.

entries.definition_cn: 对集合中的每个项目执行或重复某项操作
entries.definition_en: to perform or repeat an operation on each item in a set
entries.example_cn: 该函数遍历列表中的每个项目并进行验证。
entries.example_en: The function iterates over each item in the list and validates it.

entries.definition_cn: 反复对上一次操作的结果执行某项操作
entries.definition_en: to repeatedly apply an operation to the result of the previous operation
entries.example_cn: 程序反复计算，直到结果达到准确要求。
entries.example_en: The program iterates the calculation until the result is accurate.

entries.definition_en: doing or saying again; a repeated performance
entries.example_cn: 排练期间，演员们第二次表演了这一场景。
entries.example_en: During rehearsal, the actors performed the scene a second time.

entries.definition_cn: （计算机科学）一组指令的一次执行
entries.definition_en: (computer science) a single execution of a set of instructions that are to be repeated
entries.example_cn: 程序在循环的每次迭代中运行相同的代码。
entries.example_en: The program runs the same code in each iteration of the loop.

entries.definition_cn: （计算机科学）执行一组指令若干次或直到获得指定结果
entries.definition_en: (computer science) executing the same set of instructions a given number of times or until a specified result is obtained
entries.example_cn: 该算法需要多次迭代才能收敛到正确答案。
entries.example_en: The algorithm requires multiple iterations to converge on the correct answer.

entries.definition_en: involving or characterized by repetition
entries.example_cn: 该软件使用迭代过程来提高性能。
entries.example_en: The software uses an iterative process to improve performance.

entries.definition_cn: 表示重复体的动词形式
entries.definition_en: a verb form expressing the iterative aspect
entries.example_cn: 这个动词是重复体，表示某个动作反复发生。
entries.example_en: The verb is iterative, showing that an action is repeated.

entries.definition_en: traveling from place to place to work
entries.example_cn: 他们聘请了一位流动教师到那个偏远的村庄工作。
entries.example_en: They hired an itinerant teacher to work in the remote village.

entries.definition_en: a person who travels from place to place, especially for work
entries.example_cn: 这位流动工人在收获季节从一个农场搬到另一个农场。
entries.example_en: The itinerant laborer moved from farm to farm during the harvest.

entries.definition_en: a proposed plan for a journey or trip
entries.example_cn: 公司为商务会议提出了详细的行程计划。
entries.example_en: The company presented a detailed itinerary for the business conference.

entries.definition_en: a planned route or path for travel
entries.example_cn: 我们按照推荐的路线游览了所有历史遗迹。
entries.example_en: We followed the recommended itinerary to visit all the historical sites.

entries.definition_en: a book or guide providing information for travelers
entries.example_cn: 她买了一本当地的旅行指南来帮助规划行程。
entries.example_en: She bought a local itinerary to help plan her trip.

entries.definition_cn: 一种可口服或静脉注射的三唑类抗真菌药，尤用于治疗芽生菌病和组织胞浆菌病
entries.definition_en: a triazole antifungal drug given orally or intravenously, especially to treat blastomycosis and histoplasmosis
entries.example_cn: 医生开了伊曲康唑来治疗患者的组织胞浆菌病。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed itraconazole to treat the patient's histoplasmosis.

entries.definition_en: Belonging to it.
entries.example_cn: 那条狗摇着尾巴。
entries.example_en: The dog wagged its tail.

entries.definition_cn: 它的（独立使用，指属于它的人或物）
entries.definition_en: the one or ones belonging to it, used independently, especially after of
entries.example_cn: 那只狗认出那位邻居是它和我们的朋友。
entries.example_en: The dog recognized the neighbor as a friend of its and ours.

entries.definition_en: plural of it
entries.example_cn: 这只猫有自己的玩具。
entries.example_en: The cat has its own toys.

entries.definition_cn: 它自己；指代作为动词或介词宾语且同时也是主语的事物
entries.definition_en: it; used to refer to a thing as the object of a verb or preposition that is also the subject
entries.example_cn: 机器自行修复了。
entries.example_en: The machine repaired itself.

entries.definition_cn: 它自己；用于强调主语，特别是强调它是谓语中的唯一参与者
entries.definition_en: it; used to intensify the subject, especially to emphasize that it is the only participant in the predicate
entries.example_cn: 机器自己坏了。
entries.example_en: The machine itself broke down.

entries.definition_en: very small or tiny
entries.example_cn: 那只小小的蜘蛛爬上了水管。
entries.example_en: The itsy-bitsy spider climbed up the spout.

entries.definition_en: very small or tiny (used informally).
entries.example_cn: 我们在墙上发现了一个极小的洞，风从那里吹了进来。
entries.example_en: We found an itty-bitty hole in the wall that let the wind in.

entries.definition_en: a coarse shrubby plant with small greenish flowers, found in moist areas like coastal salt marshes in eastern and central North America
entries.example_cn: 这位植物学家在沿海盐沼中鉴定出了这种稀有的滨藜属植物。
entries.example_en: The botanist identified the rare iva growing in the coastal salt marshes.

entries.definition_en: the hard, smooth, white material that makes up the tusks of elephants and walruses
entries.example_cn: 工匠们用象牙雕刻出精美的图案。
entries.example_en: Artisans carved intricate figures from the ivory.

entries.definition_en: a creamy-white color resembling ivory
entries.example_cn: 象牙白是婚纱常用的颜色。
entries.example_en: Ivory is a popular color for wedding dresses.

entries.definition_en: the keys of a piano, especially the white keys
entries.example_cn: 他坐下来，开始弹钢琴。
entries.example_en: He sat down and began to tickle the ivories.

entries.definition_en: a climbing plant with evergreen leaves and small black berries
entries.example_cn: 那座老建筑爬满了常春藤。
entries.example_en: The old building was covered in ivy.

entries.definition_cn: 一种宽大的白色棉质外衣，传统上由北非和中东的穆斯林女性穿着以遮盖全身
entries.definition_en: a voluminous cotton outer garment, usually white, traditionally worn by Muslim women in northern Africa and the Middle East to cover the entire body
entries.example_cn: 她裹着传统的izar走在沙漠市场中。
entries.example_en: She wrapped herself in a traditional izar as she walked through the desert market.

entries.definition_en: the letter Z, especially in Scottish usage
entries.example_cn: Izzard 是字母 Z 的另一种称呼。
entries.example_en: Izzard is another name for the letter Z.

entries.definition_cn: 罗马字母表的第十个字母
entries.definition_en: the 10th letter of the Roman alphabet
entries.example_cn: J 是字母表的第十个字母。
entries.example_en: J is the tenth letter of the alphabet.

entries.definition_en: a unit of electrical energy equal to the work done when a current of one ampere passes through a resistance of one ohm for one second
entries.example_cn: 该设备消耗的能量以焦耳为单位进行测量。
entries.example_en: The energy consumed by the device was measured in J.

entries.definition_cn: 将普通重力炸弹改造成精确制导弹药的制导组件
entries.definition_en: a guidance kit that converts an unguided gravity bomb into a precision-guided munition
entries.example_cn: 军队部署了联合直接攻击弹药以提高空袭的精确度。
entries.example_en: The military deployed JDAMs to increase the precision of the airstrike.

entries.definition_cn: 大学或高中非主力校队
entries.definition_en: a college or university sports team that is not the top-level team
entries.example_cn: JV队输给了校队主力。
entries.example_en: The JV team lost the game to the varsity team.

entries.definition_cn: 男子的代称，尤指年轻或社会地位较低的男子
entries.definition_en: a conventional name for a man, especially a younger or lower-class man
entries.example_cn: 他们把那个身份不明的男子叫作杰克。
entries.example_en: They called the unidentified man Jack.

entries.definition_en: a sailor, especially one of low rank
entries.example_cn: 这位老水手熟悉船上的每一个角落。
entries.example_en: The old Jack-tar knew every corner of the ship.

entries.definition_en: a surname derived from a father's name
entries.example_cn: 杰克逊家族在这个小镇住了好几代了。
entries.example_en: The Jackson family has lived in this town for generations.

entries.definition_en: a male given name originally used as a surname
entries.example_cn: 杰克逊是美国男孩中一个流行的名字。
entries.example_en: Jackson is a popular name for boys in the United States.

entries.definition_en: a place name
entries.example_cn: 我们开车去杰克逊参观国家公园。
entries.example_en: We drove to Jackson to visit the national park.

entries.definition_en: a twenty-dollar bill in the United States
entries.example_cn: 他用一张二十美元钞票付了咖啡钱。
entries.example_en: He paid for the coffee with a Jackson.

entries.definition_en: a member of the famous musical group The Jackson 5
entries.example_cn: 迈克尔·杰克逊是该组合中最著名的成员。
entries.example_en: Michael Jackson was the most famous member of the group.

entries.definition_cn: 与安德鲁·杰克逊、其总统任期或其民粹民主概念有关的
entries.definition_en: of or pertaining to Andrew Jackson or his presidency or his concepts of popular democracy
entries.example_cn: 杰克逊的政策强调普通人的权利高于精英利益。
entries.example_en: Jacksonian policies emphasized the rights of the common man over elite interests.

entries.definition_cn: 安德鲁·杰克逊或其思想的追随者
entries.definition_en: a follower of Andrew Jackson or his ideas
entries.example_cn: 杰克逊运动旨在将民主扩展到普通民众。
entries.example_en: The Jacksonian movement sought to expand democracy to the common people.

entries.definition_cn: （圣经）雅各，以撒之子、以扫之弟，以色列十二支派族长的父亲
entries.definition_en: the biblical patriarch Jacob, son of Isaac and brother of Esau, father of the twelve patriarchs of Israel
entries.example_cn: 在旧约中，雅各与上帝摔跤，并被赐名为以色列。
entries.example_en: In the Old Testament, Jacob wrestled with God and was given the name Israel.

entries.definition_cn: 詹姆士一世、其统治或其时代的
entries.definition_en: of or relating to James I, his reign, or the period 1603–1625
entries.example_cn: 这座剧院是按照宏伟的詹姆士一世风格设计的。
entries.example_en: The theater was designed in a grand Jacobean style.

entries.definition_cn: 詹姆士一世或斯图亚特王朝的支持者
entries.definition_en: a supporter of James I or the House of Stuart
entries.example_cn: 许多詹姆士一世支持者拥护詹姆士一世和斯图亚特王朝。
entries.example_en: Many Jacobeans supported James I and the House of Stuart.

entries.definition_en: a member of the radical movement that instituted the Reign of Terror during the French Revolution
entries.example_cn: 法国大革命期间，许多雅各宾派成员支持激进改革。
entries.example_en: Many Jacobins supported radical reforms during the French Revolution.

entries.definition_en: relating to the Jacobins of the French Revolution
entries.example_cn: 恐怖统治期间实施的雅各宾派政策震惊了许多温和派公民。
entries.example_en: The Jacobinic policies implemented during the Reign of Terror shocked many moderate citizens.

entries.definition_en: relating to the Jacobins of the French Revolution
entries.example_cn: 委员会成员的雅各宾派狂热导致了激进的决策。
entries.example_en: The Jacobinical fervor of the committee members led to radical decisions.

entries.definition_en: the extreme political ideology of the most radical faction during the French Revolution, known for instituting the Reign of Terror.
entries.example_cn: 那个时代的雅各宾主义导致数千人被处决。
entries.example_en: The Jacobinism of the era led to the execution of thousands of perceived enemies.

entries.definition_en: a person who supported the restoration of the Stuart monarchy in Britain
entries.example_cn: 詹姆斯党叛乱未能将斯图亚特国王重新扶上王位。
entries.example_en: The Jacobite rebellion failed to restore the Stuart king to the throne.

entries.definition_en: a type of loom equipped with a mechanism that creates holes for the shuttle to pass through, used for weaving patterned fabrics
entries.example_cn: 窗帘上复杂的花卉图案是使用提花机织造的。
entries.example_en: The intricate floral design on the curtain was created using a Jacquard loom.

entries.definition_en: a Turkic literary language of medieval central Asia named for one of the sons of Genghis Khan
entries.example_cn: 学者们从中世纪手稿中重构了察合台语的语法。
entries.example_en: Scholars have reconstructed the grammar of the Jagatai language from medieval manuscripts.

entries.definition_en: a Turkic literary language of medieval central Asia named for one of the sons of Genghis Khan
entries.example_cn: 察合台语是中世纪中亚的一种突厥文学语言。
entries.example_en: Jaghatai was a Turkic literary language of medieval Central Asia.

entries.definition_en: relating to or characteristic of Jainism
entries.example_cn: 耆那教的饮食法规禁止食用根茎类蔬菜。
entries.example_en: Jain dietary laws prohibit the consumption of root vegetables.

entries.definition_en: a religion founded in the 6th century BC that emphasizes asceticism, the transmigration of the soul, and denies a supreme being
entries.example_cn: 耆那教教导说，灵魂会经历许多生命，直到获得解脱。
entries.example_en: Jainism teaches that the soul travels through many lives until it achieves liberation.

entries.definition_cn: 非有神论的印度异端哲学
entries.definition_en: a nontheistic heterodox Indian philosophy
entries.example_cn: 耆那教既是一种宗教，也是一种非有神论的印度哲学。
entries.example_en: Jainism is a nontheistic Indian philosophy as well as a religion.

entries.definition_en: a follower of Jainism
entries.example_cn: 许多耆那教信徒实行严格的素食主义。
entries.example_en: Many Jainists practice strict vegetarianism.

entries.definition_en: relating to or characteristic of Jainism
entries.example_cn: 耆那教社区对非暴力有着独特的理解。
entries.example_en: The Jainist community has a unique approach to non-violence.

entries.definition_en: a person who is born in or lives in Jamaica
entries.example_cn: 许多牙买加人在 20 世纪 50 年代搬到了伦敦。
entries.example_en: Many Jamaicans moved to London in the 1950s.

entries.definition_en: relating to Jamaica, its people, or its culture
entries.example_cn: 我们在度假期间享受了牙买加的美食和音乐。
entries.example_en: We enjoyed the Jamaican food and music during our holiday.

entries.definition_en: a male given name of Hebrew origin
entries.example_cn: 詹姆斯是英语国家非常流行的名字。
entries.example_en: James is a very popular name in English-speaking countries.

entries.definition_en: the twentieth book of the New Testament
entries.example_cn: 《雅各书》鼓励信徒将信仰付诸行动。
entries.example_en: The letter of James encourages believers to act on their faith.

entries.definition_en: one of two Apostles, James the Greater or James the Less
entries.example_cn: 大雅各是使徒之一。
entries.example_en: James the Greater was one of the Apostles.

entries.definition_en: an English surname
entries.example_cn: 詹姆斯家族在这个小镇住了好几代。
entries.example_en: The James family has lived in this town for generations.

entries.definition_en: a placename
entries.example_cn: 詹姆斯是加拿大安大略省蒂米斯卡明区的一个乡镇。
