entries.definition_en: the cause of someone's death
entries.example_cn: 吸烟是影响肺部健康的主要致死原因。
entries.example_en: Smoking is a major killer that affects lung health.

entries.definition_en: a very difficult problem or situation
entries.example_cn: 在市中心找个停车位真是个难题。
entries.example_en: Finding a parking spot in the city center is a real killer.

entries.definition_en: a large black-and-white whale with a big dorsal fin
entries.example_cn: 人们发现一只逆戟鲸正在海岸附近捕猎。
entries.example_en: A killer whale was spotted hunting near the coast.

entries.definition_cn: 鳉形目中的小型鱼类，可作鱼饵、观赏鱼或用于灭蚊
entries.definition_en: small mostly freshwater fishes in the Cyprinodontiformes order; used as bait or aquarium fishes or in mosquito control
entries.example_cn: 这位水族爱好者为热带展示缸精心挑选了几条鳉鱼。
entries.example_en: The aquarist carefully selected killifish for the tropical display tank.

entries.definition_en: an event that causes someone to die
entries.example_cn: 警方正在调查这起杀人事件。
entries.example_en: The police are investigating the killing.

entries.definition_en: the act of terminating a life
entries.example_cn: 这次杀戮是用刀实施的。
entries.example_en: The killing was carried out with a knife.

entries.definition_en: a very large profit
entries.example_cn: 公司在新产品上赚了一大笔钱。
entries.example_en: The company made a killing on the new product.

entries.definition_en: very funny
entries.example_cn: 那个笑话笑死人了。
entries.example_en: That joke was killing.

entries.definition_en: in a manner that is very humorous or amusing.
entries.example_cn: 这位喜剧演员极其幽默地讲述了这个故事，引得观众捧腹大笑。
entries.example_en: The comedian told the story killingly, causing the audience to laugh uncontrollably.

entries.definition_en: a person who ruins the fun or pleasure of others
entries.example_cn: 别这么扫兴，毁了我们的野餐计划。
entries.example_en: Don't be such a killjoy and ruin our picnic plans.

entries.definition_en: a special oven used for firing clay, bricks, or other materials
entries.example_cn: 陶工们把陶瓷瓦片装进窑里。
entries.example_en: The potters loaded the kiln with ceramic tiles.

entries.definition_en: a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams
entries.example_cn: 这个包裹重五千克。
entries.example_en: The package weighs five kilos.

entries.definition_en: a unit of digital information equal to 1000 bits
entries.example_cn: 文件传输速度以每秒千比特为单位进行测量。
entries.example_en: The file transfer speed was measured in kilobits per second.

entries.definition_en: a unit of information equal to 1000 bytes
entries.example_cn: 这个文件只有 1 千字节大小。
entries.example_en: The file is only one kilobyte in size.

entries.definition_en: a unit of information equal to 1024 bytes
entries.example_cn: 软件更新至少需要 2 千字节的可用内存。
entries.example_en: The software update requires at least two kilobytes of free memory.

entries.definition_cn: 等于1000小卡的能量单位；在营养学中等于1大卡
entries.definition_en: a unit of energy equal to 1,000 small calories; in nutrition, equal to one dietary Calorie
entries.example_cn: 这个苹果含有大约一百千卡的热量。
entries.example_en: This apple contains about one hundred kilocalories.

entries.definition_en: a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams, used in the International System of Units.
entries.example_cn: 这个包裹重正好一千克。
entries.example_en: The package weighs exactly one kilogram.

entries.definition_cn: 千克力米；千克力使物体移动一米所做功的单位
entries.definition_en: a unit of work equal to the work done by a one-kilogram-force acting through one meter
entries.example_cn: 扭矩以千克力米为单位进行测量。
entries.example_en: The torque was measured in kilogram-force meters.

entries.definition_en: a unit of frequency equal to one thousand cycles per second
entries.example_cn: 该无线电信号的工作频率为五千赫兹。
entries.example_en: The radio signal operates at a frequency of five kilohertz.

entries.definition_en: a unit of length equal to 1000 meters
entries.example_cn: 马拉松是一项 42 千米的比赛。
entries.example_en: The marathon is a race of 42 kilometers.

entries.definition_en: a unit of length used in the metric system, equal to 1000 meters.
entries.example_cn: 马拉松比赛全长 42.195 千米。
entries.example_en: The marathon race is 42.195 kilometres long.

entries.definition_cn: 千吨（重量单位，具体吨制取决于语境）
entries.definition_en: a unit of mass equal to 1,000 tons, with the ton type depending on context
entries.example_cn: 这艘货船可以装载五千吨的货物。
entries.example_en: The cargo ship could carry a load of five kilotons.

entries.definition_en: a unit measuring the explosive power of a weapon, equal to the energy released by one thousand tons of TNT
entries.example_cn: 这次核试验的当量为两千吨。
entries.example_en: The nuclear test had a yield of two kilotons.

entries.definition_en: a unit of electrical potential equal to one thousand volts
entries.example_cn: 高压输电线路以数百千伏的电压输送电力。
entries.example_en: The high-voltage transmission lines carry electricity at several hundred kilovolts.

entries.definition_en: a unit of power equal to 1000 watts
entries.example_cn: 这台电动机需要功率至少为一千瓦的电源。
entries.example_en: The electric motor requires a power supply of at least one kilowatt.

entries.definition_en: a knee-length pleated tartan skirt worn by men as part of the traditional dress in the Highlands of northern Scotland
entries.example_cn: 他穿着传统的苏格兰短裙参加了高地运动会。
entries.example_en: He wore a traditional kilt to the Highland games.

entries.definition_en: a state of being in working order
entries.example_cn: 维修后，机器终于恢复正常运转了。
entries.example_en: After the repair, the machine is finally back in kilter.

usage.label: chiefly in the phrase “out of kilter”

entries.definition_cn: 一种含有较高比例二氧化碳且常含钻石的橄榄岩
entries.definition_en: a variety of peridotite containing a high proportion of carbon dioxide and often containing diamonds
entries.example_cn: 金伯利岩通常含有钻石。
entries.example_en: Kimberlite often contains diamonds.

entries.definition_en: a loose robe originally worn by Japanese people
entries.example_cn: 她穿着传统的和服去参加节日庆典。
entries.example_en: She wore a traditional kimono to the festival.

entries.definition_en: a person who is related to you by blood or marriage
entries.example_cn: 我的一位亲属住在附近。
entries.example_en: One of my kin lives nearby.

entries.definition_en: a group of people who are related by blood or marriage
entries.example_cn: 整个家族都聚在一起吃节日晚餐。
entries.example_en: The whole kin gathered for the holiday dinner.

entries.definition_en: related by blood or marriage
entries.example_cn: 这两姐妹有血缘关系，而她们的丈夫则是姻亲。
entries.example_en: The two sisters are kin by blood, while their husbands are kin by marriage.

entries.definition_cn: 基那（巴布亚新几内亚货币单位）
entries.definition_en: the basic unit of currency in Papua New Guinea
entries.example_cn: 这个纪念品的价格是五基那。
entries.example_en: The price of the souvenir was five kina.

entries.definition_en: relating to the sense of movement and position in the body
entries.example_cn: 舞者依靠运动觉来保持完美的平衡。
entries.example_en: Dancers rely on their kinaesthetic sense to maintain perfect balance.

entries.definition_cn: 催化磷酸基团转移的酶；激酶
entries.definition_en: an enzyme that transfers phosphate groups to specific target molecules
entries.example_cn: 这种激酶在细胞信号传导中起着至关重要的作用。
entries.example_en: The kinase plays a crucial role in cell signaling.

entries.definition_en: having or showing a tender and considerate and helpful nature
entries.example_cn: 她对邻居非常仁慈。
entries.example_en: She is very kind to her neighbors.

entries.definition_en: favorable or conducive to comfort
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行时，天气对我们很友好。
entries.example_en: The weather was kind to us during the hike.

entries.definition_en: tolerant and forgiving under provocation
entries.example_cn: 他足够宽容，能原谅错误。
entries.example_en: He is kind enough to forgive mistakes.

entries.definition_cn: 具有某种共同特征或品质的类别
entries.definition_en: a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality
entries.example_cn: 你喜欢什么种类的水果？
entries.example_en: What kind of fruit do you like?

entries.definition_en: having or proceeding from an innately kind disposition
entries.example_cn: 她是一个天性善良、总是乐于助人的人。
entries.example_en: She is a kind-hearted person who always helps others.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being sympathetic and having a kind heart
entries.example_cn: 她的仁慈使她成为社区里深受爱戴的一员。
entries.example_en: Her kind-heartedness made her a beloved member of the community.

entries.definition_en: to some extent
entries.example_cn: 我有点喜欢这部新电影，但有点慢。
entries.example_en: I kinda like the new movie, but it's a bit slow.

entries.definition_en: a preschool for children aged 4 to 6 to prepare them for primary school
entries.example_cn: 我女儿去年九月上了幼儿园。
entries.example_en: My daughter started kindergarten last September.

entries.definition_en: a child who attends a preschool or kindergarten
entries.example_cn: 那个幼儿园学生画了一幅她老师的画。
entries.example_en: The kindergartener drew a picture of her teacher.

entries.definition_en: a young child who attends a preschool or kindergarten class
entries.example_cn: 这位幼儿园学生今天很兴奋地开始上学。
entries.example_en: The kindergartner was excited to start school today.

entries.definition_en: having an innately kind disposition
entries.example_cn: 这位心地善良的邻居总是照顾那些老人。
entries.example_en: The kindhearted neighbor always checked on the elderly residents.

entries.definition_en: to catch fire
entries.example_cn: 干树叶被火星击中后迅速着火。
entries.example_en: The dry leaves kindled quickly when struck by the spark.

entries.definition_en: to cause something to start burning
entries.example_cn: 她用火柴点燃了篝火。
entries.example_en: She used a match to kindle the campfire.

entries.definition_en: to call forth emotions, feelings, or responses
entries.example_cn: 这次演讲在观众中激起了一种希望感。
entries.example_en: The speech kindled a sense of hope in the audience.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being friendly and helpful; a kindly disposition
entries.example_cn: 工作人员的亲切感让访客立刻感到受欢迎。
entries.example_en: The kindliness of the staff made the visitors feel welcome immediately.

entries.definition_en: small pieces of wood or other material used for starting a fire.
entries.example_cn: 我们收集了干树叶和引火物来生营火。
entries.example_en: We gathered dry leaves and kindling to start the campfire.

entries.definition_en: the act of setting something on fire.
entries.example_cn: 点燃营火只花了几分钟。
entries.example_en: The kindling of the campfire took only a few minutes.

entries.definition_en: showing sympathy, understanding, and generosity
entries.example_cn: 她是一位总是帮助邻居的仁慈的老妇人。
entries.example_en: She is a kindly old lady who always helps her neighbors.

entries.definition_cn: 温和宜人的；令人愉快的；有利的（过时）
entries.definition_en: pleasant, gentle, or favorable (dated)
entries.example_cn: 温和宜人的微风让散步变得很愉快。
entries.example_en: The kindly breeze made the walk pleasant.

entries.definition_en: in a kind manner or out of kindness
entries.example_cn: 他仁慈地主动帮我提沉重的包。
entries.example_en: He kindly offered to carry my heavy bag.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being warmhearted and considerate and humane and sympathetic
entries.example_cn: 她对陌生人的仁慈令人钦佩。
entries.example_en: Her kindness towards strangers is admirable.

entries.definition_en: an instance of kind or charitable behavior
entries.example_cn: 慈善机构感谢她向收容所捐赠毯子的善举。
entries.example_en: The charity thanked her for her kindness in donating blankets to the shelter.

entries.definition_en: a tendency to be kind and forgiving
entries.example_cn: 他的仁慈和宽恕的倾向常使他原谅他人。
entries.example_en: His kindness often leads him to forgive others.

entries.definition_en: a group of people who are related by blood or marriage
entries.example_cn: 这两个家族有着悠久的亲属关系。
entries.example_en: The two families have a long history of kindred ties.

entries.definition_en: similar in quality or character
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家在新学生身上找到了志同道合的人。
entries.example_en: The artist found a kindred spirit in the new student.

entries.definition_en: related by blood or marriage
entries.example_cn: 他们有血缘关系，尽管在不同国家长大。
entries.example_en: They are kindred by blood, although they grew up in different countries.

entries.definition_en: a collective term for domesticated cattle, regardless of sex or age
entries.example_cn: 那首古诗提到了在草地上吃草的牛群。
entries.example_en: The ancient poem mentions the kine grazing in the meadow.

entries.definition_en: the branch of mechanics that studies motion without considering the forces or masses involved
entries.example_cn: 教授用运动齿轮的图解来解释运动学原理。
entries.example_en: The professor explained the principles of kinematics using diagrams of moving gears.

entries.definition_en: an early television receiver tube that converts a received signal into a visible picture
entries.example_cn: 博物馆里那个旧的显像管仍然工作正常。
entries.example_en: The old kinescope in the museum was still working perfectly.

entries.definition_cn: 人体运动学；研究身体运动及其力学和解剖学的学科
entries.definition_en: the study of body movement, including its mechanics and anatomy
entries.example_cn: 人体运动学有助于解释运动时肌肉和骨骼如何协同工作。
entries.example_en: Kinesiology helps explain how muscles and bones work together during exercise.

entries.definition_en: a movement that occurs in response to a stimulus but is not directed toward the source of that stimulus
entries.example_cn: 潮虫在强光下移动得更快，表现出动性，而不是朝向光源移动。
entries.example_en: The woodlice moved more rapidly in bright light, demonstrating kinesis rather than movement toward the light.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to kinesthesis
entries.example_cn: 舞者依靠她的动觉感来保持完美的平衡。
entries.example_en: The dancer relied on her kinesthetic sense to maintain perfect balance.

entries.definition_en: relating to the motion of material bodies and the forces associated therewith
entries.example_cn: 行驶中的汽车的动能在停车时转化成了热能。
entries.example_en: The kinetic energy of the moving car was converted into heat when it stopped.

entries.definition_en: characterized by motion
entries.example_cn: 这座动态雕塑随着风移动并改变形状。
entries.example_en: The kinetic sculpture moved and changed shape with the wind.

entries.definition_en: supplying motive force
entries.example_cn: 下落的水的动能驱动了涡轮机。
entries.example_en: The kinetic energy of the falling water turns the turbine.

entries.definition_cn: 研究化学反应速率的化学分支
entries.definition_en: the branch of chemistry concerned with the rates of chemical reactions
entries.example_cn: 化学动力学帮助科学家了解反应进行得有多快。
entries.example_en: Chemical kinetics helps scientists understand how quickly a reaction will proceed.

entries.definition_en: the branch of physics that studies the forces causing motion
entries.example_cn: 教授向工程学生解释了动力学的原理。
entries.example_en: The professor explained the principles of kinetics to the engineering students.

entries.definition_en: a protein structure assembled on the centromere that links a chromosome to spindle microtubules during mitosis
entries.example_cn: 动粒在细胞分裂过程中对染色体的分离起着至关重要的作用。
entries.example_en: The kinetochore plays a crucial role in separating chromosomes during cell division.

entries.definition_en: members of one's family or clan, especially those descended from a common ancestor
entries.example_cn: 那座老房子迎来了来自三个不同世代的亲属。
entries.example_en: The old house was visited by the kinfolk from three different generations.

usage.label: 美国英语；可数或不可数
usage.pattern: kinfolk may be countable or uncountable

entries.definition_en: a male sovereign; ruler of a kingdom
entries.example_cn: 国王与邻国签署了条约。
entries.example_en: The king signed the treaty with the neighboring country.

entries.definition_en: in chess, the weakest but the most important piece
entries.example_cn: 王不能移动到被将军的位置。
entries.example_en: The king cannot move into check.

entries.definition_en: one of the four playing cards in a deck bearing the picture of a king
entries.example_cn: 他从牌堆里抽出了红桃K。
entries.example_en: He drew the king of hearts from the deck.

entries.definition_en: preeminence in a particular category or group or field
entries.example_cn: 她是该地区流行音乐的顶尖人物。
entries.example_en: She is the king of pop music in this region.

entries.definition_en: a male competitor who holds a preeminent position
entries.example_cn: 他是世界拳击界的顶尖选手。
entries.example_en: He is the king of boxing in the world.

entries.definition_en: a very wealthy or powerful businessperson
entries.example_cn: 他是科技界的大亨。
entries.example_en: He is a king in the technology industry.

entries.definition_en: a king consort; the husband of a reigning queen
entries.example_cn: 在某些君主制国家，在位女王的丈夫被称为王夫。
entries.example_en: In some monarchies, the husband of a reigning queen is called a king consort.

entries.definition_en: a checker that has been promoted to a piece that can move freely forward or backward
entries.example_cn: 这枚棋子到达对手的底线后升变为王棋。
entries.example_en: The checker reached the opponent's back row and was crowned a king.

entries.definition_en: extra large
entries.example_cn: 她为卧室买了一张特大号的床。
entries.example_en: She bought a king-size bed for her bedroom.

entries.definition_en: of a size larger than the standard size
entries.example_cn: 她为她的主卧室买了一张特大号床。
entries.example_en: She bought a king-sized bed for her master bedroom.

entries.definition_cn: 霸王鹟属的一种大型捕蝇鸟
entries.definition_en: a large flycatcher of the genus Tyrannus
entries.example_cn: 大霸鹟俯冲下来捕捉昆虫。
entries.example_en: The kingbird swooped down to catch the insect.

entries.definition_cn: 由国王或女王统治的国家或王国
entries.definition_en: a country or realm ruled by a king or queen
entries.example_cn: 她访问了泰国王国。
entries.example_en: She visited the kingdom of Thailand.

entries.definition_en: an area where something is the most important or dominant
entries.example_cn: 互联网已成为信息的王国。
entries.example_en: The internet has become a kingdom of information.

entries.definition_en: the territory ruled by a king or queen
entries.example_cn: 女王将她的领土扩张到了新的土地。
entries.example_en: The queen expanded her kingdom to include new lands.

entries.definition_en: a system of government where a king or queen is the head of state
entries.example_cn: 这个王国有着悠久的君主制历史。
entries.example_en: The kingdom has a long history of monarchy.

entries.definition_cn: 低于域、高于门的生物分类等级，包括动物界和植物界等
entries.definition_en: a taxonomic rank below domain and above phylum, including groups such as Animalia and Plantae
entries.example_cn: 人类属于动物界。
entries.example_en: Humans belong to the kingdom Animalia.

entries.definition_cn: 自然物的基本类别，尤指传统分类中的类别
entries.definition_en: a basic group of natural objects, especially in traditional classification
entries.example_cn: 传统自然哲学将世界分为动物界、植物界和矿物界。
entries.example_en: Traditional natural philosophy divided the world into the animal, vegetable, and mineral kingdoms.

entries.definition_cn: 美国大西洋沿岸捕获的几种鱼的瘦肉
entries.definition_en: the lean flesh of any of several fish caught off the Atlantic coast of the United States
entries.example_cn: 餐厅供应的王鱼非常新鲜，脂肪含量很低。
entries.example_en: The kingfish served at the restaurant was very fresh and lean.

entries.definition_cn: 美国大西洋沿岸温带海域的大型食用王鲭
entries.definition_en: a large edible mackerel found in temperate Atlantic waters off the United States
entries.example_cn: 渔民常在夏季沿海水域捕获这种鱼。
entries.example_en: Fishermen often catch kingfish in the coastal waters during summer.

entries.definition_cn: 加利福尼亚外海的小型银色白姑鱼
entries.definition_en: a small silvery marine fish found off California
entries.example_cn: 当地市场将这种鱼作为受欢迎的食用鱼出售。
entries.example_en: The local market sells kingfish as a popular food fish.

entries.definition_cn: 北美温暖大西洋水域原产的鼓鱼科食用和游钓鱼类
entries.definition_en: various food and game fishes of the drum family native to warm Atlantic waters of North America
entries.example_cn: 这种鱼因其顽强的搏斗精神而备受垂钓者青睐。
entries.example_en: Kingfish are prized by anglers for their fighting spirit.

entries.definition_cn: 澳大利亚和新西兰的大型黄尾鰤
entries.definition_en: a large game fish found in Australia and New Zealand
entries.example_cn: 这种鱼是经验丰富的渔夫们具有挑战性的捕获目标。
entries.example_en: The kingfish is a challenging catch for experienced fishermen.

entries.definition_en: a large-headed bird with a short tail and long sharp bill, usually crested and brightly colored, that feeds mostly on fish
entries.example_cn: 翠鸟俯冲入水捕捉一条鱼。
entries.example_en: The kingfisher dove into the water to catch a fish.

entries.definition_en: a small bird of the family Regulidae
entries.example_cn: 这只戴菊鸟在松树的树枝间穿梭。
entries.example_en: The kinglet flitted among the branches of the pine tree.

entries.definition_en: having the rank of a king or resembling a king
entries.example_cn: 那位君主王者般的举止令所有人钦佩。
entries.example_en: The kingly gesture of the monarch was admired by all.

entries.definition_cn: 能决定领导人或获胜者的人或团体
entries.definition_en: a person or group with enough influence to determine who becomes a leader or wins
entries.example_cn: 这个小党在选举中成为了决定谁能获胜的政治掮客。
entries.example_en: The small party became the kingmaker in the election, deciding which candidate would win.

entries.definition_en: the most important person in a group or organization
entries.example_cn: 犯罪组织的头目被捕了。
entries.example_en: The kingpin of the criminal organization was arrested.

entries.definition_cn: 转向主销；转向枢轴螺栓
entries.definition_en: the pivot or bolt around which a vehicle's steered wheels turn
entries.example_cn: 机械师拧紧转向节螺栓以解决转向问题。
entries.example_en: The mechanic tightened the kingpin to fix the steering issue.

entries.definition_en: the front pin in a set of bowling pins
entries.example_cn: 他先击倒了前桩，以获得更多分数。
entries.example_en: He knocked down the kingpin first to score more points.

entries.definition_en: the status, dignity, or official position of being a king
entries.example_cn: 这场仪式标志着他王权的开始。
entries.example_en: The ceremony marked the beginning of his kingship.

entries.definition_en: a nonvenomous snake native to North America that constricts its prey, often eating other snakes and small mammals
entries.example_cn: 王蛇以其能吞食毒蛇而自身不受伤害的能力而闻名。
entries.example_en: The kingsnake is known for its ability to eat venomous snakes without being harmed.

entries.definition_cn: 一种产自巴西、能产出优质家具木材的树木
entries.definition_en: a Brazilian tree that produces high-quality cabinet wood
entries.example_cn: 金檀木因其耐用性和外观而备受推崇。
entries.example_en: Kingwood is highly valued for its durability and appearance.

entries.definition_cn: 来自金檀树的带有紫色条纹的精美木材，常用于木工细工
entries.definition_en: a beautiful wood with violet streaks from the kingwood tree, used in cabinetwork
entries.example_cn: 这张古董桌是用优质的金檀木制成的。
entries.example_en: The antique table was made of fine kingwood.

entries.definition_en: a plant hormone that promotes cell division and delays leaf aging
entries.example_cn: 科学家正在研究这种植物激素以提高作物产量。
entries.example_en: Scientists are studying kinin to improve crop yields.

entries.definition_cn: 肌肉痉挛，尤指颈部或背部
entries.definition_en: a painful muscle spasm, especially in the neck or back
entries.example_cn: 他在睡了一个奇怪的姿势后醒来时脖子抽筋了。
entries.example_en: He woke up with a kink in his neck after sleeping in a strange position.

entries.definition_cn: 计划或操作中的困难或缺陷
entries.definition_en: a difficulty or flaw in a plan or operation
entries.example_cn: 我们在日程安排中遇到了一个导致发射延误的问题。
entries.example_en: We encountered a kink in the schedule that delayed the launch.

entries.definition_cn: 拉紧带环的线时形成的锐角弯曲
entries.definition_en: a sharp bend in a line produced when a line having a loop is pulled tight
entries.example_cn: 绳子在系在柱子上时形成了一个结。
entries.example_en: The rope formed a kink where it was tied to the post.

entries.definition_en: a person with unusual sexual tastes
entries.example_cn: 这个故事讲述了一个寻求非传统伴侣的人的生活。
entries.example_en: The story explores the life of a kink who seeks unconventional partners.

entries.definition_cn: 使某物形成急弯或扭结
entries.definition_en: to cause something to form a kink or twist
entries.example_cn: 安装工把软管弯得过急，使其形成了扭结。
entries.example_en: The installer kinked the hose by bending it too sharply.

entries.definition_en: to form a curl, curve, or kink
entries.example_cn: 电线在绕过拐角时弯曲了。
entries.example_en: The wire kinked as it was bent around the corner.

entries.definition_en: an eccentric idea
entries.example_cn: 这个计划基于经理从未解释过的一个古怪想法。
entries.example_en: The plan was based on a kink that the manager had never explained.

entries.definition_cn: 一种热带美洲的树栖食果哺乳动物，有长卷尾
entries.definition_en: an arboreal fruit-eating mammal of tropical America with a long prehensile tail
entries.example_cn: 这只食猴狸爬上香蕉树去摘熟透的果实。
entries.example_en: The kinkajou climbed the banana tree to reach the ripe fruit.

entries.definition_cn: 一种灰褐色的狐猴（Perodicticus potto）
entries.definition_en: a kind of gray-brown lemur (Perodicticus potto)
entries.example_cn: 在某些地区，术语“食猴狸”被用来指代一种特定的狐猴。
entries.example_en: In some regions, the term kinkajou is used to refer to a specific type of lemur.

entries.definition_en: having small, tight curls
entries.example_cn: 她留着卷曲的发型。
entries.example_en: She wore her hair in a kinky style.

entries.definition_en: very unusual or unconventional
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家的作品以其古怪和离奇的意象而闻名。
entries.example_en: The artist's work is known for its kinky and bizarre imagery.

entries.definition_cn: 带有非传统性偏好的；迎合非传统性偏好的
entries.definition_en: showing or appealing to unconventional sexual interests
entries.example_cn: 这部电影因其变态的内容而受到批评。
entries.example_en: The movie was criticized for its kinky content.

entries.definition_cn: kino（一种热带植物胶，用作收敛剂或鞣料）
entries.definition_en: a gum obtained from tropical plants, used as an astringent or in tanning
entries.example_cn: 制革工人使用 kino 来处理皮革。
entries.example_en: The tanner used kino to treat the leather.

entries.definition_cn: 东印度 kino 树，一种可产出树脂或提取物、常用于医疗和鞣制的树
entries.definition_en: an East Indian tree that yields a resin or extract, often used medicinally and in tanning
entries.example_cn: kino 树能产出用于医疗和鞣制的树脂。
entries.example_en: The kino tree yields a resin used medicinally and in tanning.

entries.definition_en: people who are descended from a common ancestor
entries.example_cn: 全家人聚集在一起庆祝亲属们的团聚。
entries.example_en: The entire family gathered to celebrate the reunion of the kinsfolk.

entries.definition_en: a close connection marked by community of interests or similarity in nature or character
entries.example_cn: 这两种文化之间存在深厚的亲缘关系。
entries.example_en: There is a strong kinship between the two cultures.

entries.definition_en: relatedness or connection by blood or marriage or adoption
entries.example_cn: 亲属关系的研究有助于我们理解家庭结构。
entries.example_en: The study of kinship helps us understand family structures.

entries.definition_en: a male relative
entries.example_cn: 他邀请了他的男性亲属参加家庭聚会。
entries.example_en: He invited his kinsman to the family reunion.

entries.definition_en: a female relative
entries.example_cn: 我的女性亲属从村里来探望我。
entries.example_en: My kinswoman arrived from the village to visit me.

entries.definition_cn: 小亭；售货亭；服务亭或自助服务终端
entries.definition_en: a small structure, often enclosed or with a service window, used as a booth or service point
entries.example_cn: 我们在入口附近的售票亭买了票。
entries.example_en: We bought our tickets from the ticket kiosk near the entrance.

entries.definition_en: a period of sleep
entries.example_cn: 在我们去机场之前，我需要小睡一会儿。
entries.example_en: I need a kip before we leave for the airport.

entries.definition_cn: （爱尔兰、英国，非正式）睡觉的地方，如房间、寄宿处或床铺。
entries.definition_en: (Ireland, UK, informal) A place to sleep, such as a room, boarding house, or bed.
entries.example_cn: 我们找到了一个便宜的地方过夜。
entries.example_en: We found a cheap kip for the night.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of currency in Laos
entries.example_cn: 这个纪念品的价格是五基普。
entries.example_en: The price of the souvenir was five kips.

entries.definition_cn: 体操中的引体摆动动作，通过摆腿和拱背从悬垂或低位摆至支撑姿势
entries.definition_en: a gymnastic exercise involving arching the back and swinging the legs
entries.example_cn: 体操运动员在高低杠上做了一个后摆腿动作。
entries.example_en: The gymnast performed a kip on the uneven bars.

entries.definition_en: to sleep
entries.example_cn: 洗完澡后，婴儿睡得香甜。
entries.example_en: The baby kipped soundly after the bath.

entries.definition_cn: 腌制并烟熏的鲱鱼或鲑鱼
entries.definition_en: a herring or salmon that has been split, salted, and smoked
entries.example_cn: 我们今天早上吃了腌鲱鱼。
entries.example_en: We had kippers for breakfast this morning.

entries.definition_en: a church in Scotland
entries.example_cn: 他们走上山去参观那座古老的教堂。
entries.example_en: They walked up the hill to visit the ancient kirk.

usage.label: Northern England, Scotland
usage.pattern: Source w08718r0 labels the noun regionally.

entries.definition_cn: 受洗锡克教徒必须佩戴的礼仪剑或匕首，是五K之一
entries.definition_en: a ceremonial sword or dagger that baptized Sikh men and women are required to wear as one of the five Ks
entries.example_cn: 基尔潘是受洗锡克教徒必须始终随身携带的五K之一。
entries.example_en: The kirpan is one of the five Ks that baptized Sikhs must carry at all times.

entries.definition_en: a clear brandy made from black cherries
entries.example_cn: 她倒了一杯黑樱桃利口酒来搭配甜点。
entries.example_en: She poured a glass of kirsch to accompany the dessert.

entries.definition_en: a woman's gown or outer skirt
entries.example_cn: 在文艺复兴时期，女性常将长裙作为外衣穿着。
entries.example_en: In the Renaissance, women often wore a kirtle as their outer garment.

entries.definition_en: a knee-length tunic
entries.example_cn: 这幅中世纪画作描绘了一位身穿盔甲和及膝短上衣的骑士。
entries.example_en: The medieval painting depicts a knight in armor wearing a kirtle.

entries.definition_en: fate or destiny, especially in Muslim usage
entries.example_cn: 她接受命运，将其视为真主意旨的一部分。
entries.example_en: She accepted her fate as part of her kismat.

entries.definition_en: fate; a predetermined or unavoidable destiny
entries.example_cn: 他们相信他们的婚姻是命中注定的。
entries.example_en: They believed their marriage was kismet.

entries.definition_en: to touch with the lips or press the lips (against someone's mouth or other body part) as an expression of love, greeting, etc.
entries.example_cn: 他亲吻女儿告别。
entries.example_en: He kissed his daughter goodbye.

entries.definition_en: to touch lightly or gently
entries.example_cn: 猫用爪子轻触了桌子顶部。
entries.example_en: The cat kissed the top of the table with its paw.

entries.definition_en: the act of caressing with the lips
entries.example_cn: 他们离开前分享了一个甜蜜的吻。
entries.example_en: They shared a sweet kiss before leaving.

entries.definition_en: a light glancing touch
entries.example_cn: 微风在她行走时轻抚她的脸庞。
entries.example_en: The breeze kissed her face as she walked.

entries.definition_en: a cookie made of egg whites and sugar
entries.example_cn: 她用彩色的糖珠装饰了蛋白糖。
entries.example_en: She decorated the kiss with colorful sprinkles.

entries.definition_en: any of several bite-sized candies
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在派对上吃了一颗糖果。
entries.example_en: The children ate a kiss during the party.

entries.definition_cn: 一种一年生植物，叶片宽卵形，花序细长下垂，呈深红色，原产于东南亚和澳大利亚
entries.definition_en: an annual plant with broadly ovate leaves and slender drooping spikes of crimson flowers, native to southeastern Asia and Australia
entries.example_cn: 春天，花园里开满了这种植物鲜艳的花。
entries.example_en: The garden is filled with the vibrant colors of the kiss-me-over-the-garden-gate in spring.

entries.definition_en: the human face
entries.example_cn: 别盯着他的脸看，看看他的眼睛。
entries.example_en: Don't look at his kisser, look at his eyes.

entries.definition_en: someone who kisses
entries.example_cn: 她很会接吻！
entries.example_en: She’s a great kisser!

entries.definition_en: the act of kissing or making out
entries.example_cn: 他们整个晚上都只是在沙发上接吻。
entries.example_en: They spent the evening just kissing on the sofa.

entries.definition_en: a case containing a set of articles
entries.example_cn: 他把工具装进了工具箱里。
entries.example_en: He packed his tools into a kit.

entries.definition_en: a set of articles or tools for a specific purpose
entries.example_cn: 他们为周末旅行买了一套露营装备。
entries.example_en: They bought a camping kit for the weekend trip.

entries.definition_en: the young of various fur-bearing animals
entries.example_cn: 母狐狸守护着她的幼崽。
entries.example_en: The vixen watched over her kits.

entries.definition_en: to supply someone with a set of articles or tools
entries.example_cn: 公司将为新员工配备笔记本电脑。
entries.example_en: The company will kit the new employees with laptops.

entries.definition_cn: 装衣物或装备的大袋子，常为圆柱形
entries.definition_en: a large bag, often cylindrical, for carrying clothing or equipment
entries.example_cn: 士兵在行军前将口粮和装备装进他的行军包。
entries.example_en: The soldier packed his kitbag with rations and equipment before the march.

entries.definition_en: a room used for preparing food
entries.example_cn: 厨房里充满了食物的香味。
entries.example_en: The smell of cooking filled the kitchen.

entries.definition_en: a small kitchen, typically found in an apartment or hotel room
entries.example_cn: 这间单身公寓带有一个配有微波炉和迷你冰箱的小厨房。
entries.example_en: The studio apartment included a kitchenette with a microwave and mini-fridge.

entries.definition_en: utensils and equipment used in a kitchen
entries.example_cn: 她买了新的厨具来替换旧锅和煎锅。
entries.example_en: She bought new kitchenware to replace the old pots and pans.

entries.definition_en: a light frame covered with paper flown in the wind
entries.example_cn: 孩子们下午在公园里放风筝。
entries.example_en: The children spent the afternoon flying a kite in the park.

entries.definition_en: a bird of prey of the family Accipitridae
entries.example_cn: 一对鸢在悬崖上筑了巢。
entries.example_en: A pair of kites built a nest on the cliff.

entries.definition_cn: 利用银行间结算时间差从资金不足的账户开出的支票
entries.definition_en: a check drawn on an account with insufficient funds, used to exploit the float between banks
entries.example_cn: 骗子利用这种空头支票在支票兑现前取得资金。
entries.example_en: The fraudster used a kite to obtain funds before the check cleared.

entries.definition_en: to fly a kite
entries.example_cn: 他们去海滩在风大的日子放风筝。
entries.example_en: They went to the beach to kite on a windy day.

entries.definition_cn: 利用空头支票获取资金
entries.definition_en: to get credit or money by using a bad check
entries.example_cn: 该公司试图利用空头支票来弥补亏损。
entries.example_en: The company tried to kite money to cover their losses.

entries.definition_en: to fraudulently increase the amount on a check
entries.example_cn: 他因篡改支票金额以窃取资金而被捕。
entries.example_en: He was arrested for kiting a check to steal funds.

entries.definition_cn: 为提高票面金额而被欺诈性篡改的支票
entries.definition_en: a bank check fraudulently altered to increase its face value
entries.example_cn: 骗子利用一张空头支票从受害人的账户中提取了资金。
entries.example_en: The fraudster used a kite to withdraw money from the victim's account.

entries.definition_en: to soar or fly like a kite
entries.example_cn: 那只鸟像风筝一样在高空中飞翔。
entries.example_en: The bird kited high above the clouds.

entries.definition_en: one's friends and acquaintances (archaic, obsolete)
entries.example_cn: 多年旅居国外后，他回到了老朋友和亲人身边。
entries.example_en: He returned to his old kith and kin after many years abroad.

entries.definition_en: art that is excessively bright, sentimental, or showy and is generally considered to be in bad taste
entries.example_cn: 博物馆的新展览因包含过多庸俗艺术品而受到批评。
entries.example_en: The museum's new exhibit was criticized for featuring too much kitsch.

entries.definition_en: effusively or insincerely emotional
entries.example_cn: 这部电影太矫揉造作，不值得认真对待。
entries.example_en: The movie was too kitschy to be taken seriously.

entries.definition_en: a young domestic cat
entries.example_cn: 小猫在玩一团毛线球。
entries.example_en: The kitten played with a ball of yarn.

entries.definition_cn: 幼兔、幼鼠、幼刺猬、幼松鼠、幼狐、幼河狸、幼獾等动物的幼崽
entries.definition_en: a young rabbit, rat, hedgehog, squirrel, fox, beaver, badger, or similar animal
entries.example_cn: 兔宝宝被称为 kittens 或 kits。
entries.example_en: Rabbit babies are called kittens or kits.

entries.definition_en: to give birth to kittens
entries.example_cn: 母猫将在春天产仔。
entries.example_en: The queen cat will kitten in the spring.

entries.definition_cn: 具有小猫般顽皮活泼的；有时带有挑逗意味的
entries.definition_en: having the qualities or likeness of a kitten; playful and sometimes sexually coquettish
entries.example_cn: 那个像小猫一样顽皮的孩子在花园里追逐蝴蝶。
entries.example_en: The kittenish child ran around the garden chasing butterflies.

entries.definition_en: a small pearl-grey gull of northern regions that nests on cliffs and has a rudimentary hind toe
entries.example_cn: 三趾鸥在高高的悬崖边缘筑巢。
entries.example_en: The kittiwake nested on the high cliff edge.

entries.definition_en: a young domestic cat
entries.example_cn: 邻居的小猫正在花园里玩耍。
entries.example_en: The neighbor's little kitty is playing in the garden.

entries.definition_cn: 游戏（如扑克）中的累计资金
entries.definition_en: the cumulative amount of money involved in a game like poker
entries.example_cn: 他们决定为下一轮下注开始一个新的资金池。
entries.example_en: They decided to start a new kitty for the next round of betting.

entries.definition_en: the total amount of money bet by all players in a game
entries.example_cn: 扑克锦标赛的赢家拿走了所有的赌注总额。
entries.example_en: The winner of the poker tournament took the entire kitty.

entries.definition_en: informal terms referring to a domestic cat
entries.example_cn: 我的小猫正睡在沙发上。
entries.example_en: My kitty is sleeping on the sofa.

entries.definition_en: An informal or childish term for a domestic cat.
entries.example_cn: 那只小猫整个上午都睡在窗台上。
entries.example_en: The kitty-cat slept on the windowsill all morning.

entries.definition_cn: （主要用于北美）斜对面的；对角的，尤指隔着十字路口的
entries.definition_en: chiefly North American: located diagonally opposite, especially across an intersection
entries.example_cn: 这两栋斜对面的建筑隔着十字路口相望。
entries.example_en: The kitty-corner buildings face each other across the intersection.

entries.definition_en: positioned diagonally opposite, especially at opposite corners
entries.example_cn: 这两栋建筑彼此斜向相对。
entries.example_en: The two buildings are kitty-cornered to each other.

entries.definition_cn: 电喇叭；响亮的电动警报器
entries.definition_en: a loud electric alarm or horn, especially one formerly used in automobiles
entries.example_cn: 那辆旧救护车仍然使用汽笛来示意其到达。
entries.example_en: The old ambulance still used a klaxon to signal its arrival.

entries.definition_en: a genus of nonmotile rod-shaped Gram-negative bacteria that can cause respiratory and other infections
entries.example_cn: 克雷伯菌是医院获得性肺炎的常见原因。
entries.example_en: Klebsiella is a common cause of hospital-acquired pneumonia.

entries.definition_en: an uncontrollable urge to steal things without needing them
entries.example_cn: 该患者被诊断为有盗窃癖。
entries.example_en: The patient was diagnosed with kleptomania.

entries.definition_en: a person who has an uncontrollable urge to steal things without needing money
entries.example_cn: 这位偷窃癖患者不断从商店里拿走小物品。
entries.example_en: The kleptomaniac kept taking small items from the store.

entries.definition_en: a unit of length equal to one thousand meters
entries.example_cn: 坦克被部署在战线后方三公里处。
entries.example_en: The tank was positioned three klicks behind the front line.

entries.definition_cn: 公里每小时，通常用复数形式的俚语速度单位
entries.definition_en: kilometres per hour, usually used in the plural as a slang speed measurement
entries.example_cn: 司机在高速公路上以每小时六十公里的速度行驶。
entries.example_en: The driver was doing sixty klicks on the highway.

entries.definition_en: a card game where you build sequences of alternating colors on piles and then build sequences in suit from ace to king
entries.example_cn: 她花了一下午时间在平板电脑上玩纸牌游戏。
entries.example_en: She spent the afternoon playing klondike on her tablet.

entries.definition_cn: 为解决问题而临时拼凑的、通常粗糙但有效的装置、软件方案或做法
entries.definition_en: an improvised, often crude but effective device, software solution, or practice used to solve a problem
entries.example_cn: 程序员不得不使用一个笨拙的拼凑物，才能让旧系统与新的软件兼容。
entries.example_en: The programmer had to use a kludge to make the old system work with the new software.

entries.definition_en: a clumsy and foolish person
entries.example_cn: 他是个十足的笨蛋，把咖啡洒了一地。
entries.example_en: He is such a klutz that he dropped his coffee on the floor.

entries.definition_en: an electron tube used to generate or amplify microwave radiation through velocity modulation.
entries.example_cn: 雷达系统依赖速调管来放大信号，以实现远距离探测。
entries.example_en: The radar system relies on a klystron to amplify the signal for long-distance detection.

entries.definition_en: a metric unit of length equal to 1000 meters
entries.example_cn: 从北京到上海的距离大约是 1,300 千米。
entries.example_en: The distance from Beijing to Shanghai is about 1,300 km.

entries.definition_cn: 特殊的技能或本领；诀窍
entries.definition_en: a special skill or ability, especially in doing something well
entries.example_cn: 她擅长修理坏掉的东西。
entries.example_en: She has a knack for fixing broken things.

entries.definition_cn: 屠宰废马者；马匹屠宰商
entries.definition_en: someone who buys up old horses for slaughter
entries.example_cn: 马匹屠宰商一大早就来把退役的赛马运走。
entries.example_en: The knacker arrived early in the morning to collect the retired racehorse.

entries.definition_en: someone who buys old buildings or ships and breaks them up to recover materials
entries.example_cn: 那座旧工厂被卖给了一位拆房商，他计划将其拆解以回收废金属。
entries.example_en: The old factory was sold to a knacker who planned to strip it for scrap metal.

entries.definition_en: extremely exhausted
entries.example_cn: 徒步登山后，我精疲力竭。
entries.example_en: After hiking up the mountain, I was absolutely knackered.

entries.definition_en: to hit something sharply and suddenly
entries.example_cn: 锤子猛击石头，发出刺耳的响声。
entries.example_en: The hammer knapped the stone, sending a sharp crack through the air.

entries.definition_cn: 从易碎材料（尤其是石头）上敲下薄片，通常用于形成锋利的边缘或尖端
entries.definition_en: to break away flakes from a brittle material, especially stone, often to form a sharp edge or point
entries.example_cn: 打制者从燧石岩芯上敲下薄片，制成一件锋利的工具。
entries.example_en: The knapper knapped a flint core to make a sharp-edged tool.

entries.definition_en: a bag with a strap worn on the back or shoulder, used for carrying items
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行者在开始攀登前将水和零食装进了他的背包。
entries.example_en: The hiker packed his water and snacks into his knapsack before starting the climb.

entries.definition_cn: 矢车菊属的多种植物，花朵似蓟，常为紫色
entries.definition_en: any of various plants of the genus Centaurea having purple thistlelike flowers
entries.example_cn: 夏末，田野里开满了紫色的矢车菊属植物。
entries.example_en: The meadow was filled with purple knapweed in late summer.

entries.definition_en: a dishonest and untrustworthy person
entries.example_cn: 那位老人被一个冒充医生的骗子骗了。
entries.example_en: The old man was tricked by a knave who pretended to be a doctor.

entries.definition_cn: 印有年轻王子图案的扑克牌
entries.definition_en: a face card in a deck of cards showing a young prince
entries.example_cn: 在这款游戏中，红桃侍从是最大的牌。
entries.example_en: In the game, the knave of hearts was the highest card.

entries.definition_en: dishonest behavior such as lying, cheating, or stealing
entries.example_cn: 侦探正在寻找该商业交易中欺诈行为的证据。
entries.example_en: The detective was looking for evidence of knavery in the business deal.

entries.definition_en: marked by skill in deception
entries.example_cn: 那个狡诈的商人欺骗游客购买了价格虚高的纪念品。
entries.example_en: The knavish merchant tricked the tourists into buying overpriced souvenirs.

entries.definition_en: to mix ingredients into a homogeneous mass
entries.example_cn: 她把面团揉得光滑为止。
entries.example_en: She kneaded the dough until it became smooth.

entries.definition_en: to manually manipulate someone's body for medicinal or relaxation purposes
entries.example_cn: 他按摩她的肩膀以缓解她的紧张。
entries.example_en: He kneaded her shoulders to relieve her tension.

entries.definition_en: the joint in the human leg connecting the thigh and lower leg
entries.example_cn: 他踢足球时伤了膝盖。
entries.example_en: He hurt his knee while playing football.

entries.definition_en: the part of a trouser leg covering the knee joint
entries.example_cn: 他裤子膝盖处的布料破了。
entries.example_en: The fabric on the knee of his trousers was torn.

entries.definition_cn: （四足动物腿部的）膝样关节；尤指相当于人类膝关节的后肢关节
entries.definition_en: a joint in the leg of a four-legged animal, especially the hind-leg joint corresponding to the human knee
entries.example_cn: 那只狗的膝关节在事故中受伤了。
entries.example_en: The dog's knee was injured in the accident.

entries.definition_en: up to the knees
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在泥地里及膝地玩耍。
entries.example_en: The children played knee-deep in the mud.

entries.definition_en: reaching up to the knees
entries.example_cn: 洪水淹没了街道，水深及膝。
entries.example_en: The water was knee-deep in the flooded street.

entries.definition_cn: 及膝或略高于膝盖的短袜或长袜
entries.definition_en: a sock or stocking reaching to or slightly above the knee
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一双及膝袜搭配靴子。
entries.example_en: She wore a pair of knee-highs with her boots.

entries.definition_en: up to the knees
entries.example_cn: 暴风雨中水位涨到了膝盖。
entries.example_en: The water rose knee-high during the storm.

entries.definition_en: having a length that reaches the knee
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一条及膝裙去参加聚会。
entries.example_en: She wore a knee-length skirt to the party.

entries.definition_en: the patella, a small flat triangular bone located in front of the knee joint that protects it
entries.example_cn: 运动员在比赛中膝盖骨严重受伤。
entries.example_en: The athlete suffered a severe injury to his kneecap during the match.

entries.definition_cn: 过度且不必要地损害或削弱某人或某事物；使某人遭受重创
entries.definition_en: to damage or weaken someone or something excessively and needlessly; to cut someone off at the knees
entries.example_cn: 预算突然削减，使该项目还没来得及证明自身价值就遭受了重创。
entries.example_en: The sudden budget cuts kneecapped the program before it could prove its value.

entries.definition_en: to shoot someone in the kneecap, often as a warning by terrorist groups
entries.example_cn: 该组织被指控射伤敌对帮派成员以发出警告。
entries.example_en: The group was accused of kneecapping rival gang members to send a message.

entries.definition_en: to rest one's weight on one's knees
entries.example_cn: 她跪下来系鞋带。
entries.example_en: She knelt down to tie her shoelaces.

entries.definition_en: the position of supporting yourself on your knees
entries.example_cn: 他在仪式中处于跪姿。
entries.example_en: He was in a kneeling position during the ceremony.

entries.definition_en: a board or cushion for someone to kneel on
entries.example_cn: 她在冰冷的石地板上放了一个柔软的跪垫。
entries.example_en: She placed a soft kneeler on the cold stone floor.

entries.definition_en: a person who is kneeling
entries.example_cn: 得知终于可以站起来后，那些跪着的人都松了一口气。
entries.example_en: The kneelers sighed with relief when they were told they could finally stand up.

entries.definition_en: supporting yourself on your knees
entries.example_cn: 这座雕像描绘了一个跪着祈祷的人物。
entries.example_en: The statue depicts a figure in kneeling prayer.

entries.definition_en: the sound of a bell rung slowly to announce a death or a funeral or the end of something
entries.example_cn: 教堂的塔楼为阵亡士兵敲响了丧钟。
entries.example_en: The church tower rang out the knell for the fallen soldier.

entries.definition_en: ring as in announcing death
entries.example_cn: 钟声为老国王鸣响，以示其逝世。
entries.example_en: The bell knelled for the old king.

entries.definition_en: make (bells) ring, often for the purposes of musical edification
entries.example_cn: 僧侣们敲响钟声以标记时辰。
entries.example_en: The monks knelled the bells to mark the hour.

entries.definition_en: baggy trousers ending at or just below the knee, especially men's or boys' trousers
entries.example_cn: 他穿着灯笼裤和一顶平顶帽去郊游。
entries.example_en: He wore knickerbockers and a flat cap for his country walk.

entries.definition_cn: 【美国口语，罕见，复数专用】膝部收拢或系紧的宽松裤子；灯笼裤
entries.definition_en: [US, colloquial, rare, plural-only] loose trousers gathered or fastened at the knee
entries.example_cn: 男孩们穿着膝部收拢的灯笼裤参加学校典礼。
entries.example_en: The boys wore knickers gathered at the knee for the school ceremony.

entries.definition_en: underpants worn by women
entries.example_cn: 我需要在周末旅行前买一些新的女式内裤。
entries.example_en: I need to buy some new knickers before the weekend trip.

entries.definition_en: a small, inexpensive, mass-produced decorative object
entries.example_cn: 她买了一个色彩鲜艳的小摆设来装饰她的新架子。
entries.example_en: She bought a colorful knickknack to decorate her new shelf.

entries.definition_en: a collection of miscellaneous curios or trinkets
entries.example_cn: 这家店里摆满了来自世界各地的奇珍异宝。
entries.example_en: The shop was filled with strange knickknacks from around the world.

entries.definition_cn: 带有尖刃和锋利边缘的切割工具
entries.definition_en: a tool with a pointed blade and sharp edge used for cutting
entries.example_cn: 请用刀切面包。
entries.example_en: Please use the knife to cut the bread.

entries.definition_cn: 由手柄和锋利尖刃组成的武器
entries.definition_en: a weapon consisting of a handle and a sharp pointed blade
entries.example_cn: 侦探在嫌疑人的口袋里发现了一把刀。
entries.example_en: The detective found a knife in the suspect's pocket.

entries.definition_cn: 工具或机器中用于切割的刀片状部件
entries.definition_en: a blade-like part of a tool or machine used for cutting
entries.example_cn: 这台机器的刀片将材料切成条状。
entries.example_en: The machine's knife cuts the material into strips.

entries.definition_en: to cut something using a knife
entries.example_cn: 他把鸡肉用刀切成小块。
entries.example_en: He knifed the chicken into small pieces.

entries.definition_cn: 岌岌可危的局面或平衡
entries.definition_en: a precarious situation or balance that can be upset by a small change
entries.example_cn: 这支球队在赢得和输掉冠军之间处于微妙的界限上。
entries.example_en: The team is on a knife-edge between winning and losing the championship.

entries.definition_en: the handle or grip of a knife
entries.example_cn: 刀柄上装饰着银饰。
entries.example_en: The knife-handle was decorated with silver.

entries.definition_en: originally a person of noble birth trained to arms and chivalry; today in Great Britain a person honored by the sovereign for personal merit
entries.example_cn: 他因勇敢被授予骑士称号。
entries.example_en: He was awarded the title of knight for his bravery.

entries.definition_en: a chessman shaped to resemble the head of a horse; can move two squares horizontally and one vertically (or vice versa)
entries.example_cn: 马可以跳过其他棋子到达目的地。
entries.example_en: The knight can jump over other pieces to reach its destination.

entries.definition_en: raise (someone) to knighthood
entries.example_cn: 女王因他对医学的贡献而封这位科学家为爵士。
entries.example_en: The Queen knighted the scientist for his contributions to medicine.

entries.definition_en: a wandering knight travelling in search of adventure
entries.example_cn: 这个故事讲述了一位勇敢的游侠骑士寻求荣耀的经历。
entries.example_en: The story follows a brave knight-errant seeking glory.

entries.definition_en: the collective body or rank of knights
entries.example_cn: 骑士阶层聚集起来欢迎新授勋的骑士。
entries.example_en: The knighthood gathered to welcome the newly appointed knights.

entries.definition_cn: 骑士般的；彬彬有礼的；英勇而殷勤的
entries.definition_en: befitting a knight; chivalrous, courteous, or gallant
entries.example_cn: 他的骑士般行为包括为女士开门并让座。
entries.example_en: His knightly behavior included opening doors and offering his seat to ladies.

entries.definition_en: characteristic of the time of chivalry and knighthood in the Middle Ages
entries.example_cn: 骑士时代的荣誉准则指导着他整个锦标赛期间的行为。
entries.example_en: The knightly code of honor guided his actions throughout the tournament.

entries.definition_en: a baked or fried turnover filled with potato, meat, or cheese
entries.example_cn: 早餐我吃了一个热腾腾的土豆洋葱馅肉饼。
entries.example_en: For breakfast, I ate a hot knish filled with potato and onions.

entries.definition_en: to make textiles by interlacing yarn with needles
entries.example_cn: 我祖母喜欢给孙子孙女编织围巾。
entries.example_en: My grandmother loves to knit scarves for her grandchildren.

entries.definition_en: to tie or link things together tightly
entries.example_cn: 这两条路连接在一起形成了一条高速公路。
entries.example_en: The two roads knit together to form a highway.

entries.definition_en: to draw together or contract into wrinkles
entries.example_cn: 她专注地皱起了眉头。
entries.example_en: She knitted her brow in concentration.

entries.definition_en: a fabric made by interlacing yarn with needles
entries.example_cn: 冬天她穿了一件温暖的针织毛衣。
entries.example_en: She wore a warm knit sweater in winter.

entries.definition_en: the craft of making fabric by interlacing yarn with needles
entries.example_cn: 编织是一种古老的艺术形式。
entries.example_en: Knit is an ancient art form.

entries.definition_en: a basic stitch made by inserting the needle through the front of the loop
entries.example_cn: 这个图案只使用下针。
entries.example_en: The pattern uses only knit stitches.

entries.definition_en: made by intertwining threads in loops rather than weaving
entries.example_cn: 她在寒冷的早晨穿了一件温暖的针织毛衣。
entries.example_en: She wore a warm, knitted sweater on the chilly morning.

entries.definition_en: a person or machine that makes garments or fabrics by intertwining yarn or thread
entries.example_cn: 当地的编织者用羊毛织出了一件漂亮的毛衣。
entries.example_en: The local knitter created a beautiful sweater from wool.

entries.definition_en: needlework created by interlacing yarn in a series of connected loops using straight eyeless needles or by machine
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一件由精细针织品制成的舒适毛衣。
entries.example_en: She wore a cozy sweater made of fine knitting.

entries.definition_en: creating knitted wear
entries.example_cn: 祖母喜欢在晚上编织。
entries.example_en: Grandmother enjoys knitting in the evenings.

entries.definition_en: clothing made by knitting
entries.example_cn: 她买了一件新毛衣和一些针织衣物过冬。
entries.example_en: She bought a new sweater and some knitwear for the winter.

entries.definition_en: a round, rounded projection on a surface
entries.example_cn: 肉表面可见一个小脂肪突起。
entries.example_en: A small knob of fat was visible on the surface of the meat.

entries.definition_en: a round handle used to open or close something
entries.example_cn: 她转动门上的旋钮让自己进去。
entries.example_en: She turned the knob on the door to let herself in.

entries.definition_en: a thickened enlargement of a part of a plant or body
entries.example_cn: 园丁注意到老橡树上长出了一个奇怪的膨大物。
entries.example_en: The gardener noticed a strange knob growing on the old oak tree.

entries.definition_en: an ornamental ball on the hilt of a weapon
entries.example_cn: 这把古董匕首的剑柄顶部有一个金色的饰球。
entries.example_en: The antique dagger featured a gold knob at the top of its hilt.

entries.definition_cn: 有一个或多个疙瘩或突起的
entries.definition_en: having one or more knobs or knoblike projections
entries.example_cn: 那棵老橡树的树干上长满了大疙瘩。
entries.example_en: The old oak tree was knobbed with large knots on its trunk.

entries.definition_en: having knobs or bumps on the surface
entries.example_cn: 那张旧木桌因长期使用而表面凹凸不平。
entries.example_en: The old wooden table was knobbly from years of use.

entries.definition_en: having knobs or protuberances
entries.example_cn: 那张旧木桌的表面凹凸不平。
entries.example_en: The old wooden table had a knobby surface.

entries.definition_en: to make a sharp sound by tapping with your knuckles
entries.example_cn: 她叩击桌子以引起大家的注意。
entries.example_en: She knocked on the table to get everyone's attention.

entries.definition_en: to hit something sharply with your hand or another object
entries.example_cn: 他把球从球员手中猛击出去。
entries.example_en: He knocked the ball out of the player's hands.

entries.definition_en: to hit something hard and forcefully
entries.example_cn: 汽车在事故中猛烈撞击了墙壁。
entries.example_en: The car knocked against the wall during the accident.

entries.definition_en: the sound made when hitting something repeatedly, such as on a door
entries.example_cn: 我听到前门传来一阵响亮的敲门声。
entries.example_en: I heard a loud knock on the front door.

entries.definition_en: a strong and sudden blow
entries.example_cn: 拳击手重重地击打对手的下巴。
entries.example_en: The boxer landed a powerful knock on his opponent's jaw.

entries.definition_en: harsh or unfair criticism of someone's work or ideas
entries.example_cn: 这部电影受到了评论家们的大量批评。
entries.example_en: The movie received a lot of knocks from critics.

entries.definition_en: an unpleasant or difficult experience
entries.example_cn: 失去冠军对这支球队来说是一次真正的打击。
entries.example_en: Losing the championship was a real knock for the team.

entries.definition_en: to tap lightly and repeatedly on a surface
entries.example_cn: 如果需要帮助，请轻轻敲击玻璃。
entries.example_en: Please knock gently on the glass if you need help.

entries.definition_en: extremely violent
entries.example_cn: 那场打斗是一场极其暴力的群殴。
entries.example_en: The fight was a knock-down-and-drag-out brawl.

entries.definition_en: a condition in which the knees turn inward when standing
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了孩子的膝外翻情况。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined the child's knock-knee.

entries.definition_en: having the knees abnormally close together and the ankles wide apart
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了这位膝外翻的孩子，以查看是否有潜在问题。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined the knock-kneed child to check for underlying issues.

entries.definition_en: full of rough and exuberant animal spirits
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在花园里玩了一场粗犷激烈的游戏。
entries.example_en: The children played a knockabout game in the garden.

entries.definition_en: suitable for rough use
entries.example_cn: 我们需要一顶适合在山区露营的耐用帐篷。
entries.example_en: We need a knockabout tent for camping in the mountains.

entries.definition_en: a type of small sailing boat with a simple rig and no bowsprit
entries.example_cn: 他们乘坐一艘坚固的无前桅小帆船横渡海湾。
entries.example_en: They sailed across the bay in a sturdy knockabout.

entries.definition_en: a blow that knocks the opponent off their feet
entries.example_cn: 拳击手在第三回合击倒了对手。
entries.example_en: The boxer landed a powerful knockdown in the third round.

entries.definition_en: (furniture) easily assembled and dismantled
entries.example_cn: 我们买了一张拆装式桌子，因为它很容易运输。
entries.example_en: We bought a knockdown table because it was easy to transport.

entries.definition_en: a device attached to a door to knock on it
entries.example_cn: 她把黄铜门环擦得闪闪发光。
entries.example_en: She polished the brass knocker until it shone.

entries.definition_en: a person who knocks, especially on a door
entries.example_cn: 一个大声敲门的人吵醒了屋里所有人。
entries.example_en: A loud knocker woke everyone in the house.

entries.definition_cn: （尤指女性的）乳房（俚语，常用复数）
entries.definition_en: a woman's breast, especially in the plural
entries.example_cn: 长跑后，她的乳房有些酸痛。
entries.example_en: Her knockers were sore after the long run.

usage.label: slang; usually plural
usage.pattern: w27046r4 supports the breast sense and its plural-normally slang usage.

entries.definition_en: a person who criticizes or belittles something
entries.example_cn: 别让那个贬低者阻止你追求艺术。
entries.example_en: Don't let the knocker discourage you from pursuing your art.

entries.definition_en: a person who is arrogant and acts as if they are very important
entries.example_cn: 他是个自大狂，拒绝听取任何建议。
entries.example_en: He is such a knocker that he refuses to listen to any advice.

entries.definition_cn: 敲击的动作或声音，包括发动机反复发出的敲击声
entries.definition_en: an act of knocking or the sound produced by knocking, including a repetitive engine sound
entries.example_cn: 前门传来一阵剧烈的敲门声。
entries.example_en: There was a loud knocking at the front door.

entries.definition_en: an illegal copy of a famous brand or product
entries.example_cn: 警方从市场上查获了几个仿冒手袋。
entries.example_en: The police seized several knockoff handbags from the market.

entries.definition_en: so forceful as to render someone unconscious
entries.example_cn: 这记强有力的重拳瞬间结束了比赛。
entries.example_en: The knockout punch ended the fight instantly.

entries.definition_en: a very attractive or seductive looking woman
entries.example_cn: 她是当晚的绝色美女。
entries.example_en: She was the knockout of the evening.

entries.definition_en: a blow that renders the opponent unconscious
entries.example_cn: 他在第三回合打出了一记击倒拳。
entries.example_en: He landed a knockout in the third round.

entries.definition_en: a small natural hill
entries.example_cn: 我们坐在俯瞰山谷的草坡上。
entries.example_en: We sat on the grassy knoll overlooking the valley.

entries.definition_en: a fastening made by looping and tying a rope or cord
entries.example_cn: 他在丝带末端打了一个蝴蝶结。
entries.example_en: He tied a bow knot at the end of the ribbon.

entries.definition_en: a tight, painful lump or swelling, especially in a muscle
entries.example_cn: 他揉了揉脖子上的肌肉硬结，以缓解疼痛。
entries.example_en: He rubbed the knot in his neck to relieve the pain.

entries.definition_en: a hard, round piece of wood in a board where a branch once grew
entries.example_cn: 木匠不得不把橡木桌上的木节切掉。
entries.example_en: The carpenter had to cut out the knot in the oak table.

entries.definition_en: a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour
entries.example_cn: 这艘船正以二十节的速度航行。
entries.example_en: The ship was traveling at twenty knots.

entries.definition_en: a tight cluster of people or things
entries.example_cn: 一群人聚集在报摊周围。
entries.example_en: A knot of people gathered around the newsstand.

entries.definition_en: to tie something into a knot
entries.example_cn: 离开前请系紧鞋带。
entries.example_en: Please knot the shoelaces tightly before you leave.

entries.definition_en: to form wrinkles in the forehead, especially as a sign of concentration or concern
entries.example_cn: 她解谜时专注地皱起了眉头。
entries.example_en: She knotted her brow in concentration while solving the puzzle.

entries.definition_en: to make something complicated or tangled
entries.example_cn: 说明将这项简单的任务搞得错综复杂。
entries.example_en: The instructions knotted the simple task into a confusing mess.

entries.definition_en: a low-growing weedy grass that has spikelets along its leaf stems
entries.example_cn: 花园在夏天被结缕草侵占了。
entries.example_en: The garden was overrun by knotgrass during the summer.

entries.definition_en: a hole in a piece of wood where a knot has been removed
entries.example_cn: 木匠在油漆桌子之前必须填补那个节疤孔。
entries.example_en: The carpenter had to fill the knothole before painting the table.

entries.definition_en: youth league baseball, especially in Cincinnati
entries.example_cn: 他的父亲在辛辛那提执教一支青少年联盟棒球队。
entries.example_en: His father coached a knothole team in Cincinnati.

entries.definition_en: tied with a knot
entries.example_cn: 绳子被紧紧地打结以固定货物。
entries.example_en: The rope was knotted tightly to secure the load.

entries.definition_en: covered with knobs or knots, often used of old persons or trees
entries.example_cn: 那棵老橡树的树干布满疙瘩，长满了苔藓。
entries.example_en: The old oak tree had a knotted trunk covered in moss.

entries.definition_en: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe
entries.example_cn: 侦探面临着一个棘手的难题，无人能解。
entries.example_en: The detective faced a knotty problem that no one could solve.

entries.definition_cn: 极其复杂或错综复杂的
entries.definition_en: highly complex or intricate and occasionally devious
entries.example_cn: 这部小说的情节错综复杂，充满了意想不到的转折。
entries.example_en: The plot of the novel was knotty and full of unexpected twists.

entries.definition_en: full of knots or snarls
entries.example_cn: 这根打满结的绳子很难解开。
entries.example_en: The knotty rope was difficult to untie.

entries.definition_en: covered with knobs or knots; used of old persons or old trees
entries.example_cn: 那棵老橡树的树干布满疙瘩，长满了苔藓。
entries.example_en: The old oak tree had a knotty trunk covered in moss.

entries.definition_cn: 多股鞭，尤指沙皇俄国时期用于鞭打的鞭子
entries.definition_en: a multi-tailed whip, especially one historically used for flogging in imperial Russia
entries.example_cn: 守卫们携带俄国式多股鞭，以在囚犯中维持纪律。
entries.example_en: The guards carried knouts to enforce discipline among the prisoners.

entries.definition_en: to flog or beat with a knout
entries.example_cn: 囚犯受到威胁，如果反抗就会被多股鞭鞭打。
entries.example_en: The prisoners were threatened with being knouted if they resisted.

entries.definition_en: to be aware of a fact or have information about something
entries.example_cn: 我知道你明天要来。
entries.example_en: I know that you are coming tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: to be familiar with a person or thing
entries.example_cn: 我很熟悉这位经理。
entries.example_en: I know the manager very well.

entries.definition_en: to have the skill to do something
entries.example_cn: 你会开车吗？
entries.example_en: Do you know how to drive a car?

entries.definition_en: to experience a feeling or situation directly
entries.example_cn: 只有亲身经历过的人才知道那种痛苦。
entries.example_en: Only those who have been there know the pain.

entries.definition_en: to remember something clearly
entries.example_cn: 把这个地址牢牢记住。
entries.example_en: Know this address by heart.

entries.definition_cn: 知识；知情（主要用于短语 in the know）
entries.definition_en: knowledge; the state of knowing, chiefly in the fixed phrase in the know
entries.example_cn: 只有少数人知道这起合并的内情。
entries.example_en: Only a few people are in the know about the merger.

entries.definition_en: to accept someone's claim or authority
entries.example_cn: 人们承认国王是他们的领袖。
entries.example_en: The people know the king to be their leader.

entries.definition_cn: 与某人发生性关系（古旧的委婉说法）
entries.definition_en: to have sexual intercourse with someone (archaic euphemism)
entries.example_cn: 这篇旧文用 know 委婉地表示发生性关系。
entries.example_en: The old text uses know as a euphemism for having sexual intercourse.

entries.definition_en: someone who thinks they know everything and refuses advice
entries.example_cn: 别像个万事通一样。
entries.example_en: Stop acting like a know-all.

usage.label: derogatory; Ireland, UK
usage.pattern: Source w05466r0 labels this noun regional and derogatory.

entries.definition_en: the special knowledge and skill needed to do something
entries.example_cn: 这家公司正在寻找一位精通计算机编程的人。
entries.example_en: The company is looking for someone with know-how in computer programming.

entries.definition_en: a person who believes they know everything and does not listen to others
entries.example_cn: 别装什么万事通，听我说。
entries.example_en: Stop acting like a know-it-all and listen to what I have to say.

usage.label: derogatory
usage.pattern: a know-it-all; act like a know-it-all

entries.definition_en: able to be known or understood
entries.example_cn: 通过仔细观察，真相是可以被认知的。
entries.example_en: The truth is knowable through careful observation.

entries.definition_en: a person who has knowledge or understanding
entries.example_cn: 知晓这个秘密的人拒绝透露它。
entries.example_en: The knower of the secret refused to reveal it.

entries.definition_en: evidencing the possession of inside information
entries.example_cn: 那知情内行的微笑暗示他知道秘密。
entries.example_en: The knowing smile suggested he knew the secret.

entries.definition_en: characterized by conscious design or purpose
entries.example_cn: 这是一个针对他自尊的蓄意侮辱。
entries.example_en: It was a knowing insult aimed at his ego.

entries.definition_en: shrewd; showing clever awareness or discernment
entries.example_cn: 这群精明的观众很快发现了演出中的瑕疵。
entries.example_en: The knowing crowd quickly spotted the flaw in the performance.

entries.definition_en: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
entries.example_cn: 她对那个复杂的问题给出了博学的回答。
entries.example_en: She gave a knowing answer to the complex question.

entries.definition_en: a clear and certain mental apprehension
entries.example_cn: 他眼中的确知告诉我他已经想通了。
entries.example_en: The knowing in his eyes told me he had figured it out.

entries.definition_en: with full knowledge and deliberate intent
entries.example_cn: 他明知违法，却为了挽救生意而为之。
entries.example_en: He knowingly broke the law to save his business.

entries.definition_en: shrewdness demonstrated by knowledge
entries.example_cn: 她说话时流露出的老练令法官们印象深刻。
entries.example_en: She spoke with a knowingness that impressed the judges.

entries.definition_en: having knowledge of something
entries.example_cn: 他对当地习俗的知情使他很快融入了环境。
entries.example_en: His knowingness of the local customs helped him fit in.

entries.definition_en: information gained through perception, learning, and reasoning
entries.example_cn: 他对历史有很多知识。
entries.example_en: He has a lot of knowledge about history.

entries.definition_en: highly educated with extensive information or understanding
entries.example_cn: 她是一位古代历史方面的专家，学识渊博，可以回答任何关于罗马帝国的问题。
entries.example_en: She is a knowledgeable expert on ancient history and can answer any question about the Roman Empire.

entries.definition_cn: 通过研究或经验对某事非常熟悉的
entries.definition_en: thoroughly acquainted with a subject through study or experience
entries.example_cn: 在从事该行业多年后，他对当地的习俗和传统变得非常熟悉。
entries.example_en: After years of working in the field, he became knowledgeable about the local customs and traditions.

entries.definition_en: alert and fully informed about current events
entries.example_cn: 这位消息灵通的记者是第一个从现场报道突发新闻的人。
entries.example_en: The knowledgeable journalist was the first to report on the breaking news from the scene.

entries.definition_en: apprehended with certainty
entries.example_cn: 地球绕太阳转是一个已知的事实。
entries.example_en: It is a known fact that the earth revolves around the sun.

entries.definition_cn: know 的第三人称单数简单现在时直陈式
entries.definition_en: third-person singular simple present indicative of know
entries.example_cn: 她知道这个问题的答案。
entries.example_en: She knows the answer to the question.

entries.definition_cn: know 的非标准现在时形式
entries.definition_en: nonstandard present form of know
entries.example_cn: 他们知道真相，但什么也不说。
entries.example_en: They knows the truth, but they say nothing.

entries.definition_en: plural of know
entries.example_cn: 知情者们聚集在大厅里。
entries.example_en: The knows gathered in the hall.

entries.definition_en: a metal glove with spikes on the knuckles, used as a weapon
entries.example_cn: 这名选手因在擂台上使用指虎而被取消资格。
entries.example_en: The fighter was disqualified for using a knuck in the ring.

entries.definition_en: a joint on a finger that is visible when the hand is closed into a fist
entries.example_cn: 他用指关节敲击桌子。
entries.example_en: He hit the table with his knuckles.

entries.definition_en: to press or rub something using the knuckles of your hand
entries.example_cn: 她用手掌根部揉面团使其变软。
entries.example_en: She knuckled the dough to soften it.

entries.definition_en: to shoot a marble while keeping one's knuckles on the ground
entries.example_cn: 那个男孩用指关节贴着地面把弹珠射过人行道。
entries.example_en: The boy knuckled the marble across the pavement.

entries.definition_en: a type of baseball pitch thrown with very little speed or spin
entries.example_cn: 投手投出了一记向本垒不规则移动的指关节球。
entries.example_en: The pitcher threw a knuckleball that moved erratically toward home plate.

entries.definition_cn: 羊拐游戏（一种抛接小物件的儿童游戏）
entries.definition_en: a game played by throwing and picking up small stones or bones between bounces of a ball
entries.example_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩羊拐游戏。
entries.example_en: The children played knucklebones in the yard after school.

entries.definition_en: a stupid person
entries.example_cn: 别像个傻瓜一样，听清楚指示再说。
entries.example_en: Stop acting like a knucklehead and listen to the instructions.

usage.label: derogatory slang
usage.pattern: Source w26809r0 explicitly labels knucklehead derogatory and slang.

entries.definition_cn: 蝴蝶球；一种旋转很少、飞行不规则的棒球投球
entries.definition_en: a knuckleball
entries.example_cn: 投手投出了一个击球手无法击打的无旋转球。
entries.example_en: The pitcher threw a knuckler that the batter couldn't hit.

entries.definition_en: a small metal weapon worn over the knuckles on the back of the hand
entries.example_cn: 警方在嫌疑人的包里发现了一副黄铜指虎。
entries.example_en: The police found brass knuckles in the suspect's bag.

entries.definition_en: a sluggish, tailless Australian marsupial with grey fur that feeds on eucalyptus leaves
entries.example_cn: 我们看到一只考拉睡在桉树上。
entries.example_en: We saw a koala sleeping in a eucalyptus tree.

entries.definition_en: a paradoxical story or riddle used in Zen Buddhism to help students transcend logical thinking
entries.example_cn: 这位僧人多年参悟公案却未找到答案。
entries.example_en: The monk meditated on the koan for years without finding an answer.

entries.definition_en: an orange-brown antelope found in southeast Africa
entries.example_cn: 科布羚羊是一种生活在南部非洲草原上的小型羚羊。
entries.example_en: The kob is a small antelope that lives in the grasslands of southern Africa.

entries.definition_cn: 尼日利亚科博；尼日利亚货币单位，100科博等于1奈拉
entries.definition_en: a unit of currency in Nigeria; 100 kobos make 1 naira
entries.example_cn: 这件商品的价格是五百科博。
entries.example_en: The price of the item was five hundred kobos.

entries.definition_en: a dark cosmetic powder used to line the eyes
entries.example_cn: 她涂了眼线粉来加深眼睑边缘的颜色。
entries.example_en: She applied kohl to darken the edges of her eyelids.

entries.definition_en: a plant cultivated for its enlarged fleshy turnip-shaped edible stem
entries.example_cn: 我们在沙拉里加了一些擦碎的球茎甘蓝以增加脆度。
entries.example_en: We added some grated kohlrabi to the salad for extra crunch.

entries.definition_en: the fleshy turnip-shaped edible stem of the kohlrabi plant
entries.example_cn: 球茎甘蓝的味道略带甜味和坚果香。
entries.example_en: The kohlrabi tastes slightly sweet and nutty.

entries.definition_en: Christian fellowship or communion with God or fellow Christians, especially in the early Christian community
entries.example_cn: 早期教会珍视团契，视其为共同信仰与爱的纽带。
entries.example_en: The early church valued koinonia as a bond of shared faith and love.

entries.definition_en: a collective farm owned by the communist state
entries.example_cn: 这个集体农庄生产的粮食足以供养整个地区。
entries.example_en: The kolkhoz produced enough grain to feed the entire region.

entries.definition_en: a large, powerful Hungarian dog with a shaggy white coat, often used as a guard dog
entries.example_cn: 可蒙多尔犬站在农场的入口处守卫。
entries.example_en: The komondor stood guard at the entrance of the farm.

entries.definition_en: a person who is considered eccentric or crazy and is different from other people
entries.example_cn: 新邻居真是个怪人，跟鸽子说话。
entries.example_en: The new neighbor is a real kook who talks to pigeons.

entries.definition_en: Australian kingfisher having a loud cackling cry
entries.example_cn: 我们在树上听到了笑翠鸟大声的啼叫声。
entries.example_en: We heard the kookaburra laughing loudly in the tree.

entries.definition_en: informal term for mentally unstable or irrational
entries.example_cn: 别听他那些关于飞行汽车的疯疯癫癫的想法。
entries.example_en: Don't listen to his kookie ideas about flying cars.

entries.definition_en: eccentric, strange, or foolish; crazy or insane
entries.example_cn: 她古怪的时尚选择总是引人注目。
entries.example_en: Her kooky fashion choices always draw attention.

entries.definition_en: a Russian monetary unit where 100 kopecks equal 1 ruble
entries.example_cn: 他用一枚戈比支付了那件小商品的费用。
entries.example_en: He paid for the small item with a single kopeck.

entries.definition_en: a Russian monetary unit where 100 kopecks equal 1 ruble
entries.example_cn: 面包的价格只有几个戈比。
entries.example_en: The price of the bread was only a few kopeks.

entries.definition_en: a small hill that rises sharply from the flat grasslands of Africa
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行者在小山峰上停下来欣赏风景。
entries.example_en: The hikers paused on the kopje to admire the view.

entries.definition_en: a small hill that rises from the open grassland of southern Africa
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行者在俯瞰山谷的小山丘上休息。
entries.example_en: The hikers took a break on the koppie overlooking the valley.

entries.definition_en: an ancient Hebrew unit of capacity equal to 10 baths or 10 ephahs
entries.example_cn: 古文本描述了用古希伯来容量单位‘科’储存的谷物。
entries.example_en: The ancient text describes the grain stored in kors.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in the Czech Republic
entries.example_cn: 她用五十克朗付了午餐费。
entries.example_en: She paid for her lunch with fifty koruna.

entries.definition_cn: 斯洛伐克旧货币的基本单位
entries.definition_en: the former basic unit of money in Slovakia
entries.example_cn: 这张票的价格是十斯洛伐克克朗。
entries.example_en: The price of the ticket was ten korunas.

entries.definition_en: a unit of length used in India with varying values
entries.example_cn: 那张旧地图用古斯测量了距离。
entries.example_en: The old map measured the distance in kos.

entries.definition_en: conforming to Jewish dietary laws
entries.example_cn: 烹饪前请检查配料是否符合犹太饮食法。
entries.example_en: Please check if the ingredients are kosher before cooking.

entries.definition_en: proper or legitimate
entries.example_cn: 考试作弊是不正当的。
entries.example_en: It is not kosher to cheat on the exam.

entries.definition_en: food that complies with Jewish dietary laws
entries.example_cn: 这家餐厅只提供犹太洁食，以满足客人的宗教需求。
entries.example_en: The restaurant serves only kosher food to accommodate the guests' religious needs.

entries.definition_cn: 日本筝（一种日本弦乐器）
entries.definition_en: a Japanese stringed instrument resembling a zither with a rectangular wooden board and silk strings
entries.example_cn: 音乐家为观众演奏了传统的筝。
entries.example_en: The musician played a traditional koto for the audience.

entries.definition_en: to bend the knees and bow in a servile manner
entries.example_cn: 他拒绝向权威磕头。
entries.example_en: He refused to kowtow to authority.

entries.definition_en: to try to gain favor by cringing or flattering
entries.example_cn: 她被指控为了获得晋升而向上司卑躬屈膝。
entries.example_en: She was accused of kowtowing to her superiors to get a promotion.

entries.definition_en: a former Chinese custom of touching the ground with the forehead as a sign of respect or submission
entries.example_cn: 这项古老仪式包括在皇帝面前行大礼磕头。
entries.example_en: The ancient ritual involved a deep kowtow before the emperor.

entries.definition_cn: 千米每小时；公里每小时
entries.definition_en: kilometres per hour, a unit of speed
entries.example_cn: 高速公路的限速是每小时120公里。
entries.example_en: The speed limit on the highway is 120 kph.

entries.definition_en: a pen for livestock in southern Africa
entries.example_cn: 牛群在黄昏时被赶进了牲畜围栏。
entries.example_en: The cattle were driven into the kraal at dusk.

entries.definition_en: a village of huts for native Africans in southern Africa; usually surrounded by a stockade
entries.example_cn: 游客们参观了保护区内的一个传统村落。
entries.example_en: The travelers visited a traditional kraal in the reserve.

entries.definition_en: strong brown wrapping paper made from wood pulp by the kraft process
entries.example_cn: 我们用牛皮纸包裹礼物，并用丝带系好。
entries.example_en: We wrapped the gift in kraft paper and tied it with a ribbon.

entries.definition_cn: 东南亚环蛇属的一种色彩鲜艳的有毒蛇
entries.definition_en: a brightly colored venomous snake of the genus Bungarus found in Southeast Asia
entries.example_cn: 环蛇是东南亚一种色彩鲜艳的有毒蛇。
entries.example_en: The krait is a brightly colored venomous snake of Southeast Asia.

entries.definition_cn: 俄罗斯城市中的设防中央建筑群
entries.definition_en: a fortified central complex in a Russian city
entries.example_cn: 克里姆林宫是俄罗斯中央政府的所在地。
entries.example_en: The Kremlin is the seat of Russia's central government.

entries.definition_en: small shrimp-like creatures that float in the ocean and are a major food source for whales
entries.example_cn: 鲸鱼长途跋涉到南极水域以磷虾为食。
entries.example_en: Whales travel long distances to feed on krill in the Antarctic waters.

entries.definition_cn: 一种传统的印度尼西亚、马来西亚或菲律宾波浪形匕首或短剑
entries.definition_en: a traditional Indonesian, Malaysian, or Filipino dagger or sword with a usually serpentine blade
entries.example_cn: 收藏家展示了他那把带有复杂波浪形刀刃的稀有克里斯匕首。
entries.example_en: The collector displayed his rare kris with its intricate wavy blade.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Sweden
entries.example_cn: 这张票的价格是两克朗。
entries.example_en: The price of the ticket was two krona.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Iceland
entries.example_cn: 她在机场将美元兑换成了冰岛克朗。
entries.example_en: She exchanged her dollars for Icelandic krona at the airport.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Norway
entries.example_cn: 这杯咖啡的价格是五克朗。
entries.example_en: The price of the coffee was five kroner.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Denmark
entries.example_cn: 她用丹麦克朗支付了车票钱。
entries.example_en: She paid for the ticket with a Danish krone.

entries.definition_cn: 克朗（爱沙尼亚旧货币单位）
entries.definition_en: the former basic monetary unit of Estonia
entries.example_cn: 在爱沙尼亚采用欧元之前，她用克朗支付午餐费。
entries.example_en: Before Estonia adopted the euro, she paid for lunch with a kroon.

entries.definition_en: a colorless, odorless chemical element and noble gas, symbol Kr, with atomic number 36
entries.example_cn: 氪被用来制造明亮的灯光。
entries.example_en: Krypton is used to make bright lights.

entries.definition_cn: 表示合金中黄金含量的单位；18K金含金量为75%，24K金为纯金
entries.definition_en: the unit of measurement for the proportion of gold in an alloy
entries.example_cn: 这枚戒指是18K金制成的，也就是说含金量为75%。
entries.example_en: This ring is made of 18 kt gold, meaning it is 75% gold.

entries.definition_en: praise or recognition for an achievement
entries.example_cn: 该队因在最后一场比赛中的出色表现而受到赞誉。
entries.example_en: The team received kudos for their outstanding performance in the final match.

entries.definition_en: either of two spiral-horned antelopes of the African bush
entries.example_cn: 我们在保护区的河边看到一只角羚在吃草。
entries.example_en: We spotted a kudu grazing near the river in the reserve.

entries.definition_en: fast-growing vine from eastern Asia having tuberous starchy roots and hairy trifoliate leaves and racemes of purple flowers followed by long hairy pods containing many seeds; grown for fodder and forage and root starch; widespread in the southern United States
entries.example_cn: 葛藤迅速蔓延到山坡上，覆盖了沿途的一切。
entries.example_en: The kudzu has spread rapidly across the hillsides, covering everything in its path.

entries.definition_cn: 从葛根中提取的淀粉，用于东亚传统医学和烹饪。
