entries.example_en: The company decided not to overextend its finances by taking on too many new projects.

entries.definition_en: having been fed too much or having eaten too much
entries.example_cn: 那只吃得太饱的狗太重了，跑不快。
entries.example_en: The overfed dog was too heavy to run fast.

entries.definition_en: to give too much food to someone or something
entries.example_cn: 你不应该给小狗喂得过饱，否则它们会变胖。
entries.example_en: You should not overfeed the puppies or they will become obese.

entries.definition_en: to eat more food than is necessary
entries.example_cn: 如果你吃得过多，可能会感到不舒服。
entries.example_en: If you overfeed, you may feel uncomfortable.

entries.definition_en: the act of giving too much food to someone or something
entries.example_cn: 鱼的快速生长是由过度喂养引起的。
entries.example_en: The rapid growth of the fish was caused by overfeeding.

entries.definition_cn: 装得过满；使超过容量或适当限度
entries.definition_en: to fill beyond capacity or beyond an appropriate level
entries.example_cn: 请不要把杯子装得过满。
entries.example_en: Please do not overfill the cup with water.

entries.definition_en: a flight by an aircraft over a particular area, especially foreign territory
entries.example_cn: 飞行员请求获准飞越限制区域。
entries.example_en: The pilot requested permission for an overflight of the restricted zone.

entries.definition_en: flow or run over a limit or brim
entries.example_cn: 我加太多茶时，杯子溢出来了。
entries.example_en: The cup overflowed when I added too much tea.

entries.definition_en: be full of a certain feeling
entries.example_cn: 朋友们为她组织庆祝活动时，她满怀感激。
entries.example_en: She overflowed with gratitude when her friends organized the celebration.

entries.definition_en: a quantity of liquid that spills over
entries.example_cn: 河水溢出后淹没了低洼田地。
entries.example_en: The overflow from the river flooded the lower fields.

entries.definition_en: the occurrence of surplus liquid exceeding the limit or capacity
entries.example_cn: 这座水坝是为了防止水库溢出而建造的。
entries.example_en: The dam was built to prevent the overflow of the reservoir.

entries.definition_en: covered with water because it has spilled over
entries.example_cn: 大雨过后，河水泛滥。
entries.example_en: The river was overflowing after the heavy rain.

entries.definition_en: to fly over something
entries.example_cn: 飞机在降落前将飞越这座城市。
entries.example_en: The plane will overfly the city before landing.

entries.definition_cn: 飞过目的地或着陆区域而错过
entries.definition_en: to fly too far past a destination or landing area
entries.example_cn: 飞行员飞过了那条短跑道，只得绕回去。
entries.example_en: The pilot overflew the short runway and had to circle back.

entries.definition_en: filled beyond capacity; excessively full
entries.example_cn: 体育场里挤满了球迷，严重超员。
entries.example_en: The stadium was overfull with fans.

entries.definition_en: extremely generous
entries.example_cn: 这位过分慷慨的主人为所有客人提供了一场盛宴。
entries.example_en: The overgenerous host provided a feast for all the guests.

entries.definition_en: to grow too large
entries.example_cn: 这株植物长得太大，已经需要重新栽种了。
entries.example_en: The plant overgrew its pot and needed to be replanted.

entries.definition_en: to become overgrown
entries.example_cn: 那座废弃的房子已被藤蔓覆盖。
entries.example_en: The abandoned house has become overgrown with vines.

entries.definition_cn: 生长到某物之外或跨越某物
entries.definition_en: to grow beyond or across something
entries.example_cn: 树的根须长出了栅栏。
entries.example_en: The roots of the tree overgrow the fence.

entries.definition_cn: 被长得过于茂盛、通常使花园或某处显得杂乱的植物覆盖的
entries.definition_en: covered with plants that have grown too large, usually making a garden or area look untidy
entries.example_cn: 花园里的植物长得过于茂盛，蔓延到了小路上。
entries.example_en: The garden had become overgrown, with plants spilling across the paths.

entries.definition_cn: 长满通常不需要的植被的
entries.definition_en: abounding in usually unwanted vegetation
entries.example_cn: 小路被茂密的树篱挡住了。
entries.example_en: The path was blocked by an overgrown hedge.

entries.definition_cn: 过度生长（指植物在物体表面或上方过度蔓延）
entries.definition_en: an excessive amount of vegetation growing on or over something
entries.example_cn: 藤蔓已经接管了花园，形成了茂密的过度生长。
entries.example_en: Vines had taken over the garden, creating a thick overgrowth.

entries.definition_cn: 过度生长或数量增加（如杂草或微生物种群的过度增长）
entries.definition_en: excessive growth or increase in numbers, as in a population of weeds or microorganisms
entries.example_cn: 池塘中藻类数量的过度增长是由营养物质过多造成的。
entries.example_en: The pond's algal overgrowth was caused by excess nutrients.

entries.definition_cn: 过度生长（尤指因垂体分泌过多生长激素所致）
entries.definition_en: excessive physical size, typically caused by too much growth hormone
entries.example_cn: 患者的异常过度生长是由垂体分泌过多生长激素引起的。
entries.example_en: The patient's abnormal overgrowth was caused by excessive secretion of growth hormone from the pituitary gland.

entries.definition_en: with hand brought forward and down from above shoulder level
entries.example_cn: 投手投出了一个上手球好球。
entries.example_en: The pitcher threw an overhand strike.

entries.definition_en: sewn together with overhand stitches
entries.example_cn: 裁缝用包边针缝好了下摆。
entries.example_en: The seamstress finished the hem with an overhand stitch.

entries.definition_cn: 建筑物、悬崖或其他物体中伸出下方部分的悬伸部分
entries.definition_en: a part of a building, cliff, or other object that projects beyond the part below it
entries.example_cn: 悬伸部分为我们遮挡了雨水。
entries.example_en: The overhang sheltered us from the rain.

entries.definition_en: to project over something
entries.example_cn: 屋顶伸出悬于花园上方。
entries.example_en: The roof overhangs the garden.

entries.definition_en: to be suspended over or hang over something
entries.example_cn: 一座桥悬垂于河面上方。
entries.example_en: A bridge overhangs the river.

entries.definition_en: a period of maintenance work done on a car or machine to fix or improve it
entries.example_cn: 这辆车在出售前需要彻底大修。
entries.example_en: The car needs a complete overhaul before it can be sold.

entries.definition_en: the act of improving something by renewing and restoring it
entries.example_cn: 该市计划对旧图书馆进行重大翻新，使其现代化。
entries.example_en: The city plans a major overhaul of the old library to make it modern.

entries.definition_en: to make repairs, renovations, revisions, or adjustments to something
entries.example_cn: 我们需要检修引擎以确保其运行顺畅。
entries.example_en: We need to overhaul the engine to ensure it runs smoothly.

entries.definition_en: to pass or overtake someone or something
entries.example_cn: 那辆更快的车在高速公路上超过了那辆慢车。
entries.example_en: The faster car overtook and overhauled the slower one on the highway.

entries.definition_cn: 不直接归属于具体商品或服务的企业间接费用
entries.definition_en: business expenses not directly assigned to particular goods or services
entries.example_cn: 这家企业难以负担其间接费用。
entries.example_en: The business struggled to cover its overheads.

entries.definition_en: processing time required by a device before executing a command
entries.example_cn: 该系统开销低，因此速度非常快。
entries.example_en: The system has low overhead, making it very fast.

entries.definition_en: disk space used for location and timing information rather than data
entries.example_cn: 该文件格式最大限度地减少了开销以节省存储空间。
entries.example_en: The file format minimizes overhead to save storage.

entries.definition_en: located or originating from above
entries.example_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了，不适合阅读。
entries.example_en: The overhead lights were too bright for reading.

entries.definition_en: above your head; in the sky
entries.example_cn: 抬头看头顶上的星星。
entries.example_en: Look overhead to see the stars.

entries.definition_en: above the head; over the head
entries.example_cn: 她举着伞在头顶上方以避雨。
entries.example_en: She held the umbrella overhead to stay dry.

entries.definition_en: a transparency used with an overhead projector
entries.example_cn: 老师为课程准备了一张投影片。
entries.example_en: The teacher prepared an overhead for the lesson.

entries.definition_en: the top surface of an enclosed space on a ship
entries.example_cn: 风暴期间，船员把设备固定在舱顶上。
entries.example_en: The crew secured equipment to the overhead during the storm.

entries.definition_en: to hear something that people are saying without them knowing you are listening
entries.example_cn: 我无意中听到他们在隔壁房间争吵。
entries.example_en: I accidentally overheard them arguing in the next room.

entries.definition_en: become excessively hot
entries.example_cn: 引擎在长途驾驶中开始过热。
entries.example_en: The engine began to overheat during the long drive.

entries.definition_en: make excessively hot
entries.example_cn: 直射阳光会迅速使汽车内部过热。
entries.example_en: The direct sunlight can overheat the car interior quickly.

entries.definition_en: grow too quickly and uncontrollably
entries.example_cn: 经过多年不受控制的借贷，经济开始过热。
entries.example_en: The economy began to overheat after years of unchecked borrowing.

entries.definition_en: heated to a temperature that is unsafe or too high
entries.example_cn: 在陡峭的山路上行驶太久后，引擎变得过热。
entries.example_en: The engine became overheated after driving on the steep hill for too long.

entries.definition_en: the condition of becoming too hot
entries.example_cn: 汽车因过热而停下了。
entries.example_en: The car stopped because of overheating.

entries.definition_cn: 经济的生产能力无法跟上总需求，导致增长不可持续并带来通货膨胀压力的状况
entries.definition_en: a situation in which an economy’s productive capacity cannot keep pace with overall demand, causing unsustainable growth and inflationary pressure
entries.example_cn: 政府提高利率，以防止经济过热。
entries.example_en: The government raised interest rates to prevent the economy from overheating.

entries.definition_cn: 过度放纵；（尤指）暴饮暴食
entries.definition_en: to indulge in something to excess, especially food or drink
entries.example_cn: 他倾向于在节日晚餐时暴饮暴食。
entries.example_en: He tends to overindulge at holiday dinners.

entries.definition_en: the act of allowing oneself or others to indulge excessively
entries.example_cn: 他对甜食的过度放纵导致了严重的健康问题。
entries.example_en: His overindulgence in sweets led to serious health problems.

entries.definition_en: showing too much indulgence; excessively permissive
entries.example_cn: 父母对孩子过度纵容，给了他们想要的一切。
entries.example_en: The parents were overindulgent with their children, giving them everything they wanted.

entries.definition_en: feeling or showing extreme happiness
entries.example_cn: 她收到好消息时欣喜若狂。
entries.example_en: She was overjoyed to receive the good news.

entries.definition_en: the use of more force or resources than necessary to achieve a goal
entries.example_cn: 派专家团队去修理一个简单的漏洞简直是杀鸡用牛刀。
entries.example_en: Sending a team of experts to fix a simple leak was overkill.

entries.definition_en: the capability to obliterate a target with more weapons (especially nuclear weapons) than are required
entries.example_cn: 这种军事战略因其潜在的过度杀伤能力而受到批评。
entries.example_en: The military strategy was criticized for its potential for overkill.

entries.definition_en: loaded past capacity
entries.example_cn: 这艘船超载了货物，难以前行。
entries.example_en: The ship was overladen with cargo and struggled to make headway.

entries.definition_en: by or across land
entries.example_cn: 他们选择走陆路，以避开危险的海上航线。
entries.example_en: They chose an overland route to avoid the dangerous sea route.

entries.definition_en: coincide partially or wholly
entries.example_cn: 会议时间与我的午休时间重合。
entries.example_en: The meeting times overlap with my lunch break.

entries.definition_en: extend over and cover a part of
entries.example_cn: 毯子覆盖住了床边的一部分。
entries.example_en: The blanket overlaps the edge of the bed.

entries.definition_cn: 时间上的部分重合性质
entries.definition_en: the property of partial coincidence in time
entries.example_cn: 这两个活动的日程表在时间上有显著的重叠。
entries.example_en: There is a significant overlap in the schedules of the two events.

entries.definition_cn: 理论或现象间共同基础的表征
entries.definition_en: a representation of common ground between theories or phenomena
entries.example_cn: 韦恩图展示了这两个理论之间的重叠部分。
entries.example_en: The Venn diagram shows the overlap between the two theories.

entries.definition_cn: 覆盖并伸出另一部分的部分或边缘
entries.definition_en: a part or edge that extends over and covers another part
entries.example_cn: 屋顶有一个小盖片以防止漏水。
entries.example_en: The roof has a small overlap to prevent water leakage.

entries.definition_en: covering with a design in which one element covers a part of another
entries.example_cn: 屋顶瓦片以重叠的方式排列。
entries.example_en: The roof tiles are arranged in an overlapping pattern.

entries.definition_en: to put something on top of something else
entries.example_cn: 艺术家在素描上覆盖了一层颜料。
entries.example_en: The artist overlaid a layer of paint over the sketch.

entries.definition_en: to suffocate or kill by lying on top of
entries.example_cn: 母亲睡觉时不慎压住婴儿，使其窒息。
entries.example_en: The mother accidentally overlaid the infant in her sleep.

entries.definition_en: a protective layer applied to a building structure
entries.example_cn: 这栋房子需要一个新的保护层来抵御风暴。
entries.example_en: The house needed a new overlay to protect it from the storm.

entries.definition_en: a decorative layer applied over a surface
entries.example_cn: 这张桌子表面覆盖了一层金箔装饰。
entries.example_en: The table was finished with a gold leaf overlay.

entries.definition_cn: 在（书页等的）背面；在下一页
entries.definition_en: on the other side of a page
entries.example_cn: 插图在左页，而文字在背面继续。
entries.example_en: The illustration is on the left page, while the text continues overleaf.

entries.definition_en: lie upon; lie on top of
entries.example_cn: 积雪可以覆盖结冰的湖面，遮住下面的冰层。
entries.example_en: Snow can overlie the frozen lake, hiding the ice beneath.

entries.definition_en: to kill by lying on top of someone
entries.example_cn: 那块大石头压在了徒步旅行者身上，造成了致命伤害。
entries.example_en: The heavy rock overlied the hiker, causing fatal injuries.

entries.definition_en: an electrical load that exceeds the available electrical power
entries.example_cn: 由于过载，断路器跳闸了。
entries.example_en: The circuit breaker tripped due to an overload.

entries.definition_en: an excessive burden
entries.example_cn: 她感到照顾家人带来的情感负担过重。
entries.example_en: She felt the emotional overload of caring for her family.

entries.definition_cn: 使某物负荷过重；使某物超负荷
entries.definition_en: put too much load or strain on something
entries.example_cn: 不要因接入太多设备而使电路超负荷。
entries.example_en: Do not overload the circuit by connecting too many devices.

entries.definition_en: fill to excess so that function is impaired
entries.example_cn: 过多的通知使系统超载。
entries.example_en: Too many notifications overloaded the system.

entries.definition_cn: 因负荷过重而失灵；因超载而停止运转
entries.definition_en: fail or stop functioning because of an excessive load
entries.example_cn: 水泵启动时，老发电机因负荷过重而停机。
entries.example_en: The old generator overloaded when the pump started and shut down.

entries.definition_cn: （为不同类型或情境）重载函数，使同一名称对应不同函数
entries.definition_en: to define different functions with the same name for use with different types or contexts
entries.example_cn: 程序员对该运算符进行了重载，使其既能处理整数，也能处理小数。
entries.example_en: The programmer overloaded the operator to work with both integers and decimals.

entries.definition_en: having too much work, information, or passengers to handle effectively
entries.example_cn: 节假日期间，这辆公交车载满了游客，严重超载。
entries.example_en: The bus was overloaded with tourists during the holiday season.

entries.definition_en: to look past something and fail to notice it
entries.example_cn: 经理忽略了报告中的拼写错误。
entries.example_en: The manager overlooked the typo in the report.

entries.definition_en: to forgive, disregard, or pass over an offense or fault without punishment
entries.example_cn: 她拒绝容忍他的粗鲁行为。
entries.example_en: She refused to overlook his rude behavior.

entries.definition_en: to leave undone or to omit something
entries.example_cn: 请不要忽略指示中的任何细节。
entries.example_en: Please do not overlook any details in the instructions.

entries.definition_en: to offer a view of something from a higher position
entries.example_cn: 这所房子面朝大海。
entries.example_en: The house overlooks the sea.

entries.definition_en: to watch over or guard something
entries.example_cn: 保安整夜看守着入口。
entries.example_en: The security guard overlooked the entrance all night.

entries.definition_en: a high place that provides a good view
entries.example_cn: 我们登上了一个可以俯瞰整个山谷的观景台。
entries.example_en: We climbed to an overlook with a view of the entire valley.

entries.definition_en: not taken into account
entries.example_cn: 这项研究中忽略了几个重要因素。
entries.example_en: Several important factors were overlooked in the study.

entries.definition_en: a person who has power and authority over other people
entries.example_cn: 征服者成为了被征服王国的统治者。
entries.example_en: The conqueror became the overlord of the defeated kingdom.

entries.definition_en: the position or authority of an overlord
entries.example_cn: 该条约确立了北方王国对南方部落的霸主地位。
entries.example_en: The treaty established the overlordship of the northern kingdom over the southern tribes.

entries.definition_en: to a degree exceeding normal or proper limits
entries.example_cn: 她过分在意别人对她的看法。
entries.example_en: She was overly concerned about what others thought of her.

entries.definition_en: placed on top of something else
entries.example_cn: 覆盖在上面的土层富含养分。
entries.example_en: The overlying soil layer is rich in nutrients.

entries.definition_cn: 壁炉架上方的装饰结构，通常由灰泥或雕刻木材制成，有时带有镜子
entries.definition_en: a decorative structure, often of plasterwork or carved wood and sometimes including a mirror, over a mantelpiece
entries.example_cn: 雕刻的壁炉上方装饰结构装点着旧客厅的壁炉。
entries.example_en: The carved overmantel framed the fireplace in the old drawing room.

entries.definition_en: existing in very large quantities; excessive
entries.example_cn: 花园里长满了需要修剪的过多植被。
entries.example_en: The garden was filled with overmuch vegetation that needed pruning.

entries.definition_en: to a degree that is more than is needed or appropriate
entries.example_cn: 他过度地担心自己所犯的小错误。
entries.example_en: He worried overmuch about the small mistakes he made.

entries.definition_en: an amount that is greater than is suitable or necessary
entries.example_cn: 派对上噪音过大，让人难以交谈。
entries.example_en: There was overmuch noise at the party, making it difficult to have a conversation.

entries.definition_en: during or for the length of one night
entries.example_cn: 我们在一家小旅馆住了一夜。
entries.example_en: We stayed overnight at a small inn.

entries.definition_en: happening in a short time or with great speed
entries.example_cn: 那段病毒视频走红后，她一夜之间就成名了。
entries.example_en: She became famous overnight after the viral video.

entries.definition_en: lasting, open, or operating through the whole night
entries.example_cn: 该酒店为客人提供通宵停车服务。
entries.example_en: The hotel offers overnight parking for guests.

entries.definition_en: a small traveling bag for overnight stays
entries.example_cn: 她把衣服装进了一个紧凑型的过夜包里。
entries.example_en: She packed her clothes into a compact overnighter.

entries.definition_en: a guest who stays overnight
entries.example_cn: 由于周末涌入大量过夜客，酒店已客满。
entries.example_en: The hotel is fully booked for the weekend due to the influx of overnighters.

entries.definition_en: a bridge built over a road or railway to allow another road or railway to cross above it
entries.example_cn: 司机们利用高架桥避开主干道的交通拥堵。
entries.example_en: Drivers use the overpass to avoid the traffic jam on the main highway.

entries.definition_en: to pay someone more money than is fair or necessary
entries.example_cn: 你不应该因为急于购买而多付钱买二手车。
entries.example_en: You should not overpay for a second-hand car just because you are eager to buy it.

entries.definition_en: a payment that is larger than what is needed or expected
entries.example_cn: 公司发放了退款以纠正超额付款。
entries.example_en: The company issued a refund to correct the overpayment.

entries.definition_en: the act of paying too much
entries.example_cn: 账单系统中的 clerical 错误导致了付多了。
entries.example_en: The overpayment was caused by a clerical error in the billing system.

entries.definition_en: to act in a way that is too dramatic or exaggerated
entries.example_cn: 这位演员将角色的悲伤表演得太过夸张，使得场景显得不自然。
entries.example_en: The actor overplayed his character's grief, making the scene feel unnatural.

entries.definition_en: to cause a place to have too large a population
entries.example_cn: 快速的城市化使市中心居民人口过剩。
entries.example_en: Rapid urbanization has overpopulated the city center with residents.

entries.definition_en: a situation where there are too many people in a particular area
entries.example_cn: 城市的快速增长导致了严重的人口过剩。
entries.example_en: The rapid growth of the city has led to severe overpopulation.

entries.definition_en: to defeat or subdue someone using greater strength or force
entries.example_cn: 军队设法制服了敌军。
entries.example_en: The army managed to overpower the enemy forces.

entries.definition_cn: 以更强的强度压过、盖过（感官或其他事物）
entries.definition_en: to be so strong that it controls your feelings or senses
entries.example_cn: 大蒜味盖过了香草的清淡味道。
entries.example_en: The garlic overpowered the delicate flavor of the herbs.

entries.definition_en: so strong that it cannot be resisted
entries.example_cn: 她感到一种难以抗拒的悲伤。
entries.example_en: She felt an overpowering sense of sadness.

entries.definition_en: to such a great extent that it cannot be resisted
entries.example_cn: 她对独自旅行的想法产生了压倒性的吸引力。
entries.example_en: She was overpoweringly attracted to the idea of traveling alone.

entries.definition_en: to praise excessively
entries.example_cn: 媒体经常过分赞扬名人的慈善工作。
entries.example_en: The media often overpraise celebrities for their charitable work.

entries.definition_en: excessive or undeserved praise
entries.example_cn: 评论家对这位导演的处女作充满了过度的赞扬。
entries.example_en: The critic's review was full of overpraise for the director's debut film.

entries.definition_cn: 过高的压力，尤其是冲击波造成的暂时性压力升高；超压
entries.definition_en: excessively high pressure, especially a temporary increase caused by a shock wave
entries.example_cn: 爆炸造成了危险的超压，损坏了附近的建筑物。
entries.example_en: The explosion caused a dangerous overpressure that damaged the nearby buildings.

entries.definition_en: to set a price that is excessively high
entries.example_cn: 这家商店将进口商品定价过高，相比之下本地品牌更便宜。
entries.example_en: The store overpriced the imported goods compared to local brands.

entries.definition_en: too costly for the value provided
entries.example_cn: 这些票对于演出的质量来说定价过高了。
entries.example_en: These tickets are overpriced for the quality of the show.

entries.definition_cn: 在已印刷的纸上印刷（额外的文字或颜色）
entries.definition_en: print (additional text or colors) onto an already imprinted paper
entries.example_cn: 打印机将在现有背景上套印标志。
entries.example_en: The printer will overprint the logo on the existing background.

entries.definition_en: something added by overprinting
entries.example_cn: 邮票上的套印表明这是一个特殊的纪念版。
entries.example_en: The overprint on the stamp indicated a special commemorative issue.

entries.definition_en: to produce more than is needed or wanted
entries.example_cn: 这家工厂去年汽车生产过剩了。
entries.example_en: The factory overproduced cars last year.

entries.definition_cn: 对音乐录音进行过度制作，添加过多修改或效果
entries.definition_en: to apply excessive modifications or effects to a musical recording
entries.example_cn: 制作人给这首曲目添加了多余的效果，进行了过度制作。
entries.example_en: The producer overproduced the track with unnecessary effects.

entries.definition_en: the production of too much of something or more than is expected
entries.example_cn: 由于生产了过多的未售出商品，这家工厂陷入了财务困境。
entries.example_en: The factory faced financial difficulties due to the overproduction of unsold goods.

entries.definition_en: to protect someone too much or too carefully
entries.example_cn: 教练决定停止过度保护这位年轻球员，让他面对挑战。
entries.example_en: The coach decided to stop overprotecting the young player and let him face the challenges.

entries.definition_cn: 像母亲一样过度照顾某人
entries.definition_en: to care for someone in a way that is too much like a mother, often excessively
entries.example_cn: 父母不应让孩子免受每一个小困难的伤害。
entries.example_en: Parents should not overprotect their children from every minor difficulty.

entries.definition_en: the act of protecting someone too much or too carefully
entries.example_cn: 父母对孩子的过度保护阻碍了他学习独立解决问题的能力。
entries.example_en: The child's overprotection by his parents prevented him from learning to solve problems on his own.

entries.definition_en: showing excessive protection or concern for someone
entries.example_cn: 父母不应过度保护孩子，应允许他们从错误中学习。
entries.example_en: Parents should not be overprotective of their children, allowing them to learn from mistakes.

entries.definition_en: to think something is better or more important than it really is
entries.example_cn: 不要高估这项任务的难度，你一小时就能完成。
entries.example_en: Do not overrate the difficulty of the task; you can finish it in an hour.

entries.definition_cn: 因目标过高或努力过度而失败
entries.definition_en: to fail because you have tried to do too much or aim too high
entries.example_cn: 该公司因试图同时进入太多市场而失败。
entries.example_en: The company overreached by trying to expand into too many markets at once.

entries.definition_cn: 用狡猾手段智胜某人；蒙骗
entries.definition_en: to get the better of someone by cunning or cleverness; to outwit
entries.example_cn: 剧中，年轻仆人用一个巧计骗过了老商人。
entries.example_en: In the play, the young servant overreached the old merchant by a clever trick.

entries.definition_cn: 野心过大的；过度扩张的
entries.definition_en: showing excessive confidence or ambition; attempting to achieve more than is reasonable or possible
entries.example_cn: 该项目野心勃勃的企图导致了它的失败。
entries.example_en: The overreaching ambition of the project led to its failure.

entries.definition_en: to show a response that is too strong or exaggerated for the situation
entries.example_cn: 她对轻微的批评反应过度。
entries.example_en: She overreacted to the minor criticism.

entries.definition_en: a response that is too strong or emotional for the situation
entries.example_cn: 他的爆发是对轻微批评的过度反应。
entries.example_en: His outburst was an overreaction to the minor criticism.

entries.definition_en: the act of making something invalid or less important
entries.example_cn: 新法律是对旧法规的否决。
entries.example_en: The new law was an override of the old regulations.

entries.definition_en: a device used to manually control an automatic system
entries.example_cn: 司机使用手动控制装置让汽车停止自动运行。
entries.example_en: The driver used the override to stop the car automatically.

entries.definition_en: to rule against a decision or opinion
entries.example_cn: 法官决定否决陪审团的裁决。
entries.example_en: The judge decided to override the jury's verdict.

entries.definition_en: to be more important or powerful than something else
entries.example_cn: 在这个项目中，安全考虑优于其他所有因素。
entries.example_en: Safety concerns override all other considerations in this project.

entries.definition_en: to manually control a vehicle's gear shift instead of letting it operate automatically
entries.example_cn: 司机必须强制换挡才能爬上陡峭的山坡。
entries.example_en: The driver had to override the automatic gear shift to climb the steep hill.

entries.definition_en: to ride a horse too hard or aggressively
entries.example_cn: 骑手被警告不要在比赛中骑得太猛。
entries.example_en: The rider was warned not to override the horse during the race.

entries.definition_en: of greater importance than all other considerations in a particular situation
entries.example_cn: 安全是建筑团队至高无上的关注点。
entries.example_en: Safety is the overriding concern for the construction team.

entries.definition_en: too ripe and beginning to turn soft or spoil
entries.example_cn: 我们把过熟的香蕉扔掉了，因为它们已经软烂了。
entries.example_en: We threw away the overripe bananas because they were mushy.

entries.definition_cn: 推翻；否决；驳回（决定、裁决或异议）
entries.definition_en: to reject, overturn, or cancel a decision, ruling, or objection by superior authority
entries.example_cn: 法官决定推翻下级法院的裁决。
entries.example_en: The judge decided to overrule the lower court's decision.

entries.definition_cn: 超时；持续得比预定或预期的时间更久
entries.definition_en: to continue for longer than scheduled or expected
entries.example_cn: 演出超时了十分钟，导致一些人没赶上回家的公交车。
entries.example_en: The performance overran by ten minutes, so some people missed their bus home.

entries.definition_en: to go beyond or past a certain point or limit
entries.example_cn: 我们绝不能让这个项目超出预算。
entries.example_en: We must not overrun our budget for this project.

entries.definition_en: to invade a place in very large numbers
entries.example_cn: 夏季节日期间，这座城市被游客挤得水泄不通。
entries.example_en: The city was overrun by tourists during the summer festival.

entries.definition_en: to occupy a place in large numbers or to live on a host organism
entries.example_cn: 主人停止浇水后，花园里长满了杂草。
entries.example_en: The garden was overrun by weeds after the owner stopped watering it.

entries.definition_en: to flow or run beyond a limit or brim
entries.example_cn: 大雨过后，河水开始漫过河岸。
entries.example_en: The river began to overrun its banks after the heavy rain.

entries.definition_cn: 超出量；超支；超出预期的数量
entries.definition_en: an amount by which something exceeds a limit, estimate, or expected amount
entries.example_cn: 这个项目出现了严重的成本超支。
entries.example_en: The project suffered a substantial cost overrun.

entries.definition_en: to seize a position and defeat an opponent
entries.example_cn: 军队成功攻破了敌人的防线。
entries.example_en: The army managed to overrun the enemy's defensive line.

entries.definition_en: located across or beyond the sea
entries.example_cn: 海外市场增长迅速。
entries.example_en: The oversea markets are growing fast.

entries.definition_en: to a place beyond the sea
entries.example_cn: 他为生意出海旅行。
entries.example_en: He traveled oversea for his business.

entries.definition_en: located in or relating to a foreign country
entries.example_cn: 他在加拿大的一所大学留学。
entries.example_en: He is studying overseas at a university in Canada.

usage.label: not comparable
usage.pattern: Source w03552r0 marks the adjective not-comparable.

entries.definition_en: crossing or extending over the sea
entries.example_cn: 这条跨海电缆连接了两大洲。
entries.example_en: The overseas cable connects the two continents.

entries.definition_en: abroad, especially in or to a foreign country
entries.example_cn: 许多人去海外度假。
entries.example_en: Many people travel overseas for their holidays.

entries.definition_en: to a place across an ocean
entries.example_cn: 该公司将产品出口到海外。
entries.example_en: The company exports its products overseas.

entries.definition_en: to watch and direct the work of others
entries.example_cn: 她将负责监督这个建设项目。
entries.example_en: She will oversee the construction project.

entries.definition_en: a person who supervises people or work
entries.example_cn: 现场监督员检查了所有安全规定是否得到遵守。
entries.example_en: The site overseer checked that all safety rules were followed.

entries.definition_en: too easily offended or upset; thin-skinned
entries.example_cn: 他对批评过分敏感，拒绝讨论此事。
entries.example_en: He was oversensitive about the criticism and refused to discuss it.

entries.definition_en: having too much sexual desire or being too interested in sex
entries.example_cn: 这个角色因在电影中表现得性欲过盛而受到批评。
entries.example_en: The character was criticized for being oversexed in the movie.

entries.definition_en: to be more important or significant than something else
entries.example_cn: 他的成就使前辈们的成就相形见绌。
entries.example_en: His achievements overshadowed those of his predecessors.

entries.definition_en: to make someone or something seem less important by comparison
entries.example_cn: 丑闻使政党的主要政策提案显得无足轻重。
entries.example_en: The scandal overshadowed the party's main policy proposals.

entries.definition_en: to cast a shadow over something
entries.example_cn: 乌云开始笼罩体育场。
entries.example_en: Dark clouds began to overshadow the stadium.

entries.definition_en: to shoot beyond a target or go past a target or limit
entries.example_cn: 箭射过了目标好几米。
entries.example_en: The arrow overshot the target by several meters.

entries.definition_en: to aim too high or far
entries.example_cn: 我们的目标不应该定得太高；让我们从可实现的事情开始吧。
entries.example_en: We shouldn't overshoot our goals; let's start with something achievable.

entries.definition_en: the amount by which something goes too far
entries.example_cn: 超出跑道的距离为两米。
entries.example_en: The overshoot was two meters beyond the runway.

entries.definition_en: having the upper teeth projecting beyond the lower
entries.example_cn: 有些狗上牙突出于下牙。
entries.example_en: Some dogs are overshot, with their upper teeth projecting beyond the lower ones.

entries.definition_cn: （水轮）由从上方流过顶部的水流驱动的
entries.definition_en: powered by water flowing over the top, as of a water wheel
entries.example_cn: 这座磨坊用上击式水轮驱动机械。
entries.example_en: The mill used an overshot water wheel to power its machinery.

entries.definition_cn: 一种以平纹织物为底、配以附加纬纱浮线的纺织图案
entries.definition_en: a textile pattern made with a plain-weave ground and floats of supplemental weft
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展出了一床带有精美浮纬图案的殖民时期床罩。
entries.example_en: The museum displayed a colonial coverlet with an intricate overshot pattern.

entries.definition_en: over the side of a boat
entries.example_cn: 潜水员跳过船舷，进入清澈的蓝水中。
entries.example_en: The diver jumped overside into the clear blue water.

entries.definition_en: an unintentional omission caused by failing to notice something
entries.example_cn: 这个错误是编辑的疏忽。
entries.example_en: The error was an oversight on the part of the editor.

entries.definition_en: the management of a person or group by monitoring their performance
entries.example_cn: 董事会负责监督公司。
entries.example_en: The board of directors is responsible for the oversight of the company.

entries.definition_en: a mistake resulting from inattention
entries.example_cn: 请再次检查报告以避免任何过失。
entries.example_en: Please check the report again to avoid any oversight.

entries.definition_en: the process of making something seem simpler than it really is
entries.example_cn: 对该理论的过度简化掩盖了重要细节。
entries.example_en: The oversimplification of the theory concealed important details.

entries.definition_en: an explanation that simplifies too far to the point of misrepresentation
entries.example_cn: 教科书对历史的过度简化误导了许多学生。
entries.example_en: The textbook's oversimplification of history misled many students.

entries.definition_en: to make something too simple, ignoring important details
entries.example_cn: 你不能过分简化复杂的政治局势。
entries.example_en: You cannot oversimplify the complex political situation.

entries.definition_en: larger than the usual or standard size for its kind
entries.example_cn: 这件超大号的外套对他来说太长，穿起来不舒服。
entries.example_en: The oversized coat was too long for him to wear comfortably.

entries.definition_en: larger than the usual size for its type
entries.example_cn: 他买了一件特大号的外套以在冬天保暖。
entries.example_en: He bought an oversized coat to stay warm in winter.

entries.definition_en: an outer skirt worn over another skirt
entries.example_cn: 她在裙子上面穿了一条长罩裙，以防弄脏。
entries.example_en: She wore a long overskirt over her dress to protect it from the mud.

entries.definition_en: to sleep for a longer time than intended
entries.example_cn: 我每天早上都睡过头，因为我睡得太晚了。
entries.example_en: I oversleep every morning because I go to bed too late.

usage.label: 不及物动词
usage.pattern: oversleep; source w29967r0 marks it intransitive.

entries.definition_en: spend more than available of (a budget)
entries.example_cn: 因为我们在度假礼物上超支了，所以不得不削减饮食开支。
entries.example_en: We had to cut back on our diet because we overspent on holiday gifts.

entries.definition_en: spend at a high rate
entries.example_cn: 该公司在不必要的营销活动上花费过多。
entries.example_en: The company overspent on unnecessary marketing campaigns.

entries.definition_cn: 因超过容器容量而溢出的液体
entries.definition_en: liquid that flows out because it has exceeded the container's capacity
entries.example_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出到附近的田野里。
entries.example_en: The rain caused an overspill from the river into the nearby fields.

entries.definition_cn: 人口从拥挤的城市向小城镇迁移
entries.definition_en: the movement of people from overcrowded cities to smaller towns where they live in new housing
entries.example_cn: 政府建造了新住宅区以容纳从首都溢出的居民。
entries.example_en: The government built new housing estates to accommodate the overspill from the capital.

entries.definition_en: to spread across or over something
entries.example_cn: 厚厚的积雪覆盖了群山。
entries.example_en: A thick layer of snow overspread the mountains.

entries.definition_en: to describe something as being more important, serious, or large than it really is
entries.example_cn: 媒体经常夸大这种新病毒的危险性。
entries.example_en: The media often overstate the dangers of the new virus.

entries.definition_en: represented as greater than is true or reasonable
entries.example_cn: 演讲者的说法往往言过其实，以给听众留下深刻印象。
entries.example_en: The speaker's claims were often overstated to impress the audience.

entries.definition_en: an exaggerated statement or claim
entries.example_cn: 他说自己是最好的球员，这有些言过其实。
entries.example_en: His claim of being the best player was an overstatement.

entries.definition_en: to stay somewhere for too long
entries.example_cn: 如果你签证过期逗留，可能会被驱逐出境。
entries.example_en: If you overstay your visa, you may be deported from the country.

entries.definition_en: a situation where a car turns more sharply than the driver intended
entries.example_cn: 司机在结冰的路面上因严重的转向过度而失去了控制。
entries.example_en: The driver lost control due to severe oversteer on the icy road.

usage.label: countable or uncountable
usage.pattern: 可作可数或不可数名词

entries.definition_en: to go beyond limits or boundaries
entries.example_cn: 你不得超越作为经理的职权范围。
entries.example_en: You must not overstep your authority as a manager.

entries.definition_en: to be superior to or exceed a standard
entries.example_cn: 他的表现超越了所有先前的记录。
entries.example_en: His performance overstepped all previous records.

entries.definition_en: to stock something excessively
entries.example_cn: 仓库经理决定在假日季节前将货架库存过多。
entries.example_en: The warehouse manager decided to overstock the shelves before the holiday season.

entries.definition_en: to strain excessively
entries.example_cn: 搬重物时不要过度用力伤到背部。
entries.example_en: Do not overstrain your back when lifting heavy boxes.

entries.definition_en: excessive physical or mental strain
entries.example_cn: 长途旅行使司机过度疲劳。
entries.example_en: The long journey caused the driver severe overstrain.

entries.definition_en: to place special or excessive emphasis on something
entries.example_cn: 老师警告学生不要在作文中过分强调次要细节。
entries.example_en: The teacher warned students not to overstress the minor details in their essays.

entries.definition_en: to strain abnormally or beyond one's limits
entries.example_cn: 如果你过度拉伸肌肉，可能会导致严重受伤。
entries.example_en: If you overstretch your muscles, you risk causing a serious injury.

entries.definition_en: filled with thick, deep upholstery
entries.example_cn: 那张填充厚实饱满的扶手椅坐起来非常舒服。
entries.example_en: The overstuffed armchair was very comfortable to sit in.

entries.definition_cn: 塞得过满的；装得超过容量的
entries.definition_en: filled beyond capacity
entries.example_cn: 那个塞得过满的行李箱关不上。
entries.example_en: The overstuffed suitcase would not close.

entries.definition_en: having more applicants or orders than available seats or items
entries.example_cn: 音乐会门票在开售几分钟内就被超额认购了。
entries.example_en: The concert tickets were oversubscribed within minutes of going on sale.

entries.definition_en: a situation where there is too much of something, causing prices to drop
entries.example_cn: 近期的小麦供过于求导致全球价格下跌。
entries.example_en: The recent oversupply of wheat has driven down global prices.

entries.definition_en: to provide more of something than is needed or wanted
entries.example_cn: 该工厂决定向市场供应过剩产品以清理库存。
entries.example_en: The factory decided to oversupply the market to clear its inventory.

entries.definition_en: done openly and clearly; not secret or hidden
entries.example_cn: 该公司公开试图收购竞争对手公司。
entries.example_en: The company made an overt attempt to acquire the rival firm.

entries.definition_en: to become greater than something else in amount, value, or importance
entries.example_cn: 北方的杂货销售额已经超过了南方。
entries.example_en: Grocery sales in the north have overtaken those in the south.

usage.label: transitive
usage.pattern: overtake something in amount or value

entries.definition_en: to catch up with and pass someone or something that is moving more slowly
entries.example_cn: 那辆更快的车在高速公路上成功超过了卡车。
entries.example_en: The faster car managed to overtake the truck on the highway.

entries.definition_en: to overcome or be overcome by strong emotions or stimuli
entries.example_cn: 听到这个消息时，她突然被一阵悲伤淹没了。
entries.example_en: She was overtaken by a sudden wave of sadness when she heard the news.

entries.definition_en: the act of passing a moving vehicle or person to get ahead of it
entries.example_cn: 超车很危险，因为路很窄。
entries.example_en: The overtaking was dangerous because the road was narrow.

entries.definition_en: to burden someone or something with too much work or responsibility
entries.example_cn: 不断的截止日期开始使团队的耐心和资源不堪重负。
entries.example_en: The constant deadlines began to overtax the team's patience and resources.

entries.definition_en: to think about something too much
entries.example_cn: 不要过度思考这个问题。
entries.example_en: Do not overthink the problem.

entries.definition_en: cause the downfall of a ruler or government
entries.example_cn: 人民起义推翻了腐败的政权。
entries.example_en: The people rose up to overthrow the corrupt regime.

entries.definition_en: to overturn a decision or ruling
entries.example_cn: 上诉法院推翻了下级法院的判决。
entries.example_en: The appeals court overthrew the lower court's ruling.

entries.definition_en: the termination of a ruler or institution, especially by force
entries.example_cn: 革命导致了独裁者的被推翻。
entries.example_en: The revolution led to the overthrow of the dictator.

entries.definition_en: an act that disturbs the mind or body
entries.example_cn: 突如其来的噪音扰乱了她的注意力。
entries.example_en: The sudden noise was an overthrow of her concentration.

entries.definition_en: work done in addition to regular working hours
entries.example_cn: 她加班赶在截止日期前完成了项目。
entries.example_en: She worked overtime to finish the project before the deadline.

entries.definition_en: playing time beyond regulation, to break a tie
entries.example_cn: 那支球队在加时赛中赢得了比赛。
entries.example_en: The team won the game in overtime.

entries.definition_en: beyond the regular time
entries.example_cn: 由于意外的问题，会议在正常时间之后才结束。
entries.example_en: The meeting ran overtime due to the unexpected questions.

entries.definition_en: in a way that is clear and obvious to everyone
entries.example_cn: 该公司公开支持这项新政策。
entries.example_en: The company overtly supported the new policy.

entries.definition_en: an underlying or hidden meaning that is not directly stated
entries.example_cn: 他的声音里带有一丝讽刺的言外之意。
entries.example_en: There was an overtone of sarcasm in his voice.

entries.definition_en: a higher-pitched sound produced by a musical instrument along with the main note
entries.example_cn: 小提琴丰富音色的一部分原因在于其复杂的泛音。
entries.example_en: The violin's rich tone is partly due to its complex overtones.

entries.definition_en: to be higher than something else
entries.example_cn: 洪水淹没了堤坝。
entries.example_en: The floodwaters overtopped the levee.

entries.definition_en: music played by an orchestra at the start of an opera or oratorio
entries.example_cn: 音乐会以一首气势磅礴的序曲开场。
entries.example_en: The concert began with a dramatic overture.

entries.definition_en: an event or action that introduces something else
entries.example_cn: 这项新政策是进一步改革的开端。
entries.example_en: The new policy was an overture to further reforms.

entries.definition_en: a tentative suggestion made to see how others react
entries.example_cn: 他向该公司提出了一项试探性提议，商讨合并事宜。
entries.example_en: He made an overture to the company to discuss a merger.

entries.definition_en: turn over from an upright or normal position
entries.example_cn: 船在暴风雨中翻了。
entries.example_en: The boat overturned in the storm.

entries.definition_en: to cause something to fall over from an upright position
entries.example_cn: 孩子们试图把椅子推倒。
entries.example_en: The children tried to overturn the chair.

entries.definition_en: to make a legal decision against a previous ruling
entries.example_cn: 法院决定推翻判决。
entries.example_en: The court decided to overturn the verdict.

entries.definition_en: to cause a government or ruler to lose power
entries.example_cn: 革命者计划推翻君主制。
entries.example_en: The revolutionaries planned to overturn the monarchy.

entries.definition_en: to officially cancel or annul something
entries.example_cn: 委员会投票决定正式撤销禁令。
entries.example_en: The committee voted to overturn the ban.

entries.definition_en: the action of turning something upside down
entries.example_cn: 船只倾覆引起了恐慌。
entries.example_en: The overturn of the boat caused panic.

entries.definition_en: to change something completely and radically
entries.example_cn: 新政策将彻底改变传统做法。
entries.example_en: The new policy will overturn traditional practices.

entries.definition_en: an improbable and unexpected victory
entries.example_cn: 弱者的意外胜利震惊了体育界。
entries.example_en: The underdog's overturn shocked the sports world.

entries.definition_en: to make use of something too often or too extensively
entries.example_cn: 你应该避免在论文中滥用技术术语。
entries.example_en: You should avoid overusing technical terms in your essay.

entries.definition_en: the exploitation of something to the point where it becomes less effective
entries.example_cn: 抗生素的过度使用导致了耐药菌的产生。
entries.example_en: The overuse of antibiotics has led to resistant bacteria.

entries.definition_en: excessive use or utilization of something
entries.example_cn: 这家医院的急诊室医护人员正面临过度使用的问题。
entries.example_en: The hospital is facing severe overutilization of its emergency room staff.

entries.definition_en: an assessment of value that is higher than the actual worth
entries.example_cn: 股市崩盘部分是由科技股的高估引起的。
entries.example_en: The stock market crash was partly caused by the overvaluation of technology shares.

entries.definition_en: assigning a price or value that is too high to something
entries.example_cn: 批评人士认为，房产定价过高将使其难以出售。
entries.example_en: Critics argue that the overvaluation of the property will make it difficult to sell.

entries.definition_en: to assign a value that is too high to something
entries.example_cn: 投资者在市场繁荣时期往往会高估新兴科技股票。
entries.example_en: Investors often overvalue new technology stocks during a market boom.

entries.definition_en: a general summary of a subject
entries.example_cn: 这本书提供了现代历史的概述。
entries.example_en: The book provides an overview of modern history.

entries.definition_cn: （电子游戏中的）区域监视，使单位能够对敌方行动作出反应
entries.definition_en: in a video game, observation of an area that lets a unit respond to an enemy's actions
entries.example_cn: 狙击手利用监视掩护小队，以应对敌人的行动。
entries.example_en: The sniper used overwatch to protect the squad from enemy movement.

entries.definition_en: presumptuously arrogant
entries.example_cn: 新经理那傲慢无礼的自信疏远了资深员工。
entries.example_en: The overweening confidence of the new manager alienated the senior staff.

entries.definition_en: unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings
entries.example_cn: 她对该项目无节制的热情使得其他人难以提出批评。
entries.example_en: Her overweening enthusiasm for the project made it difficult for others to offer criticism.

entries.definition_en: having a higher body weight than is generally considered healthy for one's body type and height
entries.example_cn: 他虽然微胖，但骨架很大，所以看起来没有实际那么重。
entries.example_en: He is overweight but has a strong frame, so he doesn't look as heavy as he is.

entries.definition_en: the condition of having too much body fat
entries.example_cn: 医生警告他，他的肥胖正在危及他的心脏。
entries.example_en: The doctor warned him that his overweight was putting his heart at risk.

entries.definition_en: to be overcome by strong emotions or sensory stimuli
entries.example_cn: 日落的壮丽让她不知所措。
entries.example_en: The beauty of the sunset overwhelmed her.

entries.definition_en: to give someone too many tasks to handle
entries.example_cn: 经理决定给新员工分配太多工作，使其不堪重负。
entries.example_en: The manager decided to overwhelm the new employee with work.

entries.definition_en: to defeat someone using superior force
entries.example_cn: 军队被敌军的人数优势击败。
entries.example_en: The army was overwhelmed by the enemy's superior numbers.

entries.definition_en: to cover something completely so it cannot be seen
entries.example_cn: 雪开始完全覆盖了那个小村庄。
entries.example_en: The snow began to overwhelm the small village.

entries.definition_en: so strong as to be irresistible
entries.example_cn: 她感到一种强烈的旅行欲望。
entries.example_en: She felt an overwhelming desire to travel.

entries.definition_en: very strong; urgently felt
entries.example_cn: 房间里弥漫着一种强烈的悲伤感。
entries.example_en: There was an overwhelming sense of sadness in the room.

entries.definition_en: to such a great extent that it is impossible to resist or oppose
entries.example_cn: 这支球队被压倒性地看好将赢得冠军。
entries.example_en: The team was overwhelmingly favored to win the championship.

entries.definition_en: to spend the winter in a particular place or state
entries.example_cn: 许多蝴蝶迁徙到气候更温暖的地区越冬。
entries.example_en: Many butterflies migrate south to overwinter in warmer climates.

entries.definition_en: make someone work too hard
entries.example_cn: 经理拒绝在假期期间让员工过度劳累。
entries.example_en: The manager refused to overwork the staff during the holiday season.

entries.definition_en: work something too hard or excessively
entries.example_cn: 剧烈运动后你不应该过度使用肌肉。
entries.example_en: You should not overwork your muscles after a heavy workout.

entries.definition_en: the act of working too much or too long
entries.example_cn: 长期的过度工作会导致严重的健康问题。
entries.example_en: Chronic overwork can lead to serious health problems.

entries.definition_cn: 在计算机中用新数据覆盖旧数据，使原有内容被擦除
entries.definition_en: to write new information over old data, erasing the original content
entries.example_cn: 小心不要将新版本覆盖掉重要文件。
entries.example_en: Be careful not to overwrite the important file with the new version.

entries.definition_en: deeply agitated from emotion
entries.example_cn: 她悲痛欲绝。
entries.example_en: She was overwrought with grief.

entries.definition_cn: 风格过分繁复或矫饰的
entries.definition_en: excessively elaborate or overdone in style
entries.example_cn: 这篇演讲过分矫饰，听起来像戏剧台词。
entries.example_en: The speech was so overwrought that it sounded theatrical.

entries.definition_cn: 过度热心的；过分热衷的
entries.definition_en: showing too much enthusiasm and devotion to a cause or idea
entries.example_cn: 这些过度热心的志愿者打扫了公园的每一个角落。
entries.example_en: The overzealous volunteers cleaned every corner of the park.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being excessively enthusiastic or eager
entries.example_cn: 他执行规则时的过度狂热使员工感到疏远。
entries.example_en: His overzealousness in enforcing the rules alienated the staff.

entries.definition_en: either of a pair of tubes that conduct the egg from the ovary to the uterus
entries.example_cn: 受精卵通过输卵管到达子宫。
entries.example_en: The fertilized egg travels through the oviduct to reach the uterus.

entries.definition_en: relating to or characteristic of a sheep.
entries.example_cn: 这种羊产的羊毛以其柔软而闻名。
entries.example_en: The wool from the ovine breed is known for its softness.

entries.definition_en: passive and willing to follow others without questioning
entries.example_cn: 委员会中那些盲目顺从的成员未经讨论就批准了这项提案。
entries.example_en: The ovine members of the committee approved the proposal without discussion.

entries.definition_en: producing eggs that develop and hatch outside the mother's body
entries.example_cn: 大多数爬行动物和鸟类都是卵生的，在巢中产卵。
entries.example_en: Most reptiles and birds are oviparous, laying eggs in nests.

entries.definition_en: a tube-like organ at the end of the abdomen used by female insects and some fishes to lay eggs
entries.example_cn: 雌甲虫用她的产卵器将卵插入土壤中。
entries.example_en: The female beetle uses her ovipositor to insert eggs into the soil.

entries.definition_en: having the shape of an egg
entries.example_cn: 这座建筑呈卵形设计。
entries.example_en: The building has an ovoid design.

entries.definition_en: an object that is shaped like an egg
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展出了一件由抛光石制成的卵形物。
entries.example_en: The museum displayed an ovoid object made of polished stone.

entries.definition_cn: 古典建筑中横截面呈四分之一圆形或四分之一椭圆形的凸形线脚，常饰蛋箭纹
entries.definition_en: a classical convex molding with a quarter-circle or quarter-ellipse cross section, often decorated with egg-and-dart ornament
entries.example_cn: 建筑师指定在窗户周围使用横截面呈四分之一圆形、饰有蛋箭纹的凸形线脚。
entries.example_en: The architect specified an ovolo molding with a quarter-round profile and egg-and-dart ornament around the window.

entries.definition_en: producing living young from eggs that hatch within the mother's body
entries.example_cn: 鲨鱼通常是卵胎生的，这意味着胚胎在体内发育，直到孵化前一直留在母体内。
entries.example_en: Sharks are often ovoviviparous, meaning the embryos develop inside eggs that remain in the mother's body until they hatch.

entries.definition_en: relating to an ovum
entries.example_cn: 卵膜保护着正在发育的胚胎。
entries.example_en: The ovular membrane protects the developing embryo.

entries.definition_en: having the nature of an ovule
entries.example_cn: 在发育的早期阶段，胚珠细胞开始分裂。
entries.example_en: The ovular cells begin to divide during the early stages of development.

entries.definition_en: to release an ovum from an ovary
entries.example_cn: 女性通常每月排卵一次。
entries.example_en: Women typically ovulate once a month.

entries.definition_en: the release of an egg from the ovary during the menstrual cycle
entries.example_cn: 医生通常会测试排卵以帮助夫妇受孕。
entries.example_en: Doctors often test for ovulation to help couples conceive.

entries.definition_en: a small body that contains the female germ cell of a plant; develops into a seed after fertilization
entries.example_cn: 受精后，胚珠发育成种子。
entries.example_en: The ovule develops into a seed after fertilization.

entries.definition_en: a small or immature ovum
entries.example_cn: 胚珠是一个微小或未成熟的卵。
entries.example_en: The ovule is a small or immature ovum.

entries.definition_en: the female reproductive cell
entries.example_cn: 当精子与卵细胞相遇时，受精就会发生。
entries.example_en: Fertilization occurs when a sperm meets an ovum.

entries.definition_cn: 欠某人钱，因而有义务偿还
entries.definition_en: be obliged to pay or repay money to someone
entries.example_cn: 我欠朋友五十美元的午餐钱。
entries.example_en: I owe my friend fifty dollars for lunch.

usage.label: 搭配
usage.pattern: owe someone something；owe something to someone

entries.definition_en: be indebted to someone in an abstract or intellectual sense
entries.example_cn: 我们要归功于我们团队的辛勤工作。
entries.example_en: We owe our success to the hard work of our team.

entries.definition_en: be in debt to someone
entries.example_cn: 他欠几家银行的债。
entries.example_en: He owes money to several banks.

entries.definition_en: still owed as a debt
entries.example_cn: 这笔贷款的欠款金额已经减少。
entries.example_en: The amount owing on the loan has decreased.

entries.definition_en: a nocturnal bird of prey with a hawk-like beak, claws, and large front-facing eyes
entries.example_cn: 猫头鹰在黑暗的森林里大声鸣叫。
entries.example_en: The owl hooted loudly in the dark forest.

entries.definition_en: a young owl
entries.example_cn: 那只幼猫头鹰蜷缩在叶子下取暖。
entries.example_en: The owlet huddled under the leaves to stay warm.

entries.definition_en: resembling an owl in appearance or behavior; solemn and wise-looking
entries.example_cn: 教授坐在猫头鹰般的沉默中，全神贯注地倾听学生复杂的论点。
entries.example_en: The professor sat in an owlish silence, listening intently to the student's complex argument.

entries.definition_en: belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive
entries.example_cn: 这是我的书。
entries.example_en: This is my own book.

usage.label: possessive determiner referring back to the subject

entries.definition_en: to have ownership or possession of something
entries.example_cn: 他们拥有隔壁那栋房子。
entries.example_en: They own the house next door.

entries.definition_en: having an owner
entries.example_cn: 有主的财产昨天被卖掉了。
entries.example_en: The owned property was sold yesterday.

entries.definition_en: a person who owns something
entries.example_cn: 狗的主人带它在公园里散步。
entries.example_en: The owner of the dog walked it in the park.

entries.definition_en: the person who legally owns a business
entries.example_cn: 餐厅的老板决定提前关门。
entries.example_en: The owner of the restaurant decided to close early.

entries.definition_cn: 在工作中驾驶自己所拥有车辆的司机
entries.definition_en: a driver who owns the vehicle they use in their job
entries.example_cn: 车主司机通常使用自己的面包车送货。
entries.example_en: Owner-drivers often use their own vans to make deliveries.

entries.definition_en: a person who owns and lives in their own home
entries.example_cn: 政府为自住房主提供税收减免。
entries.example_en: The government offers tax breaks to owner-occupiers.

entries.definition_en: having no owner
entries.example_cn: 那只流浪狗在无主的田野里游荡。
entries.example_en: The stray dog wandered through the ownerless fields.

entries.definition_en: the relationship between an owner and what they own; having the right to transfer possession
entries.example_cn: 该公司的所有权已转让给一位新投资者。
entries.example_en: The ownership of the company was transferred to a new investor.

entries.definition_cn: 对某事的责任或控制权
entries.definition_en: responsibility for or control over something
entries.example_cn: 她承担了这个项目的责任。
entries.example_en: She took ownership of the project.

entries.definition_cn: 成为所有者的状态或事实
entries.definition_en: the state or fact of being an owner
entries.example_cn: 她为自己拥有这座历史建筑而感到自豪。
entries.example_en: She took pride in her ownership of the historic building.

entries.definition_en: an adult castrated bull of the genus Bos; especially Bos taurus
entries.example_cn: 农民用一头阉牛拉着犁在田里耕作。
entries.example_en: Farmers use an ox to pull the heavy plow through the field.

entries.definition_cn: 各种野生牛科动物，尤其是牛属或与其关系密切的野牛属
entries.definition_en: any of various wild bovines especially of the genera Bos or closely related Bibos
entries.example_cn: 古老的洞穴壁画描绘了一群在平原上漫游的野生牛群。
entries.example_en: The ancient cave paintings depict a herd of wild ox roaming the plains.

entries.definition_en: having large round eyes similar to those of an ox
entries.example_cn: 那个牛眼般大眼睛的孩子瞪着我们。
entries.example_en: The ox-eyed child stared at us with large, round eyes.

entries.definition_en: a type of penicillin antibiotic that is resistant to penicillinase and effective against penicillin-resistant staphylococci
entries.example_cn: 医生开了甲氧西林来治疗患者由耐药细菌引起的严重感染。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed oxacillin to treat the patient's severe infection caused by resistant bacteria.

entries.definition_en: a salt or ester derived from oxalic acid
entries.example_cn: 菠菜含有高水平的草酸盐，这会干扰钙的吸收。
entries.example_en: Spinach contains a high level of oxalate, which can interfere with calcium absorption.

entries.definition_en: relating to or derived from oxalic acid
entries.example_cn: 菠菜含有草酸，因此叶片中含有草酸化合物。
entries.example_en: Spinach contains oxalic acid, so oxalic compounds are found in the leaves.

entries.definition_en: any plant or flower belonging to the genus Oxalis
entries.example_cn: 花园里开满了五颜六色的酢浆草。
entries.example_en: The garden is filled with colorful oxalis in the spring.

entries.definition_en: a salt or ester of oxalacetic acid
entries.example_cn: 草酰乙酸在代谢循环中起关键作用。
entries.example_en: Oxaloacetate plays a key role in metabolic cycles.

entries.definition_en: a tranquilizing drug used to treat anxiety, insomnia, and alcohol withdrawal
entries.example_cn: 患者被给予奥沙西泮以帮助管理焦虑和失眠症状。
entries.example_en: The patient was given oxazepam to help manage symptoms of anxiety and sleeplessness.

entries.definition_en: a U-shaped curve in a stream
entries.example_cn: 蜿蜒的河流在开辟新河道前形成了一个明显的河曲。
entries.example_en: The meandering river formed a distinct oxbow before cutting a new channel.

entries.definition_en: the land enclosed by an oxbow bend in a river
entries.example_cn: 农民常利用河曲内肥沃的土地放牧。
entries.example_en: Farmers often use the fertile soil of the oxbow for grazing.

entries.definition_en: a wooden framework bent into a U-shape to fit around an ox's neck
entries.example_cn: 农夫将沉重的牛轭架在牛的肩膀上以拉动犁。
entries.example_en: The farmer placed the heavy oxbow across the ox's shoulders to pull the plow.

entries.definition_en: a cart pulled by an ox
entries.example_cn: 他们乘坐牛车穿越沙漠。
entries.example_en: They traveled across the desert in an oxcart.

entries.definition_cn: ox 的复数；尤指用作役畜的阉公牛
entries.definition_en: the plural of ox, especially referring to castrated male cattle used as draft animals
entries.example_cn: 农民们用役牛犁那片坚硬的土地。
entries.example_en: The farmers used oxen to plow the hard ground.

entries.definition_en: a low shoe with laces that go over the instep
entries.example_cn: 他穿着黑色的牛津鞋去参加正式晚宴。
entries.example_en: He wore black oxfords to the formal dinner.

entries.definition_en: a substance that causes oxidation in another substance
entries.example_cn: 过氧化氢是化学中常用的一种氧化剂。
entries.example_en: Hydrogen peroxide is a common oxidant used in chemistry.

entries.definition_en: an enzyme that catalyzes biological oxidation reactions
entries.example_cn: 科学家发现了一种能帮助植物分解毒素的新氧化酶。
entries.example_en: Scientists discovered a new oxidase that helps plants break down toxins.

entries.definition_cn: 氧化过程；物质失去电子或与氧结合的化学过程
entries.definition_en: the chemical process in which a substance loses electrons or combines with oxygen; it is coupled with reduction in a redox reaction
entries.example_cn: 铁桥的生锈是氧化的一个明显例子。
entries.example_en: The rusting of the iron bridge is a clear example of oxidation.

entries.definition_en: a reversible chemical reaction where one part is oxidation and the other is reduction
entries.example_cn: 电池通过氧化还原过程运作。
entries.example_en: The battery operates through an oxidation-reduction process.

entries.definition_en: of, relating to, or produced by oxidation
entries.example_cn: 氧化过程分解了土壤中的有机物质。
entries.example_en: The oxidative process breaks down the organic matter in the soil.

entries.definition_en: a binary chemical compound formed from oxygen and another element
entries.example_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
entries.example_en: Rust is an oxide of iron.

entries.definition_en: the process of adding oxygen to a compound, which involves losing electrons and always happens together with reduction
entries.example_cn: 铁生锈是氧化作用的一个常见例子。
entries.example_en: The rusting of iron is a common example of oxidisation.

entries.definition_en: to add oxygen to something or cause it to combine with oxygen
entries.example_cn: 暴露在雨水和空气中会使铁迅速氧化。
entries.example_en: Exposure to rain and air will oxidise the iron quickly.

entries.definition_en: to become converted into an oxide or enter into a combination with oxygen
entries.example_cn: 当铜氧化时，它会变成绿色。
entries.example_en: When copper oxidises, it turns green.

entries.definition_en: combined with or having undergone a chemical reaction with oxygen
entries.example_cn: 这座铁桥在多年风雨侵蚀后已经氧化了。
entries.example_en: The iron bridge had become oxidised after years of exposure to rain.

entries.definition_en: a substance that causes another substance to oxidize
entries.example_cn: 过氧化氢在化学反应中充当强氧化剂。
entries.example_en: Hydrogen peroxide acts as a powerful oxidiser in chemical reactions.

entries.definition_en: Capable of being oxidized.
entries.example_cn: 铁是可氧化的，这就是为什么它暴露在空气和湿气中会生锈。
entries.example_en: Iron is oxidizable, which is why it rusts when exposed to air and moisture.

entries.definition_cn: 氧化过程，即失去电子或氧化数升高的过程；也可指与氧结合
entries.definition_en: the process of oxidation, involving loss of electrons or an increase in oxidation state; it may involve combining with oxygen
entries.example_cn: 铁的生锈是氧化作用的一个常见例子。
entries.example_en: The rusting of iron is a common example of oxidization.

entries.definition_cn: 氧化；通常指与氧结合或失去电子
entries.definition_en: to undergo oxidation, typically by combining with oxygen or losing electrons
entries.example_cn: 如果将铁暴露在雨和空气中，它会氧化。
entries.example_en: Iron will oxidize if left exposed to rain and air.

entries.definition_en: to cause a substance to undergo oxidation, typically by adding oxygen or removing electrons
entries.example_cn: 该化学过程使金属表面氧化。
entries.example_en: The chemical process oxidizes the metal surface.

entries.definition_en: having combined with oxygen through a chemical reaction
entries.example_cn: 这座氧化的铜像随着时间推移变成了绿色。
entries.example_en: The oxidized copper statue has turned green over time.

entries.definition_en: a substance that causes other substances to oxidize
entries.example_cn: 这种火箭燃料含有一种强效氧化剂。
entries.example_en: The rocket fuel contains a powerful oxidizer.

entries.definition_en: an enzyme that speeds up chemical reactions involving the transfer of electrons
entries.example_cn: 科学家研究了该氧化还原酶在代谢途径中的作用。
entries.example_en: The scientist studied the function of the oxidoreductase in the metabolic pathway.

entries.definition_en: a compound containing the group -C=NOH
entries.example_cn: 化学家合成各种肟以研究其在有机反应中的反应性。
entries.example_en: Chemists synthesize various oximes to study their reactivity in organic reactions.

entries.definition_cn: 测量氧饱和度（尤指动脉血氧饱和度）的仪器
entries.definition_en: a device that measures oxygen saturation, especially in arterial blood
entries.example_cn: 护士将血氧仪夹在病人的手指上，以监测血氧饱和度。
entries.example_en: The nurse attached the oximeter to the patient's finger to monitor blood oxygen saturation.

entries.definition_en: the skinned tail of cattle, used especially for soups
entries.example_cn: 我们晚餐点了一道用牛尾做的浓郁牛肉炖菜。
entries.example_en: We ordered a rich beef stew with oxtail for dinner.

entries.definition_cn: 氧乙炔（用于切割或焊接金属的高温混合气体）
entries.definition_en: a mixture of oxygen and acetylene used to create high temperatures for cutting or welding metals
entries.example_cn: 焊工使用氧乙炔焊炬连接钢梁。
entries.example_en: The welder used an oxyacetylene torch to join the steel beams.

entries.definition_cn: 使用氧气和乙炔混合气体的
entries.definition_en: using a mixture of oxygen and acetylene
entries.example_cn: 技术员使用氧乙炔焊炬切割金属。
entries.example_en: The technician used an oxyacetylene torch to cut through the metal.

entries.definition_cn: 一种无色、无味、无臭的气体，对呼吸至关重要，约占空气体积的21%。
entries.definition_en: a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is essential for breathing and makes up about 21% of the air.
entries.example_cn: 植物在光合作用过程中向大气中释放氧气。
entries.example_en: Plants release oxygen into the atmosphere during photosynthesis.

entries.definition_en: an enzyme that catalyzes the addition of oxygen to a molecule
entries.example_cn: 科学家们正在研究一种特定的加氧酶，以了解植物如何处理氮。
entries.example_en: Scientists are studying a specific oxygenase to understand how plants process nitrogen.

entries.definition_en: to supply something with oxygen
entries.example_cn: 这台机器旨在为水族箱中的水充氧。
entries.example_en: The machine is designed to oxygenate the water in the aquarium.

entries.definition_en: the process of providing or combining with oxygen
entries.example_cn: 血液的氧合对生命至关重要。
entries.example_en: The oxygenation of the blood is essential for life.

entries.definition_en: bright red hemoglobin combined with oxygen
entries.example_cn: 氧合血红蛋白将氧气从肺部输送到身体组织。
entries.example_en: Oxyhemoglobin carries oxygen from the lungs to the body tissues.

entries.definition_en: conjoining contradictory terms (as in ‘deafening silence’)
entries.example_cn: “震耳欲聋的沉默”是矛盾修辞法的经典例子。
entries.example_en: The phrase 'deafening silence' is a classic example of an oxymoron.

entries.definition_en: a yellow crystalline antibiotic used to treat bacterial and rickettsial infections
entries.example_cn: 医生开了土霉素来治疗患者严重的感染。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed oxytetracycline to treat the patient's severe infection.

entries.definition_en: a drug that induces labor by stimulating uterine contractions
entries.example_cn: 医生给病人注射了催产剂以帮助开始分娩。
entries.example_en: The doctor administered an oxytocic to help start the labor.

entries.definition_cn: 促进子宫收缩从而加速分娩的
entries.definition_en: promoting uterine contractions and thereby accelerating childbirth
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一种促进子宫收缩的催产药。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed an oxytocic drug to stimulate uterine contractions.

entries.definition_en: a hormone that causes the uterus to contract and milk to be released
entries.example_cn: 医生可能会给产妇使用催产素，通过刺激子宫收缩来引产。
entries.example_en: Doctors may administer oxytocin to induce labor by stimulating uterine contractions.

entries.definition_en: the absolute leader of a yakuza clan
entries.example_cn: 这位日本黑帮家族首领为帮派作出了最终决定。
entries.example_en: The oyabun made the final decision for the yakuza clan.

entries.definition_en: marine mollusks having a rough irregular shell; found on the sea bed mostly in coastal waters
entries.example_cn: 我们在岩石海岸发现了许多牡蛎。
entries.example_en: We found many oysters on the rocky shore.

entries.definition_en: edible body of any of numerous oysters
entries.example_cn: 厨师用新鲜的牡蛎肉做了一道菜。
entries.example_en: The chef prepared a dish with fresh oyster.

entries.definition_en: a small muscle on each side of the back of a fowl
entries.example_cn: 屠夫在烹饪前从鸡身上去除了胸肌。
entries.example_en: The butcher removed the oyster from the chicken before cooking.

entries.definition_en: gather oysters, dig oysters
entries.example_cn: 渔民们每年夏天都在海湾里采牡蛎。
entries.example_en: The fishermen oyster in the bay every summer.

entries.example_en: The oystercatcher uses its strong bill to pry open oyster shells on the beach.

entries.definition_en: a colorless gas that is a strong oxidizing agent and protects Earth from ultraviolet radiation

entries.example_en: Ozone in the stratosphere acts as a shield against harmful UV rays.

entries.definition_en: the sixteenth letter of the Roman alphabet

entries.example_en: The word starts with the letter P.

entries.definition_en: a multivalent nonmetallic element of the nitrogen family that occurs commonly in inorganic phosphate rocks and as organic phosphates in all living cells; is highly reactive and occurs in several allotropic forms
entries.example_cn: 植物需要磷才能正常生长。
entries.example_en: Plants need P to grow properly.

entries.definition_en: an electronic amplification system used for communication in public areas

entries.definition_en: a metabolic acid found in yeast and liver cells, used to make dyes, drugs, and sun blockers

entries.example_en: Scientists study PABA to develop new types of sun blockers for skincare products.

usage.label: uncountable

entries.definition_en: a committee formed by a special-interest group to raise money for their favorite political candidates

entries.example_en: The PAC donated millions to support the candidate.

entries.definition_en: the British system where tax is deducted from wages before they are paid to the employee

entries.definition_cn: 等于10^15字节的数字信息单位；拍字节（PB）

entries.example_en: The new server can store 5 PB of data.

entries.definition_en: a unit of digital information equal to 1,024 tebibytes

entries.example_en: The database requires a minimum of 2 PB of storage space.

entries.definition_en: a solution containing a phosphate buffer

entries.definition_en: a small handheld electronic device used for specific tasks like keeping a diary, acting as a phone, or serving as an alarm clock

entries.definition_en: a PET scan, a medical imaging test using positron emission tomography to examine metabolic activity

entries.example_en: The doctor ordered a PET scan to examine metabolic activity in the brain.

entries.definition_cn: 全氟化碳（perfluorocarbon）的缩写；一类氟碳化合物，其中气态全氟化碳是强效温室气体，可在铝生产过程中排放。

entries.example_en: Regulations aim to reduce PFC emissions from industrial processes.

entries.definition_en: an agency that serves as the office of Surgeon General; includes agencies whose mission is to improve the public health
entries.example_cn: 公共卫生署负责监督全国健康倡议，以提高公共安全。

entries.definition_en: inflammation of the female pelvic organs caused by infection

entries.definition_cn: 重构的史前印度-欧洲语系祖语
entries.definition_en: the reconstructed prehistoric ancestor of the Indo-European languages

entries.example_en: PIE is reconstructed from similarities among Indo-European languages.

entries.definition_en: a type of application software that functions as a personal organizer

entries.example_en: The PIM helped me keep track of my appointments and contacts.

entries.definition_en: a secret number used to access accounts
entries.example_cn: 你需要输入个人识别码才能登录你的银行账户。

entries.definition_en: a kidney disease characterized by enlarged kidneys containing many cysts, often leading to kidney failure
entries.example_cn: 在多年管理多囊肾病后，患者最终需要肾移植。

entries.definition_en: a genetic disorder in which phenylalanine accumulates because the body cannot properly process it, potentially causing intellectual disability if untreated
entries.example_cn: 早期诊断苯丙酮尿症可以通过饮食预防严重症状。

entries.definition_en: Peking University, a university in Beijing, China

entries.definition_en: a political movement uniting Palestinian Arabs in an effort to create an independent state of Palestine

entries.definition_en: the person who holds the position of head of the government in the United Kingdom

entries.definition_en: an examination and dissection of a dead body to determine cause of death or the changes produced by disease

entries.definition_en: modulation of the phase of the carrier wave

entries.definition_en: (Christianity) the abode of righteous souls after death
