entries.example_en: She wrote her letter on paper.

entries.definition_en: an essay written as an assignment
entries.example_cn: 我不得不为历史课写一篇论文。
entries.example_en: I have to write a paper for history class.

entries.definition_en: a daily or weekly publication containing news and articles
entries.example_cn: 我每天读早报。
entries.example_en: I read the morning paper every day.

entries.definition_en: a scholarly article describing research results
entries.example_cn: 她在科学期刊上发表了一篇论文。
entries.example_en: She published a paper in a scientific journal.

entries.definition_en: a medium for written communication
entries.example_cn: 互联网改变了我们使用书面交流媒介的方式。
entries.example_en: The internet has changed the way we use paper.

entries.definition_en: to cover with wallpaper
entries.example_cn: 我们决定给客厅贴墙纸。
entries.example_en: We decided to paper the living room.

entries.definition_en: to cover with paper
entries.example_cn: 她用牛皮纸把盒子包了起来。
entries.example_en: She papered the box with brown paper.

entries.definition_en: a business firm that publishes newspapers
entries.example_cn: 这家报社新聘了两名记者。
entries.example_en: The paper hired two new reporters.

entries.definition_en: a clerk or bureaucrat who does paperwork
entries.example_cn: 新经理承诺不再把员工当成只会处理文书工作的人对待。
entries.example_en: The new manager promised to stop treating the staff like paper-pushers.

entries.definition_en: a book with a flexible paper cover instead of hard cardboard
entries.example_cn: 他在机场买了一本该小说廉价的平装版。
entries.example_en: He bought a cheap paperback version of the novel at the airport.

entries.definition_en: having a flexible paper cover
entries.example_cn: 图书馆最近收购了大量平装小说。
entries.example_en: The library recently acquired a large collection of paperback fiction.

entries.definition_en: to publish or issue a book in a paperback edition
entries.example_cn: 这部小说的精装本畅销后，出版商决定推出平装本。
entries.example_en: The publisher decided to paperback the novel after its hardcover edition sold well.

entries.definition_en: thick paper or thin cardboard
entries.example_cn: 艺术家用厚纸板印制了这张大海报。
entries.example_en: The artist printed the large poster on heavy paperboard.

entries.definition_en: a young boy who delivers newspapers
entries.example_cn: 报童在早上六点敲门送早报。
entries.example_en: The paperboy knocked on the door at 6 a.m. to deliver the morning edition.

entries.definition_en: a clip made of wire or plastic used to hold sheets of paper together
entries.example_cn: 她用回形针把松散的页面夹在一起。
entries.example_en: She used a paperclip to fasten the loose pages.

entries.definition_en: to fasten something with a paper clip
entries.example_cn: 她用回形针把收据夹在申请表上。
entries.example_en: She paperclipped the receipt to the application form.

entries.definition_en: a person whose job is to hang wallpaper on walls
entries.example_cn: 我们请了一位专业的裱糊工用新壁纸装饰我们的客厅。
entries.example_en: We hired a professional paperhanger to decorate our living room with new wallpaper.

entries.definition_en: someone who passes bad checks or counterfeit paper money
entries.example_cn: 侦探怀疑那个伪造货币者用假钞支付那辆豪华汽车的费用。
entries.example_en: The detective suspected the paperhanger of using fake bills to pay for the luxury car.

entries.definition_en: the act of covering walls with wallpaper
entries.example_cn: 翻新工程包括给客厅墙壁大面积贴壁纸。
entries.example_en: The renovation project involved extensive papering of the living room walls.

entries.definition_en: the craft of making paper
entries.example_cn: 博物馆有一个专门介绍造纸术历史的展区。
entries.example_en: The museum has a section dedicated to the history of papermaking.

entries.definition_cn: 官方文件或身份证件，如护照
entries.definition_en: official documents or identification documents, such as a passport
entries.example_cn: 离开前请签署这些文件。
entries.example_en: Please sign these papers before leaving.

entries.definition_en: a weight used to hold down a stack of papers
entries.example_cn: 她用一块沉重的大理石作为镇纸，使文件保持平整。
entries.example_en: She used a heavy marble as a paperweight to keep the documents flat.

entries.definition_cn: 处理文件、表格、信件或报告等工作
entries.definition_en: work involving the handling of documents such as forms, letters, or reports
entries.example_cn: 申报纳税涉及大量的文书工作。
entries.example_en: Filing the tax return involves a lot of paperwork.

entries.definition_en: having a texture that is thin and like paper
entries.example_cn: 这张旧地图因年代久远而变得像纸一样薄且易碎。
entries.example_en: The old map had become papery and brittle from age.

entries.definition_en: resembling or made of paper
entries.example_cn: 他们用一种纸制的材料制作了模型飞机。
entries.example_en: They used a papery material to construct the model airplane.

entries.definition_en: a substance made from paper pulp that can be molded when wet and painted when dry
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家用纸浆模塑材料制作了一座大型雕塑。
entries.example_en: The artist created a large sculpture using papier-mache.

entries.definition_cn: 与味觉、触觉或嗅觉相关的小乳头状突起
entries.definition_en: a small nipple-shaped protuberance concerned with taste, touch, or smell
entries.example_cn: 舌头上的小乳头状突起帮助我们辨别不同的味道。
entries.example_en: The papilla on the tongue helps us distinguish different flavors.

entries.definition_cn: 伸入毛发、羽毛或发育中牙齿根部并为其提供营养的结缔组织血管突起
entries.definition_en: a vascular process of connective tissue extending into and nourishing the root of a hair, feather, or developing tooth
entries.example_cn: 毛发根部的真皮乳头为生长中的毛囊提供营养。
entries.example_en: The dermal papilla at the base of the hair nourishes the growing follicle.

entries.definition_cn: （植物学）植物上的小肉质突起
entries.definition_en: a small fleshy projection on a plant
entries.example_cn: 玫瑰花瓣上的微小突起接住了晨露。
entries.example_en: The papilla on the rose petal caught the morning dew.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to or resembling papilla
entries.example_cn: 皮肤的乳头层含有许多神经末梢。
entries.example_en: The papillary layer of the skin contains many nerve endings.

entries.definition_en: having a surface covered with small nipple-like projections
entries.example_cn: 青蛙的皮肤是乳头状的，摸起来很粗糙。
entries.example_en: The skin of the frog is papillate and feels rough to the touch.

entries.definition_en: swelling of the optic disc caused by increased intracranial pressure
entries.example_cn: 医生在眼部检查时发现肿胀，诊断出该患者患有视乳头水肿。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed the patient with papilledema after noticing the swelling during the eye examination.

entries.definition_en: a benign tumor that forms a rounded mass
entries.example_cn: 外科医生从患者皮肤上切除了乳头状瘤。
entries.example_en: The surgeon removed the papilloma from the patient's skin.

entries.definition_en: a small toy spaniel with erect ears and a spotted coat
entries.example_cn: 繁育者展示了一只可爱的蝴蝶犬，它有着黑斑白毛。
entries.example_en: The breeder showed off the adorable papillon with its black-spotted white coat.

entries.definition_en: having a surface covered with small, nipple-like projections
entries.example_cn: 蟾蜍的皮肤粗糙且呈乳头状，摸起来有颗粒感。
entries.example_en: The skin of the toad is rough and papillose to the touch.

entries.definition_cn: 对罗马天主教徒的冒犯性称呼，原指强烈拥护教皇权威的人
entries.definition_en: an offensive term for a Roman Catholic, originally one who strongly supported papal authority
entries.example_cn: 这篇论战文章用 papist 侮辱一名拥护教皇权威的天主教徒。
entries.example_en: The polemic used papist as an insult for a Catholic who defended papal authority.

entries.definition_cn: （冒犯性）天主教的；支持教皇权威的
entries.definition_en: (offensive) relating to or supporting the Pope and Roman Catholicism
entries.example_cn: 世俗法官驳回了这些天主教论点，认为它们与案件无关。
entries.example_en: The papist arguments were dismissed by the secular judges as irrelevant to the case.

entries.definition_cn: 美洲原住民婴儿（旧称，冒犯性）
entries.definition_en: a Native American baby (dated, offensive)
entries.example_cn: 这个美洲原住民婴儿被放在摇篮板上，由母亲背着。
entries.example_en: The papoose was carried in a cradleboard on the mother's back.

entries.definition_en: an informal term for a father, likely derived from baby talk
entries.example_cn: 那个幼儿在公园里玩的时候叫爸爸为“帕帕”。
entries.example_en: The toddler called his father pappa while playing in the park.

entries.definition_cn: 蓟和蒲公英等植物花朵中由毛或鳞片组成的退化萼，称为冠毛
entries.definition_en: a tuft of hairs or scales forming the reduced calyx of flowers in plants such as thistles and dandelions
entries.example_cn: 风吹掉了蒲公英种子的冠毛，使其随风飘散。
entries.example_en: The wind blew the pappus off the dandelion seed, allowing it to float away.

entries.definition_cn: 一种由干红椒磨成的温和调味粉
entries.definition_en: a mild powdered seasoning made from dried pimientos
entries.example_cn: 她在烤鸡上撒了一些红甜椒粉。
entries.example_en: She sprinkled paprika over the roasted chicken.

entries.definition_cn: 一种结有大型、味淡、厚壁果实的植物，通常呈钟形
entries.definition_en: a plant that produces large, mild, thick-walled peppers, usually shaped like a bell
entries.example_cn: 农民在温暖的温室里种植了红甜椒。
entries.example_en: The farmer grew paprika in the warm greenhouse.

entries.definition_en: a small, solid, inflamed elevation on the skin that does not contain pus
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了病人的皮肤，发现有几个由病毒感染引起的红色丘疹。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined the patient's skin and noted several red papules caused by a viral infection.

entries.definition_en: paper made from the papyrus plant by cutting it in strips and pressing it flat
entries.example_cn: 古代历史学家发现了一封写在纸莎草纸上的信。
entries.example_en: Ancient historians discovered a letter written on papyrus.

entries.definition_en: a document written on papyrus
entries.example_cn: 考古学家发现了一份包含医疗配方的纸莎草文书。
entries.example_en: Archaeologists found a papyrus containing medical recipes.

entries.definition_en: a tall sedge of the Nile valley yielding fiber for paper
entries.example_cn: 纸莎草植物在尼罗河畔茁壮成长。
entries.example_en: The papyrus plant thrived along the banks of the Nile.

entries.definition_en: the standard number of strokes allowed for a hole in golf
entries.example_cn: 这位高尔夫球手在该洞的成绩是标准杆。
entries.example_en: The golfer finished the hole in par.

entries.definition_en: equality in value, status, or condition
entries.example_cn: 这两种货币的汇率相等。
entries.example_en: The two currencies are trading at par.

entries.definition_en: to make a score equal to the standard number of strokes
entries.example_cn: 她在第二次尝试时终于在该难打的洞上打出了标准杆。
entries.example_en: She managed to par the difficult hole on her second attempt.

entries.definition_en: a member of the paratroops
entries.example_cn: 伞兵从飞机上跳下以控制着陆区。
entries.example_en: The para jumped from the plane to secure the landing zone.

entries.definition_cn: 女性妊娠达到可存活孕周的次数
entries.definition_en: the number of pregnancies a woman has carried to viable gestational age
entries.example_cn: 医生记录她的产数为三。
entries.example_en: The doctor recorded her para as three.

entries.definition_cn: 帕拉（前南斯拉夫货币单位）
entries.definition_en: a former Yugoslav currency unit
entries.example_cn: 在南斯拉夫，一百帕拉等于一个第纳尔。
entries.example_en: In Yugoslavia, one hundred para made up one dinar.

entries.definition_en: a short story with a moral lesson, often featuring animals
entries.example_cn: 老师给我们讲了一个关于狐狸和乌鸦的寓言。
entries.example_en: The teacher told us a parable about a fox and a crow.

entries.definition_cn: （新约中）耶稣讲述的宗教故事
entries.definition_en: a story told by Jesus in the New Testament to teach religious truths
entries.example_cn: 好撒玛利亚人的故事是新约中最著名的故事之一。
entries.example_en: The parable of the Good Samaritan is one of the most famous stories in the New Testament.

entries.definition_en: a curved line formed where a plane cuts through a cone parallel to the side of the cone
entries.example_cn: 抛出的球的路径遵循完美的抛物线。
entries.example_en: The path of the thrown ball follows a perfect parabola.

entries.definition_en: of, relating to, or shaped like a parabola or paraboloid
entries.example_cn: 球在空中划出的抛物线轨迹清晰可见。
entries.example_en: The parabolic trajectory of the ball was clearly visible against the sky.

entries.definition_en: resembling or expressed by parables
entries.example_cn: 老师讲了一个寓言故事来说明道德教训。
entries.example_en: The teacher told a parabolic story to illustrate the moral lesson.

entries.definition_en: a curved surface that has parabolic cross-sections parallel to one axis and elliptic cross-sections perpendicular to that axis
entries.example_cn: 卫星天线呈抛物面形状以聚焦信号。
entries.example_en: The satellite dish is shaped like a paraboloid to focus signals.

entries.definition_cn: 腹腔穿刺术，用于诊断或引流腹腔积液
entries.definition_en: a medical procedure involving puncturing the abdomen to remove fluid for diagnosis or treatment
entries.example_cn: 医生对病人进行了腹腔穿刺术，以排出其腹部多余的液体。
entries.example_en: The doctor performed a paracentesis to drain the excess fluid from the patient's belly.

entries.definition_en: a device that fills with air to slow down your fall when jumping from a height
entries.example_cn: 士兵从飞机上跳下并打开了降落伞。
entries.example_en: The soldier jumped from the plane and opened his parachute.

entries.definition_en: to jump from an airplane and descend using a parachute
entries.example_cn: 她决定跳伞进入偏远的山谷执行救援任务。
entries.example_en: She decided to parachute into the remote valley for the rescue mission.

entries.definition_cn: 用降落伞将（人员）投送到某地；空投
entries.definition_en: to send or place someone in a location by parachute
entries.example_cn: 士兵们被伞降到敌后。
entries.example_en: The soldiers were parachuted behind enemy lines.

entries.definition_en: the act of descending from an aircraft using a parachute
entries.example_cn: 跳伞的惊险让他忘记了所有的恐惧。
entries.example_en: The thrill of parachuting made him forget all his fears.

entries.definition_en: a person who jumps from an aircraft using a parachute
entries.example_cn: 跳伞者在漫长的下降后安全降落在田野里。
entries.example_en: The parachutist landed safely in the field after the long descent.

entries.definition_en: a formal procession of people marching in a public place
entries.example_cn: 成千上万的人聚集在一起观看军事游行。
entries.example_en: Thousands of people gathered to watch the military parade.

entries.definition_cn: 一连串（通常引人注目的）事件或事物
entries.definition_en: a long series of similar events or things that happen one after another
entries.example_cn: 这座城市全年有一连串的节日。
entries.example_en: The city has a long parade of festivals throughout the year.

entries.definition_en: a display of something, often intended to show it off
entries.example_cn: 该公司为媒体展示了一系列新产品。
entries.example_en: The company held a parade of new products for the press.

entries.definition_en: to walk in a way that shows you are proud or trying to impress others
entries.example_cn: 他穿着新西装在房间里炫耀地走来走去。
entries.example_en: He paraded around the room in his new suit, showing off.

entries.definition_en: to march in a formal procession in a public place
entries.example_cn: 士兵们穿过主街列队行进。
entries.example_en: The soldiers paraded through the main street.

entries.definition_cn: 一种由四个击打组成的鼓乐基本练习，顺序为右、左、右、右或左、右、左、左
entries.definition_en: a drum rudiment consisting of four strokes in a right-left-right-right or left-right-left-left pattern
entries.example_cn: 鼓手在演出前用练习垫练习复合击。
entries.example_en: The drummer practiced paradiddles on a pad before the performance.

entries.definition_en: a typical example or model of a particular type or situation
entries.example_cn: 科技部门的快速增长是现代经济变革的一个典型范例。
entries.example_en: The rapid growth of the tech sector is a paradigm of modern economic change.

entries.definition_cn: 特定学科在特定时期的主流观点
entries.definition_en: the dominant viewpoint or approach in a specific field at a certain time
entries.example_cn: 当前心理学的主流观点强调社会交往的作用。
entries.example_en: The current paradigm in psychology emphasizes the role of social interaction.

entries.definition_en: a complete set of all the different forms a word can take
entries.example_cn: 动词 'be' 的变位体系包括 am、is 和 are 等形式。
entries.example_en: The paradigm of the verb 'to be' includes forms like am, is, and are.

entries.definition_cn: 句法位置上的词类集合
entries.definition_en: the set of all words that can occupy the same position in a sentence
entries.example_cn: 在短语 'the big dog' 中，'big' 和 'brown' 属于同一个句法位置集合。
entries.example_en: In the phrase 'the big dog', 'big' and 'brown' belong to the same paradigm.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to a grammatical paradigm
entries.example_cn: 单数和复数形式之间存在范式关系。
entries.example_en: The paradigmatic relationship exists between singular and plural forms.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to a typical example
entries.example_cn: 这个病例是该疾病的典型例子。
entries.example_en: This case is a paradigmatic example of the disease.

entries.definition_en: related as members of a substitution class
entries.example_cn: 同义词是可以相互替换的范式词。
entries.example_en: Synonyms are paradigmatic words that can substitute for each other.

entries.definition_en: resembling or like Paradise
entries.example_cn: 这座花园是远离繁忙城市的天堂般的避风港。
entries.example_en: The garden was a paradisiacal retreat from the busy city.

entries.definition_cn: 悖论；看似矛盾但可能揭示深层真理的说法或情形
entries.definition_en: a seemingly contradictory statement or situation that may reveal a deeper truth
entries.example_cn: 这个悖论在于，我们越是试图控制自然，它就越是抗拒我们。
entries.example_en: The paradox is that the more we try to control nature, the more it resists us.

entries.definition_cn: 看似矛盾但可能为真的
entries.definition_en: seemingly contradictory but possibly true
entries.example_cn: 我们知道的越多，就越意识到自己不知道的越多，这看似矛盾但可能为真。
entries.example_en: It is paradoxical that the more we know, the more we realize we do not know.

entries.definition_en: in a way that seems to contradict itself
entries.example_cn: 矛盾的是，他越是试图解释，人们就越是不理解。
entries.example_en: Paradoxically, the more he tried to explain, the less people understood.

entries.definition_en: abnormal skin sensations such as tingling, tickling, itching, or burning, often caused by nerve damage
entries.example_cn: 患者在受伤后报告手指持续出现感觉异常。
entries.example_en: The patient reported a persistent paraesthesia in her fingers after the injury.

entries.definition_en: a substance obtained from crude petroleum, used for making candles and as a preservative or waterproof coating
entries.example_cn: 他们用石蜡给帆布帐篷做了防水处理。
entries.example_en: They used paraffin to waterproof the canvas tent.

entries.definition_en: a series of non-aromatic saturated hydrocarbons with the general formula CnH(2n+2)
entries.example_cn: 烷烃是一系列非芳香族饱和烃。
entries.example_en: Paraffin is a series of non-aromatic saturated hydrocarbons.

entries.definition_en: kerosene (British usage)
entries.example_cn: 在英国，人们常用煤油取暖。
entries.example_en: In Britain, people often use paraffin for heating.

usage.label: British
usage.pattern: paraffin means kerosene in British usage.

entries.definition_en: the sport of gliding with a paraglider
entries.example_cn: 滑翔伞运动提供了令人叹为观止的山景。
entries.example_en: Paragliding offers a breathtaking view of the mountains.

usage.label: uncountable
usage.pattern: The source marks this sport as uncountable (w30163r0).

entries.definition_en: an ideal example or perfect embodiment of a concept
entries.example_cn: 她被认为是社区中的道德典范。
entries.example_en: She is considered a paragon of virtue in her community.

entries.definition_en: a model of excellence or perfection; someone having no equal
entries.example_cn: 这位运动员是奉献和勤奋的楷模。
entries.example_en: The athlete is a paragon of dedication and hard work.

entries.definition_en: a distinct section of a text, usually starting with a new indented line
entries.example_cn: 文章的第一段介绍了主要话题。
entries.example_en: The first paragraph of the essay introduces the main topic.

entries.definition_en: to divide text into separate paragraphs
entries.example_cn: 编辑将长篇文章分成了几个较短的部分。
entries.example_en: The editor paragraphed the long article into shorter sections.

entries.definition_en: to publish a brief article, notice, or announcement
entries.example_cn: 这家报纸在头版刊登了这则公告。
entries.example_en: The newspaper paragraphed the announcement on its front page.

entries.definition_cn: 撰写段落；担任段落撰写者
entries.definition_en: to write paragraphs; to work as a paragrapher
entries.example_cn: 她花了一下午为会议撰写报告段落。
entries.example_en: She spent the afternoon paragraphing the report for the meeting.

entries.definition_en: any of numerous small, slender parrots with long tails
entries.example_cn: 那只色彩斑斓的小长尾鹦鹉在花园里从树枝飞到树枝。
entries.example_en: The colorful parakeet flew from branch to branch in the garden.

entries.definition_en: a colorless liquid used as a sedative and a solvent
entries.example_cn: 三聚乙醛历史上曾被用作镇静剂。
entries.example_en: Paraldehyde was historically used as a sedative.

usage.label: countable or uncountable
usage.pattern: Both countable and uncountable uses are supplied.

entries.definition_en: a person with specialized training who assists lawyers
entries.example_cn: 法律助理帮助律师准备文件。
entries.example_en: The paralegal helped the lawyer prepare the documents.

entries.definition_en: the apparent shift in position of an object when viewed from two different points
entries.example_cn: 天文学家利用视差来测量附近恒星的距离。
entries.example_en: Astronomers use parallax to measure the distance to nearby stars.

entries.definition_en: running in the same direction without ever meeting
entries.example_cn: 这两条路彼此平行。
entries.example_en: The two roads run parallel to each other.

entries.definition_en: to be similar to or correspond with something else
entries.example_cn: 他的行为与其前任相似。
entries.example_en: His actions paralleled those of his predecessor.

entries.definition_en: to match or be equivalent to something else
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家试图模仿那位著名画家的风格。
entries.example_en: The artist tried to parallel the style of the famous painter.

entries.definition_en: to make something run in the same direction without meeting
entries.example_cn: 建筑师设计这座建筑使其与海岸线平行。
entries.example_en: The architect designed the building to parallel the coastline.

entries.definition_en: a situation or thing that is similar to another in some way
entries.example_cn: 这项新政策与去年推出的政策如出一辙。
entries.example_en: The new policy is a parallel to the one introduced last year.

entries.definition_en: an imaginary line around the Earth parallel to the equator
entries.example_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度线上。
entries.example_en: The city is located on the 40th parallel.

entries.definition_en: involving the performance of multiple operations at the same time
entries.example_cn: 计算机使用并行处理来加快计算速度。
entries.example_en: The computer uses parallel processing to speed up calculations.

entries.definition_en: one of a set of parallel lines or planes in mathematics
entries.example_cn: 在几何学中，平行线是指永不相交的另一条线。
entries.example_en: In geometry, a parallel is a line that never intersects another.

entries.definition_en: a three-dimensional solid figure with six faces, where each face is a parallelogram
entries.example_cn: 这个房间呈平行六面体形状，墙壁是倾斜的。
entries.example_en: The room was shaped like a parallelepiped, with slanted walls.

entries.definition_en: the quality of having similar structures or patterns that correspond to each other
entries.example_cn: 这两个法律体系之间的相似性令人瞩目。
entries.example_en: The parallelism between the two legal systems is striking.

entries.definition_en: the use of similar or repeated grammatical structures for rhetorical effect
entries.example_cn: 演讲者运用排比使论点更令人难忘。
entries.example_en: The speaker used parallelism to make the argument more memorable.

entries.definition_en: the use of parallel methods in hardware or software so that several tasks can be performed at the same time
entries.example_cn: 并行处理使程序能够同时处理多张图像。
entries.example_en: Parallelism allows the program to process several images at once.

entries.definition_en: to arrange or place things so that they are parallel to each other
entries.example_cn: 工程师必须使轨道平行，以确保火车平稳运行。
entries.example_en: Engineers must parallelize the tracks to ensure the trains run smoothly.

entries.definition_en: a four-sided shape with opposite sides that are parallel and equal in length
entries.example_cn: 菱形是一种特殊的平行四边形。
entries.example_en: A rhombus is a special type of parallelogram.

entries.definition_en: to cause to be paralyzed and immobile
entries.example_cn: 这种毒气旨在使敌军麻痹。
entries.example_en: The poison gas was intended to paralyse the enemy troops.

entries.definition_en: to make powerless and unable to function
entries.example_cn: 罢工威胁要使整个交通网络瘫痪。
entries.example_en: The strike threatened to paralyse the entire transport network.

entries.definition_en: complete loss of voluntary control of part of a person's body, such as one or more limbs
entries.example_cn: 事故导致他双腿暂时瘫痪。
entries.example_en: The accident caused temporary paralysis in his legs.

entries.definition_en: relating to or of the nature of paralysis
entries.example_cn: 这种毒药对神经系统有麻痹作用。
entries.example_en: The poison had a paralytic effect on the nervous system.

entries.definition_en: affected with paralysis
entries.example_cn: 这位瘫痪病人需要全天候的护理。
entries.example_en: The paralytic patient required round-the-clock care.

entries.definition_en: a person suffering from paralysis
entries.example_cn: 这家医院设有专门收治瘫痪者的病房。
entries.example_en: The hospital has a specialized ward for paralytics.

entries.definition_en: cause to be paralyzed and immobile
entries.example_cn: 事故导致他的双腿瘫痪。
entries.example_en: The accident paralyzed his legs.

entries.definition_en: make powerless and unable to function
entries.example_cn: 这则消息使该国陷入瘫痪。
entries.example_en: The news paralyzed the country.

entries.definition_en: unable to move due to paralysis
entries.example_cn: 事故导致他从腰部以下瘫痪。
entries.example_en: The accident left him paralyzed from the waist down.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to a paramagnet
entries.example_cn: 铝是一种顺磁性材料，会被磁铁微弱地吸引。
entries.example_en: Aluminum is a paramagnetic material that is weakly attracted to magnets.

entries.definition_en: the property of materials like aluminum or platinum that become magnetized in a magnetic field but lose this magnetism when the field is removed
entries.example_cn: 当铝和铂等物质暴露于磁场时，会观察到顺磁性。
entries.example_en: Paramagnetism is observed in materials such as aluminum and platinum when exposed to a magnetic field.

entries.definition_cn: 草履虫属的原生动物；草履虫
entries.definition_en: a protozoan of the genus Paramecium
entries.example_cn: 草履虫通过摆动毛发状的纤毛游动。
entries.example_en: The paramecium swims by beating its hair-like cilia.

entries.definition_cn: 接受急救训练、在送医前提供医疗救护并稳定患者病情的人
entries.definition_en: a person trained to provide emergency medical care and stabilize patients, especially before hospital admission
entries.example_cn: 急救员迅速赶到现场稳定病人的状况。
entries.example_en: The paramedic rushed to the scene to stabilize the patient's condition.

entries.definition_cn: 辅助医疗的；与医务辅助人员或相关医疗服务有关的
entries.definition_en: relating to paramedics or allied medical services
entries.example_cn: 医护部门为医院提供了至关重要的支持。
entries.example_en: The paramedical department provides essential support to the hospital.

entries.definition_cn: 受过训练以协助医疗专业人员并提供紧急医疗救治的人
entries.definition_en: a person trained to assist medical professionals and to give emergency medical treatment
entries.example_cn: 这名医护人员迅速赶到，稳定了患者的病情。
entries.example_en: The paramedical arrived quickly to stabilize the patient.

entries.definition_en: a factor that defines a system and limits its performance
entries.example_cn: 预算是规划项目时的关键参数。
entries.example_en: Budget is a key parameter in planning the project.

entries.definition_en: a value or reference passed to a function in computer programming
entries.example_cn: 该函数接受一个用户姓名的参数。
entries.example_en: The function accepts a parameter for the user's name.

entries.definition_en: a quantity like the mean or variance that describes a statistical population
entries.example_cn: 均值是用于描述数据集中趋势的参数。
entries.example_en: The mean is a parameter used to describe the central tendency of the data.

entries.definition_en: a constant in a mathematical equation that can be changed to create a family of similar curves
entries.example_cn: 半径是决定圆大小的参数。
entries.example_en: The radius is a parameter that determines the size of the circle.

entries.definition_en: relating to or expressed in terms of a parameter
entries.example_cn: 该模型是参数化的，意味着其行为由一组可调参数定义。
entries.example_en: The model is parametric, meaning its behavior is defined by a set of adjustable parameters.

entries.definition_en: a group of civilians organized in a military fashion
entries.example_cn: 该准军事组织在边境地区活动。
entries.example_en: The paramilitary group operated in the border regions.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to a group of civilians organized like a military unit
entries.example_cn: 准军事部队被部署以维持秩序。
entries.example_en: The paramilitary forces were deployed to maintain order.

entries.definition_cn: 最重要的；至高无上的；权势最大的
entries.definition_en: having the greatest importance, power, or influence; supreme
entries.example_cn: 操作重型机械时，安全至高无上。
entries.example_en: Safety is paramount when operating heavy machinery.

entries.definition_en: the state of being most important or having the highest authority
entries.example_cn: 宪法的至高无上地位确保了没有任何法律可以凌驾于其上。
entries.example_en: The paramountcy of the constitution ensures that no law can override it.

entries.definition_en: a woman's lover, especially one who is not her husband
entries.example_cn: 丑闻揭露了国王秘密的情夫。
entries.example_en: The scandal revealed the king's secret paramour.

entries.definition_en: a woman who lives with an important man without being married to him
entries.example_cn: 在18世纪，情妇通常是一位社会地位较高的女性。
entries.example_en: In the 18th century, a paramour was often a woman of high social standing.

entries.definition_cn: 副黏病毒科的一种病毒
entries.definition_en: a member of the Paramyxoviridae family of viruses
entries.example_cn: 科学家正在研究副黏病毒，以开发更有效的疫苗。
entries.example_en: Scientists are studying the paramyxovirus to develop a more effective vaccine.

entries.definition_cn: 鼻旁窦的；与鼻旁窦有关的
entries.definition_en: of or relating to the paranasal sinuses
entries.example_cn: 扫描显示鼻旁窦有炎症。
entries.example_en: The scan showed inflammation in the paranasal sinuses.

entries.definition_cn: 马来西亚和印度尼西亚使用的一种粗短直刃砍刀
entries.definition_en: a stout straight knife used in Malaysia and Indonesia
entries.example_cn: 传统舞蹈表演中，舞者们挥舞着砍刀。
entries.example_en: The traditional dance performance featured dancers wielding a parang.

entries.definition_en: a mental condition where a person believes they are being harmed or threatened without cause
entries.example_cn: 这位病人患有偏执症，认为每个人都在监视他。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from paranoia and thought everyone was spying on him.

entries.definition_cn: 与妄想症有关的；表现出妄想症的
entries.definition_en: relating to or showing paranoia
entries.example_cn: 这名患者妄想性的恐惧使他连最亲近的朋友都不信任。
entries.example_en: The patient's paranoiac fears made him distrust even his closest friends.

entries.definition_en: a person afflicted with paranoia
entries.example_cn: 这位妄想症患者坚信有人在监视他。
entries.example_en: The paranoiac was convinced everyone was spying on him.

entries.definition_en: suffering from paranoia; having unreasonable fears of being harmed or betrayed
entries.example_cn: 他开始怀疑邻居在监视他，变得偏执起来。
entries.example_en: He became paranoid about his neighbors spying on him.

entries.definition_en: a person who suffers from paranoia
entries.example_cn: 精神科医生询问了一名认为邻居在监视自己的偏执狂。
entries.example_en: The psychiatrist interviewed a paranoid who believed his neighbors were spying on him.

entries.definition_cn: 看似超出正常感官渠道的
entries.definition_en: seemingly outside normal sensory channels
entries.example_cn: 这本书讨论了各种超自然现象。
entries.example_en: The book discusses various paranormal phenomena.

entries.definition_cn: 超自然的；不符合科学定律的
entries.definition_en: not in accordance with scientific laws
entries.example_cn: 科学家们对超自然的主张持怀疑态度。
entries.example_en: Scientists remain skeptical of paranormal claims.

entries.definition_en: a slight paralysis or weakness affecting both legs
entries.example_cn: 患者在脊髓损伤愈合后从双下肢轻瘫中恢复过来。
entries.example_en: The patient recovered from paraparesis after the spinal injury healed.

entries.definition_en: a low wall along the edge of a roof or balcony
entries.example_cn: 士兵们躲在矮墙后面寻求保护。
entries.example_en: The soldiers stood behind the parapet for protection.

entries.definition_en: fortification consisting of a low wall
entries.example_cn: 这座古老的城堡在城墙上建有石制矮墙作为防御工事。
entries.example_en: The ancient castle had a stone parapet along its ramparts.

entries.definition_en: equipment consisting of miscellaneous articles needed for a particular operation or sport etc.
entries.example_cn: 摄影师把所有摄影装备都装进了包里。
entries.example_en: The photographer packed all his camera paraphernalia into the bag.

entries.definition_en: a sexual interest in objects, situations, or activities that are considered unusual or atypical
entries.example_cn: 性倒错的研究考察了各种非规范性的性行为。
entries.example_en: The study of paraphilia examines various non-normative sexual behaviors.

entries.definition_en: express the same message in different words
entries.example_cn: 他改写了说明以使它们更清晰。
entries.example_en: He paraphrased the instructions to make them clearer.

entries.definition_en: rewording for the purpose of clarification
entries.example_cn: 你能给我那句子的释义吗？
entries.example_en: Can you give me a paraphrase of that sentence?

entries.definition_en: paralysis affecting the lower half of the body, typically caused by injury
entries.example_cn: 这次事故导致他永久下肢瘫痪。
entries.example_en: The accident resulted in permanent paraplegia.

entries.definition_en: suffering complete paralysis of the lower half of the body
entries.example_cn: 这位下半身瘫痪的病人需要帮助才能在屋内移动。
entries.example_en: The paraplegic patient required assistance to move around the house.

entries.definition_en: a person who is paralyzed from the waist down
entries.example_cn: 这位下半身瘫痪的运动员使用轮椅参加了比赛。
entries.example_en: The paraplegic athlete used a wheelchair to compete in the games.

entries.definition_cn: 辅助专业人员工作的受训人员
entries.definition_en: a trained worker who assists a professional but is not a member of a profession
entries.example_cn: 这位辅助人员帮助老师管理教室。
entries.example_en: The paraprofessional helped the teacher manage the classroom.

entries.definition_en: relating to phenomena that cannot be explained by normal physical laws
entries.example_cn: 这项超心理学研究调查了关于心灵感应和预知能力的说法。
entries.example_en: The parapsychological study investigated claims of telepathy and clairvoyance.

entries.definition_en: a scientist who studies phenomena like telepathy and psychokinesis
entries.example_cn: 这位超心理学家分析了心灵感应实验的数据。
entries.example_en: The parapsychologist analyzed the data from the telepathy experiment.

entries.definition_en: the study of phenomena that seem to break physical laws and might be caused by mental processes
entries.example_cn: 超心理学研究心灵感应和预知能力的说法。
entries.example_en: Parapsychology investigates claims of telepathy and clairvoyance.

entries.definition_cn: 百草枯，一种有毒的黄色固体，制成溶液后用作除草剂
entries.definition_en: a poisonous yellow solid used in solution as a herbicide
entries.example_cn: 农民必须极其小心地处理百草枯，因为它毒性很强。
entries.example_en: Farmers must handle paraquat with extreme care because it is highly toxic.

entries.definition_cn: 滑翔伞（由摩托艇或汽车牵引升空）
entries.definition_en: a parachute that lifts a person into the air when towed by a motorboat or a car
entries.example_cn: 我们决定租一个滑翔伞，以获得海岸线的鸟瞰视角。
entries.example_en: We decided to rent a parasail to get a bird's-eye view of the coastline.

entries.definition_en: the sport of gliding through the air while attached to a parachute-like sail
entries.example_cn: 游客们享受了在蔚蓝海洋上空滑翔伞运动的刺激。
entries.example_en: The tourists enjoyed the thrill of parasailing over the blue ocean.

entries.definition_cn: 寄生生物（生活在宿主身上或体内并从中获益，不能充分补偿宿主）
entries.definition_en: an organism that lives on or in another organism and benefits from it without adequately compensating the host
entries.example_cn: 科学家研究了生活在鱼体内的寄生虫。
entries.example_en: The scientist studied the parasite that lives inside the fish.

entries.definition_cn: 寄生虫（依附他人而不回报的人）
entries.definition_en: a person who depends on others for support without giving anything in return
entries.example_cn: 他被指控是富有的叔叔的寄生虫。
entries.example_en: He was accused of being a parasite on his wealthy uncle.

entries.definition_en: the presence of parasites in the blood
entries.example_cn: 医生开了验血单以检查是否有寄生虫血症。
entries.example_en: The doctor ordered a blood test to check for parasitemia.

entries.definition_cn: 与寄生虫有关的；由寄生虫引起的
entries.definition_en: relating to or caused by parasites
entries.example_cn: 这种疾病具有寄生性。
entries.example_en: The disease is parasitic in nature.

entries.definition_en: living off another organism or person
entries.example_cn: 这种植物寄生在树上。
entries.example_en: The plant is parasitic on the tree.

entries.definition_en: relating to the insertion of a sound into a word
entries.example_cn: 这个词包含一个插入音。
entries.example_en: The word contains a parasitic vowel.

entries.definition_en: relating to or caused by parasites
entries.example_cn: 这种寄生感染对宿主的免疫系统造成了严重损害。
entries.example_en: The parasitical infection caused severe damage to the host's immune system.

entries.definition_cn: 寄生性的；靠寄生或他人供养的
entries.definition_en: living off another organism or person without giving anything in return
entries.example_cn: 他被指责过着靠父母供养的生活，完全依赖父母的钱。
entries.example_en: He was accused of leading a parasitical lifestyle, relying entirely on his parents' money.

entries.definition_en: in a parasitic manner
entries.example_cn: 这家公司寄生般地依赖其合作伙伴的成功。
entries.example_en: The company relied parasitically on the success of its partner.

entries.definition_en: a relationship between two organisms in which one, the parasite, benefits while the host is harmed
entries.example_cn: 绦虫的寄生会伤害宿主，同时为绦虫提供营养。
entries.example_en: The tapeworm's parasitism harms its host while providing the worm with nutrients.

entries.definition_en: a small, handheld umbrella used to provide shade from the sun
entries.example_cn: 她打开阳伞以保护自己免受强烈的阳光照射。
entries.example_en: She opened her parasol to protect herself from the bright sunlight.

entries.definition_en: Relating to or characteristic of the parasympathetic nervous system.
entries.example_cn: 当你感到放松和安全时，副交感神经活动会增加。
entries.example_en: Parasympathetic activity increases when you feel relaxed and safe.

entries.definition_en: a parasympathetic nerve
entries.example_cn: 副交感神经有助于控制消化和心率。
entries.example_en: Parasympathetic nerves help control digestion and heart rate.

entries.definition_en: a colorless and odorless toxic oil used as an insecticide
entries.example_cn: 农民必须极其小心地处理对硫磷，因为它毒性很强。
entries.example_en: Farmers must handle parathion with extreme care because it is highly toxic.

entries.definition_en: one of four small glands located near or inside the thyroid gland that regulate calcium levels in the blood.
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一项血液检查以监测甲状旁腺功能。
entries.example_en: The doctor ordered a blood test to check for parathyroid function.

entries.definition_en: a soldier who is trained to jump from an aircraft into a combat zone
entries.example_cn: 伞兵安全降落在敌后。
entries.example_en: The paratrooper landed safely behind enemy lines.

entries.definition_en: infantry troops trained and equipped to parachute into combat
entries.example_cn: 伞兵们在黎明时分降落在敌后。
entries.example_en: The paratroops landed behind enemy lines at dawn.

entries.definition_en: any of a variety of infectious intestinal diseases that resemble typhoid fever
entries.example_cn: 患者在出现高烧和腹痛后被诊断为副伤寒。
entries.example_en: The patient was diagnosed with paratyphoid after suffering from high fever and abdominal pain.

entries.definition_en: to cook food, especially vegetables, for a short time in boiling water
entries.example_cn: 在将土豆加入汤之前，你应该先将它们预煮一下。
entries.example_en: You should parboil the potatoes before adding them to the soup.

entries.definition_en: a container that is wrapped for sending or carrying
entries.example_cn: 她收到了姐姐寄来的包裹。
entries.example_en: She received a parcel from her sister.

entries.definition_en: a large area of land, often used for farming or settlement
entries.example_cn: 定居者向西迁移以认领一块土地。
entries.example_en: The settlers moved west to claim a parcel of land.

entries.definition_en: a share or portion obtained by dividing something
entries.example_cn: 每位工人分得了新公司的一小部分股份。
entries.example_en: Each worker received a small parcel of shares in the new company.

entries.definition_en: a group of items that are wrapped or boxed together
entries.example_cn: 慈善机构向难民发送了一组食品。
entries.example_en: The charity sent a parcel of food to the refugees.

entries.definition_en: to put something into a wrapped container
entries.example_cn: 请在邮寄前仔细打包这些礼物。
entries.example_en: Please parcel the gifts carefully before mailing them.

entries.definition_en: to divide and distribute something into parts
entries.example_cn: 政府决定将土地分割给农民。
entries.example_en: The government decided to parcel out the land among the farmers.

entries.definition_en: to wrap a strip around the end of a rope
entries.example_cn: 水手们用条带缠裹绳端以保护它。
entries.example_en: The sailors parceled the end of the rope to protect it.

entries.definition_en: the act of dividing something into parts and distributing them according to a plan
entries.example_cn: 政府正在考虑将土地分配给新移民。
entries.example_en: The government is considering the parceling of land to new settlers.

entries.definition_en: the act of distributing by allotting or apportioning; distribution according to a plan
entries.example_cn: 土地在新移民之间的分配在一个月内完成了。
entries.example_en: The parcelling of the land among the new settlers was completed within a month.

entries.definition_cn: 使因受热干透、枯萎或烤焦
entries.definition_en: to dry out or shrivel, or scorch, through heat
entries.example_cn: 烈日开始把枯叶晒得干焦。
entries.example_en: The hot sun began to parch the dry leaves.

usage.label: transitive
usage.pattern: The source labels the core verb sense transitive.

entries.definition_en: dried out by heat or sunlight
entries.example_cn: 在烈日下，干裂的土地裂开了。
entries.example_en: The parched earth cracked under the hot sun.

entries.definition_en: very thirsty
entries.example_cn: 长途徒步后，我渴极了。
entries.example_en: After the long hike, I was parched.

entries.definition_en: the skin of a sheep or goat prepared for writing
entries.example_cn: 在纸张发明之前，人们用羊皮纸书写重要文件。
entries.example_en: Before paper was invented, people wrote important documents on parchment.

entries.definition_en: stiff paper imitating parchment
entries.example_cn: 这份请柬印在仿羊皮纸的硬质纸张上。
entries.example_en: The invitation was printed on stiff paper imitating parchment.

entries.definition_cn: 伙伴；朋友（美国方言，非正式）
entries.definition_en: a friend or partner (US dialectal, informal)
entries.example_cn: 嘿，伙伴，能帮我一下吗？
entries.example_en: Hey, pardner, could you give me a hand?

usage.label: US dialectal, informal; term of address
usage.pattern: Source w30106r0–r1 tags this usage explicitly.

entries.definition_cn: 社区银行合作社，尤指为无法获得正规信贷或银行账户的社会群体设立的合作金融机构
entries.definition_en: a local community banking cooperative, especially one established for a social group unable to obtain formal credit or bank accounts
entries.example_cn: 社区成立了一个社区银行合作社，帮助那些无法获得银行贷款的当地家庭。
entries.example_en: The community set up a pardner to help local families who could not get bank loans.

entries.definition_en: accept an excuse for
entries.example_cn: 请原谅我的打断。
entries.example_en: Please pardon my interruption.

entries.definition_en: grant a pardon to
entries.example_cn: 总统决定赦免这名罪犯。
entries.example_en: The president decided to pardon the criminal.

entries.definition_en: the act of excusing a mistake or offense
entries.example_cn: 他请求原谅自己的粗鲁。
entries.example_en: He asked for a pardon for his rudeness.

entries.definition_en: a warrant granting release from punishment for an offense
entries.example_cn: 国王向囚犯发布了赦免令。
entries.example_en: The king issued a pardon to the prisoner.

entries.definition_en: the formal act of liberating someone
entries.example_cn: 这项赦免是一个重大的政治举动。
entries.example_en: The pardon was a significant political act.

entries.definition_en: acceptable or understandable enough to be forgiven
entries.example_cn: 考虑到他缺乏经验，他的错误是可以原谅的。
entries.example_en: His mistake was pardonable given his lack of experience.

entries.definition_en: a medieval cleric who sold indulgences to raise money for the church
entries.example_cn: 这位赎罪券兜售者走遍城镇，向富人兜售赎罪券。
entries.example_en: The pardoner traveled from town to town selling indulgences to the wealthy.

entries.definition_en: a person who grants forgiveness or pardon for a fault or offense
entries.example_cn: 国王任命了一名赦免者来审查囚犯的案件。
entries.example_en: The king appointed a pardoner to review the cases of the prisoners.

entries.definition_en: to decrease gradually or bit by bit
entries.example_cn: 公司不得不削减开支以度过经济衰退。
entries.example_en: The company had to pare its expenses to survive the recession.

entries.definition_en: to remove the skin from something
entries.example_cn: 请在把土豆放进汤之前削皮。
entries.example_en: Please pare the potatoes before putting them in the soup.

entries.definition_en: to cut small bits or shavings from something
entries.example_cn: 她在烘烤苹果前用刀削去了一些小块。
entries.example_en: She used a knife to pare the apple before baking it.

entries.definition_cn: 修边并修剪至所需大小
entries.definition_en: to remove the edges and cut down to the desired size
entries.example_cn: 裁缝会将布料修剪以完美贴合图案。
entries.example_en: The tailor will pare the fabric to fit the pattern perfectly.

entries.definition_cn: 止痛药；特指樟脑阿片酊
entries.definition_en: a pain-relieving medicine, specifically the traditional camphorated tincture of opium
entries.example_cn: 医生开了止痛药复方樟脑酊来缓解患者的疼痛。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed paregoric to relieve the patient's pain.

entries.definition_en: the main functional tissue of an organ, distinct from supporting structures like blood vessels
entries.example_cn: 肝脏实质组织负责过滤血液中的毒素。
entries.example_en: The liver parenchyma is responsible for filtering toxins from the blood.

entries.definition_en: the primary tissue in plants made of thin-walled cells capable of dividing
entries.example_cn: 薄壁细胞构成了叶片结构的大部分。
entries.example_en: Parenchyma cells make up the majority of the leaf structure.

entries.definition_en: a father or mother; someone who gives birth to or raises a child
entries.example_cn: 父母双方都从事全职工作。
entries.example_en: Both parents work full-time jobs.

entries.definition_en: an organism from which younger ones are obtained
entries.example_cn: 亲本植物结出了许多种子。
entries.example_en: The parent plant produced many seeds.

entries.definition_en: to look after a child until it becomes an adult
entries.example_cn: 她决定独自抚养她的儿子。
entries.example_en: She decided to parent her son alone.

entries.definition_cn: 子女与父母的亲属关系
entries.definition_en: the kinship relation of an offspring to the parents
entries.example_cn: 该法律文件要求提供子女与父母的亲属关系证明以确立继承权。
entries.example_en: The legal document required proof of parentage to establish inheritance rights.

entries.definition_en: the hereditary derivation of an individual
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家兼具法国和意大利血统。
entries.example_en: The artist's parentage was a mix of French and Italian heritage.

entries.definition_en: the social class or status into which someone was born
entries.example_cn: 她的贵族出身使她得以进入有影响力的社交圈。
entries.example_en: Her aristocratic parentage gave her access to influential social circles.

entries.definition_en: relating to or characteristic of a parent
entries.example_cn: 她产生了强烈的保护孩子的父母本能。
entries.example_en: She felt a strong parental instinct to protect her child.

entries.definition_en: relating to the generation of organisms that produce hybrid offspring
entries.example_cn: 这项研究检查了杂交亲代与杂交后代之间的遗传差异。
entries.example_en: The study examined the genetic differences between parental and hybrid generations.

entries.definition_en: in a parental manner
entries.example_cn: 这位老师以父母般的方式对待年幼的学生，给予他们指导和关怀。
entries.example_en: The teacher treated the young students parentally, offering them guidance and care.

entries.definition_cn: 有指定类型或数量父母的（尤用于复合词）
entries.definition_en: having the specified kind or number of parents, especially in compounds
entries.example_cn: 这项研究比较了双亲家庭和单亲家庭的孩子。
entries.example_en: The study compared children from two-parented and single-parented families.

entries.definition_en: administered by means other than through the alimentary tract, such as by injection
entries.example_cn: 由于患者无法进食，他们接受了非口服营养支持。
entries.example_en: The patient received parenteral nutrition because they could not eat.

entries.definition_en: located outside the alimentary tract
entries.example_cn: 这项研究关注新药的消化道外吸收率。
entries.example_en: The study focused on parenteral absorption rates of the new drug.

entries.definition_cn: 经非消化道途径（通常指注射）
entries.definition_en: by means other than through the digestive tract, typically by injection
entries.example_cn: 该患者通过注射抗生素进行治疗。
entries.example_en: The patient was treated parenterally with antibiotics.

entries.definition_en: one of the symbols '(' or ')' used to enclose extra information
entries.example_cn: 这个表达式缺少右括号。
entries.example_en: The closing parenthesis is missing from the expression.

entries.definition_en: a digression or a side comment
entries.example_cn: 演讲者补充了一句关于预算的题外话。
entries.example_en: The speaker added a brief parenthesis about the budget.

entries.definition_en: placed in parentheses or serving to qualify or explain something
entries.example_cn: 她在会议期间对天气做了一个括号式的评论。
entries.example_en: She made a parenthetical comment about the weather during the meeting.

entries.definition_en: a word or phrase placed in parentheses to provide extra information
entries.example_cn: 括号内的注释阐明了作者的原始意图。
entries.example_en: The parenthetical note clarified the author's original intent.

entries.definition_en: in a way that adds extra information not essential to the main point
entries.example_cn: 顺便说一句，我必须提到会议被推迟了。
entries.example_en: Parenthetically, I must mention that the meeting was postponed.

entries.definition_en: the state or condition of being a parent
entries.example_cn: 为人父母所面临的挑战需要耐心和奉献。
entries.example_en: The challenges of parenthood require patience and dedication.

entries.definition_en: having no parents or not being cared for by them
entries.example_cn: 孤儿院为许多无父母的孩子提供了家。
entries.example_en: The orphanage provided a home for many parentless children.

entries.definition_en: a small sharp knife used for cutting the skin off fruits or vegetables
entries.example_cn: 他用削皮刀去掉了苹果坚硬的皮。
entries.example_en: He used a parer to remove the tough skin from the apple.

entries.definition_en: a person whose job is to trim fingernails
entries.example_cn: 她请了一位专业的修指甲师为婚礼做准备。
entries.example_en: She hired a professional parer to prepare her hands for the wedding.

entries.definition_en: a condition where muscles are weak and cannot move fully
entries.example_cn: 中风后，该患者的一条腿出现了轻瘫。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from paresis in one leg after the stroke.

entries.definition_en: abnormal skin sensations such as tingling, tickling, itching, or burning, usually caused by nerve damage
entries.example_cn: 在冰冷的椅子上坐得太久后，他的双腿出现了感觉异常。
entries.example_en: After sitting in the cold chair for too long, he experienced paresthesia in his legs.

entries.definition_cn: 轻瘫（部分麻痹或无力）患者
entries.definition_en: a person who has paresis (partial paralysis or weakness)
entries.example_cn: 这名轻瘫患者需要帮助才能走下楼梯。
entries.example_en: The paretic required assistance to walk down the stairs.

entries.definition_cn: 不含肉或奶制品的（犹太饮食律法中可随肉或奶食用的）
entries.definition_en: containing neither meat nor milk products, allowing it to be eaten with either meat or dairy dishes according to Jewish dietary laws
entries.example_cn: 承办商准备了一份不含肉和奶制品的菜单，以满足所有客人的饮食限制。
entries.example_en: The caterer prepared a pareve menu to accommodate all guests' dietary restrictions.

entries.definition_en: a dessert made of layers of ice cream, syrup, and whipped cream
entries.example_cn: 我们点了巧克力分层甜点作为餐后甜点。
entries.example_en: We ordered a chocolate parfait for dessert.

entries.definition_en: a person despised and excluded by their family, community, or society
entries.example_cn: 丑闻之后，他在自己的家乡成了被遗弃者。
entries.example_en: After the scandal, he became a pariah in his own hometown.

entries.definition_en: relating to the parietal bones located on the sides and top of the skull
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了患者头部的顶骨区域是否有骨折。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the parietal region of the patient's head for fractures.

entries.definition_en: a betting system where winners share the total pool of wagers
entries.example_cn: 这场比赛按照总彩池制规则进行投注。
entries.example_en: The race was run under parimutuel betting rules.

entries.definition_en: the skin or peel removed from a fruit or vegetable
entries.example_cn: 她收集果皮来熬制高汤。
entries.example_en: She collected the parings to make stock.

entries.definition_en: a thin piece shaved from something
entries.example_cn: 他从桌子边缘削下一片薄薄的木屑。
entries.example_en: He removed a thin paring of wood from the edge of the table.

entries.definition_en: a local church community
entries.example_cn: 牧师走访了教区里的每一个家庭。
entries.example_en: The priest visited every family in the parish.

entries.definition_cn: 由一位牧师负责的主教辖区下的地方分区
entries.definition_en: the local subdivision of a diocese committed to one pastor
entries.example_cn: 她搬到了一个新教区，将在那里担任牧师。
entries.example_en: She moved to a new parish where she would serve as the pastor.

entries.definition_en: a member of a parish
entries.example_cn: 牧师在教堂门口迎接每一位教区居民。
entries.example_en: The priest greeted every parishioner at the church door.

entries.definition_en: equal status or power between people or groups
entries.example_cn: 这项新法律旨在确保工作场所中男女的平等。
entries.example_en: The new law aims to ensure parity between men and women in the workplace.

entries.definition_en: the property of two numbers being both odd or both even
entries.example_cn: 该算法检查输入数字的同奇偶性。
entries.example_en: The algorithm checks the parity of the input numbers.

entries.definition_en: a bit added to data to ensure the total number of 1s is odd or even
entries.example_cn: 该系统使用奇偶校验位来检测传输数据中的错误。
entries.example_en: The system uses parity to detect errors in transmitted data.

entries.definition_en: symmetry of physical interactions under spatial inversion
entries.example_cn: 物理学家研究宇称以理解自然界的基本对称性。
entries.example_en: Physicists study parity to understand fundamental symmetries in nature.

entries.definition_cn: （产科）达到可存活孕周的妊娠次数
entries.definition_en: the number of pregnancies reaching a viable gestational age
entries.example_cn: 手术前，医生记录了她达到可存活孕周的妊娠次数。
entries.example_en: The doctor recorded her parity before the surgery.

entries.definition_en: an open area in a city for recreation
entries.example_cn: 孩子们整个下午都在公园里玩耍。
entries.example_en: The children played in the park all afternoon.

entries.definition_en: a lot where cars are parked
entries.example_cn: 我们把车停在了地下停车场。
entries.example_en: We left our car in the underground park.

entries.definition_en: a large area of land kept in its natural state for public use
entries.example_cn: 我们去城市公园散步了。
entries.example_en: We went for a walk in the city park.

entries.definition_en: a facility for playing ball games like baseball
entries.example_cn: 棒球队每天在运动场训练。
entries.example_en: The baseball team practices at the park every day.

entries.definition_en: to drive a vehicle into a parking space
entries.example_cn: 在这条繁忙的街道上停车很困难。
entries.example_en: I had trouble parking in this busy street.

entries.definition_en: to place something temporarily
entries.example_cn: 请把自行车停在入口附近。
entries.example_en: Please park your bicycle near the entrance.

entries.definition_en: a gear position that acts as a parking brake
entries.example_cn: 下车前确保车挂在驻车挡。
entries.example_en: Make sure the car is in park before you get out.

entries.definition_en: a heavy jacket with a hood, typically worn in cold weather
entries.example_cn: 她穿上派克大衣以抵御刺骨的寒风。
entries.example_en: She put on her parka to protect herself from the freezing wind.

entries.definition_en: that have been left (in a place for a period of time)
entries.example_cn: 那辆车整晚都停在酒店外面。
entries.example_en: The car was parked outside the hotel all night.

entries.definition_en: an area where vehicles can be left
entries.example_cn: 酒店为客人提供免费停车场。
entries.example_en: The hotel offers free parking for its guests.

entries.definition_en: the act of putting a vehicle into a parking space
entries.example_cn: 他擅长在狭窄的空间里停车。
entries.example_en: He is good at parking in tight spaces.

entries.definition_en: land designated or used as a park
entries.example_cn: 该市收购了几片开阔地，从而扩大了公园用地。
entries.example_en: The city expanded its parkland by acquiring several open fields.

entries.definition_cn: 一种涉及在环境中高效奔跑、跳跃和跨越的体育项目
entries.definition_en: an athletic discipline involving running, jumping, and vaulting through an environment efficiently
entries.example_cn: 这群跑酷爱好者翻过了围栏，跃过了墙壁。
entries.example_en: The group of parkour enthusiasts climbed the fence and vaulted over the wall.

entries.definition_en: a road through or alongside a park, often landscaped; especially a scenic highway
entries.example_cn: 我们沿着林荫大道开车，欣赏美丽的山景。
entries.example_en: We drove along the parkway to enjoy the beautiful view of the mountains.

entries.definition_en: somewhat cold but not extremely so
entries.example_cn: 外面有点冷，所以她穿上了夹克。
entries.example_en: It was a bit parky outside, so she put on a jacket.

entries.definition_cn: 特定群体、职业或兴趣领域所使用的说话方式或用语；行话
entries.definition_en: a particular way of speaking or using words, especially that associated with a group, job, or interest
entries.example_cn: 他用当地渔民的行话交谈。
entries.example_en: He spoke in the parlance of the local fishermen.

usage.label: countable and uncountable
usage.pattern: The source explicitly gives both countable and uncountable usage.

entries.definition_cn: 连赌；（将赢来的钱）再下注
entries.definition_en: a series of wagers in which the winnings from one wager are used as a stake for the subsequent wagers
entries.example_cn: 他通过一次成功的连赌，将小利润变成了巨额财富。
entries.example_en: He managed to turn a small profit into a fortune through a successful parlay.

entries.definition_cn: 将赢利或资产转作进一步投资以增值
entries.definition_en: to carry winnings, money, or an asset forward to increase its value
entries.example_cn: 她决定将最初的赢利连赌成更大的投资。
entries.example_en: She decided to parlay her initial win into a larger investment.

entries.definition_en: a negotiation between enemies
entries.example_cn: 两军同意进行谈判以讨论投降条款。
entries.example_en: The two armies agreed to a parley to discuss surrender terms.

entries.definition_en: to discuss, especially between enemies
entries.example_cn: 将军们在密室里进行了谈判。
entries.example_en: The generals parleyed behind closed doors.

entries.definition_en: the group of people who make laws in a country
entries.example_cn: 议会昨天投票通过了新预算。
entries.example_en: The parliament voted on the new budget yesterday.

entries.definition_en: a card game played with a specific sequence of cards
entries.example_cn: 他们花了一下午玩帕拉门特牌。
entries.example_en: They spent the afternoon playing parliament.

entries.definition_en: a member of a parliament or other elected legislative body
entries.example_cn: 这位国会议员就新法案发表了激情的演讲。
entries.example_en: The parliamentarian spoke passionately about the new bill.

entries.definition_en: an expert in parliamentary rules and procedures
entries.example_cn: 这位新的议会专家帮助委员会处理复杂的投票规则。
entries.example_en: The new parliamentarian helped the committee navigate complex voting rules.

entries.definition_en: relating to or supporting a parliament
entries.example_cn: 该运动主张建立实行民选立法机构的议会制。
entries.example_en: The movement advocated a parliamentarian system with an elected legislature.

entries.definition_en: relating to or having the nature of a parliament
entries.example_cn: 议会会议于中午开始。
entries.example_en: The parliamentary session began at noon.

entries.definition_cn: 符合议会规则和惯例的
entries.definition_en: in accord with rules and customs of a legislative or deliberative assembly
entries.example_cn: 辩论遵循了议会程序。
entries.example_en: The debate followed parliamentary procedure.

entries.definition_cn: 最高立法权由从立法机关或议会选出并对之负责的部长会议掌握
entries.definition_en: having the supreme legislative power resting with a body of cabinet ministers chosen from and responsible to the legislature or parliament
entries.example_cn: 这个国家实行议会制政府。
entries.example_en: The country has a parliamentary system of government.

entries.definition_en: a room in a house where people can sit and talk
entries.example_cn: 我们下午在客厅里打牌。
entries.example_en: We spent the afternoon in the parlor playing cards.

entries.definition_en: a room in an inn or club for receiving visitors
entries.example_cn: 客人们被带到接待室等待经理。
entries.example_en: The guests were shown into the parlor to wait for the manager.

entries.definition_en: a room in a private house or establishment where people can sit and talk and relax.
entries.example_cn: 我们晚上在客厅里和邻居聊天。
entries.example_en: We spent the evening in the parlour chatting with the neighbors.

entries.definition_en: a reception room in an inn or club where visitors can be received.
entries.example_cn: 店主将客人迎进了接待室。
entries.example_en: Guests were welcomed into the parlour by the innkeeper.

entries.definition_en: fraught with danger
entries.example_cn: 当道路坍塌时，司机陷入了危险的境地。
entries.example_en: The driver faced a parlous situation when the road collapsed.

entries.definition_en: Narrowly restricted in outlook or scope.
entries.example_cn: 他目光狭隘，不考虑全世界的需要。
entries.example_en: His parochial views do not consider the needs of the whole world.

entries.definition_en: Relating to or supported by or located in a parish.
entries.example_cn: 这所教会学校由当地教堂管理。
entries.example_en: The parochial school is run by the local church.

entries.definition_cn: 狭隘的地方观念；地方主义
entries.definition_en: a narrow view limited to local interests
entries.example_cn: 该公司的地方主义使其无法看到全球市场机会。
entries.example_en: The company's parochialism prevented it from seeing global market opportunities.

entries.definition_en: in a narrow, limited, or local manner
entries.example_cn: 该委员会因狭隘地忽视全球趋势而受到批评。
entries.example_en: The committee was criticized for parochially ignoring global trends.

entries.definition_cn: 以滑稽方式模仿文学或音乐风格的人
entries.definition_en: a person who imitates literary or musical style for comic effect
entries.example_cn: 那位著名的戏仿作家每周都会创作一部新的短剧。
entries.example_en: The famous parodist wrote a new sketch every week.

entries.definition_en: a work that imitates someone's style humorously
entries.example_cn: 这部电影是对经典恐怖片的滑稽模仿。
entries.example_en: The movie was a hilarious parody of classic horror films.

entries.definition_cn: 以滑稽或讽刺方式模仿作品、体裁、风格或惯例的行为
entries.definition_en: the use of humorous or satirical imitation to ridicule or comment on a work, genre, style, or convention
entries.example_cn: 滑稽模仿可以揭示某种熟悉体裁的荒谬之处。
entries.example_en: Parody can expose the absurdity of a familiar genre.

entries.definition_en: to make a humorous imitation of something
entries.example_cn: 这位喜剧演员戏仿了那位著名政治家的演讲。
entries.example_en: The comedian parodied the famous politician's speech.

entries.definition_en: to create a parody of something
entries.example_cn: 他们决定为学校剧制作那首流行歌曲的戏仿版。
entries.example_en: They decided to parody the popular song for the school play.

entries.definition_en: a conditional release from imprisonment allowing the person to serve the remainder of the sentence outside prison
entries.example_cn: 她获得了假释，被允许在服刑期间与家人同住。
entries.example_en: She was granted parole and allowed to live with her family while serving her sentence.

entries.definition_cn: （历史用法）囚犯的诺言，尤指战俘获释后不再参战的保证
entries.definition_en: (historical) a prisoner's word of honor, especially a promise by a prisoner of war not to return to combat if released
entries.example_cn: 这名战俘保证不再重返战场。
entries.example_en: The prisoner of war gave his parole not to return to combat.

entries.definition_en: (archaic) a watchword or code phrase, especially a military password
entries.example_cn: 军官用这个口令向哨兵表明了身份。
entries.example_en: The officer used the parole to identify himself to the sentry.

entries.definition_en: to release a prisoner on parole
entries.example_cn: 州长决定在囚犯表现良好后将其假释。
entries.example_en: The governor decided to parole the prisoner after he had demonstrated good behavior.

entries.definition_en: a person who has been released from prison under conditions of supervision
entries.example_cn: 假释犯必须每周向官员报到，未经许可不得离开城市。
entries.example_en: The parolee must report to the officer every week and cannot leave the city without permission.

entries.definition_en: an infection of the skin around a fingernail or toenail
entries.example_cn: 这位运动员因为大拇指患甲沟炎疼痛而不得不停止比赛。
entries.example_en: The athlete had to stop playing because of a painful paronychia on his thumb.

entries.definition_cn: 腮腺的；位于腮腺附近的
entries.definition_en: relating to or located near the parotid gland, a salivary gland in the face
entries.example_cn: 外科医生非常小心地切除了腮腺肿瘤，以免损伤面神经。
entries.example_en: The surgeon removed the parotid tumor with great care to avoid damaging the facial nerves.

entries.definition_en: the parotid gland
entries.example_cn: 感染导致腮腺肿胀。
entries.example_en: An infection caused swelling of the parotid.

entries.definition_en: inflammation of one or both parotid glands
entries.example_cn: 医生在检查肿胀的腺体后，诊断该患者患有腮腺炎。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed the patient with parotitis after examining the swollen glands.

entries.definition_en: a type of medicine used to treat depression
entries.example_cn: 医生开了帕罗西汀来帮助她缓解焦虑。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed paroxetine to help with her anxiety.

entries.definition_en: a sudden uncontrollable attack or outburst
entries.example_cn: 当她听到那个有趣的故事时，爆发出一阵大笑。
entries.example_en: She had a paroxysm of laughter when she heard the funny story.

entries.definition_en: occurring in sudden, violent attacks or fits
entries.example_cn: 病人经历了持续数小时的阵发性咳嗽发作。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from paroxysmal coughing fits that lasted for hours.

entries.definition_en: a floor made of parquetry
entries.example_cn: 大厅里有一块带有复杂几何图案的美丽拼花地板。
entries.example_en: The grand hall featured a beautiful parquet floor with intricate geometric patterns.

entries.definition_cn: 位于乐队席与池座环形区之间的正厅座位区
entries.definition_en: seating on the main floor between the orchestra and the parquet circle
entries.example_cn: 我们买到了正厅座位区的票，以便能清楚地看到舞台。
entries.example_en: We secured tickets for the parquet section to get a clear view of the stage.

entries.definition_en: the technique of applying wooden tiles or veneers to create a decorative geometric pattern on floors, furniture, or other surfaces
entries.example_cn: 这间房间的地板展示了优雅的镶木拼花工艺。
entries.example_en: The room featured elegant parquetry on the floor.

entries.definition_en: a young salmon that is up to two years old
entries.example_cn: 渔民常在苏格兰高地清澈的溪流中捕获幼鲑。
entries.example_en: Fishermen often catch parr in the clear streams of the Scottish Highlands.

entries.definition_en: the young of various fishes
entries.example_cn: 孵化场每年春天向河流中释放数千条幼鱼。
entries.example_en: The hatchery releases thousands of parr into the river every spring.

entries.definition_en: the act of killing one's own father or mother
entries.example_cn: 在许多法律体系中，弑亲被视为最严重的罪行之一。
entries.example_en: Parricide is considered one of the most heinous crimes in many legal systems.

entries.definition_en: a person who kills their own parent
entries.example_cn: 这名弑亲者因谋杀父亲被判处终身监禁。
entries.example_en: The parricide was sentenced to life in prison for the murder of his father.

entries.definition_en: a brightly colored tropical bird with a short hooked beak that can mimic sounds
entries.example_cn: 那只色彩斑斓的鹦鹉栖息在树枝上，模仿着那个男人的声音。
entries.example_en: The colorful parrot perched on the branch and mimicked the man's voice.

entries.definition_en: a person who imitates others without understanding what they are doing or saying
entries.example_cn: 别再像个模仿者一样，自己动脑筋想想吧！
entries.example_en: Stop being such a parrot and think for yourself!

entries.definition_en: to repeat words or phrases mindlessly without understanding them
entries.example_cn: 他只是机械地重复着指示，却根本不知道如何修理引擎。
entries.example_en: He just parroted the instructions without really knowing how to fix the engine.

entries.definition_en: a colorful tropical marine fish with a beak-like mouth formed by fused teeth
entries.example_cn: 鹦嘴鱼在覆盖着珊瑚礁的藻类上觅食。
entries.example_en: The parrotfish grazed on the algae covering the coral reef.

entries.definition_en: a defensive move in fencing to block or deflect an attack
entries.example_cn: 他完美地执行了一次格挡，避开了对手的刺击。
entries.example_en: He executed a perfect parry to avoid the opponent's lunge.

entries.definition_en: a return punch, especially in boxing
entries.example_cn: 拳击手向挑战者的脸部打了一记快速的回击拳。
entries.example_en: The boxer landed a quick parry to the challenger's face.

entries.definition_en: to block or deflect the movement of an opponent or ball
entries.example_cn: 守门员用腿成功格挡了射门。
entries.example_en: The goalkeeper managed to parry the shot with his legs.

entries.definition_en: to avoid answering or fulfilling a question or duty
entries.example_cn: 这位政治家试图回避关于丑闻的棘手问题。
entries.example_en: The politician tried to parry the difficult question about the scandal.

entries.definition_en: to analyze the grammatical structure of a sentence
entries.example_cn: 计算机可以分析复杂句子的结构以理解其含义。
entries.example_en: Computers can parse complex sentences to understand their meaning.

entries.definition_en: a unit of distance used in astronomy, equal to about 3.26 light years
entries.example_cn: 离我们太阳系最近的恒星距离约为 1.3 秒差距。
entries.example_en: The nearest star to our solar system is located about 1.3 parsecs away.

entries.definition_en: a computer program that divides code up into functional components
entries.example_cn: 编译器使用解析器来分析源代码。
entries.example_en: The compiler uses a parser to analyze the source code.

entries.definition_en: excessively unwilling to spend money
entries.example_cn: 那位吝啬的经理拒绝批准任何预算增加。
entries.example_en: The parsimonious manager refused to approve any budget increases.

entries.definition_cn: （假设、步骤或推测）尽可能少的；简约的
entries.definition_en: using as few assumptions, steps, or conjectures as possible
entries.example_cn: 研究人员为这些结果选择了最简约的解释。
entries.example_en: The researchers chose the most parsimonious explanation for the results.

entries.definition_en: the habit of being very careful not to spend money unnecessarily
entries.example_cn: 他的节俭意味着他很少买新衣服。
entries.example_en: His parsimony meant he rarely bought new clothes.

entries.definition_en: the quality of using the fewest resources or explanations to solve a problem
entries.example_cn: 该模型因简约而被选用，用较少假设解释这些数据。
entries.example_en: The model was chosen for its parsimony, using fewer assumptions to explain the data.

entries.definition_cn: 一种芳香的欧芹草本植物，叶片平展或卷曲，常切碎后用作食物装饰
entries.definition_en: aromatic herb with flat or crinkly leaves that are cut finely and used to garnish food
entries.example_cn: 她在汤上撒了一些新鲜的欧芹作为装饰。
entries.example_en: She sprinkled fresh parsley over the soup as a garnish.

entries.definition_cn: 芳香的二年生草本植物；欧芹
entries.definition_en: a biennial herb with aromatic leaves
entries.example_cn: 欧芹是一种常用于烹饪的芳香草本植物。
entries.example_en: Parsley is an aromatic herb commonly used in cooking.

entries.definition_cn: 栽培欧洲防风的白色块根
entries.definition_en: the whitish root of the cultivated parsnip plant
entries.example_cn: 她用黄油和香草烤欧洲防风。
entries.example_en: She roasted parsnips with butter and herbs.

entries.definition_cn: 一种因可食用块根而栽培的两年生植物
entries.definition_en: a biennial plant cultivated for its edible root
entries.example_cn: 欧洲防风常因形状相似而与胡萝卜混淆。
entries.example_en: Parsnips are often confused with carrots due to their similar shape.

entries.definition_cn: 白色的可食用欧洲防风块根，需烹饪后食用
entries.definition_en: a whitish edible root eaten when cooked
entries.example_cn: 冬季蔬菜汤里加入了嫩滑的欧洲防风。
entries.example_en: The winter vegetable soup featured tender parsnips.

entries.definition_en: a Protestant or Anglican minister, especially the priest of a parish church
entries.example_cn: 牧师用热情的演讲欢迎新教会的成员。
entries.example_en: The parson welcomed the new congregation members with a warm speech.

entries.definition_en: a house provided by a church for its clergyman
entries.example_cn: 那座古老的牧师住宅静静地矗立在村中心的绿地边缘。
entries.example_en: The old parsonage stood quietly at the edge of the village green.

entries.definition_en: a portion of a whole
entries.example_cn: 这只是故事的一部分。
entries.example_en: This is just a part of the story.

entries.definition_en: a piece of an object
entries.example_cn: 轮子是汽车的一个部件。
entries.example_en: The wheel is a part of the car.

entries.definition_en: a role or responsibility
entries.example_cn: 打扫房间是我的职责。
entries.example_en: It is my part to clean the room.

entries.definition_en: to go separate ways
entries.example_cn: 他们决定分道扬镳。
entries.example_en: They decided to part ways.

entries.definition_en: to stop being together
entries.example_cn: 两家公司合并后分开了。
entries.example_en: The two companies parted after the merger.

entries.definition_en: to some extent
entries.example_cn: 他的解释只让我部分信服。
entries.example_en: I was only partly convinced by his explanation.

entries.definition_en: a piece of nature
entries.example_cn: 这座山是风景的一部分。
entries.example_en: The mountain is a part of the landscape.

entries.definition_en: rare or archaic: to leave for a particular place
entries.example_cn: 探险家们黎明时出发前往海岸。
entries.example_en: The explorers parted for the coast at dawn.

entries.definition_en: a person who owns something together with others
entries.example_cn: 她是当地社区中心的共同拥有者。
entries.example_en: She is a part-owner of the local community center.

entries.definition_en: involving less than the standard or customary time for an activity
entries.example_cn: 她在图书馆做兼职工作。
entries.example_en: She works a part-time job at the library.

entries.definition_en: for less than the standard number of hours
entries.example_cn: 他一边全职工作，一边兼职学习。
entries.example_en: He studies part-time while working full-time.

entries.definition_en: someone who works less than the standard full-time hours
entries.example_cn: 作为一名兼职人员，她平衡了工作与夜间的学习。
entries.example_en: As a part-timer, she balances her job with studying at night.

entries.definition_cn: 分享、给予或获得……的一份
entries.definition_en: to have, give, or receive a share of something
entries.example_cn: 每个人都受邀分享节日大餐。
entries.example_en: Everyone was invited to partake of the festive meal.

entries.definition_en: to consume food or drink
entries.example_cn: 客人们在休息室里享用茶点。
entries.example_en: Guests partake of the refreshments in the lounge.

entries.definition_cn: 具有……的某些品质或特征
entries.definition_en: to have some of the qualities or attributes of something
entries.example_cn: 这项新政策具有旧系统的一些低效特征。
entries.example_en: The new policy partakes of the old system's inefficiencies.

entries.definition_en: a person who shares in something, such as a meal, a crime, or an experience
entries.example_cn: 作为古老仪式的参与者，他感到与祖先有着深刻的联系。
entries.example_en: As a partaker in the ancient ritual, he felt a deep sense of connection to his ancestors.

entries.definition_en: having a margin incised almost to the base so as to create distinct divisions or lobes
entries.example_cn: 这种植物的叶子深裂，呈现出蕾丝般的外观。
entries.example_en: The leaves of the plant are deeply parted, creating a lacy appearance.

entries.definition_en: an ornamental flower garden where beds and paths form a pattern
entries.example_cn: 游客们漫步在由17世纪景观设计师设计的复杂花坛中。
entries.example_en: Visitors walked through the intricate parterre designed by the 17th-century landscape architect.

entries.definition_cn: （剧院的）正厅后部、楼座下方的池座
entries.definition_en: the part of a theater's ground-floor seating behind the stalls and beneath the galleries; the pit
entries.example_cn: 池座的门票能很好地观看舞台，但价格相当昂贵。
entries.example_en: Tickets for the parterre offer a good view of the stage but are quite expensive.

entries.definition_en: a reproductive process where an unfertilized egg develops into a new individual
entries.example_cn: 当配偶稀缺时，一些昆虫通过孤雌生殖繁殖。
entries.example_en: Some insects reproduce through parthenogenesis when mates are scarce.

usage.label: usually uncountable
usage.pattern: The biological process is generally uncountable; an instance may be countable.

entries.definition_en: the conception of Jesus by the Virgin Mary without sexual intercourse
entries.example_cn: 这段文字将基督的童贞女受孕作为一种神学教义来讨论。
entries.example_en: The text discusses the parthenogenesis of Christ as a theological doctrine.

entries.definition_en: relating to reproduction that does not involve the fusion of male and female gametes
entries.example_cn: 某些昆虫在特定条件下能够进行孤雌生殖。
entries.example_en: Some insects are capable of parthenogenetic reproduction under certain conditions.

entries.definition_en: consisting of or relating to only a part of something
entries.example_cn: 我们关于该事件只有部分信息。
entries.example_en: We have only partial information about the incident.

entries.definition_en: showing unfair preference for one person or group over others
entries.example_cn: 经理被指控偏袒他的朋友。
entries.example_en: The manager was accused of being partial to his friends.

entries.definition_en: affecting or involving only a part, not the whole
entries.example_cn: 地震仅对该建筑造成了局部损坏。
entries.example_en: The earthquake caused only partial damage to the building.

entries.definition_en: having a strong liking or preference for something
entries.example_cn: 她偏爱巧克力蛋糕。
entries.example_en: She is partial to chocolate cake.

entries.definition_en: the rate of change of a function with respect to one variable while others are held constant
entries.example_cn: 在微积分中，求多元函数的偏导数是一项常见任务。
entries.example_en: In calculus, finding a partial derivative of a multivariable function is a common task.

entries.definition_en: a musical tone whose frequency is a multiple of the fundamental frequency
entries.example_cn: 小提琴丰富的音色是由其各种分音产生的。
entries.example_en: The rich sound of the violin is created by its various partials.

entries.definition_en: an inclination to favor one group or view over alternatives
entries.example_cn: 法官被指控偏袒被告的家人。
entries.example_en: The judge was accused of partiality toward the defendant's family.

entries.definition_en: a tendency to like something more than others
entries.example_cn: 他对爵士乐的偏爱在他的唱片收藏中显而易见。
entries.example_en: His partiality for jazz music is evident in his record collection.

entries.definition_en: to some extent; not completely
entries.example_cn: 该项目在截止日期前仅部分完成。
entries.example_en: The project was only partially completed before the deadline.

entries.definition_en: capable of being divided or separated into parts
entries.example_cn: 这块土地被认为是可分的，可以在继承人之间进行分割。
entries.example_en: The land was considered partible and could be divided among the heirs.

entries.definition_cn: 与将遗产分割给各继承人的继承制度有关的
entries.definition_en: relating to an inheritance system in which an estate is divided among the heirs
entries.example_cn: 该地区实行分割继承制度，因此遗产由所有子女分得。
entries.example_en: The region followed a partible inheritance system, so the estate was divided among all the children.

entries.definition_en: a person who takes part in an activity or event
entries.example_cn: 每位参与者在研讨会结束时都收到了一张证书。
entries.example_en: Every participant received a certificate at the end of the workshop.

entries.definition_en: a person who takes part in a game or competition
entries.example_cn: 这位选手赢得了国际象棋锦标赛。
entries.example_en: The participant won the chess tournament.

entries.definition_en: to share in something
entries.example_cn: 每个人都被邀请参与讨论。
entries.example_en: Everyone is invited to participate in the discussion.

entries.definition_en: to become a participant; be involved in
entries.example_cn: 她决定加入当地的体育俱乐部。
entries.example_en: She decided to participate in the local sports club.

entries.definition_en: the act of taking part in an activity or event
entries.example_cn: 她在辩论中的表现令人印象深刻。
entries.example_en: Her participation in the debate was impressive.

entries.definition_en: the state of sharing something with others
entries.example_cn: 社区参与该项目至关重要。
entries.example_en: The participation of the community in the project was vital.

entries.definition_en: allowing people to take part in an activity or decision
entries.example_cn: 新的学校项目非常具有参与性，让学生参与规划的每一个阶段。
entries.example_en: The new school program is highly participatory, involving students in every stage of planning.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to or consisting of participles
entries.example_cn: 该结构的分词性质使其能够在从句中充当形容词。
entries.example_en: The participial nature of the construction allows it to function as an adjective within the clause.

entries.definition_en: a non-finite form of a verb that is used adjectivally or to form compound tenses
entries.example_cn: 分词短语“沿着街道跑”修饰句子的主语。
entries.example_en: The participial phrase 'running down the street' modifies the subject of the sentence.
