entries.example_en: The portrait shows the king wearing an elaborate periwig.

entries.definition_en: a trailing poisonous plant with blue flowers
entries.example_cn: 花园里长满了沿着栅栏蔓延的长春花。
entries.example_en: The garden was filled with periwinkle growing along the fence.

entries.definition_en: a cultivated woody herb with large pinkish to red flowers
entries.example_cn: 钟花在晚春绽放，开出鲜艳的粉红色花朵。
entries.example_en: The periwinkle blooms in late spring with vibrant pink flowers.

entries.definition_en: a small edible marine snail often steamed in wine
entries.example_cn: 厨师做了一道用白葡萄酒蒸煮的海蜗牛菜。
entries.example_en: The chef prepared a dish of periwinkle steamed in white wine.

entries.definition_cn: 可食用的海生腹足类动物
entries.definition_en: an edible marine gastropod
entries.example_cn: 沿海居民经常采集海生腹足类动物作为食物。
entries.example_en: Coastal residents often harvest periwinkle for their meals.

entries.definition_en: to lie under oath in a court of law
entries.example_cn: 这位证人拒绝为了朋友而作伪证。
entries.example_en: The witness refused to perjure himself to protect his friend.

entries.definition_en: a person who tells lies in a court of law
entries.example_cn: 这名伪证者因作伪证而被判入狱。
entries.example_en: The perjurer was sentenced to prison for his false testimony.

entries.definition_cn: 故意在宣誓后提供虚假证词的罪行
entries.definition_en: the crime of deliberately giving false testimony under oath
entries.example_cn: 该证人因伪证罪被捕。
entries.example_en: The witness was arrested for perjury.

entries.definition_en: an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment
entries.example_cn: 免费停车是这个工作附带的一项福利。
entries.example_en: Free parking is a perk that comes with this job.

entries.definition_cn: 游戏中玩家角色可以获得的永久特殊能力或强化能力
entries.definition_en: a permanent special ability or power-up that a player character can acquire in a game
entries.example_cn: 这项新的特殊能力让角色可以悄无声息地移动。
entries.example_en: The new perk lets the character move silently.

entries.definition_cn: 振作起来；变得更加愉快、警觉或精力充沛
entries.definition_en: to become more cheerful, alert, or energetic; perk up
entries.example_cn: 睡了一晚好觉后，她精神焕发，准备好工作了。
entries.example_en: After a good night's sleep, she perked up and felt ready to work.

entries.definition_en: cheerfulness that bubbles to the surface
entries.example_cn: 她的欢快感让沉闷的会议变得生动起来。
entries.example_en: Her perkiness made the gloomy meeting feel much more lively.

entries.definition_en: impudence or cheekiness
entries.example_cn: 他打断客人讲话的冒失举动被认为很无礼。
entries.example_en: His perkiness in interrupting the guest was seen as cheekiness.

entries.definition_cn: 精力充沛的；兴高采烈的
entries.definition_en: full of energy and cheerful
entries.example_cn: 这位精力充沛的销售员用灿烂的笑容迎接每一位顾客。
entries.example_en: The perky salesperson greeted every customer with a bright smile.

entries.definition_en: a hairstyle with waves created by chemicals and heat
entries.example_cn: 她决定为婚礼烫个发。
entries.example_en: She decided to get a perm for her wedding.

entries.definition_en: to give a permanent wave to hair
entries.example_cn: 发型师明天会给你做烫发。
entries.example_en: The stylist will perm your hair tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: ground that remains frozen permanently
entries.example_cn: 由于永久冻土融化，道路建设被迫暂停。
entries.example_en: The construction of the road was halted due to the thawing of the permafrost.

entries.definition_en: the quality of lasting for a long time or forever
entries.example_cn: 数字记录的持久性引发了人们对数据隐私的担忧。
entries.example_en: The permanence of digital records raises concerns about data privacy.

entries.definition_en: the quality of lasting for an indefinite period
entries.example_cn: 建筑师考虑了建筑材料的耐久性。
entries.example_en: The architect considered the permanency of the building materials.

entries.definition_en: lasting indefinitely without change
entries.example_cn: 他们希望找到一份永久性的工作。
entries.example_en: They hope to find a permanent job.

entries.definition_en: not able to be changed back
entries.example_cn: 织物的损坏是不可逆的。
entries.example_en: The damage to the fabric was permanent.

entries.definition_en: a hairstyle with waves created using heat and chemicals
entries.example_cn: 她去理发店做了个烫发。
entries.example_en: She went to the salon to get a permanent.

entries.definition_en: used of fabrics that do not require ironing
entries.example_cn: 她买了一件免烫衬衫，一整天都保持平整无皱。
entries.example_en: She bought a permanent-press shirt that stays wrinkle-free all day.

entries.definition_en: in a way that lasts indefinitely; not temporarily
entries.example_cn: 这种损害是永久性的。
entries.example_en: The damage was done permanently.

entries.definition_cn: 高锰酸盐，通常为紫色晶体状氧化性化合物
entries.definition_en: a salt of permanganic acid, usually a purple crystalline oxidizing compound
entries.example_cn: 化学家向溶液中添加了高锰酸盐。
entries.example_en: The chemist added permanganate to the solution.

entries.definition_en: the ability of a substance to allow liquids to pass through it
entries.example_cn: 土壤的渗透性决定了水分流失的速度。
entries.example_en: The permeability of the soil determines how quickly water drains away.

entries.definition_cn: 材料在外加磁场中被磁化能力的量度；磁导率
entries.definition_en: a measure of a material's ability to become magnetized in an applied magnetic field; magnetic permeability
entries.example_cn: 这种材料的磁导率会随温度变化。
entries.example_en: The magnetic permeability of the material changes with temperature.

entries.definition_en: allowing liquids or gases to pass through
entries.example_cn: 这种土壤可渗透，所以水排得很快。
entries.example_en: The soil is permeable, so water drains quickly.

entries.definition_cn: 可渗透的；能透过膜或聚合物的
entries.definition_en: able to pass through or into a membrane or polymer
entries.example_cn: 可渗透离子能够穿过该膜。
entries.example_en: Permeant ions can pass through the membrane.

entries.definition_en: to spread or diffuse through something
entries.example_cn: 新鲜咖啡的香气开始弥漫在整个办公室。
entries.example_en: The smell of fresh coffee began to permeate the entire office.

entries.definition_en: to pass through something
entries.example_cn: 光线可以穿过窗帘的薄布料。
entries.example_en: Light can permeate the thin fabric of the curtain.

entries.definition_en: to penetrate mutually or be interlocked
entries.example_cn: 树木的根系相互渗透，交织在土壤中。
entries.example_en: The roots of the trees permeate the soil, intertwining with each other.

entries.definition_en: the process of permeating or infusing something with a substance
entries.example_cn: 油渗入布料的过程非常缓慢。
entries.example_en: The permeation of the oil into the fabric was very slow.

entries.definition_en: mutual penetration; diffusion of each through the other
entries.example_cn: 这两种文化之间存在着思想的完全相互渗透。
entries.example_en: There was a complete permeation of ideas between the two cultures.

entries.definition_en: styled with permanent waves
entries.example_cn: 她烫卷的头发松松地卷着。
entries.example_en: She wore her permed hair in loose curls.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being allowed or permitted
entries.example_cn: 委员会对新政策的许可性进行了辩论。
entries.example_en: The permissibility of the new policy was debated by the committee.

entries.definition_en: that may be permitted especially as according to rule
entries.example_cn: 在图书馆里使用手机被允许吗？
entries.example_en: Is it permissible to use a mobile phone in the library?

entries.definition_en: that may be accepted or conceded
entries.example_cn: 周末旅行的想法对每个人来说都是可接受的。
entries.example_en: The idea of a weekend trip is permissible to everyone.

entries.definition_cn: 以获准的方式；在许可范围内
entries.definition_en: in a manner that is allowed or permitted
entries.example_cn: 用户可以在许可范围内与第三方应用程序共享数据。
entries.example_en: Users may permissibly share their data with third-party applications.

entries.definition_en: official approval to do something
entries.example_cn: 你需要我的准许才能进入大楼。
entries.example_en: You need my permission to enter the building.

entries.definition_en: the act of giving a formal authorization
entries.example_cn: 该公司就合并事宜签发了书面正式授权。
entries.example_en: The company issued a written permission for the merger.

entries.definition_en: granting or inclined or able to grant permission; not strict in discipline
entries.example_cn: 她对孩子们行为的宽容态度导致了问题。
entries.example_en: Her permissive attitude towards her children's behavior caused problems.

entries.definition_cn: 允许某事发生而非加以阻止的；尤指允许病毒复制的
entries.definition_en: allowing something to happen rather than preventing it, especially allowing viruses to replicate
entries.example_cn: 这种允许性宿主使病毒得以复制。
entries.example_en: The permissive host allowed the virus to replicate.

entries.definition_en: in a way that allows freedom or does not restrict
entries.example_cn: 这位老师宽容地批改了作文，更注重创造力而非严格的语法规则。
entries.example_en: The teacher graded the essays permissively, focusing on creativity rather than strict grammar rules.

entries.definition_cn: 放任；宽容（对规则或行为）
entries.definition_en: a tendency or disposition to allow people considerable freedom of choice or behavior
entries.example_cn: 学校对学生着装规范的放任态度遭到了家长的批评。
entries.example_en: The school's permissiveness regarding student dress codes was criticized by the parents.

entries.definition_en: to agree to allow someone to do something
entries.example_cn: 老师不允许学生在考试期间使用手机。
entries.example_en: The teacher will not permit students to use their phones during the exam.

entries.definition_en: to make it possible for something to happen
entries.example_cn: 这项新技术使数据处理速度更快。
entries.example_en: The new technology permits faster data processing.

entries.definition_en: to allow something to exist or continue without stopping or prohibiting it
entries.example_cn: 经理默许了建筑工地的噪音继续存在。
entries.example_en: The manager permitted the noise from the construction site to continue.

entries.definition_en: an official document that gives legal permission to do something
entries.example_cn: 在这个地区建房需要特殊许可证。
entries.example_en: You need a special permit to build a house in this area.

entries.definition_en: the act of giving formal authorization
entries.example_cn: 市长取消了对举行集会的准许。
entries.example_en: The mayor's permit to hold the rally was revoked.

entries.definition_cn: 许可鱼（一种西大西洋大型游钓鱼）
entries.definition_en: a large game fish, Trachinotus falcatus, found in the western Atlantic
entries.example_cn: 这种鱼是当地渔民珍视的捕获物。
entries.example_en: The permit is a prized catch among local fishermen.

entries.definition_cn: 一组元素可能的排列方式之一
entries.definition_en: one of the possible ways a set of elements can be arranged
entries.example_cn: 在数学中，排列是集合中元素的一种特定排序方式。
entries.example_en: In mathematics, a permutation is a specific arrangement of elements in a set.

entries.definition_cn: 从一个有限集合到自身的一一映射
entries.definition_en: a one-to-one mapping from a finite set to itself
entries.example_cn: 这个置换将每个元素映射到其后的元素，并将最后一个元素映射回第一个元素。
entries.example_en: This permutation takes each element to the one following it, with the last mapped back to the first.

entries.definition_cn: 有限个互不相同元素的一种排列
entries.definition_en: an ordering of a finite set of distinct elements
entries.example_cn: 三个元素有六种排列，例如{abc、acb、bac、bca、cab、cba}。
entries.example_en: There are six permutations of three elements, e.g. {abc, acb, bac, bca, cab, cba}.

entries.definition_cn: （音乐）通过移调、倒影或逆行等对原形集合的变换
entries.definition_en: in music, a transformation of a set's prime form by transposition, inversion, or retrograde
entries.example_cn: 作曲家在终乐章中使用了音列的一种变换。
entries.example_en: The composer used a permutation of the tone row in the final movement.

entries.definition_en: to change the order or arrangement of things
entries.example_cn: 你可以排列这些字母来组成不同的单词。
entries.example_en: You can permute the letters to form different words.

entries.definition_en: extremely harmful
entries.example_cn: 该病毒的极其有害的影响立即显现出来。
entries.example_en: The pernicious effects of the virus were felt immediately.

entries.definition_en: working or spreading insidiously to cause harm
entries.example_cn: 那些恶意的谣言在社区中传播开来。
entries.example_en: The pernicious rumors spread through the community.

entries.definition_en: in a harmful, insidious manner
entries.example_cn: 这种疾病以有害而阴险的方式在村庄里蔓延。
entries.example_en: The disease spread perniciously through the village.

entries.definition_en: in a noxiously baneful way
entries.example_cn: 他以有害的方式削弱了团队的士气。
entries.example_en: He perniciously undermined the team's morale.

entries.definition_en: characterized by excessive precision and attention to trivial details
entries.example_cn: 那位吹毛求疵的检查员拒绝签署报告，直到每一个小数点都正确无误。
entries.example_en: The pernickety inspector refused to sign the report until every decimal point was correct.

entries.definition_en: relating to the fibula or the outer part of the lower leg
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了腓神经以查看是否有损伤。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the peroneal nerve to check for damage.

entries.definition_en: a muscle of the lower leg involved in moving the foot
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了腓骨肌以确认是否有损伤。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the peroneus muscle to check for injury.

entries.definition_en: the concluding section of a speech or oration
entries.example_cn: 辩论的结尾部分聚焦于拟议法律的未来影响。
entries.example_en: The peroration of the debate focused on the future implications of the proposed law.

usage.label: rhetoric; technical
usage.pattern: the concluding section of a discourse

entries.definition_en: a speech that is overly flowery and rhetorical
entries.example_cn: 政治家的演说辞藻华丽，充满了空洞的承诺和浮夸的语言。
entries.example_en: The politician's peroration was filled with empty promises and grandiose language.

entries.definition_en: an enzyme that catalyzes the oxidation of a compound by a peroxide
entries.example_cn: 过氧化氢酶是一种存在于许多活细胞中的过氧化物酶。
entries.example_en: Catalase is a type of peroxidase found in many living cells.

entries.definition_cn: 过氧化氢，尤指用作漂白剂或温和消毒剂的水溶液
entries.definition_en: hydrogen peroxide, especially an aqueous solution used as a bleach or mild disinfectant
entries.example_cn: 理发师给客户的头发上过过氧化氢以使其变浅。
entries.example_en: The hairdresser applied peroxide to lighten the client's hair.

entries.definition_cn: 含有氧—氧单键的化合物
entries.definition_en: a compound containing an oxygen–oxygen single bond
entries.example_cn: 过氧化氢是简单过氧化物的一个常见例子。
entries.example_en: Hydrogen peroxide is a common example of a simple peroxide.

entries.definition_en: to bleach something using peroxide
entries.example_cn: 他们决定用双氧水处理这块布料以去除污渍。
entries.example_en: They decided to peroxide the fabric to remove the stain.

entries.definition_en: intersecting at or forming right angles
entries.example_cn: 这两面墙以直角相接。
entries.example_en: The two walls meet at a perpendicular angle.

entries.definition_en: at right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line
entries.example_cn: 塔楼垂直于地面耸立。
entries.example_en: The tower rises perpendicular to the ground.

entries.definition_en: so steep as to be nearly vertical
entries.example_cn: 悬崖壁近乎垂直，攀登很危险。
entries.example_en: The cliff face is perpendicular and dangerous to climb.

entries.definition_en: a straight line that meets another line at a right angle
entries.example_cn: 从点A向基线画一条垂线。
entries.example_en: Draw a perpendicular from point A to the base line.

entries.definition_cn: 铅垂线；用于确定垂直方向的悬锤线
entries.definition_en: a cord with a suspended weight used to determine the vertical direction
entries.example_cn: 测量员用铅垂线检查墙体是否垂直。
entries.example_en: The surveyor used a perpendicular to check whether the wall was vertical.

entries.definition_cn: 陡峭得近乎垂直的岩壁或土壁；绝壁
entries.definition_en: an extremely steep or nearly vertical face of rock or earth
entries.example_cn: 登山者面对着一道陡峭的绝壁。
entries.example_en: The climbers faced a sheer perpendicular.

entries.definition_en: a Gothic architectural style from 14th and 15th century England featuring vertical lines and fan vaulting
entries.example_cn: 这座大教堂是垂直哥特式建筑的杰出范例。
entries.example_en: The cathedral is a fine example of perpendicular architecture.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being at right angles to a specific line or plane
entries.example_cn: 建筑师强调建筑物主体结构相对于地平线的垂直性。
entries.example_en: The architect emphasized the perpendicularity of the building's main structure to the horizon.

entries.definition_en: the relation of being at right angles between two things
entries.example_cn: 这两条线的垂直关系对于几何证明至关重要。
entries.example_en: The perpendicularity of the two lines was crucial for the geometric proof.

entries.definition_en: in a direction that is straight up or down without any deviation
entries.example_cn: 攀登者垂直向上攀爬悬崖。
entries.example_en: The climber ascended the cliff perpendicularly.

entries.definition_en: in a manner that forms a right angle
entries.example_cn: 旗杆与地面成直角竖立。
entries.example_en: The flagpole stands perpendicularly to the ground.

entries.definition_en: to commit or carry out an act, usually with a negative connotation
entries.example_cn: 这名罪犯被指控犯下了一系列银行抢劫案。
entries.example_en: The criminal was accused of perpetrating a series of bank robberies.

entries.definition_en: the act of perpetrating something, especially a crime
entries.example_cn: 调查重点在于欺诈行为的实施。
entries.example_en: The investigation focused on the perpetration of the fraud.

entries.definition_en: a person who commits a crime or wrongdoing
entries.example_cn: 警方正在搜寻银行抢劫案的罪犯。
entries.example_en: The police are searching for the perpetrator of the bank robbery.

entries.definition_en: continuing forever or indefinitely
entries.example_cn: 星辰永不停息的运动令天文学家着迷。
entries.example_en: The perpetual motion of the stars fascinates astronomers.

entries.definition_en: uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing
entries.example_cn: 他们面临着来自建筑工地的持续噪音。
entries.example_en: They faced perpetual noise from the construction site.

entries.definition_en: everlastingly; for all time
entries.example_cn: 星星似乎在夜空中永远闪烁。
entries.example_en: The stars seemed to twinkle perpetually in the night sky.

entries.definition_en: invariably
entries.example_cn: 他总是早会迟到。
entries.example_en: He was perpetually late for his morning meetings.

entries.definition_en: to cause something to continue existing or to remain in force
entries.example_cn: 我们不应延续那些歧视女性的旧传统。
entries.example_en: We must not perpetuate the old traditions that discriminate against women.

entries.definition_en: the act of making something continue for a long time
entries.example_cn: 该博物馆致力于延续当地的历史和文化。
entries.example_en: The museum is dedicated to the perpetuation of local history and culture.

entries.definition_en: the property of being perpetual (seemingly ceaseless)
entries.example_cn: 该慈善机构被永久设立以永远支持教育。
entries.example_en: The charity was established in perpetuity to support education forever.

entries.definition_cn: 一种抗精神病药，有时用于控制严重的恶心和呕吐
entries.definition_en: an antipsychotic drug, sometimes used to control severe nausea and vomiting
entries.example_cn: 医生开了奋乃静来帮助控制患者的恶心。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed perphenazine to help manage the patient's nausea.

entries.definition_en: to cause someone to feel confused or unable to understand something
entries.example_cn: 侦探因缺乏线索而感到困惑。
entries.example_en: The detective was perplexed by the lack of clues.

entries.definition_en: to make a situation more complicated or difficult to solve
entries.example_cn: 新规定使问题更加复杂。
entries.example_en: The new regulations only perplexed the issue further.

entries.definition_en: feeling confused and unable to understand something
entries.example_cn: 她看着复杂的说明，显得十分困惑。
entries.example_en: She looked perplexed by the complex instructions.

entries.definition_en: lacking clarity of meaning; causing confusion or perplexity
entries.example_cn: 这个谜题令人费解，我们几个小时都在猜测。
entries.example_en: The perplexing nature of the puzzle kept us guessing for hours.

entries.definition_en: a state of confusion or difficulty caused by something complex
entries.example_cn: 法律体系的复杂性给公民带来了巨大的困惑。
entries.example_en: The complexity of the legal system caused great perplexity among the citizens.

entries.definition_cn: 衡量概率模型预测样本效果的指标；困惑度
entries.definition_en: a measure of how well a probability model predicts a sample
entries.example_cn: 该语言模型在测试数据上的困惑度更低。
entries.example_en: The language model achieved lower perplexity on the test data.

entries.definition_en: an extra benefit given to someone for their job, especially one that is considered a right
entries.example_cn: 公司为高级主管提供汽车作为一项工作福利。
entries.example_en: The company offers a car as a perquisite for senior executives.

usage.label: usually plural
usage.pattern: Job-related benefits are commonly discussed as perquisites.

entries.definition_en: a special right or privilege reserved for a specific person or group
entries.example_cn: 国王声称任命法官是其专属特权。
entries.example_en: The king claimed the perquisite of appointing his own judges.

entries.definition_en: a drink made from fermented pear juice, often fizzy and tasting like hard cider
entries.example_cn: 晚餐后他们享用了一杯清爽的梨酒。
entries.example_en: They enjoyed a glass of crisp perry after dinner.

entries.definition_en: to treat someone unfairly and cruelly because of their beliefs, race, or other characteristics
entries.example_cn: 这个少数群体因其宗教信仰而受到迫害。
entries.example_en: The minority group was persecuted for their religious beliefs.

entries.definition_cn: 迫害行为，尤其是基于种族或宗教的迫害
entries.definition_en: the act of persecuting, especially on the basis of race or religion
entries.example_cn: 他们逃离该国以躲避宗教迫害。
entries.example_en: They fled the country to escape religious persecution.

entries.definition_en: a person who torments or harasses someone
entries.example_cn: 受迫害者逃往邻国，躲避迫害者。
entries.example_en: The persecuted sought refuge from their persecutor in a neighboring country.

entries.definition_en: persistent determination
entries.example_cn: 她学习上的坚持不懈使她在考试中取得了成功。
entries.example_en: Her perseverance in studying led to her success in the exam.

entries.definition_en: the act of persisting or persevering; continuing or repeating behavior
entries.example_cn: 团队在日常训练中表现出的坚持显而易见。
entries.example_en: The perseverance of the team was evident in their daily practice.

entries.definition_en: the tendency for a memory or idea to persist or recur without any apparent stimulus for it
entries.example_cn: 该患者患有固着症，尽管没有提示，却反复说着同一句话。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from perseveration, repeatedly saying the same phrase despite no prompt.

entries.definition_en: the act or an instance of persevering; perseverance
entries.example_cn: 她坚持为这个不受欢迎的理论辩护，给同事留下了深刻印象。
entries.example_en: Her perseveration in defending the unpopular theory impressed her colleagues.

entries.definition_en: to continue trying to achieve something despite difficulties
entries.example_cn: 他们冒着风暴坚持前行，最终到达了岸边。
entries.example_en: They persevered through the storm to reach the shore.

entries.definition_en: continuing quietly and steadily, especially in attention to detail or exactness
entries.example_cn: 她坚持不懈地努力完善手稿，最终得到了回报。
entries.example_en: Her persevering efforts to perfect the manuscript finally paid off.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows perseverance
entries.example_cn: 尽管遇到困难，她仍坚持不懈地致力于这个项目。
entries.example_en: She perseveringly worked on her project despite the difficulties.

entries.definition_en: good-natured teasing or frivolous, lighthearted discussion
entries.example_cn: 他们的谈话充满了友好的戏谑，而非严肃的生意经。
entries.example_en: Their conversation was filled with friendly persiflage rather than serious business.

entries.definition_en: an orange fruit resembling a plum that is edible when fully ripe
entries.example_cn: 我们把柿子当作甜点吃了。
entries.example_en: We ate sweet persimmons for dessert.

entries.definition_en: a tropical tree of the genus Diospyros
entries.example_cn: 那棵柿树高高地立在花园里。
entries.example_en: The persimmon tree stands tall in the garden.

entries.definition_en: to continue to exist or be present
entries.example_cn: 尽管我们尽了最大努力，这个问题仍然存在。
entries.example_en: The problem persisted despite our best efforts to fix it.

entries.definition_en: to continue doing something even when it is difficult or unwanted
entries.example_cn: 她坚持提问，直到得到答案。
entries.example_en: She persisted in asking questions until she got an answer.

entries.definition_en: to stay in a particular place and not go away
entries.example_cn: 气味在房间里持续了一整天。
entries.example_en: The smell persisted in the room all day.

entries.definition_en: steady determination to continue despite difficulties
entries.example_cn: 她坚持不懈的学习最终带来了成功。
entries.example_en: Her persistence in studying led to her success.

entries.definition_en: the act of continuing or repeating a behavior
entries.example_cn: 咳嗽的持续让医生感到担忧。
entries.example_en: The persistence of the cough worried the doctor.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being continuous and connected over time
entries.example_cn: 噪音的连续性打扰了邻居。
entries.example_en: The persistence of the noise disturbed the neighbors.

entries.definition_en: the state or quality of continuing to exist or occur
entries.example_cn: 雨一直下个不停，使得旅程变得困难。
entries.example_en: The persistency of the rain made the journey difficult.

entries.definition_en: never-ceasing
entries.example_cn: 持续的噪音让人难以集中注意力。
entries.example_en: The persistent noise made it hard to concentrate.

entries.definition_en: stubbornly unyielding
entries.example_cn: 他顽固地拒绝改变主意。
entries.example_en: He was persistent in his refusal to change his mind.

entries.definition_en: continually recurring to the mind
entries.example_cn: 她一直有个念头，觉得有人在监视她。
entries.example_en: She had a persistent thought that she was being watched.

entries.definition_cn: 持久的；程序结束后仍然存在的（尤指数据）
entries.definition_en: remaining in existence after the program that created it has ended, especially when stored as data
entries.example_cn: 记录保存到数据库后就会持久存在，程序关闭后仍会保留。
entries.example_en: Once saved to the database, the record becomes persistent and remains there after the program closes.

entries.definition_en: retained; not shed
entries.example_cn: 松树的球果成熟后仍会留在树上。
entries.example_en: Pine trees have persistent cones that remain attached after maturity.

entries.definition_en: in a persistent manner
entries.example_cn: 她坚持不懈地提问，直到找到答案。
entries.example_en: She persistently asked questions until she found the answer.

entries.definition_en: with persistence
entries.example_cn: 尽管遇到困难，他仍执着地致力于该项目。
entries.example_en: He persistently worked on the project despite the difficulties.

entries.definition_en: continuing relentlessly and tirelessly in pursuit of something
entries.example_cn: 团队坚持不懈的努力终于带来了突破。
entries.example_en: The persisting efforts of the team finally led to a breakthrough.

entries.definition_en: characterized by excessive precision and attention to trivial details
entries.example_cn: 老板对报告的格式吹毛求疵。
entries.example_en: The boss is persnickety about the formatting of the report.

entries.definition_en: overly conceited or arrogant
entries.example_cn: 别那么自负地在意你的外表；这并不重要。
entries.example_en: Don't be so persnickety about your appearance; it doesn't matter.

entries.definition_en: a human being
entries.example_cn: 每个人都有投票权。
entries.example_en: Every person has the right to vote.

entries.definition_en: a human body (usually including the clothing)
entries.example_cn: 那个人穿着一件红大衣。
entries.example_en: The person was wearing a red coat.

entries.definition_en: a grammatical category for pronouns and verbs
entries.example_cn: 动词的形式取决于人称。
entries.example_en: The verb changes form depending on the person.

entries.definition_en: involving direct communication or contact between persons or parties
entries.example_cn: 我们更喜欢面对面沟通，而不是电子邮件。
entries.example_en: We prefer person-to-person communication over email.

entries.definition_cn: （电话）只有在指定的人有空接听时才接通并计费的
entries.definition_en: (of a telephone call) connecting the caller only if the specified person is available to speak, with charges applying only then
entries.example_cn: 我打了一个指定接听人的电话给酒店经理，但她当时没空。
entries.example_en: I made a person-to-person call to the hotel manager, but she was unavailable.

entries.definition_cn: （贷款）出借方和借款方都是个人，而不是公司
entries.definition_en: (of a loan) made between an individual lender and an individual borrower rather than between companies
entries.example_cn: 他们安排了一笔个人对个人的贷款，出借方和借款方都是个人。
entries.example_en: They arranged a person-to-person loan between two individuals.

entries.definition_en: (of two persons) in direct encounter
entries.example_cn: 他们直接交换了意见。
entries.example_en: They exchanged views person-to-person.

entries.definition_cn: （荣格心理学）个人向外界展示的面具
entries.definition_en: (Jungian psychology) a personal facade that one presents to the world
entries.example_cn: 在公众面前，他保持着愉快的面具，尽管他内心常常感到疲惫。
entries.example_en: In public, he maintains a cheerful persona, though he is often tired inside.

entries.definition_en: an actor's portrayal of someone in a play
entries.example_cn: 这位演员的角色如此逼真，以至于观众忘记了那是一场表演。
entries.example_en: The actor's persona was so convincing that the audience forgot it was a performance.

entries.definition_cn: （人）外表讨喜且性格随和的；和蔼可亲的
entries.definition_en: pleasant in appearance and personality; easy to like
entries.example_cn: 新经理外表讨喜、待人友善。
entries.example_en: The new manager is personable, with a pleasant appearance and friendly manner.

entries.definition_en: a person whose actions and opinions strongly influence events
entries.example_cn: 这位新部长是政府中的关键人物。
entries.example_en: The new minister is a key personage in the government.

entries.definition_en: a character in a film, book, or play
entries.example_cn: 小说中的核心人物在忠诚与野心之间挣扎。
entries.example_en: The novel's central personage struggles with loyalty and ambition.

entries.definition_cn: 涉及特定个人或其私生活与个性的
entries.definition_en: concerning or affecting a particular person or his or her private life and personality
entries.example_cn: 她要求与经理进行私人面谈。
entries.example_en: She asked for a personal interview with the manager.

entries.definition_en: relating to a person's body or physical appearance
entries.example_cn: 这本杂志称赞了这位演员的外貌魅力。
entries.example_en: The magazine praised the actor's personal charms.

entries.definition_en: of or arising from personality
entries.example_cn: 他独特的领导风格非常有效。
entries.example_en: His personal style of leadership was very effective.

entries.definition_en: indicating grammatical person
entries.example_cn: 动词的形式取决于使用的人称代词。
entries.example_en: The verb changes form depending on the personal pronoun used.

entries.definition_cn: 征友广告；个人广告（通常用复数）
entries.definition_en: a personal advertisement, usually used in the plural form personals, in which someone seeks contact with others
entries.example_cn: 她在征友广告栏刊登了一则寻找旅伴的广告。
entries.example_en: She placed an ad in the personals seeking a travel companion.

entries.definition_en: to make something more personal or tailored to an individual
entries.example_cn: 该软件允许您使用自定义小部件个性化您的仪表板。
entries.example_en: The software allows you to personalise your dashboard with custom widgets.

entries.definition_en: designed or adjusted specifically for a particular individual
entries.example_cn: 该软件根据您的偏好提供个性化的体验。
entries.example_en: The software offers a personalised experience based on your preferences.

entries.definition_en: the complex of all the attributes — behavioral, temperamental, emotional and mental — that characterize a unique individual
entries.example_cn: 她外向的个性使她在社区中很受欢迎。
entries.example_en: Her outgoing personality made her a popular figure in the community.

entries.definition_en: a person of considerable prominence
entries.example_cn: 那位名人昨晚参加了慈善晚宴。
entries.example_en: The celebrity personality attended the charity gala last night.

entries.definition_en: to make something more personal or tailored to an individual
entries.example_cn: 该软件允许您使用自定义小部件个性化您的仪表板。
entries.example_en: The software allows you to personalize your dashboard with custom widgets.

entries.definition_cn: 使某物带有自己的个性或独特特征
entries.definition_en: to imbue something with one's own personality or distinctive character
entries.example_cn: 设计师用手工家具和家庭照片为房间注入了自己的个性。
entries.example_en: The designer personalized the room with handmade furniture and family photographs.

entries.definition_en: made for or directed or adjusted to a particular individual
entries.example_cn: 该公司为每位客户提供个性化服务。
entries.example_en: The company offers personalized services for every customer.

entries.definition_en: pointedly referring to or concerning a person's individual personality or intimate affairs especially offensively
entries.example_cn: 这位政治家针对对手的个人私生活进行了人身攻击。
entries.example_en: The politician made a personalized attack on his opponent's private life.

entries.definition_en: involving oneself directly
entries.example_cn: 这件事我会亲自处理。
entries.example_en: I will handle this matter personally.

entries.definition_en: in person; without intermediaries
entries.example_cn: 我想当面向你道歉。
entries.example_en: I would like to apologize to you personally.

entries.definition_en: in a way that concerns one's own life or feelings
entries.example_cn: 就个人而言，我觉得这部电影太长了。
entries.example_en: Personally, I think the movie was too long.

entries.definition_en: in one's capacity as an individual
entries.example_cn: 作为一名公民，我个人相信自由。
entries.example_en: As a citizen, I personally believe in freedom.

entries.definition_en: regarding the speaker's own experience
entries.example_cn: 就我而言，我从未去过巴黎。
entries.example_en: Personally, I have never been to Paris.

entries.definition_en: movable property, as opposed to real estate
entries.example_cn: 破产律师列出了公司所有待拍卖的动产。
entries.example_en: The bankruptcy lawyer listed all the company's personalty for auction.

entries.definition_en: acting the part of a character on stage; dramatically representing the character by speech and action and gesture
entries.example_cn: 她扮演悲剧女王令人动容。
entries.example_en: Her personation of the tragic queen was moving.

entries.definition_en: the act of imitating the mannerisms of another person
entries.example_cn: 罪犯在冒充他人时被当场抓获。
entries.example_en: The criminal was caught in the act of personation.

entries.definition_cn: 作为人的身份；人格地位
entries.definition_en: the state of being a person
entries.example_cn: 这场辩论聚焦于胎儿的法律人格地位。
entries.example_en: The debate focused on the legal status of personhood for the fetus.

entries.definition_cn: 将抽象品质或思想拟人化
entries.definition_en: the representation of an abstract quality or idea as a person or creature
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家通过将冬天描绘成一位留着白胡子的老人，运用了拟人化的手法。
entries.example_en: The artist used personification to depict Winter as an old man with a white beard.

entries.definition_cn: 赋予抽象概念以人的特征
entries.definition_en: the act of attributing human characteristics to abstract ideas
entries.example_cn: 这首诗大量运用赋予抽象概念以人的特征的手法，让风看起来像个顽皮的孩童。
entries.example_en: The poem relies heavily on personification to make the wind seem like a mischievous child.

entries.definition_en: a person who represents an abstract quality
entries.example_cn: 在这个故事中，希望是引导迷路者的那束光的拟人化形象。
entries.example_en: In the story, Hope is a personification of the light that guides the lost travelers.

entries.definition_en: attribute human qualities to something
entries.example_cn: 这本儿童读物教导读者将大自然拟人化为一位慈爱的母亲。
entries.example_en: The children's book teaches readers to personify nature as a caring mother.

entries.definition_en: represent, as of a character on stage
entries.example_cn: 在这部戏剧中，这位演员凭借高超的技巧扮演了悲剧英雄的角色。
entries.example_en: In the play, the actor personified the tragic hero with great skill.

entries.definition_en: invest with or as with a body; give body to
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家试图在她的雕塑中赋予“希望”这一抽象概念以形体。
entries.example_en: The artist sought to personify the abstract concept of hope in her sculpture.

entries.definition_en: a group of people, especially those employed by an organization
entries.example_cn: 所有工作人员都必须佩戴身份识别证。
entries.example_en: All personnel must wear identification badges.

entries.definition_en: the department responsible for hiring and training and placing employees and for setting policies for personnel management
entries.example_cn: 她在人事部门工作，负责招聘。
entries.example_en: She works in personnel and handles recruitment.

entries.definition_cn: 看待或理解事物的特定方式
entries.definition_en: a particular way of thinking about or understanding something.
entries.example_cn: 从不同的角度看问题很重要。
entries.example_en: It is important to look at the problem from a different perspective.

entries.definition_en: the way objects appear smaller or larger depending on their distance from the viewer.
entries.example_cn: 艺术家利用透视法让房间看起来更深邃。
entries.example_en: The artist used perspective to make the room look deeper.

entries.definition_en: able to see or understand things clearly and deeply
entries.example_cn: 她对市场趋势的敏锐分析使公司免于失败。
entries.example_en: Her perspicacious analysis of the market trends saved the company from failure.

entries.definition_en: having a keen ability to understand things quickly and wisely
entries.example_cn: 这位敏锐的侦探注意到了犯罪现场最微小的细节。
entries.example_en: The perspicacious detective noticed the smallest detail in the crime scene.

entries.definition_en: the ability to assess situations shrewdly and draw sound conclusions
entries.example_cn: 侦探的洞察力帮助他解决了这个复杂的案件。
entries.example_en: The detective's perspicacity helped him solve the complex case.

entries.definition_en: shrewd intelligence, especially in business dealings
entries.example_cn: 她的精明让她立刻发现了合同中的漏洞。
entries.example_en: Her perspicacity allowed her to spot the flaw in the contract immediately.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being clear and easy to understand
entries.example_cn: 作者写作的清晰性使得复杂的理论易于理解。
entries.example_en: The perspicuity of the author's writing made the complex theory easy to grasp.

entries.definition_cn: 洞察力；清楚理解形势和人的能力
entries.definition_en: insight or the ability to understand situations and people clearly
entries.example_cn: 她的洞察力使她看出了他提议背后的隐秘动机。
entries.example_en: Her perspicuity enabled her to recognize the hidden motive behind his proposal.

entries.definition_cn: 表达清楚的；易懂的；明晰的
entries.definition_en: clearly expressed or easily understood; lucid
entries.example_cn: 教授清晰易懂的解释帮助学生迅速掌握了复杂的理论。
entries.example_en: The professor's perspicuous explanation helped the students grasp the complex theory quickly.

entries.definition_en: in a clear and lucid manner
entries.example_cn: 她清晰地解释了那个复杂的理论。
entries.example_en: She explained the complex theory perspicuously.

entries.definition_en: a salty liquid produced by sweat glands in the skin
entries.example_cn: 大量的汗水使他的衬衫紧贴着背部。
entries.example_en: Heavy perspiration made his shirt stick to his back.

entries.definition_en: the process of sweat glands secreting a salty fluid
entries.example_cn: 运动员擦掉了脸上流下的汗水。
entries.example_en: The athlete wiped away the perspiration streaming down his face.

entries.definition_en: to emit sweat through the pores of the skin; sweat
entries.example_cn: 他跑上陡峭的山坡后开始大汗淋漓。
entries.example_en: He began to perspire heavily after running up the steep hill.

entries.definition_en: able to be persuaded
entries.example_cn: 他在政治观点上不太容易被说服。
entries.example_en: He is not very persuadable about his political views.

entries.definition_en: to convince someone to do something or believe something
entries.example_cn: 我试图劝他戒烟，但他不听。
entries.example_en: I tried to persuade him to stop smoking, but he wouldn't listen.

entries.definition_en: to cause someone to agree with or support something
entries.example_cn: 证据说服了陪审团改变判决。
entries.example_en: The evidence persuaded the jury to change their verdict.

entries.definition_en: someone who tries to persuade or induce or lead on
entries.example_cn: 她是个很有说服力的劝说者，能说服犹豫不决的顾客试用该产品。
entries.example_en: She was a skilled persuader who could convince hesitant customers to try the product.

entries.definition_en: the act of persuading someone to believe or do something
entries.example_cn: 他的劝说如此有力，她终于同意了。
entries.example_en: His persuasion was so strong that she finally agreed.

entries.definition_cn: 个人坚信的看法或判断，未必有证据依据
entries.definition_en: a strongly held personal belief or judgment, not necessarily based on proof
entries.example_cn: 他仅凭相信计划会成功的看法便采取了行动。
entries.example_en: He acted on the mere persuasion that the plan would work.

entries.definition_en: having the power to convince someone to do something or believe something
entries.example_cn: 她为这项新政策提出了非常有说服力的论点。
entries.example_en: She made a very persuasive argument for the new policy.

entries.definition_en: in a manner that is convincing or effective in persuading
entries.example_cn: 她很有说服力地为新政策进行了辩护。
entries.example_en: She argued persuasively for the new policy.

entries.definition_en: the power to convince others to take action or accept a view through argument
entries.example_cn: 他演讲的说服力赢得了整个观众的赞同。
entries.example_en: The persuasiveness of his speech won over the entire audience.

entries.definition_en: characterized by a lightly pert and exuberant quality
entries.example_cn: 那个活泼俏皮的孩子连续问了一连串问题。
entries.example_en: The pert child asked a dozen questions in a row.

entries.definition_en: to be relevant to a specific subject or matter
entries.example_cn: 这份文件涉及该公司的财务规定。
entries.example_en: This document pertains to the financial regulations of the company.

usage.label: 不及物，通常与 to 连用
usage.pattern: Source examples use pertain to for belonging and relevance.

entries.definition_en: to be a part of or be an attribute of something
entries.example_cn: 安全责任属于经理。
entries.example_en: The responsibility for safety pertains to the manager.

entries.definition_en: stubbornly unyielding
entries.example_cn: 这位顽固不屈的侦探直到找到线索才肯罢休。
entries.example_en: The pertinacious detective refused to give up until he found the clues.

entries.definition_en: persistent determination
entries.example_cn: 她寻求正义的坚持不懈最终带来了突破。
entries.example_en: Her pertinacity in seeking justice eventually led to a breakthrough.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being relevant or applicable to the matter at hand
entries.example_cn: 他关于当前危机的评论的相关性立刻得到了认可。
entries.example_en: The pertinence of his comments to the current crisis was immediately recognized.

entries.definition_en: having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand
entries.example_cn: 请仅提供与报告相关的信息。
entries.example_en: Please provide only pertinent information for the report.

entries.definition_cn: 恰如其分的；非常贴切的
entries.definition_en: being of striking appropriateness and pertinence
entries.example_cn: 她的话恰如其分地提醒了截止日期。
entries.example_en: Her comment was a pertinent reminder of the deadline.

entries.definition_en: in a way that is relevant and appropriate to the matter at hand
entries.example_cn: 她切当地指出了提案中的缺陷。
entries.example_en: She pertinently pointed out the flaws in the proposal.

entries.definition_en: in a way that is rude or disrespectful
entries.example_cn: 她无礼地回答了老师的问题。
entries.example_en: She answered the teacher's question pertly.

entries.definition_en: in a lively or high-spirited manner
entries.example_cn: 她兴致勃勃地说着，带着活泼的笑容逗弄朋友们。
entries.example_en: She spoke pertly, teasing her friends with a lively smile.

entries.definition_en: to disturb in mind or make uneasy or cause to be worried or alarmed
entries.example_cn: 事故的消息深深使整个社区感到不安。
entries.example_en: The news of the accident deeply perturbed the entire community.

entries.definition_en: to throw into great confusion or disorder
entries.example_cn: 突然的停电使整个会议的日程陷入混乱。
entries.example_en: The sudden power outage perturbed the schedule of the entire conference.

entries.definition_cn: 干扰（电子或原子）的常规路径
entries.definition_en: to disturb or interfere with the usual path of an electron or atom
entries.example_cn: 磁场可以干扰带电粒子的轨迹。
entries.example_en: The magnetic field can perturb the trajectory of charged particles.

entries.definition_cn: 使天体偏离理论上的规则轨道运动
entries.definition_en: to cause a celestial body to deviate from a theoretically regular orbital motion
entries.example_cn: 附近行星的引力会干扰彗星的轨道。
entries.example_en: Gravitational pull from nearby planets can perturb the orbit of a comet.

entries.definition_en: a secondary influence that causes a system to deviate slightly
entries.example_cn: 卫星的轨道受到了引力场微小扰动的影响。
entries.example_en: The satellite's orbit was affected by a minor perturbation in the gravitational field.

entries.definition_en: a state of being unhappy and worried
entries.example_cn: 这则消息使她内心深感不安。
entries.example_en: The news caused a deep perturbation in her mind.

entries.definition_en: a disturbance or disruption in a system
entries.example_cn: 系统在更新过程中突然受到了干扰。
entries.example_en: The system experienced a sudden perturbation during the update process.

entries.definition_en: a disposition that is confused, nervous, and upset
entries.example_cn: 他的焦虑使他难以集中注意力完成任务。
entries.example_en: His perturbation made it difficult for him to concentrate on the task.

entries.definition_en: the act of causing disorder
entries.example_cn: 这次抗议活动旨在防止进一步扰乱公共秩序。
entries.example_en: The protest was organized to prevent any further perturbation of public order.

entries.definition_en: disturbed, flustered, or upset
entries.example_cn: 听到坏消息时，她看起来很不安。
entries.example_en: She looked perturbed when she heard the bad news.

entries.definition_cn: 略有改动的；轻微扰动的
entries.definition_en: slightly modified, especially from an original or expected form
entries.example_cn: 研究人员测试了这个略有改动的方程，以观察解如何变化。
entries.example_en: The researchers tested the perturbed equation to see how the solution changed.

entries.definition_en: causing feelings of distress, worry, or anxiety
entries.example_cn: 看到工厂里缺乏安全措施，令人感到不安。
entries.example_en: It is perturbing to see such a lack of safety measures in the factory.

entries.definition_cn: 百日咳，一种以剧烈咳嗽为特征的传染性细菌性呼吸道感染
entries.definition_en: a contagious bacterial respiratory infection characterized by severe coughing; whooping cough
entries.example_cn: 这名儿童因严重的百日咳被送进医院。
entries.example_en: The child was hospitalized with severe pertussis.

entries.definition_en: the act of reading or examining something carefully
entries.example_cn: 合同已提交供客户仔细查阅。
entries.example_en: The contract was submitted for the client's perusal.

entries.definition_en: examine or consider with attention and in detail
entries.example_cn: 她在签署合同前仔细审阅了条款。
entries.example_en: She perused the contract before signing it.

entries.definition_en: reading carefully with intent to remember
entries.example_cn: 他花了一下午的时间细读法律文件。
entries.example_en: He spent the afternoon perusing the legal documents.

entries.definition_en: a person who is sexually perverted or behaves in a sexually inappropriate way
entries.example_cn: 警方因这名色狼在公园骚扰他人而将其逮捕。
entries.example_en: The police arrested the perv for harassing people in the park.

entries.definition_cn: 以变态方式行事；色迷迷地窥视
entries.definition_en: to act in a sexually perverted way, especially by looking at someone lasciviously or voyeuristically
entries.example_cn: 他因透过窗户偷窥而被抓个正着。
entries.example_en: He was caught perving through the window.

entries.definition_en: to spread throughout an area or group so that it is present everywhere
entries.example_cn: 一种恐惧感弥漫在整个房间里。
entries.example_en: A sense of dread pervaded the room.

entries.definition_en: spreading or spread throughout
entries.example_cn: 考试前，房间里弥漫着一种普遍的焦虑感。
entries.example_en: A pervasive sense of anxiety filled the room before the exam.

entries.definition_en: in a way that is widespread and present everywhere
entries.example_cn: 该政策的影响普遍存在于整个地区。
entries.example_en: The influence of the policy was felt pervasively throughout the region.

entries.definition_cn: 普遍存在；遍布的状态或性质
entries.definition_en: the state or quality of being widespread or present throughout a particular thing or place
entries.example_cn: 智能手机的普遍性改变了我们的沟通方式。
entries.example_en: The pervasiveness of smartphones has changed how we communicate.

entries.definition_en: a person whose behavior deviates from what is acceptable, especially in sexual behavior
entries.example_cn: 这个角色被描绘成一个骚扰他人的淫荡者。
entries.example_en: The character was portrayed as a perve who harassed others.

entries.definition_cn: 带着性意味窥视某人，通常令人不适
entries.definition_en: to look at someone with sexual interest, often in an unpleasant way
entries.example_cn: 他意识到自己曾在公园里色眯眯地窥视那位女士后，感到很内疚。
entries.example_en: He felt guilty when he realized he had perved on the woman in the park.

entries.definition_en: marked by a disposition to oppose or contradict; contrary
entries.example_cn: 这个孩子很叛逆，拒绝遵守任何规则。
entries.example_en: The child was perverse and refused to follow any rules.

entries.definition_cn: 顽固地抗拒指导或管教的；不服管教的
entries.definition_en: obstinately resistant to guidance or discipline
entries.example_cn: 这些学生不服管教，无视老师的指示。
entries.example_en: The students were perverse and ignored the teacher's instructions.

entries.definition_en: deviating from what is considered moral or right or proper or good
entries.example_cn: 伤害无辜的人是不道德的。
entries.example_en: It is perverse to harm innocent people.

entries.definition_en: deliberately deviant
entries.example_cn: 即使证据确凿，他仍故意反常地拒绝承认自己的错误。
entries.example_en: He perversely refused to admit his mistake even when the evidence was clear.

entries.definition_en: in a contrary disobedient manner
entries.example_cn: 那个孩子违抗地无视了母亲让他打扫房间的指令。
entries.example_en: The child perversely ignored his mother's instructions to clean his room.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being deliberately stubborn and difficult to control or guide
entries.example_cn: 这个孩子的顽固不化让老师很难管理班级。
entries.example_en: The perverseness of the child made it hard for the teacher to manage the class.

entries.definition_cn: 故意违背常理、预期或正当做法的性质
entries.definition_en: The quality of deliberately acting contrary to what is reasonable, expected, or proper.
entries.example_cn: 他的故意乖张使他拒绝了显而易见的解决方案。
entries.example_en: His perverseness led him to reject the obvious solution.

entries.definition_en: the action of perverting something (turning it to a wrong use)
entries.example_cn: 对原文的歪曲改变了其原本的含义。
entries.example_en: The perversion of the original text changed its intended meaning.

entries.definition_en: an aberrant sexual practice
entries.example_cn: 法律严格禁止任何形式的变态性行为。
entries.example_en: The law strictly prohibits any form of sexual perversion.

entries.definition_cn: 对原有进程、意义或状态的歪曲或破坏
entries.definition_en: distortion or corruption of the original course, meaning, or state of something
entries.example_cn: 原有河道的改变使河流转向。
entries.example_en: The perversion of the original course changed the river's direction.

entries.definition_en: deliberate and stubborn unruliness and resistance to guidance or discipline
entries.example_cn: 老师对学生拒绝遵守规则的顽劣行为感到沮丧。
entries.example_en: The teacher was frustrated by the student's perversity in refusing to follow rules.

entries.definition_en: deliberately deviating from what is good
entries.example_cn: 这个故事探讨了人性中的悖谬。
entries.example_en: The story explores the theme of perversity in human nature.

entries.definition_en: a person whose sexual behavior is considered unacceptable
entries.example_cn: 他被发现偷窥他人更衣后，小报称他为性变态者。
entries.example_en: The tabloids called him a pervert after he was caught spying on people changing.

entries.definition_en: to divert something from its original purpose or use it improperly
entries.example_cn: 他们滥用慈善基金谋取个人利益。
entries.example_en: They perverted the charity's funds for personal gain.

entries.definition_en: to corrupt someone's morals or character, often through bad habits or immorality
entries.example_cn: 他害怕那些坏朋友会败坏他的品格。
entries.example_en: He was afraid that his bad friends would pervert his character.

entries.definition_en: to use confusing or misleading language to deceive people
entries.example_cn: 那位政治家试图曲解法律的含义以赢得选票。
entries.example_en: The politician tried to pervert the meaning of the law to win votes.

entries.definition_en: showing or appealing to bizarre or deviant sexual tastes
entries.example_cn: 警方调查了该市发生的变态犯罪。
entries.example_en: The police investigated the perverted crimes committed in the city.

entries.definition_en: having an intended meaning altered or misrepresented
entries.example_cn: 记者为了迎合其政治议程而曲解了这句引语。
entries.example_en: The quote was perverted by the journalist to fit their political agenda.

entries.definition_en: deviating from what is considered moral or right or proper or good
entries.example_cn: 他为自己的不道德思想和行为感到内疚。
entries.example_en: He felt guilty about his perverted thoughts and actions.

entries.definition_en: allowing passage or entrance
entries.example_cn: 这种土壤可透水，能迅速排水。
entries.example_en: The soil is pervious to water, allowing it to drain quickly.

entries.definition_en: the part of the leg of a human being below the ankle joint
entries.example_cn: 这只脚在长途徒步旅行中受了伤。
entries.example_en: The pes was injured during the long hike.

entries.definition_en: the former basic unit of currency in Spain, equal to 100 centimos
entries.example_cn: 在欧元之前，比塞塔是西班牙使用的货币。
entries.example_en: Before the euro, the peseta was the currency used in Spain.

entries.definition_en: a member of a Kurdish guerrilla organization fighting for an independent Kurdish state
entries.example_cn: 库尔德游击队员抵御了入侵者的进攻。
entries.example_en: The peshmerga defended the region against the invading forces.

entries.definition_en: causing irritation or annoyance
entries.example_cn: 那只令人恼火的蚊子一直在我的耳边嗡嗡叫。
entries.example_en: The pesky mosquito kept buzzing around my ear.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Mexico
entries.example_cn: 出租车费用是二十比索。
entries.example_en: The taxi ride cost twenty pesos.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in the Philippines
entries.example_cn: 她用十比索支付了午餐费。
entries.example_en: She paid for her lunch with ten pesos.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Colombia
entries.example_cn: 他在哥伦比亚花了一比索买了一杯咖啡。
entries.example_en: He bought a coffee for one peso in Colombia.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Chile
entries.example_cn: 通货膨胀率影响了智利比索的价值。
entries.example_en: The inflation rate affected the value of the peso in Chile.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in the Dominican Republic
entries.example_cn: 酒店账单是用比索支付的。
entries.example_en: The hotel bill was paid in pesos.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Uruguay
entries.example_cn: 这个纪念品的价格是五个比索。
entries.example_en: The price of the souvenir was five pesos.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Cuba
entries.example_cn: 古巴的当地货币是比索。
entries.example_en: The local currency in Cuba is the peso.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Guinea-Bissau
entries.example_cn: 他们在几内亚比绍将美元兑换成比索。
entries.example_en: They exchanged their dollars for pesos in Guinea-Bissau.

entries.definition_cn: 置入阴道、尤用于支撑移位子宫的器具
entries.definition_en: a device inserted into the vagina, especially one used to support a displaced uterus
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一种子宫托来帮助支撑她虚弱的盆底肌。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed a pessary to help support her weakened pelvic floor.

entries.definition_cn: 对某一情况结果不佳的预期
entries.definition_en: an expectation that a particular situation will turn out badly
entries.example_cn: 尽管市场悲观，该公司仍保持乐观。
entries.example_en: Despite the pessimism in the market, the company remains optimistic.

entries.definition_en: a general tendency to expect the worst in all situations
entries.example_cn: 他对未来的悲观情绪影响了整个团队。
entries.example_en: His pessimism about the future has affected his entire team.

entries.definition_en: a person who expects the worst
entries.example_cn: 即使在顺境中，他的行为也像悲观主义者一样。
entries.example_en: Even in good times, he acts like a pessimist.

entries.definition_en: expecting the worst possible outcome
entries.example_cn: 她对成功的希望很悲观。
entries.example_en: She was pessimistic about the chances of success.

entries.definition_en: in a way that expects the worst possible outcome
entries.example_cn: 他们悲观地预测该项目会失败。
entries.example_en: They pessimistically predicted that the project would fail.

entries.definition_en: a persistently annoying person
entries.example_cn: 别这么烦人，让我把活干完！
entries.example_en: Stop being such a pest and let me finish my work!

entries.definition_cn: 危害农作物、食物或牲畜的害虫、害兽或有害植物
entries.definition_en: an unwanted insect, animal, or plant that damages crops, food, or livestock
entries.example_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来控制害虫数量。
entries.example_en: Farmers use pesticides to control the pest population.

entries.definition_cn: 一种通过跳蚤传播给人类的严重啮齿动物感染病
entries.definition_en: a serious infection of rodents transmitted to humans by fleas
entries.example_cn: 历史上，这种瘟疫曾导致数百万人死亡。
entries.example_en: Historically, the pest caused millions of deaths during the plague.

entries.definition_en: an epidemic disease with a high death rate
entries.example_cn: 这种瘟疫在拥挤的城市中迅速蔓延。
entries.example_en: The pest spread rapidly through the crowded city.

entries.definition_en: to annoy someone repeatedly or persistently
entries.example_cn: 别再一直问我那些问题了！
entries.example_en: Stop pestering me with those questions!

entries.definition_en: causing irritation or annoyance through repeated requests or actions
entries.example_cn: 他不断纠缠的问题惹恼了会议中的每个人。
entries.example_en: His pestering questions annoyed everyone in the meeting.

entries.definition_en: a substance or organism used to kill or control pests
entries.example_cn: 农民使用农药来保护作物免受害虫侵害。
entries.example_en: Farmers use pesticides to protect their crops from insects.

entries.definition_cn: 会传播传染病的；致病的
entries.definition_en: causing or capable of causing infectious disease
entries.example_cn: 这种易传播的病毒迅速蔓延至整个大陆。
entries.example_en: The pestiferous virus spread rapidly across the continent.

entries.definition_en: containing organisms that cause infectious diseases
entries.example_cn: 这种被污染的水导致村庄爆发霍乱。
entries.example_en: The pestiferous water caused an outbreak of cholera in the village.

entries.definition_en: tending to corrupt or pervert
entries.example_cn: 这位腐败政客的不良影响损害了年轻人的品格。
entries.example_en: The pestiferous influence of the corrupt politician damaged the youth's character.

entries.definition_en: causing irritation or annoyance
entries.example_cn: 建筑工地的嘈杂噪音让邻居们整夜无法入睡。
entries.example_en: The pestiferous noise from the construction site kept the neighbors awake all night.

entries.definition_en: any epidemic disease with a high death rate
entries.example_cn: 这座城市在14世纪遭受了一场可怕的瘟疫的打击。
entries.example_en: The city was devastated by a terrible pestilence in the 14th century.

entries.definition_en: a serious (sometimes fatal) infection of rodents caused by Yersinia pestis and accidentally transmitted to humans by the bite of a flea that has bitten an infected animal
entries.example_cn: 这种鼠疫在鼠群中迅速传播，随后传染给了人类。
entries.example_en: The pestilence spread rapidly through the rodent population before jumping to humans.

entries.definition_en: a pernicious and malign influence that is hard to get rid of
entries.example_cn: 腐败是必须从组织中根除的祸害。
entries.example_en: Corruption is a pestilence that must be eradicated from the organization.

entries.definition_en: extremely harmful or destructive; deadly
entries.example_cn: 工厂里有害的条件导致了多次健康危机。
entries.example_en: The pestilent conditions in the factory led to several health crises.

entries.definition_en: annoying
entries.example_cn: 那恼人的噪声让邻居们无法入睡。
entries.example_en: The pestilent noise kept the neighbors awake.

entries.definition_cn: 可能传播瘟疫或导致流行病的
entries.definition_en: likely to spread pestilence or cause an epidemic
entries.example_cn: 拥挤城市中可能传播疾病的空气使许多人病倒。
entries.example_en: The pestilential air of the crowded city made many people ill.

entries.definition_en: plague, especially an infectious disease caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis
entries.example_cn: 鼠疫在历史上曾造成毁灭性的流行病。
entries.example_en: Pestis caused devastating epidemics throughout history.

entries.definition_en: a club-shaped hand tool for grinding substances in a mortar
entries.example_cn: 他拿起研杵来捣碎胡椒粒。
entries.example_en: He picked up the pestle to crush the peppercorns.

entries.definition_en: a heavy stone or iron tool with a flat base used for grinding
entries.example_cn: 那位炼金术士用重型研磨器混合颜料。
entries.example_en: The alchemist used a heavy pestle to mix the pigments.

entries.definition_en: a machine with a heavy bar used for pounding ores
entries.example_cn: 那座古老的矿井里仍有一台生锈的矿石捣碎机。
entries.example_en: The ancient mine still contained a rusted pestle.

entries.definition_en: to grind or mash something in a mortar
entries.example_cn: 她把大蒜和香草一起捣碎。
entries.example_en: She pestled the garlic and herbs together.

entries.definition_en: a sauce typically served with pasta; contains crushed basil leaves and garlic and pine nuts and Parmesan cheese in olive oil
entries.example_cn: 她端上了配有大量青酱的意大利面。
entries.example_en: She served the pasta with a generous amount of pesto.

entries.definition_en: a unit of digital information equal to 1000 terabytes or 10^15 bytes
entries.example_cn: 新的数据中心可以存储超过五拍字节的信息。
entries.example_en: The new data center can store over five petabytes of information.

entries.definition_cn: （非正式）二进制拍字节（pebibyte），等于2^50字节
entries.definition_en: a unit of digital information sometimes used informally for a pebibyte, equal to 2^50 bytes
entries.example_cn: 一些软件会非正式地用“拍字节”指代二进制拍字节。
entries.example_en: Some software uses petabyte informally to mean a pebibyte.

entries.definition_cn: 每秒千万亿次浮点运算
entries.definition_en: a unit for measuring computer speed, equal to one quadrillion floating-point operations per second
entries.example_cn: 这台新超级计算机的计算速度可达每秒五千万亿次浮点运算。
entries.example_en: The new supercomputer can perform calculations at a rate of five petaflops.

entries.definition_en: a part of a flower that is usually brightly colored and surrounds the reproductive organs
entries.example_cn: 她小心翼翼地从玫瑰上摘下一片花瓣。
entries.example_en: She carefully picked a single petal from the rose.

entries.definition_en: (of flowers) having petals
entries.example_cn: 那朵有花瓣的玫瑰在春季节日期间盛开。
entries.example_en: The petaled rose was in full bloom during the spring festival.

entries.definition_en: having petals
entries.example_cn: 这朵有花瓣的花正盛开。
entries.example_en: The petalled flower was in full bloom.

entries.definition_en: resembling a flower petal
entries.example_cn: 这种兰花的雄蕊呈花瓣状，像花瓣而不是典型的雄蕊。
entries.example_en: The stamens of this orchid are petaloid, resembling petals rather than typical stamens.

entries.definition_cn: （历史）用于炸开门或墙的小型爆炸装置；爆破筒
entries.definition_en: a small, historically used explosive device for breaching a door or wall
entries.example_cn: 士兵们使用爆破筒炸开了城堡的大门。
entries.example_en: The soldiers used a petard to breach the castle gate.

entries.definition_en: a small valve used to release air or drain fluid from a system
entries.example_cn: 他用放气阀排空了散热器里的水。
entries.example_en: He used a petcock to drain the water from the radiator.

entries.definition_en: a tiny red or purple spot on the skin caused by bleeding from small blood vessels
entries.example_cn: 医生注意到患者手臂上出现了瘀点。
entries.example_en: The doctor noticed several petechiae on the patient's arm.

entries.definition_en: to gradually become smaller or weaker until it disappears
entries.example_cn: 噪音持续了几分钟后逐渐消失了。
entries.example_en: The noise petered out after a few minutes.

entries.definition_en: to call for trump by throwing away a high card while holding a lower one
entries.example_cn: 他决定把黑桃A出掉以叫将。
entries.example_en: He decided to peter the ace of spades to signal the trump suit.

entries.definition_en: A slang term for the penis.
entries.example_cn: 在这个俚语表达中，peter 指阴茎。
entries.example_en: In this slang expression, peter refers to the penis.

entries.definition_en: a safe used for storing money or valuables
entries.example_cn: 警察搜查了房间，在地板下发现了一个隐藏的保险箱。
entries.example_en: The police searched the room and found a hidden peter under the floorboards.

entries.definition_en: a prison cell
entries.example_cn: 囚犯被关在一个狭小的牢房里。
entries.example_en: The prisoner was locked in a small peter.

entries.definition_en: food prepared for animal pets
entries.example_cn: 猫正在从碗里吃它的宠物食品。
entries.example_en: The cat is eating its petfood from the bowl.

entries.definition_en: the slender stem that attaches a leaf blade to the main stem of a plant.
entries.example_cn: 植物学家检查了支撑那片大叶子的长叶柄。
entries.example_en: The botanist examined the long petiole supporting the large leaf.

entries.definition_cn: 身材娇小的；适合身材矮小或纤细女性的
entries.definition_en: small and delicately built; of a size for short or slender women
entries.example_cn: 她身材娇小，需要穿适合身材矮小纤细女性的衣服。
entries.example_en: She is petite and needs clothes designed for short, slender women.

entries.definition_en: a garment size for short or slender women
entries.example_cn: 她为派对买了一件小码女装。
entries.example_en: She bought a petite dress for the party.

entries.definition_en: a logical fallacy where the conclusion is assumed in the premises
entries.example_cn: 该论点因预设了试图证明的内容而被驳回，被视为循环论证。
entries.example_en: The argument was dismissed as a petitio because it assumed what it tried to prove.

entries.definition_cn: 向政治当局或法院提出、通常请求采取行动或作出裁定的正式书面请求；请愿书；申请书
entries.definition_en: a formal written request to a political authority or court, often seeking action or an order
entries.example_cn: 市民们签署了一份降低税收的请愿书。
entries.example_en: The citizens signed a petition to lower taxes.

entries.definition_en: reverent petition to a deity
entries.example_cn: 僧人向佛陀默默祈祷。
entries.example_en: The monk offered a silent petition to the Buddha.

entries.definition_cn: 向某人提交请愿书；正式书面请求
entries.definition_en: write a petition for something to somebody; request formally and in writing
entries.example_cn: 他们向政府请愿，要求提供更好的医疗服务。
entries.example_en: They petitioned the government for better healthcare services.

entries.definition_en: someone who petitions a court for redress or rights
entries.example_cn: 这位请愿人认为该法律不公平。
entries.example_en: The petitioner argued that the law was unfair.

entries.definition_en: someone who presents a petition to a person in authority
entries.example_cn: 请愿者向部长请求宽恕。
entries.example_en: The petitioner appealed to the minister for mercy.

entries.definition_en: a relatively small bird with long wings and a tube-shaped beak that lives far from land
entries.example_cn: 水手们在开阔的海洋上空发现了一只海鹱在翱翔。
entries.example_en: The sailors spotted a petrel soaring above the open ocean.

entries.definition_en: the process or condition of becoming petrified, especially when plant material is mineralized while retaining its original form
entries.example_cn: 石化作用在以矿物质取代组织的同时保留了树干的原始形状。
entries.example_en: Petrifaction preserved the tree trunk's original shape while replacing its tissues with minerals.

entries.definition_en: a rock created by petrifaction; an organic object infiltrated with mineral matter and preserved in its original form
entries.example_cn: 古生物学家在挖掘现场发现了一片罕见的恐龙叶子石化物。
entries.example_en: Paleontologists discovered a rare petrifaction of a dinosaur leaf in the excavation site.

entries.definition_cn: 有机遗骸在保留原有形状的同时石化成石的过程
entries.definition_en: the process by which organic remains turn to stone while retaining their original shape
entries.example_cn: 古老森林的石化作用将年轮保存在了石头中。
entries.example_en: The petrification of the ancient forest preserved the tree rings in stone.

entries.definition_en: to cause someone to become extremely frightened and unable to move
entries.example_cn: 突如其来的噪音让那只猫惊呆，吓得它动弹不得。
entries.example_en: The sudden noise petrified the cat, leaving it frozen in fear.

entries.definition_en: to change into stone
entries.example_cn: 经过数百万年，这些古树因矿物沉积而变成了石头。
entries.example_en: Over millions of years, the ancient trees were petrified by mineral deposits.

entries.definition_cn: 使变得僵化并固守传统模式
entries.definition_en: to make something rigid and set into a conventional pattern
entries.example_cn: 严格的规则开始使该组织的文化变得僵化，扼杀了创新。
entries.example_en: The strict rules began to petrify the organization's culture, stifling innovation.

entries.definition_en: paralyzing with terror
entries.example_cn: 风暴那令人惊骇的景象让每个人都跑去躲避。
entries.example_en: The petrifying sight of the storm made everyone run for cover.

entries.definition_en: any compound obtained from petroleum or natural gas
entries.example_cn: 聚乙烯是一种用于制造业的石化产品。
entries.example_en: Polyethylene is a petrochemical used in manufacturing.

entries.definition_en: a design carved or scratched onto a rock surface, often made by ancient people
entries.example_cn: 考古学家在峡谷墙壁上发现了描绘狩猎场景的古代岩画。
entries.example_en: Archaeologists discovered ancient petroglyphs depicting hunting scenes on the canyon wall.

entries.definition_en: a volatile flammable mixture of hydrocarbons derived from petroleum; used mainly as a fuel in internal-combustion engines
entries.example_cn: 我们需要在出发前给车加满汽油。
entries.example_en: We need to fill up the car with petrol before the trip.

entries.definition_en: a semisolid mixture of hydrocarbons obtained from petroleum; used in medicinal ointments and for lubrication
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一种含有凡士林的药膏来舒缓干燥的皮肤。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed a cream containing petrolatum to soothe the dry skin.

entries.definition_en: a dark liquid oil found underground, consisting mainly of hydrocarbons
entries.example_cn: 原油从地下被抽出来并提炼成汽油。
entries.example_en: Crude petroleum is pumped from the ground and refined into gasoline.

entries.definition_en: the branch of geology that studies rocks, including their origin, formation, mineral composition, and classification
entries.example_cn: 教授讲授了岩石学的历史。
entries.example_en: The professor gave a lecture on the history of petrology.

entries.definition_cn: （指骨骼，尤其是颞骨）极硬如石的
entries.definition_en: (of bone, especially the temporal bone) extremely hard and resembling stone
entries.example_cn: 外科医生发现颞骨的岩部极难钻孔。
entries.example_en: The surgeon found the petrous part of the temporal bone very difficult to drill.

entries.definition_cn: 抚摸者；抚摸某人或某物的人
entries.definition_en: a person who pets or strokes someone or something
entries.example_cn: 狗在她身边休息时，抚摸者轻轻抚摸着它。
entries.example_en: The petter gently stroked the dog while it rested beside her.

entries.definition_cn: 穿在裙子下面的宽松衬裙
entries.definition_en: a loose undergarment worn under a skirt
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一条长衬裙，让裙子更加蓬松。
entries.example_en: She wore a long petticoat to give her dress more volume.

entries.definition_en: to argue about small and unimportant matters in a way that shows you are trying to win
entries.example_cn: 律师们花了几个小时纠缠于合同的细微末节。
entries.example_en: The lawyers spent hours pettifogging over minor details of the contract.

entries.definition_en: a narrow or limited way of thinking
entries.example_cn: 他的狭隘心胸使他无法看到大局。
entries.example_en: His pettiness prevented him from seeing the bigger picture.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being unimportant and petty or frivolous
entries.example_cn: 这场争论的琐碎与轻浮分散了人们对当前严重问题的注意力。
entries.example_en: The pettiness of the argument distracted from the serious issues at hand.

entries.definition_en: lack of generosity in trifling matters
entries.example_cn: 她因拒绝分享零食而受到批评，被认为在小事上缺乏慷慨。
entries.example_en: She was criticized for the pettiness of her refusal to share the snacks.

entries.definition_cn: 以性方式亲吻、抚摸或触摸他人的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of kissing, stroking, or touching a person in a sexual manner
entries.example_cn: 这对情侣在沙发上亲热了一晚上。
entries.example_en: The couple spent the evening petting on the sofa.

entries.definition_en: small and of little importance
entries.example_cn: 他们争论了一个无关紧要的琐碎细节。
entries.example_en: They argued over a petty detail that didn't matter.

entries.definition_en: low in rank or status
entries.example_cn: 在新政府中，他被视为一名低等官员。
entries.example_en: He was treated as a petty official in the new government.

entries.definition_en: contemptibly narrow in outlook
entries.example_cn: 他心胸狭隘的态度使他无法看到大局。
entries.example_en: His petty attitude prevented him from seeing the bigger picture.

entries.definition_en: theft of property with a value below a certain limit
entries.example_cn: 警方调查了一起涉及被盗钱包的小额盗窃案。
entries.example_en: The police investigated a case of petty theft involving a stolen wallet.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of irritability and childish bad temper
entries.example_cn: 她因那个小错误而闹脾气，毁掉了愉快的下午。
entries.example_en: Her petulance over the small mistake ruined the pleasant afternoon.

entries.definition_en: easily irritated or annoyed
entries.example_cn: 他因为那个小错误而变得任性，拒绝继续玩游戏。
entries.example_en: He was petulant about the small mistake and refused to continue the game.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows unreasonable bad temper and childishness
entries.example_cn: 他任性地拒绝把玩具分享给妹妹。
entries.example_en: He petulantly refused to share his toys with his younger sister.

entries.definition_en: a flowering plant of the genus Petunia, often grown for its funnel-shaped flowers
entries.example_cn: 夏天，花园里开满了五颜六色的矮牵牛花。
entries.example_en: The garden is filled with colorful petunias in summer.

entries.definition_en: a long bench with a back, used in a church by the congregation
entries.example_cn: 那张古老的长椅是橡木雕成的。
entries.example_en: The old pew was carved from oak.

entries.definition_en: a small olive-green bird found in the forests of eastern North America
entries.example_cn: 我们在茂密的树林里发现了一只栖息在树枝上的绿林莺。
entries.example_en: We spotted a pewee perched on a branch in the dense woodland.

entries.definition_en: an alloy made mainly of tin with small amounts of other metals
entries.example_cn: 那家古董店卖了一个精美的锡器碗。
entries.example_en: The antique shop sold a beautiful pewter bowl.

entries.definition_cn: 呈暗淡的灰色的，像白镴的颜色
entries.definition_en: dark and dull grey in colour, like pewter
entries.example_cn: 设计师为厨房橱柜选择了白镴灰。
entries.example_en: The designer chose a pewter grey for the kitchen cabinets.

entries.definition_en: a small, spineless, globe-shaped cactus that is the source of mescal buttons
entries.example_cn: 佩奥特仙人掌生长在美国西南部的干旱沙漠中。
entries.example_en: The peyote cactus grows in the arid deserts of the southwestern United States.

entries.definition_cn: 佩奥特仙人掌产生的麦斯卡尔按钮状部分
entries.definition_en: a mescal button produced by the peyote cactus
entries.example_cn: 仪式使用了含有致幻生物碱麦斯卡林的干燥佩奥特按钮状部分。
entries.example_en: The ceremony used dried peyote buttons containing the hallucinogenic alkaloid mescaline.

entries.definition_en: a former German coin; 100 pfennigs equaled 1 Deutsche Mark
entries.example_cn: 那张旧照片展示了20世纪50年代的一堆芬尼。
entries.example_en: The old photograph showed a stack of pfennigs from the 1950s.

entries.definition_en: any plant belonging to the genus Phacelia
entries.example_cn: 花园里开满了色彩斑斓的菲雅利属植物，吸引了许多蜜蜂。
entries.example_en: The garden was filled with colorful phacelia attracting many bees.

entries.definition_en: a surgical procedure to remove cataracts by using ultrasonic sound to break the lens into small fragments that are then suctioned out through a small tube
entries.example_cn: 外科医生进行了超声乳化术以恢复患者的视力。
entries.example_en: The surgeon performed phacoemulsification to restore the patient's vision.

entries.definition_cn: 敞篷四轮马车（或早期敞篷汽车）
entries.definition_en: a large, open car with a folding roof that seats four people
entries.example_cn: 他们租了一辆敞篷四轮车在阳光明媚的日子里驾车游览乡村。
entries.example_en: They rented a phaeton to drive around the countryside on a sunny day.

entries.definition_en: a virus that lives inside and reproduces within bacteria
entries.example_cn: 科学家正在研究如何利用噬菌体治疗细菌感染。
entries.example_en: Scientists are studying how phage can be used to treat bacterial infections.

entries.definition_en: a cell that engulfs and digests debris and invading microorganisms
entries.example_cn: 白细胞是吞噬细胞，能保护身体免受感染。
entries.example_en: White blood cells are phagocytes that protect the body from infection.

entries.definition_en: having the ability to engulf and digest particles or cells
entries.example_cn: 白细胞具有吞噬性，通过吞噬细菌来帮助对抗感染。
entries.example_en: White blood cells are phagocytic and help fight infections by eating bacteria.

usage.label: not comparable
usage.pattern: used attributively of cells or substances

entries.definition_en: the biological process where cells engulf and digest microorganisms and debris
entries.example_cn: 吞噬作用是抵御感染的关键防御机制。
entries.example_en: Phagocytosis is a crucial defense mechanism against infection.

entries.definition_en: relating to the bones of the fingers or toes
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了患者手部的指骨。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the phalangeal bones of the patient's hand.

entries.definition_cn: 西班牙长枪党成员（弗朗哥政党的成员）
entries.definition_en: a member of General Franco's political party in Spain
entries.example_cn: 这名长枪党成员在该政权建立初期发挥了关键作用。
entries.example_en: The phalangist played a key role in the early years of the regime.

entries.definition_en: one of the long bones in the fingers or toes
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了患者手指的骨折指骨。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the fractured phalanx of the patient's finger.

entries.definition_en: a large, closely packed crowd of people
entries.example_cn: 一大群抗议者向政府大楼进发。
entries.example_en: A phalanx of protesters marched towards the government building.

entries.definition_en: a group of soldiers arranged in a tight formation
entries.example_cn: 这支古军队以紧密的阵型向敌人推进。
entries.example_en: The ancient army advanced as a solid phalanx against the enemy.

entries.definition_en: a small shorebird similar to a sandpiper that has lobed toes and is an excellent swimmer; breeds in the Arctic and winters in the tropics
entries.example_cn: 瓣蹼鹬是一种小型涉禽，脚趾呈瓣状，善于游泳。
entries.example_en: The phalarope is a small shorebird with lobed toes and is an excellent swimmer.

entries.definition_cn: 与阴茎有关的，尤指作为生殖力象征的
entries.definition_en: relating to a phallus, especially as a symbol of generative power
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家使用象征生殖力的符号来表现雕塑中的生育力。
entries.example_en: The artist used phallic symbols to represent fertility in his sculpture.

entries.definition_en: resembling or being a phallus
entries.example_cn: 这座古代建筑有几座像阳具的塔。
entries.example_en: The ancient architecture features several phallic towers.

entries.definition_cn: 从鹅膏菌（Amanita phalloides，毒鹅膏）中获得的一组毒素之一，属于鬼笔毒素
entries.definition_en: one of a group of toxins from the death cap mushroom known as phallotoxins
entries.example_cn: 研究人员正在研究 phalloidin，以了解其对细胞结构的影响。
entries.example_en: Researchers are studying phalloidin to understand its effects on cellular structures.

entries.definition_cn: 阴茎成形术；用于重建或修复阴茎的整形手术
entries.definition_en: plastic surgery to construct or repair a penis, including after injury or during sex reassignment
entries.example_cn: 该患者接受了阴茎再造术以在严重事故后恢复功能。
entries.example_en: The patient underwent phalloplasty to restore function after a severe accident.

entries.definition_en: a penis, especially when erect
entries.example_cn: 医生解释说，阴茎是男性的性器官。
entries.example_en: The doctor explained that the phallus is the male sexual organ.

entries.definition_en: a ghostly-looking figure
entries.example_cn: 那位老人声称在雾中看到了一个幽灵。
entries.example_en: The old man claimed to have seen a phantasm in the fog.

entries.definition_cn: 只存在于想象或感知中的意象或观念
entries.definition_en: an image or idea existing only in the mind or perception
entries.example_cn: 他中彩票的希望不过是幻想。
entries.example_en: His hope of winning the lottery was nothing but a phantasm.

entries.definition_en: a ghostly appearing figure
entries.example_cn: 据说那座古堡被一位骑士的幽灵所缠绕。
entries.example_en: The old castle was said to be haunted by a phantasma of a knight.

entries.definition_en: something existing in perception only
entries.example_cn: 那个梦只是一个幻影，没有任何现实基础。
entries.example_en: The dream was just a phantasma, with no basis in reality.

entries.definition_en: a rapidly changing series of real or imagined images, like those seen in a dream
entries.example_cn: 这部电影是一场色彩与形状的变幻莫测的景象。
entries.example_en: The movie was a phantasmagoria of colors and shapes.

entries.definition_en: characterized by fantastic imagery and incongruous juxtapositions
entries.example_cn: 这部电影具有光怪陆离的特质，其不断变化的景观和超现实的角色令人着迷。
entries.example_en: The movie had a phantasmagoric quality with its shifting landscapes and surreal characters.

entries.definition_en: characterized by fantastic imagery and incongruous juxtapositions
entries.example_cn: 这部电影包含了一段光怪陆离的梦境与噩梦序列。
entries.example_en: The movie featured a phantasmagorical sequence of dreams and nightmares.

entries.definition_en: resembling or characteristic of a phantom
entries.example_cn: 雾中出现了一个幽灵般的身影。
entries.example_en: A phantasmal figure appeared in the fog.

entries.definition_cn: （精神分析）连接本能与现实的先天心理意象或观念
entries.definition_en: in psychoanalytic theory, an innate mental image or idea linking instinct with reality
entries.example_cn: 在精神分析理论中，幻想可以调节本能与现实之间的关系。
entries.example_en: In psychoanalytic theory, phantasy can mediate between instinct and reality.

entries.definition_en: fiction that contains a large amount of imagination
entries.example_cn: 她整个周末都在读一本关于龙和魔法的奇幻小说。
