entries.example_en: She spent her weekend reading a phantasy about dragons and magic.

entries.definition_en: imagination that is not limited by reality
entries.example_cn: 艺术家的无拘无束的想象力使他能够创造出不存在的世界。
entries.example_en: The artist's phantasy allowed him to create worlds that did not exist.

entries.definition_en: a ghostly appearing figure
entries.example_cn: 据说那座老房子被一个幽灵所缠绕。
entries.example_en: The old house was said to be haunted by a phantom.

entries.definition_en: something existing in perception only
entries.example_cn: 烟味的幻影让他以为房子着火了。
entries.example_en: The phantom smell of smoke made him think the house was on fire.

entries.definition_en: something apparently sensed but having no physical reality
entries.example_cn: 事故后，他感觉腿部有幻痛。
entries.example_en: He felt a phantom pain in his leg after the accident.

entries.definition_en: the title of the ancient Egyptian kings
entries.example_cn: 法老以绝对权力统治着庞大的帝国。
entries.example_en: The pharaoh ruled over the vast empire with absolute power.

entries.definition_en: excessively or hypocritically pious
entries.example_cn: 他对规则那种伪善的态度惹恼了所有人。
entries.example_en: His pharisaic attitude towards the rules annoyed everyone.

entries.definition_en: excessively or hypocritically pious
entries.example_cn: 他对慈善事业伪善的态度让邻居们怀疑他的动机。
entries.example_en: His pharisaical attitude towards charity made his neighbors suspicious of his motives.

entries.definition_en: the pharmaceutical or drug-making industry
entries.example_cn: 对制药业和生物技术行业的投资正在增长。
entries.example_en: Investment in pharma and biotech is growing.

entries.definition_en: a drug or medicine prepared for medical treatment
entries.example_cn: 这种药品是为治疗高血压而研发的。
entries.example_en: The pharmaceutical was developed to treat high blood pressure.

entries.definition_en: relating to the business of making or selling medicines
entries.example_cn: 制药行业近年来发展迅速。
entries.example_en: The pharmaceutical industry has grown rapidly in recent years.

entries.definition_en: relating to drugs used for medical treatment
entries.example_cn: 制药研究带来了更安全的医疗疗法。
entries.example_en: Pharmaceutical research has led to safer medical treatments.

entries.definition_en: the art and science of preparing and dispensing drugs and medicines
entries.example_cn: 她学习药剂学以了解药物是如何配制的。
entries.example_en: She studied pharmaceutics to understand how drugs are formulated.

entries.definition_en: a health professional trained in the art of preparing and dispensing drugs
entries.example_cn: 药剂师解释了如何服用新药。
entries.example_en: The pharmacist explained how to take the new medication.

entries.definition_cn: 研究基因如何决定药物反应差异的遗传学分支
entries.definition_en: the branch of genetics that studies how genes determine variations in drug responses
entries.example_cn: 药物遗传学帮助医生为每位患者开具正确的剂量。
entries.example_en: Pharmacogenetics helps doctors prescribe the right dosage for each patient.

entries.definition_en: the study of the action of drugs in the body: method and rate of excretion, duration of effect, etc.
entries.example_cn: 医生向患者解释了这种新药的药代动力学原理。
entries.example_en: The doctor explained the pharmacokinetics of the new medication to the patient.

usage.label: uncountable
usage.pattern: Typically used as an uncountable noun; source w30544r0.

entries.definition_en: relating to the science of drugs and their effects on the body
entries.example_cn: 这种新药的药理特性正在临床试验中进行测试。
entries.example_en: The pharmacologic properties of this new drug are being tested in clinical trials.

entries.definition_en: relating to the study of drugs and their effects on the body
entries.example_cn: 这种新药的药理作用仍在研究中。
entries.example_en: The pharmacological effects of the new drug are still being studied.

entries.definition_cn: 从药理学角度；在药理学上
entries.definition_en: in a manner relating to the science of drugs
entries.example_cn: 这种新药经过药理学测试，以确定其对神经系统的影响。
entries.example_en: The new drug was tested pharmacologically to determine its effects on the nervous system.

entries.definition_en: a scientist who studies the composition, uses, and effects of drugs
entries.example_cn: 这位药理学家解释了新药如何与身体相互作用。
entries.example_en: The pharmacologist explained how the new medication interacts with the body.

entries.definition_en: the scientific study of drugs, including their preparation, properties, uses, and effects
entries.example_cn: 她决定主修药理学，以了解药物在体内的作用方式。
entries.example_en: She decided to major in pharmacology to understand how medications work in the body.

entries.definition_en: a book containing a compilation of pharmaceutical products with their formulas and methods of preparation
entries.example_cn: 药剂师查阅国家药典以核实剂量。
entries.example_en: The pharmacist consulted the national pharmacopeia to verify the dosage.

entries.definition_en: an authoritative book or compendium describing medicines and pharmaceutical substances, including their preparation and standards
entries.example_cn: 新药典为许多现代药物制定了标准。
entries.example_en: The new pharmacopoeia sets standards for many modern medicines.

entries.definition_en: a retail shop where medicine and other articles are sold
entries.example_cn: 我在药店买了我的处方药。
entries.example_en: I bought my prescription at the pharmacy.

entries.definition_en: the art and science of preparing and dispensing drugs and medicines
entries.example_cn: 她在大学学习药剂学。
entries.example_en: She studied pharmacy at university.

entries.definition_en: the profession or work of a pharmacist
entries.example_cn: 毕业后，她选择从事药剂师这一职业。
entries.example_en: After graduating, she chose pharmacy as her career.

entries.definition_cn: 古代灯塔；为水手导航的灯塔或烽火
entries.definition_en: an ancient lighthouse or beacon used to guide sailors
entries.example_cn: 这座古老的灯塔引导水手安全穿过危险水域。
entries.example_en: The ancient pharos guided sailors safely through the dangerous waters.

entries.definition_en: relating to the throat
entries.example_cn: 咽部肌肉帮助我们吞咽食物。
entries.example_en: The pharyngeal muscles help us swallow food.

entries.definition_en: a consonant sound made by constricting the back of the throat
entries.example_cn: 咽音是阿拉伯语和希伯来语中常见的辅音。
entries.example_en: The pharyngeal is a common consonant in Arabic and Hebrew.

entries.definition_en: inflammation of the pharynx
entries.example_cn: 医生诊断患者患有咽炎。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed the patient with pharyngitis.

entries.definition_en: the throat passage connecting the mouth and nose to the esophagus and larynx, located in the neck.
entries.example_cn: 感染从咽部扩散到了扁桃体。
entries.example_en: The infection spread from the pharynx to the tonsils.

entries.definition_cn: 一系列事件中的任何特定时间段
entries.definition_en: any distinct time period in a sequence of events
entries.example_cn: 我们目前正处于项目的规划阶段。
entries.example_en: We are currently in the planning phase of the project.

entries.definition_cn: （天文学）天体照明状态的特定外观（特别是地球月球被太阳照亮部分的反复出现的形状）
entries.definition_en: (astronomy) the particular appearance of a body's state of illumination (especially one of the recurring shapes of the part of Earth's moon that is illuminated by the sun)
entries.example_cn: 满月是月球周期中最明显的阶段。
entries.example_en: The full moon is the most visible phase of the lunar cycle.

entries.definition_cn: （物理化学）系统中物质的特定状态；具有相同化学成分和物理状态，并通过相边界与其他物质分离的物质
entries.definition_en: (physical chemistry) a distinct state of matter in a system; matter that is identical in chemical composition and physical state and separated from other material by the phase boundary
entries.example_cn: 水可以以三种不同的相存在：固态、液态和气态。
entries.example_en: Water can exist in three different phases: solid, liquid, and gas.

entries.definition_cn: 周期中的特定时点；从某个任意零点测量并以角度表示
entries.definition_en: a particular point in the time of a cycle; measured from some arbitrary zero and expressed as an angle
entries.example_cn: 交流电的相位以度数测量。
entries.example_en: The phase of the alternating current was measured in degrees.

entries.definition_en: arrange in phases or stages
entries.example_cn: 建设将分三年进行。
entries.example_en: The construction will be phased over three years.

entries.definition_en: adjust so as to be in a synchronized condition
entries.example_cn: 工程师们努力将两个信号同步。
entries.example_en: The engineers worked to phase the two signals together.

entries.definition_en: the planned process of gradually stopping the use or production of something
entries.example_cn: 政府宣布逐步淘汰塑料袋。
entries.example_en: The government announced a phase-out of plastic bags.

entries.definition_en: a large tropical insect with long legs that resembles a walking stick or leaf
entries.example_cn: 这只竹节虫完美地融入了树皮中，几乎看不见。
entries.example_en: The phasmid blended perfectly with the tree bark, making it nearly invisible.

entries.definition_en: a large long-tailed gallinaceous bird native to the Old World but introduced elsewhere
entries.example_cn: 猎人们在茂密的森林中追踪那只雉。
entries.example_en: The hunters tracked the pheasant through the dense forest.

entries.definition_en: the meat of a pheasant, eaten as food
entries.example_cn: 我们点了雉肉配土豆作为晚餐。
entries.example_en: We ordered pheasant for dinner with a side of potatoes.

entries.definition_cn: 秋侧金盏花（一种花心深色、开深红色花的欧亚草本植物）
entries.definition_en: a Eurasian herb grown for its deep red flowers that have dark centers
entries.example_cn: 花园里开满了秋侧金盏花深红色、花心深色的花朵。
entries.example_en: The garden is filled with the deep red flowers of the pheasant's-eye, each with a dark center.

entries.definition_en: a white crystalline compound used as an analgesic and also as an antipyretic
entries.example_cn: 非那西丁曾被广泛用作止痛药，但在许多国家被禁止使用。
entries.example_en: Phenacetin was once widely used as a painkiller before being banned in many countries.

entries.definition_cn: 用于缓解尿路疼痛和灼热感的镇痛药；非那吡啶
entries.definition_en: an analgesic used to relieve pain and burning in the urinary tract
entries.example_cn: 护士给患者服用了非那吡啶以缓解灼烧感。
entries.example_en: The nurse administered phenazopyridine to relieve the patient's burning sensation.

entries.definition_en: a drug used as an anesthetic by veterinarians that can also cause hallucinations
entries.example_cn: 兽医在手术前给动物注射了苯环利定以止痛。
entries.example_en: The veterinarian administered phencyclidine to numb the animal's pain before the surgery.

entries.definition_cn: 用于治疗临床抑郁症的一种合成单胺氧化酶抑制剂
entries.definition_en: a synthetic monoamine oxidase inhibitor used to treat clinical depression
entries.example_cn: 医生开了苯乙肼来帮助他控制严重的抑郁症。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed phenelzine to help manage his severe depression.

entries.definition_en: a long-acting barbiturate drug used chiefly as a sedative and to treat epilepsy
entries.example_cn: 医生开了苯巴比妥来帮助病人入睡。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed phenobarbital to help the patient sleep.

entries.definition_en: a long-acting barbiturate used as a sedative
entries.example_cn: 医生开了苯巴比妥来帮助患者入睡。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed phenobarbitone to help the patient sleep.

entries.definition_cn: 一种有毒的白色结晶酸性苯衍生物，用于制造、消毒和防腐，若吞食会中毒
entries.definition_en: a toxic white crystalline acidic derivative of benzene, used in manufacturing and as a disinfectant or antiseptic, which is poisonous if swallowed
entries.example_cn: 由于苯酚的毒性，实验室技术人员对其处理得极为小心。
entries.example_en: The laboratory technician handled the phenol with extreme care due to its toxicity.

entries.definition_cn: 一类含有一个或多个羟基的弱酸性有机化合物
entries.definition_en: a type of weakly acidic organic compound that has one or more hydroxyl groups in its molecule
entries.example_cn: 酚类是用于各种化学反应的常见有机化合物。
entries.example_en: Phenols are common organic compounds used in various chemical reactions.

entries.definition_en: a thermosetting resin made from phenols and aldehydes
entries.example_cn: 锅柄由酚醛树脂制成，以承受高温。
entries.example_en: The handle of the pot is made of phenolic to withstand high heat.

entries.definition_cn: 一种泻药，常用于多种制剂；也用作酸碱滴定中的指示剂，在强碱中呈鲜红色，pH 低于 8 时无色
entries.definition_en: a laxative used in many preparations under various trade names; also used as an acid-base indicator in titrations involving weak acids and strong bases because it is brilliant red at high alkalinity and colorless below pH 8
entries.example_cn: 化学家向溶液中添加了酚酞，以监测滴定过程中的 pH 变化。
entries.example_en: The chemist added phenolphthalein to the solution to monitor the pH change during the titration.

entries.definition_en: extraordinarily good or great
entries.example_cn: 她的新生意取得了非凡的成功。
entries.example_en: She had a phenomenal success in her new business.

entries.definition_en: relating to a phenomenon or observable event
entries.example_cn: 这项研究关注光的显性属性。
entries.example_en: The study focuses on the phenomenal properties of light.

entries.definition_en: to an extremely great degree
entries.example_cn: 这支球队在最后一场比赛中表现惊人。
entries.example_en: The team performed phenomenally well in the final match.

entries.definition_en: a philosophical approach focusing on the study of human experience rather than objective reality
entries.example_cn: 教授向全班介绍了现象学的基础知识。
entries.example_en: The professor introduced the class to the basics of phenomenology.

entries.definition_en: a remarkable development
entries.example_cn: 这家初创公司的突然成功是一件非凡之事。
entries.example_en: The sudden success of the startup was a remarkable phenomenon.

entries.definition_cn: （尤指科学上）通过观察或推理认识到的事物或事件
entries.definition_en: a thing or event known through observation or inference, especially in science
entries.example_cn: 北极光是自然现象。
entries.example_en: The aurora borealis is a natural phenomenon.

entries.definition_cn: 一种构成二苯并噻嗪环系的化合物；其衍生物曾用作药物
entries.definition_en: a chemical compound forming a dibenzothiazine ring system; its derivatives have been used as pharmaceuticals
entries.example_cn: 吩噻嗪是几种药用衍生物的母体化合物。
entries.example_en: Phenothiazine is the parent compound of several pharmaceutical derivatives.

entries.definition_en: the observable characteristics of an organism resulting from the interaction of its genes and the environment
entries.example_cn: 这株植物的高大性状既受其基因型影响，也受阳光照射量影响。
entries.example_en: The plant's tall height is a phenotype influenced by both its genotype and the amount of sunlight it receives.

entries.definition_en: relating to or constituting the observable characteristics of an organism
entries.example_cn: 这项研究侧重于两种植物品种之间的表型差异。
entries.example_en: The study focused on the phenotypic differences between the two plant varieties.

entries.definition_en: relating to the observable physical characteristics of an organism
entries.example_cn: 研究人员研究了两种植物品种之间的表现型差异。
entries.example_en: The researchers studied the phenotypical differences between the two plant varieties.

entries.definition_cn: 一种合成血管扩张剂，尤其用于治疗某些高血压病例
entries.definition_en: a synthetic compound used as a vasodilator, especially in certain cases of hypertension
entries.example_cn: 医生给患者使用酚妥拉明作为血管扩张剂，以治疗其高血压。
entries.example_en: The doctor administered phentolamine as a vasodilator to treat the patient's hypertension.

entries.definition_en: an essential amino acid found in proteins that is needed for growth and protein metabolism
entries.example_cn: 牛奶和鸡蛋是苯丙氨酸的丰富来源。
entries.example_en: Milk and eggs are rich sources of phenylalanine.

entries.definition_cn: 用于治疗关节炎和痛风的抗炎镇痛药（保泰松）
entries.definition_en: an anti-inflammatory and analgesic drug used to treat arthritis and gout
entries.example_cn: 医生给他开了保泰松，以减轻关节肿胀。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed phenylbutazone to reduce the swelling in his joints.

entries.definition_cn: 苯肾上腺素（一种用于扩张瞳孔和缓解鼻塞的血管收缩剂）
entries.definition_en: a drug that constricts blood vessels, used to dilate the pupils and relieve nasal congestion
entries.example_cn: 医生开了苯肾上腺素来治疗严重的鼻塞。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed phenylephrine to treat the severe nasal congestion.

usage.label: usually uncountable
usage.pattern: usually used as the name of a drug or substance

entries.definition_en: a genetic disorder where the body cannot convert phenylalanine into tyrosine, leading to a buildup of phenylalanine that can cause mental deficiency
entries.example_cn: 新生儿会接受苯丙酮尿症筛查，以防止智力障碍。
entries.example_en: Newborns are screened for phenylketonuria to prevent intellectual disabilities.

entries.definition_cn: 一种拟交感神经药，过去曾用于人用药物中作鼻减充血剂和食欲抑制剂
entries.definition_en: a sympathomimetic drug formerly used in human medicines as a nasal decongestant and appetite suppressant
entries.example_cn: 苯丙醇胺过去曾用作鼻减充血剂，但由于有出血性卒中风险，许多国家已停止或限制其人用。
entries.example_en: Phenylpropanolamine was formerly used as a nasal decongestant, but many countries withdrew or restricted its human use because of hemorrhagic-stroke risk.

entries.definition_en: an anticonvulsant drug used to treat epilepsy
entries.example_cn: 苯妥英钠常用于预防癫痫患者的发作。
entries.example_en: Phenytoin is commonly used to prevent seizures in patients with epilepsy.

entries.definition_en: a vascular tumor of the adrenal gland; hypersecretion of epinephrine results in intermittent or sustained hypertension
entries.example_cn: 患者在经历剧烈头痛后被诊断为嗜铬细胞瘤。
entries.example_en: The patient was diagnosed with a pheochromocytoma after experiencing severe headaches.

entries.definition_en: a chemical released by an animal that affects the behavior or physiology of others of the same species
entries.example_cn: 蚂蚁沿着信息素的踪迹寻找食物。
entries.example_en: Ants follow a pheromone trail to find food.

entries.definition_en: the twenty-first letter of the Greek alphabet
entries.example_cn: 在数学中，符号 phi 代表黄金比例。
entries.example_en: In mathematics, the symbol phi represents the golden ratio.

entries.definition_en: a small bottle used to hold medicine, often sealed for injection
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一剂装在小玻璃药瓶里的药。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed a dose of medicine in a small glass phial.

usage.label: dated
usage.pattern: small glass bottle for liquid medicine

entries.definition_cn: 山梅花属的一种落叶灌木，开白色芳香花
entries.definition_en: a type of deciduous shrub with white, sweet-smelling flowers
entries.example_cn: 山梅花属植物在春天繁茂地开花。
entries.example_en: The philadelphus bloomed profusely in the spring.

entries.definition_en: to have casual romantic or sexual relationships with many different people
entries.example_cn: 他被指控在婚姻期间与几位同事有染。
entries.example_en: He was accused of philandering with several colleagues while married.

entries.definition_en: to talk or behave in a romantic way without serious intentions
entries.example_cn: 他们在酒吧里喝着酒调情度过了整个晚上。
entries.example_en: They spent the evening philandering over drinks at the bar.

entries.definition_en: a man who has short sexual relationships with many women
entries.example_cn: 她在丈夫手机上发现他与几名女性的暧昧消息后，怀疑他是个花花公子。
entries.example_en: She suspected her husband was a philanderer after finding romantic messages from several women on his phone.

entries.definition_en: generous in giving help to the poor
entries.example_cn: 这个乐善好施的组织捐赠了数百万美元，用于在农村地区建造学校。
entries.example_en: The philanthropic organization donated millions to build schools in rural areas.

entries.definition_en: relating to or characterized by philanthropy
entries.example_cn: 她创立了一个慈善基金会来支持医学研究。
entries.example_en: She founded a philanthropic foundation to support medical research.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows a desire to help others, especially through charitable giving
entries.example_cn: 她慈善地捐钱给医院。
entries.example_en: She donated the money to the hospital philanthropically.

entries.definition_en: a person who gives money to help improve people's lives
entries.example_cn: 这位慈善家捐赠了数百万资金用于建造新学校。
entries.example_en: The philanthropist donated millions to build new schools.

entries.definition_en: the voluntary promotion of human welfare
entries.example_cn: 她的慈善事业帮助了许多有需要的儿童。
entries.example_en: Her philanthropy has helped many children in need.

entries.definition_en: relating to the collection of stamps or to stamp collectors
entries.example_cn: 博物馆举办了一场集邮展览，展示了19世纪的稀有邮票。
entries.example_en: The museum has a philatelic exhibition featuring rare stamps from the 19th century.

entries.definition_en: a person who collects and studies postage stamps
entries.example_cn: 这位集邮家花了几个小时整理他庞大的复古邮票收藏。
entries.example_en: The philatelist spent hours sorting his extensive collection of vintage stamps.

entries.definition_en: the hobby of collecting and studying postage stamps
entries.example_cn: 他花了数年时间收集并研究来自世界各地的邮票。
entries.example_en: He has spent years collecting and studying postage stamps from around the world.

entries.definition_en: a large professional orchestra that performs symphonies
entries.example_cn: 爱乐乐团将于今晚演奏贝多芬的第九交响曲。
entries.example_en: The philharmonic will perform Beethoven's Ninth Symphony tonight.

entries.definition_en: relating to or characteristic of a symphony orchestra
entries.example_cn: 这支交响乐团演奏了贝多芬的《第九交响曲》。
entries.example_en: The philharmonic orchestra performed Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.

entries.definition_en: devoted to or appreciative of music
entries.example_cn: 她是一位热爱音乐的支持者，参加每一场音乐会。
entries.example_en: She is a philharmonic supporter who attends every concert.

entries.definition_en: a strong feeling of affection or fondness
entries.example_cn: 这两兄弟之间的深厚情谊在他们每天的互动中显而易见。
entries.example_en: The philia between the two brothers was evident in their daily interactions.

entries.definition_en: a speech of violent denunciation
entries.example_cn: 参议员发表了一场针对市议会腐败的激烈抨击演说。
entries.example_en: The senator delivered a fiery philippic against the corruption in the city council.

entries.definition_cn: 重物质而缺乏艺术或文化素养的态度；庸人习气
entries.definition_en: a materialistic attitude accompanied by ignorance of artistic or cultural matters
entries.example_cn: 他拒绝支持任何艺术资金，这显示了他的庸俗主义。
entries.example_en: His philistinism was evident in his refusal to support any arts funding.

entries.definition_en: a type of plant often grown as a houseplant
entries.example_cn: 她买了一株喜林芋来为客厅增添绿意。
entries.example_en: She bought a philodendron to add greenery to her living room.

entries.definition_cn: 语文学的；与语言、文学和文本的历史研究有关的
entries.definition_en: relating to philology, especially the historical study of languages, literature, and texts
entries.example_cn: 语文学分析揭示了古手稿中的错误。
entries.example_en: The philological analysis revealed errors in the ancient manuscript.

entries.definition_en: a scholar specializing in the study of classical languages and literature
entries.example_cn: 这位古典语文学家花了数十年时间破译古代手稿。
entries.example_en: The philologist spent decades deciphering ancient manuscripts.

entries.definition_en: the humanistic study of language and literature
entries.example_cn: 毕业后，她决定从事语文学事业。
entries.example_en: She decided to pursue a career in philology after graduating.

entries.definition_en: a person who loves learning
entries.example_cn: 大学图书馆是每个好学之人的最爱之地。
entries.example_en: The university library is a favorite haunt of every philomath.

entries.definition_en: a person who studies philosophy and thinks about fundamental questions of existence and knowledge
entries.example_cn: 康德被认为是历史上最伟大的哲学家之一。
entries.example_en: Kant is considered one of the greatest philosophers in history.

entries.definition_en: a wise person who remains calm and rational in difficult situations
entries.example_cn: 危机爆发时，他表现得像个真正的智者。
entries.example_en: He acted like a true philosopher when the crisis broke.

entries.definition_en: relating to philosophy or philosophers
entries.example_cn: 对生活采取的哲学方法强调理性而非情感。
entries.example_en: The philosophic approach to life emphasizes reason over emotion.

entries.definition_en: calm and sensible when facing difficulties
entries.example_cn: 面对突如其来的消息，她处变不惊。
entries.example_en: She remained philosophic in the face of the unexpected news.

entries.definition_en: relating to the study of philosophy or to philosophers
entries.example_cn: 这本书是对人性的哲学探讨。
entries.example_en: The book is a philosophical exploration of human nature.

entries.definition_en: calm and rational when facing difficulties
entries.example_cn: 她对项目的延误保持冷静。
entries.example_en: She remained philosophical about the delay in the project.

entries.definition_cn: 以哲学方式；从哲学角度
entries.definition_en: in a way that relates to the study of philosophy or deep thinking
entries.example_cn: 从哲学角度来看，这场辩论质疑了人类意识的本质。
entries.example_en: Philosophically, the debate questions the nature of human consciousness.

entries.definition_en: with respect to the subject of philosophy
entries.example_cn: 就哲学而言，这个论点站得住脚，尽管它缺乏实际应用价值。
entries.example_en: Philosophically, the argument holds water, even if it lacks practical application.

entries.definition_en: to engage in philosophical reasoning or thinking
entries.example_cn: 在他晚年，他开始思考时间的本质。
entries.example_en: In his later years, he began to philosophise about the nature of time.

entries.definition_en: to think or reason in a philosophical way
entries.example_cn: 他喜欢思考生命的意义。
entries.example_en: He likes to philosophize about the meaning of life.

entries.definition_en: the act of explaining or discussing a particular philosophy, sometimes in a superficial way
entries.example_cn: 那场讲座更多是在空谈哲学，而非提供实际解决方案。
entries.example_en: The lecture was more about philosophizing than providing practical solutions.

entries.definition_en: the study of existence, knowledge, and ethics
entries.example_cn: 她在大学学习哲学。
entries.example_en: She studied philosophy at university.

entries.definition_en: a personal belief about how to live
entries.example_cn: 他的处世哲学是努力工作并储蓄。
entries.example_en: His philosophy is to work hard and save money.

entries.definition_en: a set of principles or beliefs guiding a group or institution
entries.example_cn: 该公司的理念是公平对待客户。
entries.example_en: The philosophy of the company is to treat customers fairly.

entries.definition_en: a magical drink that makes the person who drinks it fall in love with the person who gave it
entries.example_cn: 在故事中，王子喝下爱情魔药以赢得公主的心。
entries.example_en: In the story, the prince drank a philter to win the princess's heart.

entries.definition_en: a drink credited with magical power; can make the one who takes it love the one who gave it
entries.example_cn: 在古老的故事中，公主喝了爱情魔药以赢得王子的心。
entries.example_en: In the old tale, the princess drank the philtre to win the prince's heart.

entries.definition_en: a condition where the foreskin is too tight to be pulled back over the head of the penis
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了这个男孩是否有包茎的迹象。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined the boy for signs of phimosis.

entries.definition_en: a British informal term for the human face.
entries.example_cn: 那个老人用他那张脸朝陌生人投去锐利的一瞥。
entries.example_en: The old man gave the stranger a sharp look with his phiz.

entries.definition_en: inflammation of a vein, typically occurring in the legs
entries.example_cn: 患者在长途飞行后接受了静脉炎治疗。
entries.example_en: The patient was treated for phlebitis after the long flight.

entries.definition_en: someone who practices phlebotomy
entries.example_cn: 采血员在抽取血样前仔细清洁了病人的手臂。
entries.example_en: The phlebotomist carefully cleaned the patient's arm before drawing the blood sample.

entries.definition_cn: 切开或穿刺静脉以取血或放血；静脉放血术
entries.definition_en: the opening of a vein to withdraw blood or let blood; venesection
entries.example_cn: 医生建议通过放血疗法来减少他血液中过量的铁。
entries.example_en: The doctor recommended phlebotomy to reduce the excess iron in his blood.

entries.definition_en: mucus produced in the respiratory passages and coughed up
entries.example_cn: 医生建议他多喝水以稀释痰液。
entries.example_en: The doctor advised him to drink more water to thin the phlegm.

entries.definition_en: a state of inactivity or sluggishness
entries.example_cn: 长途旅行后，他变得无精打采，行动迟缓。
entries.example_en: After the long journey, he was overcome by phlegm and could not move quickly.

entries.definition_en: calmness or composure; sometimes indifference
entries.example_cn: 她以非凡的镇定面对危机。
entries.example_en: She faced the crisis with remarkable phlegm.

entries.definition_en: showing little emotion
entries.example_cn: 即使消息令人震惊，他依然保持镇定。
entries.example_en: He remained phlegmatic even when the news was shocking.

entries.definition_en: characterized by the presence of phlegm
entries.example_cn: 他带痰的咳嗽让火车上的所有人都感到恶心。
entries.example_en: His phlegmy cough disgusted everybody on the train.

entries.definition_en: (botany) tissue that transports synthesized food substances to parts where needed
entries.example_cn: 韧皮部将糖分从叶片输送到根部。
entries.example_en: The phloem carries sugars from the leaves to the roots.

entries.definition_en: a hypothetical substance once thought to be released when materials burn
entries.example_cn: 燃素理论最终被现代化学证伪。
entries.example_en: The theory of phlogiston was eventually disproven by modern chemistry.

usage.label: historical
usage.pattern: 历史化学理论中的假想物质

entries.definition_en: a brown variety of mica composed of hydrous silicate of potassium, magnesium, and aluminum
entries.example_cn: 地质学家在挖掘过程中鉴定出这种棕色矿物为金云母。
entries.example_en: Geologists identified the brown mineral as phlogopite during the excavation.

entries.definition_en: a North American plant with clusters of colorful flowers, often grown in gardens
entries.example_cn: 花园里开满了晚春时节鲜艳的花荵。
entries.example_en: The garden was filled with vibrant phlox blooming in late spring.

entries.definition_cn: 对某事物的非理性或过度恐惧；恐惧症
entries.definition_en: an irrational or excessive fear or aversion to something
entries.example_cn: 她患有严重的恐高症，避免去高楼大厦。
entries.example_en: She suffers from a severe phobia of heights and avoids tall buildings.

entries.definition_cn: 恐惧症的；对……有强烈恐惧或厌恶的
entries.definition_en: relating to or experiencing a phobia; expressing strong fear or dislike
entries.example_cn: 她害怕坐飞机，拒绝乘坐飞机旅行。
entries.example_en: She is phobic about flying and refuses to travel by plane.

entries.definition_en: a legendary bird from Arabia that dies by fire and is reborn from its ashes
entries.example_cn: 传说凤凰能活五百年，然后自焚并从灰烬中重生。
entries.example_en: The myth says that a phoenix lives for 500 years before burning itself to death and rising again from the ashes.

entries.definition_en: a unit used to measure subjective loudness
entries.example_cn: 声音等级以方为单位进行测量，以考虑人耳的敏感度。
entries.example_en: The sound level was measured in phons to account for human hearing sensitivity.

entries.definition_en: the process of producing sound by the vibration of vocal cords
entries.example_cn: 歌手控制发声的能力使她能够毫不费力地唱出高音。
entries.example_en: The singer's ability to control phonation allowed her to hit high notes effortlessly.

usage.label: countable or uncountable
usage.pattern: The source permits both count and noncount use.

entries.definition_en: electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds
entries.example_cn: 请用电话给你妈妈打电话。
entries.example_en: Please use the phone to call your mother.

entries.definition_en: electro-acoustic transducer for converting electric signals into sounds; it is held over or inserted into the ear
entries.example_cn: 他把听筒贴在耳朵上。
entries.example_en: He held the phone to his ear.

entries.definition_cn: （语音学）不论是否为某种语言的音位而定义的单个语音单位
entries.definition_en: an individual sound unit of speech without concern as to whether or not it is a phoneme of some language
entries.example_cn: 字母“a”在英语中可以代表不同的语音。
entries.example_en: The letter 'a' can represent different phones in English.

entries.definition_en: get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone
entries.example_cn: 我稍后给你打电话。
entries.example_en: I will phone you later.

entries.definition_cn: 听众通过电话参与的节目
entries.definition_en: a program in which the audience participates by telephone
entries.example_cn: 这家广播电台每周日上午举办一个受欢迎的听众电话互动节目。
entries.example_en: The radio station hosted a popular phone-in show every Sunday morning.

entries.definition_cn: 许多人集中给目标对象打电话进行的抗议活动
entries.definition_en: a protest in which many people make telephone calls to the target
entries.example_cn: 该团体组织了一场通过集中打电话抗议该电台决定的活动。
entries.example_en: The group organized a phone-in protest against the station's decision.

entries.definition_en: a directory containing an alphabetical list of telephone subscribers and their numbers
entries.example_cn: 她在电话簿中查找号码给朋友打电话。
entries.example_en: She looked up the number in the phonebook to call her friend.

entries.definition_cn: 大型查找表，尤指用于将数值或名称映射到相应信息的表
entries.definition_en: a large lookup table, especially one used to map values or names to corresponding information
entries.example_cn: 该程序使用查找表来查找每个名称对应的地址。
entries.example_en: The program uses a phonebook to find each name's corresponding address.

entries.definition_en: a distinct sound in a language that can change the meaning of a word
entries.example_cn: 字母 'c' 在英语中代表不同的音素，例如在 'cat' 和 'city' 中。
entries.example_en: The letter 'c' represents different phonemes in English, such as in 'cat' and 'city'.

entries.definition_en: relating to the study of phonemes in a language
entries.example_cn: 音位分析有助于区分那些能改变意义的声音。
entries.example_en: Phonemic analysis helps distinguish between sounds that change meaning.

entries.definition_en: in the manner of phonemics
entries.example_cn: 语言学家以音位学的方式分析了该方言。
entries.example_en: The linguist analyzed the dialect phonemic.

entries.definition_en: in terms of phonemes; at the phonemic level
entries.example_cn: 这位语言学家从音位层面分析了该语言，以识别其基本音位。
entries.example_en: The linguist analyzed the language phonemically to identify its basic sound units.

entries.definition_en: the person initiating a telephone call
entries.example_cn: 作为主叫者，你在会议开始前负责拨打正确的号码。
entries.example_en: As the phoner, you are responsible for dialing the correct number before the meeting starts.

entries.definition_cn: 通过电话进行的广播采访
entries.definition_en: a broadcast interview conducted by telephone
entries.example_cn: 主持人在早间节目中播出了对这位演员的电话采访。
entries.example_en: The host aired a phoner with the actor during the morning show.

entries.definition_en: relating to speech sounds
entries.example_cn: 这个声音的语音符号是 /θ/。
entries.example_en: The phonetic symbol for this sound is /θ/.

entries.definition_en: relating to the scientific study of speech sounds
entries.example_cn: 她在语言学课程中学习语音转写。
entries.example_en: She is studying phonetic transcription in her linguistics course.

entries.definition_cn: 按语音拼写地；以表示发音的方式
entries.definition_en: in a way that represents the pronunciation of a word rather than its conventional spelling
entries.example_cn: 这个单词的拼写与其发音一致。
entries.example_en: The word is spelled phonetically to match its pronunciation.

entries.definition_en: the scientific study of speech sounds, including how they are produced and perceived
entries.example_cn: 这门课程涵盖了语音学的基础以及语音是如何形成的。
entries.example_en: The course covers the basics of phonetics and how speech sounds are formed.

entries.definition_cn: 虚假的；冒牌的；具有误导性的
entries.definition_en: fraudulent; having a misleading appearance
entries.example_cn: 他脸上虚假的笑容并未触及眼睛。
entries.example_en: The phoney smile on his face did not reach his eyes.

entries.definition_en: a person who professes beliefs and opinions that he or she does not hold in order to conceal his or her real feelings or motives
entries.example_cn: 这位政客是个伪君子，声称关心穷人，实际上却在暗中使自己致富。
entries.example_en: The politician was a phoney who claimed to care about the poor while secretly enriching himself.

entries.definition_en: relating to sound in general
entries.example_cn: 这项研究考察了该乐器的声音特性。
entries.example_en: The study examined the phonic properties of the instrument.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to speech sounds
entries.example_cn: 语音分析有助于识别单词中的发音。
entries.example_en: Phonic analysis helps identify the sounds in a word.

entries.definition_en: relating to the phonic method of teaching reading
entries.example_cn: 老师采用语音教学法帮助学生学习阅读。
entries.example_en: The teacher used a phonic approach to help the students learn to read.

entries.definition_en: a method of teaching reading by training beginners to associate letters with their sound values
entries.example_cn: 老师引入了自然拼读法来帮助学生学习阅读。
entries.example_en: The teacher introduced phonics to help the students learn to read.

entries.definition_cn: 表示语音的书写符号（字形）
entries.definition_en: a written symbol (grapheme) that represents a sound
entries.example_cn: 在语言学中，表音符号是代表特定语音的书写符号。
entries.example_en: In linguistics, a phonogram is a written symbol that represents a specific sound.

entries.definition_cn: 使用唱针和旋转唱片录制或播放声音的设备；留声机
entries.definition_en: a device that records or plays sound using a stylus and a rotating record
entries.example_cn: 博物馆里的老式留声机仍然能播放黑胶唱片。
entries.example_en: The old phonograph in the museum still plays vinyl records.

entries.definition_en: relating to the study of the sound system of language
entries.example_cn: 语音规则决定了声音在不同语境中如何变化。
entries.example_en: The phonological rules determine how sounds change in different contexts.

entries.definition_en: the study of the sound system of a language and its phonemes
entries.example_cn: 这门课程涵盖了英语音系学的基本原则。
entries.example_en: The course covers the basic principles of phonology in English.

entries.definition_cn: （非正式）假的；冒牌的；具有误导性外观的
entries.definition_en: (informal) fraudulent; fake; having a misleading appearance
entries.example_cn: 这家公司销售的是假冒产品，根本无法使用。
entries.example_en: The company was selling phony products that did not work.

entries.definition_en: a person who professes beliefs and opinions that he or she does not hold in order to conceal his or her real feelings or motives
entries.example_cn: 他被揭露为一个为了博取名声而假装捐款的伪君子。
entries.example_en: He was exposed as a phony who only donated money to gain fame.

entries.definition_en: a colorless poisonous gas that smells like freshly cut hay and is used in chemical warfare
entries.example_cn: 士兵们接受训练以识别光气，因为它有独特的味道。
entries.example_en: The soldiers were trained to detect phosgene because of its distinctive smell.

entries.definition_en: an enzyme that breaks down organic phosphates
entries.example_cn: 碱性磷酸酶常被用作医学检测中的标志物。
entries.example_en: Alkaline phosphatase is often used as a marker in medical tests.

entries.definition_en: a salt of phosphoric acid
entries.example_cn: 磷酸钙是骨骼中发现的一种重要矿物质。
entries.example_en: Calcium phosphate is an important mineral found in bones.

entries.definition_cn: 含果糖浆和少量磷酸的碳酸饮料
entries.definition_en: carbonated drink with fruit syrup and a little phosphoric acid
entries.example_cn: 可乐是一种深受许多人喜爱的含磷酸碳酸饮料。
entries.example_en: Cola is a popular phosphate drink enjoyed by many people.

entries.definition_en: a toxic, colorless gas with the chemical formula PH₃
entries.example_cn: 磷化氢是一种具有明显鱼腥味的有毒气体。
entries.example_en: Phosphine is a toxic gas with a distinct fishy odor.

entries.definition_en: an organic compound made of creatine and phosphoric acid that releases energy for muscle contraction in vertebrates
entries.example_cn: 在剧烈运动期间，身体依赖磷酸肌酸在肌肉细胞中快速再生 ATP。
entries.example_en: During intense exercise, the body relies on phosphocreatine to quickly regenerate ATP in muscle cells.

entries.definition_en: a compound composed of fatty acids and phosphoric acid and a nitrogenous base; an important constituent of membranes
entries.example_cn: 细胞膜主要由磷脂分子的双层组成。
entries.example_en: The cell membrane is primarily made up of a double layer of phospholipid molecules.

entries.definition_cn: 含有结合磷酸基团或与磷脂形成复合物的蛋白质
entries.definition_en: a protein containing bound phosphate groups or complexed with a phospholipid
entries.example_cn: 研究人员正在研究这种磷蛋白如何调节细胞生长。
entries.example_en: Researchers are studying how the phosphoprotein regulates cell growth.

entries.definition_en: a synthetic material that glows in the dark or when exposed to light, often used to coat television screens
entries.example_cn: 旧显示器发出的蓝光是由屏幕上的荧光粉涂层造成的。
entries.example_en: The blue glow of the old monitor was caused by the phosphor coating on its screen.

entries.definition_en: the emission of light by a substance that has absorbed radiation and continues to glow after the source is removed
entries.example_cn: 海洋生物的磷光使海水在黑暗中发光。
entries.example_en: The phosphorescence of the sea creatures made the water glow in the dark.

entries.definition_cn: 受激后能持续发光且几乎不产生热量的；磷光的
entries.definition_en: emitting light for some time after excitation, without appreciable heat
entries.example_cn: 这种磷光涂料在接触光线后在黑暗中发光。
entries.example_en: The phosphorescent paint glowed in the dark after being exposed to light.

entries.definition_en: containing phosphorus or having the characteristics of phosphorus
entries.example_cn: 含磷化合物被用于许多工业过程中。
entries.example_en: Phosphoric compounds are used in many industrial processes.

entries.definition_en: containing or having the properties of phosphorus
entries.example_cn: 这种含磷化合物被用于化学实验中。
entries.example_en: The phosphorous compound was used in the chemical experiment.

entries.definition_cn: 光照度单位，等于每平方厘米一流明（符号：ph）
entries.definition_en: a unit of illuminance equal to one lumen per square centimetre (symbol ph)
entries.example_cn: 光照度是以 phot 为单位测量的。
entries.example_en: Illuminance was measured in phots.

entries.definition_cn: 光的；与光有关的；受光照的
entries.definition_en: relating to, caused by, or irradiated by light
entries.example_cn: 海洋的透光层是阳光能够穿透并支持植物生长的区域。
entries.example_en: The photic zone of the ocean is where sunlight penetrates and supports plant life.

entries.definition_en: a picture of a person or scene made by a camera
entries.example_cn: 她拍了一张美丽的日落照片。
entries.example_en: She took a photo of the beautiful sunset.

entries.definition_cn: 用照相制版印刷法印刷
entries.definition_en: to print by the photo-offset method
entries.example_cn: 印刷厂用照相制版印刷法印刷了这本旧书的书页。
entries.example_en: The printer photo-offset the pages of the old book.

entries.definition_en: a method of printing that uses photomechanical plates to transfer images
entries.example_cn: 博物馆使用照相制版印刷法复制了这些珍贵的历史文件。
entries.example_en: The museum used photo-offset to reproduce the rare historical documents.

entries.definition_cn: 突然闯入他人照片（通常会破坏照片效果）
entries.definition_en: appear unexpectedly in someone’s photograph, often spoiling it
entries.example_cn: 一只狗闯入了这家人度假时的照片。
entries.example_en: A dog photobombed the family's vacation picture.

entries.definition_en: a cathode that emits electrons when illuminated
entries.example_cn: 图像增强管包含一个敏感的光电阴极。
entries.example_en: The image intensifier tube contains a sensitive photocathode.

entries.definition_en: a device that detects and measures light or other radiation
entries.example_cn: 当光电管检测到黑暗时，路灯会自动亮起。
entries.example_en: The streetlights turn on automatically when the photocell detects darkness.

entries.definition_en: relating to or produced by the effects of light on chemical systems
entries.example_cn: 当混合物暴露在阳光下时，发生了光化学反应。
entries.example_en: The photochemical reaction occurred when the mixture was exposed to sunlight.

entries.definition_en: the branch of chemistry that studies chemical reactions caused by light
entries.example_cn: 光化学在理解植物如何将阳光转化为能量方面起着至关重要的作用。
entries.example_en: Photochemistry plays a crucial role in understanding how plants convert sunlight into energy.

entries.definition_cn: 用激光摧毁肿瘤或患病视网膜组织，或制造疤痕固定脱离视网膜的手术
entries.definition_en: a surgical procedure using a laser to destroy a tumor or diseased retinal tissue, or to create a scar that holds a detached retina in place
entries.example_cn: 医生建议进行光凝术以防止视网膜进一步脱落。
entries.example_en: The doctor recommended photocoagulation to prevent the retina from detaching further.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to photoconductivity
entries.example_cn: 相机传感器依赖光导材料来捕捉光线。
entries.example_en: The camera sensor relies on photoconductive materials to capture light.

entries.definition_en: the increase in a substance’s electrical conductivity caused by absorbing electromagnetic radiation
entries.example_cn: 该传感器利用光电导性来检测黑暗中的光线水平。
entries.example_en: The sensor relies on photoconductivity to detect light levels in the dark.

entries.definition_en: a machine that makes copies of documents using photographic methods
entries.example_cn: 请在员工休息室使用复印机复印您的文件。
entries.example_en: Please use the photocopier in the staff room to make your documents.

entries.definition_en: reproduce by xerography
entries.example_cn: 我需要为明天的会议复印这些文件。
entries.example_en: I need to photocopy these documents for the meeting tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: a photographic copy of written or printed or graphic work
entries.example_cn: 离开前请复印一下您的护照。
entries.example_en: Please make a photocopy of your passport before you leave.

entries.definition_en: relating to the electric effects produced by electromagnetic radiation, especially light
entries.example_cn: 光电电池将光能转换为电信号。
entries.example_en: The photoelectric cell converts light energy into electrical signals.

entries.definition_en: an electron released from an atom or molecule when hit by a photon
entries.example_cn: 该实验检测到了从金属表面发射出的光电子。
entries.example_en: The experiment detected the emission of photoelectrons from the metal surface.

entries.definition_en: the emission of photoelectrons, especially from a metallic surface
entries.example_cn: 实验测量了金属表面受到紫外线照射时产生的光电子发射。
entries.example_en: The experiment measured photoemission from a metal surface exposed to ultraviolet light.

entries.definition_cn: 将摄影图像转印到版材上，再进行蚀刻和印刷的工艺
entries.definition_en: the process of transferring a photographic image onto a plate, then etching and printing it
entries.example_cn: 照相制版曾广泛用于在书籍和报纸上复制照片。
entries.example_en: Photoengraving was widely used to reproduce photographs in books and newspapers.

entries.definition_cn: 用于复制插图的蚀刻版
entries.definition_en: an engraving used to reproduce an illustration
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展示了一幅19世纪的稀有照片蚀刻版。
entries.example_en: The museum displayed a rare photoengraving from the 19th century.

usage.label: countable
usage.pattern: A photoengraving can mean the plate or reproduction.

entries.definition_en: looking attractive in photographs
entries.example_cn: 她非常上镜，经常摆姿势拍照。
entries.example_en: She is very photogenic and often poses for the camera.

entries.definition_en: a picture of a person or scene made by using a camera
entries.example_cn: 她拍了一张日落的照片。
entries.example_en: She took a photograph of the sunset.

entries.definition_en: to make a picture of someone or something using a camera
entries.example_cn: 你能帮我把这座楼拍下来吗？
entries.example_en: Can you photograph the building for me?

entries.definition_cn: 在照片中呈现出某种样子；上镜
entries.definition_en: to appear or look a particular way in a photograph; be photogenic
entries.example_cn: 她很上镜。
entries.example_en: She photographs well.

entries.definition_en: someone who takes photographs professionally
entries.example_cn: 摄影师记录了婚礼仪式。
entries.example_en: The photographer captured the wedding ceremony.

entries.definition_en: relating to photography or produced by photography
entries.example_cn: 这家博物馆收藏了大量19世纪的摄影作品。
entries.example_en: The museum has a large collection of photographic works from the 19th century.

entries.definition_en: representing people or nature with the exactness of a photograph
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家的画作如此逼真，以至于观众以为那是真照片。
entries.example_en: The artist's painting was so photographic that viewers thought it was a real photo.

entries.definition_en: by means of photography
entries.example_cn: 犯罪现场通过摄影方式进行了记录，以保留每一个细节。
entries.example_en: The crime scene was documented photographically to preserve every detail.

entries.definition_cn: 摄影（术）；制作照片的艺术和技术
entries.definition_en: the art and technology of producing photographs
entries.example_cn: 摄影改变了我们记录历史的方式。
entries.example_en: Photography has changed how we record history.

entries.definition_en: the occupation of taking photographs
entries.example_cn: 她决定以摄影为职业。
entries.example_en: She decided to make a career in photography.

entries.definition_cn: 在感光材料上产生物体图像的过程
entries.definition_en: the process of producing images of objects on photosensitive surfaces
entries.example_cn: 摄影的发明改变了我们记录历史的方式。
entries.example_en: The invention of photography changed how we record history.

entries.definition_en: a printing technique that uses an intaglio plate prepared by photographic methods.
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展示了一幅罕见的 19 世纪风景照相凹版印刷品。
entries.example_en: The museum displayed a rare photogravure of the landscape from the 19th century.

entries.definition_en: an intaglio print produced using the photogravure process.
entries.example_cn: 收藏家们珍视照相凹版印刷品，因为它具有丰富的色调范围和精细的细节。
entries.example_en: Collectors value the photogravure for its rich tonal range and fine detail.

entries.definition_en: the process of using photography to create a plate for printing.
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家花了数周时间完善照相制版技术，以捕捉叶子的纹理。
entries.example_en: The artist spent weeks perfecting the photogravure technique to capture the texture of the leaves.

entries.definition_en: journalism that tells a story mainly through photographs
entries.example_cn: 获奖的新闻摄影捕捉到了和平的时刻。
entries.example_en: The award-winning photojournalism captured the moment of peace.

entries.definition_en: a journalist who tells stories mainly using photographs
entries.example_cn: 这位摄影记者捕捉到了这一历史时刻。
entries.example_en: The photojournalist captured the moment of the historic event.

entries.definition_en: a lithographic printing process in which plates are made from photographic images
entries.example_cn: 照相平版印刷术被用于在印版上制作精细图像。
entries.example_en: Photolithography was used to produce the detailed image on the printing plate.

entries.definition_cn: 照相制版的；与通过摄影制版的各种方法有关的
entries.definition_en: of or relating to or involving various methods of using photography to make plates for printing
entries.example_cn: 照相机械工艺使得高质量印刷版的大规模生产成为可能。
entries.example_en: The photomechanical process allowed for the mass production of high-quality printing plates.

entries.definition_en: an instrument used to measure the brightness of a light source by comparing it with a standard source
entries.example_cn: 天文学家使用光度计测量遥远恒星的发光强度。
entries.example_en: The astronomer used a photometer to measure the luminous intensity of the distant star.

entries.definition_en: photographic equipment that measures the intensity of light
entries.example_cn: 在拍摄肖像之前，摄影师调整了相机的测光表以确保曝光正确。
entries.example_en: Before taking the portrait, the photographer adjusted the camera's photometer to ensure proper exposure.

entries.definition_en: relating to the measurement of light
entries.example_cn: 光度学数据帮助天文学家计算了恒星的亮度。
entries.example_en: The photometric data helped astronomers calculate the star's brightness.

entries.definition_en: the measurement of the properties of light, especially luminous intensity
entries.example_cn: 天文学家利用光度测量法测定了这颗恒星的亮度。
entries.example_en: The astronomer used photometry to determine the brightness of the star.

usage.label: usually uncountable
usage.pattern: photometry is generally used as an uncountable noun

entries.definition_en: a photograph taken using a microscope
entries.example_cn: 科学家检查了显微照片以识别细菌。
entries.example_en: The scientist examined the photomicrograph to identify the bacteria.

entries.definition_en: an artwork created by combining multiple photographic images
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家利用不同时代的图像创作了一幅超现实的照片拼贴画。
entries.example_en: The artist created a surreal photomontage using images from different eras.

entries.definition_cn: 用照片拼接制作合成图像的艺术或技法
entries.definition_en: The art or technique of constructing composite images from photographs.
entries.example_cn: 这门课程探讨照片拼贴作为一种艺术形式，而不仅仅是它所制作出的单幅图像。
entries.example_en: The course explores photomontage as an art form, not just the individual images it produces.

entries.definition_en: a particle of light
entries.example_cn: 光子是电磁辐射的一个量子。
entries.example_en: A photon is a quantum of electromagnetic radiation.

entries.definition_cn: 畏光；因强光而导致的眼部疼痛或不适
entries.definition_en: eye pain or discomfort caused by exposure to bright light
entries.example_cn: 患者出现畏光，在强光下眼睛剧烈疼痛。
entries.example_en: The patient experienced photophobia, with severe eye pain in bright light.

entries.definition_en: an abnormal fear of light
entries.example_cn: 手术后，这位病人患有严重的畏光症。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from severe photophobia after the surgery.

entries.definition_en: reacting or affected by visible light
entries.example_cn: 胶片是感光性的，必须存放在暗盒中。
entries.example_en: The film is photosensitive and must be kept in a dark box.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being easily affected by light or other radiant energy
entries.example_cn: 这种相机胶片感光性强，可以在光线不足的情况下使用。
entries.example_en: The camera film has high photosensitivity, allowing it to be used in low light.

entries.definition_en: to digitally alter a photo
entries.example_cn: 他喜欢修朋友的照片，让它们看起来更滑稽。
entries.example_en: He likes to photoshop his friends' pictures to make them look funnier.

entries.definition_cn: 恒星（特别是太阳）的发光表面
entries.definition_en: the bright, glowing surface of a star, such as the Sun
entries.example_cn: 太阳的光球层是发出大部分光线的层次。
entries.example_en: The photosphere of the Sun is the layer from which most of its light is emitted.

entries.definition_cn: 植物、藻类和某些细菌利用光能将二氧化碳和水转化为碳水化合物的过程
entries.definition_en: the process by which plants, algae, and some bacteria use light energy to make carbohydrates from carbon dioxide and water
entries.example_cn: 植物通过光合作用产生氧气和葡萄糖。
entries.example_en: Plants carry out photosynthesis to produce oxygen and glucose.

entries.definition_en: relating to or using or formed by photosynthesis
entries.example_cn: 植物是光合作用的生物，将阳光转化为能量。
entries.example_en: Plants are photosynthetic organisms that convert sunlight into energy.

entries.definition_cn: 利用光线治疗皮肤病、新生儿黄疸或某些情绪障碍的疗法
entries.definition_en: a treatment using light to treat skin disorders, newborn jaundice, or some mood disorders
entries.example_cn: 婴儿被放在特殊灯光下进行光疗，以降低胆红素水平。
entries.example_en: The baby was placed under special lights for phototherapy to reduce the bilirubin levels.

entries.definition_cn: 植物向光或背光生长、运动的现象
entries.definition_en: the movement or growth of a plant toward or away from light
entries.example_cn: 这株植物表现出向光性，将茎弯向窗户。
entries.example_en: The plant exhibits phototropism by bending its stem toward the window.

entries.definition_en: producing electricity when exposed to light
entries.example_cn: 这栋房子由屋顶上的光伏板供电。
entries.example_en: The house is powered by photovoltaic panels on the roof.

entries.definition_en: relating to or functioning as a group of words that act together as a single unit
entries.example_cn: 短语动词“give up”的含义与单独的词“give”和“up”不同。
entries.example_en: The phrasal verb 'give up' has a meaning different from the individual words 'give' and 'up'.

entries.definition_en: a group of words forming a grammatical unit
entries.example_cn: "起初"是一个常见的短语。
entries.example_en: "In the beginning" is a common phrase.

entries.definition_en: an expression whose meaning is not clear from individual words
entries.example_cn: “Kick the bucket”是一个表示“去世”的习语。
entries.example_en: "Kick the bucket" is a phrase meaning to die.

entries.definition_en: a short musical passage
entries.example_cn: 作曲家为小提琴写了一段优美的乐句。
entries.example_en: The composer wrote a beautiful phrase for the violin.

entries.definition_en: a sequence of linked dance movements
entries.example_cn: 编舞家为芭蕾舞创作了一个新的舞步序列。
entries.example_en: The choreographer created a new phrase for the ballet.

entries.definition_en: to express something in words
entries.example_cn: 他试图礼貌地措辞提出请求。
entries.example_en: He tried to phrase his request politely.

entries.definition_cn: 将某物分成、组合成或标记为乐句、短语
entries.definition_en: to divide, combine, or mark something into phrases
entries.example_cn: 老师教学生如何划分句子。
entries.example_en: The teacher showed the students how to phrase the sentence.

entries.definition_en: the manner in which something is expressed in words
entries.example_cn: 官方文件中使用的措辞非常正式。
entries.example_en: The phraseology used in the official document was very formal.

entries.definition_en: the manner in which something is expressed in words
entries.example_cn: 他对这一论点的措辞既清晰又有说服力。
entries.example_en: His phrasing of the argument was both clear and persuasive.

entries.definition_cn: 音乐作品或演奏中乐句的处理与分组
entries.definition_en: the way musical phrases are shaped and grouped in a composition or performance
entries.example_cn: 钢琴家娴熟的乐句处理使旋律听起来流畅自然。
entries.example_en: The pianist's skillful phrasing made the melody sound fluid.

entries.definition_en: a group of people who claim descent from a common ancestor
entries.example_cn: 在古希腊社会中，胞族是社会组织的根本单位。
entries.example_en: In ancient Greek society, the phratry was a fundamental unit of social organization.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to ground water
entries.example_cn: 潜水带是土壤被水饱和的区域。
entries.example_en: The phreatic zone is the area where the soil is saturated with water.

entries.definition_en: relating to the diaphragm muscle
entries.example_cn: 膈神经控制膈肌的运动。
entries.example_en: The phrenic nerve controls the movement of the diaphragm.

entries.definition_cn: 与颅相学（通过头骨形状判断性格的已被否定的理论）有关的
entries.definition_en: relating to phrenology, a discredited theory of judging character by skull shape
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展示了一张19世纪的颅相学图表。
entries.example_en: The museum displayed a phrenological chart from the 19th century.

entries.definition_en: a person who claims to determine character from skull shape
entries.example_cn: 这位颅相学家声称，客户头上的隆起揭示了他们隐藏的天赋。
entries.example_en: The phrenologist claimed that the bumps on his client's head revealed their hidden talents.

entries.definition_en: an abandoned study of the shape of the skull as indicative of the strengths of different faculties
entries.example_cn: 颅相学曾经很流行，但现在被认为是一门伪科学。
entries.example_en: Phrenology was once popular but is now considered a pseudoscience.

entries.definition_en: a blue pigment found in algae
entries.example_cn: 科学家们正在研究藻蓝蛋白的健康益处。
entries.example_en: Scientists are studying phycocyanin for its health benefits.

entries.definition_cn: 藻红蛋白：存在于蓝细菌、红藻和隐藻中的红色捕光蛋白
entries.definition_en: a red light-harvesting protein found in cyanobacteria, red algae, and cryptomonads
entries.example_cn: 科学家从红藻中提取红色色素，用于荧光标记。
entries.example_en: Scientists extracted phycoerythrin from the red algae to use in fluorescent labeling.

entries.definition_en: the branch of botany that studies algae
entries.example_cn: 藻类学对于理解海洋生态系统至关重要。
entries.example_en: Phycology is essential for understanding marine ecosystems.

entries.definition_cn: （犹太教）经文匣（两只中的一只，内含希伯来圣经经文，传统上由犹太男子祈祷时佩戴）
entries.definition_en: (Judaism) either of two small leather cases containing Hebrew Scripture texts, traditionally worn by Jewish men during prayer
entries.example_cn: 晨祷时，传统上将一只经文匣戴在额头上，另一只戴在左臂上。
entries.example_en: One phylactery is traditionally worn on the forehead and the other on the left arm during morning prayers.

entries.definition_en: relating to the evolutionary development of a group of organisms
entries.example_cn: 该物种的种系历史显示了其对环境逐渐适应的过程。
entries.example_en: The phyletic history of the species shows a gradual adaptation to the environment.

entries.definition_en: thin sheets of pastry used especially in Greek dishes
entries.example_cn: 我们用菲洛面皮制作了美味的菠菜派。
entries.example_en: We used phyllo to make delicious spanakopita.

entries.definition_en: relating to the evolutionary development of organisms
entries.example_cn: 系统发育树显示了物种之间的关系。
entries.example_en: The phylogenetic tree shows how species are related.

entries.definition_en: in a way that relates to the evolutionary history and relationships of species
entries.example_cn: 这两个物种在系统发育上有关联，拥有数百万年前的共同祖先。
entries.example_en: The two species are phylogenetically related, sharing a common ancestor millions of years ago.

entries.definition_en: the sequence of events involved in the evolutionary development of a species or taxonomic group of organisms
entries.example_cn: 科学家研究哺乳动物的系统发育，以了解它们的进化过程。
entries.example_en: Scientists study the phylogeny of mammals to understand their evolution.

entries.definition_cn: 显示生物或生物类群之间进化关系的图表；系统发育树
entries.definition_en: a diagram showing the evolutionary relationships among organisms or groups of organisms
entries.example_cn: 研究人员用系统发育树展示这些物种之间的亲缘关系。
entries.example_en: The researcher used a phylogeny to show how the species are related.

entries.definition_en: a major taxonomic group of animals or plants containing classes
entries.example_cn: 脊索动物被归类于脊索动物门。
entries.example_en: Chordates are classified within the phylum Chordata.

entries.definition_en: a large group of languages that are historically related
entries.example_cn: 罗曼语族属于印欧语系。
entries.example_en: The Romance languages belong to the Indo-European phylum.

entries.definition_en: a member of the genus Physa, a type of freshwater snail
entries.example_cn: 池塘里充满了囊螺，它们以藻类为食。
entries.example_en: The pond was teeming with physa, which feed on algae.

entries.definition_en: a medicine or drug, especially a purgative
entries.example_cn: 在18世纪，医生经常开具强效泻药来治疗发烧。
entries.example_en: In the 18th century, doctors often prescribed a strong physic to treat fevers.

entries.definition_en: relating to the body rather than the mind or spirit
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了他的身体状况。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined his physical condition.

entries.definition_en: existing as a material thing that can be perceived by the senses
entries.example_cn: 犯罪现场的实物证据被发现了。
entries.example_en: The physical evidence was found at the scene of the crime.

entries.definition_en: involving active bodily movement
entries.example_cn: 这份工作需要大量的体力劳动。
entries.example_en: The job requires a lot of physical effort.

entries.definition_en: relating to the science of matter and energy
entries.example_cn: 她正在大学学习物理科学。
entries.example_en: She is studying physical science at university.

entries.definition_en: following the laws of nature and material things
entries.example_cn: 宇宙的物理定律无处不在。
entries.example_en: The physical laws of the universe apply everywhere.

entries.definition_en: caused by physical force
entries.example_cn: 风的物理力量打破了窗户。
entries.example_en: The physical force of the wind broke the window.

entries.definition_en: concerned with material objects
entries.example_cn: 这家博物馆保存着许多来自古城的实物。
entries.example_en: The museum preserves many physical objects from the ancient city.

entries.definition_cn: 认为一切存在最终都是物理的，或由物理事实决定的哲学立场
entries.definition_en: the philosophical view that everything that exists is ultimately physical or determined by physical facts
entries.example_cn: 许多现代哲学家认为物理主义是对心灵最合理的看法。
entries.example_en: Many modern philosophers argue that physicalism is the most plausible view of the mind.

entries.definition_cn: 对满足身体欲望和食欲的强烈关注
entries.definition_en: preoccupation with physical desires and bodily appetites
entries.example_cn: 这个角色的肉欲表现主要是对身体欲望的沉迷。
entries.example_en: The character's physicality was dominated by an obsession with bodily appetites.

entries.definition_en: in a physical way, especially according to physical laws
entries.example_cn: 这个理论在物理上是不可能的。
entries.example_en: The theory is physically impossible.

entries.definition_en: a doctor who is licensed to practice medicine
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了病人并开了药。
entries.example_en: The physician examined the patient and prescribed medication.

entries.definition_en: a scientist who studies physics
entries.example_cn: 这位物理学家进行了量子力学实验。
entries.example_en: The physicist conducted experiments on quantum mechanics.

entries.definition_en: relating to physical chemistry
entries.example_cn: 该实验室专注于新材料的物理化学性质。
entries.example_en: The lab focuses on physicochemical properties of new materials.

entries.definition_en: the scientific study of matter and energy
entries.example_cn: 她正在大学学习物理学。
entries.example_en: She is studying physics at university.

entries.definition_cn: 某种现象或系统的物理原理或方面
entries.definition_en: the physical principles or aspects of a phenomenon or system
entries.example_cn: 飞行的物理原理很复杂。
entries.example_en: The physics of flight is complex.

entries.definition_en: the appearance of a person's face
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家研究了模特的面相，以捕捉其独特的表情。
entries.example_en: The artist studied the physiognomy of the subject to capture their unique expression.
