entries.example_en: He tapped the table with his pinkie while listening.

entries.definition_en: having a light shade of red
entries.example_cn: 日落时天空变成了淡红色。
entries.example_en: The sky turned a pinkish hue at sunset.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being pink
entries.example_cn: 日落的粉红色令人叹为观止。
entries.example_en: The pinkness of the sunset was breathtaking.

entries.definition_en: a person with mildly leftist political views
entries.example_cn: 这位记者因对示威活动持同情态度而被指控为温和左派人士。
entries.example_en: The journalist was accused of being a pinko for his sympathetic coverage of the protest.

entries.definition_en: the finger farthest from the thumb
entries.example_cn: 她用小指握着笔。
entries.example_en: She held the pen with her pinky finger.

entries.definition_en: the outer, visible part of the ear
entries.example_cn: 事故发生后，外科医生修复了受损的耳廓。
entries.example_en: The surgeon repaired the damaged pinna after the accident.

entries.definition_en: a division of a leaf that is divided into many narrow parts
entries.example_cn: 这位植物学家检查了蕨类植物羽状复叶的小叶以鉴定其物种。
entries.example_en: The botanist examined the pinna of the fern to identify the species.

entries.definition_en: a small boat used to communicate between a ship and the shore
entries.example_cn: 船长派了一艘小艇去码头取补给。
entries.example_en: The captain sent a pinnace to fetch supplies from the dock.

entries.definition_en: the highest level or degree attainable
entries.example_cn: 赢得冠军是他职业生涯的顶峰。
entries.example_en: Winning the championship was the pinnacle of his career.

entries.definition_en: a slender upright spire at the top of a buttress or tower
entries.example_cn: 建筑师为塔楼设计了一个高高的尖顶。
entries.example_en: The architect designed a tall pinnacle for the tower.

entries.definition_en: a lofty peak
entries.example_cn: 登山者到达了山峰的顶峰。
entries.example_en: The climbers reached the pinnacle of the mountain.

entries.definition_en: to raise on or as if on a pinnacle
entries.example_cn: 这位英雄被推上了成功的顶峰。
entries.example_en: The hero was raised to the pinnacle of success.

entries.definition_en: to surmount with a pinnacle
entries.example_cn: 他们可能会在建筑物顶部加一个金色的尖顶。
entries.example_en: They may pinnacle the building with a golden spire.

entries.definition_en: having leaflets arranged on each side of a central axis like a feather
entries.example_cn: 这种蕨类植物的叶子呈羽状，茎的两侧长有小叶。
entries.example_en: The fern has pinnate leaves with small leaflets on either side of the stem.

entries.definition_en: in a manner having a pinnate shape (feather-like arrangement)
entries.example_cn: 这种树的叶子沿茎羽状排列。
entries.example_en: The leaves of the tree are arranged pinnately along the stem.

entries.definition_en: (of a leaf) cut deeply into broad sections that do not separate into distinct leaflets
entries.example_cn: 这种蕨类植物的叶子呈羽状深裂，切口很深。
entries.example_en: The fern has pinnatifid leaves with deep cuts.

entries.definition_en: a woman's cap featuring two long flaps that are pinned to the head
entries.example_cn: 这种别针帽是 20 世纪 20 年代流行的配饰。
entries.example_en: The vintage pinner was a popular accessory in the 1920s.

entries.definition_cn: （大学社交中）以赠送兄弟会徽章表示的恋爱承诺
entries.definition_en: a mutual promise between a couple not to date other people
entries.example_cn: 他把自己的兄弟会徽章送给她，表示两人将专一交往。
entries.example_en: He gave her his fraternity pin as a promise that they would date exclusively.

entries.definition_en: an aquatic carnivorous mammal having a streamlined body specialized for swimming with limbs modified as flippers
entries.example_cn: 海豹、海狮和海象都是鳍足类动物。
entries.example_en: Seals, sea lions, and walruses are all types of pinniped.

entries.definition_en: a division of a leaf that is divided into many parts
entries.example_cn: 蕨类植物的茎上有精致的羽片。
entries.example_en: The fern has delicate pinnules along its stem.

entries.definition_en: a sleeveless dress resembling an apron; worn over other clothing
entries.example_cn: 她在开始烤饼干之前穿上了她那件红色的围裙式连衣裙。
entries.example_en: She put on her red pinny before starting to bake the cookies.

entries.definition_en: a card game played with a deck of forty-eight cards
entries.example_cn: 全家人聚集在客厅玩皮诺克勒牌戏。
entries.example_en: The family gathered in the living room to play a game of pinochle.

entries.definition_en: the process by which cells engulf and take in droplets of fluid
entries.example_cn: 研究人员观察到胞饮作用正在发生，细胞正在从周围介质中吸收营养物质。
entries.example_en: Researchers observed pinocytosis occurring as the cells absorbed nutrients from the surrounding medium.

entries.definition_cn: 用烘烤玉米粒磨成的粗粉，常与糖、香料或香草混合
entries.definition_en: a coarse flour made from ground toasted maize kernels, often mixed with sugar, spices, or herbs
entries.example_cn: 传统早餐包括一碗甜玉米粉食品。
entries.example_en: The traditional breakfast included a bowl of sweet pinole.

entries.definition_cn: 皮农松；矮松（西美洲的一类松树）
entries.definition_en: a type of low-growing pine tree native to western North America
entries.example_cn: 山坡上点缀着一棵棵皮农松。
entries.example_en: The hillside was dotted with pinon trees.

entries.definition_en: to locate something exactly
entries.example_cn: GPS 系统帮助我们精确定位了迷路徒步者的确切位置。
entries.example_en: The GPS system helped us pinpoint the exact location of the lost hiker.

entries.definition_en: a very brief moment in time
entries.example_cn: 事故发生在绿灯亮起前的那一瞬间。
entries.example_en: The accident happened in a pinpoint of time before the light turned green.

entries.definition_en: a very small spot or area
entries.example_cn: 页面上有一个极小的墨点。
entries.example_en: A pinpoint of ink marked the page.

entries.definition_en: the sharp point of a pin
entries.example_cn: 他用针尖刺破了布料。
entries.example_en: He used the pinpoint of the needle to pierce the fabric.

entries.definition_en: a tiny hole made by a sharp point
entries.example_cn: 她发现手指上有一个被刺扎出的针孔。
entries.example_en: She noticed a pinprick on her finger from the thorn.

entries.definition_cn: 极小的点，尤指微小的光点
entries.definition_en: a very tiny dot, especially a small point of light
entries.example_cn: 远处的灯在雾中看起来像一个个微小的光点。
entries.example_en: The distant lamps looked like pinpricks of light in the fog.

entries.definition_en: a very small and annoying problem or difficulty
entries.example_cn: 这次旅行原本完美无缺，延误只是一个小麻烦。
entries.example_en: The delay was just a pinprick in an otherwise perfect trip.

entries.definition_cn: 宾莎犬；宾舍犬（一类犬的统称）
entries.definition_en: any of several breeds of dog, often including the Dobermann and miniature pinscher
entries.example_cn: 这只宾莎犬对着花园里的陌生人大声吠叫。
entries.example_en: The pinscher barked loudly at the stranger in the garden.

entries.definition_en: a suit made from a fabric with very thin stripes
entries.example_cn: 他在商务会议上穿了一件经典的细条纹西装。
entries.example_en: He wore a classic pinstripe to the business meeting.

entries.definition_en: a fabric with very thin stripes
entries.example_cn: 设计师为新款系列选择了深蓝色细条纹面料。
entries.example_en: The designer chose a navy blue pinstripe for the new collection.

entries.definition_en: a very thin stripe, especially a white one on a dark fabric
entries.example_cn: 这件衬衫带有微妙的细条纹图案。
entries.example_en: The shirt features a subtle pinstripe pattern.

entries.definition_en: covered with very thin, closely spaced stripes
entries.example_cn: 他穿了一套细条纹西装去参加商务会议。
entries.example_en: He wore a pinstriped suit to the business meeting.

entries.definition_en: a United States liquid unit equal to 16 fluid ounces
entries.example_cn: 他早餐喝了一品脱牛奶。
entries.example_en: He drank a pint of milk with his breakfast.

entries.definition_en: a British unit of liquid or dry measure equal to 568.26 cubic centimeters
entries.example_cn: 她在酒吧点了一品脱啤酒。
entries.example_en: She ordered a pint of beer at the pub.

entries.definition_en: a United States dry unit equal to 0.5 quart
entries.example_cn: 食谱需要一品脱干豆。
entries.example_en: The recipe calls for a pint of dried beans.

entries.definition_en: very short in height
entries.example_cn: 这位矮小的球员很容易被他的队友们盖过。
entries.example_en: The pint-size player was easily overshadowed by his teammates.

entries.definition_cn: 个头较小的；小巧的（非正式）
entries.definition_en: comparatively small in size (colloquial)
entries.example_cn: 这位个头很小的侦探尽管身材矮小，还是破了案。
entries.example_en: The pint-sized detective solved the case despite his small stature.

entries.definition_cn: 西大西洋热带水域的各种斑点鱼，尤指王鲭
entries.definition_en: any of various spotted fishes of tropical waters in the western Atlantic, especially the cero
entries.example_cn: 渔民在佛罗里达海岸附近捕获了一条斑点鱼。
entries.example_en: Fishermen caught a large pintado near the coast of Florida.

entries.definition_en: a type of duck with a long neck and long central tail feathers
entries.example_cn: 猎人们看到一群针尾鸭飞过沼泽。
entries.example_en: The hunters spotted a flock of pintails flying over the marsh.

entries.definition_en: a pin or bolt that acts as the pivot for a hinge
entries.example_cn: 旧门铰链坏了，所以木匠换掉了铰链销。
entries.example_en: The old door hinge was broken, so the carpenter replaced the pintle.

entries.definition_cn: 有白色及其他颜色斑块的马或小马
entries.definition_en: a horse or pony with patches of white and another color
entries.example_cn: 牛仔骑着心爱的花斑马穿越了尘土飞扬的平原。
entries.example_en: The cowboy rode his favorite pinto across the dusty plains.

entries.definition_cn: （动物毛色）有白色和另一种颜色斑块的；花斑的
entries.definition_en: having a coat with patches of white and another color; piebald or mottled
entries.example_cn: 那匹花斑马在一群纯色马中格外显眼。
entries.example_en: The pinto horse stood out among the solid-colored herd.

entries.definition_cn: 一种由彩色叶片固定在棍子上、遇风旋转的玩具
entries.definition_en: a toy with colored vanes pinned to a stick that spins in the wind
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在花园里玩那个风车玩具。
entries.example_en: Children played with the pinwheel in the garden.

entries.definition_cn: 一种旋转并发射彩色火焰的圆形烟花
entries.definition_en: a circular firework that spins while emitting colored flames
entries.example_cn: 这个烟花在夜空中绽放出绚丽的色彩。
entries.example_en: The pinwheel lit up the night sky with brilliant colors.

entries.definition_cn: 一种轮缘上装有大量垂直于轮面的销钉的轮子
entries.definition_en: a wheel with numerous pins set at right angles to its rim
entries.example_cn: 这个古老的轮子被用来驱动织布机的机械装置。
entries.example_en: The antique pinwheel was used to drive the loom's mechanism.

entries.definition_cn: 一种叶片呈轮状排列的多年生亚灌木
entries.definition_en: a perennial subshrub of Tenerife with leaves arranged in rosettes resembling pinwheels
entries.example_cn: 这种植物在特内里费岛的火山土壤中野生生长。
entries.example_en: The pinwheel grows wild in the volcanic soil of Tenerife.

entries.definition_en: a small, threadlike worm that lives in the human intestines and rectum, especially in children
entries.example_cn: 医生开了药来治疗蛲虫感染。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed medication to treat the pinworm infection.

entries.definition_en: a type of small, low-growing pine tree found in western North America
entries.example_cn: 鸟儿聚集在松果柏森林中吃坚果。
entries.example_en: Birds gather in the pinyon forest to eat the nuts.

entries.definition_en: an ax used by mountain climbers to cut footholds in ice
entries.example_cn: 攀登者在尝试攀登陡峭的冰壁之前调整了冰镐。
entries.example_en: The climber adjusted the piolet before attempting to scale the steep ice wall.

entries.definition_en: a meson involved in holding the nucleus together; produced as the result of high-energy particle collision
entries.example_cn: π介子在将原子核结合在一起的强核力中起着至关重要的作用。
entries.example_en: The pion plays a crucial role in the strong nuclear force that binds the nucleus.

entries.definition_en: someone who helps to open up a new line of research, technology, or art
entries.example_cn: 玛丽·居里是放射性研究的先驱。
entries.example_en: Marie Curie was a pioneer in the study of radioactivity.

entries.definition_en: one of the first colonists or settlers in a new territory
entries.example_cn: 拓荒者在冬天来临前建好了他们的木屋。
entries.example_en: The pioneers built their cabins before the winter arrived.

entries.definition_en: to open up an area or prepare a way
entries.example_cn: 他们开辟了一条穿过森林的新路线。
entries.example_en: They pioneered a new route through the forest.

entries.definition_en: to take the lead or initiative in developing something
entries.example_cn: 该公司带头开发太阳能。
entries.example_en: The company pioneered the use of solar energy.

entries.definition_en: to open up and explore a new area
entries.example_cn: 科学家们正在开拓并探索海底的新方法。
entries.example_en: Scientists are pioneering new methods to explore the ocean floor.

entries.definition_en: showing great respect and devotion to God or a religious belief
entries.example_cn: 她是一个非常虔诚的女人，每周日都去教堂。
entries.example_en: She is a very pious woman who attends church every Sunday.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows great religious devotion and respect
entries.example_cn: 她虔诚地遵循所有传统仪式。
entries.example_en: She piously followed all the traditional rituals.

entries.definition_en: the quality or state of being pious; piety
entries.example_cn: 她的虔诚体现在她每天的祈祷和慈善行为中。
entries.example_en: Her piousness was evident in her daily prayers and charitable acts.

entries.definition_en: a small hard seed found in some fruits
entries.example_cn: 她在吃苹果前把籽去掉了。
entries.example_en: She removed the pip from the apple before eating it.

entries.definition_cn: 骰子或扑克牌上的点数标记（形状取决于花色）
entries.definition_en: a mark on a die or on a playing card (shape depending on the suit)
entries.example_cn: 他在骰子上掷出了一个点数。
entries.example_en: He rolled a pip on the die.

entries.definition_cn: 用于显示反射面位置的雷达回波
entries.definition_en: a radar echo displayed so as to show the position of a reflecting surface
entries.example_cn: 飞行员在雷达屏幕上看到一个回波，显示有一架飞机正在接近。
entries.example_en: The pilot saw a pip on the radar screen indicating an incoming aircraft.

entries.definition_en: a disease of poultry
entries.example_cn: 农民给鸡治疗严重的禽类疾病。
entries.example_en: The farmer treated the chickens for a severe pip.

entries.definition_en: a minor nonspecific ailment
entries.example_cn: 他有点小毛病，需要休息。
entries.example_en: He has a slight pip and needs some rest.

entries.definition_en: to defeat by a narrow margin
entries.example_cn: 我们的队以一分之差险胜对手。
entries.example_en: Our team pipped the opponents by a single point.

usage.label: transitive
usage.pattern: The sourced narrow-victory verb is transitive.

entries.definition_en: to hit with a gunshot
entries.example_cn: 猎人躲在隐蔽处，成功射中了三只鸭子。
entries.example_en: The hunter managed to pip three ducks from his blind.

entries.definition_en: to kill by firing a missile
entries.example_cn: 敌机被地对空导弹击落了。
entries.example_en: The enemy plane was pip by a surface-to-air missile.

entries.definition_en: a person who is very small and unimportant
entries.example_cn: 这位新实习生被高级经理们视为微不足道的人。
entries.example_en: The new intern was treated like a pip-squeak by the senior managers.

usage.label: 非正式、贬义
usage.pattern: The source marks pip-squeak as informal and derogatory.

entries.definition_en: a large, long-lived fig tree native to India, considered sacred by Buddhists and distinct from the banyan tree
entries.example_cn: 寺庙庭院里那棵古老的菩提树已经屹立了几个世纪。
entries.example_en: The ancient pipal tree in the temple courtyard has stood for centuries.

entries.definition_en: a long tube made of metal or plastic used to transport liquids or gases
entries.example_cn: 水通过管道流进每一户人家。
entries.example_en: Water flows through the pipes to every house.

entries.definition_en: a tube with a small bowl at one end, used for smoking tobacco
entries.example_cn: 他从烟斗里吸了一口。
entries.example_en: He took a puff from his pipe.

entries.definition_cn: （管乐器或管风琴的）音管；管乐器
entries.definition_en: a tube used to produce sound, especially in a wind instrument or organ
entries.example_cn: 管风琴中的每根音管都会发出不同的音符。
entries.example_en: Each pipe in the organ produces a different note.

entries.definition_en: to transport something through a pipeline
entries.example_cn: 石油从油田输送到炼油厂。
entries.example_en: Oil is piped from the field to the refinery.

entries.definition_en: to make a shrill or high-pitched cry
entries.example_cn: 那只鸟在清晨高声啼叫。
entries.example_en: The bird piped loudly in the morning.

entries.definition_en: to play music on a pipe instrument
entries.example_cn: 音乐家吹奏了一支欢快的曲子。
entries.example_en: The musician piped a cheerful tune on the flute.

entries.definition_en: to trim or decorate with a strip of contrasting material
entries.example_cn: 这条裙子镶了金线边。
entries.example_en: The dress was piped with gold thread.

entries.definition_cn: （古）人的声音，尤指尖细的声音
entries.definition_en: an archaic term for a person's voice, especially a high-pitched one
entries.example_cn: 在那首古诗中，她尖细的嗓音盖过了人群的喧闹声。
entries.example_en: In the old poem, her small pipe rang out above the crowd.

entries.definition_cn: 用于制作烟斗、陶器和皮革漂白的细白粘土
entries.definition_en: fine white clay used in making tobacco pipes and pottery and in whitening leather
entries.example_cn: 工匠为新一批烟斗精选了最优质的白粘土。
entries.example_en: The artisan selected the finest pipeclay for the new batch of pipes.

entries.definition_en: a small fish with a long tubular snout and a slim body covered in bony plates
entries.example_cn: 海龙在海藻间优雅地游动。
entries.example_en: The pipefish swims gracefully among the seaweed.

entries.definition_cn: 管道安装和管件装配工作
entries.definition_en: the work of installing and assembling pipes and pipe fittings
entries.example_cn: 管道装配需要仔细测量并确保连接牢固。
entries.example_en: Pipefitting requires careful measurement and secure connections.

entries.definition_en: a piece of pipe with threads used to join other pipes together
entries.example_cn: 水管工更换了旧的管接头以修复泄漏。
entries.example_en: The plumber replaced the old pipefitting to fix the leak.

entries.definition_cn: （信息、货物或工作等的）传递渠道；流程
entries.definition_en: a system or process through which information, goods, or work passes
entries.example_cn: 这项提案仍在筹备中。
entries.example_en: The proposal is still in the pipeline.

entries.definition_en: a pipe used to transport liquids or gases
entries.example_cn: 石油通过一条横跨沙漠的长管道进行运输。
entries.example_en: Oil is transported through a long pipeline across the desert.

entries.definition_cn: （信息按顺序处理和传输的）通道
entries.definition_en: a channel through which information is processed and transmitted in sequence
entries.example_cn: 图形处理流水线分几个阶段渲染每一帧。
entries.example_en: The graphics pipeline renders each frame in several stages.

entries.definition_en: someone who plays the bagpipe
entries.example_cn: 婚礼上，风笛手演奏了一首传统的苏格兰乐曲。
entries.example_en: The piper played a traditional Scottish tune at the wedding.

entries.definition_en: a synthetic penicillin antibiotic used to treat moderate to severe infections
entries.example_cn: 医生给患者开了哌拉西林，以治疗其严重的细菌感染。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed piperacillin to treat the patient's severe bacterial infection.

entries.definition_en: a vermifuge used to treat infestations by roundworms or pinworms
entries.example_cn: 医生开了驱肠虫药来清除肠道蛔虫感染。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed piperazine to clear the intestinal roundworm infestation.

entries.definition_en: the chemical compound derived from pepper that is responsible for its hot and spicy taste.
entries.example_cn: 胡椒碱是赋予黑胡椒独特辣味的活性成分。
entries.example_en: Piperine is the active ingredient that gives black pepper its characteristic heat.

entries.definition_en: a graduated glass tube used to measure or transfer precise volumes of liquid
entries.example_cn: 科学家使用移液管精确地转移了 5 毫升溶液。
entries.example_en: The scientist used a pipet to transfer exactly 5 milliliters of the solution.

entries.definition_en: a small glass tube with a narrow tip, used to measure or transfer precise amounts of liquid.
entries.example_cn: 科学家使用移液管精确地转移了 1 毫升溶液。
entries.example_en: The scientist used a pipette to transfer exactly one milliliter of the solution.

entries.definition_en: the pipes and stops of a pipe organ
entries.example_cn: 风琴师调整了管风琴的管道以发出更深的音调。
entries.example_en: The organist adjusted the pipework to produce a deeper tone.

entries.definition_en: a system of pipes used to carry water, oil, gas, or other fluids
entries.example_cn: 新安装的管道用于向大楼供水。
entries.example_en: The new piping was installed to supply water to the building.

entries.definition_en: a thin strip of covered cord used to edge hems
entries.example_cn: 她在裙子的下摆加了一条红色的饰边。
entries.example_en: She added a red piping to the hem of her dress.

entries.definition_en: playing a pipe or the bagpipes
entries.example_cn: 传统音乐中充满了欢快的管乐演奏。
entries.example_en: The traditional music featured lively piping.

entries.definition_en: extremely; intensely (used especially in piping hot)
entries.example_cn: 今天的太阳热得惊人。
entries.example_en: The sun was piping hot today.

entries.definition_en: a bat of the genus Pipistrellus
entries.example_cn: 这只Pipistrellus属的蝙蝠在月光下的花园里无声地飞翔。
entries.example_en: The pipistrelle flew silently across the moonlit garden.

entries.definition_en: a small songbird with streaky brown feathers that lives on the ground in open areas
entries.example_cn: 我们在田野边缘发现了一只鹨在跳跃。
entries.example_en: We spotted a pipit hopping along the edge of the field.

entries.definition_en: a sharp, spicy, or tart flavor in food
entries.example_cn: 厨师加了一点醋来增强酱汁的辛辣味。
entries.example_en: The chef added a dash of vinegar to enhance the piquancy of the sauce.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being interesting or mentally stimulating
entries.example_cn: 这部小说的刺激性让读者一直读到深夜。
entries.example_en: The novel's piquancy kept the readers turning the pages late into the night.

entries.definition_en: having a sharp, spicy, or stimulating taste that is pleasant
entries.example_cn: 这种酱汁味道辛辣，完美地衬托了鱼肉。
entries.example_en: The sauce had a piquant flavor that perfectly complemented the fish.

entries.definition_en: interesting or exciting in a way that provokes curiosity or interest
entries.example_cn: 这部侦探小说引人入胜，让读者直到最后都在猜测结局。
entries.example_en: The detective novel was piquant and kept the readers guessing until the end.

entries.definition_en: attractive or delightful in a way that stimulates the senses
entries.example_cn: 花朵迷人的香气充满了整个花园。
entries.example_en: The piquant aroma of the flowers filled the entire garden.

entries.definition_cn: 激起（兴趣、好奇心等）；激怒
entries.definition_en: to arouse, especially curiosity or interest, or to cause resentment in
entries.example_cn: 他粗鲁的评论激起了她的好奇心。
entries.example_en: His rude comment piqued her curiosity.

entries.definition_cn: 因自尊受损而产生的恼怒或怨愤
entries.definition_en: a feeling of irritation or resentment caused by wounded pride
entries.example_cn: 她的想法被拒绝时，突然感到一阵恼怒。
entries.example_en: She felt a sudden pique when her idea was rejected.

entries.definition_en: a fabric with a raised, textured pattern
entries.example_cn: 这条裙子是用奢华的珠地布制成的。
entries.example_en: The dress was made of a luxurious pique fabric.

entries.definition_en: a card game played by two people using a deck of 32 cards
entries.example_cn: 他们晚上在烛光下玩皮凯特牌。
entries.example_en: They spent the evening playing piquet by candlelight.

entries.definition_en: a historical military punishment where a soldier stood on one foot on a sharp stake
entries.example_cn: 这名士兵被判处罚站作为纪律处分。
entries.example_en: The soldier was sentenced to piquet as a form of discipline.

entries.definition_en: robbery at sea, or a similar unlawful seizure such as aircraft hijacking
entries.example_cn: 船长报告了在印度洋发生的海盗事件。
entries.example_en: The captain reported an incident of piracy in the Indian Ocean.

entries.definition_cn: 未经授权复制或传播受版权保护的商品或软件的行为
entries.definition_en: the unauthorized duplication or distribution of copyrighted goods or software
entries.example_cn: 软件盗版使开发者难以收回成本。
entries.example_en: Software piracy makes it difficult for developers to recover their costs.

entries.definition_cn: 南美洲的一种小型淡水鱼，据称会攻击并撕咬活体动物
entries.definition_en: a small freshwater fish of South America, reputed to attack and tear apart living animals
entries.example_cn: 游客被警告不要与食人鱼游泳，因为它们会攻击并破坏活体动物。
entries.example_en: Tourists are warned not to swim with piranhas because they attack and destroy living animals.

entries.definition_en: someone who attacks in search of booty
entries.example_cn: 这些海盗被指责像食人鱼一样，袭击村庄以搜刮战利品。
entries.example_en: The pirates were accused of acting like piranhas, attacking the village in search of booty.

entries.definition_cn: 非法复制或传播受版权保护作品的人

entries.example_cn: 他开始抱怨工作环境的困难。
entries.example_en: He began to plain about the difficult conditions at work.

entries.definition_en: a basic knitting stitch made by inserting the needle through the front of the stitch
entries.example_cn: 她用平针编织毛衣的前片。
entries.example_en: She used plain stitch to knit the front of her sweater.

entries.definition_en: pure and not mixed with other things
entries.example_cn: 黄金是一种纯金属，不像合金那样。
entries.example_en: Gold is a plain metal, unlike alloys.

entries.definition_en: (of cloth) made in plain weave
entries.example_cn: 这件衬衫是由平纹棉布制成的。
entries.example_en: The shirt is made of plain-woven cotton.

entries.definition_en: a type of religious singing used in the Roman Catholic Church that uses only one melody line without any instruments
entries.example_cn: 唱诗班在弥撒中表演了一首优美的圣咏。
entries.example_en: The choir performed a beautiful plainchant during the mass.

entries.definition_en: in a way that cannot be mistaken or misunderstood
entries.example_cn: 他显然在撒谎。
entries.example_en: It was plainly obvious that he was lying.

entries.definition_en: in a simple way without unnecessary decoration or complexity
entries.example_cn: 她为葬礼穿着朴素。
entries.example_en: She dressed plainly for the funeral.

entries.definition_en: the appearance of being plain and unpretentious
entries.example_cn: 她欣赏小屋的朴素，觉得那里温暖而舒适。
entries.example_en: She appreciated the plainness of the cottage, which felt warm and welcoming.

entries.definition_en: clarity as a consequence of being perspicuous
entries.example_cn: 他解释的清晰易懂帮助每个人理解了复杂的理论。
entries.example_en: The plainness of his explanation helped everyone understand the complex theory.

entries.definition_en: an appearance that is not attractive or beautiful
entries.example_cn: 那座旧楼不吸引人的外观被后面的新花园遮住了。
entries.example_en: The plainness of the old building was hidden by the new garden behind it.

entries.definition_en: the state of being unmixed with other material
entries.example_cn: 白色大理石的纯净状态让这座雕像看起来优雅。
entries.example_en: The plainness of the white marble made the statue look elegant.

entries.definition_en: a male inhabitant of a plains region, especially the Great Plains of North America
entries.example_cn: 作为一名平原居民，他懂得如何在广阔的草原上生存并度过严冬。
entries.example_en: As a plainsman, he knew how to navigate the vast grasslands and survive the harsh winters.

entries.definition_cn: 基督教礼仪中的无伴奏单声部圣咏
entries.definition_en: a Christian liturgical chant consisting of a single, unaccompanied melodic line
entries.example_cn: 在晨祷期间，唱诗班在没有乐器伴奏的情况下演唱了一首传统的圣咏。
entries.example_en: During the morning service, the choir sang a traditional plainsong without any instrumental accompaniment.

entries.definition_en: using simple and direct language
entries.example_cn: 他直白地叙述了事件经过。
entries.example_en: He gave a plainspoken account of the events.

entries.definition_en: characterized by directness in manner or speech; without subtlety or evasion
entries.example_cn: 她直率地表示不喜欢这项政策。
entries.example_en: She was plainspoken about her dislike of the policy.

entries.definition_en: a formal written document submitted to a court stating the reasons for a complaint
entries.example_cn: 律师就公司违约一事对公司提起了诉状。
entries.example_en: The lawyer filed a plaint against the company for breach of contract.

entries.definition_en: a loud cry expressing deep sorrow or grief
entries.example_cn: 看着老房子被烧毁，她发出了一声悲叹。
entries.example_en: She let out a plaint as she watched the old house burn down.

entries.definition_en: a person who starts a legal case in a court
entries.example_cn: 原告辩称该合同不公平。
entries.example_en: The plaintiff argued that the contract was unfair.

entries.definition_en: expressing sorrow or sadness in a mournful way
entries.example_cn: 鸟儿在日落时唱起了悲戚的歌。
entries.example_en: The bird sang a plaintive song as the sun set.

entries.definition_en: in a sad and complaining way
entries.example_cn: 那只鸟在暮色中哀怨地歌唱。
entries.example_en: The bird sang plaintively in the twilight.

entries.definition_en: a hairstyle made by braiding or twisting strands of hair together
entries.example_cn: 她把头发编成一条粗辫子垂在背后。
entries.example_en: She wore her hair in a thick plait down her back.

entries.definition_en: a fold in fabric created by doubling it back and pressing or stitching it into shape
entries.example_cn: 设计师用一道锐利的折痕来强调裙子的腰线。
entries.example_en: The designer used a sharp plait to accentuate the waistline of the dress.

entries.definition_en: to make something by braiding or interlacing strands
entries.example_cn: 孩子们花了一下午时间编草帽。
entries.example_en: The children spent the afternoon plaiting straw hats.

entries.definition_en: to weave strands together to form plaits
entries.example_cn: 篮匠将柳条紧密地编织成辫状。
entries.example_en: The basket maker plaited the willow branches tightly.

entries.definition_en: a series of steps to be carried out or goals to be accomplished
entries.example_cn: 我们需要一个详细的新项目计划。
entries.example_en: We need a detailed plan for the new project.

entries.definition_en: an arrangement scheme
entries.example_cn: 婚礼的座位安排非常复杂。
entries.example_en: The seating plan for the wedding was very complicated.

entries.definition_en: scale drawing of a structure
entries.example_cn: 建筑师向我们展示了这栋房子的平面图。
entries.example_en: The architect showed us the floor plan of the house.

entries.definition_en: have the will and intention to carry out some action
entries.example_cn: 我打算这个周末去看望我的祖父母。
entries.example_en: I plan to visit my grandparents this weekend.

entries.definition_en: make plans for something
entries.example_cn: 他们正在为她的生日策划一个惊喜派对。
entries.example_en: They are planning a surprise party for her birthday.

entries.definition_en: make or work out a plan for; devise
entries.example_cn: 科学家们正在制定一项新实验来测试该理论。
entries.example_en: Scientists are planning a new experiment to test the theory.

entries.definition_en: a subscription to a service
entries.example_cn: 我订购了一个新的手机套餐。
entries.example_en: I signed up for a new mobile phone plan.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to a plane; flat or two-dimensional
entries.example_cn: 该软件允许用户在二维设计中操作平面物体。
entries.example_en: The software allows users to manipulate planar objects in a 2D design.

entries.definition_en: a flatworm of the order Tricladida, living in marine, freshwater, or terrestrial environments
entries.example_cn: 科学家经常利用涡虫进行组织再生的实验研究。
entries.example_en: Scientists often use planarians in experiments to study tissue regeneration.

entries.definition_en: free-swimming mostly freshwater flatworms that are popular in laboratory studies for their ability to regenerate lost parts
entries.example_cn: 研究人员经常利用涡虫来研究再生过程。
entries.example_en: Researchers often use planarium to study the process of regeneration.

entries.definition_en: erosion that produces a level surface
entries.example_cn: 夷平作用逐渐形成了广阔的平坦地表。
entries.example_en: Planation gradually created a broad, level surface.

entries.definition_cn: 发育或进化过程中三维结构向二维结构的形态转变
entries.definition_en: The morphological transformation of a three-dimensional structure into a two-dimensional one during development or evolution.
entries.example_cn: 该结构在进化发育过程中发生了形态平面化。
entries.example_en: The planation of the structure occurred during its evolutionary development.

entries.definition_en: a flat metal disk prepared for stamping into a coin
entries.example_cn: 造币厂工人在将铸币坯放入压印机之前进行了检查。
entries.example_en: The mint worker inspected the planchet before placing it on the press.

entries.definition_en: a small triangular board on wheels used in spiritualism to write messages
entries.example_cn: 灵媒使用灵板与亡灵沟通。
entries.example_en: The medium used a planchette to communicate with the spirit.

entries.definition_en: an aircraft with fixed wings powered by engines
entries.example_cn: 我们明天将乘飞机去纽约。
entries.example_en: We will take the plane to New York tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: an unbounded two-dimensional shape in mathematics
entries.example_cn: 三角形是存在于平面上的形状。
entries.example_en: A triangle is a shape that exists on a plane.

entries.definition_en: a power tool for smoothing wood
entries.example_cn: 他为工作室买了一个新的电动刨子。
entries.example_en: He bought a new electric plane for his workshop.

entries.definition_en: having a flat surface without slope
entries.example_cn: 这条路平坦得无可挑剔，开车很容易。
entries.example_en: The road was perfectly plane and easy to drive on.

entries.definition_en: to make even or smooth using a plane
entries.example_cn: 木匠把桌子刨光直到表面光滑。
entries.example_en: The carpenter planed the table until it was smooth.

entries.definition_en: to travel on the surface of water
entries.example_cn: 那艘船以高速在水面上滑行。
entries.example_en: The boat planed across the lake at high speed.

entries.definition_en: a level of existence or development
entries.example_cn: 公司已经达到了一个新的成功阶段。
entries.example_en: The company has reached a new plane of success.

entries.definition_en: to cut or remove material with a plane
entries.example_cn: 他用手工刨子将木头的边缘刨平。
entries.example_en: He used a hand plane to smooth the edge of the wood.

entries.definition_en: a power tool used to smooth or shape wood
entries.example_cn: 木匠用刨子刨平了木板的粗糙边缘。
entries.example_en: The carpenter used a planer to smooth the rough edges of the board.

entries.definition_cn: 龙门刨床：使工件在切削刀具下往复移动以加工出精确平面的大型机床
entries.definition_en: a large machine tool that moves a workpiece back and forth beneath a cutting tool to create accurate flat surfaces
entries.example_cn: 金属工人用龙门刨床把这块大型钢板加工成了完全平整的表面。
entries.example_en: The metalworker used a planer to produce a perfectly flat surface on the large steel plate.

entries.definition_cn: （天文学）围绕太阳运行并反射阳光的大型天体
entries.definition_en: a large celestial body that orbits the sun and shines by reflected light
entries.example_cn: 地球是已知唯一支持生命的行星。
entries.example_en: Earth is the only planet known to support life.

entries.definition_en: any celestial body that orbits a star, excluding comets and satellites
entries.example_cn: 天文学家正在搜寻遥远恒星周围的新行星。
entries.example_en: Astronomers are searching for new planets around distant stars.

entries.definition_en: a person who is devoted to serving another person
entries.example_cn: 国王有一群忠诚的侍从。
entries.example_en: The king had a large retinue of loyal planets.

entries.definition_cn: 一座装有将行星位置投射到穹顶天花板上的仪器的建筑
entries.definition_en: a building housing an instrument for projecting the positions of the planets onto a domed ceiling
entries.example_cn: 孩子们喜欢参观天文馆看星星。
entries.example_en: The children loved visiting the planetarium to see the stars.

entries.definition_cn: 一种将天体和其他天文现象图像投射到半球形穹顶内表面的光学装置
entries.definition_en: an optical device for projecting images of celestial bodies and other astronomical phenomena onto the inner surface of a hemispherical dome
entries.example_cn: 天文馆使用复杂精密的投影仪来模拟夜空。
entries.example_en: The planetarium uses a sophisticated projector to simulate the night sky.

entries.definition_cn: 用于展示太阳系的装置或模型
entries.definition_en: an apparatus or model representing the solar system
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展出了一台太阳系仪，一种用于展示太阳系的装置。
entries.example_en: The museum displayed an orrery, an apparatus representing the solar system.

entries.definition_en: relating to the physical or orbital characteristics of a planet
entries.example_cn: 行星系统由恒星及其绕其运行的物体组成。
entries.example_en: The planetary system consists of a star and the objects that orbit it.

entries.definition_en: relating to the planet Earth or its inhabitants
entries.example_cn: 地球的健康取决于地球上所有生物的福祉。
entries.example_en: Planetary health depends on the well-being of all living things on Earth.

entries.definition_en: involving the entire earth; not limited to a small area
entries.example_cn: 这场全球危机需要每个国家的合作。
entries.example_en: The planetary crisis requires cooperation from every nation.

entries.definition_cn: 本轮运动的；具有本轮运动的
entries.definition_en: relating to or having an epicyclic motion
entries.example_cn: 这套行星齿轮系统采用本轮运动。
entries.example_en: The planetary gear system uses epicyclic motion.

entries.definition_en: a small solid astronomical body that can orbit a star and contribute to forming a protoplanet
entries.example_cn: 天文学家认为，星子相互碰撞形成了行星。
entries.example_en: Astronomers believe that planetesimals collided to form the planets.

entries.definition_en: a small celestial body that orbits the sun, such as an asteroid or dwarf planet
entries.example_cn: 天文学家研究行星状天体以了解太阳系的形成。
entries.example_en: Astronomers study planetoids to learn more about the formation of the solar system.

entries.definition_en: having a loud, mournful, and resonant sound
entries.example_cn: 教堂洪亮而哀伤的钟声在山谷中回荡。
entries.example_en: The plangent sound of the church bell echoed through the valley.

entries.definition_en: a long, thick piece of wood used for building or flooring
entries.example_cn: 他们用木板搭建了一座桥。
entries.example_en: They built a bridge using wooden planks.

entries.definition_cn: 在规定时间内保持俯卧撑姿势的一种锻炼
entries.definition_en: an exercise in which one holds a push-up position for a measured length of time
entries.example_cn: 她保持平板支撑姿势两分钟。
entries.example_en: She held a plank for two minutes.

entries.definition_en: a specific policy or idea in a political party's plan
entries.example_cn: 环境保护是他们政纲的关键条款。
entries.example_en: Environmental protection is a key plank of their platform.

entries.definition_en: to cover a surface with planks
entries.example_cn: 工人们将在聚会前用木板铺地板。
entries.example_en: The workers will plank the floor before the party.

entries.definition_en: to set something down heavily with a loud noise
entries.example_cn: 他把书重重地摔在桌子上。
entries.example_en: He planked the book down on the table.

entries.definition_en: to cook food on a wooden plank
entries.example_cn: 厨师决定用木板烤三文鱼作为晚餐。
entries.example_en: The chef decided to plank the salmon for dinner.

entries.definition_cn: 木板铺面或木板覆盖层（尤指船上的）
entries.definition_en: a floor or other covering made of planks, especially on a ship
entries.example_cn: 船员们花了一上午时间修理甲板上腐烂的木板铺面。
entries.example_en: The crew spent the morning repairing the rotting planking on the deck.

entries.definition_en: the act of covering a surface with planks
entries.example_cn: 这个修复工程包括对旧码头进行大量的铺木板工作。
entries.example_en: The restoration project involved extensive planking of the old pier.

entries.definition_en: a collection or quantity of planks
entries.example_cn: 造船厂订购了一批木板，用于新船体的建造。
entries.example_en: The shipyard ordered a large shipment of planking for the new vessel's hull.

entries.definition_cn: （俚语）趴在不寻常的公共场所并拍照的行为
entries.definition_en: (slang) the practice of lying face down in unusual public places and taking photographs
entries.example_cn: 趴伏自拍一度成为网络热潮，人们会在不寻常的地方拍下自己趴着的照片。
entries.example_en: Planking became an online fad in which people photographed themselves lying face down in unusual places.

entries.definition_en: tiny plants and animals that drift in water
entries.example_cn: 浮游生物构成了海洋食物链的基础。
entries.example_en: Plankton forms the base of the ocean food chain.

entries.definition_en: relating to or consisting of plankton
entries.example_cn: 浮游生物构成了海洋食物链的基础。
entries.example_en: The planktonic organisms form the base of the ocean food web.

entries.definition_en: designed or carried out according to a plan
entries.example_cn: 这个项目是由团队精心计划的。
entries.example_en: The project was carefully planned by the team.

entries.definition_cn: 处于计划阶段但尚未实施的
entries.definition_en: at the planning stage and not yet implemented or started
entries.example_cn: 计划中的扩建尚未开始。
entries.example_en: The planned expansion has not yet begun.

entries.definition_en: a person who makes plans
entries.example_cn: 活动策划者安排了会议的日程。
entries.example_en: The event planner organized the conference schedule.

entries.definition_en: a notebook for recording appointments and things to be done
entries.example_cn: 她把每天的约会都记在记事本里。
entries.example_en: She kept her daily appointments in her planner.

entries.definition_en: the act of making a program for a specific course of action
entries.example_cn: 新学校项目的计划工作始于上个月。
entries.example_en: The planning for the new school project began last month.

entries.definition_en: the process of drawing up plans or layouts for a project
entries.example_cn: 城市规划涉及为城市和城镇创建布局。
entries.example_en: Urban planning involves creating layouts for cities and towns.

entries.definition_cn: 思考某事发生时会如何应对
entries.definition_en: the process of thinking about what you will do if something happens
entries.example_cn: 她花了一整晚来规划最坏的情况。
entries.example_en: She spent the evening planning for the worst-case scenario.

entries.definition_cn: 植物；尤指能进行光合作用、通常固定生长的生物
entries.definition_en: a living organism, especially one capable of photosynthesis, that usually grows in a fixed place
entries.example_cn: 植物需要阳光和水才能生存。
entries.example_en: Plants need sunlight and water to survive.

entries.definition_en: a large building where industrial work is done
entries.example_cn: 这家汽车工厂雇佣了五千多名工人。
entries.example_en: The car plant employs over five thousand workers.

entries.definition_cn: 托儿；被安排在观众中的人
entries.definition_en: a person planted in an audience to appear to be a genuine spectator
entries.example_cn: 喜剧演员注意到那个群众演员在笑他的笑话。
entries.example_en: The comedian noticed the plant laughing at his joke.

entries.definition_en: to put seeds or seedlings into the ground to grow
entries.example_cn: 我们去年春天在花园里种了西红柿。
entries.example_en: We planted tomatoes in the garden last spring.

entries.definition_en: to fix something securely in a specific place
entries.example_cn: 他们把旗帜牢牢地插在地上。
entries.example_en: They planted the flag firmly in the ground.

entries.definition_en: to prepare the way for something to happen
entries.example_cn: 这项新政策将为未来的增长奠定基础。
entries.example_en: The new policy will plant the seeds for future growth.

entries.definition_en: something hidden to be discovered later
entries.example_cn: 警方怀疑人群中有暗桩。
entries.example_en: The police suspected there was a plant in the crowd.

entries.definition_en: to place fish into a river
entries.example_cn: 环保人员将幼鱼放入河中。
entries.example_en: The conservationists planted young fish in the river.

entries.definition_en: feeding on plants
entries.example_cn: 长颈鹿是食植物的动物，它们大部分时间都在吃树叶。
entries.example_en: Giraffes are plant-eating animals that spend most of their day browsing on leaves.

entries.definition_en: a banana tree bearing hanging clusters of edible angular greenish starchy fruits; tropics and subtropics
entries.example_cn: 他们在花园里的树上收获了成熟的芭蕉。
entries.example_en: They harvested the ripe plantains from the tree in the garden.

entries.definition_en: starchy banana-like fruit; eaten (always cooked) as a staple vegetable throughout the tropics
entries.example_cn: 当地人将大蕉煮熟作为晚餐的配菜。
entries.example_en: The locals boiled the plantains as a side dish for dinner.

entries.definition_en: any of numerous plants of the genus Plantago; mostly small roadside or dooryard weeds with elliptic leaves and small spikes of very small flowers; seeds of some used medicinally
entries.example_cn: 园丁拔掉了篱笆旁生长的车前草。
entries.example_en: The gardener pulled up the plantain growing by the fence.

entries.definition_en: relating to the sole of the foot
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了患者足底表面。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the plantar surface of the patient's foot.

entries.definition_en: a large estate where cash crops are grown, especially in tropical areas
entries.example_cn: 这个种植园生产糖和棉花用于出口。
entries.example_en: The plantation produced sugar and cotton for export.

entries.definition_en: a newly established colony, especially in North America
entries.example_cn: 早期的定居者在新领土上建立了一个殖民地。
entries.example_en: The early settlers founded a plantation in the new territory.

entries.definition_en: a small cultivated wood without undergrowth
entries.example_cn: 他们花一下午时间在河边的宁静小树林里散步。
entries.example_en: They spent the afternoon walking through the quiet plantation near the river.

entries.definition_en: a decorative pot for house plants
entries.example_cn: 她为心爱的兰花买了一个新的陶瓷花盆。
entries.example_en: She bought a new ceramic planter for her favorite orchid.

entries.definition_cn: 用于播种或移栽幼苗的机器
entries.definition_en: a machine used for planting seeds or young plants
entries.example_cn: 农民用机械播种机把种子播成整齐的直行。
entries.example_en: The farmer used a mechanical planter to sow the seeds in straight rows.

entries.definition_en: the owner or manager of a plantation
entries.example_cn: 这位种植园主决定扩大他的棉花田。
entries.example_en: The planter decided to expand his cotton fields.

entries.definition_en: a worker who puts or sets seeds or seedlings into the ground
entries.example_cn: 这位播种工小心翼翼地把每颗种子放进土壤里。
entries.example_en: The planter carefully placed each seed in the soil.

entries.definition_cn: 蜡蝉总科的多种吸食植物汁液的昆虫，常似叶片且善跳跃
entries.definition_en: any of various sap-feeding insects of the superfamily Fulgoroidea, often resembling leaves and capable of leaping
entries.example_cn: 飞虱吸食植物汁液，受到惊扰时能迅速跳跃。
entries.example_en: Planthoppers feed on plant sap and can leap rapidly when disturbed.

entries.definition_en: (of mammals) walking on the whole sole of the foot
entries.example_cn: 人类和兔子都是跖行的哺乳动物。
entries.example_en: Humans and rabbits are both plantigrade mammals.

entries.definition_en: an animal that walks with the entire sole of the foot touching the ground
entries.example_cn: 熊是跖行走动物，而猫则用脚趾行走。
entries.example_en: Bears are plantigrades, unlike cats which walk on their toes.

entries.definition_en: putting seeds or young plants in the ground to grow
entries.example_cn: 春天是在花园里种植蔬菜的最佳时节。
entries.example_en: Spring is the best time for planting vegetables in the garden.

entries.definition_cn: 种植的树木或其他植物的群体或区域；种植区；种植园
entries.definition_en: a group or area of trees or other plants that has been planted; a plantation
entries.example_cn: 庄园后面的老种植区被保留下来，作为野生动物栖息地。
entries.example_en: The old planting behind the manor has been preserved as a wildlife habitat.

entries.definition_en: the act of fixing something firmly in place
entries.example_cn: 插旗仪式庄严肃穆。
entries.example_en: The planting of the flag was a solemn ceremony.

entries.definition_en: an expert in the identification and cultivation of plants, such as fruits, flowers, or vegetables
entries.example_cn: 作为一名敬业的园艺专家，他每天花数小时照料他珍稀的兰花。
entries.example_en: As a dedicated plantsman, he spent hours every day tending to his rare orchids.

entries.definition_en: a flat plate, usually of metal or stone, bearing an inscription or commemorating a person or event
entries.example_cn: 墙上有一块纪念英雄的牌匾。
entries.example_en: There is a plaque on the wall honoring the hero.

entries.definition_en: an abnormal patch or deposit of tissue or material in or on the body
entries.example_cn: 医生在他的皮肤上发现了一个斑块。
entries.example_en: The doctor found a plaque on his skin.

usage.label: pathology
usage.pattern: abnormal patch or deposit in or on the body; sources w10414r5–r9

entries.definition_cn: 将液体泼洒在或撞向某物
entries.definition_en: to dash a liquid upon or against
entries.example_cn: 他不小心将牛奶泼洒在了桌子上。
entries.example_en: He plashed the milk onto the table by accident.

entries.definition_en: to interlace the shoots of
entries.example_cn: 园丁必须将葡萄藤的嫩枝交错在一起以支撑它们的生长。
entries.example_en: The gardener had to plash the shoots of the grapevines together to support their growth.

entries.definition_en: the sound like water splashing
entries.example_cn: 我们听到了雨水打在积水坑里发出的水花声。
entries.example_en: We heard the plash of water as the rain hit the puddles.

entries.definition_cn: 血液和淋巴中悬浮血细胞的无色液体
entries.definition_en: the colorless fluid in blood and lymph that suspends blood cells
entries.example_cn: 血浆将营养物质和废物输送到全身。
entries.example_en: Plasm carries nutrients and waste products throughout the body.

entries.definition_cn: 生殖细胞的原生质，尤指含有遗传物质的部分
entries.definition_en: the protoplasm of a germ cell, especially the part containing hereditary material
entries.example_cn: 卵细胞中的生殖质携带遗传物质。
entries.example_en: The germ plasm carries hereditary material in the egg cell.

entries.definition_en: the colorless watery fluid of the blood and lymph that contains no cells, but in which the blood cells are suspended
entries.example_cn: 医生经常检测血浆以排查疾病。
entries.example_en: Doctors often test the plasma for diseases.

entries.definition_en: a fourth state of matter distinct from solid or liquid or gas and present in stars and fusion reactors
entries.example_cn: 科学家在聚变反应堆中研究等离子体以产生能量。
entries.example_en: Scientists study plasma in fusion reactors to generate energy.

entries.definition_en: a green slightly translucent variety of chalcedony used as a gemstone
entries.example_cn: 这条项链镶嵌着一颗美丽的血玉髓宝石。
entries.example_en: The necklace featured a beautiful plasma gemstone.

entries.definition_cn: 浆细胞的恶性肿瘤，通常发生于骨髓
entries.definition_en: a malignant tumor of plasma cells, usually in the bone marrow
entries.example_cn: 医生诊断出患者脊柱患有浆细胞瘤。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed a plasmacytoma in the patient's spine.

entries.definition_cn: 血浆分离术：分离全血中的血浆，并将其余血液成分回输给供者或患者
entries.definition_en: a procedure in which whole blood is removed, plasma is separated from it, and the remaining blood components are returned to the donor or patient
entries.example_cn: 病人接受了血浆置换以从血液中去除有害抗体。
entries.example_en: The patient underwent plasmapheresis to remove harmful antibodies from their blood.

entries.definition_cn: 细胞内一种独立于染色体之外、能自主复制的小型环状DNA分子
entries.definition_en: a small ring of DNA in a cell that is separate from the chromosome and can replicate independently
entries.example_cn: 科学家发现了一种能帮助细菌抵抗抗生素的新质粒。
entries.example_en: Scientists discovered a new plasmid that helps bacteria resist antibiotics.

entries.definition_en: an enzyme that dissolves the fibrin of blood clots
entries.example_cn: 纤溶酶在分解血凝块中起着至关重要的作用。
entries.example_en: Plasmin plays a crucial role in breaking down blood clots.

entries.definition_en: the inactive precursor of plasmin, found in blood plasma and converted into plasmin during fibrinolysis
entries.example_cn: 血栓分解过程中，纤溶酶原会转化为纤溶酶。
entries.example_en: Plasminogen is converted into plasmin during the breakdown of blood clots.

entries.definition_en: a parasitic protozoan that causes malaria in humans.
entries.example_cn: 疟原虫感染红细胞并通过蚊子叮咬传播。
entries.example_en: The plasmodium infects red blood cells and spreads through mosquito bites.

entries.definition_en: a multinucleate mass of cytoplasm found in certain organisms like slime molds.
entries.example_cn: 在显微镜下，黏菌看起来像一个原质团。
entries.example_en: Under the microscope, the slime mold appeared as a single plasmodium.

entries.definition_en: a mixture of lime or gypsum with sand and water that hardens into a smooth solid, used to cover walls and ceilings
entries.example_cn: 工人们给天花板涂了一层新的灰泥。
entries.example_en: The workers applied a fresh layer of plaster to the ceiling.

entries.definition_en: a white powder made of calcium sulphate that forms a paste with water and hardens, used for making molds, sculptures, or casts for broken limbs
entries.example_cn: 医生给他的断臂打了石膏绷带。
entries.example_en: The doctor ordered a plaster cast for his broken arm.

entries.definition_en: to apply a heavy coat of plaster to a surface
entries.example_cn: 他们花了一整天给房子的外墙抹灰泥。
entries.example_en: They spent the whole day plastering the exterior walls of the house.

entries.definition_en: to cover something conspicuously or thickly, as if by pasting something on it
entries.example_cn: 墙上贴满了五颜六色的节日海报。
entries.example_en: The walls were plastered with colorful posters for the festival.

entries.definition_en: to apply a plaster cast to a broken limb
entries.example_cn: 护士在事故后仔细地为病人的腿打了石膏。
entries.example_en: The nurse carefully plastered the patient's leg after the accident.

entries.definition_en: to affix something conspicuously to a surface
entries.example_cn: 抗议者把他们的标语贴在了城市里所有可用的表面上。
entries.example_en: The protesters plastered their slogans on every available surface in the city.

entries.definition_en: a surface that has been covered with hardened plaster, such as a wall or ceiling
entries.example_cn: 房间光滑的抹灰面反射着美丽的光线。
entries.example_en: The smooth plaster of the room reflected the light beautifully.

entries.definition_en: a medical dressing made of a soft heated mass of meal or clay spread on cloth and applied to the skin to treat inflammation or improve circulation
entries.example_cn: 她在疼痛的肩膀上敷了一个热敷包来缓解疼痛。
entries.example_en: She used a hot plaster on her sore shoulder to relieve the pain.

entries.definition_en: a rigid building panel with a gypsum core bonded between layers of paper or fiberboard, used for interior walls
entries.example_cn: 工人们安装了新的石膏板来修补受损的墙壁。
entries.example_en: The workers installed new plasterboard to repair the damaged wall.

entries.definition_en: very drunk
entries.example_cn: 聚会后他醉得不省人事。
entries.example_en: He was plastered after the party.

entries.definition_en: (of walls) covered with a coat of plaster
entries.example_cn: 那所老房子的墙壁刚刚抹了灰泥。
entries.example_en: The old house had walls that were freshly plastered.

entries.definition_cn: （头发）涂了定型剂变得光滑的
entries.definition_en: (of hair) made smooth by applying a sticky or glossy substance
entries.example_cn: 她用发胶把头发向后梳得光溜溜的。
entries.example_en: She had her hair plastered back with gel.

entries.definition_en: a worker who applies plaster to walls or ceilings
entries.example_cn: 抹灰工在刷漆前将墙壁抹平。
entries.example_en: The plasterer smoothed the wall before painting it.

entries.definition_en: the application of plaster to a surface
entries.example_cn: 墙壁的抹灰工作需要两天才能完成。
entries.example_en: The plastering of the walls will take two days to complete.

entries.definition_cn: 灰泥工程；石膏装饰工程
entries.definition_en: architectural work made with plaster
entries.example_cn: 修复团队花了几个月时间修复受损的灰泥饰面。
entries.example_en: The restoration team spent months repairing the damaged plasterwork.

entries.definition_en: a synthetic material that can be molded into various shapes.
entries.example_cn: 塑料被用来制作许多日常用品，如瓶子和袋子。
entries.example_en: Plastic is used to make many everyday objects like bottles and bags.

entries.definition_en: a card used to pay for goods or services electronically.
entries.example_cn: 我用我的信用卡付了午餐费。
entries.example_en: I paid for my lunch with my plastic.

entries.definition_en: able to be shaped or molded, especially when soft.
entries.example_cn: 粘土很软且可塑，所以我能轻易地把它塑造成形。
entries.example_en: The clay was soft and plastic, so I could mold it easily.

entries.definition_en: able to be influenced or changed.
entries.example_cn: 孩子们是可塑的，他们的环境可以塑造他们。
entries.example_en: Children are plastic and can be shaped by their environment.

entries.definition_en: forming or capable of being formed into a specific shape.
entries.example_cn: 艺术家利用可塑性材料创作了一座雕塑。
entries.example_en: The artist worked with plastic materials to create a sculpture.

entries.definition_cn: 以可塑的方式；通过塑性变形
entries.definition_en: in a way that allows shaping or deformation, especially through moulding
entries.example_cn: 黏土经过塑性变形，被塑造成各种形状。
entries.example_en: The clay was molded plastically into various shapes.

entries.definition_en: the ability of a material to be shaped or molded without breaking
entries.example_cn: 黏土的可塑性使艺术家能够创作出复杂的雕塑。
entries.example_en: The plasticity of the clay allowed the artist to create intricate sculptures.

entries.definition_cn: 加入塑料或其他材料以增加柔韧性的物质
entries.definition_en: a substance added to plastics or other materials to make them more flexible
entries.example_cn: 增塑剂使乙烯基地板变得柔软且柔韧。
entries.example_en: The plasticizer makes the vinyl flooring soft and pliable.

entries.definition_cn: 植物和藻类细胞中的一种细胞器，通常参与光合作用
entries.definition_en: an organelle found in plant and algal cells, often involved in photosynthesis
entries.example_cn: 叶绿体是植物细胞中发现的一种质体。
entries.example_en: Chloroplasts are a type of plastid found in plant cells.

entries.definition_en: a process involving fixation and dehydration and forced impregnation and hardening of biological tissues; water and lipids are replaced by curable polymers (silicone or epoxy or polyester) that are subsequently hardened
entries.example_cn: 博物馆利用塑化技术保存人体以供解剖学研究。
entries.example_en: The museum uses plastination to preserve human bodies for anatomical study.

entries.definition_en: (dated) a plastic explosive
entries.example_cn: 安全部队使用塑性炸药摧毁了堵塞道路的车辆。
entries.example_en: Security forces used plastique to destroy the vehicle blocking the road.

usage.label: dated
usage.pattern: Used for plastic explosive; source w36934r1.

entries.definition_cn: 女式紧身胸衣或衬衫的前襟
entries.definition_en: the ornamental front of a woman's bodice or shirt
entries.example_cn: 这件复古连衣裙的前襟饰有精致的蕾丝，在光线下闪闪发光。
entries.example_en: The vintage dress featured a delicate lace plastron that caught the light.

entries.definition_en: the front of man's dress shirt
entries.example_cn: 面试前，他整理了一下正装衬衫僵硬的前襟。
entries.example_en: He adjusted the stiff plastron of his formal shirt before the interview.

entries.definition_cn: 击剑运动员佩戴的护胸垫
entries.definition_en: a large pad worn by a fencer to protect the chest
entries.example_cn: 击剑运动员在踏上赛道前将护胸垫系紧。
entries.example_en: The fencer secured the plastron tightly before stepping onto the piste.

entries.definition_cn: 穿在锁子甲下的金属胸甲
entries.definition_en: a metal breastplate that was worn under a coat of mail
entries.example_cn: 骑士的胸甲由硬化钢制成，以保护他的重要器官。
entries.example_en: The knight's plastron was made of hardened steel to protect his vital organs.

entries.definition_en: (zoology) the part of a turtle's shell forming its underside
entries.example_cn: 龟的腹甲保护着身体的下侧。
entries.example_en: The turtle's plastron protects the underside of its body.

entries.definition_en: a map showing the layout of streets and building lots
entries.example_cn: 开发商购买土地以创建该住宅区的新区块图。
entries.example_en: The developer bought the land to create a new plat for the subdivision.

entries.definition_en: to draw a map of an area showing streets and lots
entries.example_cn: 测量员下周将绘制新社区的地图。
entries.example_en: The surveyor will plat the new neighborhood next week.

entries.definition_en: a dish used for serving or eating food
entries.example_cn: 请把盘子递过来。
entries.example_en: Please pass the plates.

entries.definition_en: a flat piece of metal, wood, glass, or plastic
entries.example_cn: 他把木头切成薄片。
entries.example_en: He cut the wood into thin plates.

entries.definition_en: a rubber base in baseball where the batter stands
entries.example_cn: 跑垒员触碰本垒板得分。
entries.example_en: The runner touched the plate to score.

entries.definition_en: a large section of the Earth's outer shell
entries.example_cn: 构造板块移动得非常缓慢。
entries.example_en: The tectonic plates move very slowly.

entries.definition_en: the amount of food on a plate
entries.example_cn: 他点了两份意大利面。
entries.example_en: He ordered two plates of pasta.

entries.definition_en: to cover something with a layer of metal
entries.example_cn: 银杯镀了金。
entries.example_en: The silver cup was plated with gold.

entries.definition_en: a full-page picture in a magazine or newspaper
entries.example_cn: 这本杂志刊登了一幅展示该艺术家最新作品的整版插图。
entries.example_en: The magazine included a full-page plate showing the artist's latest work.

entries.definition_en: the lower part of the front section of an animal
entries.example_cn: 屠夫切下了牛的前胸下部。
entries.example_en: The butcher cut the plate off the cow.

entries.definition_en: a high area of land that is flat on top
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行者爬上高原，享受凉爽的空气。
entries.example_en: The hikers climbed up to the plateau to enjoy the cool air.

entries.definition_en: the quantity contained in a plate
entries.example_cn: 他在吃甜点之前吃了三盘蔬菜。
entries.example_en: He ate three platefuls of vegetables before dessert.

entries.definition_en: a tiny cell fragment in vertebrate blood that is essential for clotting
entries.example_cn: 血小板在血管受损止血过程中起着至关重要的作用。
entries.example_en: Platelets play a crucial role in stopping bleeding when a blood vessel is damaged.

entries.definition_cn: 扫描仪或复印机中放置待扫描或复印物品的平面玻璃板
entries.definition_en: The flat glass surface of a scanner or photocopier on which items are placed for scanning or copying.
entries.example_cn: 将文件正面朝下放在扫描仪的玻璃板上。
entries.example_en: Place the document face down on the scanner's platen.

entries.definition_en: the roller on a typewriter against which the keys strike
entries.example_cn: 这台打字机的击字辊在多年高强度使用后已经磨损。
entries.example_en: The typewriter's platen was worn down after years of heavy use.

entries.definition_en: the flat plate in a printing press that presses paper against the type
entries.example_cn: 操作员检查了印刷机压印板，以确保油墨转移均匀。
entries.example_en: The operator checked the platen to make sure the ink transferred evenly.

entries.definition_en: the work table of a machine tool
entries.example_cn: 机械师调整了机床工作台，以确保金属部件被牢固夹持。
entries.example_en: The machinist adjusted the platen to ensure the metal piece was held securely.

entries.definition_en: a skilled worker who coats objects with a thin layer of metal, such as silver or gold
entries.example_cn: 这家古董店聘请了一位技艺娴熟的镀金匠来修复银器。
entries.example_en: The antique shop hired a skilled plater to restore the silverware.

entries.definition_en: a raised horizontal surface
entries.example_cn: 工人们站在木制平台上修理屋顶。
entries.example_en: The workers stood on a wooden platform to repair the roof.

entries.definition_en: the combination of a particular computer and a particular operating system
entries.example_cn: 该软件专为在 Windows 平台上运行而设计。
entries.example_en: This software is designed to run on the Windows platform.

entries.definition_en: a document stating the aims and principles of a political party
entries.example_cn: 新的政纲承诺降低税收和改善教育。
entries.example_en: The new platform promises lower taxes and better education.

entries.definition_en: a long, flat raised structure of a railway station, where people get on and off of trains
entries.example_cn: 请在站台等待火车到达。
entries.example_en: Please wait on the platform until the train arrives.

entries.definition_en: a woman's shoe with a very high thick sole
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一双厚底高跟鞋来搭配她的夏装。
entries.example_en: She wore a platform shoe to match her summer dress.

entries.definition_en: any military structure or vehicle bearing weapons
entries.example_cn: 航空母舰是战斗机的移动平台。
entries.example_en: The aircraft carrier serves as a mobile platform for fighter jets.

entries.definition_en: the process of covering a surface with a thin layer of metal
entries.example_cn: 电镀常用于装饰珠宝。
entries.example_en: Gold plating is often used to decorate jewelry.

entries.definition_en: a thin layer of metal covering a surface
entries.example_cn: 杯子上的银镀层已经开始磨损。
entries.example_en: The silver plating on the cup has started to wear off.

entries.definition_cn: 食物上桌前的摆放和装饰过程
entries.definition_en: the arrangement and presentation of food ready to be served
entries.example_cn: 厨师十分注重每道菜的摆盘。
entries.example_en: The chef paid careful attention to the plating of each dish.

entries.definition_cn: 由金属板构成的覆盖层或防护装甲
entries.definition_en: a coating or defensive armor made of metal plates
entries.example_cn: 车辆后部的装甲板经过加固，以保护发动机。
entries.example_en: The vehicle’s rear plating was reinforced to protect the engine.

entries.definition_en: a heavy, grey-white precious metallic element that resists corrosion; it occurs in some nickel and copper ores and is also found native in some deposits
entries.example_cn: 这枚戒指是由纯铂制成的。
entries.example_en: The ring was made of pure platinum.

entries.definition_cn: 销量达到白金认证标准的；在某些认证体系中，单曲销量超过一百万张或专辑销量超过两百万张
entries.definition_en: having sold enough copies to qualify for platinum certification; in some certification systems, over one million copies for a single or over two million for an album
entries.example_cn: 这位歌手的最新专辑在一个月内就达到了白金销量。
entries.example_en: The singer's latest album went platinum within a month.

entries.definition_cn: 在电子游戏中获得或解锁全部成就
entries.definition_en: to earn or unlock every achievement in a video game
entries.example_cn: 她完成所有挑战后，获得了这款游戏的全部成就。
entries.example_en: She platinumed the game after completing every challenge.

entries.definition_en: a remark that is trite, obvious, and lacking in originality
entries.example_cn: 他的演讲充满了无法激励听众的陈词滥调。
entries.example_en: His speech was full of platitudes that failed to inspire the audience.

entries.definition_cn: 陈词滥调的；自命重要或新颖却乏味的
entries.definition_en: dull and boring but pretending to be important or original
entries.example_cn: 他陈词滥调式的演讲未能激励听众。
entries.example_en: His platitudinous speech failed to inspire the audience.

entries.definition_en: a military unit that is a subdivision of a company; usually has a headquarters and two or more squads; usually commanded by a lieutenant
entries.example_cn: 士兵们以排的队形穿过田野。
entries.example_en: The soldiers marched in a platoon formation across the field.

entries.definition_cn: 一组从事共同活动的人
entries.definition_en: a group of persons who are engaged in a common activity
entries.example_cn: 研究小组工作到深夜以完成项目。
entries.example_en: The research platoon worked late into the night to finish the project.

entries.definition_en: a team of policemen working under the military platoon system
entries.example_cn: 抗议期间，一支警察排被派去控制该区域。
entries.example_en: A police platoon was deployed to secure the area during the protest.

entries.definition_en: a large shallow dish used for serving food
entries.example_cn: 她把沙拉放在桌子中央的大盘子里。
entries.example_en: She served the salad on a large platter in the center of the table.

entries.definition_en: a sound recording consisting of a disk with a continuous groove
entries.example_cn: 他把一张旧黑胶唱片放在唱机上听爵士乐。
entries.example_en: He put an old platter on the turntable to listen to jazz music.

entries.definition_cn: 月光鱼（Xiphophorus属的一种小型热带观赏鱼）
entries.definition_en: a small tropical fish of the genus Xiphophorus, popular in aquariums
entries.example_cn: 她在新的水族箱里加了几条月光鱼。
entries.example_en: She added a few platies to her new aquarium.

entries.definition_en: a small, densely furred, aquatic monotreme from Australia and Tasmania with a broad bill, tail, and webbed feet
entries.example_cn: 鸭嘴兽是一种仅分布于澳大利亚和塔斯马尼亚的独特哺乳动物。
entries.example_en: The platypus is a unique mammal found only in Australia and Tasmania.

entries.definition_en: either of two broad muscles located on either side of the neck that move the mouth and jaw
entries.example_cn: 颈阔肌有助于将嘴角向下拉。
entries.example_en: The platysma muscle helps to pull the corners of the mouth downward.

entries.definition_en: enthusiastic approval or praise
entries.example_cn: 这位演员赢得了观众的起立鼓掌和许多喝彩。
entries.example_en: The actor received a standing ovation and many plaudits from the audience.

entries.definition_cn: 看似合理或可信的性质；似真性
entries.definition_en: the quality of seeming reasonable or probable
entries.example_cn: 该理论的看似合理性取决于进一步的证据。
entries.example_en: The plausibility of the theory depends on further evidence.

entries.definition_en: appearing reasonable and credible, so that it seems convincing
entries.example_cn: 他为缺席会议提供了一个看似合理的解释。
entries.example_en: He offered a plausible explanation for his absence from the meeting.

entries.definition_cn: （历史用法或少用，指人）惯于提出貌似合理但实为诡辩论点的
entries.definition_en: of a person, given to presenting specious arguments; historical or rare
entries.example_cn: 在较早的用法中，plausible可形容惯于提出似是而非论点的说话者。
entries.example_en: In its older use, plausible described a speaker who presented specious arguments.

entries.definition_en: in a way that is easy to believe based on the evidence available
entries.example_cn: 他令人信服地论证了新政策将促进经济增长。
entries.example_en: He plausibly argued that the new policy would boost the economy.

entries.definition_en: participate in games or sport
entries.example_cn: 孩子们喜欢在公园里玩耍。
entries.example_en: The children like to play in the park.

entries.definition_en: play on an instrument
entries.example_cn: 她会弹钢琴。
entries.example_en: She can play the piano.

entries.definition_en: play a role or part
entries.example_cn: 他在电影中扮演英雄。
entries.example_en: He plays the hero in the movie.

entries.definition_en: act or have an effect in a specified way or with a specific effect or outcome
entries.example_cn: 这种药将在你的康复中起作用。
entries.example_en: The medicine will play a role in your recovery.

entries.definition_en: a dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage
entries.example_cn: 昨晚我们去看了一场戏剧。
entries.example_en: We went to see a play last night.

entries.definition_en: a theatrical performance of a drama
entries.example_cn: 这场演出非常成功。
entries.example_en: The play was very successful.

entries.definition_cn: 团队运动中的预定战术配合
entries.definition_en: a planned sequence of action in a team sport
entries.example_cn: 教练在比赛中改变了战术。
entries.example_en: The coach changed the play during the game.

entries.definition_en: a deliberate coordinated movement requiring dexterity and skill
entries.example_cn: 那名球员做了一个精彩的动作。
entries.example_en: The player made a great play.

entries.definition_en: pretending or behaving insincerely to mislead others
entries.example_cn: 别装了，告诉我实话吧。
entries.example_en: Stop your play-acting and tell me the truth.

entries.definition_en: the performance of a play or plays; acting
entries.example_cn: 孩子们很喜欢学校演出中的演戏环节。
entries.example_en: The children enjoyed the play-acting in the school production.

entries.definition_en: acting in a pretend or insincere way
entries.example_cn: 他假装可怜以博取朋友的同情。
entries.example_en: He was play-acting to get sympathy from his friends.

entries.definition_cn: 舞台演员，尤指剧团演员
entries.definition_en: an actor who performs on stage, especially as part of an acting troupe
entries.example_cn: 这位舞台演员加入了一个巡回演出剧团。
entries.example_en: The play-actor joined a touring troupe.

entries.definition_en: a detailed description of sporting events as they occur
entries.example_cn: 广播中包含了比赛的实况转播。
entries.example_en: The radio broadcast included a play-by-play of the game.

entries.definition_en: describing a sports commentary that details every action as it happens
entries.example_cn: 我们听了足球比赛的实况转播解说。
entries.example_en: We listened to the play-by-play commentary of the football match.

entries.definition_en: capable of or suitable for being played or played on
entries.example_cn: 这款新游戏可以在手机和平板电脑上玩。
entries.example_en: This new game is playable on both mobile phones and tablets.

entries.definition_en: the performance of a part or role in a drama
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在学校节日的戏剧表演中玩得很开心。
entries.example_en: The children enjoyed the playacting during the school festival.

entries.definition_en: the act of reproducing recorded sound
entries.example_cn: 这场音乐会的录音回放清晰且响亮。
entries.example_en: The playback of the concert recording was clear and loud.

entries.definition_en: lip-syncing (nonstandard)
entries.example_cn: 这名歌手被指责在现场演出中对口型。
entries.example_en: The singer was accused of playback during the live performance.

entries.definition_en: a printed program listing the cast and acts of a theatrical performance
entries.example_cn: 她保留了上次演出的节目单作为纪念品。
entries.example_en: She kept the playbill from the last performance as a souvenir.

entries.definition_en: a notebook containing descriptions and diagrams of the plays that a team has practiced (especially an American football team)
entries.example_cn: 教练在赛前仔细研究了战术手册。
entries.example_en: The coach studied the playbook before the game.

entries.definition_en: a scheme or set of strategies for conducting a business campaign or a political campaign
entries.example_cn: 营销团队为选举制定了一套新的策略方案。
entries.example_en: The marketing team developed a new playbook for the election.

entries.definition_en: a book containing the scripts of one or more dramatic plays
entries.example_cn: 演员们从剧本集中背诵台词。
entries.example_en: The actors memorized their lines from the playbook.

entries.definition_en: a box used to store a child's toys and personal items, often found in boarding schools
entries.example_cn: 寄宿学校为每位学生提供了一个存放个人物品的玩具箱。
entries.example_en: The boarding school provided each student with a playbox for their belongings.

entries.definition_en: a man devoted to the pursuit of pleasure
entries.example_cn: 他被称为一位富有的花花公子。
entries.example_en: He was known as a wealthy playboy.

entries.definition_en: a time or occasion designated for play or diversion
entries.example_cn: 孩子们期待每周在公园的娱乐日。
entries.example_en: The children looked forward to their weekly playday at the park.

entries.definition_en: a person who participates in or is skilled at some game
entries.example_cn: 这名球员在最后一分钟进了球。
entries.example_en: The player scored a goal in the final minute.

entries.definition_en: someone who takes part in an activity
entries.example_cn: 每个参与者都必须遵守规则。
entries.example_en: Every player must follow the rules.

entries.definition_cn: 播放音频或视频媒体的软件应用程序；媒体播放器
entries.definition_en: a software application that plays audio or video media
entries.example_cn: 我安装了一个媒体播放器来观看这段视频。
entries.example_en: I installed a media player to watch the video.

entries.definition_en: someone who plays a musical instrument
entries.example_cn: 吉他手上周加入了乐队。
entries.example_en: The guitar player joined the band last week.

entries.definition_en: a theatrical performer
entries.example_cn: 她是一位著名的舞台演员。
entries.example_en: She is a famous stage player.

entries.definition_cn: 玩弄感情的人；花心的人
entries.definition_en: a person who pursues a number of different social and sexual partners simultaneously
entries.example_cn: 他是个同时和几个女人约会的花花公子。
entries.example_en: He is a player who dates several women at once.

entries.definition_cn: 爱玩的；顽皮的；诙谐的；不严肃的
entries.definition_en: fond of play; fun-loving, humorous, or not serious
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在花园里嬉戏玩闹。
entries.example_en: The children were being playful in the garden.

entries.definition_en: in a playful manner
entries.example_cn: 那只狗在花园里嬉戏地追逐自己的尾巴。
entries.example_en: The dog playfully chased its tail around the garden.

entries.definition_cn: 顽皮、轻松诙谐或爱玩乐的性质
entries.definition_en: the quality of being playful, lighthearted, or inclined to play
entries.example_cn: 他爱寻欢作乐，经常在压力大的会议中缓解气氛。
entries.example_en: His playfulness often lightened the mood during stressful meetings.

entries.definition_en: a festive and merry feeling
entries.example_cn: 装饰的喜庆欢乐气氛让派对感觉特别。
entries.example_en: The playfulness of the decorations made the party feel special.

entries.definition_en: activities that are enjoyable or amusing
entries.example_cn: 孩子们整个下午都在进行娱乐活动。
entries.example_en: The children spent the afternoon in playfulness.

entries.definition_en: an outdoor area designed for children to play
entries.example_cn: 孩子们下午在儿童游乐场玩耍。
entries.example_en: The children spent their afternoon playing in the playground.

entries.definition_cn: 供人或组织自由施展的场所或环境
entries.definition_en: a place or situation in which someone can act freely or develop an activity
entries.example_cn: 互联网成了广告商自由施展的舞台。
entries.example_en: The internet became a playground for advertisers.

entries.definition_en: a small model house that children can play inside
entries.example_cn: 孩子们整个下午都在玩具屋里玩耍。
entries.example_en: The children spent the afternoon in the playhouse.

entries.definition_en: the action of taking part in a game or sport or other recreation
entries.example_cn: 孩子们喜欢在公园里玩耍。
entries.example_en: The children love playing in the park.

entries.definition_en: the act of playing a musical instrument
entries.example_cn: 她擅长弹钢琴。
entries.example_en: She is good at playing the piano.

entries.definition_cn: 在戏剧或其他戏剧作品中扮演角色
entries.definition_en: the performance of a role in a play or other drama
entries.example_cn: 他因扮演哈姆雷特而闻名。
entries.example_en: He is famous for his playing of Hamlet.

entries.definition_en: a short play
entries.example_cn: 剧团为孩子们表演了一个幽默的短剧。
entries.example_en: The theater group performed a humorous playlet for the children.

entries.definition_en: a list of songs arranged for playing or broadcasting
entries.example_cn: 我创建了一个包含所有我最喜欢的夏季热门歌曲的新播放列表。
entries.example_en: I created a new playlist with all my favorite summer hits.

entries.definition_en: a player in a team sport who leads attacks or maneuvers so that a teammate can score
entries.example_cn: 这位组织进攻的球员将球传给了队友，打进了制胜一球。
entries.example_en: The playmaker passed the ball to his teammate for the winning goal.

entries.definition_en: a person with whom one plays
entries.example_cn: 她昨天在公园找到了一个新玩伴。
entries.example_en: She found a new playmate at the park yesterday.

entries.definition_en: a final competition to decide a championship
entries.example_cn: 该队获得了资格参加附加赛，以决定联赛冠军。
entries.example_en: The team qualified for the playoff to determine the league champion.

entries.definition_en: a portable enclosure for babies to play in
entries.example_cn: 宝宝在婴儿围栏里度过了下午。
entries.example_en: The baby spent the afternoon in the playpen.

entries.definition_en: a recreation room for noisy activities such as parties or children's play
entries.example_cn: 孩子们下午在游戏室里用积木搭城堡。
entries.example_en: The children spent the afternoon in the playroom building castles with blocks.

entries.definition_cn: 为幼儿提供半日课程的小型非正式学前班
entries.definition_en: a small, informal group for young children that meets for half-day sessions
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在开始正规上学前，每周参加两次学前班。
entries.example_en: The children attend a playschool twice a week before starting formal school.

entries.definition_cn: 连体服，尤指幼儿或女性穿的短裤式连体衣
entries.definition_en: a one-piece garment, usually with shorts, worn especially by young children or women
entries.example_cn: 孩子们穿上亮黄色的连体衣后去操场。
entries.example_en: The children put on their bright yellow playsuits before going to the playground.

entries.definition_en: an object designed to be played with
entries.example_cn: 孩子把那个破了的玩具掉在了地板上。
entries.example_en: The child dropped the broken plaything on the floor.

entries.definition_cn: 受无法控制的力量摆布的人
entries.definition_en: a person controlled or manipulated by forces beyond their control
entries.example_cn: 她夹在敌对派系之间，成了政治势力摆布的对象。
entries.example_en: Caught between the rival factions, she became a mere plaything of political forces.

entries.definition_en: time for play or diversion
entries.example_cn: 孩子们很期待开始玩耍时间。
entries.example_en: The children were excited for playtime to begin.

entries.definition_en: a person who writes plays for the stage
entries.example_cn: 莎士比亚被认为是历史上最伟大的剧作家之一。
entries.example_en: Shakespeare is considered one of the greatest playwrights in history.

entries.definition_en: a public square with room for pedestrians
entries.example_cn: 人们聚集在广场上观看街头艺人表演。
entries.example_en: People gather in the plaza to watch the street performers.

entries.definition_en: a large shopping complex with restaurants and parking
entries.example_cn: 我们花了一下午在新购物中心购物。
entries.example_en: We spent the afternoon shopping at the new plaza.

entries.definition_en: a humble request for help from someone in authority
entries.example_cn: 他向法官恳求宽恕。
entries.example_en: He made a plea for mercy to the judge.

entries.definition_en: a defendant's answer by a factual matter in law
entries.example_cn: 律师提交了无罪答辩。
entries.example_en: The lawyer filed a plea of not guilty.

entries.definition_en: an answer indicating why a suit should be dismissed
entries.example_cn: 法官接受了驳回该案件的请求。
entries.example_en: The judge accepted the plea to dismiss the case.

entries.definition_en: to agree to plead guilty in exchange for a lesser charge
entries.example_cn: 被告决定认罪求轻判，以避免被判终身监禁。
entries.example_en: The defendant decided to plea-bargain to avoid a life sentence.

usage.label: US
usage.pattern: Plea bargaining terminology is marked US in source w13128r0.

entries.definition_en: to ask someone very strongly to do something or to feel something
entries.example_cn: 她恳求他停车。
entries.example_en: She pleaded with him to stop the car.

usage.label: plead with someone to do something
usage.pattern: plead with someone not to leave

entries.definition_en: to give a reason or excuse for something
entries.example_cn: 他以生病为借口不来上班。
entries.example_en: He pleaded illness as an excuse for not coming to work.

entries.definition_cn: （在法庭上）正式答辩，承认有罪或不认罪
entries.definition_en: to officially state whether you are guilty or not guilty in a court of law
entries.example_cn: 被告对指控认罪。
entries.example_en: The defendant pleaded guilty to the charges.

entries.definition_cn: 在法庭上陈述案情；为某人辩护
entries.definition_en: to present arguments in a legal case
entries.example_cn: 律师将代表客户进行答辩。
entries.example_en: The lawyer will plead the case on behalf of the client.

entries.definition_en: a person who pleads with someone or begs for something
entries.example_cn: 这位绝望的哀求者恳求当局饶过她的儿子。
entries.example_en: The desperate pleader begged the authorities to spare her son.

entries.definition_en: a lawyer who pleads cases in court
entries.example_cn: 这位熟练的律师在法官面前激情地陈词。
