entries.example_en: In some regions, qat is chewed for its stimulating effects.

entries.definition_en: the vital life energy believed to flow through all things in Chinese philosophy and medicine
entries.example_cn: 中医旨在平衡体内的气以促进健康。
entries.example_en: Traditional Chinese medicine aims to balance the qi in the body for good health.

entries.definition_cn: 穆斯林礼拜时面向麦加克尔白的方向
entries.definition_en: the direction Muslims face when praying
entries.example_cn: 穆斯林开始每日礼拜前会面向麦加克尔白的方向。
entries.example_en: Muslims turn to the qibla before starting their daily prayers.

entries.definition_en: a person who pretends to be a doctor but has no medical training
entries.example_cn: 病人向一个卖昂贵药水的江湖郎中求医。
entries.example_en: The patient sought advice from a quack who sold expensive potions.

usage.label: derogatory
usage.pattern: 指冒充医生或不合格的医生

entries.definition_en: the harsh sound made by a duck
entries.example_cn: 我们从池塘里听到了鸭子的叫声。
entries.example_en: We heard the quack of a duck from the pond.

entries.definition_en: to make the harsh sound that a duck makes
entries.example_cn: 那只鸭子大声嘎嘎叫以警告其他鸟类。
entries.example_en: The duck quacked loudly to warn the other birds.

entries.definition_en: to act as a fake doctor or charlatan
entries.example_cn: 他因冒充医生行骗并售卖虚假疗法而被捕。
entries.example_en: He was arrested for quacking and selling fake cures.

entries.definition_en: not qualified to give medical advice
entries.example_cn: 你不应该相信无行医资格医生的建议。
entries.example_en: You should not trust advice from a quack doctor.

entries.definition_en: medical practices that are not based on scientific evidence
entries.example_cn: 政府禁止销售用于江湖医术的药物。
entries.example_en: The government banned the sale of medicines used in quackery.

entries.definition_en: an instance of fraudulent medical practice
entries.example_cn: 观众对那个假医生的欺诈性行医感到厌恶。
entries.example_en: The audience was disgusted by the fake doctor's quackery.

entries.definition_en: a rectangular area surrounded on all sides by buildings
entries.example_cn: 学生们经常在庭院里学习或休息。
entries.example_en: Students often gather in the quad to study or relax.

entries.definition_en: one of four children born at the same time from the same pregnancy
entries.example_cn: 这个家庭有四胞胎，他们看起来非常相似。
entries.example_en: The family has a quad, and they all look very similar.

entries.definition_en: a large muscle in the thigh that extends the leg
entries.example_cn: 这位运动员努力强化他的股四头肌以备战比赛。
entries.example_en: The athlete worked hard to strengthen his quads for the race.

entries.definition_cn: 空铅（铅字排版中用于留空的无字铅块）
entries.definition_en: a block of type without a raised letter, used for spacing
entries.example_cn: 打印机使用空格块来分隔这两个段落。
entries.example_en: The printer used a quad to separate the two paragraphs.

entries.definition_cn: 被建筑物环绕的矩形区域
entries.definition_en: a rectangular area surrounded on all sides by buildings
entries.example_cn: 这座矩形庭院四面被图书馆、教学楼和宿舍环绕。
entries.example_en: The rectangular quadrangle was surrounded on all sides by the library, lecture halls, and dormitories.

entries.definition_en: a polygon with four sides
entries.example_cn: 这位建筑师设计了一座带有中央庭院的建筑。
entries.example_en: The architect designed a building with a central quadrangle.

entries.definition_en: having the shape of a quadrangle
entries.example_cn: 这座建筑有一个被四个翼楼环绕的四边形庭院。
entries.example_en: The building has a quadrangular courtyard surrounded by four wings.

entries.definition_cn: 平面上两条垂直线交叉形成的四个区域之一
entries.definition_en: one of the four sections created when two perpendicular lines cross on a flat surface
entries.example_cn: 坐标轴将图表分成了四个象限。
entries.example_en: The graph is divided into four quadrants by the x and y axes.

entries.definition_cn: 等于圆周四分之一的弧（四分之一圆弧）
entries.definition_en: an arc equal to one quarter of a circle's circumference
entries.example_cn: 突出显示的弧线是圆周的四分之一。
entries.example_en: The highlighted arc is a quadrant of the circle's circumference.

entries.definition_cn: 由两条成直角的半径在圆内围成的区域
entries.definition_en: the area inside a circle bounded by two radii that meet at a right angle
entries.example_cn: 饼图中的这一扇形代表了总数据的一个象限。
entries.example_en: The sector of the pie chart represents a quadrant of the total data.

entries.definition_cn: 用于测量天体高度的仪器
entries.definition_en: an instrument used to measure the altitude of celestial bodies
entries.example_cn: 天文学家调整了象限仪以追踪月亮的位置。
entries.example_en: The astronomer adjusted the quadrant to track the moon's position.

entries.definition_en: relating to a sound system that uses four separate channels
entries.example_cn: 这张四声道唱片提供了沉浸式的听觉体验。
entries.example_en: The quadraphonic record provided an immersive listening experience.

entries.definition_cn: 四边等长且四角为直角的；正方形的
entries.definition_en: having four equal sides and four right angles; square
entries.example_cn: 这个窗户是四方的。
entries.example_en: The window is quadrate in shape.

entries.definition_en: a flat object with four equal sides and four right angles
entries.example_cn: 她在纸上画了一个正方形。
entries.example_en: She drew a quadrate on the paper.

entries.definition_en: the quadrate bone
entries.example_cn: 解剖学家辨认出了头骨中的方骨。
entries.example_en: The anatomist identified the quadrate in the skull.

entries.definition_cn: 涉及数量或程度的二次幂且无更高幂次的
entries.definition_en: involving the second and no higher power of a quantity or degree
entries.example_cn: 二次项主导了系统在原点附近的行为。
entries.example_en: The quadratic term dominates the behavior of the system near the origin.

entries.definition_cn: 未知量最高次幂为平方的方程
entries.definition_en: an equation in which the highest power of an unknown quantity is a square
entries.example_cn: 这名学生在考试中难以解出这个方程。
entries.example_en: The student struggled to solve the quadratic during the exam.

entries.definition_en: a polynomial of the second degree
entries.example_cn: 他们在代数课上研究了二次多项式的性质。
entries.example_en: They studied the properties of the quadratic in their algebra class.

entries.definition_en: the construction of a square having the same area as some other figure
entries.example_cn: 古希腊数学家寻求化圆为方问题的解法。
entries.example_en: Ancient Greek mathematicians sought a solution to the problem of quadrature.

entries.definition_en: a curve or surface whose equation in Cartesian coordinates is of the second degree
entries.example_cn: 在高等微积分中，学生经常研究二次曲面的性质。
entries.example_en: In advanced calculus, students often study the properties of a quadric.

entries.definition_en: a large muscle in the front of the thigh that straightens the leg
entries.example_cn: 运动员在赛跑前拉伸股四头肌以防止受伤。
entries.example_en: The athlete stretched his quadriceps before the race to prevent injury.

entries.definition_en: a polygon with four sides
entries.example_cn: 正方形是一种四边形。
entries.example_en: A square is a type of quadrilateral.

entries.definition_en: having four sides
entries.example_cn: 这块四边的田地被分成了四块。
entries.example_en: The quadrilateral field was divided into four plots.

entries.definition_cn: 起源于18世纪中期、由四对舞者组成方阵的舞蹈
entries.definition_en: a dance originating in the mid-1700s in which four couples form a square
entries.example_cn: 他们在舞会上学习了四对舞的舞步。
entries.example_en: They learned the steps of the quadrille at the ball.

entries.definition_en: music for dancing the quadrille
entries.example_cn: 管弦乐队演奏了一首欢快的四对舞舞曲。
entries.example_en: The orchestra played a lively quadrille.

entries.definition_en: a number equal to one followed by 15 zeros
entries.example_cn: 人口在3000年达到了千万亿。
entries.example_en: The population reached a quadrillion by the year 3000.

entries.definition_cn: （英式旧用法）一亿亿亿（1后跟24个零）
entries.definition_en: a number equal to one followed by 24 zeros, formerly used in British English
entries.example_cn: 在旧英式计数法中，债务估计为一亿亿亿美元。
entries.example_en: In the old British system, the debt was estimated at a quadrillion dollars.

entries.definition_en: involving four parties or groups
entries.example_cn: 和平条约由代表四个国家的四方代表团签署。
entries.example_en: The peace treaty was signed by a quadripartite delegation representing the four nations.

entries.definition_en: divided into four parts
entries.example_cn: 这种四分式设计将面板分成了四个部分。
entries.example_en: The quadripartite design divides the panel into four sections.

entries.definition_en: paralysis affecting all four limbs
entries.example_cn: 这次事故导致了严重的四肢瘫痪。
entries.example_en: The accident resulted in severe quadriplegia.

entries.definition_en: a person who is paralyzed in both arms and both legs
entries.example_cn: 该组织为四肢瘫痪患者提供康复服务。
entries.example_en: The organization provides rehabilitation services for quadriplegic patients.

entries.definition_en: in the Middle Ages, the higher division of the university curriculum involving arithmetic, music, geometry, and astronomy
entries.example_cn: 四艺由算术、音乐、几何学和天文学组成。
entries.example_en: The quadrivium comprised arithmetic, music, geometry, and astronomy.

entries.definition_cn: （历史用语）四分之一非白人血统的人
entries.definition_en: a person historically classified as three-quarters white and one-quarter non-White
entries.example_cn: 历史上，该术语被用来描述拥有四分之一黑人血统的人。
entries.example_en: The term quadroon was historically used to describe a person with one-quarter Black ancestry.

entries.definition_en: an animal that walks on four legs
entries.example_cn: 狮子是一种在草原上捕猎的强大四足动物。
entries.example_en: The lion is a powerful quadruped that hunts in the savanna.

entries.definition_en: having four feet
entries.example_cn: 机器人的四足运动使其能够轻松爬楼梯。
entries.example_en: The quadruped movement of the robot allowed it to climb stairs easily.

entries.definition_en: having four feet
entries.example_cn: 这种四足动物迅速穿过了田野。
entries.example_en: The quadrupedal animal moved quickly across the field.

entries.definition_en: to increase fourfold
entries.example_cn: 销售额在第一季度翻了两番。
entries.example_en: Sales quadrupled in the first quarter.

entries.definition_en: four times as great or many
entries.example_cn: 奖金是去年的四倍。
entries.example_en: The prize money is quadruple that of the previous year.

entries.definition_en: having four units or components
entries.example_cn: 他们建造了一辆四层巴士。
entries.example_en: They built a quadruple decker bus.

entries.definition_en: a set of four similar things considered as a unit
entries.example_cn: 合唱团演奏了四重和声。
entries.example_en: The choir performed a quadruple harmony.

entries.definition_en: a quantity that is four times as great as another
entries.example_cn: 新的人口数量是旧的四倍。
entries.example_en: The new population is a quadruple of the old one.

entries.definition_en: one of four children born at the same time from the same pregnancy
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了刚出生的四胞胎之一。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined the newborn quadruplet.

entries.definition_en: a set of four similar things considered as a unit
entries.example_cn: 艺术家画了一组四个相同的罐子。
entries.example_en: The artist painted a quadruplet of identical vases.

entries.definition_en: the number four
entries.example_cn: 四是三加一，即四。
entries.example_en: Four is the sum of three and one, a quadruplet.

entries.definition_en: having four units or components
entries.example_cn: 四重 DNA 结构比标准的双螺旋结构更稳定。
entries.example_en: The quadruplex DNA structure is more stable than the standard double helix.

entries.definition_en: to make four copies of something
entries.example_cn: 秘书被要求为四个部门复印四份合同。
entries.example_en: The secretary was asked to quadruplicate the contract for the four departments.

entries.definition_en: a set of four identical copies
entries.example_cn: 请在四份副本上签字，并将其中一份返还给各方。
entries.example_en: Please sign the quadruplicate and return one copy to each party.

entries.definition_en: having four parts or units
entries.example_cn: 这种四部分组成的发动机设计使得单个组件的维护更加容易。
entries.example_en: The quadruplicate engine design allows for easier maintenance of individual components.

entries.definition_en: an increase by a factor of four
entries.example_cn: 该公司经历了快速增长，五年内收入增加到原来的四倍。
entries.example_en: The company experienced rapid growth, achieving a quadrupling of its revenue in five years.

entries.definition_cn: 古罗马负责公共财政和其他财务事务的官员
entries.definition_en: a public official in ancient Rome, responsible for public revenue and other financial affairs
entries.example_cn: 这位财务官管理着罗马共和国的国库。
entries.example_en: The quaestor managed the treasury of the Roman Republic.

entries.definition_en: to swallow a drink hurriedly or greedily
entries.example_cn: 他一口气痛饮了整瓶葡萄酒。
entries.example_en: He quaffed the entire bottle of wine in one go.

entries.definition_en: a hearty draft of a drink
entries.example_cn: 长途徒步之后，他们喝了一大口清凉的水。
entries.example_en: After the long hike, they enjoyed a refreshing quaff of cold water.

entries.definition_en: a large ball used in the game of Quidditch
entries.example_cn: 追球手俯冲下去追逐魁地奇球，试图得分。
entries.example_en: The seeker dove after the quaffle to try and score a goal.

entries.definition_en: an extinct South African mammal that looked like a zebra
entries.example_cn: 夸格亚马是斑马的一个亚种，于19世纪末灭绝。
entries.example_en: The quagga was a subspecies of zebra that became extinct in the late 19th century.

entries.definition_en: a complicated and difficult situation that is hard to escape from
entries.example_cn: 这项调查陷入了证据相互矛盾、进展拖延的复杂困境。
entries.example_en: The investigation became a quagmire of conflicting evidence and delays.

entries.definition_en: soft, wet ground that sinks when you walk on it
entries.example_cn: 雨后徒步者被困在了沼泽里。
entries.example_en: The hikers got stuck in a quagmire after the rain.

entries.definition_cn: 北美大西洋沿岸的一种可食用硬壳蛤
entries.definition_en: an edible hard-shelled clam found along the Atlantic coast of North America
entries.example_cn: 我们在岸边钓鱼时捕到了几只这种蛤蜊。
entries.example_en: We caught several quahogs while fishing near the shore.

entries.definition_en: an American clam whose heavy shells were historically used as currency
entries.example_cn: 过去，美洲原住民曾使用货币蛤作为货币。
entries.example_en: Native Americans used quahogs as a form of money in the past.

entries.definition_en: a small gallinaceous game bird
entries.example_cn: 我们去田野里打猎抓鹌鹑。
entries.example_en: We went hunting for quail in the fields.

entries.definition_en: the meat of a young quail, suitable for roasting or broiling
entries.example_cn: 厨师用烤鹌鹑做了一道美味佳肴。
entries.example_en: The chef prepared a delicious dish using roasted quail.

entries.definition_en: to draw back or shrink from something due to fear or pain
entries.example_cn: 她看到那片黑暗的森林时畏缩不前。
entries.example_en: She quailed at the sight of the dark forest.

entries.definition_cn: 奇怪得有趣或令人愉快
entries.definition_en: strange in an interesting or pleasing way
entries.example_cn: 这个村庄有一座色彩斑斓的彩色玻璃窗的古教堂，显得古朴而有趣。
entries.example_en: The village has a quaint old church with colorful stained glass.

entries.definition_en: attractively old-fashioned
entries.example_cn: 他们住进了一家带有大堂壁炉的古朴酒店。
entries.example_en: They stayed in a quaint hotel with a fireplace in the lobby.

entries.definition_cn: 非常奇怪或不寻常；性格或外貌古怪
entries.definition_en: very strange or unusual; odd in character or appearance
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家的作品常被描述为古怪而离奇。
entries.example_en: The artist's work is often described as quaint and bizarre.

entries.definition_cn: 以奇怪但不令人不快的方式
entries.definition_en: in a strange but not unpleasant manner
entries.example_cn: 那座老小屋用褪色的挂毯装饰得别有一番风味。
entries.example_en: The old cottage was quaintly decorated with faded tapestries.

entries.definition_en: in a quaint old-fashioned manner
entries.example_cn: 他们身着维多利亚时代的服装，古色古香地参加了聚会。
entries.example_en: They quaintly dressed in Victorian costumes for the party.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being quaint and old-fashioned in a charming way
entries.example_cn: 这个村庄以其古雅和狭窄的鹅卵石街道而闻名。
entries.example_en: The village is famous for its quaintness and narrow cobblestone streets.

entries.definition_en: strangeness or oddness resulting from being old-fashioned
entries.example_cn: 这些古老习俗中有一种古怪之处，让现代人觉得它们很奇怪。
entries.example_en: There is a certain quaintness about the old customs that makes them seem strange to modern people.

entries.definition_en: shaking and vibration of the earth's surface caused by underground movement or volcanic activity
entries.example_cn: 强烈地震损坏了城市里的许多建筑物。
entries.example_en: The strong quake damaged many buildings in the city.

entries.definition_en: to shake with fast, tremulous movements
entries.example_cn: 她签署重要文件时双手颤抖。
entries.example_en: Her hands quaked as she signed the important document.

entries.definition_en: to shake due to seismic vibrations
entries.example_cn: 地震期间地面剧烈震动。
entries.example_en: The ground quaked violently during the earthquake.

entries.definition_cn: 资格；资历；使人具备资格的条件
entries.definition_en: an ability or attribute that qualifies someone for something
entries.example_cn: 她具备教书的资格。
entries.example_en: She has the qualification to teach.

entries.definition_en: a statement that limits or restricts some claim
entries.example_cn: 报告中包含关于数据的限制声明。
entries.example_en: The report included a qualification about the data.

entries.definition_en: the act of modifying or changing the strength of some idea
entries.example_cn: 他对他的声明作了限定。
entries.example_en: He made a qualification to his statement.

entries.definition_en: meeting the proper standards and requirements and training for an office or position or task
entries.example_cn: 她是一位有十年经验的合格教师。
entries.example_en: She is a qualified teacher with ten years of experience.

entries.definition_en: limited or restricted; not absolute
entries.example_cn: 这项报价附带一个条件，即你必须用现金支付。
entries.example_en: The offer is qualified by the condition that you must pay in cash.

entries.definition_cn: 持有适当证件并有官方备案、获准执行特定职能或从事特定技能的
entries.definition_en: holding appropriate documentation and officially on record as qualified to perform a specified function or practice a specified skill
entries.example_cn: 只有持有相应证件并获官方认可的电工才能操作主电源线。
entries.example_en: Only a qualified electrician can work on the main power lines.

entries.definition_en: contingent on something else
entries.example_cn: 该项目的成功取决于资金的可用性。
entries.example_en: The success of the project is qualified by the availability of funding.

entries.definition_en: restricted in meaning; (as e.g. 'man' in 'a tall man')
entries.example_cn: 在“a tall man”中，tall通过限定man的意义来修饰它。
entries.example_en: In “a tall man,” “tall” qualifies “man” by restricting its meaning.

entries.definition_cn: 入围者；有资格参赛的人
entries.definition_en: a person who meets the necessary conditions to participate in a competition
entries.example_cn: 她是全国决赛的顶尖入围者。
entries.example_en: She was the top qualifier for the national finals.

entries.definition_en: a word or phrase that limits or specifies the meaning of another word or phrase
entries.example_cn: 在短语“red car”中，“red”是“car”的限定成分。
entries.example_en: In the phrase 'red car', 'red' acts as a qualifier for 'car'.

entries.definition_en: to prove that you are suitable or meet the requirements
entries.example_cn: 你必须通过考试才能获得这份工作的资格。
entries.example_en: You must pass the exam to qualify for the job.

entries.definition_cn: 使具备（某项工作所需的）资格
entries.definition_en: to prepare or make someone fit for a purpose
entries.example_cn: 这门课程将使你有资格进入下一级别。
entries.example_en: The course will qualify you for the next level.

usage.label: qualify someone for something
usage.pattern: qualify someone for a job or task

entries.definition_en: to declare that someone is fit or able
entries.example_cn: 医生认定他适合执行任务。
entries.example_en: The doctor qualified him as fit for duty.

entries.definition_en: to make a statement more specific or precise
entries.example_cn: 他通过添加更多细节来限定他的回答。
entries.example_en: He qualified his answer by adding more details.

entries.definition_en: to specify a condition in an agreement
entries.example_cn: 合同在报价中规定了截止日期。
entries.example_en: The contract qualified the offer with a deadline.

entries.definition_cn: 描绘（某人）的性格或品质
entries.definition_en: to describe the character or qualities of someone
entries.example_cn: 这部小说将主人公描绘成一个复杂的人物。
entries.example_en: The novel qualifies the hero as a complex character.

entries.definition_en: to add a modifier to a word or phrase
entries.example_cn: 语法规则用形容词修饰名词。
entries.example_en: The grammar rule qualifies the noun with an adjective.

entries.definition_cn: 取得资格所需的考试；资格考试
entries.definition_en: an examination that must be taken in order to qualify
entries.example_cn: 大多数教师都不愿意在资格考试中判定学生不及格。
entries.example_en: Most faculty members dread having to fail a student in the qualifyings.

entries.definition_en: the grammatical relation that exists when a word qualifies the meaning of a phrase
entries.example_cn: 这句话中形容词与名词之间的限定关系很明确。
entries.example_en: The qualifying relation between the adjective and the noun is clear in this sentence.

entries.definition_en: based on qualities or characteristics rather than quantities
entries.example_cn: 这项研究侧重于两组之间的定性差异。
entries.example_en: The study focused on qualitative differences between the two groups.

entries.definition_en: of a form of analysis that determines the identity of a compound
entries.example_cn: 定性分析鉴定出该化合物是硫酸铜。
entries.example_en: Qualitative analysis identified the compound as copper sulfate.

entries.definition_en: in a way that relates to the nature or quality of something rather than its amount
entries.example_cn: 新数据显示，这个问题与以往的问题在性质上完全不同。
entries.example_en: The new data shows that the problem is qualitatively different from previous ones.

entries.definition_en: a level of excellence or worth
entries.example_cn: 食物的质量非常好。
entries.example_en: The quality of the food was excellent.

entries.definition_en: an essential feature of something
entries.example_cn: 诚实是我钦佩他人的品质。
entries.example_en: Honesty is a quality I admire in others.

entries.definition_en: a characteristic property defining something
entries.example_cn: 织物的特性使其耐用。
entries.example_en: The quality of the fabric makes it durable.

entries.definition_en: the distinctive property of a sound
entries.example_cn: 小提琴具有独特的音色。
entries.example_en: The violin has a unique quality of sound.

entries.definition_en: of high standard or grade
entries.example_cn: 这是由专家制造的优质产品。
entries.example_en: This is a quality product made by experts.

entries.definition_cn: 社会地位高的；上流社会的（旧时用语）
entries.definition_en: of high social status; upper-class, especially in former usage
entries.example_cn: 在那部旧小说中，上流社会的女士和先生们聚集参加舞会。
entries.example_en: In the old novel, the quality ladies and gentlemen assembled for the ball.

entries.definition_cn: 显赫的社会地位（旧时用语）
entries.definition_en: high social position or status, especially formerly
entries.example_cn: 庄园里住着一位贵妇。
entries.example_en: A lady of quality lived on the estate.

entries.definition_cn: 疑虑、不安或忧惧，尤指对某行为道德性的顾虑
entries.definition_en: a feeling of doubt, apprehension, or uneasiness, especially about the morality of an action
entries.example_cn: 她对这个礼物感到良心不安，因为它是被迫接受的。
entries.example_en: She had a qualm about accepting the gift because it was given under pressure.

usage.label: have qualms about + noun/gerund
usage.pattern: Source r0 example uses “have ... qualms about”.

entries.definition_en: a slight feeling of nausea
entries.example_cn: 鱼腥味让他突然感到轻微恶心。
entries.example_en: The smell of the fish gave him a sudden qualm.

entries.definition_en: a state of uncertainty or confusion when choosing between equally bad options
entries.example_cn: 他在考虑接受哪份工作时陷入了两难。
entries.example_en: He was in a quandary about which job offer to accept.

entries.definition_en: a difficult situation from which it is hard to escape, especially an unpleasant one
entries.example_cn: 该公司发现自己在新法规问题上陷入了困境。
entries.example_en: The company found itself in a quandary regarding the new regulations.

entries.definition_en: an organization that is funded by the government but operates independently
entries.example_cn: 政府设立了一个半官方组织来监督环境法规。
entries.example_en: The government established a quango to oversee environmental regulations.

entries.definition_cn: 量子的；量化的；全或无的
entries.definition_en: relating to a quantum or to quantization; quantized or all-or-none
entries.example_cn: 神经递质以离散的、全或无的释放单位释放。
entries.example_en: The quantal release of neurotransmitters occurs in discrete, all-or-none packets.

entries.definition_cn: 含有至少两个变量的齐次多项式
entries.definition_en: a homogeneous polynomial having at least two variables
entries.example_cn: 该模型中的齐次多项式是一个含两个变量的多项式。
entries.example_en: The quantic in the model is a homogeneous polynomial in two variables.

entries.definition_en: able to be measured or expressed in numbers
entries.example_cn: 公司需要跟踪其可量化的目标以确保成功。
entries.example_en: The company needs to track its quantifiable goals to ensure success.

entries.definition_cn: 确定或表达某物数量的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of determining or expressing the amount of something
entries.example_cn: 该报告包含了项目成本的详细量化分析。
entries.example_en: The report included a detailed quantification of the project's costs.

entries.definition_cn: 对命题中变量的数量进行限定
entries.definition_en: the process of specifying the quantity of variables in a logical statement
entries.example_cn: 这位数学家专注于该命题的量化。
entries.example_en: The mathematician focused on the quantification of the proposition.

entries.definition_en: a word in grammar that indicates a quantity, such as 'fifteen' or 'many'
entries.example_cn: 单词“许多”是一个数量词，用于表达不确定的大数量。
entries.example_en: The word 'many' is a quantifier used to express an indefinite large number.

entries.definition_en: a word in logic that binds variables in a proposition, such as 'some' or 'all'
entries.example_cn: 在逻辑陈述“所有人都是凡人”中，“所有”作为一个全称量词起作用。
entries.example_en: In the logical statement 'all humans are mortal', 'all' functions as a universal quantifier.

entries.definition_cn: 正则表达式中规定字符或字符组可出现次数的符号或符号组
entries.definition_en: a symbol or group of symbols in a regular expression that specifies how many times a character or group may occur
entries.example_cn: 量词“+”匹配前一个字符出现一次或多次。
entries.example_en: The quantifier “+” matches one or more occurrences of the preceding character.

entries.definition_en: to express as a number or measure or quantity
entries.example_cn: 很难用数字来衡量锻炼的好处。
entries.example_en: It is difficult to quantify the benefits of exercise.

entries.definition_cn: （逻辑学）用量词将谓词与集合联系起来
entries.definition_en: to relate a predicate to a set by using a quantifier
entries.example_cn: “存在一个 x”这一表达式对该论域进行量化。
entries.example_en: The expression “there exists an x” quantifies over the domain.

entries.definition_en: the act of dividing into quanta or expressing in terms of quantum theory
entries.example_cn: 量子化过程是现代物理学的基础。
entries.example_en: The process of quantisation is fundamental to modern physics.

entries.definition_en: able to be expressed as a number or measured
entries.example_cn: 这项研究侧重于定量数据而非意见。
entries.example_en: The study focused on quantitative data rather than opinions.

entries.definition_en: relating to the measurement of quantity
entries.example_cn: 定量分析有助于确定物质的确切数量。
entries.example_en: Quantitative analysis helps determine the exact amount of a substance.

entries.definition_cn: 基于音节长度的（诗歌韵律）
entries.definition_en: based on the length of syllables in poetry
entries.example_cn: 这首诗使用的是基于音节长度的韵律，而非重音节奏。
entries.example_en: This poem uses quantitative meter instead of stress-based rhythm.

entries.definition_en: in terms of quantity or amount
entries.example_cn: 该研究定量分析了数据，以确定该政策的确切影响。
entries.example_en: The study analyzed the data quantitatively to determine the exact impact of the policy.

entries.definition_en: how much there is or how many there are of something that you can quantify
entries.example_cn: 水箱中的水量是足够的。
entries.example_en: The quantity of water in the tank is sufficient.

entries.definition_en: a large or considerable amount or number
entries.example_cn: 这个食谱需要大量的面粉。
entries.example_en: We need a large quantity of flour for this recipe.

entries.definition_en: the concept that something has a magnitude and can be represented in mathematical expressions by a constant or a variable
entries.example_cn: 在物理学中，力是一个可以测量的量。
entries.example_en: In physics, force is a quantity that can be measured.

entries.definition_en: the process of describing physical quantities in discrete units
entries.example_cn: 量子力学理论依赖于量子化的概念。
entries.example_en: The theory of quantum mechanics relies on the concept of quantization.

entries.definition_cn: 将连续变化的信号近似为幅度受限的离散值
entries.definition_en: to approximate a continuously varying signal by restricting its amplitude to discrete values
entries.example_cn: 音频工程师必须将模拟录音量化以适应数字格式。
entries.example_en: The audio engineer had to quantize the analog recording to fit the digital format.

entries.definition_cn: 应用量子理论，将变量限制为离散数值
entries.definition_en: to apply quantum theory by restricting variables to discrete magnitudes
entries.example_cn: 物理学家将原子的能级量子化以解释其光谱。
entries.example_en: Physicists quantize the energy levels of an atom to explain its spectrum.

entries.definition_cn: 以离散量子存在的；量子化的
entries.definition_en: existing only in discrete amounts or quanta, rather than continuously
entries.example_cn: 在量子物理学中，能量通常是量子化的而不是连续的。
entries.example_en: In quantum physics, energy is often quantized rather than continuous.

entries.definition_en: a discrete amount of something
entries.example_cn: 能量以单个量子的形式释放。
entries.example_en: The energy was released in a single quantum.

entries.definition_en: the smallest discrete quantity of some physical property according to quantum theory
entries.example_cn: 光由称为量子的离散能量包组成。
entries.example_en: Light consists of discrete packets of energy called quanta.

entries.definition_cn: 历史上为防止传染病传播而实施的四十天隔离期
entries.definition_en: historically, a forty-day period of isolation formerly imposed to prevent the spread of contagious disease
entries.example_cn: 在中世纪的威尼斯，船只会被隔离四十天，以防止瘟疫暴发。
entries.example_en: In medieval Venice, ships were held in quarantine for forty days to prevent plague outbreaks.

entries.definition_cn: 为防止传染病传播而进行的隔离
entries.definition_en: isolation to prevent the spread of infectious disease
entries.example_cn: 新规定要求任何进入该国的人必须接受隔离期。
entries.example_en: New rules require a quarantine period for anyone entering the country.

entries.definition_cn: 强制隔离（如出于医疗原因）
entries.definition_en: place into enforced isolation, as for medical reasons
entries.example_cn: 医生决定隔离那位发热的旅行者。
entries.example_en: The doctor decided to quarantine the traveler who had a fever.

entries.definition_en: kept in forced isolation, especially for health reasons
entries.example_cn: 乘客在从受影响地区抵达后被隔离了十天。
entries.example_en: The passengers were quarantined for ten days after arriving from the affected region.

entries.definition_en: fresh unripened cheese of a smooth texture made from pasteurized milk, a starter, and rennet
entries.example_cn: 他们端上蜂蜜配的新鲜软奶酪作为甜点。
entries.example_en: They served fresh quark with honey for dessert.

entries.definition_en: (physics) hypothetical truly fundamental particle in mesons and baryons; there are supposed to be six flavors of quarks (and their antiquarks), which come in pairs; each has an electric charge of +2/3 or -1/3
entries.example_cn: 物理学家研究夸克以了解物质的结构。
entries.example_en: Physicists study quarks to understand the structure of matter.

entries.definition_en: an angry argument or disagreement between people
entries.example_cn: 他们因钱的问题发生了严重的争吵，从此不再说话。
entries.example_en: They had a serious quarrel about money and stopped speaking to each other.

entries.definition_en: a projectile with a four-sided head used in a crossbow
entries.example_cn: 中世纪士兵将弩箭装入弩中，瞄准敌人。
entries.example_en: The medieval soldier loaded a quarrel into the crossbow and aimed at the enemy.

entries.definition_en: to have an angry argument with someone
entries.example_cn: 别跟你弟弟吵架，把你的那一边解释清楚就行了。
entries.example_en: Don't quarrel with your brother; just explain your side of the story.

entries.definition_en: given to quarreling
entries.example_cn: 那两个好争吵的孩子又为那个玩具打了起来。
entries.example_en: The quarrelsome children fought over the toy again.

entries.definition_en: a person whose job is to extract stone or minerals from a quarry
entries.example_cn: 采石工努力将沉重的岩石装上卡车。
entries.example_en: The quarrier worked hard to load the heavy rocks onto the truck.

entries.definition_en: a large hole dug in the ground for extracting stone
entries.example_cn: 那个古老的采石场已被改造成一个湖泊。
entries.example_en: The old quarry has been turned into a lake.

entries.definition_cn: 攻击目标（尤指被嘲笑或剥削的受害者）
entries.definition_en: a person who is the aim of an attack (especially a victim of ridicule or exploitation) by some hostile person or influence
entries.example_cn: 辩论期间，喜剧演员把政治家当成了他的攻击目标。
entries.example_en: The comedian made the politician his quarry during the debate.

entries.definition_cn: 猎物（指被猎杀以作食物的动物）
entries.definition_en: an animal that is hunted for food
entries.example_cn: 狼在森林中悄悄接近它的猎物。
entries.example_en: The wolf stalked its quarry through the forest.

entries.definition_en: to extract stone or other materials from a rock face
entries.example_cn: 工人们从山侧开采大理石。
entries.example_en: Workers quarried marble from the mountain side.

entries.definition_en: the process of extracting building stone or slate from an open pit
entries.example_cn: 采石场的噪音打扰了附近的村庄。
entries.example_en: The noise from the quarrying operations disturbed the nearby village.

entries.definition_en: a male quarry worker who splits off blocks of stone
entries.example_cn: 采石工用大锤将花岗岩块劈开。
entries.example_en: The quarryman used a heavy hammer to split the granite block.

entries.definition_en: a US liquid measure equal to 32 fluid ounces
entries.example_cn: 她把一夸脱牛奶倒进搅拌机里。
entries.example_en: She poured a quart of milk into the blender.

entries.definition_cn: 夸脱（英制容量单位，可用于液体或干量，等于两英制品脱或1.136升）
entries.definition_en: a British imperial capacity unit for liquid or dry measure, equal to two imperial pints or 1.136 liters
entries.example_cn: 食谱需要一夸脱面粉。
entries.example_en: The recipe calls for a quart of flour.

entries.definition_en: a US dry measure equal to 2 pints
entries.example_cn: 他在市场上买了一夸脱苹果。
entries.example_en: He bought a quart of apples at the market.

entries.definition_en: occurring every fourth day, especially regarding malaria symptoms
entries.example_cn: 这种疾病每四日发作一次的规律使得预测下一次发作变得困难。
entries.example_en: The quartan pattern of the illness made it difficult to predict when the next attack would occur.

entries.definition_cn: 四日疟（一种每72小时复发的疟疾）
entries.definition_en: a malarial fever that recurs every 72 hours
entries.example_cn: 这位病人患有四日疟，发作每72小时复发一次。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from quartan fever, with attacks recurring every 72 hours.

entries.definition_en: one of four equal parts
entries.example_cn: 她吃了蛋糕的四分之一。
entries.example_en: She ate a quarter of the cake.

entries.definition_en: a unit of time equal to 15 minutes or a quarter of an hour
entries.example_cn: 会议将在一刻钟后开始。
entries.example_en: The meeting will start in a quarter.

entries.definition_cn: （篮球、美式足球等比赛的）四节之一
entries.definition_en: one of four periods into which some sports games are divided
entries.example_cn: 第三节结束时，这支球队领先六分。
entries.example_en: The team led by six points at the end of the third quarter.

entries.definition_en: a district of a city having some distinguishing character
entries.example_cn: 我们在法国区度过了晚上。
entries.example_en: We spent the evening in the French Quarter.

entries.definition_en: provide housing for (military personnel)
entries.example_cn: 军队将士兵们安置在旧兵营里。
entries.example_en: The army quartered the soldiers in the old barracks.

entries.definition_en: divide into quarters
entries.example_cn: 请把披萨分成四份，这样每个人都能得到一片。
entries.example_en: Please quarter the pizza so everyone gets a slice.

entries.definition_en: divide by four; divide into quarters
entries.example_cn: 你可以把数字20除以四得到5。
entries.example_en: You can quarter the number 20 to get 5.

entries.definition_cn: 用四匹马将人四肢绑住并撕裂处死
entries.definition_en: pull (a person) apart with four horses tied to their extremities, so as to execute them
entries.example_cn: 那个叛徒被愤怒的人群用四匹马撕裂处死了。
entries.example_en: The traitor was quartered by the angry mob.

entries.definition_en: a period of twenty-five years
entries.example_cn: 这家公司已经经营了四分之一世纪。
entries.example_en: The company has been in business for a quarter-century.

entries.definition_en: a period of time equal to fifteen minutes
entries.example_cn: 会议将在一刻钟后开始。
entries.example_en: The meeting will start in a quarter-hour.

entries.definition_en: a musical interval equal to half of a semitone
entries.example_cn: 这位作曲家尝试了四分之一音阶。
entries.example_en: The composer experimented with quarter-tone scales.

entries.definition_en: a person who plays the position of quarterback in football
entries.example_cn: 四分卫将球传到了后场。
entries.example_en: The quarterback threw the ball downfield.

entries.definition_en: the position of the football player in the backfield who directs the offensive play
entries.example_cn: 四分卫指挥了进攻战术。
entries.example_en: The quarterback directed the offensive play.

entries.definition_en: to play the position of quarterback
entries.example_cn: 他带领球队作为四分卫取得了胜利。
entries.example_en: He quarterbacked the team to victory.

entries.definition_en: the upper deck at the rear of a ship
entries.example_cn: 船长站在甲板上向船员发表讲话。
entries.example_en: The captain stood on the quarterdeck to address the crew.

entries.definition_en: one of the four matches in an elimination tournament where the winners advance to the semifinals
entries.example_cn: 我们的队伍赢得了四分之一决赛，下周将参加半决赛。
entries.example_en: Our team won the quarterfinal and will play in the semifinals next week.

entries.definition_en: the act of providing living quarters, especially lodging soldiers in private homes
entries.example_cn: 士兵们对被安排住在私人住宅中的住宿条件感到不满。
entries.example_en: The soldiers were unhappy with the conditions of their quartering in private homes.

entries.definition_cn: 将某物分成四等份的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of dividing something into four equal parts
entries.example_cn: 土地的划分是按照地图进行的。
entries.example_en: The quartering of the land was done according to the map.

entries.definition_en: the division of a shield into compartments bearing different coats of arms
entries.example_cn: 盾徽上的分格展示了四个祖先家族的纹章。
entries.example_en: The quartering on the shield displayed the arms of four ancestral families.

entries.definition_en: at three-month intervals
entries.example_cn: 该报告每三个月发布一次。
entries.example_en: The report is issued quarterly.

entries.definition_cn: 在盾徽的四个部分，或两个对角相对的部分
entries.definition_en: in the four, or in two diagonally opposite, quarters of a shield
entries.example_cn: 该盾徽在银和蓝的对角四分之一处。
entries.example_en: The coat of arms is quarterly argent and azure.

entries.definition_en: a periodical that is published every quarter
entries.example_cn: 这本杂志是季刊。
entries.example_en: The magazine is a quarterly publication.

entries.definition_cn: 每季度的；每三个月一次的
entries.definition_en: occurring every three months; quarterly
entries.example_cn: 我们按季度审查财务状况。
entries.example_en: We review our finances on a quarterly basis.

entries.definition_en: an army officer who provides clothing and subsistence for troops
entries.example_cn: 军需官确保每位士兵都有足够的食物和御寒衣物。
entries.example_en: The quartermaster ensured every soldier had enough food and warm clothes.

entries.definition_cn: （旧时船上的）舵手，负责在船长指挥下掌舵、使用罗盘、传递信号等事务的士官
entries.definition_en: A petty officer on a ship responsible for the helm, compass, signals, and related duties under the master.
entries.example_cn: 船长研究海图时，舵手负责掌舵。
entries.example_en: The quartermaster took the helm while the captain studied the charts.

entries.definition_en: accommodation or housing provided for people to live in
entries.example_cn: 士兵们被安排在靠近前线的临时住所。
entries.example_en: The soldiers were given temporary quarters near the front lines.

entries.definition_en: a long, thick staff used as a weapon
entries.example_cn: 骑士挥舞长棍，技艺高超。
entries.example_en: The knight wielded a quarterstaff with great skill.

entries.definition_cn: 使用长棍进行的格斗或练习
entries.definition_en: Fighting or practicing with a quarterstaff.
entries.example_cn: 他在一位技艺高超的教练指导下练习长棍术。
entries.example_en: He practiced quarterstaff with a skilled instructor.

entries.definition_en: a group of four performers who sing or play music together
entries.example_cn: 四重唱组在音乐会上表演了一首优美的歌曲。
entries.example_en: The quartet performed a beautiful song at the concert.

entries.definition_en: a set of four similar things considered as a single unit
entries.example_cn: 他们为客厅买了一套四把配套的椅子。
entries.example_en: They bought a quartet of matching chairs for the living room.

entries.definition_en: a piece of music written for four performers
entries.example_cn: 乐团演奏了贝多芬的一首著名的四重奏曲。
entries.example_en: The orchestra played a famous quartet by Beethoven.

entries.definition_en: a group of four people considered as a single unit
entries.example_cn: 这四个朋友一起计划了他们的假期。
entries.example_en: The quartet of friends planned their vacation together.

entries.definition_en: the number four
entries.example_cn: 这四兄妹一起搬进了新房子。
entries.example_en: The quartet of siblings moved to a new house together.

entries.definition_en: a group of four singers or performers who act together
entries.example_cn: 这个四重唱组为观众演唱了一首优美的歌曲。
entries.example_en: The quartette performed a beautiful song for the audience.

entries.definition_en: a set of four similar items regarded as a single unit
entries.example_cn: 那组四支蜡烛被放在壁炉架上。
entries.example_en: The quartette of candles was placed on the mantelpiece.

entries.definition_en: four people considered as a single unit
entries.example_cn: 这个四人组决定一起旅行。
entries.example_en: The quartette of friends decided to travel together.

entries.definition_en: a musical composition written for four performers
entries.example_cn: 他们正在学习莫扎特的四重奏曲。
entries.example_en: They are studying the quartette by Mozart.

entries.definition_en: an equation or function involving the fourth power of a variable
entries.example_cn: 这位数学家在他的研究中解出了这个四次方程。
entries.example_en: The mathematician solved the quartic equation in his research.

entries.definition_en: a point in statistics that divides an ordered distribution into four equal parts
entries.example_cn: 第一四分位数表示低于该值的 25% 数据。
entries.example_en: The first quartile represents the value below which 25% of the data falls.

entries.definition_en: a book size created by folding a sheet of paper twice to make four leaves
entries.example_cn: 这本稀有版是以四开本格式印刷的。
entries.example_en: The rare edition was printed in quarto format.

entries.definition_en: a hard mineral made of silicon dioxide found in many rocks
entries.example_cn: 砂岩主要由小块的石英组成。
entries.example_en: Sandstone is mostly made of small pieces of quartz.

entries.definition_en: a type of glass made from fused silica
entries.example_cn: 这枚透镜由石英玻璃制成。
entries.example_en: The lens was made from quartz glass.

entries.definition_en: a hard metamorphic rock made of interlocking quartz crystals
entries.example_cn: 建筑商使用石英岩建造纪念碑，因为它的耐久性。
entries.example_en: The builders used quartzite for the monument because of its durability.

entries.definition_cn: 一种类星天体，发出无线电波和其他形式的能量，通常具有较大的红移
entries.definition_en: a starlike celestial object that emits radio waves and other energy, often showing large red shifts
entries.example_cn: 天文学家发现了一个距离地球数十亿光年的遥远类星体。
entries.example_en: Astronomers discovered a distant quasar billions of light-years away.

entries.definition_en: put down by force or intimidation
entries.example_cn: 政府试图镇压抗议活动。
entries.example_en: The government tried to quash the protest.

entries.definition_en: declare invalid
entries.example_cn: 法官决定宣布该判决无效。
entries.example_en: The judge decided to quash the verdict.

entries.definition_en: resembling or having some likeness to the named thing
entries.example_cn: 这次准官方会议在一个私人房间里举行。
entries.example_en: The quasi-official meeting was held in a private room.

entries.definition_cn: 具有某些独立粒子特征、但由多个粒子组成的实体
entries.definition_en: an entity with some characteristics of a distinct particle but composed of a grouping of multiple particles
entries.example_cn: 物理学家研究准粒子如何在晶格中移动。
entries.example_en: Physicists study how quasiparticles move through a crystal lattice.

entries.definition_cn: 从苦木属及近缘植物的树皮或木材中提取的苦味化合物；苦木素
entries.definition_en: a bitter compound, quassin, extracted from the bark or wood of Quassia and related trees
entries.example_cn: 医生开苦木素来治疗患者的消化问题。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed quassia to treat the patient's digestive issues.

entries.definition_en: a South American shrub or tree with scarlet flowers that yields quassia
entries.example_cn: 他们从南美的苦木属植物中采集苦木碱，利用其药用特性。
entries.example_en: They harvested the quassia from the South American shrub for its medicinal properties.

entries.definition_en: the leaves of the shrub Catha edulis which are chewed like tobacco or used to make tea; has the effect of a euphoric stimulant
entries.example_cn: 旅行者咀嚼当地的卡他叶以保持清醒。
entries.example_en: The traveler chewed the local quat to stay awake.

entries.definition_en: consisting of or arranged in sets of four
entries.example_cn: 该蛋白质的四级结构很复杂。
entries.example_en: The quaternary structure of the protein is complex.

entries.definition_en: coming next after the third
entries.example_cn: 地质年代的第四纪继第三纪之后。
entries.example_en: The quaternary stage of the geological period follows the tertiary.

entries.definition_en: a quaternary compound
entries.example_cn: 化学家合成了一种四元化合物。
entries.example_en: The chemist synthesized a quaternary compound.

entries.definition_cn: 四元数：一种四维超复数，由一个实部和三个虚部组成
entries.definition_en: a type of four-dimensional hypercomplex number with one real component and three imaginary components
entries.example_cn: 四元数方程需要进行标量乘法和四元数加法。
entries.example_en: The quaternion equation requires scalar multiplication and quaternion addition.

entries.definition_en: a stanza consisting of four lines
entries.example_cn: 诗人写了一首短小的四行诗节来描述秋天的落叶。
entries.example_en: The poet wrote a short quatrain to describe the autumn leaves.

entries.definition_en: the 15th century in Italian art and literature
entries.example_cn: 这幅画是文艺复兴早期的杰作。
entries.example_en: The painting is a masterpiece of the quattrocento.

entries.definition_en: a tremulous sound
entries.example_cn: 他的声音中掠过一丝恐惧的颤抖。
entries.example_en: A quaver of fear ran through his voice.

entries.definition_en: a musical note having the time value of an eighth of a whole note
entries.example_cn: 这段旋律由一系列八分音符组成。
entries.example_en: The melody consists of a series of quavers.

entries.definition_en: give off unsteady sounds, alternating in amplitude or frequency
entries.example_cn: 那台旧收音机开始发出杂音颤抖。
entries.example_en: The old radio began to quaver with static.

entries.definition_cn: 以颤音演唱或演奏，使一个音与上方或下方的音快速交替
entries.definition_en: to sing or play a note with a rapid alternation between it and the note above or below
entries.example_cn: 小提琴手演奏那个高音时，以颤音快速地与上方音交替。
entries.example_en: The violinist quavered the high note, rapidly alternating with the note above.

entries.definition_en: shaking or trembling, especially in the voice due to weakness or fear
entries.example_cn: 她讲述那个悲伤的故事时，声音颤抖。
entries.example_en: She spoke with a quavering voice as she told the sad story.

entries.definition_en: a wharf usually built parallel to the shoreline
entries.example_cn: 货船停靠在繁忙的码头。
entries.example_en: The cargo ship docked at the busy quay.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of slight nausea
entries.example_cn: 鱼腥味突然引起了恶心感。
entries.example_en: The smell of the fish caused a sudden queasiness.

entries.definition_cn: 心理上的不适或嫌恶感
entries.definition_en: a feeling of mental unease or squeamishness
entries.example_cn: 看到手术器械时，他感到一阵心理上的不适。
entries.example_en: He felt queasiness at the sight of the surgical instruments.

entries.definition_en: feeling nausea; feeling about to vomit
entries.example_cn: 她吃了变质的食物后感到恶心。
entries.example_en: She felt queasy after eating the spoiled food.

entries.definition_en: causing or able to cause nausea
entries.example_cn: 腐烂鱼的气味令人恶心。
entries.example_en: The smell of the rotten fish was queasy.

entries.definition_cn: 令人不安的；显得局促不安的
entries.definition_en: causing or showing uneasiness
entries.example_cn: 结果公布前令人不安的不确定性让每个人都很紧张。
entries.example_en: The queasy uncertainty before the results made everyone nervous.

entries.definition_en: a female sovereign ruler
entries.example_cn: 伊丽莎白二世是英国的君主。
entries.example_en: Queen Elizabeth II was the monarch of the United Kingdom.

entries.definition_cn: 蜂、蚁等社会性昆虫中唯一能繁殖的雌性
entries.definition_en: the only fertile female in a colony of social insects such as bees, ants, and termites; its function is to lay eggs
entries.example_cn: 蜂后控制着整个蜂巢。
entries.example_en: The queen bee controls the entire hive.

entries.definition_en: the wife or widow of a king
entries.example_cn: 王后出席了皇家婚礼。
entries.example_en: The queen attended the royal wedding.

entries.definition_cn: 扑克牌中印有女王头像的四张面牌之一
entries.definition_en: one of four face cards in a deck bearing a picture of a queen
entries.example_cn: 他从牌堆里抽出了红桃皇后。
entries.example_en: He drew the queen of hearts from the deck.

entries.definition_cn: 被视为同类中最好或最重要的人或物（拟人化为女性）
entries.definition_en: something personified as a woman who is considered the best or most important of her kind
entries.example_cn: 她是流行音乐的女王。
entries.example_en: She is the queen of pop music.

entries.definition_en: to promote to a queen, as of a pawn in chess
entries.example_cn: 这名棋手决定将第八横排上的兵升为后。
entries.example_en: The player decided to queen the pawn on the eighth rank.

entries.definition_en: to become a queen
entries.example_cn: 国王去世后，他的妻子不想当王后。
entries.example_en: After the king died, his wife did not want to queen.

entries.definition_cn: 对男同性恋者的侮辱性称呼
entries.definition_en: an offensive term for a homosexual man
entries.example_cn: 指南警告说，queen 可被用作侮辱男同性恋者的蔑称。
entries.example_en: The guide warns that queen can be used as an offensive slur for a gay man.

entries.definition_en: describing a bed that is large but not as large as a king-size bed
entries.example_cn: 他们决定为新卧室买一张大号床。
entries.example_en: They decided to buy a queen-size bed for their new bedroom.

entries.definition_cn: （指床）大于双人床而小于特大号床的
entries.definition_en: describing a bed that is larger than a double bed but smaller than a king-size bed
entries.example_cn: 我们为蜜月预订了一间配有大号床的房间。
entries.example_en: We booked a room with a queen-sized bed for our honeymoon.

entries.definition_en: having the rank of, resembling, or befitting a queen
entries.example_cn: 她在仪式上戴了一顶皇家的王冠。
entries.example_en: She wore a queenly crown at the ceremony.

entries.definition_cn: 奇怪的、异常的或不同于预期的（过时用法）
entries.definition_en: strange, unusual, or different from what is expected (dated)
entries.example_cn: 那个老仆人奇怪地看了他一眼。
entries.example_en: The old servant gave him a queer look.

entries.definition_cn: 同性恋的；酷儿的（旧时常含贬义，现也可为相关群体自称）
entries.definition_en: relating to or involving non-heterosexual or non-cisgender identities; formerly often derogatory, now also reclaimed
entries.example_cn: 这部电影因其同性恋的潜台词和主题而受到批评。
entries.example_en: The film was criticized for its queer undertones and themes.

entries.definition_cn: 在此义项中，指男同性恋者的冒犯性名词；queer 在其他语境中也可为中性或当事人自称用语
entries.definition_en: in this sense, an offensive noun for a homosexual man; queer can also be neutral or reclaimed in other contexts
entries.example_cn: 这段历史引文把 queer 用作侮辱男同性恋者的名词。
entries.example_en: The historical quotation used queer as an offensive noun for a gay man.

entries.definition_cn: 使某人处于危险、不利或困难的境地
entries.definition_en: to put someone in a dangerous, disadvantageous, or difficult position
entries.example_cn: 他鲁莽的驾驶行为使他失去这份工作的机会。
entries.example_en: His reckless driving queered his chances of getting the job.

entries.definition_cn: 阻挠或使某人的努力、计划或协议失效
entries.definition_en: to thwart or render ineffective someone’s efforts, plans, or agreement
entries.example_cn: 突如其来的暴雨打乱了我们野餐的计划。
entries.example_en: The sudden rainstorm queered our plans for a picnic.

entries.definition_en: in a strange or unusual manner
entries.example_cn: 她奇怪地看着他，仿佛不认识他似的。
entries.example_en: She looked at him queerly, as if she did not recognize him.

entries.definition_cn: 可疑地；令人怀疑地异样地
entries.definition_en: in a questionably unusual manner
entries.example_cn: 灯光在完全熄灭前奇怪地闪烁了一下。
entries.example_en: The lights flickered queerly before going out completely.

entries.definition_cn: 酷儿身份或状态；不符合传统性别或性规范
entries.definition_en: the quality or state of being queer, especially in relation to sexual or gender identity
entries.example_cn: 这部小说探讨了二十世纪初社会中的同性恋主题。
entries.example_en: The novel explores the theme of queerness in early twentieth-century society.

entries.definition_en: an unusual or strange manner of behaving
entries.example_cn: 他行为的古怪让房间里每个人都感到不舒服。
entries.example_en: The queerness of his actions made everyone in the room uncomfortable.

entries.definition_en: suppress or crush completely
entries.example_cn: 军队被派去镇压叛乱。
entries.example_en: The army was sent to quell the rebellion.

entries.definition_en: overcome or allay
entries.example_cn: 她在面试前试图平息自己的恐惧。
entries.example_en: She tried to quell her fears before the interview.

entries.definition_en: the act of stopping something by using power or authority
entries.example_cn: 军队镇压叛乱花费了数周时间。
entries.example_en: The army's quelling of the rebellion took several weeks.

entries.definition_en: satisfy (thirst)
entries.example_cn: 长跑后，他喝了一杯水来解渴。
entries.example_en: He drank a glass of water to quench his thirst after the long run.

entries.definition_en: put out, as of fires, flames, or lights
entries.example_cn: 消防员奋力扑灭大火，防止火势蔓延。
entries.example_en: Firefighters worked hard to quench the blaze before it spread.

entries.definition_en: suppress or crush completely
entries.example_cn: 政府军队迅速镇压了叛乱。
entries.example_en: The rebellion was quickly quenched by government forces.

entries.definition_cn: 将（热金属）浸入冷水或其他液体中冷却
entries.definition_en: cool (hot metal) by plunging into cold water or other liquid
entries.example_cn: 铁匠将烧红的钢浸入油中淬火以使其硬化。
entries.example_en: The blacksmith quenched the red-hot steel in oil to harden it.

entries.definition_cn: 在电感电路中切断电流时抑制（火花），或在元件或设备中抑制（振荡或放电）
entries.definition_en: suppress (sparking) when the current is cut off in an inductive circuit, or suppress (an oscillation or discharge) in a component or device
entries.example_cn: 该电路包含一个电阻器，旨在开关断开时抑制火花。
entries.example_en: The circuit includes a resistor designed to quench the spark when the switch is opened.

entries.definition_cn: 通过添加合适的物质降低（激发分子或材料）的发光度或磷光度
entries.definition_en: reduce the degree of (luminescence or phosphorescence) in (excited molecules or a material) by adding a suitable substance
entries.example_cn: 添加了特定化学试剂以淬灭样品的荧光。
entries.example_en: A specific chemical agent was added to quench the fluorescence of the sample.

entries.definition_en: the act of extinguishing fire or stopping something from burning
entries.example_cn: 火焰的快速熄灭让消防员得以进入大楼。
entries.example_en: The rapid quenching of the flames allowed the firefighters to enter the building.

entries.definition_en: the rapid cooling of a hot metal object in a liquid to harden it
entries.example_cn: 将加热后的钢浸入油中淬火使其变得更硬。
entries.example_en: Quenching the heated steel in oil made it harder.

entries.definition_en: a primitive stone mill used for grinding corn by hand
entries.example_cn: 这台古老的手推磨被用来将谷物磨成面粉。
entries.example_en: The ancient quern was used to grind grain into flour.

entries.definition_en: habitually complaining in a peevish manner
entries.example_cn: 那个爱抱怨的老人抱怨建筑工地的噪音。
entries.example_en: The querulous old man complained about the noise from the construction site.

entries.definition_en: pose a question
entries.example_cn: 我询问了证人他看到了什么。
entries.example_en: I queried the witness about what he had seen.

entries.definition_en: a question or inquiry
entries.example_cn: 老师回答了学生关于生物合成的问题。
entries.example_en: The teacher answered the student's query about biosynthesis.

entries.definition_cn: 墨西哥奶酪夹馅玉米饼
entries.definition_en: a Mexican dish consisting of a tortilla filled with cheese and other ingredients and heated until the cheese melts
entries.example_cn: 她午餐点了一份夹鸡肉和辣椒的墨西哥奶酪玉米饼。
entries.example_en: She ordered a quesadilla with chicken and peppers for lunch.

entries.definition_en: the act of searching for something
entries.example_cn: 他对知识的追求永无止境。
entries.example_en: His quest for knowledge never ended.

entries.definition_cn: 寻找符合认知标准的替代方案
entries.definition_en: a search for an alternative that meets cognitive criteria
entries.example_cn: 这位科学家开始寻找一种新的治疗方法。
entries.example_en: The scientist embarked on a quest for a new treatment method.

entries.definition_en: make a search (for)
entries.example_cn: 他们搜寻失落的文物。
entries.example_en: They quested for the lost artifact.

entries.definition_en: express the need or desire for
entries.example_cn: 她表达了对更好理解该问题的渴望。
entries.example_en: She quested for a better understanding of the issue.

entries.definition_en: search the trail of (game)
entries.example_cn: 猎犬开始追踪鹿的踪迹。
entries.example_en: The hounds began to quest for the deer.

entries.definition_en: bark with prolonged noises, of dogs
entries.example_cn: 整夜狗都在篱笆边长声吠叫。
entries.example_en: The dogs quested at the fence all night.

entries.definition_en: seek alms, as for religious purposes
entries.example_cn: 僧人外出乞讨食物。
entries.example_en: The monk went out to quest for food.

entries.definition_en: someone making a search or inquiry
entries.example_cn: 那位寻宝者跋涉千里去寻找失落的文物。
entries.example_en: The quester traveled far to find the lost artifact.

entries.definition_en: a sentence used to ask for information or a reply
entries.example_cn: 她在黑板上写下了那个问题。
entries.example_en: She wrote down the question on the board.

entries.definition_en: the main topic or issue being discussed
entries.example_cn: 争议的问题是该法律是否应被修改。
entries.example_en: The question at issue is whether the law should be changed.

entries.definition_en: the act of questioning
entries.example_cn: 警方对嫌疑人的盘问持续了几个小时。
entries.example_en: The police's questioning of the suspect lasted several hours.

entries.definition_en: to ask a question
entries.example_cn: 他在法庭上询问了证人。
entries.example_en: He questioned the witness in court.

entries.definition_cn: 质疑；对……的准确性或正当性提出挑战
entries.definition_en: to challenge the truth, honesty, or correctness of something
entries.example_cn: 我质疑所提供数据的准确性。
entries.example_en: I question the accuracy of the data provided.

entries.definition_en: to ask a series of questions to someone
entries.example_cn: 记者就其过去向那位政治家提问。
entries.example_en: The journalist questioned the politician about his past.

entries.definition_en: a state of not knowing if something is true or exists
entries.example_cn: 关于他的安全仍存疑虑。
entries.example_en: There is still a question about his safety.

entries.definition_cn: （在电视、报纸或广播报道中）采访
entries.definition_en: to interview someone for news reporting
entries.example_cn: 记者就她的新电影采访了这位名人。
entries.example_en: The reporter questioned the celebrity about her new movie.

entries.definition_en: subject to question
entries.example_cn: 信息来源可疑。
entries.example_en: The source of the information is questionable.

entries.definition_en: of dubious respectability or morality
entries.example_cn: 他品行可疑的经营方式损害了公司的声誉。
entries.example_en: His questionable business practices damaged the company’s reputation.

entries.definition_en: in a way that is doubtful or open to question
entries.example_cn: 证据是以可疑的方式提出的，导致人们对其有效性产生怀疑。
entries.example_en: The evidence was presented questionably, leading to doubts about its validity.

entries.definition_en: a person who asks questions
entries.example_cn: 提问者打断发言者要求澄清。
entries.example_en: The questioner interrupted the speaker to ask for clarification.

entries.definition_en: the act of asking for information or answers
entries.example_cn: 警方对所有证人进行了彻底的询问。
entries.example_en: The police conducted a thorough questioning of all the witnesses.

entries.definition_en: characterized by doubt or skepticism
entries.example_cn: 当被问及新数据的可靠性时，他投去了怀疑的目光。
entries.example_en: He gave a questioning look when asked about the reliability of the new data.

entries.definition_en: showing a strong desire to learn or know more
entries.example_cn: 孩子们充满好奇，想知道魔术是如何表演的。
entries.example_en: The children had questioning minds and wanted to know how the magic trick was performed.

entries.definition_en: feeling confused or uncertain as if you should know something you do not
entries.example_cn: 当我提到会议取消时，她投来困惑的目光。
entries.example_en: She gave a questioning look when I mentioned the meeting was cancelled.

entries.definition_en: in a curious and questioning manner
entries.example_cn: 她疑惑地看着他，不确定他是否听懂了她的指示。
entries.example_en: She looked at him questioningly, unsure if he understood her instructions.

entries.definition_en: in a quizzical and questioning manner
entries.example_cn: 当她发表奇怪的评论时，他探询地笑了笑。
entries.example_en: He smiled questioningly when she made a strange comment.

entries.definition_en: a form with questions used to collect information
entries.example_cn: 请在离开前填写问卷。
entries.example_en: Please fill out the questionnaire before leaving.

entries.definition_en: plural of question
entries.example_cn: 老师问了几个关于课文的问题。
entries.example_en: The teacher asked several questions about the text.

entries.definition_cn: 一种玩家只能用问句说话，否则就输的游戏
entries.definition_en: a game in which players must speak only in questions; anyone who does not do so loses
entries.example_cn: 我们在聚会上玩“问题游戏”，让大家保持清醒。
entries.example_en: We played Questions during the party to keep everyone awake.

entries.definition_cn: 质疑；询问（第三人称单数现在时）
entries.definition_en: third-person singular simple present indicative of question
entries.example_cn: 他质疑证据的有效性。
entries.example_en: He questions the validity of the evidence.

entries.definition_en: a large Central and South American bird with golden-green and scarlet feathers
entries.example_cn: 色彩斑斓的绿咬鹃是危地马拉的国家象征。
entries.example_en: The colorful quetzal is a national symbol of Guatemala.

entries.definition_en: the basic unit of money in Guatemala
entries.example_cn: 她在银行将美元兑换成了危地马拉货币。
entries.example_en: She exchanged her dollars for quetzals at the bank.

entries.definition_cn: 排队等候的人或车辆；队列
entries.definition_en: a line of people or vehicles waiting for something
entries.example_cn: 买票的队伍排得很长。
entries.example_en: There was a long queue for tickets.

entries.definition_en: an ordered list of tasks to be performed or messages to be transmitted
entries.example_cn: 服务器从消息队列中处理请求。
entries.example_en: The server processes requests from the message queue.

entries.definition_en: a braid of hair at the back of the head
entries.example_cn: 她把头发编成一条长长的发辫垂在背后。
entries.example_en: She wore her hair in a long queue down her back.

entries.definition_en: to form a line of people or vehicles waiting for something
entries.example_cn: 请在房间前面排队。
entries.example_en: Please queue up at the front of the room.

entries.definition_cn: 通过提出琐碎或无关的异议来回避问题或真相
entries.definition_en: to evade the point or truth by raising a trivial or irrelevant objection
entries.example_cn: 她对措辞吹毛求疵，以逃避承认自己的错误。
entries.example_en: She quibbled over the wording to avoid admitting her mistake.

entries.definition_en: to argue over petty details
entries.example_cn: 他们整个下午都在纠缠琐事。
entries.example_en: They spent the whole afternoon quibbling over minor points.

entries.definition_en: an objection based on a trivial or irrelevant detail
entries.example_cn: 他针对拼写提出了一个吹毛求疵的异议，却忽略了主要论点。
entries.example_en: He raised a quibble about the spelling, ignoring the main argument.

entries.definition_en: a person who raises annoying petty objections
entries.example_cn: 法官将那位律师视为一个纯粹的吹毛求疵者。
entries.example_en: The judge dismissed the lawyer as a mere quibbler.

entries.definition_en: accomplished rapidly and without delay
entries.example_cn: 我们需要一个迅速解决这个问题的办法。
entries.example_en: We need a quick solution to this problem.

entries.definition_en: hurried and brief
entries.example_cn: 会议前我们匆匆吃了午饭。
entries.example_en: We had a quick lunch before the meeting.

entries.definition_en: performed with little or no delay
entries.example_cn: 医生迅速做出了诊断。
entries.example_en: The doctor gave a quick diagnosis.

entries.definition_en: moving quickly and lightly
entries.example_cn: 那只猫穿过房间时脚步轻快。
entries.example_en: The cat was quick and light on its feet as it crossed the floor.

entries.definition_en: with little or no delay
entries.example_cn: 汽车迅速停了下来。
entries.example_en: The car stopped quick.

entries.definition_cn: （皮肤下、指甲或脚趾甲下的）敏感部位
entries.definition_en: the sensitive part of the body just under the skin or beneath a fingernail or toenail
entries.example_cn: 他不小心剪到了指甲下的嫩肉。
entries.example_en: He accidentally cut into the quick beneath his fingernail.

entries.definition_en: apprehending and responding with speed and sensitivity
entries.example_cn: 她对数学反应敏捷。
entries.example_en: She has a quick mind for mathematics.

entries.definition_cn: 容易激动的；易被鼓动的
entries.definition_en: easily aroused or excited
entries.example_cn: 球队得分时，人群很容易就欢呼起来。
entries.example_en: The crowd was quick to cheer when the team scored.

entries.definition_en: drying very rapidly after being applied
entries.example_cn: 画家更喜欢快干的颜料，这样她可以工作得更快。
entries.example_en: The artist preferred quick-drying paint so she could work faster.

entries.definition_cn: 迅速冷冻以保留天然汁液和风味
entries.definition_en: freeze rapidly so as to preserve the natural juices and flavors
entries.example_cn: 在储存浆果之前，你应该先快速冷冻它们。
entries.example_en: You should quick-freeze the berries before storing them.

entries.definition_en: preserved by freezing rapidly to maintain quality
entries.example_cn: 这些速冻蔬菜保留了大部分营养。
entries.example_en: These quick-frozen vegetables retain most of their nutrients.

entries.definition_en: having very keen vision
entries.example_cn: 那位视力敏锐的猎人在远处就发现了那只鸟。
entries.example_en: The quick-sighted hunter spotted the bird from a distance.

entries.definition_en: keenly perceptive or alert
entries.example_cn: 她敏锐的判断立即发现了危险。
entries.example_en: Her quick-sighted assessment identified the danger immediately.

entries.definition_en: easily angered or losing one's temper quickly
entries.example_cn: 那位易怒的经理立刻对员工大喊大叫。
entries.example_en: The quick-tempered manager shouted at the staff immediately.

entries.definition_en: mentally nimble and resourceful
entries.example_cn: 这位思维敏捷的侦探在几分钟内就解决了案件。
entries.example_en: The quick-witted detective solved the case in minutes.

entries.definition_en: the ability to think quickly and give correct answers without delay
entries.example_cn: 她的思维敏捷帮助她在其他人之前解开了谜题。
entries.example_en: Her quick-wittedness helped her solve the puzzle before anyone else.

entries.definition_en: to move or act faster
entries.example_cn: 他加快了步伐以赶上公交车。
entries.example_en: He quickened his pace to catch the bus.

entries.definition_en: to stimulate or excite something
entries.example_cn: 教练的讲话激发了团队的热情。
entries.example_en: The coach's speech quickened the team's enthusiasm.

entries.definition_en: to become alive or active; revive
entries.example_cn: 休眠的植物在雨后恢复了活力。
entries.example_en: The dormant plant quickened after the rain.

entries.definition_en: to make something more keen or acute
entries.example_cn: 明亮的光线使她的感官变得敏锐。
entries.example_en: The bright light quickened her senses.

entries.definition_en: to give new life or energy to something
entries.example_cn: 雨水让枯萎的花朵重新焕发生机。
entries.example_en: The rain quickened the dying flowers.

entries.definition_cn: 孕妇首次感觉到胎儿运动的阶段
entries.definition_en: the stage of pregnancy at which the mother first feels the movements of the fetus
entries.example_cn: 她在二十周时第一次感觉到了宝宝的胎动。
entries.example_en: She felt the quickening of her baby for the first time at twenty weeks.

entries.definition_cn: 复苏或变得活跃的过程
entries.definition_en: the process of coming to life or becoming more active
entries.example_cn: 经济复苏的迹象在股市上涨中显而易见。
entries.example_en: The quickening of the economy was evident in the rising stock market.

entries.definition_en: the act of accelerating; increasing the speed
entries.example_cn: 汽车引擎的加速使其能够超越卡车。
entries.example_en: The quickening of the car's engine allowed it to overtake the truck.

entries.definition_cn: 短暂的性接触，尤指随意发生的性行为
entries.definition_en: a brief sexual encounter, especially a casual one
entries.example_cn: 他们在准备参加聚会前进行了一次短暂的性行为。
entries.example_en: They had a quickie before getting ready for the party.

entries.definition_en: a repair done hurriedly
entries.example_cn: 出发前我们需要对汽车进行一次速修。
entries.example_en: We need a quickie on the car before the trip.

entries.definition_en: a white crystalline oxide used in the production of calcium hydroxide
entries.example_cn: 建筑工人生石灰制作灰浆。
entries.example_en: Builders use quicklime to make mortar.

entries.definition_en: with speed
entries.example_cn: 汽车在高速公路上迅速行驶。
entries.example_en: The car moved quickly down the highway.

entries.definition_en: with little or no delay
entries.example_cn: 请尽快回复这封邮件。
entries.example_en: Please reply quickly to this email.

entries.definition_en: without taking pains
entries.example_cn: 他草率地完成了报告，没有核实事实。
entries.example_en: He quickly finished the report without checking the facts.

entries.definition_cn: 动作或活动的迅速；敏捷
entries.definition_en: rapidity of movement or activity
entries.example_cn: 她动作敏捷，躲开了掉落的树枝。
entries.example_en: The quickness of her movements helped her avoid the falling branches.

entries.definition_en: skillful performance or ability without difficulty
entries.example_cn: 外科医生在手术中的熟练程度显而易见。
entries.example_en: The surgeon's quickness was evident in the smooth operation.

entries.definition_en: intelligence as revealed by an ability to give correct responses without delay
entries.example_cn: 这孩子解题的敏捷让老师印象深刻。
entries.example_en: The child's quickness in solving the puzzle impressed the teacher.

entries.definition_en: a pit filled with loose wet sand that sucks objects down
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行者避开了河边的流沙。
entries.example_en: The hikers avoided the quicksand near the riverbank.

entries.definition_en: a dangerous situation that traps and destroys people
entries.example_cn: 丑闻爆发后，该公司陷入了困境。
entries.example_en: The company found itself in quicksand after the scandal broke.

entries.definition_cn: 由直接种植在地里的插条长成的
entries.definition_en: grown from cuttings planted directly in the ground
entries.example_cn: 花园里由插条长成的山楂篱笆比由种子长成的要强壮得多。
entries.example_en: The quickset hedges in the garden are much stronger than those grown from seeds.

entries.definition_cn: 用于培育山楂篱笆或葡萄藤的插条；由此形成的篱笆
entries.definition_en: cuttings used to grow hawthorn hedges or vines, or the hedge produced from them
entries.example_cn: 农夫种植了插条以在田地周围建立坚固的边界。
entries.example_en: The farmer planted quickset to create a sturdy boundary around the field.

entries.definition_en: a heavy, silvery, toxic metal that is liquid at ordinary temperatures
entries.example_cn: 那个旧温度计里含有水银，现在被视为危险废物。
entries.example_en: The old thermometer contained quicksilver, which is now considered hazardous waste.

entries.definition_en: liable to sudden and unpredictable change
entries.example_cn: 这位政治家变幻莫测的脾气使得同事们很难与他共事。
entries.example_en: The politician's quicksilver temper made it difficult for his colleagues to work with him.

entries.definition_en: a lively ballroom dance characterized by alternating quick and slow steps
entries.example_cn: 这对夫妇随着轻快的音乐跳起了优雅的快步舞。
entries.example_en: The couple performed a graceful quickstep to the upbeat music.

entries.definition_en: a military march performed at a fast pace
entries.example_cn: 士兵们以快步军行进，以示纪律严明。
entries.example_en: The soldiers marched in a quickstep to show their discipline.

entries.definition_en: to dance or move in a quickstep
entries.example_cn: 他们在舞会比赛中在地板上跳起了快步舞。
entries.example_en: They quickstepped across the floor during the ballroom competition.

entries.definition_en: a hurried repair
entries.example_cn: 比赛前，机械师对引擎进行了匆忙的修理。
entries.example_en: The mechanic performed a quicky on the engine before the race.

entries.definition_en: a pound sterling (£1), especially in colloquial British usage
entries.example_cn: 他用一张二十英镑的钞票和一英镑付了餐费。
entries.example_en: He paid for the meal with a twenty-pound note and a quid.

entries.definition_en: something for something; that which a party receives (or is promised) in return for something they do or give or promise
entries.example_cn: 该公司以一份新合同作为回报。
entries.example_en: The company offered a quid pro quo in the form of a new contract.

entries.definition_en: a wad of something chewable as tobacco
entries.example_cn: 他把一块嚼烟含在脸颊里。
entries.example_en: He kept a quid of tobacco in his cheek.

entries.definition_en: the essential nature or quality that makes something what it is
entries.example_cn: 这部小说的本质在于其对幽默与悲伤的独特融合。
entries.example_en: The quiddity of the novel lies in its unusual blend of humor and grief.

entries.definition_en: an evasion of the point of an argument by raising irrelevant distinctions or objections
entries.example_cn: 他的回答是一种诡辩，回避了主要问题。
entries.example_en: His answer was a quiddity that avoided addressing the main issue.

entries.definition_en: a state of quiet but possibly temporary inaction
entries.example_cn: 火山在再次喷发前进入了一段静止期。
entries.example_en: The volcano entered a period of quiescence before erupting again.

entries.definition_en: quiet and inactive restfulness
entries.example_cn: 图书馆为学生们提供了一个宁静的避风港，供他们备考。
entries.example_en: The library offers a sanctuary of quiescence for students studying for exams.

entries.definition_en: not active or activated
entries.example_cn: 这座火山在沉寂了数十年后终于爆发。
entries.example_en: The volcano remained quiescent for decades before erupting.

entries.definition_cn: 安静的；静止的；不活动的
entries.definition_en: being quiet or still or inactive
entries.example_cn: 平静的湖面完美地倒映着群山。
entries.example_en: The quiescent lake reflected the mountains perfectly.

entries.definition_en: marked by a state of tranquil repose
entries.example_cn: 在清晨的微光中，花园显得格外宁静。
entries.example_en: The garden was quiescent in the cool morning light.

entries.definition_cn: （疾病或病理过程）处于静止期的；不发展的
entries.definition_en: inactive or not progressing, especially of a disease or pathological process
entries.example_cn: 肿瘤有数月处于静止期。
entries.example_en: The tumor remained quiescent for several months.

entries.definition_en: free of noise or uproar; or making little if any sound
entries.example_cn: 请在图书馆保持安静。
entries.example_en: Please keep quiet in the library.

entries.definition_en: characterized by an absence or near absence of agitation or activity
entries.example_cn: 村庄在夜间保持无骚动。
entries.example_en: The village remained quiet during the night.

entries.definition_en: become quiet or quieter
entries.example_cn: 演讲者开始时，人群安静了下来。
entries.example_en: The crowd quieted as the speaker began.

entries.definition_en: make calm or still
entries.example_cn: 这种药让婴儿停止了哭泣。
entries.example_en: The medicine quieted the baby's crying.

entries.definition_en: an untroubled state; free from disturbances
entries.example_cn: 他在忙碌的生活中寻求片刻安宁。
entries.example_en: He sought some quiet in his busy life.

entries.definition_en: with little or no activity or no agitation (‘quiet’ is a nonstandard variant for ‘quietly’)
entries.example_cn: 她安静地坐在角落里。
entries.example_en: She sat quiet in the corner.

entries.definition_en: the absence of sound
entries.example_cn: 森林里一片寂静。
entries.example_en: There was a deep quiet in the forest.

entries.definition_en: a period of calm weather
entries.example_cn: 风暴过后，我们等待一段平静期。
entries.example_en: The storm passed, and we waited for a quiet spell.

entries.definition_en: to become quiet or quieter
entries.example_cn: 当演讲者走向讲台时，人群开始安静下来。
entries.example_en: The crowd began to quieten as the speaker approached the podium.

entries.definition_en: to make calm or still
entries.example_cn: 她试图用魔法咒语使汹涌的水面平静下来。
entries.example_en: She tried to quieten the stormy waters with her magic spell.

entries.definition_cn: 使某人安静或停止说话
entries.definition_en: to cause someone to be quiet or stop talking
entries.example_cn: 老师必须在开始上课前让吵闹的班级安静下来。
entries.example_en: The teacher had to quieten the noisy class before starting the lesson.

entries.definition_en: a religious belief that requires withdrawing from all human activity to passively contemplate God
entries.example_cn: 寂静主义是17世纪的一个有争议的运动，它强调被动沉思而非人为努力。
entries.example_en: Quietism was a controversial movement in the 17th century that emphasized passive contemplation over human effort.

entries.definition_cn: 不积极参与社会或政治活动的人
entries.definition_en: a person who is not socially or politically active
entries.example_cn: 与身边的积极分子不同，他是个不参与政治和社会运动的人。
entries.example_en: Unlike the activists around him, he was a quietist who avoided political and social campaigns.

entries.definition_cn: 一位主张避免积极参与世俗事务的宗教神秘主义者
entries.definition_en: a religious mystic who believes in avoiding active involvement in the world
entries.example_cn: 这位神秘主义者修士整天都在进行无声的祈祷和冥想。
entries.example_en: The quietist monk spent his days in silent prayer and meditation.

entries.definition_en: with low volume
entries.example_cn: 请小声说话，别吵醒宝宝。
entries.example_en: Please speak quietly so we don't wake the baby.

entries.definition_en: with little or no sound
entries.example_cn: 猫无声地穿过地板。
entries.example_en: The cat moved quietly across the floor.

entries.definition_en: with little or no activity or agitation
entries.example_cn: 风暴过去了，大海平静下来。
entries.example_en: The storm passed, and the sea settled quietly.

entries.definition_en: in a restful manner
entries.example_cn: 长途旅行后，她安详地睡着了。
entries.example_en: She slept quietly after the long journey.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being silent or making no noise
entries.example_cn: 图书馆的寂静让我们能够安静地学习。
entries.example_en: The quietness of the library allowed us to study in peace.

entries.definition_en: a state of peace and quiet
entries.example_cn: 暴风雨过后，村庄里一片宁静。
entries.example_en: After the storm, there was a profound quietness over the village.

entries.definition_en: a state of peace and quiet
entries.example_cn: 她寻求修道院的宁静以找到内心的平静。
entries.example_en: She sought the quietude of the monastery to find inner peace.

entries.definition_en: death, especially as a euphemism
entries.example_cn: 这部小说把死亡称为“解脱”。
entries.example_en: The novel refers to death as a quietus.

entries.definition_cn: 将前额头发向上梳起或用发胶定型的发型；飞机头
entries.definition_en: a hairstyle in which the forelock is brushed or gelled upward
entries.example_cn: 他把头发梳成了高高的刘海。
entries.example_en: He styled his hair into a high quiff.

entries.definition_en: a pen made from a bird's feather
entries.example_cn: 他用羽毛笔在旧书上写下了自己的名字。
entries.example_en: He wrote his name in the old book with a quill.

entries.definition_cn: 鸟类较大的翼羽或尾羽
entries.definition_en: any of the larger wing or tail feathers of a bird
entries.example_cn: 老鹰展开它的翼羽以捕捉气流。
entries.example_en: The eagle spread its quills to catch the wind.

entries.definition_cn: 豪猪或刺猬身上的硬空心刺
entries.definition_en: a stiff hollow protective spine on a porcupine or hedgehog
entries.example_cn: 当感到受威胁时，豪猪竖起了它的刺。
entries.example_en: The porcupine raised its quills when it felt threatened.

entries.definition_cn: 羽毛下部没有羽枝的中空羽轴
entries.definition_en: the hollow lower shaft of a feather, the part without barbs
entries.example_cn: 这根羽毛的羽轴是中空的，而且没有羽枝。
entries.example_en: The feather's quill was hollow and had no barbs.

entries.definition_en: bedding made of two layers of cloth filled with stuffing and stitched together
entries.example_cn: 她把暖和的被子拉到下巴处。
entries.example_en: She pulled the warm quilt up to her chin.

entries.definition_en: to create something by stitching layers together
entries.example_cn: 她的祖母教她如何制作拼布图案。
entries.example_en: Her grandmother taught her how to quilt a patchwork design.

entries.definition_en: to stitch or sew together layers of fabric
entries.example_cn: 他们花了一下午的时间绗缝新的被芯。
entries.example_en: They spent the afternoon quilting the new comforter.

entries.definition_en: made of layers of fabric held together by patterned stitching
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一件保暖的绗缝夹克去参加冬季节日庆典。
entries.example_en: She wore a warm, quilted jacket to the winter festival.

entries.definition_en: the craft of stitching through layers of fabric and filling to create a design
entries.example_cn: 她花了一下午在新项目上练习绗缝。
entries.example_en: She spent the afternoon practicing quilting on her new project.

entries.definition_en: a material used for making a quilt or a quilted fabric
entries.example_cn: 这件夹克采用柔软的绗缝面料来保暖。
entries.example_en: The jacket uses soft quilting to keep the wearer warm.

entries.definition_en: one of five children born at the same time from the same pregnancy
