entries.definition_en: relating to mean-tone temperament, in which major thirds are tuned pure
entries.example_cn: 作曲家在这部新作品中尝试了中庸律调音。
entries.example_en: The composer experimented with tertian tuning in the new piece.

entries.definition_en: of the third rank, order, or level; coming after the first and second
entries.example_cn: 经济中的第三部门包括银行和教育等服务。
entries.example_en: The tertiary sector of the economy includes services like banking and education.

entries.definition_en: a unit used to measure magnetic flux density
entries.example_cn: 核磁共振机的磁场强度以特斯拉为单位进行测量。
entries.example_en: The magnetic field of the MRI machine is measured in teslas.

entries.definition_en: to fit together exactly, especially when made of identical shapes
entries.example_cn: 地板瓷砖完美镶嵌，形成几何图案。
entries.example_en: The floor tiles tessellate perfectly to form a geometric pattern.

entries.definition_en: to cover a surface with small square or rectangular pieces
entries.example_cn: 工人们用彩色瓷砖铺砌了古老的墙壁。
entries.example_en: Workers tessellated the ancient wall with colorful tiles.

entries.definition_en: decorated with small pieces of colored glass or stone fitted together
entries.example_cn: 教堂的墙壁装饰着复杂的马赛克图案。
entries.example_en: The church wall was tessellated with intricate mosaics.

entries.definition_cn: 呈棋盘格或斑驳外观的
entries.definition_en: having a checkered or mottled appearance
entries.example_cn: 这只蝴蝶的翅膀呈现出棋盘格图案。
entries.example_en: The butterfly's tessellated wings had a checkered pattern.

entries.definition_en: the careful juxtaposition of shapes in a pattern
entries.example_cn: 地板上有复杂的几何形状镶嵌图案。
entries.example_en: The floor features an intricate tessellation of geometric shapes.

entries.definition_cn: 无缝铺满区域或平面的镶嵌图案
entries.definition_en: a tiling pattern formed by tessellating an area or plane without gaps
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家花了数年时间完善教堂天花板的镶嵌装饰。
entries.example_en: The artist spent years perfecting the tessellation of the church ceiling.

entries.definition_cn: 用于制作马赛克的小方块（石、木、象牙或玻璃）
entries.definition_en: a small square piece of stone, wood, ivory, or glass used for making a mosaic
entries.example_cn: 古老的地板是由彩色的马赛克小方块铺成的。
entries.example_en: The ancient floor was made of colorful tesserae.

entries.definition_en: a four-dimensional shape that is the analogue of a cube
entries.example_cn: 这位数学家难以在三维空间中想象超立方体。
entries.example_en: The mathematician struggled to visualize a tesseract in three dimensions.

entries.definition_en: a set of questions to evaluate skill or knowledge
entries.example_cn: 期末考试将决定你的成绩。
entries.example_en: The final test will determine your grade.

entries.definition_en: the act of trying something to find out about it
entries.example_cn: 新软件的测试花了三天时间。
entries.example_en: The test of the new software took three days.

entries.definition_en: a procedure for measuring ability or knowledge
entries.example_cn: 学生们昨天做了一次数学测验。
entries.example_en: The students took a math test yesterday.

entries.definition_en: to examine something to find out its quality
entries.example_cn: 科学家将测试水中的污染情况。
entries.example_en: Scientists will test the water for pollution.

entries.definition_en: to examine someone's knowledge
entries.example_cn: 老师将考核全班同学的语法知识。
entries.example_en: The teacher will test the class on grammar.

entries.definition_en: to check for disease or infection
entries.example_cn: 你应该定期检测血液。
entries.example_en: You should test your blood regularly.

entries.definition_en: the act of being tested
entries.example_cn: 新发动机的测试花了三天时间。
entries.example_en: The test of the new engine took three days.

entries.definition_en: to show a certain characteristic when examined
entries.example_cn: 该材料在高压下表现良好。
entries.example_en: The material tested well under high pressure.

entries.definition_en: to drive a car or other vehicle to check how it works before buying it
entries.example_cn: 我们在购买前决定试驾那辆新车。
entries.example_en: We decided to test-drive the new electric car before making a purchase.

entries.definition_en: to try out a product to see if it is suitable before committing to buy it
entries.example_cn: 该公司允许客户试用其软件一周。
entries.example_en: The company allows customers to test-drive their software for a week.

entries.definition_en: the hard outer covering of a seed
entries.example_cn: 坚硬的种皮保护着种子内部的胚。
entries.example_en: The hard testa protects the embryo inside the seed.

entries.definition_cn: 棘皮动物（如海胆）坚硬的石灰质内骨骼
entries.definition_en: the hard, calcareous endoskeleton of an echinoderm, such as a sea urchin
entries.example_cn: 海胆的内骨骼保护着它柔软的内部器官。
entries.example_en: The sea urchin's testa protects its soft internal organs.

entries.definition_en: relating to a will or the distribution of property after death
entries.example_cn: 文件中的遗嘱条款确保了慈善机构能继承遗产。
entries.example_en: The testamentary provisions in the document ensure the charity receives the inheritance.

entries.definition_en: having made a legally valid will before death
entries.example_cn: 死者立有遗嘱，因此遗产按照遗嘱分配。
entries.example_en: The deceased was testate, so the estate was distributed according to the will.

entries.definition_en: a person who has left a valid will
entries.example_cn: 这位立遗嘱者将他所有的财产都留给了他的慈善机构。
entries.example_en: The testate left his entire fortune to his charity.

entries.definition_en: a person who makes a legal will
entries.example_cn: 遗嘱人在遗嘱中将他的所有财产留给了他的慈善机构。
entries.example_en: The testator left all his property to his charity in his will.

entries.definition_en: a person who administers a test
entries.example_cn: 考官在考试开始前解释了规则。
entries.example_en: The tester explained the rules before the exam began.

entries.definition_en: a device used for testing
entries.example_cn: 技术员用检测仪检查电池。
entries.example_en: The technician used a tester to check the battery.

entries.definition_en: a flat canopy covering a bed
entries.example_cn: 床顶篷装饰着精致的蕾丝。
entries.example_en: The tester was decorated with intricate lace.

entries.definition_en: one of the two male reproductive organs that produce sperm and male hormones
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了他的睾丸以查看是否有任何异常。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined his testicle to check for any abnormalities.

entries.definition_en: relating to or involving the testes
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了他的睾丸健康状况。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined his testicular health.

entries.definition_en: to give formal evidence in a court of law
entries.example_cn: 证人将作证讲述他在事故发生当晚所见到的情况。
entries.example_en: The witness will testify about what he saw on the night of the accident.

entries.definition_en: to provide evidence or proof for something
entries.example_cn: 新数据证明了这种治疗方法的有效性。
entries.example_en: The new data testify to the effectiveness of the treatment.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows irritation or impatience
entries.example_cn: 她烦躁地回答了那个问题，显然对被打断感到恼火。
entries.example_en: She answered the question testily, clearly annoyed by the interruption.

entries.definition_en: something that recommends a person or thing as worthy or desirable
entries.example_cn: 他在申请中附上了一位前上司的推荐信。
entries.example_en: He included a testimonial from his former boss in his application.

entries.definition_en: a statement or document serving as testimony or evidence
entries.example_cn: 证人向法院提供了证据。
entries.example_en: The witness provided a testimonial to the court.

entries.definition_en: something given or done as an expression of esteem
entries.example_cn: 这支球队收到了球迷们的致敬。
entries.example_en: The team received a testimonial from their fans.

entries.definition_en: expressing admiration or appreciation
entries.example_cn: 这场表彰晚宴向即将退休的教练表达了敬意。
entries.example_en: The testimonial dinner honored the retiring coach.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to or constituting testimony
entries.example_cn: 证词证据对案件至关重要。
entries.example_en: The testimonial evidence was crucial to the case.

entries.definition_en: a solemn statement made under oath
entries.example_cn: 证人在法庭上作证。
entries.example_en: The witness gave testimony in court.

entries.definition_en: an assertion offering firsthand authentication of a fact
entries.example_cn: 她的证词证实了这个故事。
entries.example_en: Her testimony confirmed the story.

entries.definition_en: something that serves as evidence
entries.example_cn: 那封旧信是他爱的证据。
entries.example_en: The old letter was testimony of his love.

entries.definition_cn: 将某物置于实验测试中以确定其性能的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of subjecting something to an experimental test to determine how well it works
entries.example_cn: 该公司目前正在测试新软件中的错误。
entries.example_en: The company is currently testing the new software for bugs.

entries.definition_en: an examination of the characteristics of something
entries.example_cn: 水质检测显示污染水平很高。
entries.example_en: The testing of the water revealed high levels of pollution.

entries.definition_cn: 给学生或候选人进行测试以确定其知识的行为
entries.definition_en: the act of giving students or candidates a test to determine their knowledge
entries.example_cn: 老师花了一上午的时间测试学生的语法知识。
entries.example_en: The teacher spent the morning testing the students on their grammar.

entries.definition_en: difficult or tough
entries.example_cn: 这次艰苦的攀登比我们预想的更难。
entries.example_en: The testing climb was harder than we had expected.

entries.definition_en: one of the two male reproductive glands that produce sperm and male hormones
entries.example_cn: 睾丸产生精子并分泌雄激素。
entries.example_en: The testis produces spermatozoa and secretes androgens.

entries.definition_en: a potent androgenic hormone produced chiefly by the testes; responsible for the development of male secondary sex characteristics
entries.example_cn: 睾酮水平通常在青春期达到峰值。
entries.example_en: Testosterone levels typically peak during adolescence.

entries.definition_cn: （比喻）男子气概；尤指好斗或鲁莽的行为
entries.definition_en: manly behavior, especially aggressive or foolishly reckless behavior (figurative)
entries.example_cn: 母亲劝詹姆斯在应付邻居家的儿子时多靠智慧，少凭血气之勇。
entries.example_en: Mother encouraged James to rely more on intelligence and less on testosterone to deal with the neighbor's son.

entries.definition_en: a movable protective covering used by Roman troops to shield themselves from above when approaching enemy walls
entries.example_cn: 罗马士兵组成龟甲阵以保护自己免受落石伤害。
entries.example_en: The Roman soldiers formed a testudo to protect themselves from falling stones.

entries.definition_en: easily irritated or annoyed
entries.example_cn: 当交通延误时，他变得易怒。
entries.example_en: He became testy when the traffic was delayed.

entries.definition_en: relating to or causing tetanus
entries.example_cn: 感染后，患者出现了强直性肌肉痉挛。
entries.example_en: The patient developed tetanic muscle spasms after the infection.

entries.definition_cn: 与手足搐搦有关的；引起手足搐搦的
entries.definition_en: relating to or causing tetany
entries.example_cn: 患者因低钙血症出现了手足搐搦症状。
entries.example_en: The patient exhibited tetanic symptoms caused by hypocalcemia.

entries.definition_cn: 一种通常在伤口感染后由破伤风梭菌产生的毒素引起、导致肌肉僵硬和痉挛的疾病
entries.definition_en: a disease caused by toxin produced by Clostridium tetani, usually after wound infection, causing muscle stiffness and spasms
entries.example_cn: 医生警告他，如果不正确处理，深伤口可能会导致破伤风。
entries.example_en: The doctor warned him that a deep cut could lead to tetanus if not treated properly.

entries.definition_en: a sustained muscular contraction caused by a rapid series of nerve impulses
entries.example_cn: 一连串快速刺激使肌纤维发生持续性强直收缩。
entries.example_en: A rapid series of stimuli produced a sustained tetanus in the muscle fibers.

entries.definition_cn: 手足搐搦症：引起不自主肌肉抽搐、痉挛，有时导致癫痫发作的疾病，常与低钙、维生素D缺乏、甲状旁腺功能减退或碱中毒有关
entries.definition_en: a medical condition causing involuntary muscle twitching, cramps, and sometimes seizures, often associated with low calcium or vitamin D levels, hypoparathyroidism, or alkalosis
entries.example_cn: 该患者因甲状旁腺功能减退导致严重的手足搐搦症而住院。
entries.example_en: The patient was admitted to the hospital for severe tetany caused by hypoparathyroidism.

entries.definition_en: easily irritated or annoyed by small things
entries.example_cn: 交通缓慢时，他变得易怒起来。
entries.example_en: He became tetchy when the traffic was slow.

usage.label: Commonwealth; Ireland; Southern US; UK
usage.pattern: Source w40519r0 labels this adjective for these varieties.

entries.definition_en: a private conversation between two people
entries.example_cn: 经理要求与新员工进行二人密谈，以讨论期望。
entries.example_en: The manager requested a tete-a-tete with the new employee to discuss expectations.

entries.definition_en: a small sofa designed to seat two people
entries.example_cn: 客厅里壁炉旁摆放着一张舒适的双人沙发。
entries.example_en: The living room featured a cozy tete-a-tete by the fireplace.

entries.definition_en: involving two persons; intimately private
entries.example_cn: 他们在等火车时分享了一段二人私密的时刻。
entries.example_en: They shared a tete-a-tete moment while waiting for the train.

entries.definition_cn: 泰特（希伯来字母第九个字母）
entries.definition_en: the ninth letter of the Hebrew alphabet
entries.example_cn: 在这篇古文中，单词以字母泰特开头。
entries.example_en: In the ancient text, the word begins with the letter teth.

entries.definition_en: a rope or chain used to restrain an animal
entries.example_cn: 狗被一根长拴绳拴在柱子上。
entries.example_en: The dog was tied to a post with a long tether.

entries.definition_en: to tie with a tether
entries.example_cn: 他们把马拴在栅栏上。
entries.example_en: They tethered the horse to the fence.

entries.definition_en: a game where players hit a ball attached to a pole with rackets to wrap the string around the pole
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在校园里玩系绳球。
entries.example_en: The children played tetherball in the schoolyard.

entries.definition_en: confined or restricted as if by a rope or chain
entries.example_cn: 那只狗被拴在花园的柱子上。
entries.example_en: The dog was tethered to a post in the garden.

entries.definition_cn: 脂鲤科或脂鲤目等小型淡水鱼，常作为观赏鱼饲养
entries.definition_en: a small freshwater fish of the South American Characidae or West African Alestidae families, often kept in aquariums
entries.example_cn: 水族馆展示了一缸色彩鲜艳的脂鲤。
entries.example_en: The aquarium displayed a tank full of vibrant tetras.

entries.definition_en: a chloride compound containing four chlorine atoms in each molecule
entries.example_cn: 四氯化碳过去常被用作溶剂。
entries.example_en: Carbon tetrachloride was once commonly used as a solvent.

entries.definition_cn: 用于治疗钩虫和其他线虫感染的驱虫药
entries.definition_en: an anthelmintic used to treat hookworm and other nematode infections
entries.example_cn: 医生开了四氯乙烯作为驱虫药，治疗患者的钩虫感染。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed tetrachloroethylene as an anthelmintic to treat the patient's hookworm infection.

entries.definition_cn: 四环素类广谱抗生素，可由链霉菌产生或人工合成
entries.definition_en: A broad-spectrum antibiotic of the tetracycline group, produced by Streptomyces or synthetically.
entries.example_cn: 医生开了四环素来治疗细菌感染。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed tetracycline to treat the bacterial infection.

entries.definition_cn: 四个一组的事物；四元组
entries.definition_en: a group or set of four things
entries.example_cn: 旗帜上的四种颜色代表四个季节。
entries.example_en: The tetrad of colors on the flag represents the four seasons.

entries.definition_en: a flammable gas containing fluorine used to make certain plastics
entries.example_cn: 四氟乙烯是一种用于制造不粘涂层的危险气体。
entries.example_en: Tetrafluoroethylene is a dangerous gas that is used to manufacture non-stick coatings.

entries.definition_en: a polygon with four sides
entries.example_cn: 黑板上的几何图形是一个正四边形。
entries.example_en: The geometric shape on the board was a regular tetragon.

entries.definition_cn: 四边形的；（晶体）四方晶系的
entries.definition_en: having four sides; specifically, in crystallography, having two equal axes and one unequal axis, with all angles 90°
entries.example_cn: 这种矿物的晶体结构属于四方晶系。
entries.example_en: The crystal structure of the mineral is tetragonal.

entries.definition_en: a solid shape with four flat faces
entries.example_cn: 桌面上展示了一个四面体模型。
entries.example_en: The model of a tetrahedron was displayed on the desk.

entries.definition_en: psychoactive substance present in marijuana
entries.example_cn: 四氢大麻酚是大麻中的主要活性成分。
entries.example_en: Tetrahydrocannabinol is the main active ingredient in cannabis.

entries.definition_en: a type of single-celled organism related to paramecium, often used in genetic studies
entries.example_cn: 科学家利用四膜虫作为模式生物来研究细胞过程。
entries.example_en: Scientists use tetrahymena as a model organism to study cellular processes.

entries.definition_en: a series of four related works (plays or operas or novels)
entries.example_cn: 作者写了一部关于帝国历史的四部曲。
entries.example_en: The author wrote a tetralogy about the history of the empire.

entries.definition_en: a line of verse containing four metrical feet
entries.example_cn: 这首诗的开头诗行是节奏鲜明的四步格诗行。
entries.example_en: The opening line of the poem is a rhythmic tetrameter.

entries.definition_en: a vertebrate animal that has four legs or leglike appendages
entries.example_cn: 人类、狗和青蛙都是四足动物的例子。
entries.example_en: Humans, dogs, and frogs are all examples of tetrapods.

entries.definition_en: having a valence of four
entries.example_cn: 碳是一种四价元素，能与其它原子形成四个键。
entries.example_en: Carbon is a tetravalent element that forms four bonds with other atoms.

entries.definition_cn: 具有四种抗原价的；四价的
entries.definition_en: having four vaccine valences
entries.example_cn: 这种新的四价疫苗针对该病毒的四种毒株。
entries.example_en: The new tetravalent vaccine targets four strains of the virus.

entries.definition_en: an electronic vacuum tube with four electrodes
entries.example_cn: 那台旧收音机使用四极管来放大信号。
entries.example_en: The old radio used a tetrode to amplify the signal.

entries.definition_cn: 存在于河豚等动物体内的一种强效神经毒素
entries.definition_en: a powerful neurotoxin found in pufferfish and some other animals
entries.example_cn: 科学家们正在研究河豚毒素以开发新型止痛药。
entries.example_en: Scientists are studying tetrodotoxin to develop new painkillers.

entries.definition_en: a chemical compound containing four oxygen atoms in its molecule
entries.example_cn: 科学家分析了该金属四氧化物的结构。
entries.example_en: The scientist analyzed the structure of the metal tetroxide.

entries.definition_en: the topmost cabin deck on a steamboat
entries.example_cn: 乘客们聚集在汽船的顶层客舱欣赏日落。
entries.example_en: The passengers gathered on the texas to watch the sunset.

entries.definition_en: to send a message by SMS or similar text-based messaging service
entries.example_cn: 我给朋友发了短信，告诉她我迟到了。
entries.example_en: I texted my friend to let her know I was late.

entries.definition_en: words that are written down
entries.example_cn: 这封信的文字非常正式。
entries.example_en: The text of the letter was very formal.

entries.definition_en: the main body of a written work, excluding illustrations or footnotes
entries.example_cn: 这部小说的正文分为三部分。
entries.example_en: The text of the novel is divided into three parts.

entries.definition_en: a book prepared for use in schools or colleges
entries.example_cn: 学生必须购买这门课的新教科书。
entries.example_en: Students must buy the new text for the course.

entries.definition_en: a passage from the Bible used as the subject of a sermon
entries.example_cn: 牧师宣读了周日讲道的经文。
entries.example_en: The minister read the text for the Sunday sermon.

entries.definition_en: a book prepared for use in schools or colleges
entries.example_cn: 学生必须在学期开始前购买新教科书。
entries.example_en: Students must buy the new textbook before the semester starts.

entries.definition_en: typical or characteristic of a textbook case
entries.example_cn: 医生描述了一个典型的流感病例。
entries.example_en: The doctor described a textbook case of the flu.

entries.definition_en: a cloth or fabric made by weaving, knitting, or felting fibers
entries.example_cn: 这家工厂生产高质量的棉纺织品。
entries.example_en: The factory produces high-quality cotton textiles.

entries.definition_en: relating to fabrics or the making of cloth
entries.example_cn: 她在大学主修纺织工程。
entries.example_en: She studied textile engineering at university.

entries.definition_en: the act of sending messages via SMS
entries.example_cn: 开车时发短信很危险。
entries.example_en: Texting while driving is dangerous.

entries.definition_en: relating to or based on a written text
entries.example_cn: 对这部小说的文本分析揭示了隐藏的主题。
entries.example_en: The textual analysis of the novel revealed hidden themes.

entries.definition_en: the feel of a surface or a fabric
entries.example_cn: 这件羊毛衫的质地非常柔软。
entries.example_en: The texture of the wool sweater was very soft.

entries.definition_en: the characteristic appearance of a surface having a tactile quality
entries.example_cn: 石墙粗糙的表面特征令人印象深刻。
entries.example_en: The rough texture of the stone wall was impressive.

entries.definition_en: the essential quality of something
entries.example_cn: 他的写作风格独具特色。
entries.example_en: The texture of his writing is unique.

entries.definition_en: the musical pattern created by parts being played or sung together
entries.example_cn: 作曲家专注于管弦乐的织体。
entries.example_en: The composer focused on the texture of the orchestra.

entries.definition_en: the physical composition of something (especially with respect to the size and shape of the small constituents of a substance)
entries.example_cn: 科学家研究土壤的质地以了解其成分。
entries.example_en: Scientists study the texture of the soil to understand its composition.

entries.definition_en: having a rough or uneven surface
entries.example_cn: 艺术家选择了一张有纹理的画布，以在画作中创造深度。
entries.example_en: The artist chose a textured canvas to create depth in the painting.

entries.definition_en: relating to the connections between the thalamus and the cerebral cortex
entries.example_cn: 丘脑皮层通路在感觉信息处理中起着至关重要的作用。
entries.example_en: The thalamocortical pathway plays a crucial role in processing sensory information.

entries.definition_en: an egg-shaped mass of grey matter in the brain that forms part of the diencephalon
entries.example_cn: 丘脑充当感觉信息的中继站。
entries.example_en: The thalamus acts as a relay station for sensory information.

entries.definition_en: a genetic blood disorder where the body cannot make enough hemoglobin
entries.example_cn: 地中海贫血是一种由血红蛋白合成缺陷引起的遗传性贫血。
entries.example_en: Thalassaemia is an inherited form of anemia caused by faulty synthesis of hemoglobin.

entries.definition_cn: 因珠蛋白合成异常导致血红蛋白生成减少的一组遗传性贫血疾病
entries.definition_en: an inherited group of disorders involving reduced hemoglobin production due to defective globin synthesis
entries.example_cn: 这名患者在出生时就被诊断出患有地中海贫血。
entries.example_en: The patient was diagnosed with thalassemia at birth.

entries.definition_cn: 一种曾用作镇静催眠药和止吐药、因导致严重出生缺陷而撤市、现用于治疗麻风病的药物
entries.definition_en: a drug once used as a sedative, hypnotic, and antiemetic, withdrawn after causing severe birth defects and now used to treat leprosy
entries.example_cn: 沙利度胺丑闻导致了更严格的药物监管。
entries.example_en: The thalidomide scandal led to stricter drug regulations.

entries.definition_en: a soft grey metallic element that is highly toxic
entries.example_cn: 铊是一种剧毒元素，用于某些杀虫剂中。
entries.example_en: Thallium is a highly toxic element used in some insect poisons.

entries.definition_cn: 未分化的植物体；叶状体
entries.definition_en: an undifferentiated plant body, such as that of an alga, lacking true stems, roots, and leaves
entries.example_cn: 这种藻类形成了简单的叶状体，而不是由明显的根、茎和叶组成的结构。
entries.example_en: The alga formed a simple thallus instead of distinct roots, stems, and leaves.

entries.definition_en: the middle of the main navigable channel of a waterway that serves as a boundary between states
entries.example_cn: 该条约规定沿河流的界河主航道中心线划定边界。
entries.example_en: The treaty defined the border along the thalweg of the river.

entries.definition_en: a line connecting the lowest points along the bottom of a valley
entries.example_cn: 冰川通常沿着山谷的最低点连线流动。
entries.example_en: Glaciers often follow the thalweg of a mountain valley.

entries.definition_en: used to introduce the second element in a comparison
entries.example_cn: 她比她哥哥高。
entries.example_en: She is taller than her brother.

entries.definition_en: used after words like more, less, or fewer to introduce the second element in a comparison
entries.example_cn: 我的书比你少。
entries.example_en: I have fewer books than you.

entries.definition_en: at that time; then
entries.example_cn: 我那时更年轻。
entries.example_en: I was younger then.

entries.definition_en: the scientific study of death, including its social and psychological aspects
entries.example_cn: 大学为对临终关怀感兴趣的学生提供了一门专门的死亡学课程。
entries.example_en: The university offers a specialized course in thanatology for students interested in palliative care.

entries.definition_en: a contemplation or meditation on death
entries.example_cn: 这篇论死亡的文章反思了死亡的必然性。
entries.example_en: The thanatopsis reflects on the inevitability of death.

entries.definition_cn: 诺曼征服前英格兰的贵族，地位约相当于男爵
entries.definition_en: a nobleman in pre-Norman England, roughly equivalent to a baron
entries.example_cn: 这位塞恩以绝对权威统治着该地区。
entries.example_en: The thane ruled the district with absolute authority.

entries.definition_cn: 盎格鲁-撒克逊英格兰的贵族男子，尤指以军事服务换取土地者
entries.definition_en: a man of a noble rank in Anglo-Saxon England, especially one who gave military service in exchange for land
entries.example_cn: 作为一名塞恩，他必须为国王提供军事服务以换取庄园。
entries.example_en: As a thane, he owed military service to the king in return for his estate.

entries.definition_en: to show gratitude to someone
entries.example_cn: 我感谢你的帮助。
entries.example_en: I thank you for your help.

entries.definition_en: An expression of gratitude.
entries.example_cn: 她给主人寄了一张感谢信。
entries.example_en: She sent a thank-you note to her host.

entries.definition_en: That expresses thanks.
entries.example_cn: 演讲最后向观众致谢。
entries.example_en: The speech ended with a thank-you to the audience.

entries.definition_en: feeling or showing gratitude
entries.example_cn: 我很感激你在困难时期给予的帮助。
entries.example_en: I am thankful for your help during the difficult time.

entries.definition_en: in a thankful manner; with thanks
entries.example_cn: 病人感激地看着一直陪伴他的护士。
entries.example_en: The patient looked thankfully at the nurse who had stayed with him.

entries.definition_en: let us be thankful that
entries.example_cn: 值得庆幸的是，火车刚好赶上了。
entries.example_en: Thankfully, the train arrived just in time.

entries.definition_en: the state of being thankful
entries.example_cn: 她对所获帮助的感激之情在她的笑容中显而易见。
entries.example_en: Her thankfulness for the help she received was evident in her smile.

entries.definition_cn: 难以得到感谢或回报的
entries.definition_en: not likely to be rewarded
entries.example_cn: 她一生致力于慈善事业，这是一项难以获得回报的壮举。
entries.example_en: She devoted her life to charity, a thankless endeavor.

entries.definition_en: not feeling or showing gratitude
entries.example_cn: 他非常不知感恩，从不感谢帮助过他的人。
entries.example_en: He was so thankless that he never thanked anyone who helped him.

entries.definition_en: an expression of gratitude or appreciation
entries.example_cn: 我想对你的帮助表示感谢。
entries.example_en: I want to offer my thanks for your help.

entries.definition_en: the help or credit that someone or something provides
entries.example_cn: 项目的成功归功于团队的辛勤工作。
entries.example_en: The success of the project was thanks to the team's hard work.

entries.definition_en: introducing a clause that is the object of a verb, especially a reporting verb.
entries.example_cn: 他说他累了。
entries.example_en: He said that he was tired.

usage.label: that-clause as verb object
usage.pattern: He told me that the book is good.

entries.definition_en: introducing a clause that complements an adjective or passive participle.
entries.example_cn: 我很高兴你在这里。
entries.example_en: I am glad that you are here.

entries.definition_en: indicating something more remote than 'this'.
entries.example_cn: 那边那本书是我的。
entries.example_en: That book over there is mine.

entries.definition_cn: 那个（指代上下文中的事物）
entries.definition_en: referring to a thing, person, or idea indicated from context.
entries.example_cn: 我不喜欢那个。
entries.example_en: I don't like that.

entries.definition_en: to a given extent or degree.
entries.example_cn: 没有那么冷。
entries.example_en: It wasn't that cold.

entries.definition_en: something being indicated that is there.
entries.example_cn: 看那个。
entries.example_en: Look at that.

entries.definition_cn: （引导形容词或副词后的结果从句）
entries.definition_en: introducing a clause expressing a result after an adjective or adverb
entries.example_cn: 他跑得如此快，结果赢得了比赛。
entries.example_en: He ran so fast that he won.

entries.definition_en: introducing a clause that is the subject of a verb, especially the 'be' verb.
entries.example_cn: 她赢得了奖项令人惊讶。
entries.example_en: That she won the prize is surprising.

entries.definition_en: to cover a roof with thatch
entries.example_cn: 他们决定用茅草覆盖小屋，使其具有传统的外观。
entries.example_en: They decided to thatch the cottage to give it a traditional look.

entries.definition_cn: 用稻草等植物材料制成的屋顶
entries.definition_en: a roof made of plant material such as straw
entries.example_cn: 旧谷仓的茅草屋顶已经修补过好几次了。
entries.example_en: The thatch on the old barn has been repaired several times.

entries.definition_cn: 用作屋顶材料的植物茎秆
entries.definition_en: plant stalks used as a material for roofing
entries.example_cn: 这个村庄依赖当地的植物茎秆来满足屋顶材料的需求。
entries.example_en: The village relies on local thatch for its roofing needs.

entries.definition_cn: 像茅草屋顶材料的头发
entries.definition_en: hair resembling thatch or a thatched roof
entries.example_cn: 艺术家把这个人物画成蓬乱的茅草般头发。
entries.example_en: The artist depicted the character with a thatch of unruly hair.

entries.definition_en: a person who makes roofs using dried plant stalks or leaves
entries.example_cn: 那位老工匠用新稻草修补了屋顶。
entries.example_en: The old thatcher repaired the roof with fresh straw.

entries.definition_en: a person who practices magic or sorcery
entries.example_cn: 那位古老的巫师举行仪式治好了受伤的骑士。
entries.example_en: The ancient thaumaturge performed a ritual to heal the wounded knight.

entries.definition_en: the art of invoking supernatural powers
entries.example_cn: 这部小说探讨了古代欧洲神迹术的黑暗历史。
entries.example_en: The novel explores the dark history of thaumaturgy in ancient Europe.

entries.definition_en: an illusory feat considered magical by naive observers
entries.example_cn: 街头艺人的魔术把戏让孩子们惊叹不已，却未让大人们感到惊奇。
entries.example_en: The street performer's thaumaturgy amazed the children but not the adults.

entries.definition_en: to become or cause to become soft or liquid
entries.example_cn: 我们需要在烹饪前把肉解冻。
entries.example_en: We need to thaw the meat before cooking it.

entries.definition_en: the process of heat changing something from a solid to a liquid
entries.example_cn: 融化使结冰的湖泊变成了游泳池。
entries.example_en: The thaw turned the frozen lake into a swimming pool.

entries.definition_en: warm weather following a freeze
entries.example_cn: 农民们等待融雪期来播种。
entries.example_en: Farmers wait for the thaw to plant their crops.

entries.definition_en: a relaxation of tensions or reserve
entries.example_cn: 两国关系有所缓和。
entries.example_en: There was a thaw in relations between the two countries.

entries.definition_en: warm weather that follows a period of freezing temperatures
entries.example_cn: 回暖给花园带来了春天的最初迹象。
entries.example_en: The thawing brought the first signs of spring to the garden.

entries.definition_en: the process of becoming unfrozen, especially when heat melts ice or snow
entries.example_cn: 冰层的融化露出了河床。
entries.example_en: The thawing of the ice revealed the riverbed.

entries.definition_cn: 与比较级或'more'连用，表示与其他相似比较的关系
entries.definition_en: Used with a comparative or 'more' to show a relationship with other similar comparisons.
entries.example_cn: 你练习得越多，你就越好。
entries.example_en: The more you practice, the better you get.

entries.definition_cn: 与比较级连用，表示结果类似于该比较
entries.definition_en: Used with a comparative to indicate a result similar to that comparison.
entries.example_cn: 他并没有因此变得更明智。
entries.example_en: He was none the wiser for it.

entries.definition_en: To a greater extent than any other.
entries.example_cn: 在她的领导下，我们走得最远。
entries.example_en: We went the furthest under her leadership.

entries.definition_en: For each individual item.
entries.example_cn: 每小时的费用是五美元。
entries.example_en: The cost is five dollars the hour.

entries.definition_cn: 上演戏剧、放映电影或举办其他演出的建筑物
entries.definition_en: a building where plays, films, or other performances are presented
entries.example_cn: 我们去剧院看了一场新剧。
entries.example_en: We went to the theater to see a new play.

entries.definition_en: the art of writing and performing plays
entries.example_cn: 她很有戏剧天赋。
entries.example_en: She has a great talent for theater.

usage.label: theater as an uncountable art or profession
usage.pattern: “Work in theater” uses the sense as an uncountable art or profession.

entries.definition_en: an area where military fighting is happening
entries.example_cn: 士兵们被派往战区。
entries.example_en: The soldiers were sent to the theater of war.

entries.definition_en: a building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented
entries.example_cn: 我们去剧院看戏。
entries.example_en: We went to the theatre to see a play.

entries.definition_en: the art of writing and producing plays
entries.example_cn: 她对戏剧艺术有着浓厚的兴趣，经常撰写剧本。
entries.example_en: She has a deep interest in theatre and often writes scripts.

entries.definition_en: a region in which active military operations are in progress
entries.example_cn: 士兵们被部署到战区。
entries.example_en: The soldiers were deployed to the theatre of war.

entries.definition_en: a person who attends the theater
entries.example_cn: 每一位剧院观众都焦急地等待着幕布升起。
entries.example_en: Every theatregoer waited anxiously for the curtain to rise.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to the theater
entries.example_cn: 这位演员以戏剧性的方式登上舞台。
entries.example_en: The actor made a theatrical entrance onto the stage.

entries.definition_cn: 适合舞台或具有戏剧特征的
entries.definition_en: suited to or characteristic of the stage or theater
entries.example_cn: 这部戏过于依赖戏剧效果，而非强有力的对话。
entries.example_en: The play relied too much on theatrical effects rather than strong dialogue.

entries.definition_en: a performance of a play
entries.example_cn: 这场业余戏剧演出在几分钟内就售罄了。
entries.example_en: The amateur theatrical was sold out within minutes.

entries.definition_en: theatrical behavior and mannerisms, especially artificial or exaggerated ones
entries.example_cn: 演员过度的矫揉造作使表演显得不自然。
entries.example_en: The actor's excessive theatricality made the performance feel unnatural.

entries.definition_en: in a theatrical manner
entries.example_cn: 这部戏戏剧性地演出，配有华丽的服装和灯光。
entries.example_en: The play was performed theatrically, with elaborate costumes and lighting.

entries.definition_en: in a manner that is like a stage performance
entries.example_cn: 她说话做作，使用夸张的手势来吸引观众。
entries.example_en: She spoke theatrically, using exaggerated gestures to captivate the audience.

entries.definition_cn: 在影院上映；从戏剧或影院的角度看
entries.definition_en: in theaters, or in terms of the theater
entries.example_cn: 这部电影先在网上首映，两天后才在影院上映。
entries.example_en: The film premiered online before opening theatrically two days later.

entries.definition_cn: 博茨瓦纳普拉的百分之一；特贝
entries.definition_en: a unit of currency in Botswana where 100 thebe equal 1 pula
entries.example_cn: 她兑换了货币，收到五十特贝作为找零。
entries.example_en: She exchanged her money and received fifty thebe in change.

entries.definition_en: a case or sheath, such as a pollen sac or moss capsule
entries.example_cn: 花粉囊（即 theca）将花粉释放到空气中。
entries.example_en: The pollen sac, known as the theca, releases pollen into the air.

entries.definition_en: the outer sheath of the pupa of certain insects
entries.example_cn: 外层蛹壳在昆虫发育期间保护着蛹。
entries.example_en: The outer theca protects the insect pupa during development.

entries.definition_en: the act of stealing something that belongs to someone else
entries.example_cn: 警方正在调查一系列发生在当地商店的盗窃案。
entries.example_en: The police are investigating a series of thefts from the local shop.

entries.definition_en: Used to show that something belongs to them (a group of people or things).
entries.example_cn: 他们的房子非常大。
entries.example_en: Their house is very big.

entries.definition_en: Used to show that something belongs to a specific person or thing.
entries.example_cn: 每位学生都应该带上自己的书。
entries.example_en: Every student should bring their own book.

entries.definition_en: the belief that one or more gods exist
entries.example_cn: 有神论与无神论之间的辩论塑造了西方哲学的许多方面。
entries.example_en: The debate between theism and atheism has shaped much of Western philosophy.

entries.definition_en: a person who believes that a god or gods exist
entries.example_cn: 一位有神论者与一位无神论者之间的辩论非常激烈。
entries.example_en: The debate between a theist and an atheist was heated.

entries.definition_en: relating to the belief in the existence of a god or gods
entries.example_cn: 有神论者对宇宙的看法与无神论者的观点不同。
entries.example_en: The theist view of the universe differs from the atheist perspective.

entries.definition_en: relating to or supporting the belief in the existence of a god or gods
entries.example_cn: 这场辩论集中讨论了关于宇宙起源的有神论论点。
entries.example_en: The debate focused on theistic arguments regarding the origin of the universe.

entries.definition_en: those ones
entries.example_cn: 我非常喜欢它们。
entries.example_en: I like them very much.

entries.definition_cn: 此前提到的某一个人，性别未知、不相关或为非二元性别
entries.definition_en: a single person, previously mentioned, whose gender is unknown, irrelevant, or non-binary
entries.example_cn: 乔丹说，经理昨天和乔丹谈过。
entries.example_en: Jordan said the manager spoke to them yesterday.

entries.definition_en: they or those
entries.example_cn: 我在花园里看见他们了。
entries.example_en: I saw them in the garden.

entries.definition_en: those
entries.example_cn: 那些苹果烂了。
entries.example_en: Them apples are rotten.

entries.definition_en: relating to or forming the main subject of discussion
entries.example_cn: 这次讲座是对现代艺术的主题性探索。
entries.example_en: The lecture was a thematic exploration of modern art.

entries.definition_en: relating to a melody or musical theme
entries.example_cn: 作曲家为这首民歌创作了一个主题变奏。
entries.example_en: The composer wrote a thematic variation on the folk song.

entries.definition_en: in a way that relates to the main theme or subject
entries.example_cn: 这次展览按主题组织，以探索现代艺术的不同方面。
entries.example_en: The exhibition was organized thematically to explore different aspects of modern art.

entries.definition_en: a unifying idea that is a recurrent element in literary or artistic work
entries.example_cn: 爱是她许多小说中的常见主题。
entries.example_en: Love is a common theme in many of her novels.

entries.definition_en: the subject matter of a conversation or discussion
entries.example_cn: 我们今天会议的主题是环境保护。
entries.example_en: The theme of our meeting today is environmental protection.

entries.definition_en: an essay (especially one written as an assignment)
entries.example_cn: 学生们必须写一篇关于本国历史的作文。
entries.example_en: Students must write a theme on the history of their country.

entries.definition_en: (music) melodic subject of a musical composition
entries.example_cn: 作曲家为交响曲创作了一个新的主题。
entries.example_en: The composer developed a new theme for the symphony.

entries.definition_en: (linguistics) the stem of a word
entries.example_cn: 在语言学中，“running”的词干是“run”。
entries.example_en: In linguistics, the theme of “running” is “run”.

entries.definition_en: to provide with a particular theme or motive
entries.example_cn: 这场派对以20世纪20年代为主题。
entries.example_en: The party was themed around the 1920s.

entries.definition_cn: they 的反身形式，指前文提到的一群人、动物或事物，可作动词或介词的宾语（也可用于强调）
entries.definition_en: the reflexive form of they, referring to a group of people, animals, or things previously mentioned, as the object of a verb or preposition (also used for emphasis)
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在镜子里看到了自己。
entries.example_en: The children saw themselves in the mirror.

entries.definition_cn: 指代前文提到的单个人。
entries.definition_en: Used to refer back to a single person mentioned earlier.
entries.example_cn: 他们看着镜子里的自己。
entries.example_en: They looked at themselves in the mirror.

entries.definition_en: subsequently or soon afterward (often used as sentence connectors)
entries.example_cn: 先洗车，然后擦干。
entries.example_en: First wash the car, then dry it.

entries.definition_en: in that case or as a consequence
entries.example_cn: 如果你累了，那就休息吧。
entries.example_en: If you are tired, then rest.

entries.definition_en: at that time
entries.example_cn: 我当时很年轻。
entries.example_en: I was young then.

entries.definition_en: at a specific prior time
entries.example_cn: 那所房子当时很旧。
entries.example_en: The house was old then.

entries.definition_en: that time; that moment
entries.example_cn: 这项工作会在那之前完成。
entries.example_en: The work will be finished before then.

entries.definition_en: the fleshy area of the palm at the base of the thumb
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了患者的大鱼际，以寻找神经损伤的迹象。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the patient's thenar eminence for signs of nerve damage.

entries.definition_en: the inner surface of the hand from the wrist to the base of the fingers
entries.example_cn: 手掌内侧的老茧是由频繁的体力劳动造成的。
entries.example_en: The callus on the thenar surface was caused by frequent manual labor.

entries.definition_en: relating to the palm of the hand or the area at the base of the thumb
entries.example_cn: 大鱼际肌肉负责控制拇指的运动。
entries.example_en: The thenar muscles are responsible for controlling thumb movement.

entries.definition_en: from that place
entries.example_cn: 他离开了城市，从此地前往山区。
entries.example_en: He left the city and traveled thence to the mountains.

entries.definition_en: as a result of that fact
entries.example_cn: 证据确凿，因此判决立即作出。
entries.example_en: The evidence was overwhelming, and thence the verdict was immediate.

entries.definition_en: from that situation or cause
entries.example_cn: 争论源于误解，由此引发了一场漫长的争吵。
entries.example_en: The argument arose from a misunderstanding, and thence a long quarrel followed.

entries.definition_en: from that time on
entries.example_cn: 他离开了城市，从此住在乡下。
entries.example_en: He left the city and thenceforth lived in the countryside.

entries.definition_en: a country or region ruled by a god or by leaders believed to be guided by a god
entries.example_cn: 这座古城曾是一个神权政治国家，大祭司拥有最高权力。
entries.example_en: The ancient city was once a theocracy where the high priest held supreme power.

entries.definition_en: the belief that a government should be guided by divine authority
entries.example_cn: 该政党的政治纲领基于神治论原则。
entries.example_en: The political party's platform is based on the principle of theocracy.

entries.definition_en: relating to a system of government ruled by religious leaders
entries.example_cn: 这个神权国家对其公民强制执行严格的宗教法律。
entries.example_en: The theocratic state enforced strict religious laws on its citizens.

entries.definition_en: the branch of theology that defends God's goodness and justice despite the existence of evil
entries.example_cn: 这位哲学家写了一篇神义论，以解释为何仁慈的上帝允许苦难存在。
entries.example_en: The philosopher wrote a theodicy to explain why a benevolent God allows suffering.

entries.definition_en: a surveying instrument consisting of a small telescope mounted on a tripod, used for measuring horizontal and vertical angles
entries.example_cn: 测量员调整经纬仪以测量建筑物的屋顶角度。
entries.example_en: The surveyor adjusted the theodolite to measure the angle of the building's roof.

entries.definition_cn: 诸神的起源；讲述诸神起源的神话或谱系
entries.definition_en: the origin of the gods, or a narrative about their origin
entries.example_cn: 这位学者写了一本关于古希腊神话中诸神起源的书。
entries.example_en: The scholar wrote a book about the theogony of ancient Greek mythology.

entries.definition_en: a person who is learned in theology or speculates about it
entries.example_cn: 这位神学家写了一本关于教会历史的书。
entries.example_en: The theologian wrote a book on the history of the church.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to or concerning theology
entries.example_cn: 神学辩论通常发生在大学里。
entries.example_en: Theological debates often take place in universities.

entries.definition_en: in relation to the study of the nature of God and religious belief
entries.example_cn: 只有从神学角度审视这个问题，争论才得以解决。
entries.example_en: The debate was resolved only when the issue was examined theologically.

entries.definition_en: in a manner characteristic of theology
entries.example_cn: 作者从神学而非历史的角度解读这部古籍。
entries.example_en: The author interprets the ancient text theologically rather than historically.

entries.definition_en: a person who is an expert in theology or who studies religious beliefs systematically
entries.example_cn: 这位著名的神学家广泛论述了信仰与理性之间的关系。
entries.example_en: The famous theologist wrote extensively on the relationship between faith and reason.

entries.definition_en: the systematic study of religion and religious truth
entries.example_cn: 她正在大学学习神学，以理解信仰的本质。
entries.example_en: She is studying theology at university to understand the nature of faith.

entries.definition_en: a specific system of religious beliefs
entries.example_cn: 这本书探讨了不同文化中的各种神学体系。
entries.example_en: The book explores different theologies across various cultures.

entries.definition_cn: 神学这一职业领域，通常需在大学或神学院接受专门训练
entries.definition_en: the learned profession of theology, acquired through specialized study at a college or seminary
entries.example_cn: 毕业后，他决定从事神学研究工作。
entries.example_en: After graduating, he decided to pursue a career in theology.

entries.definition_en: a visible appearance of a god to a human being
entries.example_cn: 在《圣经》中，摩西在西奈山上目睹了神显。
entries.example_en: In the Bible, Moses witnessed a theophany on Mount Sinai.

entries.definition_en: a colorless crystalline alkaloid derived from tea leaves or made synthetically; used in medicine as a bronchial dilator
entries.example_cn: 医生开了茶碱，以帮助患者呼吸更顺畅。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed theophylline to help the patient breathe more easily.

entries.definition_en: a proposition deducible from basic postulates
entries.example_cn: 勾股定理是几何学中的一个基本定理。
entries.example_en: The Pythagorean theorem is a fundamental theorem in geometry.

entries.definition_cn: （口语，非规范）被认为或预期为真的数学命题，即使尚未得到证明
entries.definition_en: a mathematical statement believed or expected to be true, even though it may not yet have been proved (colloquial, nonstandard)
entries.example_cn: 这个猜想甚至在尚未有人证明之前，就被口语化地称为定理。
entries.example_en: The conjecture was colloquially called a theorem even before anyone had proved it.

entries.definition_en: related to theories or ideas rather than to practical action
entries.example_cn: 该项目因过于理论化而缺乏实际应用受到批评。
entries.example_en: The project was criticized for being too theoretic and lacking real-world application.

entries.definition_cn: 抽象的；基于理论而非经验观察的
entries.definition_en: abstract or based on theory rather than empirical observation
entries.example_cn: 这个理论模型没有用经验数据进行检验。
entries.example_en: The theoretical model was not tested against empirical data.

entries.definition_cn: 关注理论而非其实际应用
entries.definition_en: concerned with theories rather than their practical applications
entries.example_cn: 这门课程太理论化，缺乏实践练习。
entries.example_en: The course is too theoretical and lacks practical exercises.

entries.definition_en: in theory; according to the assumed facts
entries.example_cn: 该计划在理论上是合理的，但在实践中可能会失败。
entries.example_en: The plan is theoretically sound, but it may fail in practice.

entries.definition_en: in a theoretical manner
entries.example_cn: 他们从理论上而非实践上讨论了这个问题。
entries.example_en: They discussed the problem theoretically rather than practically.

entries.definition_en: someone who creates or studies theories, especially in science or art
entries.example_cn: 这位现代理论家提出了一个理解量子力学的新框架。
entries.example_en: The modern theoretician proposed a new framework for understanding quantum mechanics.

entries.definition_cn: 提出理论；根据不确定的依据推测
entries.definition_en: to form or propose a theory about something, especially on uncertain grounds
entries.example_cn: 科学家推测气候将迅速发生变化。
entries.example_en: Scientists theorise that the climate will change rapidly.

entries.definition_en: someone who theorizes, especially in science or art
entries.example_cn: 这位物理学家是一位著名的理论家，以他在量子力学方面的工作而闻名。
entries.example_en: The physicist is a renowned theorist known for his work on quantum mechanics.

entries.definition_en: the production or use of theories
entries.example_cn: 这本书详细阐述了量子力学的理论化过程。
entries.example_en: The book provides a detailed account of the theorization of quantum mechanics.

entries.definition_en: to formulate a theory, especially about a specific subject
entries.example_cn: 研究人员对疾病的成因提出理论。
entries.example_en: Researchers theorize about the causes of the disease.

entries.definition_en: to form or construct theories
entries.example_cn: 该团队建立了一个新模型来解释数据。
entries.example_en: The team theorized a new model to explain the data.

entries.definition_cn: 推测；根据不确定或试探性的依据相信
entries.definition_en: to speculate or believe something on uncertain or tentative grounds
entries.example_cn: 科学家们推测气候将迅速发生变化。
entries.example_en: Scientists theorize that the climate will change rapidly.

entries.definition_cn: 对自然界某一方面经过充分证实的解释；一套有组织的公认知识体系，适用于多种情况以解释特定的一组现象
entries.definition_en: a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world; an organized system of accepted knowledge that applies in a variety of circumstances to explain a specific set of phenomena
entries.example_cn: 爱因斯坦的相对论改变了我们对宇宙的理解。
entries.example_en: Einstein's theory of relativity changed our understanding of the universe.

entries.definition_cn: 对自然界的一种试探性见解；一个尚未被证实的概念，但如果为真，将能解释某些事实或现象
entries.definition_en: a tentative insight into the natural world; a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena
entries.example_cn: 科学家们正在测试关于气候变化的一个新假说。
entries.example_en: Scientists are testing a new theory about climate change.

entries.definition_cn: 用于解释或指导实践的一套原则或思想
entries.definition_en: a set of principles or ideas used to explain or guide practice
entries.example_cn: 他的成功信念是努力工作，永不放弃。
entries.example_en: His theory of success is to work hard and never give up.

entries.definition_en: relating to theosophy
entries.example_cn: 神智学会促进对精神真理的研究。
entries.example_en: The theosophical society promotes the study of spiritual truths.

entries.definition_en: a person who believes in theosophy
entries.example_cn: 这位神智学者研究古老的灵性文本。
entries.example_en: The theosophist studied ancient spiritual texts.

entries.definition_en: a belief system based on mystical knowledge of God and the soul
entries.example_cn: 她研究神智学，以了解物质世界与精神世界之间的联系。
entries.example_en: She studied theosophy to understand the connection between the physical and spiritual worlds.

entries.definition_en: having the power to cure or restore health
entries.example_cn: 花园为康复中的患者提供了一个治疗性的环境。
entries.example_en: The garden provided a therapeutic environment for the recovering patients.

entries.definition_en: relating to or involved in therapy
entries.example_cn: 她参加了一次治疗会话来讨论她的感受。
entries.example_en: She attended a therapeutic session to discuss her feelings.

entries.definition_en: a therapeutic agent or treatment
entries.example_cn: 医生为这种慢性病开具了一种新的治疗剂。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed a new therapeutic agent for the chronic condition.

entries.definition_en: relating to or involved in therapy
entries.example_cn: 这家医院为慢性疼痛患者推出了一个新的治疗项目。
entries.example_en: The hospital has a new therapeutical program for patients with chronic pain.

entries.definition_cn: 以治疗为目的；用于治疗
entries.definition_en: in a way that is intended to treat or cure a disease or condition
entries.example_cn: 这种新药在罕见病患者中进行了治疗性测试。
entries.example_en: The new drug was tested therapeutically on patients with rare diseases.

entries.definition_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the treatment of diseases
entries.example_cn: 现代治疗学提高了许多疾病的生存率。
entries.example_en: Modern therapeutics have improved survival rates for many conditions.

entries.definition_en: a person skilled in a particular type of therapy
entries.example_cn: 病人与治疗师会面讨论他们的焦虑问题。
entries.example_en: The patient met with a therapist to discuss their anxiety.

entries.definition_en: psychotherapy
entries.example_cn: 她已经接受心理治疗几个月了。
entries.example_en: She has been in therapy for several months.

entries.definition_cn: 对健康问题的治疗或管理，通常在诊断后进行，包括慢性病
entries.definition_en: treatment or management of a health problem, often following diagnosis, including chronic conditions
entries.example_cn: 医生建议他进行物理治疗来缓解背痛。
entries.example_en: The doctor recommended physical therapy for his back pain.

entries.definition_en: in or at that place
entries.example_cn: 快点到那里来。
entries.example_en: Come there soon.

entries.definition_en: to or toward that place; away from the speaker
entries.example_cn: 现在到那里去。
entries.example_en: Go there now.

entries.definition_en: in that matter; in that respect; on that point
entries.example_cn: 在这一点上，你说得有道理。
entries.example_en: There, you have a point.

entries.definition_en: a place other than here
entries.example_cn: 那里有一个美丽的公园。
entries.example_en: There is a beautiful park there.

entries.definition_en: at or near that place
entries.example_cn: 我们在公园拐角附近见面了。
entries.example_en: We met thereabout the corner of the park.

entries.definition_en: at or near that time
entries.example_cn: 这件事发生在清晨左右。
entries.example_en: The event took place thereabout in the early morning.

entries.definition_en: approximately at that place
entries.example_cn: 我们在城市里的某个地方，大约在那附近，见了面。
entries.example_en: We met somewhere in the city, thereabouts.

entries.definition_en: approximately at that time or date
entries.example_cn: 该事件大约发生在 20 世纪 90 年代。
entries.example_en: The event took place in the 1990s, thereabouts.

entries.definition_en: from that time on
entries.example_cn: 条约于1990年签署，此后关系得到改善。
entries.example_en: The treaty was signed in 1990, and thereafter relations improved.

entries.definition_en: by that means or because of that
entries.example_cn: 他努力学习，从而显著提高了成绩。
entries.example_en: He studied hard, thereby improving his grades significantly.

entries.definition_cn: 为此；作为对此的回报（正式，尤用于法律语境）
entries.definition_en: for that; in return for that, especially in formal or legal usage
entries.example_cn: 款项已为此支付。
entries.example_en: The payment was made therefor.

usage.label: formal/legal
usage.pattern: therefor means “for that” or “in return for that”; source w24449r0.

entries.definition_en: used to introduce a conclusion based on a fact or reason
entries.example_cn: 雨下得很大，所以我们待在室内。
entries.example_en: It was raining heavily; therefore, we stayed indoors.

usage.label: conjunctive adverb
usage.pattern: w01826r0: source tag conjunctive; commonly follows a semicolon or starts a new clause.

entries.definition_en: as a consequence
entries.example_cn: 他错过了公交车，因此上班迟到了。
entries.example_en: He missed the bus, therefore he was late for work.

entries.definition_en: from that circumstance or source
entries.example_cn: 损害由此造成。
entries.example_en: The damage was caused therefrom.

entries.definition_en: from that place or from there
entries.example_cn: 他旅行后从那里回来了。
entries.example_en: He returned therefrom after his trip.

entries.definition_en: in or into that thing or place
entries.example_cn: 说明在其中有详细描述。
entries.example_en: The instructions are detailed therein.

entries.definition_en: an electronic musical instrument played by moving hands near antennas to control pitch and phrasing
entries.example_cn: 音乐家在演出中展示了特雷门琴那诡异的声音。
entries.example_en: The musician demonstrated the eerie sound of the theremin during the performance.

entries.definition_en: of or concerning the thing just mentioned
entries.example_cn: 该合同涵盖了货物的销售及其所有权利。
entries.example_en: The contract covers the sale of goods and all rights thereof.

entries.definition_cn: 源于刚提到的事物或情况；由此
entries.definition_en: from the thing or source just mentioned; therefrom
entries.example_cn: 工厂关闭了，由此产生的失业持续了多年。
entries.example_en: The factory closed, and the unemployment that arose thereof lasted for years.

entries.definition_cn: 在其上；在刚提到的事物上
entries.definition_en: on that; on the thing just mentioned
entries.example_cn: 表格列出了条款，双方在其上签了字。
entries.example_en: The form listed the terms, and the parties signed thereon.

entries.definition_en: to that thing or person
entries.example_cn: 合同提到了条款，双方对此表示同意。
entries.example_en: The contract refers to the terms, and the parties agree thereto.

entries.definition_en: up to that time; previously
entries.example_cn: 此前，该地区以孤立著称，但新公路的开通改变了这一状况。
entries.example_en: Theretofore, the region had been known for its isolation, but that changed with the new highway.

entries.definition_en: with that thing; with it
entries.example_cn: 他提交了签署的合同，并随合同附上了收据。
entries.example_en: He submitted the signed contract and the receipt therewith.

entries.definition_en: a unit of heat equal to 100,000 British thermal units
entries.example_cn: 供暖系统需要一单位热量的天然气才能高效运行。
entries.example_en: The heating system requires a therm of gas to operate efficiently.

entries.definition_en: relating to or associated with heat
entries.example_cn: 这种建筑材料的与热有关的特性使房子保持温暖。
entries.example_en: The thermal properties of the building material keep the house warm.

entries.definition_en: caused by or designed to retain heat
entries.example_cn: 大衣的隔热内衬能抵御寒冷。
entries.example_en: The thermal lining of the coat protects against the cold.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to a hot spring
entries.example_cn: 他们去山里的一家温泉度假村游玩。
entries.example_en: They visited a thermal resort in the mountains.

entries.definition_en: a rising current of warm air used by gliders
entries.example_cn: 飞行员借助热气流爬升了高度。
entries.example_en: The pilot gained altitude by riding a thermal.

entries.definition_cn: 以热的方式；在热性能方面
entries.definition_en: by means of heat or with respect to thermal properties
entries.example_cn: 这栋建筑的设计使其冬季热效率很高。
entries.example_en: The building is designed to be thermally efficient in winter.

entries.definition_en: relating to or associated with heat
entries.example_cn: 这种材料的热学性质使其适合用于隔热。
entries.example_en: The thermic properties of the material make it suitable for insulation.

entries.definition_en: relating to or characteristic of thermions
entries.example_cn: 热离子发射过程是真空管技术的基础。
entries.example_en: The thermionic emission process is fundamental to vacuum tube technology.

entries.definition_en: a semiconductor resistor whose resistance changes predictably with temperature, used to measure or compensate for temperature
entries.example_cn: 该电路包含一个热敏电阻，用于监测发动机的温度。
entries.example_en: The circuit includes a thermistor to monitor the engine's temperature.

entries.definition_en: the branch of chemistry that studies the heat absorbed or released during chemical reactions
entries.example_cn: 热化学帮助科学家理解化学过程中的能量变化。
entries.example_en: Thermochemistry helps scientists understand how energy changes during chemical processes.

entries.definition_en: a thermometer made of two different metal wires joined at both ends to measure temperature differences
entries.example_cn: 工程师使用热电偶来监测发动机的温度。
entries.example_en: The engineer used a thermocouple to monitor the engine's temperature.

entries.definition_en: relating to the study of heat and energy transfer
entries.example_cn: 计算了该发动机的热力学效率。
entries.example_en: The thermodynamic efficiency of the engine was calculated.

entries.definition_en: relating to or concerned with the study of heat and its relation to other forms of energy
entries.example_cn: 随着气体膨胀，其热力学的性质发生了改变。
entries.example_en: The thermodynamical properties of the gas changed as it expanded.

entries.definition_en: in a way that relates to thermodynamics
entries.example_cn: 必须从热力学角度分析发动机的效率。
entries.example_en: The engine's efficiency must be analyzed thermodynamically.

entries.definition_en: the branch of physics that studies how energy changes from one form to another
entries.example_cn: 热力学的研究帮助工程师设计出更高效的发动机。
entries.example_en: The study of thermodynamics helps engineers design more efficient engines.

entries.definition_en: producing electricity from heat or using heat to generate electricity
entries.example_cn: 航天器利用热电发电机将来自太阳的热量转化为电力。
entries.example_en: The spacecraft uses thermoelectric generators to convert heat from the sun into power.

entries.definition_en: electricity produced by heat, as in a thermocouple
entries.example_cn: 该装置将热电转换成远程传感器可用的电力。
entries.example_en: The device converts thermoelectricity into usable power for remote sensors.

entries.definition_en: a graphical record produced by a thermograph
entries.example_cn: 科学家分析热记录图以检测温度波动。
entries.example_en: The scientist analyzed the thermogram to detect temperature fluctuations.

entries.definition_cn: 热成像技术；尤指通过生成身体红外图像远程测量温差，用于研究血流或检测肿瘤
entries.definition_en: a technique for remotely measuring temperature variations, especially by producing infrared images of the body, used to study blood flow or detect tumors
entries.example_cn: 医生要求进行热成像检查，以查看血液循环是否有异常。
entries.example_en: The doctor ordered thermography to check for abnormalities in blood circulation.

entries.definition_en: relating to the measurement of mass changes in a substance as it is heated
entries.example_cn: 研究人员使用热重分析法测定了该聚合物的热稳定性。
entries.example_en: The researchers used thermogravimetric analysis to determine the thermal stability of the polymer.

entries.definition_en: an instrument used to measure temperature
entries.example_cn: 医生用温度计量了我的体温。
entries.example_en: The doctor took my temperature with a thermometer.

entries.definition_en: relating to the measurement of temperature
entries.example_cn: 随着温度升高，该气体的测温特性发生了变化。
entries.example_en: The thermometric properties of the gas changed as the temperature rose.

entries.definition_en: the measurement of temperature
entries.example_cn: 现代测温法依赖数字传感器，而非水银温度计。
entries.example_en: Modern thermometry relies on digital sensors rather than mercury thermometers.

entries.definition_cn: 热核的；与高温核聚变有关的
entries.definition_en: relating to nuclear fusion at high temperatures, especially fusion weapons
entries.example_cn: 热核反应为太阳提供能量。
entries.example_en: The thermonuclear reaction powers the sun.

entries.definition_en: a device consisting of several thermocouples connected in series to measure heat radiation
entries.example_cn: 卫星使用热电堆来探测来自地球的红外辐射。
entries.example_en: The satellite uses a thermopile to detect infrared radiation from the Earth.

entries.definition_en: a material that softens when heated and hardens again when cooled
entries.example_cn: 热塑性材料常用于制造塑料瓶。
entries.example_en: Thermoplastic is commonly used to make plastic bottles.

entries.definition_en: having the property of softening or fusing when heated and of hardening and becoming rigid again when cooled
entries.example_cn: 热塑性涂层在直射阳光下会熔化。
entries.example_en: The thermoplastic coating melts under direct sunlight.

entries.definition_en: a vacuum flask used to keep drinks hot or cold
entries.example_cn: 她带着一瓶咖啡去徒步，以便让咖啡保持温热。
entries.example_en: She carried her coffee in a thermos to stay warm during the hike.

entries.definition_en: having the property of becoming permanently hard and rigid when heated or cured
entries.example_cn: 热固性塑料用于需要高耐热性的应用场合。
entries.example_en: Thermoset plastics are used in applications requiring high heat resistance.

entries.definition_en: having the property of becoming permanently hard and rigid when heated or cured
entries.example_cn: 热固性塑料被用来制作耐用的厨房用具。
entries.example_en: Thermosetting plastics are used to make durable kitchen utensils.

entries.definition_en: the layer of Earth's atmosphere located between the mesosphere and the exosphere
entries.example_cn: 卫星通常运行在热层，那里的温度极高。
entries.example_en: Satellites often orbit within the thermosphere where temperatures are extremely high.

entries.definition_en: a device that automatically regulates temperature
entries.example_cn: 恒温器控制着家里的供暖系统。
entries.example_en: The thermostat controls the heating system in the house.

entries.definition_en: to control the temperature with a thermostat
entries.example_cn: 我们用恒温器调节房间温度，以保持白天的凉爽。
entries.example_en: We thermostated the room to keep it cool during the day.

entries.definition_en: relating to or controlled by a thermostat
entries.example_cn: 恒温阀可自动调节水温。
entries.example_en: The thermostatic valve adjusts the water temperature automatically.

entries.definition_en: in a manner controlled by a thermostat; automatically regulating temperature.
entries.example_cn: 温室通过恒温装置加热，以保持恒定温度。
entries.example_en: The greenhouse is heated thermostatically to maintain a constant temperature.

entries.definition_en: the treatment of a disease using heat
entries.example_cn: 病人接受了热疗以缓解肌肉紧张。
entries.example_en: The patient underwent thermotherapy to relieve muscle tension.

entries.definition_en: a carnivorous dinosaur from the Triassic to Cretaceous periods that walked on strong hind legs and had short forelimbs.
entries.example_cn: 这种兽脚类恐龙用锋利的牙齿和强壮的腿捕猎。
entries.example_en: The theropod hunted its prey with sharp teeth and powerful legs.

entries.definition_en: a book containing a classified list of synonyms
entries.example_cn: 她查阅同义词词典，为她的文章寻找更精确的词汇。
entries.example_en: She consulted a thesaurus to find a more precise word for her essay.

entries.definition_en: The (thing) here (used in indicating something or someone nearby).
entries.example_cn: 这些书是我的。
entries.example_en: These books are mine.

entries.definition_cn: 这些（指刚提到的人或物）
entries.definition_en: The known (thing) (used in indicating something or someone just mentioned).
entries.example_cn: 这些人是我的邻居。
entries.example_en: These people are my neighbors.

entries.definition_cn: 这些（指即将提到的人或物）
entries.definition_en: The known (thing) (used in indicating something or someone about to be mentioned).
entries.example_cn: 这些日子非常忙碌。
entries.example_en: These days are very busy.

entries.definition_en: Designates the current or next instance.
entries.example_cn: 这些结果令人惊讶。
entries.example_en: These results are surprising.

entries.definition_cn: 这些（指说话者认为听众未知的人或物）
entries.definition_en: A known (thing) (used in first mentioning a person or thing that the speaker does not think is known to the audience). Compare with "a certain ...".
entries.example_cn: 这些人在街对面住。
entries.example_en: These folks live down the street.

entries.definition_en: a treatise advancing a new point of view resulting from research; usually a requirement for an advanced academic degree
entries.example_cn: 她花了三年时间撰写关于可再生能源的论文。
entries.example_en: She spent three years writing her thesis on renewable energy.

entries.definition_en: an unproved statement put forward as a premise in an argument
entries.example_cn: 他文章的论点是技术改善了沟通。
entries.example_en: The thesis of his essay was that technology improves communication.

entries.definition_en: an actor or actress
entries.example_cn: 这位演员在舞台上表演了一段独白。
entries.example_en: The thespian performed a dramatic monologue on stage.

entries.definition_en: relating to the theatre or acting
entries.example_cn: 戏剧艺术已经流行数百年了。
entries.example_en: The thespian arts have been popular for centuries.

entries.definition_cn: 希腊字母表中的第八个字母θ（theta）
entries.definition_en: the 8th letter of the Greek alphabet
entries.example_cn: Theta 是希腊字母表中的第八个字母。
entries.example_en: Theta is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet.

entries.definition_cn: 角的度量，通常用度数或弧度表示
entries.definition_en: the measure of an angle, usually expressed in degrees or radians
entries.example_cn: 在这个方程中，θ表示旋转角度。
entries.example_en: In the equation, theta represents the angle of rotation.

entries.definition_en: magic intended to worship, summon, or communicate with spirits or deities
entries.example_cn: 新柏拉图主义者通过神术崇拜并与仁慈的灵体交流。
entries.example_en: Neoplatonists used theurgy to worship and communicate with benevolent spirits.

entries.definition_cn: 对人类事务的超自然干预；神迹
entries.definition_en: a supernatural intervention in human affairs
entries.example_cn: 古代编年史将国王的康复描述为神迹，即归因于诸神的超自然干预。
entries.example_en: The ancient chronicle describes the king's recovery as theurgy, a supernatural intervention attributed to the gods.

entries.definition_en: A group of people or things that have been mentioned before.
entries.example_cn: 他们是我最好的朋友。
entries.example_en: They are my best friends.

entries.definition_cn: 他/她/TA（指性别未知、与性别无关或非二元的单个人）
entries.definition_en: A single person whose gender is unknown, irrelevant, or non-binary.
entries.example_cn: 有人把包落在这儿了；TA会回来取的。
entries.example_en: Someone left their bag here; they will come back for it.

entries.definition_en: People in general; someone, excluding the speaker.
entries.example_cn: 人们说天气正在变化。
entries.example_en: They say that the weather is changing.

entries.definition_en: The authorities or the powerful people in charge.
entries.example_cn: 当局决定提高税收。
entries.example_en: They have decided to raise taxes.

entries.definition_en: The opponents in a game or competition.
entries.example_cn: 他们在决赛中与我们对阵。
entries.example_en: They are playing against us in the final.

entries.definition_en: To refer to someone using they/them pronouns.
entries.example_cn: 我们用“他们”来称呼亚历克斯。
entries.example_en: We use they to refer to Alex.

entries.definition_en: The or those (dialectal, Southern England).
entries.example_cn: 那些房子非常古老。
entries.example_en: They houses are very old.

entries.definition_en: There (dialectal, US).
entries.example_cn: 房间里有很多人。
entries.example_en: They is a lot of people in the room.

entries.definition_en: a substance used to treat fungal infections and expel parasitic worms
entries.example_cn: 兽医开了抗真菌药来治疗马的皮肤状况。
entries.example_en: The veterinarian prescribed thiabendazole to treat the horse's skin condition.

entries.definition_cn: 一种预防脚气病并维持食欲和生长的B族维生素
entries.definition_en: a B vitamin that prevents beriberi; maintains appetite and growth
entries.example_cn: 医生建议患有慢性酒精中毒的患者补充维生素B1。
entries.example_en: Doctors recommend thiamin for patients with chronic alcoholism.

entries.definition_en: a B vitamin that prevents beriberi and helps maintain appetite and growth
entries.example_cn: 医生建议病人服用硫胺素补充剂。
entries.example_en: Doctors recommended that the patient take thiamine supplements.

entries.definition_en: a type of drug used to treat high blood pressure by helping the kidneys remove sodium from the body
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一种噻嗪类利尿剂来帮助降低他的血压。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed a thiazide to help lower his blood pressure.

entries.definition_en: having a large distance from one side to the other
entries.example_cn: 这本书的封面很厚。
entries.example_en: The book has a thick cover.

entries.definition_en: having a dense consistency
entries.example_cn: 这油漆太稠了，不容易涂抹。
entries.example_en: The paint is too thick to spread easily.

entries.definition_en: having parts crowded closely together
entries.example_cn: 体育场里人群密集。
entries.example_en: The crowd was thick in the stadium.

entries.definition_en: spoken with a heavy accent
entries.example_cn: 他用浓重的口音说话。
entries.example_en: He spoke with a thick accent.

entries.definition_en: in a dense or closely packed manner
entries.example_cn: 雪厚厚地覆盖在地面上。
entries.example_en: Snow lay thick on the ground.

entries.definition_cn: 最密集（或最激烈）的部分；中心
entries.definition_en: the thickest, most active, or most intense part of something
entries.example_cn: 我们在森林深处迷路了。
entries.example_en: We got lost in the thick of the forest.

entries.definition_en: one after another quickly
entries.example_cn: 问题接连不断地涌来。
entries.example_en: Questions came thick and fast.

entries.definition_en: having a short and solid shape
entries.example_cn: 他个子不高，身材敦实。
entries.example_en: He was short and thickset.

entries.definition_en: a large shorebird with a thickened knee joint, found in the Old World and tropical America
entries.example_cn: 厚膝鸟在黄昏时沿着泥泞的海岸蹒跚而行。
entries.example_en: The thick-knee waddled along the muddy shore at dusk.

entries.definition_cn: 不易受批评影响的；不敏感的
entries.definition_en: insensitive to criticism
entries.example_cn: 尽管遭到反对派的猛烈抨击，这位政治家仍不为所动。
entries.example_en: The politician remained thick-skinned despite the harsh attacks from the opposition.

entries.definition_cn: 不顾他人感受的；冷漠无情的
entries.definition_en: Insensitive to other people's feelings; callous.
entries.example_cn: 那个冷漠无情的经理对员工的痛苦置之不理。
entries.example_en: The thick-skinned manager dismissed the employee's distress.

entries.definition_en: stupid or slow to understand; thickheaded
entries.example_cn: 他两次犯了同样的错误，显示他多么愚笨。
entries.example_en: He made the same mistake twice, showing how thick-skulled he was.

entries.definition_cn: 使某物在厚度或宽度上变厚
entries.definition_en: to make something thicker in width or extent
entries.example_cn: 工人加厚了墙壁，以改善其隔热性能。
entries.example_en: The workers thickened the wall to improve its insulation.

entries.definition_en: to become thicker in width or extent
entries.example_cn: 气温持续低于冰点，冰层逐渐变厚。
entries.example_en: The ice thickened as temperatures remained below freezing.

entries.definition_en: to make something viscous or dense
entries.example_cn: 厨师用面粉使酱汁变得浓稠。
entries.example_en: The chef thickened the sauce with flour.

entries.definition_en: a substance used to make a liquid thicker
entries.example_cn: 玉米淀粉常用作酱汁的增稠剂。
entries.example_en: Cornstarch is often used as a thickener in sauces.

entries.definition_en: becoming more intense or severe
entries.example_cn: 加剧的风暴使得看不见道路。
entries.example_en: The thickening storm made it impossible to see the road.

entries.definition_en: becoming more intricate or complex
entries.example_cn: 小说情节的复杂化让读者捉摸不透。
entries.example_en: The thickening plot of the novel kept readers guessing.

entries.definition_en: the process of becoming thicker
entries.example_cn: 酱汁变稠大约花了十分钟。
entries.example_en: The thickening of the sauce took about ten minutes.

entries.definition_en: a substance used to make a liquid thicker
entries.example_cn: 她在汤里加了增稠剂以改善其质地。
entries.example_en: She added a thickening to the soup to improve its texture.

entries.definition_en: an area that has become thicker or enlarged
entries.example_cn: 医生检查了他脖子上的增厚处。
entries.example_en: The doctor examined the thickening on his neck.

entries.definition_en: a dense growth of bushes
entries.example_cn: 我们在徒步时迷失在灌木丛中了。
entries.example_en: We got lost in the thicket while hiking.

entries.definition_en: stupid or slow to understand
entries.example_cn: 他太愚蠢了，没意识到自己的错误。
entries.example_en: He is too thickheaded to realize his mistake.

entries.definition_en: in a thick, dense, or heavy manner
entries.example_cn: 整夜大雪纷飞。
entries.example_en: The snow fell thickly all night long.

entries.definition_en: with a thick consistency
entries.example_cn: 汤从锅里浓稠地流了出来。
entries.example_en: The soup flowed thickly from the pot.

entries.definition_en: densely or heavily
entries.example_cn: 浓雾笼罩着山谷。
entries.example_en: The fog hung thickly over the valley.

entries.definition_en: in quick succession
entries.example_cn: 观众接连不断地提出问题。
entries.example_en: Questions came thickly from the audience.

entries.definition_cn: 含糊不清地，仿佛舌头发僵
entries.definition_en: with indistinct articulation, as if speaking with a thick tongue
entries.example_cn: 那个外国人说话含糊不清，很难听懂。
entries.example_en: The foreigner spoke thickly and was hard to understand.

entries.definition_en: the dimension through an object as opposed to its length or width
entries.example_cn: 测量了玻璃的厚度以确保安全。
entries.example_en: The thickness of the glass was measured to ensure safety.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being thick in consistency or viscosity
entries.example_cn: 酱汁冷却后，稠度增加了。
entries.example_en: The thickness of the sauce increased as it cooled.

entries.definition_en: used of a line or mark
entries.example_cn: 她调整了画笔线条的粗细以便作画。
entries.example_en: She adjusted the thickness of the pen line for the drawing.

entries.definition_en: indistinct articulation
entries.example_cn: 他口音的含糊不清让人难以听懂他的话。
entries.example_en: The thickness of his accent made it hard to understand him.

entries.definition_en: having a short and solid build
entries.example_cn: 那个矮胖的男人费力地挤过了狭窄的门口。
entries.example_en: The thickset man struggled to fit through the narrow doorway.

entries.definition_en: planted or growing close together
entries.example_cn: 那些密集生长的灌木丛挡住了花园的视线。
entries.example_en: The thickset bushes blocked the view of the garden.

entries.definition_en: a person who steals property with the intention of keeping or selling it
entries.example_cn: 警方正在寻找昨晚偷车的小偷。
entries.example_en: The police are looking for a thief who stole the car last night.

entries.definition_en: to commit theft
entries.example_cn: 他们因在画廊行窃而被捕。
entries.example_en: They were arrested for thieving from the gallery.

usage.label: Intransitive
usage.pattern: Normally used without a direct object; source w43208r0.

entries.definition_en: the act of stealing something that belongs to someone else
entries.example_cn: 警方正在调查昨晚发生在博物馆的盗窃行为。
entries.example_en: The police investigated the thievery that occurred at the museum last night.

usage.label: countable or uncountable
usage.pattern: source w24921r0 permits both countable and uncountable use

entries.definition_en: having a tendency to steal
entries.example_cn: 孩子们有偷窃倾向的行为让他们的父母很担心。
entries.example_en: The thieving behavior of the children worried their parents.

entries.definition_en: the act of stealing things from people without permission
entries.example_cn: 警方正在调查昨晚博物馆发生的偷窃事件。
entries.example_en: The police are investigating the thieving that occurred in the museum last night.

entries.definition_en: having a tendency to steal
entries.example_cn: 那个爱偷窃的孩子不断从商店里拿糖果。
entries.example_en: The thievish child kept taking sweets from the shop.

entries.definition_cn: 像小偷一样偷偷摸摸的；鬼鬼祟祟的
entries.definition_en: having the furtive or stealthy manner of a thief
entries.example_cn: 他像小偷一样鬼鬼祟祟地环顾房间，然后把手表塞进口袋。
entries.example_en: He cast a thievish glance around the room before slipping the watch into his pocket.

entries.definition_en: the part of the leg between the hip and the knee
entries.example_cn: 他的大腿感到疼痛。
entries.example_en: He felt a pain in his thigh.

entries.definition_en: the upper part of the leg of a bird
entries.example_cn: 厨师烤了鸡大腿。
entries.example_en: The chef roasted the chicken thigh.

entries.definition_en: a joke that is so funny it makes people laugh uncontrollably
entries.example_cn: 这位喜剧演员讲了一个令人捧腹的笑话，引得全场哄堂大笑。
entries.example_en: The comedian told a thigh-slapper that had the entire audience roaring with laughter.

entries.definition_en: the longest and thickest bone in the human leg, extending from the hip to the knee
entries.example_cn: 外科医生在复位骨折前仔细检查了断裂的股骨。
entries.example_en: The surgeon carefully examined the broken thighbone before setting the fracture.

entries.definition_cn: 连接车辆与牵引动物的两根长杆之一
entries.definition_en: one of the two long poles attached to the front of a cart or carriage to connect it to the pulling animal
entries.example_cn: 司机紧握缰绳，引导马匹在两根挽具杆之间前行。
entries.example_en: The driver held the reins tightly while guiding the horse between the thills.

entries.definition_cn: 缝纫时戴在手指上用于保护手指的小金属帽；也可用作小容器
entries.definition_en: a small metal cap worn on the finger to protect it while sewing; can also be used as a small container
entries.example_cn: 她用顶针把针推过厚布料。
entries.example_en: She used a thimble to push the needle through the thick fabric.

entries.definition_en: as much liquid or powder as a thimble will hold
entries.example_cn: 往混合物里加一顶针那么多的水。
entries.example_en: Add a thimble of water to the mixture.

entries.definition_cn: 一顶针的量；顶针所能容纳的少量液体或粉末
entries.definition_en: a small amount of liquid or powder that fits inside a thimble
entries.example_cn: 她往汤里只加了一顶针量的盐。
entries.example_en: She added just a thimbleful of salt to the soup.

entries.definition_cn: 几种果实簇形似顶针的北美植物的统称
entries.definition_en: a common name for several North American plants whose fruit clusters resemble thimbles
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行者在小溪附近发现了一片顶针草。
entries.example_en: The hikers spotted a patch of thimbleweed growing near the stream.

entries.definition_en: a light-colored crystalline powder used as a surgical antiseptic.
entries.example_cn: 外科医生将硫柳汞涂抹在伤口上以防止感染。
entries.example_en: The surgeon applied thimerosal to the wound to prevent infection.

entries.definition_en: having a small distance between opposite surfaces
entries.example_cn: 这本书的纸很薄。
entries.example_en: The book has thin pages.

entries.definition_en: having little body fat
entries.example_cn: 他太瘦了，不符合他的年龄。
entries.example_en: He is too thin for his age.

entries.definition_en: to become less thick
entries.example_cn: 随着太阳升起，冰开始变薄。
entries.example_en: The ice began to thin as the sun rose.

entries.definition_en: to make something less thick
entries.example_cn: 请在涂抹前将油漆稀释。
entries.example_en: Please thin the paint before applying it.

entries.definition_en: to reduce the strength or flavor of a mixture
entries.example_cn: 加水会冲淡汤的味道。
