entries.definition_en: relating to uniform movement without rotation
entries.example_cn: 汽车在直路上行驶时经历了平移运动。
entries.example_en: The car experienced translational motion as it drove down the straight road.

entries.definition_en: a person who translates written messages from one language to another
entries.example_cn: 翻译者工作到很晚以完成那份文件。
entries.example_en: The translator worked late to finish the document.

entries.definition_en: an interpreter who translates spoken language between people using different languages
entries.example_cn: 翻译者帮助双方互相理解。
entries.example_en: The translator helped the two parties understand each other.

entries.definition_en: a program that translates one programming language into another
entries.example_cn: 该翻译程序将代码从 Java 转换为 C++。
entries.example_en: The translator converts code from Java to C++.

entries.definition_en: to write or print letters of one script using the letters of another script
entries.example_cn: 学者们经常将古汉字转写为拉丁字母以便研究。
entries.example_en: Scholars often transliterate ancient Chinese characters into the Latin alphabet for study.

entries.definition_en: the process of writing a word from one alphabet using the letters of another alphabet
entries.example_cn: 这本书包含将汉字音译为英文的指南。
entries.example_en: The book includes a guide to the transliteration of Chinese characters into English.

entries.definition_cn: 将人、动物或事物从一处迁移到另一处，尤指有计划地迁移
entries.definition_en: to move a person, animal, or thing from one place to another, especially as part of a planned relocation
entries.example_cn: 自然保护人员将这些濒危龟类迁移到了更安全的栖息地。
entries.example_en: Conservationists translocated the endangered turtles to a safer habitat.

entries.definition_en: to move a part of a chromosome to a different position within it
entries.example_cn: 科学家发现一个基因易位到了染色体上的新位置。
entries.example_en: Scientists discovered that a gene had translocated to a new location on the chromosome.

entries.definition_cn: 染色体片段转移到不同位置；染色体易位
entries.definition_en: the transfer of a chromosome segment to a different position
entries.example_cn: 这种遗传疾病是由两条染色体之间的易位引起的。
entries.example_en: The genetic disorder was caused by a translocation between two chromosomes.

entries.definition_en: the transport of dissolved material within a plant
entries.example_cn: 光合作用产生的糖分通过运输作用被输送到根部。
entries.example_en: Photosynthesis produces sugars that are moved by translocation to the roots.

entries.definition_en: the transfer of a molecule through a membrane
entries.example_cn: 这种分子穿过细胞膜的转运需要能量。
entries.example_en: The translocation of the molecule across the cell membrane requires energy.

entries.definition_en: the quality of allowing light to pass through but not clearly
entries.example_cn: 磨砂玻璃的半透明性使得很难看清里面的人。
entries.example_en: The translucence of the frosted glass made it difficult to see who was inside.

entries.definition_en: the quality of allowing light to pass through but not clearly
entries.example_cn: 玻璃的半透明性让房间显得明亮通透。
entries.example_en: The translucency of the glass made the room feel airy.

entries.definition_cn: 允许光线透过但会使光线漫射的
entries.definition_en: allowing light to pass through but diffusing it
entries.example_cn: 半透明的织物让阳光透过织物照进房间。
entries.example_en: The translucent fabric allowed sunlight to filter through it into the room.

entries.definition_cn: 从地球或其他行星飞向月球的
entries.definition_en: moving toward the Moon from Earth or another planet
entries.example_cn: 航天器开始了从地球飞往月球的旅程。
entries.example_en: The spacecraft began its translunar journey from Earth.

entries.definition_en: located beyond the moon or its orbit
entries.example_cn: 探测器进入了月球轨道之外的月外空间。
entries.example_en: The probe entered translunar space beyond the Moon's orbit.

entries.definition_en: unworldly or ethereal
entries.example_cn: 她那超凡脱俗的目光似乎穿透了物质世界。
entries.example_en: Her translunar gaze seemed to look past the physical world.

entries.definition_en: to move from one country or region to another and settle there
entries.example_cn: 许多家庭为了寻找更好的就业机会移居到了城市。
entries.example_en: Many families transmigrated to the city in search of better employment opportunities.

entries.definition_en: to be born again in a different body after death
entries.example_cn: 根据古老的信仰，灵魂在死后会转世进入新的形态。
entries.example_en: According to the ancient belief, the soul transmigrates into a new form upon death.

entries.definition_en: the belief that a soul passes into another body after death
entries.example_cn: 在许多东方宗教中，灵魂转世是关乎生命轮回的核心概念。
entries.example_en: In many Eastern religions, transmigration is a central concept regarding the cycle of life.

entries.definition_en: (of disease) capable of being transmitted by infection
entries.example_cn: 流感是一种传染性极强的疾病。
entries.example_en: The flu is a highly transmissible disease.

entries.definition_en: capable of being transmitted genetically from parent to offspring
entries.example_cn: 某些高血压类型可以从父母遗传给子女。
entries.example_en: Some forms of high blood pressure are transmissible from parents to children.

entries.definition_en: inherited or inheritable by established rules (usually legal rules) of descent
entries.example_cn: 公爵的头衔只能世袭给长子。
entries.example_en: The title of Duke is transmissible only to the eldest son.

entries.definition_en: the act of sending information from one place to another
entries.example_cn: 信号传输因大雨而中断。
entries.example_en: The transmission of the signal was interrupted by heavy rain.

entries.definition_en: the system of gears in a car that transfers power from the engine to the wheels
entries.example_cn: 机械师检查了变速箱以消除噪音。
entries.example_en: The mechanic checked the transmission to fix the noise.

entries.definition_en: an event where a disease is passed from one person to another
entries.example_cn: 医院报告了患者之间发生的新一轮病毒传播。
entries.example_en: The hospital reported a new transmission of the virus between patients.

entries.definition_en: communication using radio or television signals
entries.example_cn: 我们收听了来自空间站的新闻广播。
entries.example_en: We listened to the news transmission from the space station.

entries.definition_en: the amount of light or heat that passes through a material
entries.example_cn: 这种玻璃对可见光有很高的透射率。
entries.example_en: The glass has a high transmission of visible light.

entries.definition_cn: 神经冲动通过突触的传递
entries.definition_en: the passage of a nerve impulse across a synapse
entries.example_cn: 这种药会减缓神经冲动通过突触的传递。
entries.example_en: The drug slows the transmission of nerve impulses across synapses.

entries.definition_en: to send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another
entries.example_cn: 这种病毒可以通过咳嗽在人与人之间传播。
entries.example_en: The virus can be transmitted from person to person through coughing.

entries.definition_en: to send information or messages from one person or place to another
entries.example_cn: 请在截止日期前将文件发送给客户。
entries.example_en: Please transmit the file to the client before the deadline.

entries.definition_en: to broadcast signals over the airwaves, such as for radio or television
entries.example_cn: 该电台将从首都现场直播新闻。
entries.example_en: The station will transmit the news live from the capital.

entries.definition_en: to act as a medium that allows something to be passed from one place to another
entries.example_cn: 水传导声音的效果比空气好。
entries.example_en: Water can transmit sound better than air.

entries.definition_en: capable of being transmitted from one person to another by infection
entries.example_cn: 医生警告说，该病毒在拥挤的地方极易传染。
entries.example_en: The doctor warned that the virus is highly transmittable in crowded places.

entries.definition_en: the act of sending a message or document
entries.example_cn: 合同的传送因暴风雨而延误。
entries.example_en: The transmittal of the contract was delayed due to the storm.

entries.definition_en: the fraction of radiant energy that passes through a substance
entries.example_cn: 这种玻璃对可见光具有很高的透射率。
entries.example_en: The glass has a high transmittance for visible light.

entries.definition_en: sent or passed from one person, place, or thing to another
entries.example_cn: 那条传送到接收站的消息完好无损。
entries.example_en: The transmitted message reached the receiving station intact.

entries.definition_cn: 无线电或电视信号发射器
entries.definition_en: an electronic device that generates and broadcasts radio or television signals
entries.example_cn: 新发射台的覆盖范围比旧的大得多。
entries.example_en: The new transmitter covers a much larger area than the old one.

entries.definition_en: any agent that carries and transmits a disease
entries.example_cn: 蚊子是疟疾常见的传播媒介。
entries.example_en: The mosquito is a common transmitter of malaria.

entries.definition_en: someone who transmits a message
entries.example_cn: 发报员向海岸警卫队发送了求救信号。
entries.example_en: The transmitter sent the distress signal to the coast guard.

entries.definition_en: the act of sending a message or signal from one place to another
entries.example_cn: 长距离传输数据仍然是工程师面临的挑战。
entries.example_en: The difficulty of transmitting data over long distances remains a challenge for engineers.

entries.definition_en: the act of changing into a different form or appearance, often in a fantastic or grotesque way
entries.example_cn: 魔术师表演了一场精彩的兔子变蝴蝶的变形戏法。
entries.example_en: The magician performed a spectacular transmogrification of the rabbit into a butterfly.

entries.definition_cn: 彻底改变……的性质或外观
entries.definition_en: to change completely the nature or appearance of something
entries.example_cn: 魔法咒语将那座古堡彻底变成了一朵巨大的蘑菇。
entries.example_en: The magic spell transmogrified the old castle into a giant mushroom.

entries.definition_en: an act that changes the form, character, or substance of something
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家的作品是将痛苦转化为美的过程。
entries.example_en: The artist's work was a transmutation of pain into beauty.

entries.definition_en: a qualitative change in nature or character
entries.example_cn: 合并后，这家公司发生了彻底的质的变化。
entries.example_en: The company underwent a complete transmutation after the merger.

entries.definition_en: the change of one chemical element into another through nuclear decay or bombardment
entries.example_cn: 科学家研究元素嬗变以了解恒星如何产生重元素。
entries.example_en: Scientists study transmutation to understand how stars create heavy elements.

entries.definition_cn: （尤指将贱金属变成黄金的）元素嬗变（旧时炼金术观点）
entries.definition_en: the supposed transformation of one element into another, especially a base metal into gold
entries.example_cn: 炼金术士寻找将贱金属嬗变为黄金的方法。
entries.example_en: Alchemists searched for the transmutation of base metals into gold.

entries.definition_en: change or alter in form, appearance, or nature
entries.example_cn: 毛毛虫在其生命周期中蜕变为蝴蝶。
entries.example_en: The caterpillar transmutes into a butterfly during its life cycle.

entries.definition_en: change in outward structure or looks
entries.example_cn: 多年来，那座旧建筑已改造成了一座现代艺术画廊。
entries.example_en: Over the years, the old building has transmuted into a modern art gallery.

entries.definition_en: alter the nature of (elements)
entries.example_cn: 在核物理中，一种元素可以通过放射性衰变转变为另一种元素。
entries.example_en: In nuclear physics, one element can transmute into another through radioactive decay.

entries.definition_en: operating across national boundaries or involving several countries
entries.example_cn: 这是一家在十个国家设有办事处的跨国公司。
entries.example_en: The company is a transnational corporation with offices in ten countries.

entries.definition_cn: 跨洋的；位于大洋彼岸的
entries.definition_en: crossing, beyond, or on the other side of an ocean
entries.example_cn: 这次跨洋飞行耗时超过二十个小时。
entries.example_en: The transoceanic flight took over twenty hours to complete.

entries.definition_en: a window located above a door, usually hinged to a horizontal bar over the door
entries.example_cn: 这所老房子正门上方有一个门楣窗。
entries.example_en: The old house featured a transom above the front door.

entries.definition_en: a horizontal bar across a window or separating a door from a window above it
entries.example_cn: 横档将大窗户分成了两部分。
entries.example_en: The transom divided the large window into two sections.

entries.definition_en: having a speed approximately equal to that of sound in air at sea level
entries.example_cn: 当飞机接近音速时，它进入了跨音速状态。
entries.example_en: The aircraft entered the transonic regime as it approached the speed of sound.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being clear and easy to see through
entries.example_cn: 水的透明使得鱼很容易被发现。
entries.example_en: The transparence of the water made the fish easy to spot.

entries.definition_en: the property of allowing light or other electromagnetic radiation to pass through without scattering
entries.example_cn: 玻璃的透光性让我们能看见下面的花园。
entries.example_en: The transparence of the glass allowed us to see the garden below.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being transparent, especially open to scrutiny
entries.example_cn: 报告的透明性帮助每个人理解了财务状况。
entries.example_en: The transparency of the report helped everyone understand the financial situation.

entries.definition_en: the property of allowing light to pass through clearly
entries.example_cn: 玻璃的透明性让我们能看见外面的花园。
entries.example_en: The transparency of the glass allowed us to see the garden outside.

entries.definition_en: a photographic slide or drawing on a transparent base used for projection
entries.example_cn: 她为演示准备了一张地图的幻灯片。
entries.example_en: She prepared a transparency of the map for the presentation.

entries.definition_en: transmitting light; able to be seen through with clarity
entries.example_cn: 窗户是由透明玻璃制成的。
entries.example_en: The window was made of transparent glass.

entries.definition_cn: 公开坦诚的；不隐瞒信息的
entries.definition_en: open and honest; not hiding information
entries.example_cn: 他对自己的感情坦率直言。
entries.example_en: He was transparent about his feelings.

entries.definition_cn: （图像或动画 GIF）透明的，允许背景从部分区域显示出来
entries.definition_en: of an image or animated GIF, allowing the background to show through parts of it
entries.example_cn: 请将徽标保存为透明图像，以便显示出背景。
entries.example_en: Save the logo as a transparent image so that the background shows through.

entries.definition_cn: 显而易见的；容易看穿的
entries.definition_en: easily understood or seen through (because of a lack of subtlety)
entries.example_cn: 那个政治家的动机对每个人来说都显而易见。
entries.example_en: The politician's motives were transparent to everyone.

entries.definition_en: so thin as to transmit light
entries.example_cn: 这块布料薄而透明，以至于我们可以看到下面的图案。
entries.example_en: The fabric was so transparent that we could see the pattern underneath.

entries.definition_cn: 显而易见地；容易理解地
entries.definition_en: in a way that is readily apparent or easily understood
entries.example_cn: 这个计划显然是为了造福公司的股东而设计的。
entries.example_en: The plan was transparently designed to benefit the company's shareholders.

entries.definition_en: in a way that allows light to pass through
entries.example_cn: 玻璃墙透明得清晰，提供了无障碍的视野。
entries.example_en: The glass wall was transparently clear, offering an unobstructed view.

entries.definition_cn: 恐跨性别的；歧视跨性别者的
entries.definition_en: showing prejudice or hostility towards transgender people
entries.example_cn: 该组织反对歧视跨性别者的法律和态度。
entries.example_en: The organization campaigns against transphobic laws and attitudes.

entries.definition_en: the release of water vapor from plant leaves
entries.example_cn: 植物蒸腾有助于将水从根部输送到叶片。
entries.example_en: Transpiration helps pull water up from the roots to the leaves.

entries.definition_cn: 经皮肤或黏膜排出水蒸气的过程
entries.definition_en: the process of releasing water vapor through the skin or mucous membranes
entries.example_cn: 剧烈运动会增加皮肤蒸发，使身体降温。
entries.example_en: Heavy exercise increases transpiration, causing the body to cool down.

entries.definition_en: the passage of gases through fine tubes
entries.example_cn: 该实验测量了气体通过细管的速率。
entries.example_en: The experiment measured the rate at which gas passed through the fine tube.

entries.definition_en: to become known or come to light
entries.example_cn: 很快便泄露出会议已取消的消息。
entries.example_en: It soon transpired that the meeting had been cancelled.

entries.definition_en: to happen or occur
entries.example_cn: 原来延误是由于天气恶劣造成的。
entries.example_en: It transpired that the delay was due to bad weather.

entries.definition_en: to perspire; to give off sweat through the skin
entries.example_cn: 他跑了一会儿后开始大汗淋漓。
entries.example_en: He began to transpire heavily after running.

entries.definition_cn: （植物）通过气孔散失水分和废物，进行蒸腾
entries.definition_en: of a plant, to give off water and waste products through its stomata
entries.example_cn: 水分从植物叶片的气孔中蒸腾散失。
entries.example_en: Water transpires from the leaves of the plant.

entries.definition_en: to pass through the pores or interstices of a substance, such as gas escaping
entries.example_cn: 气体开始从损坏的管道中渗出。
entries.example_en: Gas began to transpire from the damaged pipe.

entries.definition_en: occurring through or by way of the placenta
entries.example_cn: 抗体的胎盘转移使新生儿在几个月内得到保护。
entries.example_en: The transplacental transfer of antibodies protects the newborn for several months.

entries.definition_en: an operation to move an organ from one organism to another
entries.example_cn: 肾脏移植手术是一种复杂的医疗程序。
entries.example_en: Kidney transplant surgery is a complex medical procedure.

entries.definition_en: a tissue or organ that has been moved from a donor to a recipient
entries.example_cn: 病人心脏移植后恢复良好。
entries.example_en: The patient recovered well after the heart transplant.

entries.definition_en: the act of moving something from one location to another
entries.example_cn: 决定将工厂搬迁引发了争议。
entries.example_en: The decision to transplant the factory was controversial.

entries.definition_en: to place a donor's organ into a recipient's body
entries.example_cn: 医生很快会将肝脏植入患者体内。
entries.example_en: Doctors will transplant the liver into the patient soon.

entries.definition_en: to lift and reset a plant in another soil or situation
entries.example_cn: 天气变暖时你应该移植幼苗。
entries.example_en: You should transplant the seedlings when the weather warms up.

entries.definition_en: to transfer something from one place or period to another
entries.example_cn: 导演决定将故事背景移植到另一个时代。
entries.example_en: The director decided to transplant the story to a different era.

entries.definition_en: to be suitable for transplantation
entries.example_cn: 这棵树在春季很容易移植。
entries.example_en: This tree transplants well in spring.

entries.definition_en: able to be moved from one place to another and continue to grow or function
entries.example_cn: 医生解释说这个器官可以移植给那位病人。
entries.example_en: The doctor explained that the organ was transplantable to the patient.

entries.definition_en: the surgical procedure of moving an organ from one body to another
entries.example_cn: 患者在心脏移植手术后恢复得很快。
entries.example_en: The patient recovered quickly after the heart transplantation.

entries.definition_en: the act of moving something from one place to another
entries.example_cn: 移植这棵树时非常小心，以确保它能存活。
entries.example_en: The transplantation of the tree was done carefully to ensure its survival.

entries.definition_en: the action of removing something from one place and putting it in another.
entries.example_cn: 这种稀有兰花的移植需要特殊的照顾和湿度。
entries.example_en: The transplanting of the rare orchid required special care and humidity.

entries.definition_cn: 跨越两极之一或极地地区的
entries.definition_en: extending across or crossing one of the poles or a polar region
entries.example_cn: 跨极航线为亚洲和欧洲之间提供了更短的路径。
entries.example_en: The transpolar route offers a shorter path between Asia and Europe.

entries.definition_en: an electronic device that receives a signal and automatically sends back a specific reply
entries.example_cn: 安全系统使用应答器来识别车辆。
entries.example_en: The security system uses a transponder to identify vehicles.

entries.definition_en: a vehicle used for moving people or goods
entries.example_cn: 公交车是城市里常见的交通工具。
entries.example_en: The bus is a common form of transport in the city.

entries.definition_en: the business of moving goods commercially
entries.example_cn: 这家公司专门从事国际运输。
entries.example_en: The company specializes in international transport.

entries.definition_en: the movement of molecules across a boundary
entries.example_cn: 细胞膜控制营养物质的输送。
entries.example_en: The cell membrane controls the transport of nutrients.

entries.definition_en: to move someone or something from one place to another
entries.example_cn: 他们将家具运到了新房子。
entries.example_en: They transported the furniture to the new house.

entries.definition_en: to move goods commercially
entries.example_cn: 这艘船将货物运过海洋。
entries.example_en: The ship transported cargo across the ocean.

entries.definition_en: to carry something while supporting it
entries.example_cn: 他小心地搬运那个重箱子。
entries.example_en: He transported the heavy box carefully.

entries.definition_en: to hold someone spellbound
entries.example_cn: 这个故事将观众带入了另一个世界。
entries.example_en: The story transported the audience to another world.

entries.definition_en: a state of being overwhelmed by emotion
entries.example_cn: 她陶醉在音乐中。
entries.example_en: She was in a state of transport listening to the music.

entries.definition_en: able to be moved or carried from one place to another
entries.example_cn: 这台重型机械无法用普通卡车运输。
entries.example_en: The heavy machinery is not transportable by standard trucks.

entries.definition_en: a long truck for carrying motor vehicles
entries.example_cn: 运车拖车抵达机场装载新车。
entries.example_en: The transporter arrived at the airport to load the new cars.

entries.definition_en: a moving belt that transports objects (as in a factory)
entries.example_cn: 工人把箱子放在传送带上。
entries.example_en: The worker placed the box on the transporter.

entries.definition_en: a crane for moving material with dispatch as in loading and unloading ships
entries.example_cn: 起重机将沉重的集装箱吊上船。
entries.example_en: The transporter lifted the heavy containers onto the ship.

entries.definition_cn: 可置换的；可变换位置或顺序的
entries.definition_en: able to be transposed, or moved into a different position or order
entries.example_cn: 基因组中的可移动元件可以改变位置并影响基因表达。
entries.example_en: The transposable elements in the genome can shift locations and affect gene expression.

entries.definition_en: change the order or arrangement of
entries.example_cn: 请调换这个单词中字母的顺序以组成一个新词。
entries.example_en: Please transpose the letters in the word to form a new one.

entries.definition_cn: 将……转移至另一地点或时期
entries.definition_en: transfer from one place or period to another
entries.example_cn: 这部电影将小说的背景从英格兰乡村移植到了现代纽约。
entries.example_en: The film transposes the novel's setting from rural England to modern New York.

entries.definition_en: cause to change places
entries.example_cn: 这对双胞胎经常互换衣服，因为他们长得太像了。
entries.example_en: The twins often transpose their clothes because they look alike.

entries.definition_en: change key
entries.example_cn: 乐队不得不迅速将歌曲移调以匹配歌手的音域。
entries.example_en: The band had to transpose the song quickly to match the singer's range.

entries.definition_en: put (a piece of music) into another key
entries.example_cn: 钢琴家将这首曲子移低调，以便初学者演奏。
entries.example_en: The pianist transposed the piece to a lower key for the beginner.

entries.definition_en: a matrix formed by interchanging the rows and columns of a given matrix
entries.example_cn: 在线性代数中，矩阵的转置是一个基本概念。
entries.example_en: In linear algebra, the transpose of a matrix is a fundamental concept.

entries.definition_cn: 通过交换行列来重新排列矩阵元素
entries.definition_en: rearrange elements in a matrix by interchanging rows and columns
entries.example_cn: 要转置这个矩阵，请交换它的行和列。
entries.example_en: To transpose the matrix, interchange its rows and columns.

entries.definition_en: transfer a quantity from one side of an equation to the other side reversing its sign, in order to maintain equality
entries.example_cn: 为了解这个方程，你必须将变量移到左边。
entries.example_en: To solve the equation, you must transpose the variable to the left side.

entries.definition_en: an act of interchanging two things
entries.example_cn: 这两项内容的调换让员工感到困惑。
entries.example_en: The transposition of the two entries caused confusion among the staff.

entries.definition_en: the act of reversing the order or place of things
entries.example_cn: 单词中字母顺序的颠倒使其难以辨认。
entries.example_en: The transposition of the letters in the word made it difficult to read.

entries.definition_en: playing music in a different key than intended or shifting the pitch
entries.example_cn: 合唱团将赞美诗移调以适应歌手的音域。
entries.example_en: The choir performed a transposition of the hymn to suit the singers' range.

entries.definition_en: a genetic mutation where a chromosomal segment moves to a new position
entries.example_cn: 这种疾病是由特定基因片段的易位引起的。
entries.example_en: The disease was caused by a transposition of a specific gene segment.

entries.definition_en: moving a quantity from one side of an equation to the other while changing its sign
entries.example_cn: 在代数中，移项变号用于求解未知变量。
entries.example_en: In algebra, transposition is used to solve for an unknown variable.

entries.definition_en: an abnormal condition where body organs are in the wrong position
entries.example_cn: 医生诊断出心脏腔室先天性位置异常。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed a congenital transposition of the heart chambers.

entries.definition_cn: （国际象棋）通过一系列着法达到也可由另一系列着法达到的局面
entries.definition_en: (in chess) a sequence of moves that reaches a position also reachable by a different sequence of moves
entries.example_cn: 两位棋手选择了不同的着法顺序，却通过转置达到了同一局面。
entries.example_en: The players reached the same position by transposition after choosing different move orders.

entries.definition_cn: （欧盟）将欧盟指令纳入成员国国内法的过程
entries.definition_en: (European Union) the incorporation of an EU directive into a member state's domestic law
entries.example_cn: 政府完成了将欧盟指令纳入国内法的转化。
entries.example_en: The government completed the transposition of the EU directive into domestic law.

entries.definition_en: rearranging power lines to reduce electrical interference
entries.example_cn: 公用事业公司对高压线路进行了换位。
entries.example_en: The utility company performed a transposition of the high-voltage lines.

entries.definition_en: a segment of DNA that can move to another position within a genome, or into the genome of another species
entries.example_cn: 科学家研究转座子以了解基因如何改变位置。
entries.example_en: Scientists study transposons to understand how genes change location.

entries.definition_cn: （过时）接受过或正在接受改变身体性别的医疗治疗的
entries.definition_en: dated: having undergone or undergoing medical treatment to change physical sex
entries.example_cn: 她是一位接受过激素治疗、认同为女性的跨性别女性。
entries.example_en: She is a transsexual woman who has undergone hormone therapy and identifies as female.

entries.definition_en: a person who has undergone a sex change operation
entries.example_cn: 这位变性人在手术后过上了幸福的生活。
entries.example_en: The transsexual lived a happy life after the surgery.

entries.definition_cn: 同性恋者（指异性恋认同者）
entries.definition_en: a person whose sexual identification is entirely with the opposite sex
entries.example_cn: 他是一位认同为男性的跨性别男性。
entries.example_en: He is a transsexual man who identifies as male.

entries.definition_en: the state of being transsexual; transsexuality
entries.example_cn: transsexualism一词指变性者的状态。
entries.example_en: The term transsexualism refers to the state of being transsexual.

entries.definition_en: to transfer goods from one ship or vehicle to another for further transport
entries.example_cn: 货物从集装箱船转运到了较小的渡轮上。
entries.example_en: The cargo was transshipped from the container ship to the smaller ferry.

usage.label: transitive
usage.pattern: transship something from one vessel or conveyance to another

entries.definition_cn: 从一艘船或一种运输工具转运到另一艘船或另一种运输工具上继续运输
entries.definition_en: to be transferred from one vessel or conveyance to another for onward shipment
entries.example_cn: 货物从集装箱船转运到较小的渡轮上后继续运送。
entries.example_en: The cargo transshipped from the container ship to the smaller ferry before continuing its journey.

entries.definition_en: the transfer of goods from one vehicle to another for shipment
entries.example_cn: 货物在港口经历了漫长的转运过程。
entries.example_en: The cargo underwent a long transshipment process at the port.

entries.definition_en: the shipment of goods through an intermediate destination
entries.example_cn: 货物在经由一个区域枢纽中转时被延误了。
entries.example_en: The goods were delayed during transshipment through a regional hub.

entries.definition_en: the Roman Catholic doctrine that the substance of bread and wine changes into the substance of Christ's body and blood during the Eucharist
entries.example_cn: 变体说是罗马天主教关于圣餐的一个核心信仰。
entries.example_en: Transubstantiation is a central belief in the Roman Catholic Church regarding the Eucharist.

entries.definition_en: an act that changes the form, character, or substance of something
entries.example_cn: 快速的工业化是对乡村景观本质的一次改变。
entries.example_en: The rapid industrialization was a transubstantiation of the rural landscape.

entries.definition_en: having an atomic number greater than 92
entries.example_cn: 钚是一种超铀元素。
entries.example_en: Plutonium is a transuranic element.

entries.definition_cn: 横截的；横向的；垂直于长轴的
entries.definition_en: extending or lying across; in a crosswise direction; at right angles to the long axis
entries.example_cn: 这条横截线将矩形分成两个相等的部分。
entries.example_en: The transversal line divides the rectangle into two equal parts.

entries.definition_en: in a manner that crosses from one side to another
entries.example_cn: 为了支撑重量，横梁被横向加固。
entries.example_en: The beam was reinforced transversally to support the weight.

entries.definition_en: extending or lying across; in a crosswise direction; at right angles to the long axis
entries.example_cn: 横向的横梁支撑着屋顶。
entries.example_en: The transverse beam supports the roof.

entries.definition_en: in a direction across something rather than along it
entries.example_cn: 这根梁被横向切割以制造更短的段落。
entries.example_en: The beam was cut transversely to create shorter sections.

entries.definition_en: relating to transvestism or cross-dressing
entries.example_cn: 这种异装行为是私事，不宜公开讨论。
entries.example_en: The transvestic behavior was a private matter not to be discussed publicly.

entries.definition_en: the practice or condition of wearing clothing traditionally associated with another gender
entries.example_cn: “异装”一词指穿着传统上与另一性别相关联的服装的行为。
entries.example_en: The term transvestism refers to the practice of wearing clothing traditionally associated with another gender.

entries.definition_cn: 穿着传统上与另一性别相关服装的人
entries.definition_en: a person who wears clothing traditionally associated with another sex
entries.example_cn: 他有时穿女装，因此被人用一个过时的词称为异装者。
entries.example_en: He was described, using a dated term, as a transvestite because he sometimes wore women's clothing.

usage.label: dated
usage.pattern: Source w22565r0 labels this noun dated.

entries.definition_cn: 与通过异装获得性兴奋有关的
entries.definition_en: relating to or involving sexual arousal from cross-dressing
entries.example_cn: 形容词“transvestite”指与异装相关的性兴奋。
entries.example_en: The adjective transvestite refers to sexual arousal associated with cross-dressing.

entries.definition_en: an antidepressant drug that works by inhibiting monoamine oxidase
entries.example_cn: 苯乙肼被用于治疗抑郁症，但由于副作用需要仔细监测。
entries.example_en: Tranylcypromine is prescribed for depression but requires careful monitoring due to side effects.

entries.definition_en: a device used to catch animals
entries.example_cn: 猎人设了一个陷阱捕捉狐狸。
entries.example_en: The hunter set a trap for the fox.

entries.definition_cn: 诱人的事物所设下的陷阱；圈套
entries.definition_en: something attractive that leads you into a difficult situation
entries.example_cn: 低价是一个诱饵，旨在让顾客购买更多商品。
entries.example_en: The cheap price was a trap to get customers to buy more.

entries.definition_cn: 诱捕或使某人或某物落入陷阱
entries.definition_en: to catch someone or something in or as if in a trap
entries.example_cn: 他们在树林里成功捕捉到了一只兔子。
entries.example_en: They managed to trap the rabbit in the woods.

entries.definition_en: to prevent something from moving
entries.example_cn: 厚厚的积雪将徒步旅行者困在了小木屋里。
entries.example_en: The heavy snow trapped the hikers in the cabin.

entries.definition_en: to put someone in a difficult or embarrassing situation
entries.example_cn: 这个问题让他不得不承认自己的错误。
entries.example_en: The question trapped him into admitting his mistake.

entries.definition_en: to hold or catch something tightly
entries.example_cn: 泥浆卡住了汽车的轮子。
entries.example_en: The mud trapped the car's wheels.

entries.definition_en: a U-shaped pipe in a drain that holds water to stop gas from rising
entries.example_cn: 水管工修好了水槽的存水弯。
entries.example_en: The plumber fixed the trap in the sink.

entries.definition_en: a device used to shoot clay pigeons in sports
entries.example_cn: 射击运动员排好队准备向抛靶机射击。
entries.example_en: The trapshooters lined up to fire at the trap.

entries.definition_cn: 杂技用的吊杠；高空秋千
entries.definition_en: a swinging bar used by acrobats in a circus
entries.example_cn: 这位杂技演员在吊杠上完成了一个惊险的翻转动作。
entries.example_en: The acrobat performed a daring flip on the trapeze.

entries.definition_en: either of two flat triangular muscles located in the shoulder and upper back that help move the shoulders and arms
entries.example_cn: 斜方肌连接颈部与肩胛骨。
entries.example_en: The trapezius muscle connects the neck to the shoulder blades.

entries.definition_cn: 具有鸢形面的多面体，且为反棱柱的对偶多面体
entries.definition_en: a polyhedron with kite-shaped faces, dual to an antiprism
entries.example_cn: 这种矿物的晶体结构是一个具有鸢形面的复杂多面体。
entries.example_en: The crystal structure of the mineral is a complex polyhedron with kite-shaped faces.

entries.definition_en: a convex quadrilateral with two non-adjacent parallel sides
entries.example_cn: 棚屋的屋顶呈梯形。
entries.example_en: The roof of the shed is shaped like a trapezoid.

entries.definition_cn: 腕部的一块骨，即位于大多角骨和头状骨之间的小多角骨
entries.definition_en: a specific bone located in the wrist between the trapezium and capitate bones
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查了患者的小多角骨是否有骨折迹象。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the patient's trapezoid bone for signs of fracture.

entries.definition_en: resembling a trapezoid
entries.example_cn: 屋顶呈梯形。
entries.example_en: The roof has a trapezoidal shape.

entries.definition_cn: 被困住的；无法逃脱危险或不愉快处境的
entries.definition_en: unable to escape from a dangerous or unpleasant situation
entries.example_cn: 士兵们被敌人困在山谷中。
entries.example_en: The soldiers were trapped in the valley by the enemy.

entries.definition_cn: 设陷阱捕捉动物（通常为了获取皮毛）的人
entries.definition_en: someone who sets traps for animals, usually to obtain their furs
entries.example_cn: 捕兽者在深雪中设下了他的陷阱。
entries.example_en: The trapper set his snares in the deep snow.

entries.definition_en: the act of catching someone or something in a trap
entries.example_cn: 在这个地区设陷阱捕捉野生动物是违法的。
entries.example_en: Trapping wild animals is illegal in this area.

entries.definition_cn: 马的装饰性覆盖物或马具；（尤指旧时战马的）马饰
entries.definition_en: an ornamental covering or harness for a horse, especially one formerly used for a warhorse
entries.example_cn: 骑士的马披着华丽的装饰性马具参加游行。
entries.example_en: The knight's horse was covered in rich trappings for the parade.

entries.definition_cn: 与特定身份、地位或情境相关的外在装束、装备或标志
entries.definition_en: clothing, equipment, or other outward signs associated with a particular role, status, or situation
entries.example_cn: 新经理带着所有象征权威的装饰物到任了。
entries.example_en: The new manager arrived with all the trappings of authority.

entries.definition_en: the sport of shooting at clay pigeons that simulate bird flight
entries.example_cn: 他是一位专业的飞碟射击运动员。
entries.example_en: He is an expert trapshooting competitor.

entries.definition_en: material that is useless and should be thrown away
entries.example_cn: 我们需要在晚饭前把垃圾倒掉。
entries.example_en: We need to take out the trash before dinner.

entries.definition_en: people who are considered worthless or bad
entries.example_cn: 他称那些懒惰的朋友是废物。
entries.example_en: He called his lazy friends trash.

entries.definition_en: speech or writing that is silly or meaningless
entries.example_cn: 别再胡言乱语了，听说明。
entries.example_en: Stop talking trash and listen to the instructions.

entries.definition_en: a container into which things are discarded
entries.example_cn: 请把纸放进垃圾桶。
entries.example_en: Please put the paper in the trash.

entries.definition_en: to throw away something that is useless or old
entries.example_cn: 他们决定扔掉那些旧家具。
entries.example_en: They decided to trash the old furniture.

entries.definition_en: to criticize someone or something very harshly
entries.example_cn: 评论家在她的影评中猛烈抨击了这部新电影。
entries.example_en: The critic trashed the new movie in her review.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being cheaply imitative of something better
entries.example_cn: 这些仿冒名牌包的拙劣模仿立刻被所有人察觉。
entries.example_en: The trashiness of the knock-off designer bags was immediately obvious to everyone.

entries.definition_en: of low quality; cheap and inferior
entries.example_cn: 这家餐厅提供的食物低劣，吃起来像纸板一样。
entries.example_en: The restaurant served trashy food that tasted like cardboard.

entries.definition_en: showy in a tasteless way
entries.example_cn: 她在正式场合穿了一套俗气的衣服。
entries.example_en: She wore a trashy outfit to the formal event.

entries.definition_en: a serious physical injury, often caused by violence or an accident
entries.example_cn: 车祸导致他的腿部严重受伤。
entries.example_en: The car accident caused severe trauma to his leg.

entries.definition_en: an emotional shock that has long-lasting effects
entries.example_cn: 父母的去世给她留下了深刻的精神创伤。
entries.example_en: The death of her parents left her with deep trauma.

entries.definition_en: relating to a physical injury or wound
entries.example_cn: 医生立即处理了他腿上的外伤。
entries.example_en: The doctor treated the traumatic wound on his leg immediately.

entries.definition_en: causing severe psychological pain
entries.example_cn: 那场事故是一个对全家都造成精神创伤的事件。
entries.example_en: The accident was a traumatic event that affected the whole family.

entries.definition_en: to cause severe emotional shock or distress to someone
entries.example_cn: 突然失去家园使这个家庭深受创伤。
entries.example_en: The sudden loss of her home deeply traumatised the family.

entries.definition_en: to inflict a trauma upon someone
entries.example_cn: 这起突如其来的事故使司机余生都深受创伤。
entries.example_en: The sudden accident traumatized the driver for the rest of his life.

entries.definition_cn: 研究创伤诊断与治疗的医学分支
entries.definition_en: the branch of medicine concerned with diagnosing and treating trauma
entries.example_cn: 这家医院设有专门的创伤学部门，用于治疗严重事故受害者。
entries.example_en: The hospital has a specialized department for traumatology to treat severe accident victims.

entries.definition_cn: 艰苦或痛苦的劳作；辛劳或苦难
entries.definition_en: arduous or painful exertion; hard work or hardship
entries.example_cn: 完成这个项目需要付出巨大的艰辛劳动。
entries.example_en: The completion of the project required immense travail.

entries.definition_en: the period of labor from the onset of contractions until the birth of a child
entries.example_cn: 这位母亲以极大的勇气忍受了漫长的分娩过程。
entries.example_en: The mother endured the long travail with great courage.

entries.definition_en: to work very hard
entries.example_cn: 他们辛勤劳作多年，从零开始建造了这座图书馆。
entries.example_en: They travailed for years to build the library from scratch.

entries.definition_en: a horizontal beam that extends across something
entries.example_cn: 古老的横梁支撑着大教堂沉重的屋顶。
entries.example_en: The ancient trave supported the heavy roof of the cathedral.

entries.definition_en: the act of going from one place to another
entries.example_cn: 旅行可能很累，尤其是旅途较长时。
entries.example_en: Travel can be tiring, especially when the journey is long.

entries.definition_en: to undertake a journey or trip
entries.example_cn: 她每个月去伦敦出差。
entries.example_en: She travels to London for business every month.

entries.definition_en: to make a trip for pleasure
entries.example_cn: 他们决定在欧洲旅游一个月。
entries.example_en: They decided to travel around Europe for a month.

entries.definition_en: to change location; move or proceed
entries.example_cn: 这条河流穿过山谷。
entries.example_en: The river travels through the valley.

entries.definition_en: to undergo transportation as in a vehicle
entries.example_cn: 乘客从市中心乘坐火车出行。
entries.example_en: Passengers travel by train from the city center.

entries.definition_en: to travel upon or across a surface
entries.example_cn: 鸟儿横穿海洋寻找食物。
entries.example_en: Birds travel across the ocean to find food.

entries.definition_en: the movement or range of movement of a machine part
entries.example_cn: 活塞的行程受到气缸的限制。
entries.example_en: The travel of the piston was limited by the cylinder.

entries.definition_en: the working motion or range of movement of a machine part
entries.example_cn: 由于工具未调好，手柄的行程过大。
entries.example_en: The handle had too much travel because the tool was out of adjustment.

entries.definition_cn: 供旅行者通行的；常有人经过的
entries.definition_en: frequented by travelers
entries.example_cn: 我们沿着一条常有人走的路爬了上去。
entries.example_en: We climbed up a well-traveled path.

entries.definition_en: having traveled over or through a place
entries.example_cn: 那些经过的道路被雪覆盖了。
entries.example_en: The traveled roads were covered in snow.

entries.definition_en: a person who travels, especially to places away from home
entries.example_cn: 这家旅馆深受国际旅行者的欢迎。
entries.example_en: The hotel is popular with international travelers.

entries.definition_en: the act of going from one place to another
entries.example_cn: 货物跨越国界的运输受到严格管制。
entries.example_en: The traveling of goods across the border is strictly regulated.

entries.definition_cn: （英式拼写）游历广的；旅行经验丰富的
entries.definition_en: the British spelling of traveled; having traveled widely and gained substantial travel experience
entries.example_cn: 她在国外工作多年后，游历很广，旅行经验丰富。
entries.example_en: She is well travelled after years of working abroad.

usage.label: UK spelling
usage.pattern: w08434r0 identifies travelled as the standard UK spelling of traveled.

entries.definition_en: a person who goes to different places
entries.example_cn: 旅行者在长途旅行前收拾好了行李。
entries.example_en: The traveller packed his bags before the long journey.

entries.definition_en: the act of travelling; a journey
entries.example_cn: 坐火车旅行通常比坐巴士更舒适。
entries.example_en: Travelling by train is often more comfortable than by bus.

usage.label: countable or uncountable
usage.pattern: Source w00002r0 explicitly supplies both uses.

entries.definition_cn: 旅行影片、配图讲座或其他旅行记录
entries.definition_en: a film, illustrated lecture, or other account of travel
entries.example_cn: 这部纪录片是一部关于亚马逊雨林生活的引人入胜的游记片。
entries.example_en: The documentary is a fascinating travelog of life in the Amazon rainforest.

entries.definition_cn: 旅行记；旅行讲座、幻灯片放映或电影
entries.definition_en: a film, book, or lecture that describes experiences and places visited during travel
entries.example_cn: 我们观看了一部关于罗马古代遗迹的精彩旅行纪录片。
entries.example_en: We watched a fascinating travelogue about the ancient ruins of Rome.

entries.definition_en: capable of being traversed or crossed
entries.example_cn: 这条山路太陡峭且布满岩石，徒步旅行者无法通行。
entries.example_en: The mountain path was too steep and rocky to be traversable by hikers.

entries.definition_en: the act of traveling across something
entries.example_cn: 穿越沙漠花了三天时间。
entries.example_en: The traversal of the desert took three days.

entries.definition_en: the product or result of traversing
entries.example_cn: 这份详细地图是此次穿越的结果。
entries.example_en: The detailed map was the result of the traversal.

entries.definition_en: travel across or pass over
entries.example_cn: 我们决定徒步横穿这座山脉。
entries.example_en: We decided to traverse the mountain range on foot.

entries.definition_en: to cover or extend over an area or time period
entries.example_cn: 风暴席卷了整个海岸线。
entries.example_en: The storm traversed the entire coastline.

entries.definition_cn: 横穿；穿越（的行为或旅程）
entries.definition_en: an act or journey of traveling across something
entries.example_cn: 穿越沙漠花了他们三天时间。
entries.example_en: The traverse of the desert took them three days.

entries.definition_en: a horizontal beam that extends across something
entries.example_cn: 屋顶由一根钢制横梁支撑。
entries.example_en: The roof is supported by a steel traverse.

entries.definition_en: a horizontal crosspiece across a window or separating a door from a window over it
entries.example_cn: 那扇旧窗户有一根木制的横档将其分为两格。
entries.example_en: The old window had a wooden traverse dividing it into two panes.

entries.definition_en: taking a zigzag path on skis
entries.example_cn: 那位滑雪者大胆地在陡峭的斜坡上划出之字形路线。
entries.example_en: The skier made a daring traverse down the steep slope.

entries.definition_cn: 在法律诉讼中正式否认对方提出的事实指控
entries.definition_en: deny formally (an allegation of fact by the opposing party) in a legal suit
entries.example_cn: 被告选择正式否认原告关于疏忽的指控。
entries.example_en: The defendant chose to traverse the plaintiff's claim of negligence.

entries.definition_en: a person who moves or passes across a place
entries.example_cn: 穿越者在悬崖边停下脚步，回头望去。
entries.example_en: The traverser paused at the edge of the cliff to look back.

entries.definition_en: a composition that imitates or misrepresents somebody's style, usually in a humorous way
entries.example_cn: 他写莎士比亚十四行诗的那次尝试完全是个拙劣的模仿。
entries.example_en: His attempt at a Shakespearean sonnet was a total travesty.

entries.definition_cn: 对某事物的荒谬歪曲；糟糕透顶的版本
entries.definition_en: a grotesque or grossly inferior representation of something
entries.example_cn: 这部戏剧把这一严肃的历史事件歪曲得荒谬可笑。
entries.example_en: The play was a complete travesty of the serious historical event.

entries.definition_en: to make a travesty of
entries.example_cn: 这部电影通过改变结局歪曲了原著小说。
entries.example_en: The movie travestied the original novel by changing the ending.

entries.definition_en: to fish using trawlers
entries.example_cn: 他们上午在深海里用拖网捕鱼。
entries.example_en: They spent the morning trawling for cod in the deep sea.

entries.definition_cn: 仔细搜查或查阅大量信息或材料
entries.definition_en: to search thoroughly through a large amount of information or material
entries.example_cn: 研究人员仔细查阅档案，寻找有关这一事件的证据。
entries.example_en: The researchers trawled through the archives for evidence of the event.

entries.definition_cn: 用于拖网捕捞的网或拖网
entries.definition_en: a net or dragnet used for trawling
entries.example_cn: 船员们布设了沉重的深水拖网来捕捞深海物种。
entries.example_en: The crew deployed the heavy trawl to catch the deep-sea species.

entries.definition_cn: 带有许多系钩短线的长钓线；延绳钓线
entries.definition_en: a long fishing line with many short lines bearing hooks attached; a setline
entries.example_cn: 渔民们在风暴来临前修理了他们的多钩长线。
entries.example_en: The fishermen repaired their trawl before the storm.

entries.definition_en: a fishing boat that uses a trawl net or dragnet to catch fish
entries.example_cn: 拖网渔船在黎明时分驶向深海。
entries.example_en: The trawler sailed out into the deep sea at dawn.

entries.definition_en: a person who fishes using a trawl net
entries.example_cn: 这位拖网渔夫工作很长时间以装满渔船。
entries.example_en: The trawler worked long hours to fill the boat with fish.

entries.definition_en: a flat, open container used for holding, displaying, or serving items or food.
entries.example_cn: 她把饼干放在一个盛盘上。
entries.example_en: She placed the cookies on a serving tray.

entries.definition_en: a nontricyclic oral antidepressant drug used as a sedative
entries.example_cn: 医生开了曲唑酮来帮助患者睡眠并治疗抑郁症。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed trazodone to help the patient sleep and manage depression.

entries.definition_cn: 危险、不稳定且难以预测的
entries.definition_en: dangerously unstable and unpredictable
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行者避开了悬崖边那条危险且不稳定的小径。
entries.example_en: The hikers avoided the treacherous path near the cliff edge.

entries.definition_en: tending to betray; having a treacherous character
entries.example_cn: 外交官警告说，要提防敌对国家的背信弃义意图。
entries.example_en: The diplomat warned against the treacherous intentions of the rival nation.

entries.definition_en: in a disloyal and faithless manner
entries.example_cn: 他为了自保背信弃义地出卖了朋友。
entries.example_en: He treacherously betrayed his friends to save himself.

entries.definition_en: the act of betraying someone's trust
entries.example_cn: 他的背叛震惊了所有认识他的人。
entries.example_en: His treachery shocked everyone who knew him.

entries.definition_cn: 叛国行为；背叛自己的国家
entries.definition_en: an act of treason against one's country
entries.example_cn: 这名将军的背叛被谴责为叛国行为。
entries.example_en: The general's treachery was condemned as treason against his country.

entries.definition_cn: 制糖副产品制成的糖浆，如糖蜜或金色糖浆
entries.definition_en: a syrupy byproduct of sugar refining, such as molasses or golden syrup
entries.example_cn: 她在热茶中搅拌了一勺浅色甘蔗糖浆。
entries.example_en: She stirred a spoonful of treacle into the warm tea.

entries.definition_cn: 过分甜腻或感伤的言辞、作品或音乐
entries.definition_en: excessively sweet or sentimental speech, writing, or music
entries.example_cn: 评论家们将这部小说斥为毫无深度的甜腻之作。
entries.example_en: The critics dismissed the novel as mere treacle, lacking any depth.

entries.definition_en: having too much sweetness
entries.example_cn: 这块蛋糕过甜的味道令人难以忍受。
entries.example_en: The treacly flavor of the cake was overwhelming.

entries.definition_en: to put down or press the foot on a surface
entries.example_cn: 小心不要在花园里踩到那些脆弱的鲜花。
entries.example_en: Be careful not to tread on the fragile flowers in the garden.

entries.definition_en: to tread heavily or roughly on something
entries.example_cn: 那匹马开始不安地在地上重踏。
entries.example_en: The horse began to tread on the ground nervously.

entries.definition_en: the grooved surface on a pneumatic tire that provides traction
entries.example_cn: 这辆车的轮胎花纹已经磨损了，所以很快需要更换。
entries.example_en: The car's tread was worn down, so it needed to be replaced soon.

entries.definition_en: the part of a wheel, shoe, or similar object that makes contact with the ground
entries.example_cn: 这双鞋的鞋底是用橡胶做的，以获得更好的抓地力。
entries.example_en: The tread of the shoe was made of rubber for better grip.

entries.definition_en: the horizontal part of a stair or step that one stands on
entries.example_cn: 楼梯上那层旧木制的踏面在他的体重下嘎吱作响。
entries.example_en: The old wooden tread of the staircase was creaking under his weight.

entries.definition_en: a single step taken while walking or running
entries.example_cn: 他沉重的靴子每一步都在空旷的大厅里发出巨大的回声。
entries.example_en: Every tread of his heavy boots echoed loudly in the empty hall.

entries.definition_en: to crush something as if by treading on it with the foot
entries.example_cn: 公牛开始在草地上踩踏，把草完全踩平了。
entries.example_en: The bull began to tread on the grass, flattening it completely.

entries.definition_cn: 用脚抵住弓的中心以支撑弓
entries.definition_en: to brace an archer's bow by pressing the foot against the center
entries.example_cn: 弓箭手学会了用脚抵住弓的中心来稳定瞄准。
entries.example_en: The archer learned to tread the bow to stabilize his aim.

entries.definition_cn: 一种产于热带美洲的刺激性草药
entries.definition_en: a stinging herb found in tropical America
entries.example_cn: 当地医生使用这种草药来治疗昆虫叮咬。
entries.example_en: The local healer used tread-softly to treat insect bites.

entries.definition_en: a lever that is operated with the foot
entries.example_cn: 她踩下踏板启动了缝纫机。
entries.example_en: She pushed the treadle to start the sewing machine.

entries.definition_en: to operate machinery by a treadle
entries.example_cn: 他用脚踏板操作那台老式洗衣机。
entries.example_en: He treadled the old-fashioned washing machine.

entries.definition_en: to tread over
entries.example_cn: 马在吃草时踩踏草地。
entries.example_en: The horse treadle the grass while grazing.

entries.definition_en: a machine with a moving belt used for walking or running exercise
entries.example_cn: 她每天早上在跑步机上跑步以保持健康。
entries.example_en: She runs on the treadmill every morning to stay fit.

entries.definition_cn: 需要持续努力却无法取得进展的过程或处境；徒劳循环
entries.definition_en: a process or situation requiring continued effort without making progress
entries.example_cn: 加班只是为了维持同样的收入，让人感觉像陷入了徒劳循环。
entries.example_en: Working overtime just to maintain the same income felt like a treadmill.

entries.definition_cn: 人力或畜力驱动的转轮磨坊
entries.definition_en: a mill powered by people or animals walking on a circular belt
entries.example_cn: 历史上，该工厂曾使用大型转轮磨坊来研磨谷物。
entries.example_en: Historically, the factory used a large treadmill to grind grain.

entries.definition_en: the crime of betraying one's own country
entries.example_cn: 这名间谍因犯叛国罪而被捕。
entries.example_en: The spy was arrested for committing treason.

entries.definition_en: an act of betrayal of trust or confidence
entries.example_cn: 将军的蓄意背叛导致了战役的失败。
entries.example_en: The general's treason led to the loss of the battle.

entries.definition_en: disloyalty by virtue of subversive behavior
entries.example_cn: 他的行为被视为对国家的背叛。
entries.example_en: His actions were seen as an act of treason against the state.

entries.definition_en: involving or constituting treason
entries.example_cn: 法庭辩论被告的行为是否具有叛国性质。
entries.example_en: The court debated whether the defendant's actions were treasonable.

entries.definition_en: having the character of, or characteristic of, a traitor
entries.example_cn: 间谍的叛国行为被当局发现了。
entries.example_en: The treasonous actions of the spy were discovered by the authorities.

entries.definition_en: wealth in the form of money, jewels, or other valuable items
entries.example_cn: 海盗发现了一箱装满古代财宝的宝箱。
entries.example_en: The pirates found a chest full of ancient treasure.

entries.definition_en: art that is highly prized for its beauty or perfection
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展示了一件稀有的古典雕塑珍品。
entries.example_en: The museum displayed a rare treasure of classical sculpture.

entries.definition_en: a possession that is highly valued by its owner
entries.example_cn: 这件家族传家宝是一块银表，是家族的珍爱之物。
entries.example_en: The family heirloom is a small silver watch that is a family treasure.

entries.definition_en: a collection of precious things
entries.example_cn: 国王的珍宝包括金币和宝石。
entries.example_en: The king's treasure included gold coins and precious stones.

entries.definition_en: to value something or someone very highly
entries.example_cn: 她非常珍视童年的回忆。
entries.example_en: She treasures the memories of her childhood.

entries.definition_en: to be fond of or attached to someone or something
entries.example_cn: 他非常喜爱那辆旧自行车，从不让别人碰它。
entries.example_en: He treasures his old bicycle and never lets anyone touch it.

entries.definition_cn: 珍爱的；尤其因具有个人意义而受到珍视的
entries.definition_en: valued and cherished, especially because of personal significance
entries.example_cn: 那座老房子是全家人珍爱的地方。
entries.example_en: The old family home is a treasured place for everyone in the family.

entries.definition_cn: 负责组织资金和财务事务的官员
entries.definition_en: an officer responsible for an organization's funds and financial affairs
entries.example_cn: 财务主管将在会议上提交财务报告。
entries.example_en: The treasurer will present the financial report at the meeting.

entries.definition_en: to behave towards someone in a particular way
entries.example_cn: 你应该尊重你的朋友。
entries.example_en: You should treat your friends with respect.

entries.definition_en: to give medical care to someone
entries.example_cn: 这家医院治疗许多心脏病患者。
entries.example_en: The hospital treats many patients with heart disease.

entries.definition_en: to apply a process to something to improve or fix it
entries.example_cn: 医生会用抗生素处理这个伤口。
entries.example_en: The doctor will treat the wound with antibiotics.

entries.definition_en: to pay for something enjoyable for someone
entries.example_cn: 今晚让我请你吃饭吧。
entries.example_en: Let me treat you to dinner tonight.

entries.definition_en: to provide someone with plenty of food or drink
entries.example_cn: 主人请客人们吃了一顿丰盛的宴席。
entries.example_en: The host treated the guests to a feast.

entries.definition_en: an enjoyable event or experience
entries.example_cn: 去听音乐会真是一次享受。
entries.example_en: Going to the concert was a real treat.

entries.definition_en: something special and delicious to eat
entries.example_cn: 我们买了一些冰淇淋作为给孩子们的特别款待。
entries.example_en: We bought some ice cream as a treat for the children.

entries.definition_en: to express something in words or art
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家在他的画作中表现了自然的主题。
entries.example_en: The artist treated the theme of nature in his painting.

entries.definition_cn: 经过物理或化学处理的
entries.definition_en: having been subjected to a physical or chemical process
entries.example_cn: 这种木材经过特殊防腐剂处理，以防止腐烂。
entries.example_en: The wood was treated with a special preservative to stop it rotting.

entries.definition_en: having received medical care
entries.example_cn: 该患者因严重感染在医院接受了治疗。
entries.example_en: The patient was treated for a severe infection in the hospital.

entries.definition_cn: 经热处理变硬、变柔韧或具弹性的
entries.definition_en: made hard or flexible or resilient especially by heat treatment
entries.example_cn: 这种皮革经过处理，使其更耐用且防水。
entries.example_en: The leather was treated to make it more durable and water-resistant.

entries.definition_en: someone who negotiates to reach a settlement
entries.example_cn: 这位谈判者努力解决了两家公司之间的争端。
entries.example_en: The treater worked hard to resolve the dispute between the two companies.

entries.definition_cn: 用于处理油水乳状液以便输送原油的容器
entries.definition_en: a vessel used to treat oil–water emulsions so that the oil can be transported
entries.example_cn: 油水乳状液在进入管道前被送入处理器。
entries.example_en: The oil–water emulsion was sent to a treater before entering the pipeline.

entries.definition_en: a formal written work discussing a specific subject in detail
entries.example_cn: 这位教授撰写了一本关于古代历史的全面论著。
entries.example_en: The professor wrote a comprehensive treatise on ancient history.

entries.definition_en: medical care provided to improve a health condition
entries.example_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗这种疾病的新疗法。
entries.example_en: The doctor recommended a new treatment for the illness.

entries.definition_en: the way someone or something is managed or handled
entries.example_cn: 该公司受到了批评家的严厉对待。
entries.example_en: The company received harsh treatment from the critics.

entries.definition_en: the act of caring for someone, especially using medicine
entries.example_cn: 她在医院接受了特殊护理。
entries.example_en: She received special treatment in the hospital.

entries.definition_en: a manner of dealing with something artistically
entries.example_cn: 这部电影对经典故事提供了独特的处理方式。
entries.example_en: The film offers a unique treatment of the classic story.

entries.definition_en: an extended communication dealing with a particular topic
entries.example_cn: 这份报告对气候变化作了详细论述。
entries.example_en: The report provides a detailed treatment of climate change.

entries.definition_en: a written agreement between two states or sovereigns
entries.example_cn: 两国签署了和平条约以结束冲突。
entries.example_en: The two nations signed a peace treaty to end the conflict.

entries.definition_en: to increase something to three times its original amount
entries.example_cn: 该公司去年的利润增至三倍。
entries.example_en: The company trebled its profits last year.

entries.definition_en: to sing a song in a treble, or high, voice
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在礼拜期间用高音演唱赞美诗。
entries.example_en: The children trebled the hymn during the service.

entries.definition_cn: 最高的歌唱声部，尤指男童的高音声部
entries.definition_en: the highest singing voice or part, especially that of a boy
entries.example_cn: 合唱团中有一名男孩演唱高音声部。
entries.example_en: The choir included a boy singing the treble part.

entries.definition_en: relating to or having a high pitch
entries.example_cn: 长笛演奏了编曲中的高音声部。
entries.example_en: The flutes played the treble part of the arrangement.

entries.definition_en: being three times as large or numerous
entries.example_cn: 三倍的游客数量让博物馆不堪重负。
entries.example_en: The treble number of visitors overwhelmed the museum.

entries.definition_en: consisting of three parts or elements
entries.example_cn: 三个邻国组成了三王同盟。
entries.example_en: The treble alliance was formed by three neighboring kingdoms.

entries.definition_en: having several very different qualities or aspects
entries.example_cn: 这部小说的多面性让读者感到困惑。
entries.example_en: The treble character of the novel confused the readers.

entries.definition_en: a catapult that uses a swinging arm to throw a projectile
entries.example_cn: 中世纪军队部署了一台巨大的配重投石机来攻破城堡墙壁。
entries.example_en: The medieval army deployed a massive trebuchet to breach the castle walls.

entries.definition_en: a tall plant with a main trunk and branches that form a crown at the top
entries.example_cn: 那棵古老的橡树矗立在森林中央。
entries.example_en: The old oak tree stood tall in the middle of the forest.

entries.definition_en: a diagram or chart that branches out from a single starting point
entries.example_cn: 家谱显示了所有表亲之间的关系。
entries.example_en: The family tree shows the relationships between all the cousins.

entries.definition_en: to place a person or animal in a tree
entries.example_cn: 黑熊可以把幼崽放到树上保护它们，但灰熊不能。
entries.example_en: Black bears can tree their cubs for protection, but grizzly bears cannot.

entries.definition_en: to plant trees in an area
entries.example_cn: 志愿者们花了一天时间在光秃的山坡上植树。
entries.example_en: The volunteers spent the day treeing the bare hillside.

entries.definition_en: to chase an animal up into a tree so it cannot escape
entries.example_cn: 那只狗在松鼠跳过栅栏之前成功把它逼上了树。
entries.example_en: The dog managed to tree the squirrel before it could jump over the fence.

entries.definition_en: to stretch a shoe on a shoetree to dry or keep its shape
entries.example_cn: 他用鞋撑撑了他的新皮靴，以确保它们保持形状。
entries.example_en: He treeed his new leather boots to make sure they kept their shape.

entries.definition_cn: 植有树木的；树木覆盖的
entries.definition_en: planted with or covered by trees
entries.example_cn: 树木覆盖的山坡为徒步者提供了阴凉。
entries.example_en: The treed hillside provided shade for hikers.

entries.definition_en: not wooded; having no trees
entries.example_cn: 一望无际的平原上没有任何树木。
entries.example_en: The treeless plains stretched as far as the eye could see.

entries.definition_en: resembling a tree in form and branching structure
entries.example_cn: 珊瑚形似树木的枝条为小鱼提供了庇护所。
entries.example_en: The treelike branches of the coral provided shelter for small fish.

entries.definition_en: the highest branches and leaves of a tree
entries.example_cn: 那只鸟在树梢上筑巢。
entries.example_en: The bird built its nest in the treetop.

entries.definition_cn: 不符合犹太教饮食律法的；非洁食的
entries.definition_en: not conforming to Jewish dietary laws; not kosher
entries.example_cn: 按照犹太教饮食律法，猪肉被视为非洁食。
entries.example_en: Pork is considered tref under Jewish dietary law.

entries.definition_en: a plant of the genus Trifolium, commonly known as clover
entries.example_cn: 蜜蜂正忙着从白色的三叶草上采集花蜜。
entries.example_en: Bees were busy gathering nectar from the white trefoil.

entries.definition_en: a European herb with small flowers and leaves composed of three leaflets
entries.example_cn: 田野里充满了盛开的苜蓿的甜香。
entries.example_en: The meadow was filled with the sweet scent of blooming trefoil.

entries.definition_en: an architectural decoration consisting of three curved lines arranged in a circle
entries.example_cn: 大教堂的彩色玻璃窗上有一个显眼的三叶饰设计。
entries.example_en: The cathedral's stained glass window features a prominent trefoil design.

entries.definition_cn: 任何漫长而艰难的旅程
entries.definition_en: any long and difficult trip
entries.example_cn: 从城市到偏远村庄的旅程是一段漫长的跋涉。
entries.example_en: The journey from the city to the remote village was a long trek.

entries.definition_cn: （南非）牛车之旅，尤指定居者群体的有组织迁徙
entries.definition_en: a South African journey by ox wagon, especially an organized migration by a group of settlers
entries.example_cn: 拓荒者们乘牛车，冒险穿越了平原。
entries.example_en: The pioneers undertook a dangerous trek by ox wagon across the plains.

usage.label: South-Africa
usage.pattern: 指定居者的牛车迁徙；source w08614r0。

entries.definition_cn: 进行漫长而艰难的旅程
entries.definition_en: make a long and difficult journey
entries.example_cn: 他们在没有水的情况下穿越沙漠走了三天。
entries.example_en: They trekked through the desert for three days without water.

entries.definition_en: journey on foot, especially in the mountains
entries.example_cn: 我们决定徒步上山看日出。
entries.example_en: We decided to trek up the mountain to see the sunrise.

entries.definition_en: a person who travels on foot over long distances, especially in difficult terrain
entries.example_cn: 徒步者们花了数周时间穿越喜马拉雅山脉。
entries.example_en: The trekkers spent weeks hiking through the Himalayas.

entries.definition_en: a framework of crossed wooden or metal bars used to support climbing plants
entries.example_cn: 我们在篱笆旁建了一个棚架，以帮助葡萄藤向上生长。
entries.example_en: We built a trellis along the fence to help the grapevines grow upwards.

entries.definition_cn: 一种用于通信理论和加密的图，其节点按时间排列成垂直层片，并且每个节点至少与一个更早层片中的节点和一个更晚层片中的节点相连
entries.definition_en: a graph used in communication theory and encryption whose nodes are arranged in time-ordered vertical slices, with each node connected to at least one node in an earlier slice and at least one node in a later slice
entries.example_cn: 解码器使用网格图表示随时间变化的各种可能传输状态序列。
entries.example_en: The decoder uses a trellis to represent the possible sequences of transmitted states over time.

entries.definition_en: to train a climbing plant on a trellis
entries.example_cn: 园丁将黄瓜植株搭架，使它们不接触地面。
entries.example_en: The gardener trellised the cucumber plants to keep them off the ground.

entries.definition_en: parasitic flatworms that attach to a host using external suckers
entries.example_cn: 这种吸虫生活在蜗牛体内，以蜗牛的组织为食。
entries.example_en: The trematode lives inside the snail and feeds on its tissues.

entries.definition_en: to shake or vibrate involuntarily
entries.example_cn: 她签署那份重要文件时，双手颤抖着。
entries.example_en: Her hands trembled as she signed the important document.

entries.definition_cn: 因寒冷、恐惧或激动而颤抖
entries.definition_en: a shaking movement caused by cold, fear, or excitement
entries.example_cn: 当他告知那个坏消息时，他的声音里微微颤抖了一下。
entries.example_en: A slight tremble ran through his voice when he told the bad news.

entries.definition_en: a person who shakes with fear
entries.example_cn: 那名因恐惧而颤抖的人在面试前浑身发抖。
entries.example_en: The trembler shook with fear before the interview.

entries.definition_en: disease of livestock and especially cattle poisoned by eating certain kinds of snakeroot
entries.example_cn: 几头牛在牧场吃了蛇根草后患上了震颤病。
entries.example_en: Several cattle developed trembles after eating snakeroot in the pasture.

entries.definition_cn: 轻微且不规则地颤抖的
entries.definition_en: vibrating slightly and irregularly, often due to fear or cold
entries.example_cn: 她签署合同时双手颤抖。
entries.example_en: Her hands were trembling as she signed the contract.

entries.definition_en: a shaky or vibrating motion
entries.example_cn: 地震前地面发生了颤抖。
entries.example_en: There was a trembling in the ground before the earthquake.

entries.definition_en: extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree
entries.example_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
entries.example_en: The earthquake caused tremendous destruction.

entries.definition_en: extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers
entries.example_cn: 我们在聚会上玩得很开心。
entries.example_en: We had a tremendous time at the party.

entries.definition_en: extreme in degree or extent or amount or impact
entries.example_cn: 球队面临着巨大的获胜压力。
entries.example_en: There was tremendous pressure on the team to win.

entries.definition_en: to a very great extent or degree
entries.example_cn: 风暴极大地损坏了这所房子。
entries.example_en: The storm damaged the house tremendously.

entries.definition_en: a white or pale green mineral used as a form of asbestos
entries.example_cn: 地质学家在从山上采集的岩石样本中发现了透闪石。
entries.example_en: Geologists found tremolite in the rock samples from the mountain.

entries.definition_en: a musical effect created by rapidly repeating a single note or alternating between two notes
entries.example_cn: 小提琴手在高弦上演奏了一段优美的颤音。
entries.example_en: The violinist played a beautiful tremolo on the high string.

entries.definition_cn: （尤指过度或控制不佳的）嗓音颤动；歌唱时音高或音量的快速反复变化
entries.definition_en: a rapid, repetitive variation in the pitch or volume of the singing voice, especially an excessive or poorly controlled one
entries.example_cn: 歌手失控的嗓音颤动使得歌词难以听清。
entries.example_en: The singer's tremolo made it difficult to hear the lyrics clearly.

entries.definition_en: an involuntary shaking or vibration of the body, often caused by illness or fear
entries.example_cn: 这位病人双手轻微震颤。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from a slight tremor in his hands.

entries.definition_en: a small earthquake
entries.example_cn: 昨晚该地区感觉到了轻微的小地震。
entries.example_en: A minor tremor was felt in the region last night.

entries.definition_en: shaking or trembling, usually resulting from weakness, stress, or disease
entries.example_cn: 恐惧使她全身颤抖。
entries.example_en: Fear caused a tremor to run through her body.

entries.definition_en: to shake with seismic vibrations
entries.example_cn: 地震导致地面剧烈震动。
entries.example_en: The earthquake caused the ground to tremor violently.

entries.definition_en: (of the voice) quivering as from weakness or fear
entries.example_cn: 她颤抖的声音揭示了她对面试的深深焦虑。
entries.example_en: Her tremulous voice revealed her deep anxiety about the interview.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows a slight shaking or quivering, often due to fear or excitement
entries.example_cn: 她在跑出房间前颤抖着低声道歉。
entries.example_en: She tremulously whispered her apology before running out of the room.

entries.definition_en: a ditch dug as a fortification with a wall of the excavated earth
entries.example_cn: 士兵们挖了一条战壕以保护自己免受敌军火力攻击。
entries.example_en: The soldiers dug a trench to protect themselves from enemy fire.

entries.definition_en: a long steep-sided depression in the ocean floor
entries.example_cn: 科学家们研究了太平洋深处的海沟。
entries.example_en: Scientists studied the deep trench in the Pacific Ocean.

entries.definition_en: any long ditch cut in the ground
entries.example_cn: 他们利用旧沟渠将花园里多余的水排走。
entries.example_en: They used the old trench to drain the excess water from the garden.

entries.definition_en: to impinge or infringe upon
entries.example_cn: 这项新法律侵犯了少数群体的权利。
entries.example_en: The new law trenches on the rights of the minority.

usage.label: usually trench on/upon something
usage.pattern: 通常与 on 或 upon 连用，表示“侵犯、侵害”。

entries.definition_en: to cut a trench in, as for drainage
entries.example_cn: 建筑队将挖沟以改善院子的排水系统。
entries.example_en: The construction crew will trench the yard to improve drainage.

entries.definition_en: to fortify by surrounding with trenches
entries.example_cn: 军队决定在进攻前用战壕包围这座城市。
entries.example_en: The army decided to trench the city before the attack.

entries.definition_en: to set, plant, or bury in a trench
entries.example_cn: 农民将土豆埋入沟中以防止其冻坏。
entries.example_en: Farmers trench the potatoes to keep them from freezing.

entries.definition_en: to cut or carve deeply into
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家将深入雕刻石头以创作一座新的雕塑。
entries.example_en: The artist will trench the stone to create a new sculpture.

entries.definition_en: sharp, forceful, and penetrating in thought or expression
entries.example_cn: 她对政府的这项新政策提出了尖锐的批评。
entries.example_en: She made a trenchant criticism of the government's new policy.

usage.label: figurative
usage.pattern: keen, biting, or severe in expression

entries.definition_en: characterized by or full of force and vigor
entries.example_cn: 他写作中充满活力的风格吸引了观众。
entries.example_en: The trenchant style of his writing captivated the audience.

entries.definition_cn: 思维清晰的；界限分明的
entries.definition_en: clearly or sharply defined to the mind
entries.example_cn: 事实与观点之间清晰的界限立刻显而易见。
entries.example_en: The trenchant distinction between fact and opinion was immediately apparent.

entries.definition_en: in a forceful and incisive manner
entries.example_cn: 评论家有力地指出了论点中的缺陷。
entries.example_en: The critic trenchantly pointed out the flaws in the argument.

entries.definition_en: a machine for digging trenches
entries.example_cn: 挖沟机为新电缆挖出了一条狭窄的沟。
entries.example_en: The trencher dug a narrow trench for the new cable.

entries.definition_en: someone who digs trenches
entries.example_cn: 这位挖壕沟的人不知疲倦地工作，为新防御工事准备地面。
entries.example_en: The trencher worked tirelessly to prepare the ground for the new fortification.

entries.definition_cn: 木制餐盘；（旧时用作餐盘的）厚面包片
entries.definition_en: a wooden board or platter, or formerly a thick slice of bread, on which food is served or carved
entries.example_cn: 在中世纪，trencher常是用作盘子的厚块陈面包。
entries.example_en: In medieval times, a trencher was often a thick slice of stale bread used as a plate.

entries.definition_en: a general direction in which something tends to move
entries.example_cn: 房价呈上升趋势。
entries.example_en: The trend in housing prices is upward.

entries.definition_en: the general direction or course in which something extends
entries.example_cn: 海岸线的走向是向南。
entries.example_en: The trend of the coastline is southward.

entries.definition_en: a general tendency to change (as of opinion)
entries.example_cn: 居家办公成为一种趋势。
entries.example_en: There is a trend towards working from home.

entries.definition_en: the popular taste at a given time
entries.example_cn: 最新的时尚潮流是鲜艳的颜色。
entries.example_en: The latest trend in fashion is bright colors.

entries.definition_en: to be temporarily popular
entries.example_cn: 这首歌在社交媒体上很流行。
entries.example_en: This song is trending on social media.

entries.definition_en: extend or run in a particular direction
entries.example_cn: 这条路向左延伸。
entries.example_en: The road trends to the left.

entries.definition_en: a person who introduces new fashions or styles
entries.example_cn: 这位设计师是时尚界的引领者。
entries.example_en: The designer is known as a trend-setter in the fashion industry.

entries.definition_en: creating or introducing a new trend that others will follow
entries.example_cn: 这位时装设计师以其开创潮流的风格而闻名。
entries.example_en: This fashion designer is known for her trendsetting styles.

entries.definition_en: following the latest fashion or popular style
entries.example_cn: 那家咖啡店非常时髦，有很多年轻人去那里。
entries.example_en: That coffee shop is very trendy, with lots of young people visiting it.

entries.definition_en: a surgical tool used to cut a hole in the skull
entries.example_cn: 外科医生使用颅骨钻取出了感染的骨片。
entries.example_en: The surgeon used a trepan to remove the infected bone fragment.

entries.definition_en: a drill used to cut circular holes around a center point
entries.example_cn: 木匠选了一台中心钻在木材上钻出一个精确的孔。
entries.example_en: The carpenter selected a trepan to bore a precise hole in the wood.

entries.definition_en: to cut a hole in the skull using a trepan
entries.example_cn: 古代文献描述了他们如何通过钻孔颅骨来治疗头痛。
entries.example_en: Ancient texts describe how they would trepan the head to treat headaches.

entries.definition_en: sea cucumber, used as food in some Asian cuisines
entries.example_cn: 海参是一道常出现在中国传统菜肴中的美食。
entries.example_en: Trepang is a delicacy often found in traditional Chinese dishes.

entries.definition_cn: 用于切除圆形组织部分（如骨或角膜）的圆筒形外科器械
entries.definition_en: a surgical instrument with a cylindrical blade for removing a circular section of tissue, such as bone or cornea
entries.example_cn: 外科医生使用颅骨钻切器移除了感染的骨片。
entries.example_en: The surgeon used a trephine to remove the infected bone.

entries.definition_cn: 用颅骨钻切器进行手术
entries.definition_en: to operate on with a trephine
entries.example_cn: 病人接受了颅骨钻切手术以缓解脑压。
entries.example_en: The patient was trephined to relieve the pressure in the brain.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of alarm or dread
entries.example_cn: 她带着恐惧不安谈论即将到来的面试。
entries.example_en: She spoke with trepidation about the upcoming interview.

entries.definition_cn: 密螺旋体属的细菌，包括可引起梅毒和雅司病等疾病的种类
entries.definition_en: a bacterium of the genus Treponema, including species that cause diseases such as syphilis and yaws
entries.example_cn: 医生诊断出该患者感染了密螺旋体。
entries.example_en: The doctor diagnosed the patient with a treponema infection.

entries.definition_en: to enter someone's property without permission
entries.example_cn: 请勿闯入私人花园。
entries.example_en: Do not trespass on the private garden.

entries.definition_cn: 侵扰或占用某人的时间、耐心
entries.definition_en: to intrude on or impose on someone’s time or patience
entries.example_cn: 他被指责侵占了同事的时间。
entries.example_en: He was accused of trespassing on his colleagues’ time.

entries.definition_en: to go beyond limits or boundaries
entries.example_cn: 争论开始越界涉及私人事务。
entries.example_en: The argument began to trespass into personal matters.

entries.definition_en: to break the law
entries.example_cn: 非法越境是严重的犯罪行为。
entries.example_en: The act of trespassing on the border is a serious crime.

entries.definition_en: entry to another's property without right or permission
entries.example_cn: 保安制止了施工地的非法闯入。
entries.example_en: The security guard stopped the trespass on the construction site.

entries.definition_cn: 非法侵占财产或为索赔而提起的诉讼
entries.definition_en: wrongful interference with the possession of property, or the legal action to recover damages
entries.example_cn: 该公司就有人非法侵占其土地一事提起了诉讼。
entries.example_en: The lawsuit was filed for trespass on the company's land.

entries.definition_en: to commit a sin or violate a moral law
entries.example_cn: 他觉得自己违背了自己的良心。
entries.example_en: He felt he had trespassed against his own conscience.

entries.definition_cn: 未经许可擅自闯入他人财产或侵犯他人隐私的人；侵入者
entries.definition_en: a person who trespasses or intrudes on another's property or privacy without permission
entries.example_cn: 保安要求入侵者立即离开私人花园。
entries.example_en: The security guard asked the trespasser to leave the private garden immediately.

entries.definition_cn: 擅自闯入的；未经许可占用他人财产的
entries.definition_en: entering or occupying property without permission
entries.example_cn: 这些擅自闯入的徒步者被要求离开私人土地。
entries.example_en: The trespassing hikers were ordered to leave the private land.

entries.definition_en: a hairdo formed by braiding or twisting the hair
entries.example_cn: 她梳着一条优雅的辫子垂在脑后。
entries.example_en: She wore her hair in an elegant tress down her back.

entries.definition_cn: 桥梁支架；支撑桥梁的支架结构
entries.definition_en: a framework of spreading pairs of legs used to support a bridge
entries.example_cn: 那座古老的铁路桥由铁制的桥梁支架支撑。
entries.example_en: The old railway bridge is supported by iron trestles.

entries.definition_en: a pair of sawhorses used to support a horizontal tabletop
entries.example_cn: 木匠把木头放在支架上以便加工。
entries.example_en: The carpenters placed the wood on the trestles to work on it.

entries.definition_cn: 紧身裤（通常由苏格兰格纹布料制成）
entries.definition_en: tight-fitting trousers, typically made of tartan fabric
entries.example_cn: 他穿着传统的苏格兰紧身裤参加了高地运动会。
entries.example_en: He wore traditional Scottish trews to the Highland games.

entries.definition_en: a playing card with three pips
entries.example_cn: 她从牌堆里抽出了一张红桃三。
entries.example_en: She drew a trey of hearts from the deck.

entries.definition_cn: 在纸牌、骰子或多米诺骨牌中得三分
entries.definition_en: a score of three in cards, dice, or dominoes
entries.example_cn: 他在掷骰子游戏中掷出了三点。
entries.example_en: He rolled a trey in the dice game.

entries.definition_en: a type of cellulose acetate that burns slowly and is used for motion-picture film
entries.example_cn: 早期的电影胶片由三醋酸纤维素制成，因为它比赛璐珞更安全。
entries.example_en: Early films were made from triacetate because it was safer than celluloid.

entries.definition_en: a set of three similar things considered as a unit
entries.example_cn: 原色的三者一组构成了许多色彩系统的基础。
entries.example_en: The triad of primary colors forms the basis of many color systems.

entries.definition_en: three people considered as a unit
entries.example_cn: 这三个朋友从童年起就形影不离。
entries.example_en: The triad of friends has been together since childhood.

entries.definition_en: a three-note major or minor chord
entries.example_cn: 钢琴老师解释了如何演奏简单的三和弦。
entries.example_en: The piano teacher explained how to play a simple triad.

entries.definition_en: the number three
entries.example_cn: 三是一个大于 1 的最小奇数。
entries.example_en: The triad is the smallest odd number greater than one.

entries.definition_en: the sorting and allocation of aid based on medical need or benefit
entries.example_cn: 医生进行检伤分类以优先救治急诊室的病人。
entries.example_en: Doctors performed triage to prioritize patients in the emergency room.

entries.definition_en: the act of testing something
entries.example_cn: 该公司正在对新软件进行测试。
entries.example_en: The company is conducting a trial of the new software.

entries.definition_en: (law) the determination of a person's innocence or guilt by due process of law
entries.example_cn: 陪审团开始了对被告男子的审判。
entries.example_en: The jury began the trial of the accused man.

entries.definition_en: trying something to find out about it
entries.example_cn: 我们在购买前决定先试用一下这辆新车。
entries.example_en: We decided to give the new car a trial before buying it.

entries.definition_cn: 接受测试或试验的状态或过程
entries.definition_en: the state or process of undergoing testing
entries.example_cn: 这套新系统目前正在三家医院试用。
entries.example_en: The new system is on trial in three hospitals.
