entries.definition_en: the branch of mathematics concerned with the relationships between the sides and angles of triangles
entries.example_cn: 高级数学课的学生通常学习三角学。
entries.example_en: Students in advanced math classes often study trigonometry.

entries.definition_en: a word consisting of three letters
entries.example_cn: 这种古老的代码用一个三字母词来表示一个特定的概念。
entries.example_en: The ancient code used a trigram to represent a specific concept.

entries.definition_en: having three hydroxyl groups attached to a molecule
entries.example_cn: 这种含三个羟基的化合物与酸发生了剧烈反应。
entries.example_en: The trihydroxy compound reacted vigorously with the acid.

entries.definition_en: a thyroid hormone similar to thyroxine but with one less iodine atom and more potent
entries.example_cn: 三碘甲状腺原氨酸是一种比甲状腺素效力更强的甲状腺激素。
entries.example_en: Triiodothyronine is a thyroid hormone that is more potent than thyroxine.

entries.definition_en: a three-wheeled vehicle powered by foot pedals
entries.example_cn: 那个孩子在公园里学会了骑三轮车。
entries.example_en: The child learned to ride the trike in the park.

entries.definition_en: a three-wheeled motorbike
entries.example_cn: 他骑着三轮摩托车沿着狭窄的山路行驶。
entries.example_en: He rode his trike along the narrow mountain road.

entries.definition_en: involving three parties or countries
entries.example_cn: 三方协议由三个国家的代表签署。
entries.example_en: The trilateral agreement was signed by representatives from three nations.

entries.definition_en: having three sides
entries.example_cn: 三边的栅栏围绕着三角形的花园。
entries.example_en: The trilateral fence surrounds the triangular garden.

entries.definition_en: a polygon with three sides
entries.example_cn: 三角形是几何学中的基本形状。
entries.example_en: A trilateral is a fundamental shape in geometry.

entries.definition_en: a narrow-brimmed felt hat with a creased crown, usually with the brim turned down at the front and up at the back
entries.example_cn: 他戴着一顶时尚的软呢帽去参加晚上的派对。
entries.example_en: He wore a stylish trilby to the evening party.

entries.definition_en: able to speak or understand three languages
entries.example_cn: 她精通三种语言，流利地说英语、法语和日语。
entries.example_en: She is trilingual, speaking English, French, and Japanese fluently.

entries.definition_cn: 用三种语言书写或表达的
entries.definition_en: written or expressed in three languages
entries.example_cn: 这块三语标牌用英语、法语和日语指示方向。
entries.example_en: The trilingual sign gave directions in English, French, and Japanese.

entries.definition_en: a person who speaks three languages
entries.example_cn: 她会说三种语言，把说明翻译成了英语、法语和日语。
entries.example_en: As a trilingual, she translated the instructions into English, French, and Japanese.

entries.definition_en: to pronounce with a trill, of the phoneme /r/
entries.example_cn: 她必须在西班牙语发音中发颤音'r'。
entries.example_en: She had to trill the 'r' in her Spanish pronunciation.

entries.definition_cn: 用颤音演唱或演奏（使一个音与上方音快速交替）
entries.definition_en: sing or play with a rapid alternation between a note and the note above it
entries.example_cn: 小提琴手用颤音演奏高音以制造紧张感。
entries.example_en: The violinist trilled the high note to create tension.

entries.definition_cn: 辅音（尤其是'r'）的颤音发音
entries.definition_en: the articulation of a consonant (especially the consonant 'r') with a rapid flutter of the tongue against the palate or uvula
entries.example_cn: 俄语中'r'的颤音对初学者来说很难。
entries.example_en: The trill of the 'r' in Russian is very difficult for beginners.

entries.definition_cn: 颤音；一个音与上方音之间的快速交替
entries.definition_en: a rapid alternation between a note and the note above it
entries.example_cn: 长笛在乐句结尾奏出了清晰的颤音。
entries.example_en: The flute produced a clear trill at the end of the phrase.

entries.definition_cn: 一万亿（10¹²；美式及现代英式英语）
entries.definition_en: one million million (10¹²), in US and modern British English
entries.example_cn: 该公司去年的收入达到了一万亿美元。
entries.example_en: The company's revenue reached a trillion dollars last year.

entries.definition_en: one quintillion (in British English)
entries.example_cn: 据估计宇宙有一万亿年的历史。
entries.example_en: The universe is estimated to be a trillion years old.

entries.definition_cn: 表示为 1 后跟 12 个零的数字
entries.definition_en: the number represented as a one followed by 12 zeros
entries.example_cn: 国债已超过一万亿。
entries.example_en: The national debt is over a trillion.

entries.definition_cn: 英国表示为 1 后跟 18 个零的数字
entries.definition_en: the number represented as a one followed by 18 zeros in the UK
entries.example_cn: 在英国数字系统中，万亿是一个非常大的数字。
entries.example_en: A trillion is a very large number in the UK numbering system.

entries.definition_cn: 极大的不确定的数字（通常用于夸张）
entries.definition_en: a very large indefinite number, often used for exaggeration
entries.example_cn: 该项目的成本是一万亿美元。
entries.example_en: The cost of the project was a trillion dollars.

entries.definition_en: the ordinal number of one trillion in counting order
entries.example_cn: 第万亿位访客获得了一份纪念奖。
entries.example_en: The trillionth visitor received a commemorative award.

entries.definition_en: one part in a trillion equal parts
entries.example_cn: 科学家测量了原子之间的距离，精确到万亿分之一米。
entries.example_en: Scientists measured the distance between atoms in trillionths of a meter.

entries.definition_cn: 处于第一万亿位的人或事物
entries.definition_en: the person or thing in the trillionth position
entries.example_cn: 序列中的第一万亿个对象被标上了金色星标。
entries.example_en: The trillionth in the sequence was marked with a gold star.

entries.definition_en: a plant with a whorl of three leaves at the top of its stem and a single flower with three petals
entries.example_cn: 早春时节，林地上点缀着白色的延龄草。
entries.example_en: The forest floor was dotted with white trilliums in early spring.

entries.definition_en: (of a leaf shape) divided into three lobes
entries.example_cn: 梧桐树三裂的叶子很容易辨认。
entries.example_en: The trilobed leaf of the sycamore tree is easily recognizable.

entries.definition_cn: 一种已灭绝的海生节肢动物，身体分为三个叶状部分
entries.definition_en: an extinct marine arthropod of the class Trilobita, with a body divided into three lobes
entries.example_cn: 古生物学家经常研究三叶虫以了解地球早期的生命。
entries.example_en: Paleontologists often study trilobites to understand early life on Earth.

entries.definition_en: a set of three literary or dramatic works that are related in subject or theme
entries.example_cn: 这位作家的三部曲探讨了古代文明的历史。
entries.example_en: The author's trilogy explores the history of the ancient civilization.

entries.definition_cn: 修剪边缘使其整齐或达到所需尺寸
entries.definition_en: to cut away the edges of something to make it neat or to the desired size
entries.example_cn: 她修剪树篱以保持其形状。
entries.example_en: She trimmed the hedges to keep them in shape.

entries.definition_cn: 减少某物的数量或规模
entries.definition_en: to reduce the amount or size of something
entries.example_cn: 公司决定裁员以降低成本。
entries.example_en: The company decided to trim its staff to cut costs.

entries.definition_en: to decorate something with ornaments
entries.example_cn: 他们用彩灯和装饰球装饰圣诞树。
entries.example_en: They trimmed the Christmas tree with colorful lights and baubles.

entries.definition_en: thin and fit
entries.example_cn: 经过几个月的节食，他看起来瘦削且健康。
entries.example_en: After months of dieting, he looked trim and healthy.

entries.definition_en: characterized by order and neatness; free from disorder
entries.example_cn: 新经理将办公室保持得井然有序且整洁。
entries.example_en: The office was kept trim and organized by the new manager.

entries.definition_en: a decorative border or ornament on the edge of a garment
entries.example_cn: 这件连衣裙的领口有一圈精致的蕾丝镶边。
entries.example_en: The dress had a delicate lace trim along the neckline.

entries.definition_cn: 整洁有序的状态或外观
entries.definition_en: a neat and orderly condition or appearance
entries.example_cn: 风暴来临前，这艘游艇保持着良好状态。
entries.example_en: The yacht was kept in good trim before the storm.

entries.definition_cn: 飞机在飞行中允许自行调整姿态时的姿态
entries.definition_en: the attitude of an aircraft in flight when allowed to take its own orientation
entries.example_cn: 飞行员调整了配平以在着陆进近期间稳定飞机。
entries.example_en: The pilot adjusted the trim to stabilize the aircraft during the landing approach.

entries.definition_en: a fast sailboat that has three parallel hulls
entries.example_cn: 船员们驾驶着他们的新型三体船在开阔的大海上疾驰。
entries.example_en: The crew raced their new trimaran across the open ocean.

entries.definition_cn: 由三个单体组成的低聚物；三聚体
entries.definition_en: an oligomer composed of three monomer units
entries.example_cn: 三个单体连接在一起形成了一个三聚体。
entries.example_en: Three monomer units joined together to form a trimer.

entries.definition_cn: 三个月时期；（尤指）妊娠期的三个阶段之一
entries.definition_en: a period of three months, especially one of the three periods into which human pregnancy is divided
entries.example_cn: 医生说宝宝在孕期的第二个三个月阶段发育正常。
entries.example_en: The doctor said the baby is developing normally during the second trimester.

entries.definition_cn: 实行三学期制的学年中的一个学期
entries.definition_en: one of the three equal parts into which an academic year is divided
entries.example_cn: 在学年的第一学期和第二学期之间，学生通常会放假。
entries.example_en: Students usually take a break between the first and second trimester of the school year.

entries.definition_en: made neat and tidy by cutting away excess parts
entries.example_cn: 树篱被修剪得整整齐齐，以迎接节日。
entries.example_en: The hedges were trimmed to look perfect for the holiday.

entries.definition_cn: 用于修剪或削切的工具或装置
entries.definition_en: a tool or device used for trimming
entries.example_cn: 我的新电动剃须刀配有胡须修剪器。
entries.example_en: My new electric shaver has a beard trimmer attachment.

entries.definition_cn: 修剪树木和灌木的工人
entries.definition_en: a person whose job is to cut away branches and thin out trees and bushes
entries.example_cn: 公园雇佣了一名专业修剪工人来打理过度生长的树篱。
entries.example_en: The park hired a professional trimmer to manage the overgrown hedges.

entries.definition_cn: （电子）微调元件，尤指用于精细调节的可变电容器
entries.definition_en: in electronics, an adjustable electrical component, especially a variable capacitor, used for fine adjustments
entries.example_cn: 技术人员使用微调电容器微调无线电频率。
entries.example_en: The technician used a trimmer capacitor to fine-tune the radio frequency.

entries.definition_cn: 用于将木材修整至所需尺寸的机器
entries.definition_en: a machine used to trim timber to size
entries.example_cn: 木匠用木材修整机把木板修整到屋顶所需的尺寸。
entries.example_en: The carpenter used a timber trimmer to trim the boards to size for the roof.

entries.definition_cn: 支撑端梁末端以在地板或屋顶上形成开口的横梁
entries.definition_en: a joist that supports the end of a header to create an opening in a floor or roof
entries.example_cn: 建筑师设计了一根横梁，以便楼梯穿过地板。
entries.example_en: The architect designed a trimmer to allow a staircase to pass through the floor.

entries.definition_en: a decoration or adornment typically on the edge of a garment
entries.example_cn: 这件连衣裙有美丽的蕾丝花边。
entries.example_en: The dress featured beautiful lace trimming.

entries.definition_cn: 修剪至所需大小或形状
entries.definition_en: cutting down to the desired size or shape
entries.example_cn: 园丁花了一下午修剪树篱。
entries.example_en: The gardener spent the afternoon on the trimming of the hedges.

entries.definition_en: the act of adding decoration
entries.example_cn: 装饰圣诞树花了几个小时。
entries.example_en: The trimming of the Christmas tree took several hours.

entries.definition_en: decorations or accompaniments added to something, especially a meal
entries.example_cn: 节日期间，人们用喜庆的装饰物装点了房间。
entries.example_en: The room was decorated with festive trimmings for the holiday season.

entries.definition_cn: 两个天体相距120度的占星相位（三分相）
entries.definition_en: an astrological aspect in which two celestial bodies are 120 degrees apart
entries.example_cn: 占星师说这两颗行星之间的三分相是吉相。
entries.example_en: The astrologer said that the trine between the two planets was favorable.

entries.definition_en: a group of three things
entries.example_cn: 这批藏品中有一组三只黄铜乌龟。
entries.example_en: The collection included a single trine of brazen tortoises.

entries.definition_en: a yellow crystalline explosive that is toxic and flammable
entries.example_cn: 三硝基甲苯是一种危险的炸药，用于军事用途。
entries.example_en: Trinitrotoluene is a dangerous explosive used in military applications.

entries.definition_en: three people or things considered as a single unit
entries.example_cn: 国王、王后和王子这三位一体统治着王国。
entries.example_en: The trinity of the king, the queen, and the prince ruled the kingdom.

entries.definition_en: the number three, formed by adding one to one to one
entries.example_cn: 三原色是红、黄、蓝。
entries.example_en: The trinity of primary colors is red, yellow, and blue.

entries.definition_en: a small, showy ornament, especially a piece of jewelry
entries.example_cn: 她脖子上戴着一件小金饰。
entries.example_en: She wore a gold trinket around her neck.

entries.definition_en: three performers who sing or play together
entries.example_cn: 那个三重唱组合昨晚赢得了歌唱比赛。
entries.example_en: The vocal trio won the singing competition last night.

entries.definition_en: a musical composition for three performers
entries.example_cn: 乐团演奏了一首著名的钢琴三重奏曲。
entries.example_en: The orchestra performed a famous piano trio.

entries.definition_en: a set of three similar things considered as a unit
entries.example_cn: 厨师将甜点作为三种风味的组合呈现。
entries.example_en: The chef presented the dessert as a trio of flavors.

entries.definition_en: three people considered as a unit
entries.example_cn: 这个喜剧三人组已经一起表演了十年。
entries.example_en: The comedy trio has been performing together for ten years.

entries.definition_cn: 小步舞曲中段的一段，通常采用不同的调
entries.definition_en: a passage in the middle of a minuet, often in a different key
entries.example_cn: 这首小步舞曲的中段采用了不同的调。
entries.example_en: The trio of the minuet was written in a different key.

entries.definition_en: a vacuum tube with three electrodes used for amplification
entries.example_cn: 早期的收音机依靠三极管来放大信号。
entries.example_en: Early radio sets relied on the triode for signal amplification.

entries.definition_en: a chemical compound containing three oxygen atoms per molecule
entries.example_cn: 氧化铝用于玻璃和陶瓷的生产。
entries.example_en: Aluminum trioxide is used in the production of glass and ceramics.

entries.definition_en: a journey to a place and back again
entries.example_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
entries.example_en: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.

entries.definition_en: an accidental misstep that threatens or causes a fall
entries.example_cn: 当他踩到那块松动的地毯时，差点绊了一跤。
entries.example_en: He almost had a trip when he stepped on the loose rug.

entries.definition_en: a hallucinatory experience caused by drugs
entries.example_cn: 他吃下那些药片后经历了一场可怕的幻觉。
entries.example_en: He had a terrible trip after taking the pills.

entries.definition_en: to miss a step and fall or nearly fall
entries.example_cn: 我在小路上被一块石头绊倒了。
entries.example_en: I tripped over a stone on the path.

entries.definition_en: to cause someone to stumble
entries.example_cn: 不平坦的路面绊倒了许多行人。
entries.example_en: The uneven pavement tripped many pedestrians.

entries.definition_en: to make a journey for pleasure
entries.example_cn: 他们决定假期去海滩旅行。
entries.example_en: They decided to trip to the beach for the holidays.

entries.definition_en: an exciting or stimulating experience
entries.example_cn: 这场音乐会对于所有粉丝来说都是一次真正的难忘经历。
entries.example_en: The concert was a real trip for all the fans.

entries.definition_en: to put something in motion or move it to act
entries.example_cn: 经理启动了机器以开始生产。
entries.example_en: The manager tripped the machine to start production.

entries.definition_en: involving three parties or elements
entries.example_cn: 三方协议由政府、工会和雇主代表签署。
entries.example_en: The tripartite agreement was signed by representatives from the government, the unions, and the employers.

entries.definition_en: the lining of the stomach of a ruminant, such as a cow, used as food
entries.example_cn: 这道传统炖菜里包含了牛肚和蔬菜。
entries.example_en: The traditional stew included tripe and vegetables.

entries.definition_en: nonsensical or foolish talk or writing
entries.example_cn: 他的演讲全是胡言乱语。
entries.example_en: His speech was nothing but tripe and nonsense.

usage.label: derogatory; figurative
usage.pattern: foolish or worthless talk or writing

entries.definition_en: having a leaf shape that is divided into leaflets three times
entries.example_cn: 树蕨的三回羽状复叶深裂且优雅。
entries.example_en: The tripinnate leaves of the tree fern are deeply divided and elegant.

entries.definition_en: three times as great or many
entries.example_cn: 新型号的价格是旧型号的三倍。
entries.example_en: The new model costs triple the price of the old one.

entries.definition_en: having three units or components or elements
entries.example_cn: 三重威胁涉及跑、跳和投掷。
entries.example_en: The triple threat involves running, jumping, and throwing.

entries.definition_en: to increase threefold
entries.example_cn: 假日期间销售额翻了三倍。
entries.example_en: Sales tripled during the holiday season.

entries.definition_en: a quantity that is three times as great as another
entries.example_cn: 新项目的成本是原估算的三倍。
entries.example_en: The cost of the new project is a triple of the original estimate.

entries.definition_en: a set of three similar things considered as a unit
entries.example_cn: 金、银、铜牌这三枚奖牌代表了前三名。
entries.example_en: The triple of gold, silver, and bronze medals represents the top three finishers.

entries.definition_en: a base hit at which the batter stops safely at third base
entries.example_cn: 击球手击出一记三垒安打得分。
entries.example_en: The batter hit a triple to score a run.

entries.definition_en: to hit a three-base hit
entries.example_cn: 他在第九局下半击出了一记三垒安打。
entries.example_en: He tripled in the bottom of the ninth inning.

entries.definition_cn: 由四片面包夹着三层馅料制成的三层三明治
entries.definition_en: a sandwich consisting of three levels of filling between four slices of bread
entries.example_cn: 午餐我们点了一份热腾腾的火腿奶酪三层夹心三明治。
entries.example_en: For lunch, we ordered a hot triple-decker with ham and cheese.

entries.definition_en: one of three babies born at the same time from the same pregnancy
entries.example_cn: 这个三胞胎是母亲所生的三个孩子中最小的一个。
entries.example_en: The triplet was the smallest of the three born to the mother.

entries.definition_en: a group of three similar things considered together
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家画了三幅肖像，描绘了同一个人不同年龄的样子。
entries.example_en: The artist painted a triplet of portraits depicting the same person at different ages.

entries.definition_en: a group of three notes played or written where two notes would ordinarily be
entries.example_cn: 钢琴家在最后一小节弹奏了一个三连音。
entries.example_en: The pianist played a triplet in the final measure.

entries.definition_cn: 分为三个公寓或部分的建筑物
entries.definition_en: a building divided into three apartments or sections
entries.example_cn: 开发商把那座旧仓库改建成了一个三户式建筑。
entries.example_en: The developer converted the old warehouse into a triplex.

entries.definition_en: a dwelling unit with three floors
entries.example_cn: 他们买了一套三层住宅，每层都有一间卧室。
entries.example_en: They bought a triplex with a bedroom on each floor.

entries.definition_cn: 三重的；由三个部分组成的
entries.definition_en: having three units, components, or elements
entries.example_cn: 这栋建筑采用了三重窗户设计，以获得更好的隔热效果。
entries.example_en: The building features a triplex window design for better insulation.

entries.definition_en: one of three identical copies of a document or item.
entries.example_cn: 请在一式三份的合同上签字，以便各方各持一份。
entries.example_en: Please sign the contract in triplicate so each party receives a copy.

entries.definition_en: to make three copies of something.
entries.example_cn: 秘书在将表格分发给委员会之前将其一式三份。
entries.example_en: The secretary triplicated the form before distributing it to the committee.

entries.definition_en: increase by a factor of three
entries.example_cn: 该公司的利润正在迅速增至三倍。
entries.example_en: The company is experiencing rapid tripling of its profits.

entries.definition_en: of a cell or organism having three complete sets of chromosomes
entries.example_cn: 某些植物是三倍体的，意味着它们拥有三套染色体而不是通常的两套。
entries.example_en: Some plants are triploid, meaning they possess three sets of chromosomes instead of the usual two.

entries.definition_en: a stand with three legs used to support something
entries.example_cn: 摄影师把相机架在三脚架上。
entries.example_en: The photographer set up the camera on a tripod.

entries.definition_cn: 一种用于抛光的风化分解硅质沉积岩，通常由硅藻遗骸等组成
entries.definition_en: a weathered, decomposed siliceous sedimentary rock, often composed of diatom remains, used in powdered form for polishing
entries.example_cn: 珠宝商用 tripoli 粉末抛光银戒指。
entries.example_en: The jeweler used tripoli to polish the silver ring.

entries.definition_en: the final honors examinations taken by students at Cambridge University
entries.example_cn: 许多学生花数年时间准备荣誉学位考试。
entries.example_en: Many students spend years preparing for the tripos exams.

entries.definition_en: a tourist visiting sights of interest
entries.example_cn: 观光客们在历史遗迹拍了许多照片。
entries.example_en: The trippers took many photos at the historic site.

entries.definition_en: a person who has taken a psychedelic drug and is hallucinating
entries.example_cn: 警察发现一名吸毒致幻者在公园里游荡。
entries.example_en: The police found the tripper wandering in the park.

entries.definition_en: a person who trips and almost falls
entries.example_cn: 注意冰路上那个差点摔倒的人。
entries.example_en: Watch out for the tripper on the icy path.

entries.definition_en: a catch mechanism that acts as a switch
entries.example_cn: 工程师调整了触发开关以控制传送带。
entries.example_en: The engineer adjusted the tripper to control the conveyor belt.

entries.definition_en: moving with agility and speed
entries.example_cn: 舞者在舞台上做了一个敏捷的动作。
entries.example_en: The dancer performed a tripping movement across the stage.

entries.definition_en: having a light, bouncy rhythm
entries.example_cn: 这首歌的旋律非常轻快。
entries.example_en: The song has a very tripping melody.

entries.definition_en: by moving with quick, light steps
entries.example_cn: 孩子们轻快地跑过草地。
entries.example_en: The children ran trippingly across the grass.

entries.definition_en: a work of art, such as a painting, divided into three sections or panels
entries.example_cn: 博物馆展示了一幅著名的中世纪三联画，描绘了一位圣人的生活。
entries.example_en: The museum displayed a famous medieval triptych depicting the life of a saint.

entries.definition_cn: 古希腊或罗马的三层桨座战船
entries.definition_en: an ancient Greek or Roman warship with three rows of oars on each side
entries.example_cn: 三列桨座战船是古代地中海世界的主要战舰。
entries.example_en: The trireme was the dominant warship of the ancient Mediterranean world.

entries.definition_en: an irrational and intense fear of the number thirteen
entries.example_cn: 由于他的十三恐惧症，建筑师坚持要求这栋楼只有十二层。
entries.example_en: Due to his triskaidekaphobia, the architect insisted that the building have only twelve floors.

entries.definition_en: a symbol made of three stylized arms or legs (or bent lines) radiating from a central point
entries.example_cn: 这枚古币的背面印有三曲腿纹。
entries.example_en: The ancient coin featured a triskele on its reverse side.

entries.definition_cn: 三曲臂（或三曲腿）图案；三旋臂图形
entries.definition_en: a figure consisting of three stylized human arms or legs (or three bent lines) radiating from a center
entries.example_cn: 旗帜上的古老符号是一个三曲臂图案。
entries.example_en: The ancient symbol on the flag is a triskelion.

entries.definition_en: a condition where the jaw muscles are in a prolonged spasm, making it difficult or impossible to open the mouth
entries.example_cn: 该患者在牙科手术后出现了牙关紧闭的症状。
entries.example_en: The patient was suffering from trismus after the dental procedure.

entries.definition_en: a chromosomal abnormality where a cell has one more chromosome than normal
entries.example_cn: 唐氏综合征是一种影响第21号染色体的三体性。
entries.example_en: Down syndrome is a type of trisomy affecting chromosome 21.

entries.definition_en: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.example_cn: 这篇演讲充满了令听众感到无聊的陈腐短语。
entries.example_en: The speech was full of trite phrases that bored the audience.

entries.definition_en: unoriginality resulting from being dull and hackneyed
entries.example_cn: 作者批评了故事结局的陈腐之处。
entries.example_en: The author criticized the triteness of the story's ending.

entries.definition_cn: 认为圣父、圣子和圣灵是三个独立神祇的异端信仰
entries.definition_en: the heretical belief that the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit are three separate gods
entries.example_cn: 会议谴责三神论是对基督教教义的歪曲。
entries.example_en: The council condemned tritheism as a distortion of Christian doctrine.

entries.definition_en: a radioactive form of hydrogen that is heavier than ordinary hydrogen
entries.example_cn: 科学家利用氚来为某些类型的核电池提供动力。
entries.example_en: Scientists use tritium to power certain types of nuclear batteries.

entries.definition_en: tropical marine gastropods having beautifully colored spiral shells
entries.example_cn: 潜水员发现了一种罕见的蓝色外壳的海螺。
entries.example_en: The divers discovered a rare triton with a vibrant blue shell.

entries.definition_en: small usually bright-colored semiaquatic salamanders of North America and Europe and northern Asia
entries.example_cn: 科学家正在研究北方森林中的火蝾螈种群。
entries.example_en: Scientists are studying the triton population in the northern forests.

entries.definition_en: a victory or success after a difficult struggle
entries.example_cn: 整个城市都在庆祝这支球队的胜利。
entries.example_en: The team's triumph was celebrated by the whole city.

entries.definition_en: a feeling of great joy after winning
entries.example_cn: 当她冲过终点线时，她感到一种胜利的喜悦。
entries.example_en: She felt a sense of triumph when she crossed the finish line.

entries.definition_en: to be better than someone or something
entries.example_cn: 我们的新技术胜过旧方法。
entries.example_en: Our new technology triumphed over the old methods.

entries.definition_en: to feel extremely happy about a victory
entries.example_cn: 当他们的球队赢得冠军时，球迷们狂喜不已。
entries.example_en: The fans triumphed when their team won the championship.

entries.definition_en: to show great happiness
entries.example_cn: 当孩子们收到礼物时，他们表现出极大的喜悦。
entries.example_en: The children triumphed when they received their gifts.

entries.definition_en: to think about something happily because it is good
entries.example_cn: 他满意地回味着自己的成功，并与朋友们分享。
entries.example_en: He triumphed over his success and shared it with his friends.

entries.definition_en: relating to or celebrating a triumph
entries.example_cn: 城市举行了盛大的胜利游行以欢迎归来的英雄。
entries.example_en: The city held a triumphal parade to welcome the returning hero.

entries.definition_en: joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success
entries.example_cn: 赢得冠军后，队员们感到无比胜利的喜悦。
entries.example_en: The team felt triumphal after winning the championship.

entries.definition_cn: 因胜利或成功而感到高兴和自豪的
entries.definition_en: joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success
entries.example_cn: 赢得冠军后，球队感到既高兴又自豪。
entries.example_en: The team was triumphant after winning the championship.

entries.definition_en: having achieved victory; victorious
entries.example_cn: 获胜的球队凯旋，受到英雄般的欢迎。
entries.example_en: The triumphant team returned home to a hero's welcome.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows great joy after a victory
entries.example_cn: 听到这个消息时，她胜利地笑了。
entries.example_en: She smiled triumphantly when she heard the news.

entries.definition_en: one of three people who share power or authority, especially in ancient Rome
entries.example_cn: 尤利乌斯·凯撒与庞培和克拉苏一同担任执政官统治罗马。
entries.example_en: Julius Caesar served as a triumvir alongside Pompey and Crassus to rule Rome.

entries.definition_en: a group of three people who share power or responsibility
entries.example_cn: 三人执政团做出了合并两个部门的决定。
entries.example_en: The triumvirate made the decision to merge the two departments.

entries.definition_en: consisting of three parts that are considered one; used especially to describe the Christian Trinity
entries.example_cn: 基督教的神通常被描述为三位一体的。
entries.example_en: The Christian God is often described as triune.

entries.definition_cn: 可预防三种不同病毒的（尤指疫苗）
entries.definition_en: protecting against three different viruses, especially in a vaccine
entries.example_cn: 这种三价疫苗可预防三种不同的病毒株。
entries.example_en: The trivalent vaccine protects against three different strains of the virus.

entries.definition_en: having a valence of three
entries.example_cn: 铝是一种三价金属，能与其它原子形成三个化学键。
entries.example_en: Aluminum is a trivalent metal that forms three bonds with other atoms.

entries.definition_cn: 一种带有短脚的支架，用于在桌子上垫在热盘下
entries.definition_en: a stand with short feet used under a hot dish on a table
entries.example_cn: 三脚架防止了平底锅刮伤台面。
entries.example_en: The trivet prevented the saucepan from scratching the countertop.

entries.definition_cn: 一种三足金属支架，用于在壁炉中支撑炊具
entries.definition_en: a three-legged metal stand for supporting a cooking vessel in a hearth
entries.example_cn: 她把锅放在火上的三脚锅架上。
entries.example_en: She placed the pot on the trivet over the fire.

entries.definition_en: facts or information that are unimportant or of minor significance
entries.example_cn: 这场测验充满了大多数人不知道的生僻琐事。
entries.example_en: The quiz was full of obscure trivia that most people would not know.

entries.definition_en: small and of little importance
entries.example_cn: 我们花了一下午讨论琐碎的事情。
entries.example_en: We spent the afternoon discussing trivial matters.

entries.definition_en: of little substance or significance
entries.example_cn: 他对项目的贡献微不足道。
entries.example_en: His contribution to the project was trivial.

entries.definition_en: concerned with trivialities
entries.example_cn: 这场辩论变得琐碎，失去了原本的重点。
entries.example_en: The debate became trivial and lost its original focus.

entries.definition_en: to make something seem unimportant or insignificant
entries.example_cn: 我们绝不能轻视气候变化的危险。
entries.example_en: We must not trivialise the dangers of climate change.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being unimportant, petty, or frivolous
entries.example_cn: 他轻蔑地认为这个论点只是微不足道的琐事。
entries.example_en: He dismissed the argument as a mere triviality.

entries.definition_en: a detail that is considered insignificant
entries.example_cn: 合同中包含了一个关于交付日期的细枝末节。
entries.example_en: The contract contained a triviality regarding the delivery date.

entries.definition_en: something of small importance
entries.example_cn: 与破碎的窗户相比，缝好松动的纽扣是一件小事。
entries.example_en: Fixing the loose button was a triviality compared to the broken window.

entries.definition_en: to make something seem unimportant or insignificant
entries.example_cn: 不断抱怨细微之处往往会将手头的严重问题变得微不足道。
entries.example_en: Constant complaints about minor details tend to trivialize the serious issues at hand.

entries.definition_en: with little effort
entries.example_cn: 应用基本公式后，这个问题被轻易解决了。
entries.example_en: The problem was trivially solved by applying the basic formula.

entries.definition_en: in a frivolously trivial manner
entries.example_cn: 他轻率地驳回了委员会提出的严重关切。
entries.example_en: He trivially dismissed the serious concerns raised by the committee.

entries.definition_cn: 三艺（中世纪大学的基础课程，包括文法、逻辑和修辞）
entries.definition_en: in the Middle Ages, an introductory university curriculum covering grammar, logic, and rhetoric
entries.example_cn: 中世纪大学的学生以三艺（文法、逻辑和修辞）开始学习。
entries.example_en: Students in medieval universities began their studies with the trivium.

entries.definition_cn: 扬抑格的；由扬抑格组成的
entries.definition_en: relating to or consisting of a trochee (a metrical foot with a stressed syllable followed by an unstressed one)
entries.example_cn: 这首诗采用扬抑格节奏。
entries.example_en: The poem is written in a trochaic rhythm.

entries.definition_cn: 股骨上端附近形成的骨性突起之一，肌肉附着于此
entries.definition_en: one of the bony prominences developed near the upper extremity of the femur to which muscles are attached
entries.example_cn: 外科医生检查股骨大转子是否有骨折迹象。
entries.example_en: The surgeon examined the trochanter for signs of fracture.

entries.definition_cn: 节肢动物腿部的第二节，位于基节和股节之间
entries.definition_en: in an arthropod, the second segment of a leg, between the coxa and the femur
entries.example_cn: 这种昆虫的转节连接着基节和股节。
entries.example_en: The insect's trochanter connects the coxa to the femur.

entries.definition_en: a small medicated lozenge used to soothe the throat
entries.example_cn: 她含了一片喉片来缓解喉咙痛。
entries.example_en: She took a troche to relieve her sore throat.

entries.definition_en: a metrical unit in poetry consisting of a stressed syllable followed by an unstressed one
entries.example_cn: 这一行诗以扬抑格开头，营造出强烈的起始节奏。
entries.example_en: The line begins with a trochee, creating a strong opening rhythm.

entries.definition_en: either of the two cranial nerves on either side that control the superior oblique muscles of the eyes
entries.example_cn: 滑车神经受损会导致复视。
entries.example_en: Damage to the trochlear nerve can cause double vision.

entries.definition_en: someone who lives in a cave
entries.example_cn: 这个故事描述了一个将家凿进石灰岩悬崖的穴居人。
entries.example_en: The story describes the troglodyte who carved his home into the limestone cliff.

entries.definition_en: a derogatory term for a reclusive, reactionary, or out-of-date person
entries.example_cn: 由于他拒绝使用现代技术，人们称他为穴居人，暗指他守旧落伍。
entries.example_en: People called him a troglodyte because he rejected modern technology.

entries.definition_en: a colorful tropical bird with a long tail found in the forests of the Americas
entries.example_cn: 我们在雨林里发现了一只罕见的咬鹃栖息在树枝上。
entries.example_en: We spotted a rare trogon perched on a branch in the rainforest.

entries.definition_cn: 由三匹并排马匹牵引的俄罗斯马车或雪橇
entries.definition_en: a Russian carriage or sleigh drawn by three horses abreast
entries.example_cn: 游客们乘坐传统的四轮双套马车在雪地上游览。
entries.example_en: The tourists took a ride in a traditional troika across the snow.

entries.definition_en: a group of three people who share power in Russia
entries.example_cn: 新政府由三位政治领导人组成的三人执政集团建立。
entries.example_en: The new government was formed by a troika of political leaders.

entries.definition_en: the number three
entries.example_cn: 这三个数字加起来是十。
entries.example_en: The troika of numbers sums up to ten.

entries.definition_cn: 北欧神话中的超自然生物（如矮人或巨人），居住在洞穴或山中
entries.definition_en: a supernatural creature from Scandinavian folklore, such as a dwarf or giant, that lives in caves or mountains
entries.example_cn: 传说中有个巨人住在深山洞穴里。
entries.example_en: The legend says a troll lives deep in the mountain caves.

entries.definition_en: the activity of fishing by drawing a baited line through the water
entries.example_cn: 他们一大早就去湖里拖钓。
entries.example_en: They went trolling in the lake early in the morning.

entries.definition_cn: 拖钓用的鱼线、诱饵或拟饵
entries.definition_en: a fishing line, bait, or lure used for trolling
entries.example_cn: 渔夫拖钓鳟鱼时使用了一个闪亮的金属拟饵。
entries.example_en: The fisherman used a shiny metal troll while trolling for trout.

entries.definition_en: to fish by drawing a hook and line through the water
entries.example_cn: 他决定在河里拖钓鳟鱼。
entries.example_en: He decided to troll for trout in the river.

entries.definition_en: to move or travel around slowly or leisurely
entries.example_cn: 他悠闲地漫步穿过小镇。
entries.example_en: He trolled leisurely through the town.

entries.definition_en: to roll or cause to roll or rotate
entries.example_cn: 他用棍子让水车旋转起来。
entries.example_en: He used a stick to troll the waterwheel.

entries.definition_cn: 轮唱曲；众人依次接唱不同声部的歌曲
entries.definition_en: a type of song where voices enter one after another, each singing a different part until everyone sings together
entries.example_cn: 合唱团表演了一首复杂的轮唱曲，需要完美的配合。
entries.example_en: The choir performed a complex troll that required perfect timing.

entries.definition_cn: 依次演唱轮唱曲的各个声部
entries.definition_en: to sing the parts of a round in succession
entries.example_cn: 学生们练习如何正确地依次演唱这首轮唱曲。
entries.example_en: The students practiced how to troll the song correctly.

entries.definition_cn: 拖着钓线缓慢行驶的机动渔船
entries.definition_en: an engine-powered fishing boat that moves slowly while trailing fishing lines behind it
entries.example_cn: 这艘拖钓渔船拖着钓线缓慢驶过浅水区。
entries.example_en: The troller moved slowly through the shallow water with its lines trailing behind.

entries.definition_cn: 使用拖钓法捕鱼的渔民
entries.definition_en: a fisherman who catches fish by trolling
entries.example_cn: 这名拖钓渔民让带饵钓线在船后缓慢拖行。
entries.example_en: The troller slowly towed baited lines behind the boat.

entries.definition_en: a streetcar or other light electric rail vehicle
entries.example_cn: 电车准时到达了车站。
entries.example_en: The trolley arrived at the station on time.

entries.definition_en: a bus that runs on electricity from overhead wires
entries.example_cn: 无轨电车在城市中心行驶，不排放废气。
entries.example_en: The trolleybus travels along the city center without emitting exhaust fumes.

entries.definition_cn: 故意挑衅或激怒他人的行为，尤指在网上这样做
entries.definition_en: The act of deliberately provoking or antagonizing others, especially online.
entries.example_cn: 论坛版主删除了他的挑衅言论，并警告他不要故意激怒其他用户。
entries.example_en: The forum moderators removed his trolling and warned him not to provoke other users.

entries.definition_en: angling by drawing a baited line through the water
entries.example_cn: 他花了一上午时间在深湖里拖钓鲈鱼。
entries.example_en: He spent the morning trolling for bass in the deep lake.

entries.definition_en: a prostitute
entries.example_cn: 那部旧小说用 trollop 这一侮辱性词语指称妓女。
entries.example_en: The old novel used trollop as an insulting term for a prostitute.

entries.definition_en: a woman who commits adultery
entries.example_cn: 在故事中，丈夫发现妻子是个通奸的女人。
entries.example_en: In the story, the husband discovered his wife was a trollop.

entries.definition_en: a woman who is untidy and dirty
entries.example_cn: 他称她为邋遢的女人，因为她从不打扫房间。
entries.example_en: He called her a trollop because she never cleaned her room.

entries.definition_en: a brass musical instrument with a long tube that changes length using a slide
entries.example_cn: 爵士乐队有一位才华横溢的长号手。
entries.example_en: The jazz band featured a talented trombone player.

entries.definition_en: a musician who plays the trombone
entries.example_cn: 那位著名的大号手昨晚加入了乐团。
entries.example_en: The famous trombonist joined the orchestra last night.

entries.definition_cn: 以假乱真的；产生立体错觉的
entries.definition_en: creating the illusion of three-dimensional reality on a flat surface
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅错觉天花板，看起来像是有飞鸟的天空。
entries.example_en: The artist painted a trompe-l'oeil ceiling that looked like an open sky with flying birds.

entries.definition_en: a group of soldiers or a military unit
entries.example_cn: 军队派遣一个连守卫边境。
entries.example_en: The army sent a troop to guard the border.

entries.definition_en: a group of people or animals
entries.example_cn: 一群粉丝在体育场外有秩序地等待。
entries.example_en: A troop of fans waited outside the stadium.

entries.definition_en: a cavalry unit corresponding to an infantry company
entries.example_cn: 该骑兵连驻扎在北部地区。
entries.example_en: The troop was stationed in the northern region.

entries.definition_en: a unit of Girl or Boy Scouts
entries.example_cn: 童子军小队每周在公园聚会。
entries.example_en: The troop gathered at the park for their weekly meeting.

entries.definition_en: to move or march as if in a crowd
entries.example_cn: 游客们成群结队地爬上山顶看风景。
entries.example_en: The tourists trooped up the hill to see the view.

entries.definition_en: to march in a procession in a public place
entries.example_cn: 学生们将在节日游行穿过城镇广场。
entries.example_en: The students will troop through the town square for the festival.

entries.definition_en: an officer of the state police force
entries.example_cn: 这名州警因超速拦下了那辆车。
entries.example_en: The trooper stopped the car for speeding on the highway.

entries.definition_en: a soldier in an armored unit
entries.example_cn: 这名装甲部队士兵驾驶装甲车穿过城市街道。
entries.example_en: The trooper drove the armored vehicle through the city streets.

entries.definition_en: a mounted police officer, especially in Australia
entries.example_cn: 这名骑警在事故现场协助疏导交通。
entries.example_en: The trooper on horseback helped direct traffic at the accident scene.

entries.definition_en: a soldier who fights while riding a horse
entries.example_cn: 这幅历史画作描绘了一名骑兵冲锋入阵。
entries.example_en: The historical painting showed a trooper charging into battle.

entries.definition_en: military personnel, especially soldiers, considered collectively
entries.example_cn: 军队开进了城市。
entries.example_en: The troops marched into the city.

entries.definition_en: a ship designed for transporting military troops
entries.example_cn: 这艘历史悠久的运输船被改造成博物馆以纪念士兵们。
entries.example_en: The historic troopship was converted into a museum to honor the soldiers.

entries.definition_en: a word or phrase used in a figurative or nonliteral way
entries.example_cn: 作者用“风暴”这一比喻手法来描述城市的混乱。
entries.example_en: The author uses the metaphor of a storm as a trope to describe the chaos in the city.

entries.definition_en: relating to nutrition or the supply of nutrients
entries.example_cn: 血液中的营养因子有助于细胞生长。
entries.example_en: The trophic factors in the blood help the cells grow.

entries.definition_cn: 构成囊胚壁、为胚胎提供营养并随后发育成胎盘一部分的细胞层
entries.definition_en: the layer of cells that forms the wall of a blastocyst, nourishes the embryo, and later develops into part of the placenta
entries.example_cn: 滋养层在怀孕早期植入过程中起着至关重要的作用。
entries.example_en: The trophoblast plays a crucial role in implantation during early pregnancy.

entries.definition_en: relating to or formed from the trophoblast
entries.example_cn: 胚胎的滋养层附着在子宫壁上。
entries.example_en: The trophoblastic layer of the embryo attaches to the uterine wall.

entries.definition_cn: 处于生命周期活跃摄食阶段的原生动物；滋养体
entries.definition_en: a protozoan in the active feeding stage of its life cycle
entries.example_cn: 显微镜检查显示样本中存在滋养体。
entries.example_en: Microscopic examination revealed the presence of trophozoites in the sample.

entries.definition_en: an object given to someone to show they have won a competition
entries.example_cn: 她因赢得游泳比赛而获得了一个银质奖杯。
entries.example_en: She received a silver trophy for winning the swimming race.

entries.definition_en: an award given for winning in a war or a hunt
entries.example_cn: 猎人把那只鹿当作战利品展示在客厅里。
entries.example_en: The hunter displayed the deer as a trophy in his living room.

entries.definition_en: either of two parallels of latitude about 23.5 degrees to the north and south of the equator representing the points farthest north and south at which the sun can shine directly overhead and constituting the boundaries of the Torrid Zone or tropics
entries.example_cn: 北回归线标志着热带的北界。
entries.example_en: The Tropic of Cancer marks the northern boundary of the tropics.

entries.definition_en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)
entries.example_cn: 他们去了热带地区的一个热带岛屿。
entries.example_en: They traveled to a tropical island in the tropics.

entries.definition_en: of weather or climate; hot and humid as in the tropics
entries.example_cn: 湿热如热带的气候使得在户外工作变得困难。
entries.example_en: The tropic heat made it difficult to work outside.

entries.definition_en: relating to the tropics
entries.example_cn: 热带气候使植物生长得非常快。
entries.example_en: The tropical climate makes the plants grow very fast.

entries.definition_en: having weather that is hot and humid
entries.example_cn: 我们习惯了湿热的气候。
entries.example_en: We are used to the tropical heat and humidity.

entries.definition_en: of or relating to the tropics or either tropic
entries.example_cn: 热带风暴通常在夏季形成。
entries.example_en: Tropical storms often form in the summer.

entries.definition_en: using figurative language instead of literal meaning
entries.example_cn: 作者用比喻的说法来描述这种情况。
entries.example_en: The author used a tropical expression to describe the situation.

entries.definition_en: in a manner characteristic of the tropics
entries.example_cn: 这些植物在温暖潮湿的气候下热带般地生长。
entries.example_en: The plants grew tropically in the warm, humid climate.

entries.definition_cn: 生物体，尤指植物或其部分，朝向或背离刺激源的转向
entries.definition_en: the turning of an organism, especially a plant, or part of one, toward or away from a stimulus
entries.example_cn: 这种植物表现出正向趋性，向着阳光生长。
entries.example_en: The plant exhibits a positive tropism by growing toward the sunlight.

entries.definition_cn: 病原体感染某种细胞、组织、器官或宿主的能力或倾向
entries.definition_en: the ability or tendency of a pathogen to infect a particular type of cell, tissue, organ, or host
entries.example_cn: 这种病毒的组织嗜性限制了它能够感染的器官。
entries.example_en: The virus's tissue tropism limits the organs it can infect.

entries.definition_en: an instinctive tendency or preference, especially in a person
entries.example_cn: 她偏爱安静地方，因此乡间很适合她。
entries.example_en: Her tropism toward quiet places made the countryside ideal for her.

entries.definition_en: the boundary layer separating the troposphere from the stratosphere
entries.example_cn: 当你穿过对流层顶时，温度会急剧下降。
entries.example_en: The temperature drops sharply as you cross the tropopause.

entries.definition_cn: 大气层的最低层，从地球表面延伸至对流层顶
entries.definition_en: the lowest layer of the atmosphere, extending from Earth’s surface to the tropopause
entries.example_cn: 大多数天气现象都发生在对流层内。
entries.example_en: Most weather phenomena occur within the troposphere.

entries.definition_en: a mutual promise to marry
entries.example_cn: 他们在婚礼前互许婚约。
entries.example_en: They plighted their troth before the wedding.

entries.definition_en: a solemn pledge of fidelity
entries.example_cn: 他发誓要保护家人免受伤害。
entries.example_en: He gave his troth to protect his family from harm.

entries.definition_cn: 蹄（猪或羊的脚，尤指用作食物的部分）
entries.definition_en: the foot of a pig or sheep, especially one used as food
entries.example_cn: 这道传统食谱需要猪蹄来使汤变得浓郁且胶质感强。
entries.example_en: The traditional recipe calls for a pig trotter to make the soup rich and gelatinous.

entries.definition_cn: 快步赛马；尤指用于驾车比赛的马
entries.definition_en: a horse trained to trot, especially one trained for harness racing
entries.example_cn: 这匹快步赛马以稳定而有节奏的步伐赢得了比赛。
entries.example_en: The trotter won the race by maintaining a steady, rhythmic pace.

entries.definition_cn: 狼阱；带有中央尖桩的锥形陷坑
entries.definition_en: a sloping pit with a stake in the middle used as an obstacle to the enemy
entries.example_cn: 士兵们必须穿过布满狼阱的田野。
entries.example_en: The soldiers had to cross the field full of trou-de-loup.

entries.definition_cn: 中世纪欧洲的游吟诗人；巡回创作并演唱歌曲的人
entries.definition_en: a medieval European itinerant composer and performer of songs
entries.example_cn: 游吟诗人弹奏鲁特琴，吟唱着关于骑士精神的歌谣。
entries.example_en: The troubadour played his lute and sang tales of chivalry.

entries.definition_en: a source of difficulty
entries.example_cn: 我们没钱了，所以陷入了困境。
entries.example_en: We are in trouble because we ran out of money.

entries.definition_en: an effort that is inconvenient
entries.example_cn: 修车真是费了一番周折。
entries.example_en: It was a lot of trouble to fix the car.

entries.definition_en: an angry disturbance
entries.example_cn: 人群在街上造成了很大的骚乱。
entries.example_en: The crowd caused a great deal of trouble in the street.

entries.definition_en: to cause inconvenience or discomfort to
entries.example_cn: 我希望我的问题没有给你造成不便。
entries.example_en: I hope I am not troubling you with my questions.

entries.definition_en: to disturb in mind or make uneasy
entries.example_cn: 这消息使他非常不安。
entries.example_en: The news troubled him greatly.

entries.definition_en: to take the trouble to do something
entries.example_cn: 她费心写了一封长信。
entries.example_en: She took the trouble to write a long letter.

entries.definition_en: an event causing distress or pain
entries.example_cn: 她爱犬的去世对她来说是一件非常悲痛的事。
entries.example_en: The death of her dog was a great trouble to her.

entries.definition_en: to move deeply (emotionally)
entries.example_cn: 这个故事深深打动了我。
entries.example_en: The story troubled me deeply.

entries.definition_en: without problems or difficulties
entries.example_cn: 我们希望去机场的旅途一帆风顺。
entries.example_en: We hope to have a trouble-free journey to the airport.

entries.definition_en: feeling or showing distress, worry, or sadness
entries.example_cn: 听到坏消息后，她看起来忧心忡忡。
entries.example_en: She looked troubled after hearing the bad news.

entries.definition_en: affected by difficulties, unrest, or disorder
entries.example_cn: 该国多年来一直受到国内骚乱的困扰。
entries.example_en: The country has been troubled by civil unrest for years.

entries.definition_en: someone who deliberately causes problems or disturbances
entries.example_cn: 老师让那个捣乱者离开教室。
entries.example_en: The teacher asked the troublemaker to leave the classroom.

entries.definition_en: to find and fix problems in a system or process
entries.example_cn: IT 团队将排查网络连接问题。
entries.example_en: The IT team will troubleshoot the network connection issues.

entries.definition_en: a worker whose job is to locate and fix sources of trouble, especially in mechanical devices
entries.example_cn: 公司聘请了一名专门的维修技师来修理故障发动机。
entries.example_en: The company hired a specialist troubleshooter to repair the faulty engine.

entries.definition_cn: 尝试诊断计算机系统问题的软件程序或例程
entries.definition_en: a software program or routine that attempts to diagnose a problem with a computer system
entries.example_cn: 运行系统故障排除程序，查找打印机无法工作的原因。
entries.example_en: Run the system troubleshooter to find out why the printer is not working.

entries.definition_en: causing difficulty or annoyance
entries.example_cn: 那令人烦恼的噪音让他整夜未眠。
entries.example_en: The troublesome noise kept him awake all night.

entries.definition_en: causing worry, anxiety, or distress
entries.example_cn: 令人担忧的消息让每个人都感到焦虑。
entries.example_en: The troubling news made everyone feel anxious.

entries.definition_cn: 狭窄的凹陷（如在地面、海浪之间或海底）
entries.definition_en: a narrow depression (as in the earth or between ocean waves or in the ocean bed)
entries.example_cn: 船只穿越了暴风雨大海的波谷。
entries.example_en: The ship navigated through the trough of the stormy sea.

entries.definition_cn: 屋檐或屋顶上的沟槽；收集并带走雨水
entries.definition_en: a channel along the eaves or on the roof; collects and carries away rainwater
entries.example_cn: 旧屋顶需要一个新的排水槽以防止漏水。
entries.example_en: The old roof needed a new trough to prevent leaks.

entries.definition_en: a long narrow shallow receptacle
entries.example_cn: 他们用一个长槽来装沙子给孩子们玩。
entries.example_en: They used a trough to hold the sand for the children.

entries.definition_cn: （通常在谷仓或马厩中）供牛马进食的食槽
entries.definition_en: a container (usually in a barn or stable) from which cattle or horses feed
entries.example_cn: 农民往食槽里装满了新鲜的干草喂马。
entries.example_en: The farmer filled the trough with fresh hay for the horses.

entries.definition_en: a concave shape with an open top
entries.example_cn: 艺术家用一块木头雕刻出一个凹形槽。
entries.example_en: The artist sculpted a trough from a single piece of wood.

entries.definition_cn: 可供攫取的政府资金（常用于比喻）
entries.definition_en: a source of government funds regarded as available for exploitation
entries.example_cn: 政客被指责靠国家资金中饱私囊。
entries.example_en: Politicians were accused of feeding at the national trough.

entries.definition_en: come out better in a competition, race, or conflict
entries.example_cn: 主队以五比一的比分大胜客队。
entries.example_en: The home team trounced the visitors by a score of five to one.

entries.definition_en: censure severely or angrily
entries.example_cn: 经理决定因员工违反安全规定而严厉斥责他。
entries.example_en: The manager decided to trounce the employee for breaking the safety rules.

entries.definition_en: beat severely; thrash
entries.example_cn: 守卫威胁要用重鞭鞭打囚犯。
entries.example_en: The guard threatened to trounce the prisoner with a heavy whip.

entries.definition_en: a very heavy defeat
entries.example_cn: 主队在最后一场比赛中惨败。
entries.example_en: The home team suffered a trouncing in the final match.

entries.definition_en: the act of beating someone severely with repeated blows
entries.example_cn: 那个恶霸因痛打年幼的学生而被捕。
entries.example_en: The bully was arrested for trouncing the younger student.

entries.definition_en: an organization of performers and associated personnel, especially in theater
entries.example_cn: 这个喜剧剧团在当地节日上进行了表演。
entries.example_en: The comedy troupe performed at the local festival.

entries.definition_cn: 可靠、不抱怨且勤奋的人
entries.definition_en: a person who is reliable, uncomplaining, and hardworking
entries.example_cn: 她是个真正的老黄牛，从不抱怨漫长的工时。
entries.example_en: She is a real trouper who never complains about the long hours.

entries.definition_en: a member of a theatrical company
entries.example_cn: 这名演员随巡回剧团演出了莎士比亚戏剧。
entries.example_en: The trouper performed Shakespeare with a touring company.

entries.definition_en: a garment designed for or relating to trousers
entries.example_cn: 裁缝测量了裤腿以确保合身。
entries.example_en: The tailor measured the trouser leg to ensure a perfect fit.

entries.definition_en: dressed in trousers
entries.example_cn: 这位表演者总是穿着裤装出席演出。
entries.example_en: The trouper was always seen in a trousered outfit for the performance.

entries.definition_en: a garment extending from the waist to the knee or ankle, covering each leg separately
entries.example_cn: 他穿上裤子离开了家。
entries.example_en: He put on his trousers and left the house.

entries.definition_en: the collection of clothes, linens, and accessories a bride brings to her new home
entries.example_cn: 她花了数年用手工缝制的亚麻布制作嫁妆。
entries.example_en: She spent years building her trousseau with hand-stitched linens.

entries.definition_cn: 一种生活在冷水中的食用和游钓鱼，通常比鲑鱼小
entries.definition_en: a game and food fish found in cool fresh waters, usually smaller than salmon
entries.example_cn: 我们去河里钓鱼，希望能钓到一条鳟鱼。
entries.example_en: We went fishing in the river hoping to catch a trout.

entries.definition_cn: 某些淡水食用和游钓鱼的肉
entries.definition_en: the flesh of certain freshwater game and food fishes
entries.example_cn: 厨师用新鲜的鳟鱼肉做了一道美味的菜肴。
entries.example_en: The chef prepared a delicious meal using fresh trout.

entries.definition_en: a large collection of valuable or interesting things, often found hidden
entries.example_cn: 阁楼里藏着一大堆旧照片和信件，堪称宝库。
entries.example_en: The attic was a trove of old photographs and letters.

entries.definition_cn: 带柄、扁平或铲状金属刃的小工具，用于抹砂浆或翻动土壤
entries.definition_en: a small hand tool with a handle and flat or scoop-shaped blade, used for spreading mortar or working soil
entries.example_cn: 石匠用抹子将砂浆涂抹在墙上。
entries.example_en: The mason used a trowel to spread the mortar on the wall.

entries.definition_cn: 用抹子或小铲涂抹、铺开或翻动
entries.definition_en: to apply, spread, or work with a trowel
entries.example_cn: 他用抹子将新鲜灰泥涂抹在粗糙的表面上。
entries.example_en: He troweled the fresh plaster over the rough surface.

entries.definition_en: a system of weights used for measuring precious metals and gemstones
entries.example_cn: 金条是按金衡盎司称重的。
entries.example_en: The gold bar was weighed in troy ounces.

entries.definition_en: the act of failing to attend school regularly
entries.example_cn: 学校董事会正在考虑对逃学行为实施更严厉的处罚。
entries.example_en: The school board is considering stricter penalties for truancy.

entries.definition_en: one who is absent from school without permission
entries.example_cn: 老师立即向校长报告了这名逃学者。
entries.example_en: The teacher reported the truant to the school principal immediately.

entries.definition_en: someone who shirks duty
entries.example_cn: 经理解雇了拒绝上夜班的逃避责任者。
entries.example_en: The manager fired the truant employee who refused to work the night shift.

entries.definition_cn: （学生）未经许可缺席的；逃学的
entries.definition_en: absent without permission
entries.example_cn: 他整个上午都被标记为缺席。
entries.example_en: He was marked truant for the entire morning session.

entries.definition_cn: 对手之间达成停止战斗的临时协议
entries.definition_en: a temporary agreement to stop fighting between opponents
entries.example_cn: 两国签署停火协议以谈判持久和平。
entries.example_en: The two nations signed a truce to negotiate a lasting peace.

entries.definition_en: a large vehicle for carrying goods
entries.example_cn: 运送物资的卡车迟到了。
entries.example_en: The truck arrived late with the supplies.

entries.definition_en: a handcart with two wheels and handles for moving heavy objects
entries.example_cn: 他用手推车搬运箱子。
entries.example_en: He used a truck to move the crates.

entries.definition_en: transport goods using a truck
entries.example_cn: 他们用卡车把家具运到了新房子。
entries.example_en: They trucked the furniture to the new house.

entries.definition_en: a person whose job is to drive a truck
entries.example_cn: 卡车司机在黎明时分将货物运到了仓库。
entries.example_en: The trucker delivered the goods to the warehouse at dawn.

usage.label: 加拿大、美国非正式用语

entries.definition_en: the activity of transporting goods by truck
entries.example_cn: 这家公司专门从事将货物从工厂运往港口的业务。
entries.example_en: The company specializes in trucking goods from the factory to the ports.

entries.definition_en: to yield to someone out of weakness
entries.example_cn: 他拒绝屈从于上司的要求。
entries.example_en: He refused to truckle to the demands of his superiors.

entries.definition_en: to try to gain favor by cringing or flattering
entries.example_cn: 这名员工被指控为了获得晋升而谄媚老板。
entries.example_en: The employee was accused of truckling to the boss to get a promotion.

entries.definition_en: a low bed designed to slide under a higher bed
entries.example_cn: 孩子们睡在一张塞在父母床底下的床底床上。
entries.example_en: The children slept on a truckle tucked under the parents' bed.

entries.definition_cn: 蛮横好斗；好斗蛮横的行为
entries.definition_en: aggressive and defiant behavior that is noisy and difficult to control
entries.example_cn: 抗议者的蛮横好斗使警方难以驱散他们。
entries.example_en: The truculence of the protesters made it hard for the police to disperse them.

entries.definition_cn: 桀骜好斗、爱争执或凶狠的
entries.definition_en: defiantly aggressive, quarrelsome, or savage
entries.example_cn: 这位好斗的拳击手拒绝与对手握手。
entries.example_en: The truculent boxer refused to shake hands with his opponent.

entries.definition_en: in an aggressively hostile or defiant manner
entries.example_cn: 他好斗地拒绝为自己的错误道歉。
entries.example_en: He truculently refused to apologize for his mistake.

entries.definition_en: in a defiantly hostile manner
entries.example_cn: 该团队对抗地捍卫了他们有争议的决定。
entries.example_en: The team truculently defended their controversial decision.

entries.definition_en: to walk heavily and firmly, usually because one is tired or walking through mud
entries.example_cn: 士兵们蹒跚着穿过雪地前往基地。
entries.example_en: The soldiers trudged through the snow to reach the base.

entries.definition_en: a long and difficult walk
entries.example_cn: 徒步之后，我们艰难地跋涉回车里。
entries.example_en: After the hike, we had a long trudge back to the car.

entries.definition_en: showing unswerving loyalty
entries.example_cn: 他是一位忠诚的朋友，从未背叛过我。
entries.example_en: He is a true-blue friend who has never betrayed me.

entries.definition_en: offering a series of statements each of which is to be judged as true or false
entries.example_cn: 考试中包含了几道关于历史的判断题。
entries.example_en: The exam included several true-false questions about history.

entries.definition_en: a person who is deeply loved by another person
entries.example_cn: 她写了一首诗献给她的挚爱。
entries.example_en: She wrote a poem dedicated to her truelove.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being in agreement with reality
entries.example_cn: 该历史记载的真实性已通过多个来源得到证实。
entries.example_en: The trueness of the historical account was verified by multiple sources.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being loyal
entries.example_cn: 在危机期间，她对朋友的忠诚从未动摇。
entries.example_en: Her trueness to her friends never wavered during the crisis.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being accurate or correctly aligned
entries.example_cn: 该仪器测量的精确度对科学研究至关重要。
entries.example_en: The trueness of the instrument's measurements is crucial for scientific research.

entries.definition_en: a highly prized edible fungus that grows underground, especially in southwestern Europe
entries.example_cn: 厨师用一种罕见的松露准备了一道美食。
entries.example_en: The chef prepared a gourmet dish featuring a rare truffle.

entries.definition_en: an edible fungus of the genus Tuber that grows underground
entries.example_cn: 松露通常生长在橡树附近。
entries.example_en: Truffles are often found growing near oak trees.

entries.definition_en: a creamy chocolate candy
entries.example_cn: 她买了一盒松露巧克力参加节日派对。
entries.example_en: She bought a box of truffles for the holiday party.

entries.definition_cn: 不言自明的道理；陈词滥调
entries.definition_en: a statement that is obviously true but often uninteresting
entries.example_cn: 三角形有三条边，这是一个不言自明的道理。
entries.example_en: It is a truism that a triangle has three sides.

entries.definition_en: in accordance with truth or fact or reality
entries.example_cn: 他确实相信教育的力量。
entries.example_en: He truly believes in the power of education.

entries.definition_en: in fact (used as intensifiers or sentence modifiers)
entries.example_cn: 实在说，我从未见过如此美丽的日落。
entries.example_en: Truly, I have never seen such a beautiful sunset.

entries.definition_en: with sincerity; without pretense
entries.example_cn: 她真诚地感谢他的帮助。
entries.example_en: She thanked him sincerely for his help.

entries.definition_en: by right
entries.example_cn: 诚然，这是城里最好的餐厅。
entries.example_en: Truly, this is the best restaurant in the city.

entries.definition_en: in card games, the suit that is declared to rank above all other suits for the hand
entries.example_cn: 他选择黑桃作为这局游戏的王牌花色。
entries.example_en: He chose spades as the trump suit for the game.

entries.definition_en: a brass musical instrument with a narrow tube, flared bell, and valves that produces a brilliant tone
entries.example_cn: 小号手用一段有力的旋律引领了整个管弦乐队。
entries.example_en: The trump player led the orchestra with a powerful melody.

entries.definition_en: a playing card belonging to the suit that has been declared as the highest-ranking suit
entries.example_cn: 她打出一张红心K，用这张王牌赢得了这一墩。
entries.example_en: She played a king of hearts to win the trick with her trump.

entries.definition_en: be more successful or powerful than someone else
entries.example_cn: 新技术在效率上胜过旧方法。
entries.example_en: The new technology trumped the old methods in efficiency.

entries.definition_en: play a card of the trump suit
entries.example_cn: 如果你有一张王牌，你必须出王牌。
entries.example_en: You must trump if you have a card of the trump suit.

entries.definition_en: make a loud, brassy sound like that of a trumpet
entries.example_cn: 乐队开始大声吹号来宣布获胜者。
entries.example_en: The band began to trump loudly to announce the winner.

entries.definition_en: announce something loudly and impressively, as if with a fanfare
entries.example_cn: 公司隆重举行了盛大的仪式来发布新产品。
entries.example_en: The company trumped its new product launch with a grand ceremony.

entries.definition_en: fabricated or invented with the intention to deceive
entries.example_cn: 警方调查了针对无辜男子的捏造指控。
entries.example_en: The police investigated the trumped-up charges against the innocent man.

entries.definition_en: decorative objects that are not very valuable
entries.example_cn: 这家店里摆满了廉价的装饰品，比如玻璃小雕像和塑料花瓶。
entries.example_en: The shop was filled with cheap trumpery like glass figurines and plastic vases.

entries.definition_en: speech or writing that is meaningless or absurd
entries.example_cn: 那位政治家的演讲不过是旨在误导选民的胡言乱语。
entries.example_en: The politician's speech was nothing but trumpery designed to mislead the voters.

entries.definition_en: a brass musical instrument with a brilliant tone, played by blowing into it
entries.example_cn: 乐队用小号演奏了一首欢快的曲子。
entries.example_en: The band played a lively tune on the trumpet.

entries.definition_en: to announce or proclaim something loudly and publicly
entries.example_cn: 这则消息在全国范围内被大肆宣扬。
entries.example_en: The news was trumpeted across the country.

entries.definition_en: to play or blow on the trumpet
entries.example_cn: 他决定在音乐会上吹小号。
entries.example_en: He decided to trumpet during the concert.

entries.definition_cn: 发出像大象一样的响亮叫声
entries.definition_en: to make a loud cry like that of an elephant
entries.example_cn: 大象看到猎人时发出响亮的号叫声。
entries.example_en: The elephant trumpeted loudly when it saw the hunters.

entries.definition_en: a musician who plays the trumpet or cornet
entries.example_cn: 小号手在音乐会期间演奏了独奏曲。
entries.example_en: The trumpeter played a solo during the concert.

entries.definition_cn: 宣告、公布或谴责某事的人
entries.definition_en: a person who proclaims, publishes, or denounces something
entries.example_cn: 皇家宫廷的传令官宣布国王驾到。
entries.example_en: The trumpeter of the royal court announced the king's arrival.

entries.definition_cn: 一种南美洲森林中的群居大型鸟类，羽毛黑而有光泽，叫声响亮
entries.definition_en: a large, gregarious, crane-like bird from South American forests with glossy black plumage and a loud cry
entries.example_cn: 这种鸟很容易被当地农民驯养。
entries.example_en: The trumpeter was easily domesticated by the local farmers.

entries.definition_cn: 号手天鹅是北美最大的天鹅种类。
entries.definition_en: a large, pure white wild swan from western North America with a sonorous cry
entries.example_cn: 北美最大的天鹅物种是 trumpeter 天鹅。
entries.example_en: The trumpeter swan is the largest species of swan in North America.

entries.definition_cn: 黄瓶子草（Sarracenia flava），一种产于美国东南部的食虫植物
entries.definition_en: the yellow pitcher plant (Sarracenia flava), a plant found in the southeastern United States
entries.example_cn: 植物学家研究黄瓶子草，以了解植物独特的适应性。
entries.example_en: Botanists study trumpets to understand unique plant adaptations.

entries.definition_en: the act of winning a trick in card games by playing a trump card when you cannot follow suit
entries.example_cn: 他通过出王牌赢了这一墩，当时他手中没有红心牌。
entries.example_en: He won the trick by trumping, playing a spade when he held no hearts.

entries.definition_en: make shorter as if by cutting off
entries.example_cn: 编辑不得不删减文章以适应有限的版面。
entries.example_en: The editor had to truncate the article to fit the limited space.

entries.definition_cn: 截去（数字的小数位）以进行近似
entries.definition_en: approximate by ignoring all terms beyond a chosen one
entries.example_cn: 为了效率，计算机程序将小数展开截断为五位。
entries.example_en: The computer program truncates the decimal expansion to five digits for efficiency.

entries.definition_cn: 截去角部；用平面替代角
entries.definition_en: replace a corner by a plane
entries.example_cn: 建筑师决定截去大楼的角以改善视野。
entries.example_en: The architect decided to truncate the corner of the building to improve the view.

entries.definition_en: terminating abruptly by having or as if having an end or point cut off
entries.example_cn: 这个被截断的句子让读者对结局感到好奇。
entries.example_en: The truncated sentence left the reader wondering about the conclusion.

entries.definition_en: having a part cut off so it does not have a complete end
entries.example_cn: 由于文件太大，图像被截断了。
entries.example_en: The image was truncated because the file was too large.

entries.definition_en: ending before the usual or expected time
entries.example_cn: 由于暴风雨，足球比赛被缩短了。
entries.example_en: Due to the storm, the football match was truncated.

entries.definition_en: the act of cutting something short
entries.example_cn: 电影的删减去掉了最后一场戏。
entries.example_en: The truncation of the film removed the final scene.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being cut short or made shorter
entries.example_cn: 这个句子的缩短使其含义变得不明确。
entries.example_en: The truncation of the sentence made its meaning unclear.

entries.definition_cn: 在不进行四舍五入的情况下去掉小数中最低位的数字
entries.definition_en: the removal of the least significant digits from a decimal number without rounding
entries.example_cn: 将3.14159截断到小数点后三位得到3.141。
entries.example_en: Truncation of 3.14159 to three decimal places gives 3.141.

entries.definition_cn: 用平面替换固体物体的边缘或角
entries.definition_en: the replacement of an edge or corner of a solid object by a flat surface
entries.example_cn: 宝石的截断创造了一个新的平坦切面。
entries.example_en: The truncation of the gemstone created a new, flat facet.

entries.definition_en: a short, thick club used by police officers

entries.definition_en: a low bed designed to be slid underneath a higher bed

entries.example_en: The children slept in a trundle bed tucked under the main bed.

entries.example_en: The suitcase has wheels that trundle smoothly over the carpet.

entries.definition_en: to move something heavily by rolling or dragging it

entries.definition_en: a large case for luggage

entries.definition_en: the storage compartment in an automobile
entries.example_cn: 把杂货放进后备箱。
entries.example_en: Put the groceries in the trunk.

entries.definition_en: the main stem of a tree
entries.example_cn: 那棵老橡树有一个巨大的树干。
entries.example_en: The old oak tree had a massive trunk.

entries.definition_en: the body excluding the head, neck, and limbs
entries.example_cn: 跑步者感到躯干疼痛。
entries.example_en: The runner felt a pain in his trunk.

entries.definition_en: a long flexible snout of an elephant
entries.example_cn: 大象用鼻子把水吸起来。
entries.example_en: The elephant used its trunk to pick up the water.

entries.definition_en: trousers that end at or above the knee
entries.example_cn: 他在游泳池里穿着白色短裤游泳。
entries.example_en: He wore white trunks while swimming in the pool.

usage.label: plural-only
usage.pattern: used in the plural for shorts or briefs

entries.definition_en: a framework of beams supporting a roof or bridge
entries.example_cn: 这座旧桥加装了一个新的钢制桁架以加固。
entries.example_en: The old bridge was reinforced with a new steel truss.

entries.definition_en: a medical bandage with a pad and belt used to support a hernia
entries.example_cn: 医生开了一种疝气带来帮助固定疝气。
entries.example_en: The doctor prescribed a truss to help hold the hernia in place.

entries.definition_en: a small triangular bracket of brick or stone in architecture
entries.example_cn: 建筑师在门上方设计了一个装饰性的小三角托架。
entries.example_en: The architect designed a decorative truss above the doorway.

entries.definition_en: to support a structure using a framework
entries.example_cn: 木梁用框架支撑着沉重的屋顶以抵御大风。
entries.example_en: The wooden beams truss the heavy roof against the wind.

entries.definition_en: to tie the wings and legs of a bird before cooking
entries.example_cn: 请把火鸡捆好再放进烤箱。
entries.example_en: Please truss the turkey before putting it in the oven.

entries.definition_cn: 用绳索或带子捆扎固定
entries.definition_en: to secure something tightly with ropes or bands

entries.example_en: They had to truss the cargo securely before the storm arrived.

entries.definition_en: have confidence or faith in someone or something
entries.example_cn: 我信任你会做出正确的决定。
entries.example_en: I trust you to make the right decision.

entries.definition_en: allow without fear
entries.example_cn: 她信赖那只狗看家。
entries.example_en: She trusted the dog to guard the house.

entries.definition_en: be confident about something
entries.example_cn: 我确信天气明天会好转。
entries.example_en: I trust that the weather will improve tomorrow.

entries.definition_cn: 对某人或某事的可靠性，或对某事会发生的信心
entries.definition_en: confidence that someone or something will be reliable or that something will happen

entries.example_en: I have little trust that the project will finish on time.

entries.definition_en: the trait of believing in the honesty and reliability of others
entries.example_cn: 信任是良好关系的基础。
entries.example_en: Trust is the foundation of a good relationship.

entries.definition_en: something held by one party for the benefit of another
entries.example_cn: 这个家庭设立了一个信托基金来支持孩子们的教育。
entries.example_en: The family set up a trust to support their children's education.

entries.definition_en: expect and wish for something to happen
entries.example_cn: 我们指望你能平安到达。
entries.example_en: We trust that you will arrive safely.

usage.label: trust that + clause
usage.pattern: trust that you will arrive safely

entries.definition_en: a consortium of independent organizations formed to limit competition
entries.example_cn: 政府拆散了该托拉斯以促进公平竞争。
entries.example_en: The government broke up the trust to promote fair competition.

entries.definition_en: worthy of being believed or relied upon
entries.example_cn: 她是公司董事会的可信赖顾问。
entries.example_en: She is a trusted advisor to the company's board.

entries.definition_en: a person or organization given legal ownership of property to manage for someone else's benefit
entries.example_cn: 该慈善机构任命了一名新的受托人来监督资金。
entries.example_en: The charity appointed a new trustee to oversee the funds.

entries.definition_en: a member of a governing board
entries.example_cn: 作为大学的董事会成员，她参加每月的会议。
entries.example_en: As a trustee of the university, she attends monthly meetings.

entries.definition_en: the position of trustee
entries.example_cn: 她接受了该慈善基金会的受托人职位。
entries.example_en: She accepted the trusteeship of the charitable foundation.

entries.definition_cn: 联合国托管理事会授予某国对某领土的行政管理权
entries.definition_en: the administrative control of a territory granted to a country by the United Nations Trusteeship Council
entries.example_cn: 战后，联合国托管理事会将该岛屿的行政管理权授予了某国。
entries.example_en: After the war, the United Nations Trusteeship Council granted a country administrative control of the island.

entries.definition_en: a person who trusts someone or something
entries.example_cn: 她很容易相信自己听到的每一个谣言。
entries.example_en: She was a truster who readily believed every rumor she heard.

entries.definition_en: inclined to believe or confide readily; full of trust
entries.example_cn: 她是个充满信任的孩子，相信父母说的每一句话。
entries.example_en: She was a trustful child who believed everything her parents said.

entries.definition_en: inclined to believe or confide readily; full of trust
entries.example_cn: 她是一个信任他人的人，总是对别人抱有最好的期望。
entries.example_en: She is a trusting person who believes the best in others.

entries.definition_en: in a way that shows complete confidence and reliance
entries.example_cn: 她信赖地看着他，相信他会帮忙。
entries.example_en: She looked at him trustingly, believing he would help.

entries.definition_en: (law) a person who creates a trust by transferring property to a trustee for a beneficiary
entries.example_cn: 委托人将家族产业移交给受托人，以供子女受益。
entries.example_en: The trustor transferred the family estate to the trustee for the children's benefit.

entries.definition_en: the trait of deserving trust and confidence
entries.example_cn: 她的行为显示出她值得信赖的品质。
entries.example_en: Her trustworthiness is evident in her actions.

entries.definition_en: able to be relied on; deserving of trust or belief
entries.example_cn: 她是一位可靠的朋友，总是信守承诺。
entries.example_en: She is a trustworthy friend who always keeps her promises.

entries.definition_en: taking responsibility for one's conduct and obligations
entries.example_cn: 他是一位负责任的员工，对自己的工作全权负责。
entries.example_en: He is a trustworthy employee who takes full responsibility for his work.

entries.definition_en: worthy of trust or belief
entries.example_cn: 她是一位值得信任的朋友，总是保守秘密。
entries.example_en: She is a trusty friend who always keeps her secrets.

entries.definition_en: a convict considered trustworthy and granted special privileges
entries.example_cn: 这位受信任的囚犯被允许在花园工作，而不是在牢房里。
entries.example_en: The trusty was allowed to work in the garden instead of the cell.

entries.definition_en: a fact that has been verified
entries.example_cn: 地球绕太阳转是事实。
entries.example_en: It is the truth that the earth revolves around the sun.

entries.definition_en: conformity to reality or actuality
entries.example_cn: 这部电影缺乏原著故事的真实感。
entries.example_en: The movie lacked the truth of the original story.

entries.definition_en: a true statement
entries.example_cn: 他向我坦白了他的过去。
entries.example_en: He told me the truth about his past.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being near to the true value
entries.example_cn: 这个测量结果很接近真实值。
entries.example_en: The measurement was close to the truth.

entries.definition_en: expressing or giving expression to the truth
entries.example_cn: 他是一位诚实的证人，向法官讲述了他所看到的一切。
entries.example_en: He was a truthful witness who told the judge exactly what he saw.

entries.definition_en: conforming to the truth
entries.example_cn: 该报告包含了一些关于事故的符合事实的细节。
entries.example_en: The report contained several truthful details about the accident.

entries.definition_en: in a way that tells the truth
entries.example_cn: 她诚实地承认自己犯了错误。
entries.example_en: She truthfully admitted that she had made a mistake.

entries.definition_en: the quality of being honest and telling the truth
entries.example_cn: 法官赞扬了证人在审判期间的诚实。
entries.example_en: The judge praised the witness for his truthfulness during the trial.

entries.definition_en: make an effort or attempt

entries.example_en: He tried the limits of the car by driving it so fast.

entries.definition_en: hard to endure or deal with

entries.example_en: She filled the tub with warm water and bathed her children.

entries.example_cn: 旧电视使用电子管而不是屏幕。
entries.example_en: Old televisions used vacuum tubes instead of screens.

entries.definition_en: to provide with a tube or insert a tube into something
entries.example_cn: 医生将给病人插管以帮助呼吸。
entries.example_en: The doctor will tube the patient to help them breathe.

entries.example_en: Please tube the sample before sending it to the lab.
