entries.example_en: They drilled a well to get fresh water.

entries.definition_en: come up, as of a liquid
entries.example_cn: 水从地里涌了出来。
entries.example_en: Water welled up from the ground.

entries.definition_cn: 物体中用于容纳液体的腔体或容器
entries.definition_en: a cavity or vessel in an object used to contain liquid
entries.example_cn: 喷泉里的蓄水池装了很多水。
entries.example_en: The well in the fountain held a lot of water.

entries.definition_en: an abundant source of something
entries.example_cn: 森林是生命的源泉。
entries.example_en: The forest is a well of life.

entries.definition_en: having a healthy psychological state and functioning well in society
entries.example_cn: 她是一个适应良好的孩子，与同学相处融洽。
entries.example_en: She is a well-adjusted child who gets along well with her classmates.

entries.definition_en: having the benefit of careful prior consideration or counsel
entries.example_cn: 她在签署合同之前咨询律师是明智的。
entries.example_en: She was well-advised to consult a lawyer before signing the contract.

entries.definition_en: having a full array of suitable equipment or furnishings
entries.example_cn: 他们住在一间设备齐全的酒店里。
entries.example_en: They stayed in a well-appointed hotel.

usage.label: of accommodation, rooms, kitchens, and other furnished or equipped spaces
usage.pattern: well-appointed + accommodation, room, kitchen, or other furnished/equipped space

entries.definition_cn: 处于最佳平衡或均衡状态
entries.definition_en: in an optimal state of balance or equilibrium
entries.example_cn: 均衡的饮食对健康至关重要。
entries.example_en: A well-balanced diet is essential for good health.

entries.definition_en: free from psychological disorder
entries.example_cn: 她是一个心理健康的人，能很好地应对压力。
entries.example_en: She is a well-balanced person who handles stress well.

entries.definition_en: behaving in a way that is considered correct, especially by children
entries.example_cn: 老师表扬了那些安静听话的守规矩的学生。
entries.example_en: The teacher praised the well-behaved students for listening quietly.

entries.definition_en: a contented state of being happy and healthy and prosperous
entries.example_cn: 该社区中心关注所有儿童的幸福安康。
entries.example_en: The community center focuses on the well-being of all children.

entries.definition_en: well-mannered and refined because of good upbringing and education
entries.example_cn: 她很有教养，总是对陌生人说话有礼貌。
entries.example_en: She was well-bred and always spoke politely to strangers.

entries.definition_cn: 建造得令人满意或坚固的
entries.definition_en: Constructed in a pleasing or sound manner.
entries.example_cn: 这栋房子建造得很结实，应该能用很多年。
entries.example_en: The house is well-built and should last for many years.

entries.definition_en: Muscular and lean, having a body resembling that of an athlete.
entries.example_cn: 他身材精壮，跑得很快。
entries.example_en: He is well-built and runs very fast.

entries.definition_cn: 与有钱人或有社会地位的人关系密切的；有关系的
entries.definition_en: having close friends or relatives who are rich or important
entries.example_cn: 他因为有关系而得到了这份工作。
entries.example_en: He got the job because he is well-connected.

entries.definition_cn: （尤指某地区）交通连接便利的。
entries.definition_en: Having good transport connections, especially in an area.
entries.example_cn: 这个新社区通过公交车和火车与市中心相连，交通十分便利。
entries.example_en: The new neighborhood is well-connected to the city center by buses and trains.

entries.definition_en: having a clear and distinct outline as if precisely cut
entries.example_cn: 山影在天空中轮廓清晰。
entries.example_en: The shadow of the mountain was well-defined against the sky.

entries.definition_en: accurately stated or described
entries.example_cn: 该报告对问题提供了准确的解释。
entries.example_en: The report provided a well-defined explanation of the problem.

entries.definition_en: inclined to help or support; not antagonistic or hostile
entries.example_cn: 她对新同事很友好。
entries.example_en: She is well-disposed towards her new colleagues.

entries.definition_en: (of meat) cooked until there is no pink meat left inside
entries.example_cn: 我喜欢牛排全熟，这样比较容易咀嚼。
entries.example_en: I prefer my steak well-done so it is easy to chew.

entries.definition_en: wearing attractive, stylish, or tasteful clothes
entries.example_cn: 客人们都衣着考究地参加了正式晚宴。
entries.example_en: The guests were all well-dressed for the formal gala.

entries.definition_en: having received a high level of education and extensive knowledge
entries.example_cn: 这位受过良好教育的老师向学生清楚地解释了复杂的主题。
entries.example_en: The well-educated teacher explained the complex topic clearly to the students.

entries.definition_en: having a substantial income or a great deal of money
entries.example_cn: 她家境富裕，供得起她读书。
entries.example_en: She came from a well-endowed family that could afford to support her studies.

entries.definition_cn: 具有显著天赋或才能的
entries.definition_en: having a notable natural gift or ability
entries.example_cn: 他很有语言天赋。
entries.example_en: He is well-endowed with a natural ability to understand languages.

entries.definition_en: having a large bosom and pleasing curves
entries.example_cn: 她身材丰满，体态优雅。
entries.example_en: She was a well-endowed woman with a graceful figure.

entries.definition_en: having a pleasing appearance that matches ideal standards of beauty and proportion
entries.example_cn: 这位容貌俊美的男演员主演了这部新电影。
entries.example_en: The well-favored actor starred in the new film.

entries.definition_en: pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion
entries.example_cn: 相貌堂堂的王子受到所有人的赞赏。
entries.example_en: The well-favoured prince was admired by all.

entries.definition_en: properly nourished
entries.example_cn: 那些营养充足的孩子在公园里快乐地玩耍。
entries.example_en: The well-fed children played happily in the park.

entries.definition_en: having enough money to live comfortably; moderately rich
entries.example_cn: 经过多年的努力工作，他们变得富裕起来，买得起一所大房子。
entries.example_en: After years of hard work, they became well-fixed and could afford a large house.

entries.definition_cn: 符合语法或母语者公认用法的
entries.definition_en: conforming to the rules of grammar or usage accepted by native speakers
entries.example_cn: 这个句子符合标准英语语法。
entries.example_en: The sentence is well-formed according to standard English grammar.

entries.definition_en: having a full array of suitable equipment or furnishings
entries.example_cn: 这艘装备齐全的船已准备好进行长途航行。
entries.example_en: The well-found ship was ready for the long voyage.

entries.definition_cn: 有充分根据的；有理有据的
entries.definition_en: based on good reasons or solid evidence
entries.example_cn: 鉴于最近的新闻，他们的担忧是有充分根据的。
entries.example_en: Their fears were well-founded given the recent news.

entries.definition_en: wearing tasteful clothes and being very neat
entries.example_cn: 这位衣着得体、整洁的客人准时到达了派对。
entries.example_en: The well-groomed guest arrived at the party on time.

entries.definition_en: having hair that is neatly brushed and combed
entries.example_cn: 经过早晨的整理，他看起来头发梳理得很整齐。
entries.example_en: He looked well-groomed after his morning routine.

entries.definition_en: based on sound reasoning and good judgment
entries.example_cn: 她合乎逻辑的论点说服了委员会。
entries.example_en: Her well-grounded argument convinced the committee.

entries.definition_cn: 对某一学科有广博知识的；知识渊博的
entries.definition_en: having extensive knowledge of a subject
entries.example_cn: 她对中世纪历史有广博的知识。
entries.example_en: She is well-grounded in medieval history.

entries.definition_en: having a lot of money; wealthy
entries.example_cn: 富裕的客人们开着豪车抵达。
entries.example_en: The well-heeled guests arrived in luxury cars.

entries.definition_en: having good knowledge about a subject
entries.example_cn: 这位见多识广的记者知道案件的所有细节。
entries.example_en: The well-informed journalist knew all the details of the case.

entries.definition_en: having good motives, even if the results are not successful
entries.example_cn: 虽然他的建议令人困惑，但他本意是好的。
entries.example_en: Although his well-intentioned advice was confusing, he meant to help.

entries.definition_en: kept in good condition
entries.example_cn: 这座保养良好的花园令人赏心悦目。
entries.example_en: The well-kept garden was a pleasure to walk through.

entries.definition_en: characterized by order and neatness; free from disorder
entries.example_cn: 她住在一所整洁有序、井井有条的房子里。
entries.example_en: She lives in a well-kept house with everything in its place.

entries.definition_en: Kept secret from most people and known only to a limited group
entries.example_cn: 宝藏的位置一直是个鲜为人知的秘密。
entries.example_en: The location of the treasure remained a well-kept secret.

entries.definition_en: strongly and firmly constructed
entries.example_cn: 这种结构紧密的织物既耐用又穿着舒适。
entries.example_en: The well-knit fabric is durable and comfortable to wear.

entries.definition_en: widely recognized or familiar to many people
entries.example_cn: 这位众所周知的演员出席了慈善活动。
entries.example_en: The well-known actor appeared at the charity event.

entries.definition_cn: 指定或保留用于标准或通常用途的
entries.definition_en: designated or reserved for a standard or usual purpose
entries.example_cn: 这个知名端口留作标准服务使用。
entries.example_en: This well-known port is reserved for a standard service.

entries.definition_en: liked by many people; popular
entries.example_cn: 她是学校里一位受欢迎的老师。
entries.example_en: She is a well-liked teacher in the school.

entries.definition_en: constructed with great skill and care
entries.example_cn: 这是一套制作精良的西装，可以穿好几年。
entries.example_en: This is a well-made suit that will last for years.

entries.definition_en: socially correct in behavior
entries.example_cn: 排队时耐心等待是举止得体的表现。
entries.example_en: It is well-mannered to wait your turn in line.

entries.definition_en: having good upbringing
entries.example_cn: 这个有教养的孩子礼貌地迎接了客人。
entries.example_en: The well-mannered child greeted the guests politely.

entries.definition_cn: 出于好意但往往导致不幸结果的
entries.definition_en: marked by good intentions though often producing unfortunate results
entries.example_cn: 他出于好意的建议反而让学生感到困惑，而不是有帮助。
entries.example_en: His well-meaning advice confused the student instead of helping.

entries.definition_en: not unfriendly or threatening
entries.example_cn: 这位好心的邻居主动提出帮忙搬沙发。
entries.example_en: The well-meaning neighbor offered to help move the sofa.

entries.definition_cn: 出于好意但往往适得其反的
entries.definition_en: marked by good intentions though often producing unfortunate results
entries.example_cn: 她出于好意的建议实际上让人很困惑。
entries.example_en: Her well-meant advice was actually quite confusing.

entries.definition_en: almost; slightly short of being accomplished
entries.example_cn: 该项目在截止日期前几乎完成了。
entries.example_en: The project was well-nigh completed before the deadline.

entries.definition_en: having received enough food to be healthy and strong
entries.example_cn: 那些营养充足的孩子们在操场上精力充沛地玩耍。
entries.example_en: The well-nourished children played energetically in the playground.

entries.definition_en: having a moderate amount of money; moderately rich
entries.example_cn: 他们住在一个富裕的社区。
entries.example_en: They live in a well-off neighborhood.

entries.definition_en: in a fortunate situation
entries.example_cn: 多亏了新产品，这家公司处境良好。
entries.example_en: The company is well-off thanks to its new product.

entries.definition_en: arranged in a good order
entries.example_cn: 图书馆是一个秩序井然的地方，书籍摆放整齐。
entries.example_en: The library is a well-ordered place where books are neatly arranged.

entries.definition_en: receiving enough money for the work done
entries.example_cn: 她是一位在大城市工作的薪水丰厚的律师。
entries.example_en: She is a well-paid lawyer who works in a big city.

entries.definition_en: having an advantageous position
entries.example_cn: 该公司处于有利位置，可以拓展新市场。
entries.example_en: The company is well-placed to expand into new markets.

entries.definition_en: cleverly or judiciously positioned
entries.example_cn: 这是一句巧妙改变气氛的评论。
entries.example_en: It was a well-placed remark that changed the mood.

entries.definition_en: used of older persons who are healthy
entries.example_cn: 尽管年纪大了，他身体依然健壮，精力充沛。
entries.example_en: Despite his age, he is well-preserved and full of energy.

entries.definition_en: having pleasing and balanced proportions
entries.example_cn: 建筑师设计了一座比例匀称的建筑，与周围环境和谐相融。
entries.example_en: The architect designed a well-proportioned building that harmonized with its surroundings.

entries.definition_cn: 具备特定职业或任务所需资格或专业知识的
entries.definition_en: having the necessary qualifications or expertise for a particular vocation or task
entries.example_cn: 她非常胜任高级管理职位。
entries.example_en: She is well-qualified for the senior management position.

entries.definition_en: well informed or deeply versed through reading
entries.example_cn: 她博览群书，对文学有深入了解。
entries.example_en: She is well-read and knows a great deal about literature.

entries.definition_en: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
entries.example_cn: 受过良好教育的观众提出了有见地的问题。
entries.example_en: The well-read audience asked insightful questions.

entries.definition_en: having a variety of skills, interests, or experiences
entries.example_cn: 她是一名全面发展的学生，在体育和学术方面都很出色。
entries.example_en: She is a well-rounded student who excels in both sports and academics.

entries.definition_cn: 身材丰满、匀称或有曲线美的
entries.definition_en: having a plump, shapely, or curvaceous body
entries.example_cn: 她丰满匀称的身材令人赞赏。
entries.example_en: She was admired for her well-rounded figure.

entries.definition_en: strongly and firmly constructed
entries.example_cn: 这栋房子牢固地建在山坡上。
entries.example_en: The house is well-set against the hillside.

entries.definition_cn: 谈吐文雅的；口齿清楚的
entries.definition_en: speaking clearly, articulately, or eloquently
entries.example_cn: 她谈吐文雅，面对棘手问题也应对自如。
entries.example_en: She is well-spoken and handles difficult questions calmly.

entries.definition_en: regarded with respect and admiration
entries.example_cn: 她是社区里一位受人尊敬的老师。
entries.example_en: She is a well-thought-of teacher in the community.

entries.definition_en: done or happening at the appropriate time
entries.example_cn: 她时机恰当的评论化解了会议上的紧张气氛。
entries.example_en: Her well-timed comment defused the tension in the meeting.

entries.definition_en: at an opportune time
entries.example_cn: 雨水适时落下，滋润了干旱的花园。
entries.example_en: The rain fell well-timed to water the dry garden.

entries.definition_en: having a lot of money; moderately rich
entries.example_cn: 他们住在一个富裕的社区。
entries.example_en: They live in a well-to-do neighborhood.

entries.definition_en: tested many times and found to be useful or correct
entries.example_cn: 这是解决该问题的一种久经考验的方法。
entries.example_en: This is a well-tried method for solving the problem.

entries.definition_cn: （指语言）表达得体且令人愉悦的
entries.definition_en: (of language) expressed in an apt and pleasing way
entries.example_cn: 她发表了一篇表达得体且令人愉悦的演讲，博得了观众的喜爱。
entries.example_en: She gave a well-turned speech that delighted the audience.

entries.definition_en: having a pleasing shape
entries.example_cn: 这座雕像是一件造型优美的大理石作品。
entries.example_en: The statue was a well-turned piece of marble.

entries.definition_cn: 经车床精心加工成形的
entries.definition_en: expertly shaped or finished on a lathe
entries.example_cn: 工匠展示了一个经车床精心加工成形的木碗。
entries.example_en: The craftsman displayed a wooden bowl expertly turned on a lathe.

entries.definition_cn: 向他人表达良好祝愿或同情的人；好心人
entries.definition_en: someone who expresses good wishes or sympathy to another person
entries.example_cn: 这位好心人寄来一张卡片祝贺她晋升。
entries.example_en: The well-wisher sent a card to congratulate her on her promotion.

entries.definition_en: expressing good wishes for someone's success, happiness, or well-being
entries.example_cn: 这支队伍的队长发表了表示祝愿的讲话。
entries.example_en: The well-wishing speech was delivered by the team captain.

entries.definition_en: an expression of good wishes for someone
entries.example_cn: 告别会上充满了祝福。
entries.example_en: There was much well-wishing at the farewell party.

entries.definition_en: showing signs of much wear or use
entries.example_cn: 那双磨损的鞋子诉说着长途跋涉的故事。
entries.example_en: The well-worn shoes told a story of many miles traveled.

entries.definition_en: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.example_cn: 这个陈腐的笑话没能逗笑任何人。
entries.example_en: The well-worn joke failed to make anyone laugh.

entries.definition_cn: 幸福、健康和繁荣的状态
entries.definition_en: a state of being happy, healthy, and prosperous
entries.example_cn: 该社区项目致力于改善老年居民的幸福安康。
entries.example_en: The community program focuses on improving the wellbeing of elderly residents.

entries.definition_en: of good or upper-class lineage
entries.example_cn: 那位出身名门的继承人回到了庄园。
entries.example_en: The wellborn heir returned to the estate.

entries.definition_cn: 泉水从地下涌出的地方，或溪流或井的水源
entries.definition_en: the place where a spring emerges from the ground, or the source of water for a stream or well
entries.example_cn: 这处井水源标志着泉水涌出的地方，并为村庄提供清水。
entries.example_en: The wellhead marked the place where the spring emerged and supplied fresh water to the village.

entries.definition_cn: 井的地面结构，尤其是油井的井口装置
entries.definition_en: the surface structure of a well, especially an oil well
entries.example_cn: 工人在暴风雨来临前检查了井口装置，以确保油井设备牢固。
entries.example_en: Workers inspected the wellhead to ensure the oil-well equipment was secure before the storm.

entries.definition_en: a state of being healthy and free from illness
entries.example_cn: 这家度假村专注于促进身心健康。
entries.example_en: The resort focuses on promoting physical and mental wellness.

entries.definition_en: a perforated tube driven into the ground to collect water
entries.example_cn: 施工队安装了几个集水井以降低地下水位。
entries.example_en: The construction team installed several wellpoints to lower the water table.

entries.definition_en: an abundant source
entries.example_cn: 她的创造力是新思想的丰富源泉。
entries.example_en: Her creativity is a wellspring of new ideas.

entries.definition_en: the source of water for a well
entries.example_cn: 这个村庄的水来自一口深井的泉源。
entries.example_en: The village draws its water from a deep wellspring.

entries.definition_en: to cheat by not paying a gambling debt
entries.example_cn: 他试图赖掉赌债。
entries.example_en: He tried to welsh on his gambling debts.

entries.definition_en: a raised or strengthened seam on a piece of clothing or leather
entries.example_cn: 这件夹克的前面有一条装饰性的凸接缝。
entries.example_en: The jacket has a decorative welt running down the front.

entries.definition_cn: 皮肤上隆起的肿痕（可由击打或过敏反应引起）
entries.definition_en: a raised, swollen mark on the skin, caused by a blow or sometimes an allergic reaction
entries.example_cn: 他手臂被鞭子抽后留下了一道疼痛的肿痕。
entries.example_en: He received a painful welt on his arm from the whip.

entries.definition_en: to beat severely with a whip or rod
entries.example_cn: 士兵被命令狠打那个囚犯。
entries.example_en: The soldier was ordered to welt the prisoner.

entries.definition_cn: 给某物镶边或做凸起的接缝
entries.definition_en: to add a raised strip of material to an edge or seam, especially to reinforce or finish it
entries.example_cn: 裁缝会给这件外套的边缘镶边。
entries.example_en: The tailor will welt the edges of the coat.

entries.definition_en: a large, confused mass or collection of things
entries.example_cn: 书桌上堆满了杂乱无章的纸张和书籍。
entries.example_en: The desk was covered in a welter of papers and books.

entries.definition_en: to move in a confused, rolling, or tumbling manner
entries.example_cn: 海浪在岩石上翻滚。
entries.example_en: The waves weltered against the rocks.

entries.definition_en: to revel in or be deeply immersed in something
entries.example_cn: 他发现自己深陷债务之中。
entries.example_en: He found himself weltered in debt.

entries.definition_en: to roll around on the ground
entries.example_cn: 小狗们在洗澡后在草地上打滚。
entries.example_en: The puppies weltered in the grass after their bath.

entries.definition_cn: 格斗运动中介于轻量级和中量级之间的重量级别
entries.definition_en: a weight class division in combat sports for fighters heavier than lightweight and lighter than middleweight
entries.example_cn: 轻重量级类别在业余格斗选手中很受欢迎。
entries.example_en: The welterweight category is popular among amateur fighters.

entries.definition_cn: 参加轻量级和中量级之间这一量级比赛的职业拳击手
entries.definition_en: a professional boxer who competes in the welterweight division
entries.example_cn: 这名次中量级拳手成功卫冕了冠军头衔，击败了来自欧洲的挑战者。
entries.example_en: The welterweight defended his title against a challenger from Europe.

entries.definition_cn: 参加轻量级与中量级之间这一量级的业余拳击手
entries.definition_en: an amateur boxer competing in the welterweight division
entries.example_cn: 这位轻量级与中量级之间量级的业余拳击手在第一轮就落败了。
entries.example_en: The welterweight contender lost in the first round.

entries.definition_cn: 参加154至172磅摔跤量级比赛的摔跤手
entries.definition_en: a wrestler who competes in the 154-to-172-pound weight class
entries.example_cn: 这名次中量级摔跤手赢得了锦标赛中竞争最激烈的量级比赛。
entries.example_en: The welterweight wrestler won the most competitive division in the tournament.

entries.definition_cn: 28磅的重量；有时作为赛马中的让步负重
entries.definition_en: a weight of 28 pounds; sometimes imposed as a handicap in a horse race
entries.example_cn: 这匹马因参加障碍赛马而被分配了二十八磅的负重障碍。
entries.example_en: The horse was assigned a welterweight penalty for the steeplechase.

entries.definition_en: a rare plant found in dry areas of southwestern Africa, featuring a short, turnip-like trunk and two long, strap-like leaves that grow from the base.
entries.example_cn: Welwitschia 是一种活化石，能在干旱的纳米布沙漠中存活数千年。
entries.example_en: The welwitschia is a living relic that can survive for thousands of years in the arid Namib Desert.

entries.definition_en: a small cyst on the skin filled with fatty matter caused by a blocked gland
entries.example_cn: 医生从她的下巴上切除了那个皮脂腺囊肿。
entries.example_en: The doctor removed the wen from her chin.

entries.definition_cn: 沿特定路线前进；蜿蜒前行
entries.definition_en: to move or travel in a particular direction
entries.example_cn: 这条河蜿蜒穿过山谷。
entries.example_en: The river wends its way through the valley.

usage.label: 通常与 one's way/course 连用；及物

entries.definition_en: past tense of be for they/we
entries.example_cn: 他们开会迟到了。
entries.example_en: They were late for the meeting.

entries.definition_cn: 是（第二人称单数过去式）
entries.definition_en: past tense of be for you
entries.example_cn: 你昨天开心吗？
entries.example_en: Were you happy yesterday?

entries.definition_cn: be 的一般过去时虚拟式，用于表达愿望、假设或建议
entries.definition_en: used to express a wish or suggestion
entries.example_cn: 我希望现在是夏天。
entries.example_en: I wish it were summer now.

entries.definition_cn: 是（第一/三人称单数过去式，方言用法）
entries.definition_en: past tense of be for I/he/she/it (in some dialects)
entries.example_cn: 他才是那个做这件事的人。
entries.example_en: He were the one who did it.

entries.definition_en: a person who changes into another form
entries.example_cn: 那个变形人被村民们攻击了。
entries.example_en: The were attacked by the villagers.

entries.definition_cn: 男子；亦指 wergeld，即作为赔偿支付的一笔钱
entries.definition_en: a man; also, wergeld, a sum of money paid as compensation
entries.example_cn: 在一段文字中，were 表示“男子”；在另一段文字中，它表示作为赔偿支付的一笔钱。
entries.example_en: The word were meant a man in one passage and a sum of money paid as compensation in another.

entries.definition_en: a mythical monster that can change its shape from a human to a wolf and back again
entries.example_cn: 传说狼人只在满月时袭击人。
entries.example_en: The legend says that the werewolf attacks only during a full moon.

entries.definition_en: the compass point at 270 degrees
entries.example_cn: 太阳在西方落下。
entries.example_en: The sun sets in the west.

entries.definition_en: a location in the western part of a place
entries.example_cn: 城市的西部非常安静。
entries.example_en: The west of the city is very quiet.

entries.definition_en: the direction of the west
entries.example_cn: 向西看，那里有山。
entries.example_en: Look west for the mountains.

entries.definition_en: situated in or facing the west
entries.example_cn: 他们住在一所朝西的房子里。
entries.example_en: They live in a west-facing house.

entries.definition_en: toward the west
entries.example_cn: 我们整天向西开车。
entries.example_en: We drove west all day.

entries.definition_en: moving or traveling toward the west
entries.example_cn: 向西行驶的火车就在日落时分抵达了车站。
entries.example_en: The westbound train arrived at the station just as the sun set.

entries.definition_en: a wind blowing from the west towards the east
entries.example_cn: 水手们等待西风将他们的船推向大洋彼岸。
entries.example_en: The sailors waited for the wester to push their ship across the ocean.

entries.definition_en: coming from the west (used for wind)
entries.example_cn: 今天刮的是西来的风。
entries.example_en: A westerly wind is blowing today.

entries.definition_en: moving towards the west
entries.example_cn: 向西移动的车流造成了延误。
entries.example_en: The westerly flow of traffic caused a delay.

entries.definition_en: winds that blow from the west in temperate regions
entries.example_cn: 西风给沿海地区带来了雨水。
entries.example_en: The westerly winds brought rain to the coast.

entries.definition_en: in a direction towards the west
entries.example_cn: 那艘船向西驶过海洋。
entries.example_en: The ship sailed westerly across the ocean.

entries.definition_en: from the west
entries.example_cn: 太阳从西边落山了。
entries.example_en: The sun set westerly behind the mountains.

entries.definition_en: a native or inhabitant of the West, especially the Western world or the western United States
entries.example_cn: 那位西部人骑着马穿越了广阔的平原。
entries.example_en: The westerner rode his horse across the vast plains.

entries.definition_en: to make something have western characteristics
entries.example_cn: 该公司决定使办公室文化西化，以吸引国际人才。
entries.example_en: The company decided to westernize its office culture to attract international talent.

entries.definition_en: farthest to the west
entries.example_cn: 该群岛最西边的岛屿无人居住。
entries.example_en: The westernmost island in the archipelago is uninhabited.

entries.definition_en: located in or relating to the western part of a city
entries.example_cn: 他们决定在西区买一套房子。
entries.example_en: They decided to buy a house on the westside.

entries.definition_en: toward the west
entries.example_cn: 他们向西穿越了平原。
entries.example_en: They traveled westward across the plains.

entries.definition_en: moving toward the west
entries.example_cn: 这条河向西的流向很强劲。
entries.example_en: The westward flow of the river was strong.

entries.definition_en: the cardinal compass point that is at 270 degrees
entries.example_cn: 那艘船向西航行。
entries.example_en: The ship sailed westward.

entries.definition_en: in a direction toward the west
entries.example_cn: 风向西吹过平原。
entries.example_en: The wind blew westwards across the plains.

entries.definition_en: covered or soaked with liquid
entries.example_cn: 毛巾是湿的，请把它挂起来晾干。
entries.example_en: The towel is wet, so please hang it to dry.

entries.definition_en: containing moisture or volatile components
entries.example_cn: 含水的水泥需要盖上。
entries.example_en: The wet cement needs to be covered.

entries.definition_cn: 允许或支持合法生产和销售酒类的
entries.definition_en: permitting or supporting the legal production and sale of alcoholic beverages
entries.example_cn: 该州支持售酒，所以你可以在商店买到啤酒。
entries.example_en: The state is wet, so you can buy beer in stores.

entries.definition_en: to make something become covered with water
entries.example_cn: 小心别把鞋子弄湿了。
entries.example_en: Be careful not to wet your shoes.

entries.definition_en: to make one's bed or clothes wet by urinating
entries.example_cn: 宝宝醒来后尿湿了床。
entries.example_en: The baby woke up and wet the bed.

entries.definition_en: rainy weather
entries.example_cn: 因为下雨，我们待在室内。
entries.example_en: We stayed inside because of the wet.

entries.definition_en: related to the production or trade of alcoholic liquor
entries.example_cn: 他在酒类行业工作。
entries.example_en: He works in the wet business.

entries.definition_en: producing or secreting milk
entries.example_cn: 那头正在泌乳的奶牛可以挤奶了。
entries.example_en: The wet cow was ready to be milked.

entries.definition_en: a woman hired to suckle a child of someone else
entries.example_cn: 过去，富裕家庭经常雇佣乳母。
entries.example_en: In the past, wealthy families often hired a wet-nurse.

entries.definition_en: give suck to
entries.example_cn: 乳母给婴儿喂奶。
entries.example_en: The wet-nurse suckled the baby.

entries.definition_cn: （侮辱性，通常指非法越境进入美国的墨西哥或中美洲人）
entries.definition_en: an offensive slur for a Mexican or Central American person, especially one who illegally enters the United States from Mexico
entries.example_cn: "wetback"是一个贬义的侮辱性称呼，不应使用。
entries.example_en: The term 'wetback' is a derogatory slur that should not be used.

entries.definition_en: a castrated male sheep or goat
entries.example_cn: 农夫把那只阉羊卖给了屠夫。
entries.example_en: The farmer sold the wether to the butcher.

entries.definition_en: a low area of land that is covered with water
entries.example_cn: 许多珍稀鸟类生活在河边的湿地里。
entries.example_en: Many rare birds live in the wetland near the river.

entries.definition_en: the state of being wet; moisture
entries.example_cn: 雨后地面的湿气使小路变得湿滑。
entries.example_en: The wetness of the ground after the rain made the path slippery.

entries.definition_en: a woman who is hired to breastfeed a baby that is not her own
entries.example_cn: 在18世纪，许多富裕家庭雇佣乳母来照顾他们的婴儿。
entries.example_en: In the 18th century, many wealthy families employed a wetnurse to care for their infants.

entries.definition_en: a chemical agent that reduces the surface tension of a liquid
entries.example_cn: 这种润湿剂有助于油漆在墙上均匀涂抹。
entries.example_en: The wetter helps the paint spread evenly on the wall.

entries.definition_en: someone who urinates while asleep in bed
entries.example_cn: 这位夜尿症患者每天早上都需要换衣服。
entries.example_en: The wetter needed to change their clothes every morning.

entries.definition_en: a worker who wets the work in a manufacturing process
entries.example_cn: 湿工在切割石头前将其弄湿。
entries.example_en: The wetter applied water to the stone before cutting.

entries.definition_en: the action of making something wet
entries.example_cn: 路面被弄湿后，街道变得湿滑。
entries.example_en: The wetting of the pavement made the streets slippery.

entries.definition_en: a euphemism for urination
entries.example_cn: 孩子尿裤子让父母很尴尬。
entries.example_en: The child's wetting accident was embarrassing for the parents.

entries.definition_en: to strike someone or something hard
entries.example_cn: 击球手将球重重地击飞过围栏。
entries.example_en: The batter whacked the ball over the fence.

entries.definition_en: the act of hitting vigorously
entries.example_cn: 那名球员对对手进行了猛烈的打击后，裁判判罚犯规。
entries.example_en: The referee called a foul after the player delivered a nasty whack to his opponent.

entries.definition_cn: 锐利快速打击发出的声音
entries.definition_en: the sound made by a sharp, swift blow
entries.example_cn: 我听到厨房传来一声巨响，跑过去看发生了什么事。
entries.example_en: I heard a loud whack from the kitchen and ran to see what was happening.

entries.definition_en: exhausted or worn out (US colloquial)
entries.example_cn: 通宵工作后，我完全精疲力竭了。
entries.example_en: I am completely whacked after working all night.

entries.definition_cn: 同类中特别巨大或令人印象深刻的事物
entries.definition_en: something that is especially big or impressive compared to others of its kind
entries.example_cn: 这座新体育场对当地社区来说真是个庞然大物。
entries.example_en: The new stadium is a real whacker for the local community.

entries.definition_en: enormous (British informal)
entries.example_cn: 他们昨晚在派对上玩得很开心。
entries.example_en: They had a whacking good time at the party last night.

entries.definition_en: (chiefly British, informal) to an unusually great extent; extremely
entries.example_cn: 维修费用高得离谱。
entries.example_en: The repairs were whacking expensive.

entries.definition_en: a beating; a series of blows
entries.example_cn: 他用锤子把门狠狠砸了好几下。
entries.example_en: He gave the door a whacking with a hammer.

entries.definition_en: a person who is regarded as eccentric or mad
entries.example_cn: 邻居们称那位整夜演奏的乐手为怪人。
entries.example_en: The neighbors called the loud musician a whacko because he played at all hours.

entries.definition_en: extremely foolish or absurd; ludicrous
entries.example_cn: 这个荒谬的计划涉及用气球建造一座房子。
entries.example_en: The whacky plan involved building a house out of balloons.

entries.definition_cn: （非正式且常冒犯）精神失常的；古怪的
entries.definition_en: informal, often offensive: mentally disturbed or eccentric
entries.example_cn: 这部老派小说把他描写成一个古怪的人。
entries.example_en: The old-fashioned novel portrays him as a whacky eccentric.

entries.definition_en: a large marine mammal that breathes through a blowhole
entries.example_cn: 我们看到一只鲸鱼跃出水面。
entries.example_en: We saw a whale breaching the water.

entries.definition_en: a very large or impressive person
entries.example_cn: 他在商界是个巨头。
entries.example_en: He is a whale in the business world.

entries.definition_en: to hunt for whales
entries.example_cn: 他们过去常在沿海捕鲸。
entries.example_en: They used to whale along the coast.

entries.definition_cn: 捕鲸艇；一种以前用于捕鲸的细长划艇，两端尖，能同样向前或向后航行
entries.definition_en: a long, narrow rowing boat formerly used for whaling, pointed at both ends so it can move equally well forwards or backwards
entries.example_cn: 船员们把捕鲸艇下水，划过湍急的河流。
entries.example_en: The crew launched the whaleboat to cross the turbulent river.

entries.definition_cn: 类似捕鲸艇、由军舰或其他船只搭载的船
entries.definition_en: a boat resembling a whaleboat and carried on a warship or other vessel
entries.example_cn: 这艘军舰搭载了一艘捕鲸艇，用作小型登陆船。
entries.example_en: The warship carried a whaleboat for use as a small landing boat.

entries.definition_en: a tough, horny material from whale jaws, historically used for fan ribs or corset stays
entries.example_cn: 这件紧身胸衣用鲸须加固以保持其形状。
entries.example_en: The corset was reinforced with whalebone to maintain its shape.

entries.definition_en: a sailor who works on a ship that hunts whales
entries.example_cn: 这位捕鲸水手在海上追逐巨鲸度过了数年时光。
entries.example_en: The whaler spent years at sea chasing the great whales.

entries.definition_en: a ship engaged in whale fishing
entries.example_cn: 那艘古老的捕鲸船正在冰冷的水中慢慢下沉。
entries.example_en: The old whaler was slowly sinking in the icy waters.

entries.definition_en: to strike something with great force
entries.example_cn: 击球手猛击将球打出了球场。
entries.example_en: The batter whammed the ball out of the park.

entries.definition_en: A serious or devastating setback.
entries.example_cn: 资金突然流失对这家初创公司来说是一个真正的严重挫折。
entries.example_en: The sudden loss of funding was a real whammy for the startup.

entries.definition_en: An evil spell or curse.
entries.example_cn: 巫师施了一个恶咒来保护村庄免受入侵者侵害。
entries.example_en: The wizard cast a whammy to protect the village from invaders.

entries.definition_en: to beat or strike something with force
entries.example_cn: 他反复用力将球砸向墙壁。
entries.example_en: He whanged the ball against the wall repeatedly.

entries.definition_en: to propel or hit something forcefully
entries.example_cn: 水流猛地将船撞到了岩石上。
entries.example_en: The current whanged the boat against the rocks.

entries.definition_en: to attack someone or something forcefully
entries.example_cn: 那只狗猛烈地咬了入侵者的腿。
entries.example_en: The dog whanged at the intruder's leg.

entries.definition_en: a forceful blow or whack
entries.example_cn: 他重重地猛击了一下门。
entries.example_en: He landed a heavy whang on the door.

entries.definition_en: to hit someone or something with a sudden, hard blow
entries.example_cn: 球猛地打在他的脸上。
entries.example_en: The ball whapped him in the face.

entries.definition_en: a platform built out from the shore into the water to support ships
entries.example_cn: 货物在繁忙的码头上被装上船。
entries.example_en: The cargo was loaded onto the ship at the busy wharf.

entries.definition_en: to arrive and dock at a wharf
entries.example_cn: 渡轮在清晨抵达码头。
entries.example_en: The ferry wharfed early in the morning.

entries.definition_en: to secure a vessel at a wharf
entries.example_cn: 船长将船牢固地系泊在码头边。
entries.example_en: The captain wharfed the boat securely against the pier.

entries.definition_en: to discharge cargo at a wharf
entries.example_cn: 船员将木材卸到码头上。
entries.example_en: The crew wharfed the timber onto the dock.

entries.definition_en: to store goods on a wharf
entries.example_cn: 风暴来临前，他们将集装箱储存在码头。
entries.example_en: They wharfed the containers before the storm arrived.

entries.definition_en: to provide with a wharf
entries.example_cn: 该市计划沿河为新工业区修建码头。
entries.example_en: The city plans to wharf the new industrial area along the river.

entries.definition_en: a fee charged for the use of a wharf or quay
entries.example_cn: 航运公司因卸货而支付了可观的码头使用费。
entries.example_en: The shipping company had to pay a substantial wharfage fee for unloading the cargo.

entries.definition_en: a platform built out from the shore into the water and supported by piles; provides access to ships and boats
entries.example_cn: 河口处的旧码头已翻新，可容纳更大的船只。
entries.example_en: The old wharfage at the river mouth has been renovated to accommodate larger vessels.

entries.definition_cn: 什么（用于询问事物、事件或情况）
entries.definition_en: Used to ask about a thing, event, or situation.
entries.example_cn: 昨天发生了什么？
entries.example_en: What happened yesterday?

entries.definition_cn: 哪一个（指众多或未知选项中的某一个）
entries.definition_en: Used to ask about a specific thing from a large or unknown number of possibilities.
entries.example_cn: 你在读哪本书？
entries.example_en: What book are you reading?

entries.definition_cn: 哪一个（用于间接疑问句）
entries.definition_en: Used in indirect questions to ask about a specific thing.
entries.example_cn: 我想知道那辆车是什么颜色的。
entries.example_en: I wonder what color the car is.

entries.definition_en: Used before a noun to mean any or all of the things of a specified kind.
entries.example_cn: 你有什么工具就用什么工具。
entries.example_en: Use what tools you have.

entries.definition_cn: 以什么方式；到什么程度
entries.definition_en: In what way; to what extent.
entries.example_cn: 这有什么关系？
entries.example_en: What does it matter?

entries.definition_cn: （对“是什么”这一问题的）答案；本质
entries.definition_en: The answer to a question about identity or nature.
entries.example_cn: 这种情况的本质很清晰。
entries.example_en: The what of the situation is clear.

entries.definition_cn: 表示惊讶或不相信的感叹词
entries.definition_en: An expression used to show surprise or disbelief.
entries.example_cn: 什么！你已经走了？
entries.example_en: What! You're leaving already?

entries.definition_cn: （新加坡/马来西亚方言）用于强调某事属实，反驳听者的错误假设
entries.definition_en: Used in some dialects to emphasize that a statement is true despite a false assumption.
entries.example_cn: 什么，你不认识他？
entries.example_en: What, you don't know him?

entries.definition_en: used to add emphasis and seek agreement
entries.example_cn: 那是美好的一天，对吧？
entries.example_en: It was a great day, what-what?

entries.definition_cn: 不知名或想不起名字的东西
entries.definition_en: something unspecified whose name is either forgotten or not known
entries.example_cn: 我想不起你昨天给我看的那个不知名东西叫什么。
entries.example_en: I can't remember the name of that whatchamacallit you showed me yesterday.

usage.label: slang
usage.pattern: Used as a placeholder when the actual name is unknown or forgotten.

entries.definition_cn: （用于名词前）任何的；无论什么的；（引导让步从句）无论什么
entries.definition_en: used before a noun to mean any, every, or no matter which; in concessive clauses, regardless of what
entries.example_cn: 无论你作出什么选择，都不要放弃。
entries.example_en: Whatever choice you make, don't give up.

entries.definition_en: a collection of various small and miscellaneous objects
entries.example_cn: 架子上摆满了书、小摆设和其他杂七杂八的东西。
entries.example_en: The shelf was filled with books, knick-knacks, and other whatnot.

entries.definition_en: used to emphasize that there is none or no amount of something
entries.example_cn: 没有任何证据支持他的说法。
entries.example_en: There is no evidence whatsoever to support his claim.

entries.definition_en: a swollen, raised mark on the skin caused by a blow or an allergic reaction
entries.example_cn: 马在挨打后脖子上长了一个大肿块。
entries.example_en: The horse developed a large wheal on its neck after being whipped.

entries.definition_en: the edible grains of the wheat plant, used for flour or cereal
entries.example_cn: 我们买了一条用全麦制成的面包。
entries.example_en: We bought a loaf of bread made from whole wheat.

entries.definition_en: a grass plant with light brown grains that grows in spikes
entries.example_cn: 农民在春天在田里种植小麦。
entries.example_en: Farmers plant wheat in the fields during the spring.

entries.definition_en: a pale yellow color, often mixed with white
entries.example_cn: 墙壁被漆成了柔和的淡黄色。
entries.example_en: The walls were painted a soft wheat color.

entries.definition_cn: 石䳭属的一种雀形鸟，尤指北方石䳭，具有明显的浅色腰部
entries.definition_en: a passerine bird of the genus Oenanthe, especially the northern wheatear, with a distinctive pale rump
entries.example_cn: 石䳭在迁徙期间于开阔草地觅食。
entries.example_en: The wheatear foraged in open grassland during migration.

entries.definition_en: made from or resembling wheat
entries.example_cn: 面包师制作了一种带有轻微甜味的小麦面包。
entries.example_en: The baker prepared a wheaten bread that has a slightly sweet flavor.

entries.definition_cn: 小麦色的；淡黄色或米黄色的
entries.definition_en: pale yellow or beige, like the color of wheat
entries.example_cn: 她为夏季仪式选了一条小麦色的连衣裙。
entries.example_en: She chose a wheaten dress for the summer ceremony.

entries.definition_en: a field planted with wheat
entries.example_cn: 金色的麦田一直延伸到视线尽头。
entries.example_en: The golden wheatfield stretched as far as the eye could see.

entries.definition_en: a grass of the genus Agropyron
entries.example_cn: 许多人喝小麦草汁作为健康补充剂。
entries.example_en: Many people drink wheatgrass juice as a health supplement.

entries.definition_cn: 哄劝；用花言巧语劝说或骗取
entries.definition_en: persuade or obtain something by flattering or coaxing
entries.example_cn: 他试图通过承诺未来的业务哄劝经理给他打折。
entries.example_en: He tried to wheedle a discount from the manager by promising future business.

entries.definition_en: the act of coaxing or flattering someone to persuade them
entries.example_cn: 推销员的花言巧语终于说服经理批准了这项请求。
entries.example_en: The salesman's wheedling finally persuaded the manager to approve the request.

entries.definition_cn: 装在轴或轴上的圆形物体，用于车辆或机器
entries.definition_en: a circular object that rotates on an axle or shaft, used in vehicles or machines
entries.example_cn: 这辆车有四个轮子。
entries.example_en: The car has four wheels.

entries.definition_en: a steering wheel used in a vehicle
entries.example_cn: 他紧紧握住方向盘。
entries.example_en: He held the wheel tightly.

entries.definition_cn: 推动或引导进展或活动的力量或机制
entries.definition_en: a force or mechanism that drives or directs progress or activity
entries.example_cn: 选举后，改革的车轮开始转动。
entries.example_en: The wheels of reform began to turn after the election.

entries.definition_en: to move someone or something using a wheelchair or similar
entries.example_cn: 他们用推车将病人送往医院。
entries.example_en: They wheeled the patient to the hospital.

entries.definition_en: to move on wheels or a wheeled vehicle
entries.example_cn: 我们把家具用车运进了新房间。
entries.example_en: We wheeled the furniture into the new room.

entries.definition_en: to turn or change direction quickly
entries.example_cn: 舞者在舞台上旋转。
entries.example_en: The dancer wheeled around the stage.

entries.definition_en: a helm used to control a ship's rudder
entries.example_cn: 船长站在舵轮旁。
entries.example_en: The captain stood at the wheel.

entries.definition_en: to ride a bicycle
entries.example_cn: 他每天早上骑自行车去公园。
entries.example_en: He wheeled to the park every morning.

entries.definition_en: a small cart with one or more wheels and handles, used for carrying light loads
entries.example_cn: 园丁用独轮手推车搬运土壤。
entries.example_en: The gardener used a wheelbarrow to move the soil.

entries.definition_en: to transport something using a wheelbarrow
entries.example_cn: 他们不得不用独轮手推车把沙子运到建筑工地。
entries.example_en: They had to wheelbarrow the sand to the construction site.

entries.definition_en: the distance between the centers of the front and rear wheels of a vehicle
entries.example_cn: 这辆车轴距很长，行驶起来非常平稳。
entries.example_en: The car has a long wheelbase, which provides a smooth ride.

entries.definition_en: a chair with large wheels used by people who cannot walk
entries.example_cn: 她把轮椅移到了公交车的前面。
entries.example_en: She moved her wheelchair to the front of the bus.

entries.definition_en: having wheels
entries.example_cn: 带轮子的行李箱在地板上很容易滚动。
entries.example_en: The wheeled suitcase rolled easily across the floor.

entries.definition_en: a person who rides a bicycle
entries.example_cn: 那位骑车人经过时向朋友们挥手致意。
entries.example_en: The wheeler waved to his friends as he passed by.

entries.definition_en: someone who makes and repairs wooden wheels
entries.example_cn: 那位老工匠熟练地修好了手推车的坏轮子。
entries.example_en: The old wheeler fixed the cart's broken wheel with skill.

entries.definition_cn: 套在车辆最后方、靠近车轮的拉车马
entries.definition_en: a draft horse harnessed behind others and nearest the wheels of a vehicle
entries.example_cn: 那匹拉车马拉着沉重的马车爬上了陡峭的山坡。
entries.example_en: The wheeler pulled the heavy wagon up the steep hill.

entries.definition_en: the man at the outermost end of the rank in wheeling
entries.example_cn: 轮行者带领牛群绕着田地行走。
entries.example_en: The wheeler led the team of oxen around the field.

entries.definition_en: an enclosed compartment from which a vessel can be navigated
entries.example_cn: 船长站在驾驶室里，指挥船只穿越风暴。
entries.example_en: The captain stood in the wheelhouse to steer the ship through the storm.

entries.definition_en: one's area of interest or expertise
entries.example_cn: 教学是我的专长领域，我喜欢向学生解释复杂的概念。
entries.example_en: Teaching is my wheelhouse; I love explaining complex concepts to students.

entries.definition_cn: 用轮子移动或运送某物
entries.definition_en: the act of moving or conveying something on wheels
entries.example_cn: 推动这辆沉重的手推车需要四个人。
entries.example_en: The wheeling of the heavy cart required four people.

entries.definition_en: a person who constructs and repairs wooden wheels for vehicles
entries.example_cn: 这位老车轮匠整天为农场马车制作坚固的车轮。
entries.example_en: The old wheelwright spent his days crafting sturdy wheels for the farm wagons.

entries.definition_cn: 呼吸困难时发出的喘鸣声
entries.definition_en: a whistling or rattling sound made during difficult breathing
entries.example_cn: 医生听到他呼吸时发出的喘鸣声。
entries.example_en: The doctor heard a wheeze in his breathing.

entries.definition_en: a clever or amusing scheme or trick (British usage)
entries.example_cn: 他想出了一个诡计来逃避付账单。
entries.example_en: He came up with a wheeze to get out of paying the bill.

entries.definition_en: to breathe with difficulty, making a whistling or rattling sound
entries.example_cn: 她气喘吁吁地爬上了陡峭的山坡。
entries.example_en: She wheezed as she climbed the steep hill.

entries.definition_en: relating to breathing that makes a whistling sound
entries.example_cn: 哮喘发作后，病人气喘得很厉害。
entries.example_en: The patient was wheezing heavily after the asthma attack.

entries.definition_en: relating to breathing with a whistling sound
entries.example_cn: 患者在冬天患有呼吸有哨音的咳嗽。
entries.example_en: The patient suffered from a wheezy cough during the winter.

entries.definition_cn: 声音刺耳、气息重而带喘鸣的
entries.definition_en: having a harsh, breathy, wheezing sound
entries.example_cn: 歌手的嗓音带着喘鸣，让我们想起一位老烟民。
entries.example_en: The singer had a wheezy voice that reminded us of an old smoker.

entries.definition_en: a large sea snail often eaten as food
entries.example_cn: 我们在海边散步时抓到了几只蝾螺。
entries.example_en: We caught several whelks while walking along the shore.

entries.definition_en: a large carnivorous sea snail with a strong shell
entries.example_cn: 蝾螺是沿海水域中常见的捕食者。
entries.example_en: The whelk is a common predator in coastal waters.

entries.definition_en: to gather whelks
entries.example_cn: 渔民们在岩石海滩上花了一上午时间采集蝾螺。
entries.example_en: The fishermen spent the morning whelking on the rocky beach.

entries.definition_en: to overcome someone completely, especially with strong emotions or a large amount of information
entries.example_cn: 数据量之大开始使这位研究人员不知所措。
entries.example_en: The sheer volume of data began to whelm the researcher.

entries.definition_cn: 恰如其分；正好符合预期
entries.definition_en: to meet expectations exactly without failing or exceeding them
entries.example_cn: 演出正好符合观众的高期望。
entries.example_en: The performance whelmed the audience's high expectations.

entries.definition_en: a young dog or wolf
entries.example_cn: 母狗一直待在它的幼犬身边。
entries.example_en: The mother dog stayed close to her whelp.

entries.definition_en: to give birth to young, especially puppies
entries.example_cn: 母狗昨晚产下了幼崽。
entries.example_en: The bitch whelped last night.

entries.definition_en: Used to ask about time or occasion.
entries.example_cn: 你通常什么时候起床？
entries.example_en: When do you usually wake up?

entries.definition_en: At which, on which, or during which.
entries.example_cn: 我记得我们初次见面的那一天。
entries.example_en: I remember the day when we first met.

entries.definition_en: The time at, on, or during which something happens.
entries.example_cn: 铃声响起的那一刻令人兴奋。
entries.example_en: The moment when the bell rang was exciting.

entries.definition_en: At that time that; if.
entries.example_cn: 你到了给我打电话。
entries.example_en: Call me when you arrive.

entries.definition_en: What time; which time.
entries.example_cn: 会议是什么时候？
entries.example_en: When is the meeting?

entries.definition_en: The time at which something happens.
entries.example_cn: 我不知道它什么时候会发生。
entries.example_en: I don't know when it will happen.

entries.definition_en: At an earlier time under different, usually less favorable, circumstances.
entries.example_cn: 我年轻时住在一个小村庄里。
entries.example_en: When I was young, I lived in a small village.

entries.definition_en: A command asking someone to stop adding something.
entries.example_cn: 够了。
entries.example_en: When.

entries.definition_cn: 从哪里；从何处或何种来源
entries.definition_en: from what place, source, or cause
entries.example_cn: 我们必须追溯谣言的起源，看看它从何而来。
entries.example_en: We must trace the origin of the rumor to see whence it started.

entries.definition_en: at any time that something happens
entries.example_cn: 你到了随时给我打电话。
entries.example_en: Call me whenever you arrive.

entries.definition_en: every time that something happens
entries.example_cn: 每当我去看望祖母，她都会烤蛋糕。
entries.example_en: Whenever I visit my grandmother, she bakes a cake.

entries.definition_en: regardless of the time that something happens
entries.example_cn: 您随时可以进入大楼。
entries.example_en: You can enter the building whenever you like.

entries.definition_cn: 无论何时（特指那个时刻）
entries.definition_en: at the specific time that, no matter when it is
entries.example_cn: 无论您何时准备好，我们都可以开始会议。
entries.example_en: Whenever you are ready, we can start the meeting.

entries.definition_en: at any time
entries.example_cn: 你随时可以问我问题。
entries.example_en: You can ask me whenever you have a question.

entries.definition_en: when ever: emphatic form of when
entries.example_cn: 你究竟说你是什么时候出生的？
entries.example_en: Whenever did you say you were born?

entries.definition_cn: 当……时（爱尔兰及美国非标准用法）
entries.definition_en: when (used in Ireland and US nonstandard speech)
entries.example_cn: 我小时候住在阿肯色州。
entries.example_en: Whenever I was a child, I lived in Arkansas.

entries.definition_en: used to ask about a place
entries.example_cn: 你住在哪里？
entries.example_en: Where do you live?

entries.definition_en: used to refer to a specific place
entries.example_cn: 这就是我工作的地方。
entries.example_en: This is where I work.

entries.definition_en: used to connect a clause about a place
entries.example_cn: 我出生的那座房子很旧了。
entries.example_en: The house where I was born is old.

entries.definition_en: used to mean wherever or anywhere
entries.example_cn: 你可以坐任何你喜欢的位置。
entries.example_en: You can sit where you like.

entries.definition_en: used to ask about a place
entries.example_cn: 车站在哪里？
entries.example_en: Where is the station?

entries.definition_en: the place in which something happens
entries.example_cn: 我们讨论了地点和时间。
entries.example_en: We discussed the where and the when.

entries.definition_en: used to ask about a situation
entries.example_cn: 你在什么情况下想到那个主意的？
entries.example_en: Where did you get that idea?

entries.definition_en: used to show a contrast or difference
entries.example_cn: 他很有钱，然而他的兄弟很穷。
entries.example_en: He is rich, where his brother is poor.

entries.definition_en: the general location where something is
entries.example_cn: 我已经好几个星期没见到他了，也不知道他在哪里。
entries.example_en: I haven't seen him for weeks and I don't know his whereabouts.

entries.definition_en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with a previous one
entries.example_cn: 他很有才华，而他的兄弟则不然。
entries.example_en: He is very talented, whereas his brother is not.

entries.definition_en: used in legal documents to state a fact that is the basis for a decision
entries.example_cn: 鉴于被告已认罪，法院将进入量刑程序。
entries.example_en: Whereas the defendant has pleaded guilty, the court will proceed to sentencing.

usage.label: legal/formal
usage.pattern: 常用于法律文件开头引出事实

entries.definition_en: a clause in a legal document stating a fact or reason
entries.example_cn: 该合同包含几个阐述背景的鉴于条款。
entries.example_en: The contract contains several whereas clauses outlining the background.

entries.definition_en: by which
entries.example_cn: 新法律通过了，借此公民获得了更多权利。
entries.example_en: The new law was passed, whereby citizens gained more rights.

entries.definition_en: where; wherein; in which
entries.example_cn: 他去了商店，在那里他买了一些牛奶。
entries.example_en: He went to the store, whereby he bought some milk.

entries.definition_en: the cause or reason for something
entries.example_cn: 事故的缘由从未得到完全解释。
entries.example_en: The whys and wherefores of the accident were never fully explained.

entries.definition_en: no matter where; in any place
entries.example_cn: 无论你走到哪里，他都会跟随你。
entries.example_en: He will follow you wheresoever you go.

entries.definition_cn: （非正式）在或到任意选择的地方；随便哪儿
entries.definition_en: in, at, or to any place that one likes or chooses (informal)
entries.example_cn: 我不在乎你怎么处理它；就随便放哪儿吧。
entries.example_en: I don't care what you do with it; just put it wherever.

entries.definition_en: the necessary means, especially financial resources, to do something
entries.example_cn: 她攒够了钱买了一辆新车。
entries.example_en: She saved up her wherewithal to buy a new car.

entries.definition_cn: 一种用于内陆水域竞赛或运输货物及乘客的轻划艇
entries.definition_en: a light rowboat used for racing or transporting goods and passengers in inland waters
entries.example_cn: 他们租了一艘轻划艇快速穿过港口。
entries.example_en: They rented a wherry to cross the harbor quickly.

entries.definition_cn: 历史上的帆船驳船，尤指东安格利亚使用的船只
entries.definition_en: a historical sailing barge, especially one used in East Anglia
entries.example_cn: 那艘历史悠久的帆船驳船在满帆下沿河而下。
entries.example_en: The historic wherry sailed down the river under full sail.

usage.label: historical; East Anglia
usage.pattern: A regional historical noun for a sailing barge.

entries.definition_en: to sharpen by rubbing, as on a whetstone
entries.example_cn: 他在切面包前用石头磨快了刀。
entries.example_en: He whetted his knife on the stone before cutting the bread.

entries.definition_en: to make keen or more acute
entries.example_cn: 老师用一个故事来激发学生对历史的兴趣。
entries.example_en: The teacher used a story to whet the students' interest in history.

entries.definition_en: used to show doubt between two possibilities
entries.example_cn: 她无法决定是留下还是离开。
entries.example_en: She couldn't decide whether to stay or go.

entries.definition_en: used to introduce an indirect question
entries.example_cn: 我不知道他明天是否会来。
entries.example_en: I don't know whether he will come tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: used to introduce a clause showing a choice
entries.example_cn: 无论你喜欢不喜欢，都必须完成这项工作。
entries.example_en: Whether you like it or not, you must finish the work.

entries.definition_en: a flat stone used for sharpening knives or other edged tools
entries.example_cn: 他在做饭前用磨刀石磨了磨厨房的刀。
entries.example_en: He used a whetstone to sharpen his kitchen knives before cooking.

entries.definition_en: the watery part of milk separated from the curd in making cheese
entries.example_cn: 农民经常用乳清制作酸奶或作为动物饲料。
entries.example_en: Farmers often use whey to make yogurt or as animal feed.

entries.definition_cn: 牛奶变酸凝结时从凝乳中分离出的水状液体，即酸乳清
entries.definition_en: the watery liquid separating from curds when milk sours and coagulates
entries.example_cn: 酸牛奶在阳光下放置后分离成凝乳和酸乳清。
entries.example_en: The sour milk separated into curds and whey after sitting in the sun.

entries.definition_en: What, of those mentioned or implied.
entries.example_cn: 你想要哪本书？
entries.example_en: Which book do you want?

entries.definition_en: The/Any ... that; whichever.
entries.example_cn: 你可以选择你喜欢的任何颜色。
entries.example_en: You can choose which color you like.

entries.definition_en: In a restrictive relative clause, referring to a noun previously mentioned.
entries.example_cn: 我买的那本书很贵。
entries.example_en: The book which I bought is expensive.

entries.definition_en: What one or ones (of those mentioned or implied).
entries.example_cn: 哪一个是你的？
entries.example_en: Which one is yours?

entries.definition_en: In a non-restrictive relative clause, referring to something previously mentioned.
entries.example_cn: 会议很长，这很烦人。
entries.example_en: The meeting was long, which was annoying.

entries.definition_en: The/Any ones that; whichever.
entries.example_cn: 你买了哪些？
entries.example_en: Which ones did you buy?

entries.definition_cn: 用于名词前，指代前面提到的一个或多个事物
entries.definition_en: used before a noun to refer to one or more things previously mentioned
entries.example_cn: 所有这些手机都采用塑料机身并搭载英特尔处理器；它们还用背面的“Intel Inside”标志自豪地宣布这一事实。
entries.example_en: All the phones come in plastic bodies and carry Intel processors, which fact they proudly announce with an Intel Inside logo on the back.

entries.definition_en: And.
entries.example_cn: 他离开了，这出乎意料。
entries.example_en: He left, which was unexpected.

entries.definition_en: Any or either one that fits the description.
entries.example_cn: 坐任何有空位的座位。
entries.example_en: Take whichever seat is available.

entries.definition_en: No matter which one; regardless of the choice.
entries.example_cn: 无论哪支球队获胜，我们都会庆祝。
entries.example_en: Whichever team wins, we will celebrate.

entries.definition_en: Depending on which one is chosen.
entries.example_cn: 结果取决于我们选择哪条路。
entries.example_en: The result depends on whichever path we take.

entries.definition_cn: 哪个（强调形式，用于疑问句）
entries.definition_en: an emphatic form of “which,” used in questions
entries.example_cn: 我该选哪一本书呢？
entries.example_en: Whichever book shall I choose?

entries.definition_en: Emphatic form of 'which' as a pronoun.
entries.example_cn: 你想要哪一个都可以。
entries.example_en: Whichever you want is fine with me.

entries.definition_en: No matter which one(s).
entries.example_cn: 无论你挑哪几个，我都会买。
entries.example_en: Whichever ones you pick, I will buy them.

entries.definition_en: Any or either one(s) that fits.
entries.example_cn: 剩下的任何一个（或某些），请拿走。
entries.example_en: Whichever ones are left, please take them.

entries.definition_en: Any or either one(s) (informal).
entries.example_cn: 随便哪个，先拿点吃的吧。
entries.example_en: Whichever, just grab something to eat.

entries.definition_en: the characteristic sounds made by a horse
entries.example_cn: 马的轻柔嘶鸣声在马厩里回荡。
entries.example_en: The horse's soft whicker echoed through the stable.

entries.definition_en: to make a characteristic sound, of a horse
entries.example_cn: 小马驹看到母亲时兴奋地嘶鸣起来。
entries.example_en: The foal whickered with excitement when it saw its mother.

entries.definition_en: to smell something by inhaling air
entries.example_cn: 我从房间的另一头闻到了香水味。
entries.example_en: I whiffed the perfume from across the room.

entries.definition_en: to strike out by swinging and missing the third pitch
entries.example_cn: 投手想用曲球让击球手挥棒落空出局。
entries.example_en: The pitcher wanted to whiff the batter with a curveball.

entries.definition_en: to smoke by puffing on a cigarette, pipe, or similar implement
entries.example_cn: 他抽了口烟，吐出一团烟雾。
entries.example_en: He whiffed his cigarette and blew out a cloud of smoke.

entries.definition_en: to move something quickly as if blown by air
entries.example_cn: 他用一口气把纸吹到了桌子上。
entries.example_en: He whiffed the paper across the desk with his breath.

entries.definition_en: a short, light gust of air
entries.example_cn: 一阵微风把桌上的叶子吹落了。
entries.example_en: A whiff of wind blew the leaves off the table.

entries.definition_en: a strikeout in baseball when the batter swings and misses the third pitch
entries.example_cn: 击球手在最后一球时挥棒落空，被判三振出局。
entries.example_en: The batter took a whiff on the final pitch.

entries.definition_en: to speak or make a sound with a puff of air
entries.example_cn: 他呼出一口气，发出疲惫的叹息。
entries.example_en: He whiffed out a weary sigh.

entries.definition_en: a type of flounder fish found in coastal waters
entries.example_cn: 渔夫在浅水区钓到了一条左眼鲆。
entries.example_en: The fisherman caught a whiff in the shallow water.

entries.definition_en: a short period of time
entries.example_cn: 离开之前等一会儿。
entries.example_en: Wait a while before you leave.

entries.definition_en: At the same time as; during the period that.
entries.example_cn: 外面在下雨，但太阳却照耀着。
entries.example_en: The sun was shining whilst it was raining outside.

entries.definition_en: During the time; meanwhile.
entries.example_cn: 与此同时，我去叫托比爵士。
entries.example_en: I’ll call Sir Toby the whilst.

entries.definition_en: a sudden desire
entries.example_cn: 她一时兴起买了那条裙子。
entries.example_en: She bought the dress on a whim.

entries.definition_en: an odd or fanciful or capricious idea
entries.example_cn: 这个古怪的想法突然冒了出来。
entries.example_en: The idea came to him in a sudden whim.

entries.definition_en: cry weakly or softly
entries.example_cn: 那只小狗在房间的角落里呜咽着。
entries.example_en: The puppy whimpered in the corner of the room.

entries.definition_cn: 以哀怨呜咽的方式发出的抱怨
entries.definition_en: a complaint uttered in a plaintive whining way
entries.example_cn: 当她被告知停止工作时，她发出了一声抗议的呜咽。
entries.example_en: She let out a whimper of protest when she was told to stop working.

entries.definition_cn: 古怪、异想天开或任性的念头
entries.definition_en: an odd or fanciful or capricious idea
entries.example_cn: 他想在月球上建房子的计划纯属异想天开。
entries.example_en: His plan to build a house on the moon was pure whimsey.

entries.definition_cn: 凭一时冲动而非理智或判断行事的特质
entries.definition_en: the trait of acting unpredictably and more from whim or caprice than from reason or judgment
entries.example_cn: 他凭一时兴致作决定，表现出任性行事的倾向。
entries.example_en: His whimsical decision-making revealed a tendency toward whimsey.

entries.definition_en: determined by chance or impulse rather than by necessity or reason
entries.example_cn: 花园异想天开的设计让它看起来像童话世界。
entries.example_en: The whimsical design of the garden made it look like a fairy tale.

entries.definition_en: the quality of acting unpredictably based on sudden desires rather than reason
entries.example_cn: 他决策中的任性特质使得团队难以提前规划。
entries.example_en: The whimsicality of his decisions made it hard for his team to plan ahead.

entries.definition_en: the quality of behaving in a mischievous or playful manner like an imp
entries.example_cn: 孩子那顽皮的笑声充满了整个房间，带来了欢乐。
entries.example_en: The whimsicality of the child's laughter filled the room with joy.

entries.definition_en: in a fanciful manner
entries.example_cn: 这位艺术家异想天开地画出了像跳舞动物一样的云朵。
entries.example_en: The artist whimsically painted clouds that looked like dancing animals.

entries.definition_en: an odd or fanciful or capricious idea
entries.example_cn: 这个故事充满了奇想和魔法。
entries.example_en: The story was full of whimsy and magic.

entries.definition_en: the trait of acting unpredictably and more from whim or caprice than from reason or judgment
entries.example_cn: 他的任性常常让朋友们感到困惑。
entries.example_en: His whimsy often confused his friends.

entries.definition_en: a very spiny and dense evergreen shrub with fragrant golden-yellow flowers, common throughout western Europe
entries.example_cn: 徒步旅行者在暴风雨中躲在茂密的荆豆灌丛下。
entries.example_en: The hikers found shelter under the dense whin during the storm.

entries.definition_en: a small Eurasian shrub having clusters of yellow flowers that yield a dye, common as a weed in Britain and the United States
entries.example_cn: 园丁从花坛里拔除了入侵的染料木。
entries.example_en: The gardener pulled up the invasive whin from the flower bed.

entries.definition_cn: 各种坚硬的有色岩石，尤指燧石或玄武岩
entries.definition_en: any of various hard colored rocks, especially rocks consisting of chert or basalt
entries.example_cn: 这些古老的工具是用河床中发现的坚硬燧石或玄武岩雕刻而成的。
entries.example_en: The ancient tools were carved from a hard whin found in the riverbed.

entries.definition_en: a brown-and-buff European songbird found in grassy meadows
entries.example_cn: 我们在高草丛中发现了一只正在鸣唱的草原石䳭。
entries.example_en: We spotted a whinchat singing in the tall grass.

entries.definition_en: complain whiningly
entries.example_cn: 别抱怨天气了，快进去吧。
entries.example_en: Stop whining about the weather and get inside.

entries.definition_en: make a high-pitched, screeching noise
entries.example_cn: 当那辆旧车爬上陡峭的山坡时，开始发出高音刺耳的声音。
entries.example_en: The old car started to whine as it climbed the steep hill.

entries.definition_en: move with a whining sound
entries.example_cn: 门打开时，生锈的铰链开始发出尖叫声。
entries.example_en: The rusty hinge began to whine as the door opened.

entries.definition_en: talk in a tearful manner
entries.example_cn: 孩子开始带着哭腔说不想睡觉。
entries.example_en: The child began to whine about not wanting to go to bed.

entries.definition_en: a complaint uttered in a plaintive whining way
entries.example_cn: 他停止了抱怨，听老师讲课。
entries.example_en: He stopped his whine and listened to the teacher.

entries.definition_en: a person who complains continually, especially about minor problems
entries.example_cn: 别像个爱抱怨的人那样，直接解决问题吧。
entries.example_en: Stop acting like a whiner and just solve the problem.

entries.definition_en: habitually complaining in a whining manner
entries.example_cn: 当孩子不如意时，他开始爱抱怨。
entries.example_en: The child became whiney when he didn't get his way.

entries.definition_en: the characteristic sounds made by a horse
entries.example_cn: 这匹马看到骑手时发出了一声响亮的嘶鸣。
entries.example_en: The horse gave a loud whinny when it saw the rider.

entries.definition_en: make a characteristic sound, of a horse
entries.example_cn: 小马驹向母亲发出轻柔的嘶鸣。
entries.example_en: The foal whinnyed softly to its mother.

entries.definition_cn: 坚硬的、通常颜色较深的岩石
entries.definition_en: a hard, usually dark-colored rock
entries.example_cn: 这座古老的城堡墙壁是用这种坚硬的深色岩石建造的。
entries.example_en: The ancient castle walls were built from durable whinstone.

entries.definition_en: habitually complaining in a high-pitched, annoying way
entries.example_cn: 孩子们意识到得不到糖果时，开始爱发牢骚了。
entries.example_en: The children became whiny when they realized they wouldn't get any candy.

entries.definition_en: an instrument with a handle and a flexible lash used for whipping
entries.example_cn: 牛仔用长鞭引导马匹。
entries.example_en: The cowboy used a long whip to guide the horses.

entries.definition_cn: 负责执行党内纪律的议员；党鞭
entries.definition_en: a legislator appointed by the party to enforce discipline
entries.example_cn: 党鞭确保所有成员按时投票。
entries.example_en: The party whip ensured all members voted on time.

entries.definition_en: to beat severely with a whip or rod
entries.example_cn: 马被训练员鞭打了。
entries.example_en: The horse was whipped by the trainer.

entries.definition_en: to defeat thoroughly
entries.example_cn: 球队在决赛中彻底败给了冠军。
entries.example_en: The team was whipped by the champions in the final match.

entries.definition_en: to strike as if by whipping
entries.example_cn: 风雨猛烈地打在窗户上。
entries.example_en: The wind whipped the rain against the window.

entries.definition_en: to thrash about flexibly in the manner of a whiplash
entries.example_cn: 旗帜在强风中剧烈摆动。
entries.example_en: The flag whipped in the strong wind.

entries.definition_en: a dessert made of sugar and stiffly beaten egg whites or cream
entries.example_cn: 她端上了一份配新鲜浆果的轻甜点。
entries.example_en: She served a light whip with fresh berries.

entries.definition_en: the flexibility of the shaft of a golf club
entries.example_cn: 他选择了一支弹性较好的球杆进行开球。
entries.example_en: He chose a club with a softer whip for his drive.

entries.definition_cn: （英联邦、爱尔兰、英国，非正式）一群人临时凑集的钱，通常用于有益的目的；募捐
entries.definition_en: (Commonwealth, Ireland, UK, informal) a quick collection of money from a group, usually for a beneficial purpose
entries.example_cn: 社区组织了一次募捐来帮助洪水受害者。
entries.example_en: The community organized a whip-round to help the flood victims.

entries.definition_en: a tightly twisted, hard cord used for making whip lashes
entries.example_cn: 牛仔把鞭绳啪地一声抽响，让马匹开始奔跑。
entries.example_en: The cowboy cracked his whipcord to start the horses running.

entries.definition_en: a strong fabric made of worsted or cotton with a diagonal rib pattern
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一套由优质斜纹粗呢制成的西装。
entries.example_en: She wore a suit made of fine whipcord.

entries.definition_en: an injury to the neck caused by rapid acceleration or deceleration
entries.example_cn: 她在车祸中受了挥鞭伤。
entries.example_en: She suffered a whiplash in the car accident.

entries.definition_cn: 鞭梢；用鞭子抽打的一下
entries.definition_en: the lash of a whip; a quick blow delivered with it
entries.example_cn: 鞭梢落地时发出清脆的啪声。
entries.example_en: The whiplash struck the ground with a sharp crack.

entries.definition_cn: 用于搅打奶油等物质的器具
entries.definition_en: a device used to whip a substance such as cream
entries.example_cn: 她用搅打器把奶油打得轻盈蓬松。
entries.example_en: She used a whipper to make the cream light and fluffy.

entries.definition_en: a person who punishes someone by hitting them with a whip
entries.example_cn: 这位鞭打者以纪律严明而闻名。
entries.example_en: The whipper was known for his strict discipline.

entries.definition_cn: 猎人的助手，负责防止猎犬走散，并在必要时将它们赶回追猎
entries.definition_en: a huntsman's assistant who keeps hounds from wandering and drives them into the chase
entries.example_cn: 猎犬助手呼唤猎犬到起点。
entries.example_en: The whipper-in called the hounds to the starting point.

entries.definition_en: someone who is unimportant but cheeky and presumptuous
entries.example_cn: 老船长无视那个不知天高地厚的小子的无礼评论。
entries.example_en: The old captain ignored the whippersnapper's rude comments.

entries.definition_en: a small, slender dog of the greyhound type that originated in England
entries.example_cn: 惠比特犬飞快地追球。
entries.example_en: The whippet ran quickly after the ball.

entries.definition_cn: （俚语）一罐笑气，用作娱乐性吸入毒品
entries.definition_en: a cartridge of nitrous oxide (laughing gas), used as a recreational inhalant drug
entries.example_cn: 他因持有笑气罐和其他吸毒用具而被捕。
entries.example_en: He was arrested for possessing whippets and other drug paraphernalia.

entries.definition_en: beating someone with a whip, strap, or rope as a punishment
entries.example_cn: 这名囚犯因犯罪受到了严厉的鞭打。
entries.example_en: The prisoner received a severe whipping for his crimes.

entries.definition_en: a sound defeat
entries.example_cn: 这支球队在最后一场比赛中惨败。
entries.example_en: The team suffered a whipping in the final match.

entries.definition_cn: （奶油等食物的）打发；搅打起泡
entries.definition_en: a cooking technique in which air is incorporated into cream or another food
entries.example_cn: 把奶油打发后，质地变得轻盈蓬松。
entries.example_en: Whipping the cream made it light and fluffy.

entries.definition_en: a sewing stitch passing over an edge diagonally
entries.example_cn: 她用整齐的斜向缝合完成了下摆。
entries.example_en: She finished the hem with a neat whipping.

entries.definition_en: smart and fashionable
entries.example_cn: 她穿了一套时髦的服装去参加聚会。
entries.example_en: She wore a whipping outfit to the party.

entries.definition_cn: 北美夜鹰（一种夜行食虫鸟）
entries.definition_en: a nocturnal insectivorous North American bird with grey-and-white plumage, a type of nightjar
entries.example_cn: 我们在黑暗的森林里听到了夜鹰那怪异的叫声。
entries.example_en: We heard the eerie call of a whippoorwill in the dark forest.

entries.definition_en: bending and snapping back readily without breaking
entries.example_cn: 那些柔韧的枝条在风中弯曲却没有折断。
entries.example_en: The whippy branches bent in the wind but did not break.

entries.definition_cn: （尤指在赌博或谈判中）欺骗；使陷入困境
entries.definition_en: to victimize someone, especially in gambling or negotiations
entries.example_cn: 交易员通过迅速改变立场欺骗了投资者。
entries.example_en: The trader whipsawed the investor by changing his position rapidly.

entries.definition_en: to cut with a whipsaw
entries.example_cn: 工人们用双柄锯锯木材以适配框架。
entries.example_en: The workers whipsawn the timber to fit the frame.

entries.definition_en: a saw with handles at both ends, used by two people
entries.example_cn: 他们用双柄锯锯断了那根粗木头。
entries.example_en: They used a whipsaw to cut the thick log.

entries.definition_en: a very agile and alert lizard found in the New World
entries.example_cn: 鞭尾蜥迅速穿过滚烫的沙地以躲避高温。
entries.example_en: The whiptail darted across the hot sand to escape the heat.

entries.definition_en: to make a soft swishing sound while moving quickly
entries.example_cn: 风扇呼呼作响，为房间降温。
entries.example_en: The fan whirred loudly as it cooled the room.

entries.definition_en: a sound made by something moving rapidly
entries.example_cn: 直升机从头顶飞过，发出巨大的呼啸声。
entries.example_en: The helicopter flew overhead, creating a loud whir.

entries.definition_en: to turn in a twisting or spinning motion
entries.example_cn: 舞者在舞台上旋转。
entries.example_en: The dancer whirled around the stage.

entries.definition_en: to cause something to spin
entries.example_cn: 她把球在绳子上旋转。
entries.example_en: She whirled the ball on the string.

entries.definition_en: to flow in a circular current, typically of liquids
entries.example_cn: 水在下水道里打旋。
entries.example_en: The water whirled down the drain.

entries.definition_en: something that whirls, such as a whirlwind
entries.example_cn: 龙卷风形成了一个可怕的旋涡。
entries.example_en: The tornado formed a terrifying whirl.

entries.definition_en: the act of rotating rapidly
entries.example_cn: 吊扇的快速旋转令人舒缓。
entries.example_en: The whirl of the ceiling fan was soothing.

entries.definition_cn: 短暂的尝试，通常用于短语 give it a whirl
entries.definition_en: a brief experiment or attempt, usually in the phrase give it a whirl
entries.example_cn: 他在离开前试着修了一下漏水处。
entries.example_en: He gave fixing the leak a whirl before leaving.

entries.definition_cn: 绕自身轴快速反复旋转
entries.definition_en: to revolve quickly and repeatedly around one's own axis
entries.example_cn: 地球每天绕自身轴旋转一次。
entries.example_en: The earth whirls on its axis once every day.

entries.definition_en: a state of confused or dizzy movement
entries.example_cn: 那次乘坐让我感觉像是在眩晕中。
entries.example_en: The ride made me feel like I was in a whirl.

entries.definition_en: a conical toy that spins on a sharp point
entries.example_cn: 孩子们在花园里玩了一个色彩斑斓的陀螺。
entries.example_en: The children played with a colorful whirligig in the garden.

entries.definition_en: a large amusement park ride that rotates with seats for children
entries.example_cn: 我们在集市上花了一下午时间乘坐那个巨大的旋转木马。
entries.example_en: We spent the afternoon riding the giant whirligig at the fair.

entries.definition_en: to spin or whirl rapidly like a whirligig
entries.example_cn: 树叶在风中像陀螺一样旋转。
entries.example_en: The leaves whirled in the wind like a whirligig.

entries.definition_en: the act of rotating in a circle or spiral
entries.example_cn: 舞者裙摆的旋转创造了一个美丽的图案。
entries.example_en: The whirling of the dancer's skirt created a beautiful pattern.

entries.definition_en: a strong circular movement of water
entries.example_cn: 船被卷入漩涡中。
entries.example_en: The boat was caught in a whirlpool.

entries.definition_en: a hot tub or Jacuzzi
entries.example_cn: 晚饭后，乔治在按摩浴缸里放松。
entries.example_en: After dinner, George relaxed in the whirlpool.

entries.definition_cn: 混乱或激动不安的状态
entries.definition_en: a state of turmoil or agitated excitement
entries.example_cn: 这则突然的公告使办公室陷入一片混乱。
entries.example_en: The sudden announcement threw the office into a whirlpool of confusion.

entries.definition_cn: 像漩涡中的水一样旋转；打旋
entries.definition_en: to move in a circular current
entries.example_cn: 水开始在岩石周围形成漩涡。
entries.example_en: The water began to whirlpool around the rock.

entries.definition_en: a vertical column of air that whirls around itself while moving over the Earth's surface
entries.example_cn: 这场猛烈的旋风摧毁了山谷里的几座房屋。
entries.example_en: The whirlwind, a violent vortex of air, destroyed several houses in the valley.

entries.definition_en: an aircraft without wings that obtains its lift from the rotation of overhead blades
entries.example_cn: 直升机在峡谷上方无声地盘旋。
entries.example_en: The whirlybird hovered silently above the valley.

entries.definition_en: a sound made by something moving quickly
entries.example_cn: 直升机旋翼发出巨大的嗡嗡声，正向我们靠近。
entries.example_en: The helicopter blades created a loud whirr as it approached.

entries.definition_en: to make a soft swishing sound
entries.example_cn: 风扇启动时发出了嗡嗡声。
entries.example_en: The fan began to whirr as it started up.

usage.label: intransitive
usage.pattern: make a sibilant buzzing or droning sound

entries.definition_cn: 发出嗡嗡声飞行或移动
entries.definition_en: to move or fly with a whirring sound
entries.example_cn: 鸟儿发出嗡嗡声穿过河上方的树林。
entries.example_en: The birds whirred through the trees above the river.

entries.definition_en: the sound of something moving rapidly
entries.example_cn: 直升机的嗡嗡声充满了空气。
entries.example_en: The whirring of the helicopter filled the air.

entries.definition_en: producing a whirring sound
entries.example_cn: 嗡嗡作响的风扇让大家都无法入睡。
entries.example_en: The whirring fan kept everyone awake.

entries.definition_en: to make a sharp, sibilant sound like 'whish'
entries.example_cn: 箭咻地穿过空气，然后击中目标。
entries.example_en: The arrow whished through the air before hitting the target.

entries.definition_en: to move quickly making a sibilant sound
entries.example_cn: 汽车咻地一声从我们身边高速驶过。
entries.example_en: The car whished past us at high speed.

entries.definition_en: to move someone or something somewhere very quickly
entries.example_cn: 警察必须在人群到达之前迅速把嫌疑人带走。
entries.example_en: The police officer had to whisk the suspect away before the crowd arrived.

entries.definition_en: to beat or whip with a wire whisk
entries.example_cn: 你需要将奶油搅打至出现坚挺的峰状。
entries.example_en: You need to whisk the cream until it forms stiff peaks.

entries.definition_en: to move quickly and skillfully
entries.example_cn: 体操运动员以非凡的敏捷身手在平衡木上快速移动。
entries.example_en: The gymnast whisked across the balance beam with remarkable agility.

entries.definition_en: to brush or wipe off something lightly
entries.example_cn: 她用纸巾轻轻拂去桌上的碎屑。
entries.example_en: She whisked the crumbs off the table with a napkin.

entries.definition_en: a kitchen tool with a coil of wires used for beating eggs or cream
entries.example_cn: 她用打蛋器将鸡蛋打至蓬松。
entries.example_en: She used a whisk to beat the eggs until they were fluffy.

entries.definition_en: a small handheld broom, often with a short handle, used for brushing or sweeping
entries.example_cn: 他用衣刷掸去西装上的灰尘。
entries.example_en: He used a whisk to brush the dust off his suit.

entries.definition_en: a very small distance or space
entries.example_cn: 那辆车擦着墙壁过去了，只差一点点。
entries.example_en: The car missed the wall by a whisker.

usage.label: colloquial
usage.pattern: by a whisker means by a very small distance.

entries.definition_en: a long stiff hair growing from the snout or brow of most mammals as e.g. a cat
entries.example_cn: 当猫闻到鱼腥味时，它的触须动了动。
entries.example_en: The cat twitched its whisker when it smelled the fish.

entries.definition_en: furnish with whiskers
entries.example_cn: 漫画家给这个人物添上了胡须，画出了一大把小胡子。
entries.example_en: The cartoonist whiskered the character, giving him a large moustache.

entries.definition_en: having whiskers, especially on the cheeks and chin or on an animal’s muzzle
entries.example_cn: 那位老人脸上长满了长长的白胡须。
entries.example_en: The old man had a face covered with long white whiskers.

entries.definition_en: having coarse hair on the cheeks and chin
entries.example_cn: 他面颊和下巴长满粗毛的样子表明他已经几天没刮胡子了。
entries.example_en: His whiskery appearance suggested he had not shaved for several days.

entries.definition_en: a strong alcoholic drink made from fermented grain
entries.example_cn: 他更喜欢威士忌而不是其他类型的烈酒。
entries.example_en: He prefers whiskey over other types of liquor.

entries.definition_en: a strong alcoholic drink made from fermented grain
entries.example_cn: 他更喜欢威士忌而不是其他烈酒。
entries.example_en: He prefers whisky over other spirits.

entries.definition_en: to speak very softly
entries.example_cn: 请小声说话，别吵醒宝宝。
entries.example_en: Please whisper so we don't wake the baby.

entries.definition_cn: 轻声说话（通常不振动声带）
entries.definition_en: speech produced in a very soft voice, often without vocal-cord vibration
entries.example_cn: 她凑近去听他的耳语。
entries.example_en: She leaned in to hear his whisper.

entries.definition_cn: 传闻；未经证实的消息（通常用复数）
entries.definition_en: a rumor or unconfirmed report, usually used in the plural
entries.example_cn: 到处都有叛乱的传闻。
entries.example_en: There are whispers of rebellion all around.

entries.definition_en: a very light noise
entries.example_cn: 微风轻拂，树叶沙沙作响。
